formal.mt: In-numru ta' parteċipanti għadu tablagħadd, għax ir-reġistrazzjoni għadha miftuħa.
formal.en: The number of participants is still indeterminate because registration remains open.
formal.zh: 由于报名仍在进行，参加人数尚未确定。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kemm se jiġu nies għall-ikla? Pawlu: In-numru għadu tablagħadd; mhux kulħadd wieġeb.
colloquial.en: Maja: How many people are coming to dinner? Pawlu: The number is still indeterminate; not everyone has replied.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：有多少人来吃饭？保罗：人数还没确定，还有人没回复。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 有多少人来吃饭？
messages.en: How many people are coming to dinner?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (聚餐组织者)
messages.mt_spoken: In-numru għadu tablagħadd; mhux kulħadd wieġeb.
messages.mt_standard: In-numru għadu tablagħadd; mhux kulħadd wieġeb.
messages.zh: 人数还没确定，还有人没回复。
messages.en: The number is still indeterminate; not everyone has replied.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它放进“人数还没定”的场景记忆：人数和结果尚无定论时，联想到 tablagħadd。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action of beating something or crushing it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某物进行敲打，或将其压碎、捣碎的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għemil ta' swat jew ta' tfarrik ta' xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 敲打；击打这一动作。
压碎；捣碎这一动作。

formal.mt: It-tablit tal-ġebel isir biex il-biċċiet il-kbar jitkissru f'biċċiet iżgħar.
formal.en: The crushing of stone is carried out to break large pieces into smaller ones.
formal.zh: 捣碎石料是为了把大块石头变成较小的碎块。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhu dak il-ħoss mill-ħanut tax-xogħol? Mark: Huwa t-tablit bil-martell; qed ikissru l-ġebel.
colloquial.en: Lara: What's that noise from the workshop? Mark: It's the hammering; they're breaking up stone.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：作坊里那是什么声音？马克：是锤子敲打的声音，他们在敲碎石头。

messages.speaker: Lara (邻居)
messages.zh: 作坊里那是什么声音？
messages.en: What's that noise from the workshop?

messages.speaker: Mark (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa t-tablit bil-martell; qed ikissru l-ġebel.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa t-tablit bil-martell; qed ikissru l-ġebel.
messages.zh: 是锤子敲打的声音，他们在敲碎石头。
messages.en: It's the hammering; they're breaking up stone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象锤子连续敲击，最后把石头捣碎；用这段动作画面连接“敲打”和“压碎”两个名词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A surname used as a family name.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用作家族姓氏的专有名称，书写时首字母大写。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kunjom li jintuża bħala isem tal-familja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 姓氏；家族名称。

formal.mt: Is-Sinjura Tabone talbet kopja tad-dokument.
formal.en: Mrs Tabone requested a copy of the document.
formal.zh: Tabone 女士申请了一份文件副本。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għandi appuntament mas-Sur Tabone. Nina: Iva, is-Sur Tabone qed jistenniek.
colloquial.en: Sara: I have an appointment with Mr Tabone. Nina: Yes, Mr Tabone is waiting for you.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我和 Tabone 先生有预约。妮娜：好的，Tabone 先生正在等您。

messages.speaker: Sara (访客)
messages.zh: 我和 Tabone 先生有预约。
messages.en: I have an appointment with Mr Tabone.

messages.speaker: Nina (接待员)
messages.zh: 好的，Tabone 先生正在等您。
messages.en: Yes, Mr Tabone is waiting for you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象门牌写着“Tabone 一家”，再配上“Tabone 先生”的称呼，记住这是首字母大写的姓氏。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action of removing the contents of something so that it becomes empty.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把容器或其他事物中的内容物移走，使其变空的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għemil li jitneħħa l-kontenut ta' xi ħaġa sabiex tibqa' vojta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 排空；倒空；清除内部内容物的过程。

formal.mt: It-tabtil tat-tank għandu jitlesta qabel ma jibda t-tindif.
formal.en: The emptying of the tank must be completed before cleaning begins.
formal.zh: 开始清洗之前，必须先完成储罐的排空工作。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Lestejtu t-tabtil tal-kaxxi? Ben: Kważi; fadal biss il-kaxxa tal-kotba.
colloquial.en: Anna: Have you finished emptying the boxes? Ben: Almost; only the box of books is left.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你们把箱子都清空了吗？本：差不多了，只剩装书的那个箱子。

messages.speaker: Anna (室友)
messages.zh: 你们把箱子都清空了吗？
messages.en: Have you finished emptying the boxes?

messages.speaker: Ben (室友)
messages.zh: 差不多了，只剩装书的那个箱子。
messages.en: Almost; only the box of books is left.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tabtil 想成清空箱子的整个过程：东西一件件拿出来，最后箱子变空，记住它是动作名词。

gloss_zh: 被强迫缴付的钱款；乱子；麻烦

teaching_sense.en_definition: A sum of money that someone is forced to pay; also, a mess or troublesome situation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被迫缴付的一笔钱；也指混乱、乱子或令人头痛的麻烦。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Somma flus li wieħed ikun imġiegħel iħallas; ukoll, taħwid jew sitwazzjoni ta' nkwiet.

sense_translations.en_definition: sum of money to be paid coercively
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被强迫缴付的一笔钱款。
混乱；乱子；麻烦。

collocations.en: to pay a sum under coercion

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi tabxa li n-nies kienu mġiegħla jħallsu.
formal.en: The report describes a sum of money that people were forced to pay.
formal.zh: 报告描述了一笔人们被迫缴付的钱款。

colloquial.mt: Maja: F'liema tabxa dħalna! Għandna żewġ prenotazzjonijiet għall-istess ħin. Leo: Ċempel ir-ristorant; forsi nistgħu nbiddlu waħda.
colloquial.en: Maja: What a mess we've got ourselves into! We have two bookings for the same time. Leo: Call the restaurant; perhaps we can change one.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这下可麻烦了！我们有两个预约撞在同一时间。利奥：给餐厅打个电话吧，也许能改掉其中一个。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: F'liema tabxa dħalna! Għandna żewġ prenotazzjonijiet għall-istess ħin.
messages.mt_standard: F'liema tabxa dħalna! Għandna żewġ prenotazzjonijiet għall-istess ħin.
messages.zh: 这下可麻烦了！我们有两个预约撞在同一时间。
messages.en: What a mess we've got ourselves into! We have two bookings for the same time.

messages.speaker: Leo (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ċempel ir-ristorant; forsi nistgħu nbiddlu waħda.
messages.mt_standard: Ċempel ir-ristorant; forsi nistgħu nbiddlu waħda.
messages.zh: 给餐厅打个电话吧，也许能改掉其中一个。
messages.en: Call the restaurant; perhaps we can change one.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个独立画面记忆：一幅是被逼交钱，另一幅是预约撞期的乱子；两幅画面分别对应两个词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To send something through the air by throwing it, including casually chucking it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用手将某物抛向空中或某个方向，也可指随手一扔。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitfa' xi ħaġa fl-arja jew lejn post, ukoll b'mod każwali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 扔；投；抛。
随手扔；随意抛出。

collocations.en: he chucked the paper into the bin
collocations.zh: 他把纸随手扔进垃圾桶

formal.mt: Il-plejer tafa' l-ballun lil sieħbu waqt it-taħriġ.
formal.en: The player threw the ball to his teammate during training.
formal.zh: 训练时，那名球员把球抛给了队友。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Fejn mar il-ballun? Sam: Mark tafa' l-ballun fuq is-saqaf! Nina: Mela rridu nġibuh minn hemm.
colloquial.en: Nina: Where did the ball go? Sam: Mark threw the ball onto the roof! Nina: Then we need to get it down from there.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：球到哪里去了？萨姆：马克把球扔到屋顶上了！妮娜：那我们得把它弄下来。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 球到哪里去了？
messages.en: Where did the ball go?

messages.speaker: Sam (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克把球扔到屋顶上了！
messages.en: Mark threw the ball onto the roof!

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 那我们得把它弄下来。
messages.en: Then we need to get it down from there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象球从手里飞出去的弧线，联结“扔、抛”的动作；抄写 tafa' 时也要保留末尾的撇号。

gloss_zh: 用陶土制作；养育儿童；陶土工匠

teaching_sense.en_definition: To work with clay or make clay objects; also, to bring up a child.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使用陶土进行制作，或制作陶土器物；另有养育儿童的意思。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jaħdem bit-tafal jew jagħmel oġġetti minnu; ukoll, irabbi tifel jew tifla.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使用陶土；以陶土进行制作。
制作陶土器物。
在幼年时期抚养、养育。
以陶土制作器物的工匠；陶土工匠。

collocations.en: he worked with clay by hand
collocations.zh: 他用双手进行陶土制作

collocations.en: he worked with clay to make vases

formal.mt: L-artiġjan taffal bl-idejn biex jagħmel vażun għall-wirja.
formal.en: The craftsman worked with clay by hand to make a vase for the exhibition.
formal.zh: 那位工匠用双手制作陶土花瓶，供展览使用。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'għamel Pawlu fil-lezzjoni tal-arti? Ben: Taffal u għamel skutella żgħira. Lara: Ħa naraha meta tinxef!
colloquial.en: Lara: What did Pawlu do in art class? Ben: He worked with clay and made a small bowl. Lara: Let me see it when it dries!
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：保罗在美术课上做了什么？本：他用陶土做了一个小碗。拉拉：等干了让我看看！

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗在美术课上做了什么？
messages.en: What did Pawlu do in art class?

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.zh: 他用陶土做了一个小碗。
messages.en: He worked with clay and made a small bowl.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 等干了让我看看！
messages.en: Let me see it when it dries!

cognitive_memory_aid: 分格记忆：动词格放“用陶土、做陶器、养育儿童”，名词格放“陶土工匠”；按语境辨义，不把这些义项当作词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Connected with clay or concerning clay.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与陶土有联系的；涉及陶土的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mat-tafal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 与陶土有关的；涉及陶土的。

formal.mt: Il-katalgu jiddeskrivi l-materjal taffali u l-użu tiegħu fil-produzzjoni tal-vażuni.
formal.en: The catalogue describes the clay-related material and its use in the production of vases.
formal.zh: 目录介绍了与陶土有关的材料，以及它在花瓶制作中的用途。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Illum se nagħmlu xogħol taffali? Rita: Iva, kull wieħed se jagħmel skutella bit-tafal.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are we doing clay work today? Rita: Yes, everyone is going to make a bowl from clay.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：今天我们要做陶土作品吗？丽塔：对，每个人都要用陶土做一个碗。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 今天我们要做陶土作品吗？
messages.en: Are we doing clay work today?

messages.speaker: Rita (美术老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kull wieħed se jagħmel skutella bit-tafal.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kull wieħed se jagħmel skutella bit-tafal.
messages.zh: 对，每个人都要用陶土做一个碗。
messages.en: Yes, everyone is going to make a bowl from clay.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象给材料或制作活动贴上“与陶土有关”的标签；taffali 就是这张形容词标签，用来说明事物的性质。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who helps reduce someone's pain, distress, or difficulty.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 帮助减轻他人疼痛、苦恼或困难的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tgħin biex jonqsu l-uġigħ, it-tbatija jew id-diffikultajiet ta' xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 缓解者；帮助减轻痛苦或困难的人。
具有减轻或缓解作用的。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, it-tabib jidher bħala taffej tal-uġigħ u tal-biża' tal-pazjenti.
formal.en: In the story, the doctor appears as someone who alleviates the patients' pain and fear.
formal.zh: 在故事中，这位医生是帮助病人减轻疼痛与恐惧的人。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex sejjaħtlu taffej? Mark: Għax dejjem isib mod kif inaqqas it-tbatija ta' ħaddieħor.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you call him someone who brings relief? Mark: Because he always finds a way to lessen other people's suffering.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么称他为缓解他人痛苦的人？马克：因为他总能想办法减轻别人的苦难。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么称他为缓解他人痛苦的人？
messages.en: Why did you call him someone who brings relief?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax dejjem isib mod kif inaqqas it-tbatija ta' ħaddieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Għax dejjem isib mod kif inaqqas it-tbatija ta' ħaddieħor.
messages.zh: 因为他总能想办法减轻别人的苦难。
messages.en: Because he always finds a way to lessen other people's suffering.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个替别人卸下沉重背包的人：名词指缓解者，形容词则强调具有缓解作用。

gloss_zh: 疼痛缓解；晕厥感；灭火；一次晕厥

teaching_sense.en_definition: A reduction in pain that brings a feeling of relief.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 疼痛程度减轻、让人感到舒缓的状态或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tnaqqis fl-uġigħ li jġib sens ta' serħan.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 疼痛的减轻或缓解。
感到发晕、仿佛将要昏倒的状态。
火焰的扑灭或熄灭。
一次晕厥；一次短暂失去知觉的发作。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi t-tafja tal-fjammi u l-ħidma tal-ħaddiema fuq il-post.
formal.en: The report describes the extinguishing of the flames and the work of the personnel at the scene.
formal.zh: 报告描述了火焰的扑灭过程以及现场人员的工作。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Ħassejt xi tafja tal-uġigħ? Pawlu: Iva, issa qed inħossni aħjar.
colloquial.en: Anna: Have you felt any relief from the pain? Pawlu: Yes, I'm feeling better now.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：疼痛有缓解一些吗？保罗：有，我现在感觉好些了。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 疼痛有缓解一些吗？
messages.en: Have you felt any relief from the pain?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 有，我现在感觉好些了。
messages.en: Yes, I'm feeling better now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用四格图分别记疼痛变轻、眼前发晕、火焰熄灭和一次昏倒；尤其区分晕厥感与真正发生的一次晕厥。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action of pressing or squashing something until it becomes flat.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某物挤压或压制到扁平状态的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għafis ta' xi ħaġa sakemm issir ċatta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 持续挤压直到物体变扁；压扁。

formal.mt: It-taftir tal-bottijiet inaqqas l-ispazju li jieħdu waqt il-ħażna.
formal.en: Flattening the cans reduces the space they occupy during storage.
formal.zh: 把罐子压扁可以减少它们在存放时占用的空间。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex qed tagħmel it-taftir ta' dawn il-kaxxi? Ben: Biex jieħdu inqas spazju fil-karozza.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why are you flattening these boxes? Ben: So they take up less space in the car.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：你为什么把这些箱子压扁？本：这样它们在车里占的空间就小一些。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed tagħmel it-taftir ta' dawn il-kaxxi?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed tagħmel it-taftir ta' dawn il-kaxxi?
messages.zh: 你为什么把这些箱子压扁？
messages.en: Why are you flattening these boxes?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.zh: 这样它们在车里占的空间就小一些。
messages.en: So they take up less space in the car.

cognitive_memory_aid: 脑中播放一个立体纸箱逐渐被压成薄片的画面，重点记住动作的结果是变扁。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To stab someone or something with a dagger.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用匕首刺向某人或某物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ta daqqa lil xi ħadd jew lil xi ħaġa b'daga.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用匕首刺；以匕首刺击。
匕首，一种短的刺击兵器。

collocations.en: stabbed the enemy with a dagger

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-ħalliel tagħan lill-gwardjan b'daga u ħarab.
formal.en: In the story, the thief stabbed the guard with a dagger and fled.
formal.zh: 在故事中，小偷用匕首刺了守卫后逃走了。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi jfisser 'tagħan' f'din is-sentenza? Ben: Ifisser li ta daqqa lil xi ħadd b'daga.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does 'tagħan' mean in this sentence? Ben: It means that he stabbed someone with a dagger.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：这句话里的“tagħan”是什么意思？本：意思是他用匕首刺了某个人。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 这句话里的“tagħan”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'tagħan' mean in this sentence?

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li ta daqqa lil xi ħadd b'daga.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li ta daqqa lil xi ħadd b'daga.
messages.zh: 意思是他用匕首刺了某个人。
messages.en: It means that he stabbed someone with a dagger.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画两张学习卡：一张写匕首这件物品，一张写用匕首刺这个动作；同形词要按名词和动词分别记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A feeling of anger that can become very intense.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 生气、愤怒的情绪，也可指程度强烈的暴怒。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sens ta' rabja li jista' jkun qawwi ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 生气；愤怒。
暴怒；非常强烈的愤怒。

formal.mt: L-awtur juri t-tagħbid tal-karattru permezz ta' kliem iebes u ġesti vjolenti.
formal.en: The author conveys the character's rage through harsh words and violent gestures.
formal.zh: 作者通过严厉的话语和激烈的动作表现人物的暴怒。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għad għandek dak it-tagħbid kollu? Pawlu: Le, issa kkalmajt u nistgħu nitkellmu.
colloquial.en: Anna: Are you still feeling all that anger? Pawlu: No, I've calmed down now and we can talk.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你还那么生气吗？保罗：没有，我现在平静下来了，我们可以谈谈。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 你还那么生气吗？
messages.en: Are you still feeling all that anger?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, issa kkalmajt u nistgħu nitkellmu.
messages.mt_standard: Le, issa kkalmajt u nistgħu nitkellmu.
messages.zh: 没有，我现在平静下来了，我们可以谈谈。
messages.en: No, I've calmed down now and we can talk.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把情绪画成温度计：较低刻度是愤怒，最高刻度是暴怒；这个词的两个义项体现强度差别。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of putting goods or other items onto or into a vehicle or container.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把货物或其他物品放上或放进车辆、容器的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li fih jitqiegħdu oġġetti jew merkanzija fuq vettura jew f'kontenitur.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 装载；把货物或物品装入运输工具、容器等的过程。

formal.mt: It-tagħbien tal-merkanzija fuq it-trakk għandu jitlesta qabel it-tmienja ta' filgħodu.
formal.en: Loading the goods onto the truck must be completed before eight in the morning.
formal.zh: 把货物装上卡车的工作必须在早上八点前完成。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Lest it-tagħbien tat-trakk? Rita: Kważi; għad fadal żewġ kaxxi.
colloquial.en: Mark: Is the truck loading finished? Rita: Almost; there are two boxes left.
colloquial.zh: 马克：卡车装好货了吗？丽塔：快了，还剩两个箱子。

messages.speaker: Mark (司机)
messages.zh: 卡车装好货了吗？
messages.en: Is the truck loading finished?

messages.speaker: Rita (仓库同事)
messages.zh: 快了，还剩两个箱子。
messages.en: Almost; there are two boxes left.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象箱子一件件进入卡车的连续画面，把这个名词记成整个装货过程，而不是某一件货物。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Unjust or cruel treatment that places people under oppressive control.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以不公正或残酷的方式控制、压制他人的待遇。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Trattament inġust jew krudili li jżomm lin-nies taħt kontroll oppressiv.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 压迫；以权力或强制手段对人进行不公正的控制和压制。
苛刻；严酷；待人或行事缺乏温和与体谅。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi t-tagħbir li sofrew il-ħaddiema u jitlob kundizzjonijiet tax-xogħol aktar ġusti.
formal.en: The report describes the oppression suffered by the workers and calls for fairer working conditions.
formal.zh: 报告描述了工人遭受的压迫，并呼吁提供更加公平的工作条件。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dak li qed jgħaddu minnu l-ħaddiema hu tagħbir. Mark: Naqbel; ħadd ma għandu jiġi ttrattat hekk.
colloquial.en: Maja: What the workers are going through is oppression. Mark: I agree; nobody should be treated like that.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：工人们正在遭受的就是压迫。马克：我同意，任何人都不应该受到这样的对待。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak li qed jgħaddu minnu l-ħaddiema hu tagħbir.
messages.mt_standard: Dak li qed jgħaddu minnu l-ħaddiema hu tagħbir.
messages.zh: 工人们正在遭受的就是压迫。
messages.en: What the workers are going through is oppression.

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Naqbel; ħadd ma għandu jiġi ttrattat hekk.
messages.mt_standard: Naqbel; ħadd ma għandu jiġi ttrattat hekk.
messages.zh: 我同意，任何人都不应该受到这样的对待。
messages.en: I agree; nobody should be treated like that.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅画区分义项：权力把人压住表示压迫，冷硬严厉的待人态度表示苛刻；两者都联系到人的处境。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process by which something becomes obscured, less clear, or less visible.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某物逐渐被遮住、变得不清楚或不易看见的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li fih xi ħaġa ssir inqas ċara jew inqas viżibbli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被遮蔽或变得模糊不清的过程。

formal.mt: Id-duħħan wassal għal tagħbix gradwali tal-veduta tal-port.
formal.en: The smoke caused the view of the harbour to become gradually obscured.
formal.zh: 烟雾使港口的景象逐渐变得模糊。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ma nistax nara l-port sew? Mark: Dan it-tagħbix ġej miċ-ċpar; stenna ftit sakemm jiċċara.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why can't I see the harbour clearly? Mark: This obscuring of the view comes from the fog; wait a little until it clears.
colloquial.zh: Maja：为什么我看不清港口？Mark：视野变模糊是因为起雾了，稍等一会儿，等雾散开。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ma nistax nara l-port sew?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ma nistax nara l-port sew?
messages.zh: 为什么我看不清港口？
messages.en: Why can't I see the harbour clearly?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan it-tagħbix ġej miċ-ċpar; stenna ftit sakemm jiċċara.
messages.mt_standard: Dan it-tagħbix ġej miċ-ċpar; stenna ftit sakemm jiċċara.
messages.zh: 视野变模糊是因为起雾了，稍等一会儿，等雾散开。
messages.en: This obscuring of the view comes from the fog; wait a little until it clears.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象港口逐渐被雾遮住：用画面记住这个词强调“变得看不清的过程”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of counting items or determining how many there are.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 逐个计算物品或确定其总数的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tgħodd oġġetti jew issib kemm hemm minnhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 计数、点数或清点数量的行为。

formal.mt: It-tagħdid tal-voti sar fil-preżenza ta' żewġ osservaturi.
formal.en: The counting of the votes took place in the presence of two observers.
formal.zh: 选票清点工作在两名观察员在场的情况下进行。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Lestejt it-tagħdid tal-muniti? Mark: Iva, b'kollox hemm għoxrin munita.
colloquial.en: Maja: Have you finished counting the coins? Mark: Yes, there are twenty coins altogether.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你清点完硬币了吗？Mark：清点完了，总共有二十枚。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你清点完硬币了吗？
messages.en: Have you finished counting the coins?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 清点完了，总共有二十枚。
messages.en: Yes, there are twenty coins altogether.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把硬币一枚枚排好并数数：这个名词指“清点”这一动作，而不是最后得到的数字。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The removal of hair from the body.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将身体某个部位的毛发去除的行为或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-tneħħija tax-xagħar minn xi parti tal-ġisem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 脱毛，即去除身体毛发的处理。
去除毛发的行为或过程。

formal.mt: Is-salon joffri servizzi ta' tagħdil bix-xama' fuq appuntament.
formal.en: The salon offers waxing services by appointment.
formal.zh: 这家美容院提供需预约的蜜蜡脱毛服务。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Nixtieq appuntament għat-tagħdil tas-saqajn. Rita: Żgur, għandna post għada filgħodu.
colloquial.en: Maja: I'd like an appointment for leg hair removal. Rita: Certainly, we have an opening tomorrow morning.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我想预约腿部脱毛。Rita：当然可以，我们明天上午有空位。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.zh: 我想预约腿部脱毛。
messages.en: I'd like an appointment for leg hair removal.

messages.speaker: Rita (美容院接待员)
messages.zh: 当然可以，我们明天上午有空位。
messages.en: Certainly, we have an opening tomorrow morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它放进美容院预约的画面：从腿上去除毛发，就是这个词所指的“脱毛”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of becoming bony or turning into bone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 逐渐具有骨的性质或转变为骨组织的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li fih xi ħaġa ssir għadam jew tieħu karatteristiċi tal-għadam.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得具有骨质或骨性特征的过程。
发生骨化、逐渐转变为骨组织的过程。

formal.mt: Id-dijagramma turi t-tagħdim tal-qarquċa matul l-iżvilupp tal-għadam.
formal.en: The diagram shows the ossification of cartilage during bone development.
formal.zh: 这幅示意图展示了骨骼发育过程中软骨的骨化。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'qed turi din l-istampa? Mark: It-tagħdim: il-qarquċa qed tinbidel f'għadam.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is this picture showing? Mark: Ossification: the cartilage is turning into bone.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这张图展示的是什么？Mark：骨化，也就是软骨正在转变为骨组织。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 这张图展示的是什么？
messages.en: What is this picture showing?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 骨化，也就是软骨正在转变为骨组织。
messages.en: Ossification: the cartilage is turning into bone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象课本里软骨逐步转变为骨组织的连续图，用“逐渐成为骨”记住这个过程名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Understanding and consideration for another person's feelings or difficulties, expressed as empathy, sympathy, mercy, or patience.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 理解并顾及他人的感受或困难，表现为共情、同情、仁慈或耐心。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fehim u konsiderazzjoni għas-sentimenti jew id-diffikultajiet ta' ħaddieħor, li jidhru bħala empatija, simpatija, ħniena jew paċenzja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 共情；设身处地理解他人的感受。
同情；对他人的困难或痛苦表示关切。
仁慈；对他人表现怜悯或宽恕。
耐心；面对他人的困难或不足时保持宽容。

formal.mt: L-għalliema wriet tagħdir lejn l-istudent li kien għaddej minn żmien diffiċli.
formal.en: The teacher showed understanding towards the student who was going through a difficult time.
formal.zh: 老师对那位正经历困难时期的学生表示了体谅。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Skużani talli wasalt tard; ommi kellha bżonn l-għajnuna. Mark: Tinkwetax, ftit tagħdir ma jagħmel ħsara lil ħadd.
colloquial.en: Maja: Sorry I'm late; my mother needed help. Mark: Don't worry, a little understanding never hurts anyone.
colloquial.zh: Maja：抱歉我来晚了，我妈妈需要帮忙。Mark：别担心，多一点体谅对谁都没有坏处。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Skużani talli wasalt tard; ommi kellha bżonn l-għajnuna.
messages.mt_standard: Skużani talli wasalt tard; ommi kellha bżonn l-għajnuna.
messages.zh: 抱歉我来晚了，我妈妈需要帮忙。
messages.en: Sorry I'm late; my mother needed help.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tinkwetax, ftit tagħdir ma jagħmel ħsara lil ħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Tinkwetax, ftit tagħdir ma jagħmel ħsara lil ħadd.
messages.zh: 别担心，多一点体谅对谁都没有坏处。
messages.en: Don't worry, a little understanding never hurts anyone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“先站在对方的位置想一想”串起四个义项：理解感受是共情，关心困境是同情，宽恕是仁慈，愿意等待是耐心。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To give food to a person or an animal.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 给人或动物提供食物，使其进食。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħti l-ikel lil persuna jew lil annimal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 喂食；给人或动物食物吃。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem tagħem lill-annimali qabel fetaħ il-bibien għall-viżitaturi.
formal.en: The worker fed the animals before opening the gates to visitors.
formal.zh: 工作人员在开门迎接访客之前给动物喂了食。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min tagħem lill-qattus? Rita: Mark tagħem lill-qattus dalgħodu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who fed the cat? Rita: Mark fed the cat this morning.
colloquial.zh: Maja：谁给猫喂食了？Rita：Mark今天早上喂过猫了。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 谁给猫喂食了？
messages.en: Who fed the cat?

messages.speaker: Rita (室友)
messages.zh: Mark今天早上喂过猫了。
messages.en: Mark fed the cat this morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把食物放进猫碗：主语是提供食物的人，接受食物的是被喂的人或动物。

gloss_zh: 挤压；压碎；弄得一团糟；把事情办砸

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of squeezing or crushing something; figuratively, making a mess or bungling a task.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 挤压或压碎某物的行为；也可比喻把东西弄得一团糟或把事情办砸。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tagħfas jew tfarrak xi ħaġa; f'sens figurattiv, li tagħmel taħwid jew twettaq xogħol ħażin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 挤压；用压力挤紧或挤出内容物的行为。
压碎；用压力使某物破碎或变形的行为。
比喻把事情或局面弄得一团糟。
因处理笨拙或不得当而把任务办砸。

formal.mt: Wara t-tagħfiġ tal-għeneb, il-meraq inġabar f'kontenitur nadif.
formal.en: After the grapes were crushed, the juice was collected in a clean container.
formal.zh: 葡萄压碎后，汁液被收集到一个干净的容器中。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ippruvajt insewwi l-kexxun, imma issa lanqas jingħalaq. Mark: X'tagħfiġ! Ejja naraw kif nistgħu nirranġawh.
colloquial.en: Maja: I tried to fix the drawer, but now it won't even close. Mark: What a mess! Let's see how we can fix it.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我试着修抽屉，结果现在连关都关不上了。Mark：真是弄糟了！我们来看看怎么修好它。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ippruvajt insewwi l-kexxun, imma issa lanqas jingħalaq.
messages.mt_standard: Ippruvajt insewwi l-kexxun, imma issa lanqas jingħalaq.
messages.zh: 我试着修抽屉，结果现在连关都关不上了。
messages.en: I tried to fix the drawer, but now it won't even close.

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'tagħfiġ! Ejja naraw kif nistgħu nirranġawh.
messages.mt_standard: X'tagħfiġ! Ejja naraw kif nistgħu nirranġawh.
messages.zh: 真是弄糟了！我们来看看怎么修好它。
messages.en: What a mess! Let's see how we can fix it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 分两个画面记忆：手把葡萄压碎是具体动作，修抽屉反而修坏是比喻义“办砸”；这是学习联想，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of casting the evil eye or placing a curse on someone, as understood in folk belief.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 民间信仰中所说的向人施恶眼或下咒的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għemil li, skont twemmin popolari, jitfa' l-għajn jew saħta fuq xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 施恶眼；民间信仰中认为以目光给他人带来厄运的行为。
向某人下咒；民间信仰中认为以诅咒加害某人的行为。

collocations.en: fear of the evil eye or curses
belief in the evil eye or the casting of curses
collocations.zh: 对施恶眼或下咒的信仰

formal.mt: L-istudju jeżamina t-twemmin fit-tagħjin kif jidher fir-rakkonti tal-parteċipanti.
formal.en: The study examines belief in the evil eye and curses as expressed in the participants' accounts.
formal.zh: 该研究考察参与者叙述中体现的恶眼与诅咒信仰。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex il-karattru fl-istorja jibża' mit-tagħjin? Pawlu: Għax jaħseb li xi ħadd tefagħlu l-għajn.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why is the character in the story afraid of the evil eye? Pawlu: Because he thinks someone has cast the evil eye on him.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：故事里的人物为什么害怕恶眼？保罗：因为他觉得有人对他施了恶眼。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 故事里的人物为什么害怕恶眼？
messages.en: Why is the character in the story afraid of the evil eye?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax jaħseb li xi ħadd tefagħlu l-għajn.
messages.mt_standard: Għax jaħseb li xi ħadd tefagħlu l-għajn.
messages.zh: 因为他觉得有人对他施了恶眼。
messages.en: Because he thinks someone has cast the evil eye on him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tagħjin 记在民间故事场景中：人物担心被施恶眼或下咒；两个义项都要记住，不把故事中的信念当作事实。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of offending or insulting someone through hurtful or disrespectful words or behaviour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以伤人或不尊重的言语、行为冒犯或侮辱他人的举动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għemil li joffendi jew jinsulta lil xi ħadd bi kliem jew imġiba li jweġġgħu.

sense_translations.en_definition: the act of offending or insulting
sense_translations.zh_definition: 冒犯或侮辱他人的行为；辱骂。

formal.mt: Ir-regoli tal-laqgħa jitolbu li l-parteċipanti jesprimu n-nuqqas ta' qbil tagħhom mingħajr tagħjir personali.
formal.en: The meeting rules require participants to express disagreement without personal insults.
formal.zh: 会议规则要求参与者表达不同意见时不得进行人身辱骂。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex waqaft taqra l-kummenti? Samwel: Għax kien hemm wisq tagħjir u ftit diskussjoni.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why did you stop reading the comments? Samwel: Because there were too many insults and too little discussion.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你怎么不继续看评论了？萨姆韦尔：因为辱骂太多，讨论太少。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你怎么不继续看评论了？
messages.en: Why did you stop reading the comments?

messages.speaker: Samwel (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax kien hemm wisq tagħjir u ftit diskussjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Għax kien hemm wisq tagħjir u ftit diskussjoni.
messages.zh: 因为辱骂太多，讨论太少。
messages.en: Because there were too many insults and too little discussion.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象评论区从讨论变成人身辱骂，用 tagħjir 标记这种冒犯行为，再练习 mingħajr tagħjir：表达意见不骂人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Living: the activity or condition of remaining alive and carrying on daily life.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 活着并继续日常生活的活动或状态；生活与生存。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħajja u t-tkomplija tagħha minn jum għal ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 生活；生存；维持生命与日常生活。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-kundizzjonijiet tat-tagħjix tal-familji li ħadu sehem fl-istħarriġ.
formal.en: The report describes the living conditions of the families who took part in the survey.
formal.zh: 报告描述了参与调查的家庭的生活条件。

colloquial.mt: Marija: X'se nieħdu magħna fid-dar il-ġdida? Ġużeppi: L-ewwel nieħdu dak li hu meħtieġ għat-tagħjix, bħal ikel, ħwejjeġ u friex.
colloquial.en: Marija: What shall we take with us to the new house? Ġużeppi: First, we'll take what we need for living, such as food, clothes and bedding.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：我们搬去新家要带什么？朱塞佩：先带生活必需品，比如食物、衣服和寝具。

messages.speaker: Marija (妻子)
messages.zh: 我们搬去新家要带什么？
messages.en: What shall we take with us to the new house?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (丈夫)
messages.mt_spoken: L-ewwel nieħdu dak li hu meħtieġ għat-tagħjix, bħal ikel, ħwejjeġ u friex.
messages.mt_standard: L-ewwel nieħdu dak li hu meħtieġ għat-tagħjix, bħal ikel, ħwejjeġ u friex.
messages.zh: 先带生活必需品，比如食物、衣服和寝具。
messages.en: First, we'll take what we need for living, such as food, clothes and bedding.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tagħjix 联想到每天吃饭、穿衣、安睡的连续画面，记住它指生活与生存，并用“生活所必需”这一搭配巩固。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Viscosity: the degree to which a fluid resists flowing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 黏度；流体抵抗流动的程度。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-grad ta' reżistenza ta' fluwidu għall-fluss.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 黏度；黏滞性，即流体抵抗流动的性质或程度。

formal.mt: Matul l-esperiment, sar kejl tat-tagħkir taż-żejt f'temperaturi differenti.
formal.en: During the experiment, the viscosity of the oil was measured at different temperatures.
formal.zh: 实验中测量了油在不同温度下的黏度。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex dan il-likwidu joħroġ daqshekk bil-mod? David: Minħabba t-tagħkir tiegħu; għandu reżistenza kbira għall-fluss.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why does this liquid come out so slowly? David: Because of its viscosity; it has a high resistance to flowing.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这种液体怎么流出来这么慢？戴维：因为它的黏度大，流动阻力很大。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex dan il-likwidu joħroġ daqshekk bil-mod?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex dan il-likwidu joħroġ daqshekk bil-mod?
messages.zh: 这种液体怎么流出来这么慢？
messages.en: Why does this liquid come out so slowly?

messages.speaker: David (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Minħabba t-tagħkir tiegħu; għandu reżistenza kbira għall-fluss.
messages.mt_standard: Minħabba t-tagħkir tiegħu; għandu reżistenza kbira għall-fluss.
messages.zh: 因为它的黏度大，流动阻力很大。
messages.en: Because of its viscosity; it has a high resistance to flowing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象倾斜容器时浓稠液体缓慢流出，用 tagħkir 对应“黏度”，抓住抵抗流动这个核心含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Oppression or harsh restriction imposed on others; also self-abnegation through giving up one's own desires or comforts.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对他人施加的压迫或严苛限制；也指舍弃个人欲望或舒适的克己行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Moħqrija jew restrizzjonijiet ħorox fuq ħaddieħor; ukoll iċ-ċaħda tax-xewqat jew tal-kumditajiet personali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 压迫；以权力或严苛限制使他人受苦。
克己；舍弃个人欲望、利益或舒适的自我克制。

formal.mt: L-awtur jiddistingwi bejn it-tagħkis tal-poplu minn min għandu l-poter u t-tagħkis personali magħżul bħala dixxiplina.
formal.en: The author distinguishes between oppression of the people by those in power and personal self-abnegation chosen as a discipline.
formal.zh: 作者区分了掌权者对人民施加的压迫与个人作为自律方式而选择的克己。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Hawnhekk, tagħkis ifisser li xi ħadd qed jaħqar lil ħaddieħor? Toni: Le, f'din is-sentenza jfisser li persuna tiċċaħħad minn xi kumditajiet minn jeddha.
colloquial.en: Elena: Does tagħkis mean that someone is oppressing others here? Toni: No, in this sentence it means that a person willingly gives up certain comforts.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：这里的 tagħkis 是指有人压迫别人吗？托尼：不是，在这句话里，它指一个人自愿放弃某些舒适享受。

messages.speaker: Elena (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawnhekk, tagħkis ifisser li xi ħadd qed jaħqar lil ħaddieħor?
messages.mt_standard: Hawnhekk, tagħkis ifisser li xi ħadd qed jaħqar lil ħaddieħor?
messages.zh: 这里的 tagħkis 是指有人压迫别人吗？
messages.en: Does tagħkis mean that someone is oppressing others here?

messages.speaker: Toni (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, f'din is-sentenza jfisser li persuna tiċċaħħad minn xi kumditajiet minn jeddha.
messages.mt_standard: Le, f'din is-sentenza jfisser li persuna tiċċaħħad minn xi kumditajiet minn jeddha.
messages.zh: 不是，在这句话里，它指一个人自愿放弃某些舒适享受。
messages.en: No, in this sentence it means that a person willingly gives up certain comforts.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅画记 tagħkis：权力压在人身上是“压迫”，自己主动舍弃享受是“克己”；读句子时先判断限制来自谁。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Your or yours when addressing two or more possessors; it identifies something as belonging to the people being addressed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示某物属于正在对话的两人或多人，即“你们的”；既可修饰名词，也可独立表示所属。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tindika li xi ħaġa tappartjeni lil żewġ persuni jew aktar li qed jiġu indirizzati.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 你们的；表示所有者为正在被称呼的两人或多人，可随名词使用或独立表示所属。

collocations.en: your house, addressing more than one person
this is yours, addressing more than one person

formal.mt: Jekk jogħġobkom, iktbu l-ismijiet tagħkom fuq il-formola qabel tibdew l-attività.
formal.en: Please write your names on the form before you begin the activity.
formal.zh: 请你们在活动开始前把各自的姓名写在表格上。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-ballun tagħkom, Mark u Lara? Mark: Iva, tagħna. Grazzi talli sibthulna!
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this ball yours, Mark and Lara? Mark: Yes, it's ours. Thanks for finding it for us!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克、拉拉，这个球是你们的吗？马克：是的，是我们的。谢谢你帮我们找到它！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-ballun tagħkom, Mark u Lara?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-ballun tagħkom, Mark u Lara?
messages.zh: 马克、拉拉，这个球是你们的吗？
messages.en: Is this ball yours, Mark and Lara?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 是的，是我们的。谢谢你帮我们找到它！
messages.en: Yes, it's ours. Thanks for finding it for us!

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 tagħkom 时想象对面站着两个人，你指着一个球说“你们的”；复数说的是所有者，物品本身可以只有一个。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of giving food to a person or, especially, to animals.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 给人或尤其给动物提供食物的行为；喂食或饲喂。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għemil li jingħata l-ikel lil persuna jew, b'mod speċjali, lill-annimali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 喂食；饲喂的行为，尤其指给动物喂食。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiema għandhom jirreġistraw il-ħin tat-tagħlif u l-ammont ta' ikel mogħti lil kull annimal.
formal.en: The workers should record the feeding time and the amount of food given to each animal.
formal.zh: 工作人员应记录喂食时间以及给每只动物提供的食物量。

colloquial.mt: Ben: Wasal il-ħin tat-tagħlif tal-fniek? Rita: Iva, ġib l-ikel tagħhom u jien inġib l-ilma.
colloquial.en: Ben: Is it time to feed the rabbits? Rita: Yes, bring their food and I'll bring the water.
colloquial.zh: 本：到给兔子喂食的时间了吗？丽塔：到了，你拿它们的食物，我去拿水。

messages.speaker: Ben (儿子)
messages.zh: 到给兔子喂食的时间了吗？
messages.en: Is it time to feed the rabbits?

messages.speaker: Rita (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ġib l-ikel tagħhom u jien inġib l-ilma.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ġib l-ikel tagħhom u jien inġib l-ilma.
messages.zh: 到了，你拿它们的食物，我去拿水。
messages.en: Yes, bring their food and I'll bring the water.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象每天定时把食物放进兔子的食盆，用 tagħlif 记“喂食这件事”，再连着记 ħin tat-tagħlif，即喂食时间。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The work of cultivating crops so that they grow and produce a harvest.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 培育和种植农作物，使其生长并获得收成的农业活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħidma tat-tkabbir u l-kura tal-għelejjel biex jagħtu l-ħsad.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 农作物的栽培与种植。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jispjega kif it-tagħlil tal-qamħ jiddependi mill-kwalità tal-ħamrija u mill-ilma disponibbli.
formal.en: The report explains how wheat cultivation depends on soil quality and the water available.
formal.zh: 报告说明了小麦栽培如何依赖土壤质量和可用水量。

colloquial.mt: Maja: It-tagħlil tal-ħaxix jieħu ħafna ħin? Pawlu: Iva, trid issaqqi u tieħu ħsieb il-pjanti regolarment.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does growing vegetables take a lot of time? Pawlu: Yes, you need to water and care for the plants regularly.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：种蔬菜很花时间吗？保罗：是的，你得定期浇水、照料植株。

messages.speaker: Maja (园艺初学者)
messages.zh: 种蔬菜很花时间吗？
messages.en: Does growing vegetables take a lot of time?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (农夫)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, trid issaqqi u tieħu ħsieb il-pjanti regolarment.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, trid issaqqi u tieħu ħsieb il-pjanti regolarment.
messages.zh: 是的，你得定期浇水、照料植株。
messages.en: Yes, you need to water and care for the plants regularly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tagħlil 联想成一整季的田间劳动：播种、浇水、照料，最后收获；记住它指作物栽培。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Something useful learned from an experience, especially a mistake or difficulty.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从经历中，尤其从错误或困难中学到的道理或经验教训。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa utli li wieħed jitgħallem minn esperjenza, speċjalment minn żball jew diffikultà.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 从某次经历中学到的道理或吸取的教训。

formal.mt: Minn din l-esperjenza ħadna tagħlima siewja dwar l-importanza ta' ppjanar tajjeb.
formal.en: From this experience, we learned a valuable lesson about the importance of good planning.
formal.zh: 这次经历让我们认识到周密规划的重要性，给了我们宝贵的一课。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Erġajt tlift ix-xarabank? Mark: Iva, imma ħadt tagħlima: għada noħroġ qabel.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did you miss the bus again? Mark: Yes, but I learned a lesson: tomorrow I'll leave earlier.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你又没赶上公交车？马克：是啊，不过我吸取教训了：明天早点出门。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你又没赶上公交车？
messages.en: Did you miss the bus again?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma ħadt tagħlima: għada noħroġ qabel.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma ħadt tagħlima: għada noħroġ qabel.
messages.zh: 是啊，不过我吸取教训了：明天早点出门。
messages.en: Yes, but I learned a lesson: tomorrow I'll leave earlier.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象错过公交后写下的一句提醒：明天早点走。这句从经历中学来的道理，就是 tagħlima。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of closing something or bringing its operation or use to an end.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某物关闭，或使某处停止运作、停止使用的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għeluq ta' xi ħaġa jew it-tmiem tal-operat jew tal-użu tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 关闭、封闭，或停止开放、停止运作。

collocations.en: the temporary closure of the road

formal.mt: L-avviż iħabbar it-tagħliq temporanju tat-triq minħabba xogħlijiet ta' manutenzjoni.
formal.en: The notice announces the temporary closure of the road for maintenance work.
formal.zh: 公告宣布，该道路因维护施工而临时封闭。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Rajt l-avviż dwar it-tagħliq tat-triq? Toni: Iva, illum irridu ngħaddu minn triq oħra.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did you see the notice about the road closure? Toni: Yes, today we need to take another road.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你看到道路封闭的通知了吗？托尼：看到了，今天我们得走另一条路。

messages.speaker: Lara (邻居)
messages.zh: 你看到道路封闭的通知了吗？
messages.en: Did you see the notice about the road closure?

messages.speaker: Toni (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, illum irridu ngħaddu minn triq oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, illum irridu ngħaddu minn triq oħra.
messages.zh: 看到了，今天我们得走另一条路。
messages.en: Yes, today we need to take another road.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 tagħliq，就想象门合上、道路放下围栏的画面；共同意思是关闭或封闭。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of covering someone's eyes so that they cannot see.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用布等遮住某人的眼睛，使其无法看见的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tgħatti għajnejn xi ħadd biex ma jkunx jista' jara.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 蒙住某人眼睛、使其看不见的行为。

formal.mt: F'din il-logħba, it-tagħmid tal-għajnejn isir b'ċarruta ratba qabel ma l-parteċipant jipprova jagħraf l-oġġetti bil-mess.
formal.en: In this game, the participant's eyes are covered with a soft cloth before they try to identify objects by touch.
formal.zh: 在这个游戏中，参与者先用软布蒙住眼睛，再尝试通过触摸辨认物品。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex hemm bżonn it-tagħmid tal-għajnejn? Ben: Biex tipprova tagħraf l-oġġetti b'idejk biss.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why do we need the blindfolding? Ben: So you can try to identify the objects using only your hands.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：为什么要蒙眼？本：这样你就能试着只用双手辨认物品。

messages.speaker: Nina (游戏参与者)
messages.zh: 为什么要蒙眼？
messages.en: Why do we need the blindfolding?

messages.speaker: Ben (游戏主持人)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex tipprova tagħraf l-oġġetti b'idejk biss.
messages.mt_standard: Biex tipprova tagħraf l-oġġetti b'idejk biss.
messages.zh: 这样你就能试着只用双手辨认物品。
messages.en: So you can try to identify the objects using only your hands.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tagħmid 配上蒙眼摸物游戏的画面：软布遮住双眼，双手开始辨认，记住它表示蒙眼这一行为。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or process of doing something or making something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 进行某项事情，或制作某种东西的行为与过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att jew il-proċess li tagħmel xi ħaġa jew tipproduċi xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 做某事；进行某项活动的行为。
制作某物；把某种东西做出来的过程。

formal.mt: Il-kors jispjega l-passi ewlenin fit-tagħmil tal-ħobż, mit-taħlit tal-ingredjenti sal-ħami.
formal.en: The course explains the main steps in making bread, from mixing the ingredients to baking.
formal.zh: 课程讲解面包制作的主要步骤，从混合原料一直到烘烤。

colloquial.mt: Mark: It-tagħmil tal-ħobż jieħu ħafna ħin? Rita: Iva, l-aktar għax trid tistenna li l-għaġina togħla.
colloquial.en: Mark: Does making bread take a lot of time? Rita: Yes, mainly because you have to wait for the dough to rise.
colloquial.zh: 马克：做面包很花时间吗？丽塔：是的，主要是因为得等面团发起来。

messages.speaker: Mark (烘焙初学者)
messages.zh: 做面包很花时间吗？
messages.en: Does making bread take a lot of time?

messages.speaker: Rita (面包师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, l-aktar għax trid tistenna li l-għaġina togħla.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, l-aktar għax trid tistenna li l-għaġina togħla.
messages.zh: 是的，主要是因为得等面团发起来。
messages.en: Yes, mainly because you have to wait for the dough to rise.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅画记 tagħmil：一幅是动手做工作，一幅是动手做面包；都把注意力放在做的行为和过程上。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of making something darker or reducing the light in a place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物颜色变深，或减少某处光线、使其变暗的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tagħmel xi ħaġa aktar skura jew tnaqqas id-dawl f'post.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使变暗、变深，或减少光照的行为。

formal.mt: It-tagħmim tal-kamra qabel il-preżentazzjoni jgħin lill-udjenza tara l-immaġnijiet fuq l-iskrin.
formal.en: Darkening the room before the presentation helps the audience see the images on the screen.
formal.zh: 演示前调暗房间，有助于观众看清屏幕上的图像。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Hemm bżonn it-tagħmim tal-kamra għall-film? Leo: Iva, agħlaq il-purtieri biex naraw aħjar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do we need to darken the room for the film? Leo: Yes, close the curtains so we can see better.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：看电影要把房间弄暗吗？莱奥：要，拉上窗帘，这样看得更清楚。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 看电影要把房间弄暗吗？
messages.en: Do we need to darken the room for the film?

messages.speaker: Leo (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, agħlaq il-purtieri biex naraw aħjar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, agħlaq il-purtieri biex naraw aħjar.
messages.zh: 要，拉上窗帘，这样看得更清楚。
messages.en: Yes, close the curtains so we can see better.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象拉上窗帘后房间一点点变暗，再想象颜料逐渐加深；用这两个变化记住 tagħmim。

gloss_zh: 家具配备；使受孕；成套器具

teaching_sense.en_definition: The furnishing of a place, or a set of items provided for a particular use.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为某处配备家具或用品的行为，也可指为特定用途配备的一套器具。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-provvista ta' għamara jew oġġetti għal post, jew sett ta' oġġetti għal użu partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 配备家具、陈设或其他所需用品。
使受孕；使雌性受精的行为。
一套用品或器具；成套配备。

formal.mt: Il-baġit għat-tagħmir tal-uffiċċju jinkludi skrivaniji, siġġijiet u kompjuters.
formal.en: The budget for furnishing and equipping the office includes desks, chairs and computers.
formal.zh: 办公室家具与设备的配备预算包括书桌、椅子和电脑。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għandna t-tagħmir kollu għall-kċina? David: Kważi, jonqosna biss borma kbira.
colloquial.en: Sara: Do we have all the kitchen equipment? David: Almost; we just need a large pot.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：厨房用具都齐了吗？戴维：差不多了，就缺一个大锅。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: 厨房用具都齐了吗？
messages.en: Do we have all the kitchen equipment?

messages.speaker: David (室友)
messages.zh: 差不多了，就缺一个大锅。
messages.en: Almost; we just need a large pot.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用搬家时配齐家具和厨房器具的清单记 tagħmir；另把使受孕义单独记卡，依语境区分，勿混成一个意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Harsh or oppressive treatment that causes people difficulty or suffering.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人遭受困难或痛苦的严酷对待，也可指压迫他人的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Trattament aħrax jew oppressiv li jġib tbatija jew diffikultà lin-nies.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对待他人时的严酷、苛刻或冷酷。
压迫；以权力使人受到不公正的控制或欺压。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jikkundanna t-tagħmis tal-ħaddiema u jitlob kundizzjonijiet tax-xogħol aktar ġusti.
formal.en: The report condemns the oppression of workers and calls for fairer working conditions.
formal.zh: 报告谴责对工人的压迫，并呼吁提供更公平的工作条件。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex il-ħaddiema qed jilmentaw? Toni: Minħabba t-tagħmis: ma jħalluhomx jieħdu l-pawżi tagħhom.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why are the workers complaining? Toni: Because of the oppressive treatment: they aren't allowed to take their breaks.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：工人们为什么在抱怨？托尼：因为受到压迫，连应有的休息都不让他们休。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 工人们为什么在抱怨？
messages.en: Why are the workers complaining?

messages.speaker: Toni (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Minħabba t-tagħmis: ma jħalluhomx jieħdu l-pawżi tagħhom.
messages.mt_standard: Minħabba t-tagħmis: ma jħalluhomx jieħdu l-pawżi tagħhom.
messages.zh: 因为受到压迫，连应有的休息都不让他们休。
messages.en: Because of the oppressive treatment: they aren't allowed to take their breaks.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用不准休息、严厉欺压的场景记 tagħmis：较轻可理解为苛刻严酷，涉及权力欺压时理解为压迫。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of putting one's arms around someone in an embrace or hug.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用双臂搂住某人、给予拥抱的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li ddawwar dirgħajk ma' xi ħadd biex tgħannqu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 拥抱；用双臂环抱某人的动作。
搂抱；抱住某人以表达亲近或关爱。

formal.mt: It-tagħniq bejn il-membri tal-familja wera l-ferħ tagħhom meta reġgħu ltaqgħu.
formal.en: The embracing between the family members showed their joy at meeting again.
formal.zh: 家人之间的拥抱表达了他们重逢时的喜悦。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kemm ili ma narak! Pawlu: U jien! Ejja hawn, illum hemm bżonn ftit tagħniq.
colloquial.en: Maja: I haven't seen you in ages! Pawlu: Same here! Come here, we need a bit of hugging today.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：好久没见到你了！保罗：我也是！过来，今天得好好抱一抱。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 好久没见到你了！
messages.en: I haven't seen you in ages!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: U jien! Ejja hawn, illum hemm bżonn ftit tagħniq.
messages.mt_standard: U jien! Ejja hawn, illum hemm bżonn ftit tagħniq.
messages.zh: 我也是！过来，今天得好好抱一抱。
messages.en: Same here! Come here, we need a bit of hugging today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词和朋友重逢时张开双臂的画面绑定，记住它表示拥抱这一动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Work carried out quickly or efficiently.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 做得迅速或有效率的工作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xogħol li jsir malajr jew b'effiċjenza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 迅速或高效的工作；快捷有效的办事。

collocations.zh: 工作中的迅速或高效表现

collocations.en: quick or efficient work in preparation
collocations.zh: 准备工作中的迅速或高效表现

formal.mt: It-tagħnit tat-tim fit-tħejjija tas-sala għen biex il-laqgħa tibda fil-ħin.
formal.en: The team's efficient work in preparing the hall helped the meeting start on time.
formal.zh: 团队高效完成了会场准备工作，帮助会议准时开始。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Diġà lestejtu kollox? Mark: Iva, bit-tagħnit ta' kulħadd spiċċajna qabel nofsinhar.
colloquial.en: Lara: Have you already finished everything? Mark: Yes, thanks to everyone's efficient work, we finished before noon.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：你们已经全做完了吗？马克：是的，大家干活都很高效，中午之前就完成了。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 你们已经全做完了吗？
messages.en: Have you already finished everything?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, bit-tagħnit ta' kulħadd spiċċajna qabel nofsinhar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, bit-tagħnit ta' kulħadd spiċċajna qabel nofsinhar.
messages.zh: 是的，大家干活都很高效，中午之前就完成了。
messages.en: Yes, thanks to everyone's efficient work, we finished before noon.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象大家配合默契，午饭前就把任务完成；用这幅画面记住迅速高效的工作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of gathering material into a heap or mound.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把材料聚拢并堆成一堆或小丘状的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tiġbor materjal u tqiegħdu f'munzell jew f'għolja żgħira.

sense_translations.en_definition: piling into a heap or mound
sense_translations.zh_definition: 把东西堆成一堆或小丘状。

formal.mt: It-tagħqib tal-ħamrija f'rokna tal-ġnien ħalla spazju għat-tħawwil.
formal.en: Piling the soil into a mound in a corner of the garden left space for planting.
formal.zh: 把泥土堆到花园角落形成小丘后，便腾出了种植空间。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Fejn inpoġġi dan ir-ramel? Rita: Hawn fil-kantuniera; kompli bit-tagħqib sakemm ikollna munzell wieħed.
colloquial.en: Mark: Where should I put this sand? Rita: Here in the corner; keep piling it up until we have one heap.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这些沙子放哪里？丽塔：放在这个角落；继续堆，直到聚成一堆。

messages.speaker: Mark (园艺助手)
messages.zh: 这些沙子放哪里？
messages.en: Where should I put this sand?

messages.speaker: Rita (园丁)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn fil-kantuniera; kompli bit-tagħqib sakemm ikollna munzell wieħed.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn fil-kantuniera; kompli bit-tagħqib sakemm ikollna munzell wieħed.
messages.zh: 放在这个角落；继续堆，直到聚成一堆。
messages.en: Here in the corner; keep piling it up until we have one heap.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一铲一铲把沙子集中，最后堆成小丘；记忆重点是堆出一堆的形状。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The development of wisdom and maturity in thought or behaviour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 思想或行为逐渐明智、成熟的发展过程或状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-iżvilupp tal-għaqal u tal-maturità fil-ħsieb jew fl-imġiba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 智慧或明智判断能力的逐渐增长。
成熟；思想或行为表现出的稳重与明理。

formal.mt: Id-deċiżjoni tagħha li tisma' ż-żewġ naħat qabel tagħti ġudizzju turi tagħqil.
formal.en: Her decision to hear both sides before making a judgment shows maturity.
formal.zh: 她决定先听取双方意见再作判断，这体现了成熟。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Din id-darba ħsibt sew qabel weġibt. Lara: Dak sinjal ta' tagħqil; tajt lilek innifsek ħin biex taħseb.
colloquial.en: Maja: This time I thought carefully before answering. Lara: That's a sign of maturity; you gave yourself time to think.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这次我仔细想过才回答。劳拉：这是成熟的表现；你给了自己思考的时间。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Din id-darba ħsibt sew qabel weġibt.
messages.mt_standard: Din id-darba ħsibt sew qabel weġibt.
messages.zh: 这次我仔细想过才回答。
messages.en: This time I thought carefully before answering.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak sinjal ta' tagħqil; tajt lilek innifsek ħin biex taħseb.
messages.mt_standard: Dak sinjal ta' tagħqil; tajt lilek innifsek ħin biex taħseb.
messages.zh: 这是成熟的表现；你给了自己思考的时间。
messages.en: That's a sign of maturity; you gave yourself time to think.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把冲动回答变成先想再说的成长画面记下来，用它联想智慧增长和成熟。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The formation of ulcers, including the development of pressure sores.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 溃疡形成的过程，也包括压疮的形成。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-formazzjoni ta' ulċeri, inklużi feriti li jiżviluppaw minħabba pressjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 溃疡形成；组织出现溃疡的过程。
压疮的形成或发展。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi t-tagħqir tal-ġilda u jindika ż-żoni affettwati.
formal.en: The report describes the ulceration of the skin and identifies the affected areas.
formal.zh: 报告描述了皮肤溃疡的形成，并标明了受影响的部位。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Xi tfisser il-kelma tagħqir f'dan ir-rapport? Rita: Hawn tfisser il-formazzjoni ta' ulċeri fil-ġilda.
colloquial.en: Mark: What does the word tagħqir mean in this report? Rita: Here it means the formation of ulcers in the skin.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这份报告里的 tagħqir 是什么意思？丽塔：这里指皮肤溃疡的形成。

messages.speaker: Mark (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser il-kelma tagħqir f'dan ir-rapport?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser il-kelma tagħqir f'dan ir-rapport?
messages.zh: 这份报告里的 tagħqir 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does the word tagħqir mean in this report?

messages.speaker: Rita (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn tfisser il-formazzjoni ta' ulċeri fil-ġilda.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn tfisser il-formazzjoni ta' ulċeri fil-ġilda.
messages.zh: 这里指皮肤溃疡的形成。
messages.en: Here it means the formation of ulcers in the skin.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在学习卡上画出皮肤出现溃疡的示意图，旁边标注形成过程，并联记压疮义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of deliberately misleading someone or making them believe something false.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 故意误导他人，使其相信不实内容的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tqarraq b'xi ħadd jew iġġiegħlu jemmen xi ħaġa falza apposta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 欺骗；故意使他人产生错误认识的行为。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi każ ta' tagħqix li fih il-klijenti ngħataw informazzjoni falza dwar il-prodott.
formal.en: The report describes a case of deception in which customers were given false information about the product.
formal.zh: 报告描述了一起欺骗事件，其中顾客获得了有关产品的虚假信息。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Qaluli li l-kunsinna kienet b'xejn, imma mbagħad talbuni nħallas. Mark: Jekk kienu jafu li kien hemm ħlas u ħbewh, dak tagħqix.
colloquial.en: Lara: They told me delivery was free, but then they asked me to pay. Mark: If they knew there was a charge and hid it, that's deception.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：他们说免费送货，后来却要我付钱。马克：如果他们明知要收费却故意隐瞒，那就是欺骗。

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Qaluli li l-kunsinna kienet b'xejn, imma mbagħad talbuni nħallas.
messages.mt_standard: Qaluli li l-kunsinna kienet b'xejn, imma mbagħad talbuni nħallas.
messages.zh: 他们说免费送货，后来却要我付钱。
messages.en: They told me delivery was free, but then they asked me to pay.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jekk kienu jafu li kien hemm ħlas u ħbewh, dak tagħqix.
messages.mt_standard: Jekk kienu jafu li kien hemm ħlas u ħbewh, dak tagħqix.
messages.zh: 如果他们明知要收费却故意隐瞒，那就是欺骗。
messages.en: If they knew there was a charge and hid it, that's deception.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象广告写着免费，付款时却冒出被故意隐瞒的费用，用这个场景记住欺骗。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of gathering things into a heap or placing them in piles or stacks.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把东西聚成一堆、堆放起来或一层层叠放的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tiġbor affarijiet f'munzell jew tqegħedhom fuq xulxin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 堆积起来；把东西聚成一堆。
堆放；把东西逐渐放成一堆。
叠放；把东西一层层放在彼此上面。

formal.mt: It-tagħrim tal-kaxxi fuq xulxin ħalla aktar spazju ħieles fil-maħżen.
formal.en: Stacking the boxes on top of one another left more free space in the storeroom.
formal.zh: 把箱子一层层叠放起来，为储藏室腾出了更多空间。

colloquial.mt: Pawlu: Fejn trid dawn il-kaxxi? Maja: Ħdejn il-ħajt; jien nieħu ħsieb it-tagħrim tagħhom.
colloquial.en: Pawlu: Where do you want these boxes? Maja: By the wall; I'll take care of stacking them.
colloquial.zh: 保罗：这些箱子你想放在哪里？玛雅：放在墙边；我来负责把它们叠好。

messages.speaker: Pawlu (仓库同事)
messages.zh: 这些箱子你想放在哪里？
messages.en: Where do you want these boxes?

messages.speaker: Maja (仓库同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħdejn il-ħajt; jien nieħu ħsieb it-tagħrim tagħhom.
messages.mt_standard: Ħdejn il-ħajt; jien nieħu ħsieb it-tagħrim tagħhom.
messages.zh: 放在墙边；我来负责把它们叠好。
messages.en: By the wall; I'll take care of stacking them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用石块聚成堆和箱子层层叠两幅画面联记，让堆积、堆放、叠放三个义项一起出现。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of lightly touching someone's body in a way that makes them feel ticklish or laugh.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 轻触或搔弄某人的身体，使其感到痒或发笑的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tmiss ħafif il-ġisem ta' xi ħadd b'mod li jġiegħlu jħoss it-tferfir jew jidħaq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 挠痒痒；通过轻触或搔弄身体使人感到痒或发笑。

collocations.en: tickling the soles of the feet

formal.mt: Waqt il-logħba, it-tagħrix taħt is-saqajn ġiegħel lit-tifel jidħaq.
formal.en: During the game, tickling the soles of his feet made the boy laugh.
formal.zh: 游戏时，挠脚底痒痒让男孩笑了起来。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ieqaf bit-tagħrix, qed nidħaq wisq! Pawlu: Tajjeb, nieqaf issa.
colloquial.en: Lara: Stop tickling me, I'm laughing too much! Pawlu: Okay, I'll stop now.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：别挠我痒痒了，我都笑个不停了！保罗：好，我现在就停。

messages.speaker: Lara (妹妹)
messages.zh: 别挠我痒痒了，我都笑个不停了！
messages.en: Stop tickling me, I'm laughing too much!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (哥哥)
messages.zh: 好，我现在就停。
messages.en: Okay, I'll stop now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象脚底被轻轻一挠就笑出声，把轻触、发痒和笑声连成一幅记忆画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of mixing ingredients together, especially kneading dough.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把材料混合在一起的过程，尤指揉制面团。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tħallat ingredjenti flimkien, speċjalment l-għaġna tal-għaġin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 将不同材料混合在一起。
揉制，通常指揉面团。

formal.mt: Waqt it-tagħsid, żid l-ilma ftit ftit sakemm l-għaġin ikun artab u lixx.
formal.en: During kneading, add the water gradually until the dough is soft and smooth.
formal.zh: 揉面时，逐渐加水，直到面团柔软光滑。

colloquial.mt: Marija: L-għaġin għadu iebes. Inżid ftit ilma? Pawlu: Iva, imma ftit biss, u kompli bit-tagħsid.
colloquial.en: Marija: The dough is still stiff. Should I add a little water? Pawlu: Yes, but only a little, and keep kneading.
colloquial.zh: Marija：面团还是很硬。我加一点水好吗？Pawlu：好，但只加一点，然后继续揉。

messages.speaker: Marija (烘焙学员)
messages.mt_spoken: L-għaġin għadu iebes. Inżid ftit ilma?
messages.mt_standard: L-għaġin għadu iebes. Inżid ftit ilma?
messages.zh: 面团还是很硬。我加一点水好吗？
messages.en: The dough is still stiff. Should I add a little water?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (烘焙老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma ftit biss, u kompli bit-tagħsid.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma ftit biss, u kompli bit-tagħsid.
messages.zh: 好，但只加一点，然后继续揉。
messages.en: Yes, but only a little, and keep kneading.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tagħsid 配上一幅双手揉面图：先把材料混合，再反复揉成面团，同时记住“混合”和“揉面”两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of making food or drink sweeter by adding honey.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过加入蜂蜜，使食物或饮料变甜的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tagħmel ikel jew xorb aktar ħelu billi żżid l-għasel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使用蜂蜜给食物或饮料增添甜味。

formal.mt: Għat-tagħsil tal-jogurt, żid kuċċarina għasel u ħawwad sew.
formal.en: To sweeten the yogurt with honey, add a teaspoon of honey and stir well.
formal.zh: 给酸奶加蜂蜜增甜时，加入一茶匙蜂蜜并充分搅拌。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kemm għasel nuża għat-tagħsil tat-te? Mark: Ibda b'nofs kuċċarina u duqu qabel iżżid aktar.
colloquial.en: Lara: How much honey should I use to sweeten the tea? Mark: Start with half a teaspoon and taste it before adding more.
colloquial.zh: Lara：给茶加蜂蜜增甜，要放多少蜂蜜？Mark：先放半茶匙，尝过以后再决定要不要多加。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 给茶加蜂蜜增甜，要放多少蜂蜜？
messages.en: How much honey should I use to sweeten the tea?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ibda b'nofs kuċċarina u duqu qabel iżżid aktar.
messages.mt_standard: Ibda b'nofs kuċċarina u duqu qabel iżżid aktar.
messages.zh: 先放半茶匙，尝过以后再决定要不要多加。
messages.en: Start with half a teaspoon and taste it before adding more.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记忆 tagħsil 时想象一小勺蜂蜜流进茶杯；把“蜂蜜”和“增甜”绑定，牢牢记住这里指定的词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of providing an entrance or doorway with a threshold.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为入口或门洞设置、装设门槛的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tipprovdi daħla jew fetħa ta' bieb b'għatba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为门口设置或装设门槛。

collocations.en: the provision of a threshold at the entrance
the provision of a stone threshold

formal.mt: Il-pjan ta' restawr jinkludi t-tagħtib tad-daħla b'għatba tal-ġebel.
formal.en: The restoration plan includes providing the entrance with a stone threshold.
formal.zh: 修复计划包括在入口装设一道石质门槛。

colloquial.mt: Rita: It-tagħtib tad-daħla nagħmluh illum? Ġużeppi: Iva, l-għatba tal-ġebel waslet dalgħodu.
colloquial.en: Rita: Shall we put in the entrance threshold today? Ġużeppi: Yes, the stone threshold arrived this morning.
colloquial.zh: Rita：我们今天装入口的门槛吗？Ġużeppi：是的，石门槛今天早上到了。

messages.speaker: Rita (房主)
messages.zh: 我们今天装入口的门槛吗？
messages.en: Shall we put in the entrance threshold today?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (施工师傅)
messages.zh: 是的，石门槛今天早上到了。
messages.en: Yes, the stone threshold arrived this morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 tagħtib 画一幅工人在门口安装石门槛的图；记住它指“设置门槛”这一过程，而不是门槛这个物件。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Speech in which sounds or syllables are involuntarily repeated or prolonged, or the flow of speech is blocked.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 说话时不自主地重复或拖长音、音节，或出现发声阻塞的现象。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Taħdit li fih persuna tirrepeti jew ittawwal ħsejjes jew sillabi mingħajr ma trid, jew teħel waqt li titkellem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 口吃，说话时出现不自主的重复、拖音或阻塞。
说话结巴，表达时出现不自主的语音重复或停顿。

formal.mt: Jekk student jitkellem bit-tagħtigħ, agħtih il-ħin biex itemm kliemu mingħajr ma tinterrompih.
formal.en: If a student speaks with a stammer, give them time to finish speaking without interrupting.
formal.zh: 如果学生说话时口吃，应给对方时间把话说完，不要打断。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Meta nitkellem quddiem il-klassi, kultant ikolli t-tagħtigħ. Sara: Ħu l-ħin li għandek bżonn; aħna nisimgħuk.
colloquial.en: Nina: When I speak in front of the class, I sometimes stutter. Sara: Take the time you need; we're listening.
colloquial.zh: Nina：我在全班面前说话时，有时会口吃。Sara：慢慢说，按你需要的时间来；我们在听。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta nitkellem quddiem il-klassi, kultant ikolli t-tagħtigħ.
messages.mt_standard: Meta nitkellem quddiem il-klassi, kultant ikolli t-tagħtigħ.
messages.zh: 我在全班面前说话时，有时会口吃。
messages.en: When I speak in front of the class, I sometimes stutter.

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħu l-ħin li għandek bżonn; aħna nisimgħuk.
messages.mt_standard: Ħu l-ħin li għandek bżonn; aħna nisimgħuk.
messages.zh: 慢慢说，按你需要的时间来；我们在听。
messages.en: Take the time you need; we're listening.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tagħtigħ 与“耐心听对方把话说完”的场景相连；两个英语释义都表示口吃，不必记成两种不同现象。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of scraping a surface or removing material from it by scraping.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 刮削表面，或通过刮削去除表面材料的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tobrox wiċċ jew tneħħi materjal minn fuqu billi tobrox.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 刮削；用工具刮擦表面或刮去表面材料。

collocations.en: the scraping off of old paint

formal.mt: It-tagħtil taż-żebgħa l-qadima għandu jsir bil-mod biex il-wiċċ tal-injam ma ssirlux ħsara.
formal.en: Old paint should be scraped off carefully to avoid damaging the wooden surface.
formal.zh: 刮除旧漆时应缓慢小心，以免损伤木质表面。

colloquial.mt: Toni: Lestejt it-tagħtil taż-żebgħa minn fuq il-bieb? Elena: Kważi; baqa' ftit ħdejn il-manku.
colloquial.en: Toni: Have you finished scraping the paint off the door? Elena: Almost; there's a little left near the handle.
colloquial.zh: Toni：门上的漆刮完了吗？Elena：快了，把手旁边还剩一点。

messages.speaker: Toni (维修师傅)
messages.mt_spoken: Lestejt it-tagħtil taż-żebgħa minn fuq il-bieb?
messages.mt_standard: Lestejt it-tagħtil taż-żebgħa minn fuq il-bieb?
messages.zh: 门上的漆刮完了吗？
messages.en: Have you finished scraping the paint off the door?

messages.speaker: Elena (维修学徒)
messages.zh: 快了，把手旁边还剩一点。
messages.en: Almost; there's a little left near the handle.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 tagħtil 时想象刮刀沿木门表面移动、旧漆一片片脱落；把这个动作直接对应“刮削、刮除”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or process of making a dent in a surface.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某个表面产生凹痕或凹陷的动作、过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att jew il-proċess li bih issir daħla f'wiċċ ta' oġġett.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使物体表面形成凹痕或凹陷。

collocations.en: the denting of the metal sheet
the denting of the car door

formal.mt: It-tagħtin tal-folja tal-metall seħħ meta waqa' oġġett tqil fuqha.
formal.en: The metal sheet was dented when a heavy object fell onto it.
formal.zh: 一个重物掉到金属薄板上，导致薄板表面凹陷。

colloquial.mt: David: X'ikkawża t-tagħtin tal-bieba tal-karozza? Marija: Karrettun laqat il-bieba fil-parkeġġ.
colloquial.en: David: What caused the car door to become dented? Marija: A trolley hit the door in the car park.
colloquial.zh: David：车门怎么被碰凹了？Marija：停车场里一辆手推车撞到了车门。

messages.speaker: David (修车师傅)
messages.zh: 车门怎么被碰凹了？
messages.en: What caused the car door to become dented?

messages.speaker: Marija (车主)
messages.zh: 停车场里一辆手推车撞到了车门。
messages.en: A trolley hit the door in the car park.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tagħtin 配成“重物落下，表面向里凹”的连续画面；注意记忆重点是造成凹陷的过程，而非单指那道凹痕。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The care and upbringing of offspring as they grow.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在后代成长过程中对其进行照料、养育的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kura u t-trobbija tal-ulied jew tal-frieħ waqt li jikbru.

sense_translations.en_definition: rearing or bringing up of offspring
sense_translations.zh_definition: 对后代的养育、抚育，包括照料其成长。

formal.mt: It-tagħtiq tal-frieħ jeħtieġ ikel adattat, kenn u kura regolari.
formal.en: Rearing young animals requires suitable food, shelter, and regular care.
formal.zh: 养育幼崽需要适当的食物、栖身之处和日常照料。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Kif sejjer it-tagħtiq tal-frieħ tal-fenek? Ġorġ: Sejjer tajjeb; qegħdin jikbru u nieħdu ħsiebhom kuljum.
colloquial.en: Anna: How is rearing the baby rabbits going? Ġorġ: It's going well; they're growing, and we look after them every day.
colloquial.zh: Anna：小兔子养得怎么样？Ġorġ：挺好，它们正在长大，我们每天都照料它们。

messages.speaker: Anna (邻居)
messages.zh: 小兔子养得怎么样？
messages.en: How is rearing the baby rabbits going?

messages.speaker: Ġorġ (养兔人)
messages.mt_spoken: Sejjer tajjeb; qegħdin jikbru u nieħdu ħsiebhom kuljum.
messages.mt_standard: Sejjer tajjeb; qegħdin jikbru u nieħdu ħsiebhom kuljum.
messages.zh: 挺好，它们正在长大，我们每天都照料它们。
messages.en: It's going well; they're growing, and we look after them every day.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“每天喂养、照料，直到幼小慢慢长大”的时间线记 tagħtiq；它强调持续的养育，不只是一次喂食。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of repeating something, or of replacing one thing with another.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将某事再做一次的重复行为，或用另一事物取代原有事物的替换行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li terġa' tagħmel xi ħaġa, jew li tissostitwixxi ħaġa b'oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 重复；再次进行某个动作或再次呈现同一内容。
替换；以另一事物取代原有事物。

collocations.en: the repetition of the same word
the replacement of one word with another
collocations.zh: 用另一个词替换某个词

formal.mt: Fl-eżerċizzju tal-kitba, it-tagħwid ta' kelma b'oħra għandu jżomm it-tifsira tas-sentenza.
formal.en: In the writing exercise, replacing one word with another should preserve the meaning of the sentence.
formal.zh: 在写作练习中，用另一个词替换原词时，应保持句子的意思。

colloquial.mt: Maja: It-tagħwid tal-istess kelma jgħinni niftakarha. Mark: Lili wkoll; ejja ngħiduha tliet darbiet oħra.
colloquial.en: Maja: Repeating the same word helps me remember it. Mark: Me too; let's say it three more times.
colloquial.zh: Maja：重复同一个词能帮我记住它。Mark：我也是；我们再说三遍吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (语言学习伙伴)
messages.zh: 重复同一个词能帮我记住它。
messages.en: Repeating the same word helps me remember it.

messages.speaker: Mark (语言学习伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Lili wkoll; ejja ngħiduha tliet darbiet oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Lili wkoll; ejja ngħiduha tliet darbiet oħra.
messages.zh: 我也是；我们再说三遍吧。
messages.en: Me too; let's say it three more times.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 tagħwid 做两张情景卡：“同一个词再说一次”记重复，“拿新词换掉旧词”记替换；结合上下文区分两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Deceit or dishonesty in what someone says or does.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 言语或行为中的欺骗、不诚实。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qerq jew nuqqas ta' onestà f'dak li persuna tgħid jew tagħmel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 欺骗；使别人相信虚假情况的行为
不诚实；不如实说话或行事

formal.mt: It-tagħwil fir-reklamar jista' jwassal biex il-klijenti jitilfu l-fiduċja fil-kumpanija.
formal.en: Dishonesty in advertising can cause customers to lose trust in the company.
formal.zh: 广告中的不诚实行为可能使顾客失去对公司的信任。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Qalli li l-prezz kien jinkludi kollox, imma mbagħad talabni aktar flus. | Lara: Dan tagħwil; kellu jgħidlek il-prezz sħiħ mill-bidu.
colloquial.en: Mark: He told me the price included everything, but then he asked me for more money. | Lara: That's dishonest; he should have told you the full price from the start.
colloquial.zh: Mark：他跟我说价格已经包含所有费用，后来却又向我加收钱。 | Lara：这就是不诚实；他一开始就该告诉你全部价格。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Qalli li l-prezz kien jinkludi kollox, imma mbagħad talabni aktar flus.
messages.mt_standard: Qalli li l-prezz kien jinkludi kollox, imma mbagħad talabni aktar flus.
messages.zh: 他跟我说价格已经包含所有费用，后来却又向我加收钱。
messages.en: He told me the price included everything, but then he asked me for more money.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan tagħwil; kellu jgħidlek il-prezz sħiħ mill-bidu.
messages.mt_standard: Dan tagħwil; kellu jgħidlek il-prezz sħiħ mill-bidu.
messages.zh: 这就是不诚实；他一开始就该告诉你全部价格。
messages.en: That's dishonest; he should have told you the full price from the start.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“嘴上说全包，结账又加钱”的场景与此词相连，同时记住“欺骗”和“不诚实”两个义项。

gloss_zh: 使人游泳；使物漂浮的动作

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of making someone or something swim or float.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人或某物游泳，或使其漂浮起来的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li biha wieħed iġiegħel lil xi ħadd jew lil xi ħaġa jgħum jew iżomm fil-wiċċ tal-ilma.

sense_translations.en_definition: the act of making sb. or sth. swim or float
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某人或某物游泳或漂浮的动作

collocations.en: an exercise in making someone or something swim or float
collocations.zh: 使人游泳或使物漂浮的练习

formal.mt: L-esperiment juri t-tagħwim ta' oġġetti ħfief fuq wiċċ l-ilma.
formal.en: The experiment demonstrates making light objects float on the surface of the water.
formal.zh: 该实验演示如何使轻物体漂浮在水面上。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'se nagħmlu fl-eżerċizzju ta' tagħwim illum? | Toni: Se npoġġu dawn il-biċċiet tas-sufra fl-ilma u narawhom iżommu fil-wiċċ.
colloquial.en: Sara: What are we going to do in today's floating exercise? | Toni: We'll put these pieces of cork in the water and watch them stay on the surface.
colloquial.zh: Sara：今天的漂浮练习要做什么？ | Toni：我们会把这些软木块放进水里，看它们浮在水面上。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: X'se nagħmlu fl-eżerċizzju ta' tagħwim illum?
messages.mt_standard: X'se nagħmlu fl-eżerċizzju ta' tagħwim illum?
messages.zh: 今天的漂浮练习要做什么？
messages.en: What are we going to do in today's floating exercise?

messages.speaker: Toni (科学教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Se npoġġu dawn il-biċċiet tas-sufra fl-ilma u narawhom iżommu fil-wiċċ.
messages.mt_standard: Se npoġġu dawn il-biċċiet tas-sufra fl-ilma u narawhom iżommu fil-wiċċ.
messages.zh: 我们会把这些软木块放进水里，看它们浮在水面上。
messages.en: We'll put these pieces of cork in the water and watch them stay on the surface.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象老师把软木块放入水中使它浮起，抓住“使其游泳或漂浮”的使动含义来记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of looking to one side.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把视线转向一侧、朝旁边看的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li wieħed iħares lejn naħa waħda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 向一侧看；朝旁边看

formal.mt: Fir-ritratt, it-tagħwis tat-tifel lejn il-lemin jiġbed l-attenzjoni lejn it-tieqa.
formal.en: In the photograph, the boy's looking to the right draws attention to the window.
formal.zh: 照片中，男孩向右侧看的动作把人们的注意力引向窗户。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex dan it-tagħwis kollu lejn ix-xellug? | Ben: Qed nistenna lil ħija; għandu jiġi minn dik in-naħa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why do you keep looking to the left? | Ben: I'm waiting for my brother; he should be coming from that direction.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你怎么老是往左边看？ | Ben：我在等我哥哥，他应该会从那边过来。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex dan it-tagħwis kollu lejn ix-xellug?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex dan it-tagħwis kollu lejn ix-xellug?
messages.zh: 你怎么老是往左边看？
messages.en: Why do you keep looking to the left?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed nistenna lil ħija; għandu jiġi minn dik in-naħa.
messages.mt_standard: Qed nistenna lil ħija; għandu jiġi minn dik in-naħa.
messages.zh: 我在等我哥哥，他应该会从那边过来。
messages.en: I'm waiting for my brother; he should be coming from that direction.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象等朋友时不断朝侧面张望，把视线向一侧移动的画面与“侧视”联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action of bending something into a curved or angled shape.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某物弄弯，使其形成曲线或角度的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li biha xi ħaġa titgħawweġ u tieħu forma mgħawġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 弯折；使某物弯曲的动作

formal.mt: It-tagħwiġ tal-wajer għandu jsir bil-mod biex il-wajer ma jinkisirx.
formal.en: The wire should be bent slowly so that it does not break.
formal.zh: 应缓慢弯折金属丝，以免将其折断。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Tista' tgħinni bit-tagħwiġ ta' dan il-wajer? | Pawlu: Iva, x'forma tixtieq?
colloquial.en: Maja: Can you help me bend this wire? | Pawlu: Yes, what shape would you like?
colloquial.zh: Maja：你能帮我把这根金属丝弯一下吗？ | Pawlu：可以，你想弯成什么形状？

messages.speaker: Maja (手工课同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' tgħinni bit-tagħwiġ ta' dan il-wajer?
messages.mt_standard: Tista' tgħinni bit-tagħwiġ ta' dan il-wajer?
messages.zh: 你能帮我把这根金属丝弯一下吗？
messages.en: Can you help me bend this wire?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (手工课同学)
messages.zh: 可以，你想弯成什么形状？
messages.en: Yes, what shape would you like?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把一根直金属丝弯成圆环，用这个动作记住“弯折”，重点是动作而非最后的形状。

gloss_zh: 缴纳或奉献十分之一；什一奉献

teaching_sense.en_definition: The practice of giving or paying one tenth of income or produce as a tithe.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将收入或出产的十分之一作为什一款缴纳或奉献的做法。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-prattika li wieħed jagħti jew iħallas parti minn kull għaxra tad-dħul jew tal-prodott tiegħu bħala deċma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 缴纳或奉献收入、出产等的十分之一，即什一奉献

collocations.zh: 将收入的十分之一缴纳或奉献

formal.mt: Fl-eżempju mogħti, it-tagħxir ta' dħul ta' mitt ewro jfisser li jingħataw għaxar ewro.
formal.en: In the example given, tithing an income of one hundred euros means giving ten euros.
formal.zh: 在所给例子中，对一百欧元的收入进行什一奉献，就是拿出十欧元。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi jfisser tagħxir f'dan it-test? | Mark: Ifisser li tagħti parti minn kull għaxra; minn mitt ewro tagħti għaxra.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does tithing mean in this text? | Mark: It means giving one part out of every ten; from one hundred euros, you give ten.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这篇文章里的什一奉献是什么意思？ | Mark：意思是每十份拿出一份；一百欧元就拿出十欧元。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 这篇文章里的什一奉献是什么意思？
messages.en: What does tithing mean in this text?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li tagħti parti minn kull għaxra; minn mitt ewro tagħti għaxra.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li tagħti parti minn kull għaxra; minn mitt ewro tagħti għaxra.
messages.zh: 意思是每十份拿出一份；一百欧元就拿出十欧元。
messages.en: It means giving one part out of every ten; from one hundred euros, you give ten.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画出十枚硬币并圈出其中一枚，用“十份取一份”的比例记住什一奉献这一行为。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A weakening or loss of strength and energy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 力量减弱、身体变得虚弱或精力流失。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dgħufija jew telf ta' saħħa u enerġija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 衰弱；力量减弱或身体变得虚弱
精力流失；活力减退

collocations.en: a feeling of weakness or loss of energy
collocations.zh: 虚弱或精力不足的感觉

formal.mt: Fid-djarju tagħha, l-atleta ddeskriviet sensazzjoni ta' tagħxix wara t-taħriġ twil.
formal.en: In her diary, the athlete described a feeling of weakness after the long training session.
formal.zh: 这位运动员在日记中描述了长时间训练后感到虚弱的情况。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Wara dik il-mixja kollha, qed inħoss tagħxix fil-ġisem. | Pawlu: Jien ukoll; ejja noqogħdu bilqiegħda ftit.
colloquial.en: Nina: After all that walking, my body feels weak. | Pawlu: Mine too; let's sit down for a bit.
colloquial.zh: Nina：走了那么久，我觉得浑身没力气。 | Pawlu：我也是，咱们坐一会儿吧。

messages.speaker: Nina (徒步同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Wara dik il-mixja kollha, qed inħoss tagħxix fil-ġisem.
messages.mt_standard: Wara dik il-mixja kollha, qed inħoss tagħxix fil-ġisem.
messages.zh: 走了那么久，我觉得浑身没力气。
messages.en: After all that walking, my body feels weak.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (徒步同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien ukoll; ejja noqogħdu bilqiegħda ftit.
messages.mt_standard: Jien ukoll; ejja noqogħdu bilqiegħda ftit.
messages.zh: 我也是，咱们坐一会儿吧。
messages.en: Mine too; let's sit down for a bit.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把身体想成电量逐渐下降的电池，借此记住“力量减弱、精力流失”，两个义项一同记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A feeling of great surprise or wonder at something unexpected or remarkable.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 遇到出乎意料或非同寻常的事物时产生的强烈惊讶或惊叹。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sens qawwi ta' sorpriża jew meravilja quddiem xi ħaġa mhux mistennija jew straordinarja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 惊讶；因意外或非凡的事物而产生的惊叹。

formal.mt: Il-viżitaturi esprimew it-tagħġib tagħhom quddiem is-sbuħija tal-palazz.
formal.en: The visitors expressed their astonishment at the beauty of the palace.
formal.zh: 访客们对宫殿的美丽表达了惊叹。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Rajt il-kastell għall-ewwel darba? Mark: Iva, bqajt inħares lejh bit-tagħġib.
colloquial.en: Maja: Was that your first time seeing the castle? Mark: Yes, I kept looking at it in astonishment.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你是第一次看到这座城堡吗？Mark：是啊，我一直惊叹地望着它。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你是第一次看到这座城堡吗？
messages.en: Was that your first time seeing the castle?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 是啊，我一直惊叹地望着它。
messages.en: Yes, I kept looking at it in astonishment.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象第一次看到宏伟城堡时睁大眼睛、久久凝望：把这个词与心里发出的“哇，真惊人”联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Haste or excessive speed in doing something, often without enough care.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 做事时的匆忙或急促，常指因求快而缺少充分注意。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għaġla biex isir xi ħaġa, ħafna drabi mingħajr biżżejjed attenzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 匆忙；急促；赶着做事的状态。

formal.mt: Ix-xogħol għandu jsir b'attenzjoni, għax it-tagħġil jista' jwassal għal żbalji.
formal.en: The work should be done carefully, because haste can lead to mistakes.
formal.zh: 工作应当认真完成，因为匆忙可能导致错误。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandna biżżejjed ħin? Mark: Iva, nistgħu nlestu kollox mingħajr tagħġil.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do we have enough time? Mark: Yes, we can finish everything without rushing.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们时间够吗？马克：够，我们可以不慌不忙地把事情做完。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 我们时间够吗？
messages.en: Do we have enough time?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, nistgħu nlestu kollox mingħajr tagħġil.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, nistgħu nlestu kollox mingħajr tagħġil.
messages.zh: 够，我们可以不慌不忙地把事情做完。
messages.en: Yes, we can finish everything without rushing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tagħġil 放进“赶时间而漏看一行”的画面，再配对记忆 mingħajr tagħġil，表示不慌不忙。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The state of being lazy or unwilling to make an effort.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 处于懒惰、不愿行动或不愿付出努力的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-istat ta' għażż, meta wieħed ma jkunx irid jaħdem jew jagħmel sforz.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 懒惰的状态；懒散

formal.mt: Biex jegħleb it-tagħżin, l-istudent iddeċieda li jibda b'kompitu żgħir kull filgħodu.
formal.en: To overcome laziness, the student decided to begin with a small task every morning.
formal.zh: 为了克服懒惰，这名学生决定每天早上先完成一项小任务。

colloquial.mt: Ben: Illum għandi tagħżin; lanqas irrid nirranġa l-kamra. | Sara: Ibda bl-iskrivanija biss, imbagħad tara jekk tridx tkompli.
colloquial.en: Ben: I'm feeling lazy today; I don't even want to tidy my room. | Sara: Just start with the desk, then see whether you want to carry on.
