colloquial.zh: Ben：我今天很懒，连房间都不想收拾。 | Sara：先只收拾书桌，再看看想不想继续。

messages.speaker: Ben (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Illum għandi tagħżin; lanqas irrid nirranġa l-kamra.
messages.mt_standard: Illum għandi tagħżin; lanqas irrid nirranġa l-kamra.
messages.zh: 我今天很懒，连房间都不想收拾。
messages.en: I'm feeling lazy today; I don't even want to tidy my room.

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ibda bl-iskrivanija biss, imbagħad tara jekk tridx tkompli.
messages.mt_standard: Ibda bl-iskrivanija biss, imbagħad tara jekk tridx tkompli.
messages.zh: 先只收拾书桌，再看看想不想继续。
messages.en: Just start with the desk, then see whether you want to carry on.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象待办事项摆在眼前却只想躺着，用“不愿动手”的状态记住懒散，重点在行动意愿。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of cherishing someone or something, or regarding them as valuable.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 珍爱某人或某物，或认为其有价值并加以重视的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li wieħed jgħożż lil xi ħadd jew lil xi ħaġa, jew jagħti valur lilhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 珍爱；怀着深厚感情爱惜某人或某物
珍视；认为某人或某物有价值并加以重视

formal.mt: It-tagħżiż tal-ilsien Malti jidher fl-użu tiegħu fil-kitba, fit-tagħlim u fil-ħajja ta' kuljum.
formal.en: Valuing the Maltese language is reflected in its use in writing, teaching, and everyday life.
formal.zh: 对马耳他语的珍视体现在写作、教学及日常生活中使用它。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex għadek iżżomm dawk l-ittri qodma? | Mark: Għax kitbithomli n-nanna; għalija, li nżommhom hu mod ta' tagħżiż tal-memorja tagħha.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why do you still keep those old letters? | Mark: Because my grandmother wrote them to me; keeping them is a way of cherishing her memory.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你为什么还留着那些旧信？ | Mark：因为那是奶奶写给我的；对我来说，保存它们就是珍惜关于她的回忆的一种方式。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex għadek iżżomm dawk l-ittri qodma?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex għadek iżżomm dawk l-ittri qodma?
messages.zh: 你为什么还留着那些旧信？
messages.en: Why do you still keep those old letters?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax kitbithomli n-nanna; għalija, li nżommhom hu mod ta' tagħżiż tal-memorja tagħha.
messages.mt_standard: Għax kitbithomli n-nanna; għalija, li nżommhom hu mod ta' tagħżiż tal-memorja tagħha.
messages.zh: 因为那是奶奶写给我的；对我来说，保存它们就是珍惜关于她的回忆的一种方式。
messages.en: Because my grandmother wrote them to me; keeping them is a way of cherishing her memory.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象小心保存家人写的旧信，以感情记“珍爱”；再想到重视自己的语言，以价值记“珍视”。

gloss_zh: 属于同一群体的；同群体的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Belonging to the same group or expressing membership in that group.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 属于同一个群体的，或体现该群体共同归属的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jappartjeni għall-istess grupp jew jesprimi sħubija f'dak il-grupp.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 属于同一群体的；具有共同群体归属的。

collocations.en: a sense of belonging to the same group
a character reflecting shared group membership
collocations.zh: 体现共同群体归属的性质

formal.mt: Is-simbolu għandu karattru tajfi: juri li dawk li jilbsuh jappartjenu għall-istess grupp.
formal.en: The symbol reflects shared group membership: it shows that those who wear it belong to the same group.
formal.zh: 这个标志体现了共同的群体归属：佩戴它的人属于同一群体。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Xi jfisser 'tajfi' hawn? Adam: Ifisser li jappartjeni għall-istess grupp. Hawn qed jitkellmu dwar simbolu komuni għall-membri.
colloquial.en: Nina: What does 'tajfi' mean here? Adam: It means belonging to the same group. Here they're talking about a symbol shared by the members.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这里的 tajfi 是什么意思？亚当：意思是属于同一群体的。这里说的是成员共有的标志。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: 这里的 tajfi 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'tajfi' mean here?

messages.speaker: Adam (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li jappartjeni għall-istess grupp. Hawn qed jitkellmu dwar simbolu komuni għall-membri.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li jappartjeni għall-istess grupp. Hawn qed jitkellmu dwar simbolu komuni għall-membri.
messages.zh: 意思是属于同一群体的。这里说的是成员共有的标志。
messages.en: It means belonging to the same group. Here they're talking about a symbol shared by the members.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一群人佩戴相同徽章，用“同一个圈子、同一种归属”记住这个形容词；这只是场景联想，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small stick with cotton at one or both ends, used for wiping or applying small amounts of a substance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一端或两端带有棉头的小棒，用于擦拭或少量涂抹。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Stikka żgħira bil-qoton f'tarf wieħed jew fiż-żewġt itruf, użata biex timsaħ jew tapplika ammont żgħir ta' sustanza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一根棉签；带有棉头、用于擦拭或涂抹的小棒。

collocations.en: to wipe with a cotton swab

formal.mt: Biex tneħħi t-tikek żgħar taż-żebgħa, uża tajjara nadifa u imsaħ bil-mod.
formal.en: To remove the small spots of paint, use a clean cotton swab and wipe gently.
formal.zh: 要去除小漆点，请用干净的棉签轻轻擦拭。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Għandek tajjara? Irrid innaddaf din ir-rokna żgħira. David: Iva, hawn waħda nadifa.
colloquial.en: Elena: Do you have a cotton swab? I want to clean this little corner. David: Yes, here's a clean one.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：你有棉签吗？我想清理这个小角落。戴维：有，这里有一根干净的。

messages.speaker: Elena (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek tajjara? Irrid innaddaf din ir-rokna żgħira.
messages.mt_standard: Għandek tajjara? Irrid innaddaf din ir-rokna żgħira.
messages.zh: 你有棉签吗？我想清理这个小角落。
messages.en: Do you have a cotton swab? I want to clean this little corner.

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.zh: 有，这里有一根干净的。
messages.en: Yes, here's a clean one.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一根细棒顶着小棉头，专门伸进小角落擦拭；把完整的 tajjara 和这根棉签的形象一起记住。

gloss_zh: 使之飞起的；引起飞行的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Causing something to fly or take flight.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物飞起来或开始飞行的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jġiegħel lil xi ħaġa ttir jew tibda tittajjar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 引起飞行的；使某物飞起来的。

collocations.en: an effect that causes something to fly
a mechanism that causes something to take flight

formal.mt: Fid-deskrizzjoni tal-mudell, il-mekkaniżmu jissejjaħ 'tajjari' għax iġiegħel l-oġġett itir.
formal.en: In the description of the model, the mechanism is called 'tajjari' because it causes the object to fly.
formal.zh: 在这个模型的说明中，该装置被称为 tajjari，因为它能使物体飞起来。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Xi jfisser 'effett tajjari' f'din is-sentenza? Samwel: Effett li jġiegħel xi ħaġa ttir. Ħares, hawn qed jitkellmu dwar il-mudell tal-karta.
colloquial.en: Rita: What does 'effett tajjari' mean in this sentence? Samwel: An effect that makes something fly. Look, here they're talking about the paper model.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：这句话里的 effett tajjari 是什么意思？萨姆韦尔：使某物飞起来的作用。你看，这里说的是那个纸模型。

messages.speaker: Rita (学生)
messages.zh: 这句话里的 effett tajjari 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'effett tajjari' mean in this sentence?

messages.speaker: Samwel (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Effett li jġiegħel xi ħaġa ttir. Ħares, hawn qed jitkellmu dwar il-mudell tal-karta.
messages.mt_standard: Effett li jġiegħel xi ħaġa ttir. Ħares, hawn qed jitkellmu dwar il-mudell tal-karta.
messages.zh: 使某物飞起来的作用。你看，这里说的是那个纸模型。
messages.en: An effect that makes something fly. Look, here they're talking about the paper model.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一支箭头从装置指向飞起的纸模型，把“使它飞起来”作为记忆中心，突出这个形容词的致使意义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of entering written text using a keyboard or typewriter.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使用键盘或打字机输入文字的活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-attività li ddaħħal test permezz ta' tastiera jew magna tal-kitba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 打字；通过键盘或打字机输入文字。

formal.mt: Il-kors tat-tajping jiffoka fuq il-preċiżjoni u l-użu korrett tat-tastiera.
formal.en: The typing course focuses on accuracy and correct keyboard use.
formal.zh: 这门打字课程注重准确性和正确使用键盘。

colloquial.mt: Julia: Kif sejjer il-kors tat-tajping? Omar: Tajjeb! Issa nikteb aktar malajr u nagħmel inqas żbalji.
colloquial.en: Julia: How's the typing course going? Omar: Well! I type faster now and make fewer mistakes.
colloquial.zh: 尤莉娅：打字课学得怎么样？奥马尔：挺好！现在我打得更快，错误也更少了。

messages.speaker: Julia (朋友)
messages.zh: 打字课学得怎么样？
messages.en: How's the typing course going?

messages.speaker: Omar (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb! Issa nikteb aktar malajr u nagħmel inqas żbalji.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb! Issa nikteb aktar malajr u nagħmel inqas żbalji.
messages.zh: 挺好！现在我打得更快，错误也更少了。
messages.en: Well! I type faster now and make fewer mistakes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tajping 与英语 typing 的声音联系起来，再想象手指连续敲键盘；这个词记的是“打字这项活动”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person whose work is to type letters, documents or other texts.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以打字录入信件、文件或其他文字为工作的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li xogħolha hu li tittajpja ittri, dokumenti jew testi oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 打字员；负责打字录入文字的工作人员。

formal.mt: L-uffiċċju qed ifittex tajpist b'esperjenza biex jipprepara ittri u dokumenti bi preċiżjoni.
formal.en: The office is seeking an experienced typist to prepare letters and documents accurately.
formal.zh: 该办公室正在招聘一名有经验的打字员，以准确录入信件和文件。

colloquial.mt: Marija: X'xogħol jagħmel ħuk? Toni: Jaħdem bħala tajpist f'uffiċċju. Jittajpja ħafna ittri kuljum.
colloquial.en: Marija: What does your brother do for work? Toni: He works as a typist in an office. He types lots of letters every day.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：你兄弟做什么工作？托尼：他在办公室当打字员，每天要打很多封信。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 你兄弟做什么工作？
messages.en: What does your brother do for work?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jaħdem bħala tajpist f'uffiċċju. Jittajpja ħafna ittri kuljum.
messages.mt_standard: Jaħdem bħala tajpist f'uffiċċju. Jittajpja ħafna ittri kuljum.
messages.zh: 他在办公室当打字员，每天要打很多封信。
messages.en: He works as a typist in an office. He types lots of letters every day.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tajpist 与英语 typist 对照记忆：画面中坐在键盘前工作的人就是打字员；再与表示打字活动的 tajping 配对区分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of entering text by typing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过敲击键盘输入文字的行为或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att jew il-proċess li ddaħħal test billi tagħfas it-tasti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 打字；一次文字录入的行为。

formal.mt: Qabel ma jintbagħat id-dokument, għandu jiġi ċċekkjat għal żbalji fit-tajpjatura.
formal.en: Before the document is sent, it should be checked for typing errors.
formal.zh: 文件发送之前，应检查其中的打字错误。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Hemm żball fit-tajpjatura ta' ismek. Mark: Iva, għandu jkun Mark, mhux Mar.
colloquial.en: Maja: There is a typing error in your name. Mark: Yes, it should be Mark, not Mar.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你的名字有个打字错误。马克：对，应该是 Mark，不是 Mar。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 你的名字有个打字错误。
messages.en: There is a typing error in your name.

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għandu jkun Mark, mhux Mar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għandu jkun Mark, mhux Mar.
messages.zh: 对，应该是 Mark，不是 Mar。
messages.en: Yes, it should be Mark, not Mar.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词和手指敲键盘的画面绑定，再用“打字错误、打字速度”两组搭配巩固。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Birds, especially poultry; also a kite or kites flown in the wind.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指鸟或鸟类，尤其是家禽；也可指在风中放飞的风筝。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasafar, speċjalment dawk imrobbija għall-bajd jew għal-laħam; ukoll oġġetti li jittajru mar-riħ u jinżammu b'ħajta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鸟；鸟类，尤其指饲养的家禽。
风筝；借风升起、以线牵引的物体。

formal.mt: It-tajr tar-razzett għandu jingħata għalf adattat u ilma nadif kuljum.
formal.en: The farm's poultry should be given suitable feed and clean water every day.
formal.zh: 农场里的家禽每天都应获得合适的饲料和干净的水。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Illum hemm ir-riħ. Intellgħu t-tajr tal-karti? Mark: Iva, nieħdu l-ħajt u mmorru fil-park.
colloquial.en: Maja: It is windy today. Shall we fly the paper kites? Mark: Yes, let's take the string and go to the park.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：今天有风。我们去放纸风筝吧？马克：好，我们带上线去公园。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Illum hemm ir-riħ. Intellgħu t-tajr tal-karti?
messages.mt_standard: Illum hemm ir-riħ. Intellgħu t-tajr tal-karti?
messages.zh: 今天有风。我们去放纸风筝吧？
messages.en: It is windy today. Shall we fly the paper kites?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, nieħdu l-ħajt u mmorru fil-park.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, nieħdu l-ħajt u mmorru fil-park.
messages.zh: 好，我们带上线去公园。
messages.en: Yes, let's take the string and go to the park.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅画区分同形义项：农场里吃饲料的是鸟和家禽，天空中由线牵着的是风筝。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity or process of flying through the air.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在空中飞行的活动或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-attività jew il-proċess ta' moviment fl-ajru, bħal dak tal-għasafar jew tal-ajruplani.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 飞行；在空中飞翔或驾驶飞行器的活动。

formal.mt: L-istudenti osservaw it-tajran tal-għasafar u rreġistraw kif biddlu d-direzzjoni.
formal.en: The students observed the birds flying and recorded how they changed direction.
formal.zh: 学生们观察了鸟类的飞行，并记录了它们如何改变方向。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Bdejt il-lezzjonijiet tat-tajran? Mark: Iva, u għada għandi t-tieni lezzjoni.
colloquial.en: Maja: Have you started your flying lessons? Mark: Yes, and tomorrow I have my second lesson.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你开始上飞行课了吗？马克：开始了，明天上第二节课。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你开始上飞行课了吗？
messages.en: Have you started your flying lessons?

messages.speaker: Mark (飞行学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u għada għandi t-tieni lezzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u għada għandi t-tieni lezzjoni.
messages.zh: 开始了，明天上第二节课。
messages.en: Yes, and tomorrow I have my second lesson.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象鸟和飞机在空中移动，把整个“飞行过程”记作这个名词，再联想飞行课程。

gloss_zh: 台湾的；台湾人，通常指男性

teaching_sense.en_definition: Of, from, or relating to Taiwan.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 来自台湾的，或与台湾有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ġej mit-Tajwan jew li għandu x'jaqsam mat-Tajwan.

sense_translations.en_definition: Taiwanese (of, from or relating to Taiwan)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 台湾的；来自台湾的；与台湾有关的。

sense_translations.en_definition: Taiwanese (native or inhabitant of Taiwan) (usually male)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 台湾人；台湾本地人或居民，通常指男性。

formal.mt: Student Tajwaniż ippreżenta proġett dwar it-trasport fil-belt tiegħu.
formal.en: A Taiwanese student presented a project about transport in his city.
formal.zh: 一名台湾男学生展示了一个有关他所在城市交通的项目。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid tipprova ikel Tajwaniż illejla? Mark: Iva, hemm restorant qrib id-dar tiegħi.
colloquial.en: Maja: Would you like to try Taiwanese food tonight? Mark: Yes, there is a restaurant near my house.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：今晚想尝尝台湾食物吗？马克：想，我家附近有一家餐馆。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 今晚想尝尝台湾食物吗？
messages.en: Would you like to try Taiwanese food tonight?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hemm restorant qrib id-dar tiegħi.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hemm restorant qrib id-dar tiegħi.
messages.zh: 想，我家附近有一家餐馆。
messages.en: Yes, there is a restaurant near my house.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“台湾食物”和“一位台湾人”并排记忆：修饰事物时是形容词，直接指人时是名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An increase in size or extent, including enlargement or expansion.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使大小或范围增加的过程或结果，包括增大和扩展。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Żieda fid-daqs jew fil-firxa ta' xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 增大；使原有的大小或程度增加。
扩展；使原有的空间、范围或规模扩大。

formal.mt: Il-pjan jipprevedi takbir tal-kamra biex ikun hemm aktar spazju għall-istudenti.
formal.en: The plan provides for an expansion of the room to create more space for the students.
formal.zh: 该计划提出扩建房间，为学生提供更多空间。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Nistgħu nagħmlu takbir ta' din l-istampa? Mark: Iva, biex naraw id-dettalji aħjar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can we make an enlargement of this picture? Mark: Yes, so we can see the details better.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们能把这张图片放大吗？马克：可以，这样能更清楚地看到细节。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Nistgħu nagħmlu takbir ta' din l-istampa?
messages.mt_standard: Nistgħu nagħmlu takbir ta' din l-istampa?
messages.zh: 我们能把这张图片放大吗？
messages.en: Can we make an enlargement of this picture?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 可以，这样能更清楚地看到细节。
messages.en: Yes, so we can see the details better.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象图片被放大、房间被扩建，两种画面都突出原有事物的大小或范围增加。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An increase or addition that makes an amount or quantity greater.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使数量或总量变得更多的增加过程或增量。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Żieda li tagħmel ammont jew kwantità akbar minn qabel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 增加；数量或总量比原来更多。
增量；通过添加而使原有数量或总量增加。

collocations.en: an increase in the number of participants

formal.mt: Ir-rapport juri taktir fil-produzzjoni matul l-aħħar sena.
formal.en: The report shows an increase in production over the past year.
formal.zh: 报告显示，过去一年产量有所增加。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Hemm taktir fin-numru ta' parteċipanti din is-sena? Mark: Iva, is-sena l-oħra konna għoxrin u issa aħna tletin.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is there an increase in the number of participants this year? Mark: Yes, last year there were twenty of us, and now there are thirty.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：今年参与人数增加了吗？马克：增加了，去年我们有二十人，现在有三十人。

messages.speaker: Maja (活动组织者)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm taktir fin-numru ta' parteċipanti din is-sena?
messages.mt_standard: Hemm taktir fin-numru ta' parteċipanti din is-sena?
messages.zh: 今年参与人数增加了吗？
messages.en: Is there an increase in the number of participants this year?

messages.speaker: Mark (活动助手)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, is-sena l-oħra konna għoxrin u issa aħna tletin.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, is-sena l-oħra konna għoxrin u issa aħna tletin.
messages.zh: 增加了，去年我们有二十人，现在有三十人。
messages.en: Yes, last year there were twenty of us, and now there are thirty.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用人数从二十变成三十的画面记忆，重点抓住数量比原来更多这一共同含义。

gloss_zh: Tal-Imħammed（马耳他马尔萨什洛克的一处地方）

teaching_sense.en_definition: The name of a locality in Marsaxlokk, in Malta's Southern Region.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 马耳他南部大区马尔萨什洛克境内的一处地方的名称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem ta' lokalità f'Marsaxlokk, fir-Reġjun tan-Nofsinhar ta' Malta.

sense_translations.en_definition: Tal-Imħammed (a locality in Marsaxlokk, Southern Region, Malta)
sense_translations.zh_definition: Tal-Imħammed，位于马耳他南部大区马尔萨什洛克的一处地方。

formal.mt: Tal-Imħammed hija lokalità f'Marsaxlokk, fir-Reġjun tan-Nofsinhar ta' Malta.
formal.en: Tal-Imħammed is a locality in Marsaxlokk, in Malta's Southern Region.
formal.zh: Tal-Imħammed 是马耳他南部大区马尔萨什洛克境内的一处地方。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn jinsab Tal-Imħammed? Mark: Qiegħed f'Marsaxlokk, fin-nofsinhar ta' Malta.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is Tal-Imħammed? Mark: It is in Marsaxlokk, in the south of Malta.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Tal-Imħammed 在哪里？Mark：在马耳他南部的马尔萨什洛克。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: Tal-Imħammed 在哪里？
messages.en: Where is Tal-Imħammed?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.zh: 在马耳他南部的马尔萨什洛克。
messages.en: It is in Marsaxlokk, in the south of Malta.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用地图定位记忆：马耳他南部、马尔萨什洛克、Tal-Imħammed，按大到小的地点顺序串联。

gloss_zh: 来呀；用于招呼小孩子过来

teaching_sense.en_definition: An expression used to call a small child over, with 'come' understood.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于招呼小孩子过来的表达，意思中隐含“来”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni biex issejjaħ lit-tfal iż-żgħar biex jiġu ħdejk, bil-verb 'ejja' mifhum.

sense_translations.en_definition: According to Caruana, this expression was used to call little children with the verb 'ejja' understood
sense_translations.zh_definition: 据 Caruana 记载，这一表达曾用于招呼小孩子，其中隐含动词 ejja，意为“来”。

formal.mt: L-espressjoni 'tala' sservi biex issejjaħ lit-tfal iż-żgħar, bil-verb 'ejja' mifhum.
formal.en: The expression 'tala' serves to call small children over, with the verb 'come' understood.
formal.zh: 表达 tala 用于招呼小孩子过来，其中隐含动词“来”。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Tala ħdejja, ċkejken. Ben: Ġej, nanna! Nista' nġib il-ktieb miegħi?
colloquial.en: Anna: Come over to me, little one. Ben: I'm coming, Grandma! Can I bring the book with me?
colloquial.zh: 安娜：到我身边来，小家伙。本：来了，奶奶！我能把书也带来吗？

messages.speaker: Anna (祖母)
messages.zh: 到我身边来，小家伙。
messages.en: Come over to me, little one.

messages.speaker: Ben (孙子)
messages.mt_spoken: Ġej, nanna! Nista' nġib il-ktieb miegħi?
messages.mt_standard: Ġej, nanna! Nista' nġib il-ktieb miegħi?
messages.zh: 来了，奶奶！我能把书也带来吗？
messages.en: I'm coming, Grandma! Can I bring the book with me?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象长辈向幼童招手说“来呀”，把整句当作招呼语记住，理解其中省略了“来”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A call telling someone to come here, towards the speaker.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 招呼或要求对方到说话者这里来的感叹表达。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sejħa lil xi ħadd biex jiġi hawn, qrib min qed jitkellem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 到这里来！过来！

formal.mt: L-għalliema qalet lill-istudent: 'Talahawn ħdejja biex nurik kif issolvi l-eżerċizzju.'
formal.en: The teacher said to the student: 'Come here beside me so I can show you how to solve the exercise.'
formal.zh: 老师对学生说：“到我身边来，我给你演示怎样解这道练习题。”

colloquial.mt: Maja: Talahawn, Mark! Ara dan ir-ritratt. Mark: Ġej! Min hemm fir-ritratt?
colloquial.en: Maja: Come here, Mark! Look at this photo. Mark: I'm coming! Who is in the photo?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：过来，马克！看看这张照片。马克：来了！照片里是谁？

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 过来，马克！看看这张照片。
messages.en: Come here, Mark! Look at this photo.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 来了！照片里是谁？
messages.en: I'm coming! Who is in the photo?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象朋友站在原地招手叫你靠近，把这个词整体对应成一句“到这里来！”即可。

teaching_sense.en_definition: At a minimum, indicating the smallest amount or the least that should be done.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示数量、程度或行动的最低限度，相当于“至少、起码”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bħala minimu, biex tindika l-iżgħar ammont jew l-inqas ħaġa li għandha ssir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 至少；起码。

formal.mt: Kull student għandu jaqra t-test talanqas darba qabel il-lezzjoni.
formal.en: Each student should read the text at least once before the lesson.
formal.zh: 每位学生应在上课前至少读一遍课文。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kemm għandna ħin qabel nitilqu? Mark: Għandna talanqas siegħa; nistgħu nieklu xi ħaġa.
colloquial.en: Maja: How much time do we have before we leave? Mark: We have at least an hour; we can get something to eat.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我们出发前还有多少时间？Mark：至少还有一个小时，可以吃点东西。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们出发前还有多少时间？
messages.en: How much time do we have before we leave?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandna talanqas siegħa; nistgħu nieklu xi ħaġa.
messages.mt_standard: Għandna talanqas siegħa; nistgħu nieklu xi ħaġa.
messages.zh: 至少还有一个小时，可以吃点东西。
messages.en: We have at least an hour; we can get something to eat.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 talanqas 想成数量旁的一条最低线：talanqas darba 就是次数至少达到一次。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Inclined to pray or to spend time in prayer.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容一个人有祈祷的倾向，喜欢或经常作祷告。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu tendenza jitlob lil Alla jew iqatta' ħin fit-talb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 倾向于祈祷的；爱作祷告的。

formal.mt: Il-bijografija tiddeskrivih bħala raġel talban li kien iqatta' ħin fit-talb kuljum.
formal.en: The biography describes him as a prayerful man who spent time in prayer every day.
formal.zh: 这部传记将他描写为一位爱祈祷的男子，每天都会花时间作祷告。

colloquial.mt: Maja: In-nannu tiegħek jitlob kuljum? Mark: Iva, hu raġel talban u jħobb jitlob fil-kwiet.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does your grandfather pray every day? Mark: Yes, he is a prayerful man and likes to pray quietly.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你爷爷每天都祈祷吗？Mark：是的，他很爱祈祷，喜欢安静地作祷告。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你爷爷每天都祈祷吗？
messages.en: Does your grandfather pray every day?

messages.speaker: Mark (孙子)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hu raġel talban u jħobb jitlob fil-kwiet.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hu raġel talban u jħobb jitlob fil-kwiet.
messages.zh: 是的，他很爱祈祷，喜欢安静地作祷告。
messages.en: Yes, he is a prayerful man and likes to pray quietly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住 raġel talban 的画面：一个每天静心祈祷的人，用祷告场景固定这个形容词的意义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The Maltese name for Tallinn, the capital city of Estonia.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 爱沙尼亚首都塔林的马耳他语名称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-isem bil-Malti tal-belt kapitali tal-Estonja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 塔林，爱沙尼亚的首都。

formal.mt: Talinn hija l-belt kapitali tal-Estonja.
formal.en: Tallinn is the capital city of Estonia.
formal.zh: 塔林是爱沙尼亚的首都。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Liema belt se żżur fl-Estonja? Mark: Se nżur Talinn, il-kapitali.
colloquial.en: Maja: Which city will you visit in Estonia? Mark: I will visit Tallinn, the capital.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你要去爱沙尼亚的哪座城市？Mark：我要去首都塔林。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你要去爱沙尼亚的哪座城市？
messages.en: Which city will you visit in Estonia?

messages.speaker: Mark (旅行者)
messages.zh: 我要去首都塔林。
messages.en: I will visit Tallinn, the capital.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Talinn 与“塔林、爱沙尼亚首都”做成同一张记忆卡；拼写时留意一个 l、结尾两个 n。

formal.zh: 制作鲜奶酪时，会使用促凝乳制剂，使牛奶凝结成凝乳。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'jagħmel dan l-aġent? Ġużeppi: Huwa aġent tammasi: jgħin lill-ħalib jagħqad.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does this agent do? Ġużeppi: It is a milk-curdling agent: it helps the milk form curds.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这种制剂有什么作用？朱塞佩：它是促凝乳制剂，帮助牛奶凝结。

messages.speaker: Maja (烹饪学员)
messages.zh: 这种制剂有什么作用？
messages.en: What does this agent do?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (奶酪制作师)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa aġent tammasi: jgħin lill-ħalib jagħqad.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa aġent tammasi: jgħin lill-ħalib jagħqad.
messages.zh: 它是促凝乳制剂，帮助牛奶凝结。
messages.en: It is a milk-curdling agent: it helps the milk form curds.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tammasi 当作贴在制剂瓶上的性质标签：“能使牛奶凝结”。记住它描述作用或性质，并不是动作本身。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A date fruit, or the date palm that produces such fruit, depending on context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可指一颗椰枣，也可指结椰枣的椰枣树，具体含义由上下文判断。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Frotta tas-siġra tat-tamal, jew is-siġra stess, skont il-kuntest.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 椰枣树；结椰枣的棕榈树。
椰枣；椰枣树所结的果实。

collocations.en: a date palm in the garden

formal.mt: Fil-ġnien tal-iskola hemm tamra, siġra li tagħti t-tamal.
formal.en: There is a date palm in the school garden, a tree that produces dates.
formal.zh: 学校花园里有一棵椰枣树，这种树会结椰枣。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid tamra mal-kafè? Mark: Iva, agħtini waħda, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Maja: Would you like a date with your coffee? Mark: Yes, give me one, please.
colloquial.zh: Maja：喝咖啡时要配一颗椰枣吗？Mark：好，请给我一颗。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 喝咖啡时要配一颗椰枣吗？
messages.en: Would you like a date with your coffee?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 好，请给我一颗。
messages.en: Yes, give me one, please.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把一颗椰枣和一棵椰枣树画在同一张卡片上：吃东西的语境想到果实，花园的语境想到树。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Resembling a date palm in appearance or form.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 外观或形态像椰枣树的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jixbah is-siġra tat-tamal fid-dehra jew fil-forma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 似椰枣树的；具有椰枣树般外观或形态的。

formal.mt: L-iskultura għandha profil tamri, b'parti twila fin-nofs u forom bħal weraq fil-quċċata.
formal.en: The sculpture has a date-palm-like outline, with a tall central section and leaf-like forms at the top.
formal.zh: 这座雕塑的轮廓像椰枣树，中间部分修长，顶部有叶片般的造型。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex għażilt dan id-disinn? Pawlu: Għax għandu aspett tamri; ifakkarni f'siġra tat-tamal.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did you choose this design? Pawlu: Because it has a date-palm-like appearance; it reminds me of a date palm.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你为什么选这个设计？Pawlu：因为它的样子像椰枣树，让我想起那种树。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么选这个设计？
messages.en: Why did you choose this design?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax għandu aspett tamri; ifakkarni f'siġra tat-tamal.
messages.mt_standard: Għax għandu aspett tamri; ifakkarni f'siġra tat-tamal.
messages.zh: 因为它的样子像椰枣树，让我想起那种树。
messages.en: Because it has a date-palm-like appearance; it reminds me of a date palm.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个顶部展开叶片的装饰轮廓，用“像椰枣树”来记住这个形容词，重点是相似的外形。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The postponement of a payment to a later time.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把付款时间推迟到较晚日期的行为或安排。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-posponiment ta' ħlas għal żmien aktar tard.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 延期付款；将付款推迟到较晚时间。

formal.mt: Il-klijent talab tamtil tal-ħlas sal-aħħar tax-xahar.
formal.en: The client requested deferment of payment until the end of the month.
formal.zh: 客户申请将付款推迟到月底。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Nista' nitlob tamtil tal-ħlas sal-Ġimgħa? Rita: Iva, tista' tħallas dakinhar.
colloquial.en: Mark: Can I ask to defer payment until Friday? Rita: Yes, you can pay that day.
colloquial.zh: Mark：我可以申请延到星期五付款吗？Rita：可以，你那天付就行。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 我可以申请延到星期五付款吗？
messages.en: Can I ask to defer payment until Friday?

messages.speaker: Rita (店员)
messages.zh: 可以，你那天付就行。
messages.en: Yes, you can pay that day.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在日历上把付款箭头从今天移到星期五，用“付款日期往后移”的画面记住延期付款。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of stretching one's own body or limbs.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 伸展自己身体或四肢的动作，如伸懒腰。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed jiġġebbed u jifrex ġismu jew riġlejh u dirgħajh.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 伸展自己的身体；伸懒腰。

formal.mt: Fl-ewwel xena, l-attur juri t-tamtir tal-ġisem wara li jqum mis-sodda.
formal.en: In the first scene, the actor portrays stretching his body after getting out of bed.
formal.zh: 在第一场戏中，演员表现了起床后伸展身体的动作。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'qed tagħmel b'dirgħajk hekk? Toni: Ftit tamtir; ilni bilqiegħda ħafna.
colloquial.en: Maja: What are you doing with your arms like that? Toni: Just stretching a little; I've been sitting for a long time.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你把胳膊这样伸着是在做什么？Toni：伸展一下，我坐了很久了。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 你把胳膊这样伸着是在做什么？
messages.en: What are you doing with your arms like that?

messages.speaker: Toni (同事)
messages.zh: 伸展一下，我坐了很久了。
messages.en: Just stretching a little; I've been sitting for a long time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 一边举起双臂伸个懒腰，一边默念这个词，把词义直接绑在自己伸展身体的动作上。

gloss_zh: 重申并坚持先前的观点

teaching_sense.en_definition: To insist again on a point that has already been made.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对已经提出过的观点再次强调并坚持。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jerġa' jinsisti fuq punt li jkun diġà semma.

sense_translations.en_definition: to insist on a point already made
sense_translations.zh_definition: 坚持已经说过的观点；再次强调先前提出的论点。

collocations.en: he insisted again on the same point
collocations.zh: 他再次坚持同一个观点

collocations.mt: tanas fuq dak li kien qal
collocations.en: he insisted on what he had already said
collocations.zh: 他坚持自己先前说过的话

formal.mt: Matul il-laqgħa, ir-rappreżentant tanas fuq il-punt li kien diġà semma: il-proposta kellha bżonn aktar diskussjoni.
formal.en: During the meeting, the representative insisted on the point he had already made: the proposal needed further discussion.
formal.zh: 会上，代表再次坚持他先前提出的观点：这项提案需要进一步讨论。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Pawlu reġa' semma l-istess ħaġa? Mark: Iva, tanas fuq il-punt li għandna nitilqu kmieni.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did Pawlu bring up the same thing again? Mark: Yes, he insisted again that we should leave early.
colloquial.zh: Lara：Pawlu又提起同一件事了吗？Mark：是啊，他再次坚持说我们应该早点出发。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: Pawlu又提起同一件事了吗？
messages.en: Did Pawlu bring up the same thing again?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, tanas fuq il-punt li għandna nitilqu kmieni.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, tanas fuq il-punt li għandna nitilqu kmieni.
messages.zh: 是啊，他再次坚持说我们应该早点出发。
messages.en: Yes, he insisted again that we should leave early.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象讨论中有人再次指向刚才写下的观点，说“我还是坚持这一点”，记住先说过、再坚持的顺序。

gloss_zh: 爱敲鼓的；发出鼓声般声音的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Inclined to drum, or producing sounds like drumming.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 倾向于敲鼓的，或发出类似敲鼓声音的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu tendenza jdoqq it-tanbur, jew li jagħmel ħsejjes bħal dawk tat-tanbur.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 爱敲鼓的；有敲鼓倾向的。
发出鼓声般声音的；产生类似敲鼓声的。

formal.mt: Ix-xita fuq is-saqaf tal-metall kienet tagħmel ħoss tanbari li nstema' mill-kamra kollha.
formal.en: The rain on the metal roof produced a drumming sound that could be heard throughout the room.
formal.zh: 雨点落在金属屋顶上，发出鼓声般的声音，整个房间都听得见。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Ibnek dejjem iħabbat fuq il-mejda? Marija: Iva, huwa tifel tanbari; kull ħaġa ssir tanbur għalih.
colloquial.en: Rita: Does your son always tap on the table? Marija: Yes, he's a boy who loves to drum; everything becomes a drum to him.
colloquial.zh: Rita：你儿子总是在桌上敲来敲去吗？Marija：是啊，他很爱敲鼓，什么东西到他手里都成了鼓。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 你儿子总是在桌上敲来敲去吗？
messages.en: Does your son always tap on the table?

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, huwa tifel tanbari; kull ħaġa ssir tanbur għalih.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, huwa tifel tanbari; kull ħaġa ssir tanbur għalih.
messages.zh: 是啊，他很爱敲鼓，什么东西到他手里都成了鼓。
messages.en: Yes, he's a boy who loves to drum; everything becomes a drum to him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把两个画面并排记：孩子爱敲桌子，雨点敲屋顶像鼓声；一个记敲鼓倾向，一个记发声特点。

gloss_zh: 船上帆柜；马耳他传统小船的小甲板

teaching_sense.en_definition: A cupboard for storing sails on a ship, or a small deck on a traditional Maltese or Gozitan boat.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可指船上存放船帆的柜子，也可指马耳他或戈佐传统小船上的一小块甲板。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Armarju għall-qlugħ fuq bastiment, jew gverta żgħira fuq dgħajsa tradizzjonali Maltija jew Għawdxija.

sense_translations.en_definition: a sail cupboard on a ship
sense_translations.zh_definition: 船上用于存放船帆的柜子。

sense_translations.en_definition: a small deck on a traditional Maltese or Gozitan boat (known as the 'dgħajsa' or 'luzzu')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 马耳他或戈佐传统小船上的小甲板，这类船称为 dgħajsa 或 luzzu。

collocations.en: the sails in the sail cupboard
the small deck of the luzzu

formal.mt: Wara li nixfu, il-qlugħ ġew mitwija u mqiegħda fit-tanburett tal-bastiment.
formal.en: After drying, the sails were folded and placed in the ship's sail cupboard.
formal.zh: 船帆晾干后被折好，放进了船上的帆柜。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn inpoġġi din il-kaxxa fuq il-luzzu? Toni: Fuq it-tanburett, il-gverta żgħira li qed nurik.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where should I put this box on the luzzu? Toni: On the tanburett, the small deck I'm pointing out to you.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这个箱子放在 luzzu 小船的哪里？Toni：放在 tanburett 上，就是我正指给你看的那块小甲板。

messages.speaker: Maja (乘客)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn inpoġġi din il-kaxxa fuq il-luzzu?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn inpoġġi din il-kaxxa fuq il-luzzu?
messages.zh: 这个箱子放在 luzzu 小船的哪里？
messages.en: Where should I put this box on the luzzu?

messages.speaker: Toni (船主)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq it-tanburett, il-gverta żgħira li qed nurik.
messages.mt_standard: Fuq it-tanburett, il-gverta żgħira li qed nurik.
messages.zh: 放在 tanburett 上，就是我正指给你看的那块小甲板。
messages.en: On the tanburett, the small deck I'm pointing out to you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张船上场景卡记忆：一张是收纳船帆的柜子，一张是传统小船的小甲板；看上下文选择词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A fish known as bonito.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种称为 bonito 的鱼，中文通常译作鲣鱼。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tip ta' ħuta magħrufa bl-Ingliż bħala bonito.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鲣鱼，英文称 bonito 的一种鱼。

formal.mt: Il-menu jinkludi tanburill mixwi, servut bil-ħaxix u l-lumi.
formal.en: The menu includes grilled bonito, served with vegetables and lemon.
formal.zh: 菜单上有烤鲣鱼，配蔬菜和柠檬。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għandek tanburill frisk illum? Rita: Iva, kemm trid? Mark: Wieħed, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Mark: Do you have fresh bonito today? Rita: Yes, how many would you like? Mark: One, please.
colloquial.zh: Mark：今天有新鲜鲣鱼吗？Rita：有，你要几条？Mark：请给我一条。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 今天有新鲜鲣鱼吗？
messages.en: Do you have fresh bonito today?

messages.speaker: Rita (鱼贩)
messages.zh: 有，你要几条？
messages.en: Yes, how many would you like?

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 请给我一条。
messages.en: One, please.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词写在鱼摊上的鲣鱼图片旁，再配一盘烤鱼，连着记住鱼名、新鲜购买和烹调三个场景。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small percussion instrument played by shaking it or striking it with the hand.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种通过摇动或用手拍击来演奏的小型打击乐器，即铃鼓。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Strument żgħir tal-perkussjoni li jindaqq billi tħabbtu b'idek jew iċċaqalqu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 铃鼓；通过摇动或拍击发声的小型打击乐器。

formal.mt: Waqt il-kunċert tal-iskola, waħda mill-istudenti daqqet it-tanburin biex iżżomm ir-ritmu.
formal.en: During the school concert, one of the students played the tambourine to keep the rhythm.
formal.zh: 在学校音乐会上，一名女学生演奏铃鼓来保持节奏。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Fejn hu t-tanburin? Pawlu: Qiegħed fuq il-mejda. Trid iddoqqu?
colloquial.en: Marta: Where is the tambourine? Pawlu: It's on the table. Do you want to play it?
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：铃鼓在哪里？保罗：在桌上。你想敲一敲吗？

messages.speaker: Marta (乐队成员)
messages.zh: 铃鼓在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the tambourine?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (乐队成员)
messages.zh: 在桌上。你想敲一敲吗？
messages.en: It's on the table. Do you want to play it?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tanburin 和手中摇动、拍击的铃鼓画面配对，再连读 idoqq it-tanburin，记住“演奏铃鼓”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An expression used to return someone's good wishes, meaning 'the same to you' or 'you too'.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 回应他人祝福时使用的表达，意思是“也同样祝你”或“你也一样”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni li tintuża biex trodd awgurju lil min ikun għamillek l-istess awgurju.

sense_translations.en_definition: same to you, likewise, you too (in response to good wishes, etc.)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 你也一样；同样祝你，用于回应他人的祝福或类似话语。

formal.mt: Fit-tweġiba tagħha għall-awguri tal-festa, il-kollega kitbet: 'Grazzi tal-awguri. Tant ieħor lilek u lill-familja tiegħek.'
formal.en: In her written reply to the holiday wishes, the colleague wrote: 'Thank you for your wishes. The same to you and your family.'
formal.zh: 在书面回复节日祝福时，这位女同事写道：“谢谢你的祝福。也同样祝福你和你的家人。”

colloquial.mt: Lara: Il-festa t-tajba, Ben! Ben: Grazzi, tant ieħor!
colloquial.en: Lara: Happy holiday, Ben! Ben: Thanks, you too!
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：本，节日快乐！本：谢谢，你也一样！

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 本，节日快乐！
messages.en: Happy holiday, Ben!

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.zh: 谢谢，你也一样！
messages.en: Thanks, you too!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把收到的祝福原样送回去：别人祝你节日快乐，你就用 tant ieħor 表达“你也一样”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The chemical element called tantalum.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 化学元素钽的名称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-isem tal-element kimiku magħruf bħala tantalum bl-Ingliż.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 钽，一种化学元素。

formal.mt: Fir-rapport tal-laboratorju, l-istudenta identifikat il-kampjun bħala tantalju.
formal.en: In the laboratory report, the student identified the sample as tantalum.
formal.zh: 在实验报告中，这名女学生将该样品鉴定为钽。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'inhu t-tantalju? Mark: Huwa element kimiku. Ejja nsibuh fit-tabella perjodika.
colloquial.en: Sara: What is tantalum? Mark: It's a chemical element. Let's find it in the periodic table.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：钽是什么？马克：它是一种化学元素。我们在元素周期表里找找它吧。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 钽是什么？
messages.en: What is tantalum?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa element kimiku. Ejja nsibuh fit-tabella perjodika.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa element kimiku. Ejja nsibuh fit-tabella perjodika.
messages.zh: 它是一种化学元素。我们在元素周期表里找找它吧。
messages.en: It's a chemical element. Let's find it in the periodic table.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tantalju、英语 tantalum 和中文“钽”写在同一张元素卡上，作为三语名称对应来记忆。

gloss_zh: 坦桑尼亚的；坦桑尼亚人（通常指男性）

teaching_sense.en_definition: Of, from, or connected with Tanzania.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 属于、来自或涉及坦桑尼亚的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li huwa tat-Tanżanija, ġej minnha jew għandu x'jaqsam magħha.

sense_translations.en_definition: Tanzanian (of, from or relating to Tanzania)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 坦桑尼亚的；来自坦桑尼亚的；与坦桑尼亚有关的。

sense_translations.en_definition: Tanzanian (native or inhabitant of Tanzania) (usually male)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 坦桑尼亚人，指出生于或居住在坦桑尼亚的人，通常指男性。

formal.mt: Il-mużew stieden artist Tanzani biex jippreżenta x-xogħol tiegħu lill-pubbliku.
formal.en: The museum invited a Tanzanian artist to present his work to the public.
formal.zh: 博物馆邀请了一位坦桑尼亚艺术家向公众介绍他的作品。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Minn fejn hu l-ġar il-ġdid tiegħek? David: Huwa Tanzani, u issa jgħix hawn Malta.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is your new neighbour from? David: He's a Tanzanian, and he now lives here in Malta.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你的新邻居来自哪里？戴维：他是坦桑尼亚人，现在住在马耳他这里。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Minn fejn hu l-ġar il-ġdid tiegħek?
messages.mt_standard: Minn fejn hu l-ġar il-ġdid tiegħek?
messages.zh: 你的新邻居来自哪里？
messages.en: Where is your new neighbour from?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa Tanzani, u issa jgħix hawn Malta.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa Tanzani, u issa jgħix hawn Malta.
messages.zh: 他是坦桑尼亚人，现在住在马耳他这里。
messages.en: He's a Tanzanian, and he now lives here in Malta.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个位置记词性：artist Tanzani 中表示“坦桑尼亚的”，Huwa Tanzani 中表示“他是坦桑尼亚人”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A country in East Africa, officially called the United Republic of Tanzania.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 位于东非的国家，正式名称为坦桑尼亚联合共和国。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pajjiż fl-Afrika tal-Lvant li l-isem uffiċjali tiegħu huwa r-Repubblika Magħquda tat-Tanżanija.

sense_translations.en_definition: Tanzania (a country in East Africa; official name: Repubblika Magħquda tat-Tanżanija)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 坦桑尼亚，东非国家；正式名称为坦桑尼亚联合共和国。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi proġett edukattiv fit-Tanżanija, pajjiż fl-Afrika tal-Lvant.
formal.en: The report describes an educational project in Tanzania, a country in East Africa.
formal.zh: 该报告介绍了在东非国家坦桑尼亚开展的一个教育项目。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Fejn se tmur għall-vaganzi? Adam: Se mmur it-Tanżanija mal-familja tiegħi.
colloquial.en: Nina: Where are you going on holiday? Adam: I'm going to Tanzania with my family.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你准备去哪里度假？亚当：我准备和家人一起去坦桑尼亚。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你准备去哪里度假？
messages.en: Where are you going on holiday?

messages.speaker: Adam (朋友)
messages.zh: 我准备和家人一起去坦桑尼亚。
messages.en: I'm going to Tanzania with my family.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在东非地图上标出“坦桑尼亚”，旁边写 Tanżanija，并用 vjaġġ lejn it-Tanżanija 练习国家名称。

gloss_zh: 塞子；瓶盖；软木塞；盖帽；龙头

teaching_sense.en_definition: A plug, stopper, or cap used to close an opening, especially the opening of a bottle.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用来封住开口的塞子或盖子，尤其指瓶塞或瓶盖。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Oġġett li jagħlaq fetħa, speċjalment il-fetħa ta' flixkun.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 龙头；用于控制液体流出的开关装置。
塞子；用来堵住孔口或排水口的物件。
瓶盖；用于封闭瓶口的盖子。
软木塞；用软木制成的瓶塞。
盖帽；套在或盖在容器等物件开口处的小盖子。

formal.mt: Qabel it-trasport, iċċekkja li t-tapp tal-flixkun ikun magħluq sew biex il-likwidu ma joħroġx.
formal.en: Before transport, check that the bottle cap is securely closed so that the liquid does not leak out.
formal.zh: 运输前，请检查瓶盖是否盖紧，以免液体漏出。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Fejn poġġejt it-tapp tal-flixkun? Luqa: Ħdejn it-tazza. Agħlaq il-flixkun, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Anna: Where did you put the bottle cap? Luqa: Next to the glass. Close the bottle, please.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你把瓶盖放在哪里了？卢卡：在玻璃杯旁边。请把瓶子盖好。

messages.speaker: Anna (室友)
messages.zh: 你把瓶盖放在哪里了？
messages.en: Where did you put the bottle cap?

messages.speaker: Luqa (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħdejn it-tazza. Agħlaq il-flixkun, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.mt_standard: Ħdejn it-tazza. Agħlaq il-flixkun, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.zh: 在玻璃杯旁边。请把瓶子盖好。
messages.en: Next to the glass. Close the bottle, please.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用“把开口封住”的画面记 tapp 的塞子、瓶盖和盖帽义；另把所列龙头义单独配图，避免混淆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To close or block a hole or opening by putting something into it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某物塞进孔洞或开口，使其封闭或堵住。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħlaq jew isodd toqba jew fetħa billi jdaħħal xi ħaġa fiha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 塞住；用物件堵住孔洞或开口。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem tappap it-toqba b'biċċa gomma biex iwaqqaf it-tnixxija tal-ilma.
formal.en: The worker plugged the hole with a piece of rubber to stop the water leak.
formal.zh: 工人用一块橡胶堵住孔洞，以止住漏水。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għadu ħiereġ l-ilma minn dik it-toqba? Toni: Le, missieri tappap it-toqba b'biċċa gomma.
colloquial.en: Rita: Is water still coming out of that hole? Toni: No, my father plugged the hole with a piece of rubber.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：那个洞还在漏水吗？托尼：没有了，我爸爸用一块橡胶把洞堵住了。

messages.speaker: Rita (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadu ħiereġ l-ilma minn dik it-toqba?
messages.mt_standard: Għadu ħiereġ l-ilma minn dik it-toqba?
messages.zh: 那个洞还在漏水吗？
messages.en: Is water still coming out of that hole?

messages.speaker: Toni (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, missieri tappap it-toqba b'biċċa gomma.
messages.mt_standard: Le, missieri tappap it-toqba b'biċċa gomma.
messages.zh: 没有了，我爸爸用一块橡胶把洞堵住了。
messages.en: No, my father plugged the hole with a piece of rubber.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tappap 配成一个动作画面：手把橡胶塞进漏水孔，水随即停止；整句记 tappap it-toqba。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An access opening used to inspect or maintain pipes or other installations, such as a manhole or inspection hatch.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供检查或维护管道等设施使用的入口或开口，例如检查井或检修口。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fetħa li tagħti aċċess għal pajpijiet jew installazzjonijiet oħra biex jiġu spezzjonati jew miżmuma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 检查井；供人员进入地下管道等设施进行检查或维护的井口。
检修口；供检查或维护内部设施使用的开口。

collocations.en: the manhole or inspection hatch cover
open the manhole or inspection hatch

formal.mt: It-tekniku fetaħ it-tappiera biex jispezzjona l-pajpijiet ta' taħt l-art.
formal.en: The technician opened the manhole to inspect the underground pipes.
formal.zh: 技术人员打开检查井，检查地下管道。

colloquial.mt: Mara: Minn fejn tista' tiċċekkja l-pajpijiet? Ġużeppi: Hemm tappiera fil-kuritur. Niftaħha u nħares ġewwa.
colloquial.en: Mara: Where can you access the pipes to check them? Ġużeppi: There's an inspection hatch in the corridor. I'll open it and look inside.
colloquial.zh: 玛拉：从哪里可以检查管道？朱塞佩：走廊里有个检修口。我打开看看里面。

messages.speaker: Mara (住户)
messages.zh: 从哪里可以检查管道？
messages.en: Where can you access the pipes to check them?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (维修人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm tappiera fil-kuritur. Niftaħha u nħares ġewwa.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm tappiera fil-kuritur. Niftaħha u nħares ġewwa.
messages.zh: 走廊里有个检修口。我打开看看里面。
messages.en: There's an inspection hatch in the corridor. I'll open it and look inside.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 tappiera 配两张维修图片：街上的检查井和室内的检修口；共同点都是打开后能检查里面的设施。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action or sound of making repeated light taps on a surface.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在某个表面上连续轻轻敲击的动作或声音。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni jew il-ħoss ta' daqqiet ħfief u ripetuti fuq wiċċ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 轻敲；连续轻叩的动作或声音。

formal.mt: Matul il-laqgħa nstema' taptip ħafif fuq il-bieb, u s-segretarju fetaħ biex jilqa' lill-mistieden.
formal.en: During the meeting, light tapping was heard at the door, and the secretary opened it to welcome the guest.
formal.zh: 会议期间，门上传来轻轻的叩门声，秘书开门迎接来宾。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Smajt dak it-taptip fuq il-bieb? Pawlu: Iva, immur nara min hemm.
colloquial.en: Marija: Did you hear that tapping on the door? Pawlu: Yes, I'll go and see who's there.
colloquial.zh: Marija：你听见刚才的轻叩门声了吗？Pawlu：听见了，我去看看是谁。

messages.speaker: Marija (室友)
messages.zh: 你听见刚才的轻叩门声了吗？
messages.en: Did you hear that tapping on the door?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.zh: 听见了，我去看看是谁。
messages.en: Yes, I'll go and see who's there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 taptip 和手指轻轻连敲桌面的画面配对记忆：注意是连续轻敲，而不是重重砸下。

gloss_zh: 使振作；喂养；滋养；努力工作

teaching_sense.en_definition: To give energy, feed, or nourish; in another sense, to work hard.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 给予活力、喂养或提供滋养；另一个义项是努力工作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħti s-saħħa, titma' jew issostni; f'sens ieħor, taħdem ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使恢复活力；使振作。
喂食；给人或动物提供食物。
滋养；提供维持健康或成长所需的营养。
努力工作；辛勤劳动。

collocations.en: to work hard at one's job

formal.mt: Il-verb taq jista' jfisser li wieħed jagħti s-saħħa, jitma' jew isostni; jista' jfisser ukoll li wieħed jaħdem ħafna.
formal.en: The verb taq can mean to invigorate, feed, or nourish; it can also mean to work hard.
formal.zh: 动词 taq 可以表示使振作、喂养或滋养，也可以表示努力工作。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Taq dejjem għandu x'jaqsam mal-ikel? Mark: Le, jista' jfisser ukoll li wieħed jaħdem ħafna.
colloquial.en: Lara: Does taq always have something to do with food? Mark: No, it can also mean to work hard.
colloquial.zh: Lara：taq 总是与食物有关吗？Mark：不是，它也可以表示努力工作。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: taq 总是与食物有关吗？
messages.en: Does taq always have something to do with food?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, jista' jfisser ukoll li wieħed jaħdem ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Le, jista' jfisser ukoll li wieħed jaħdem ħafna.
messages.zh: 不是，它也可以表示努力工作。
messages.en: No, it can also mean to work hard.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用四张场景卡记 taq：精神振作、给人喂饭、提供营养、埋头工作；这是义项记忆法，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Fighting or struggling, ranging from a brief tussle or skirmish to combat or continuing strife.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 战斗或争斗，可指短暂的扭打、小规模交战，也可指持续的冲突或斗争。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġlied jew taqbida, minn kunflitt qasir sa ġlied jew tilwim li jdum.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 战斗；交战。
小规模交战；短暂冲突。
纷争；持续的不和或冲突。
斗争；奋力抗争或挣扎。
扭打；短暂而激烈的争夺。
打斗；交战的行为。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi t-taqbid bejn iż-żewġ gruppi u l-isforzi biex terġa' tinkiseb il-paċi.
formal.en: The report describes the fighting between the two groups and the efforts to restore peace.
formal.zh: 报告描述了两个群体之间的冲突，以及为恢复和平所作的努力。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex għalqu t-triq? David: Kien hemm xi taqbid, imma issa kollox kalm.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why did they close the street? David: There was some fighting, but everything is calm now.
colloquial.zh: Nina：他们为什么封路？David：刚才有人打斗，不过现在已经平静了。

messages.speaker: Nina (邻居)
messages.zh: 他们为什么封路？
messages.en: Why did they close the street?

messages.speaker: David (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien hemm xi taqbid, imma issa kollox kalm.
messages.mt_standard: Kien hemm xi taqbid, imma issa kollox kalm.
messages.zh: 刚才有人打斗，不过现在已经平静了。
messages.en: There was some fighting, but everything is calm now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 taqbid 放在一条冲突强度线上记忆：短暂扭打、小规模交战、持续纷争，都围绕争斗这一核心画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Adaptation to suit something else, or the matching of word endings in rhyme.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为适合另一事物而进行的调整或改编；也指让词尾声音相配的押韵。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-adattament ta' xi ħaġa għal oħra, jew it-tqegħid ta' kliem f'rima.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 适配；为适合新的条件或用途而进行的调整或改编。
押韵；使词语的末尾声音相呼应。

collocations.en: adaptation of the text to the music
collocations.zh: 使文字与音乐相适配的调整

formal.mt: Fl-analiżi tal-poeżija, l-istudenti eżaminaw it-taqbil tal-kliem fl-aħħar ta' kull vers.
formal.en: In their analysis of the poem, the students examined the rhyming of the words at the end of each line.
formal.zh: 分析这首诗时，学生们考察了每行末尾词语的押韵情况。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan it-taqbil tal-kliem jogħġbok? Ben: Iva, it-truf tal-versi jinstemgħu tajjeb flimkien.
colloquial.en: Sara: Do you like this rhyming of the words? Ben: Yes, the line endings sound good together.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你喜欢这些词的押韵吗？Ben：喜欢，这些诗行的结尾听起来很协调。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 你喜欢这些词的押韵吗？
messages.en: Do you like this rhyming of the words?

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, it-truf tal-versi jinstemgħu tajjeb flimkien.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, it-truf tal-versi jinstemgħu tajjeb flimkien.
messages.zh: 喜欢，这些诗行的结尾听起来很协调。
messages.en: Yes, the line endings sound good together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅配合画面记 taqbil：文字配合音乐是适配，诗行末尾声音相配是押韵；两种用法分开练习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action of jumping or leaping, or of skipping and leaving something out.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 跳跃或跃起的动作；也指跳过某些内容而产生的省略。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li taqbeż, jew li tħalli barra xi kliem, passi jew partijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 跳跃；身体离地跳起的动作。
跃起；较大幅度或较远距离的跳跃。
略去；把某些内容或步骤跳过不包括在内。
省略；遗漏；未被包括在内的情况。

formal.mt: It-taqbiż ta' kliem importanti fit-traduzzjoni jista' jbiddel it-tifsira tas-sentenza.
formal.en: Leaving out important words in a translation can change the meaning of the sentence.
formal.zh: 翻译中省略重要词语可能改变句子的意思。

colloquial.mt: Anna: X'għamiltu fil-logħba llum? Leo: Ħafna taqbiż fuq sieq waħda! Għadni għajjien.
colloquial.en: Anna: What did you do in the game today? Leo: Lots of jumping on one foot! I'm still tired.
colloquial.zh: Anna：你们今天玩游戏做了什么？Leo：单脚跳了好多次！我现在还累着呢。

messages.speaker: Anna (姐姐)
messages.zh: 你们今天玩游戏做了什么？
messages.en: What did you do in the game today?

messages.speaker: Leo (弟弟)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħafna taqbiż fuq sieq waħda! Għadni għajjien.
messages.mt_standard: Ħafna taqbiż fuq sieq waħda! Għadni għajjien.
messages.zh: 单脚跳了好多次！我现在还累着呢。
messages.en: Lots of jumping on one foot! I'm still tired.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 taqbiż 记成两个跳过的画面：身体跳离地面是跳跃，阅读时跳过词语是省略；这是学习联想。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action of whipping or striking with blows.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用鞭子抽打或以连续的打击进行击打的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li ssawwat bil-frosta jew tolqot b'daqqiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鞭打；用鞭子抽打。
击打；施加打击的动作。

formal.mt: Fl-eżerċizzju tal-vokabularju, taqdib jirreferi għal swat bil-frosta jew għal daqqiet b'mod aktar ġenerali.
formal.en: In the vocabulary exercise, taqdib refers to whipping or, more generally, to striking with blows.
formal.zh: 在这项词汇练习中，taqdib 指鞭打，或更广义的击打。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Taqdib ifisser biss swat bil-frosta? Ġorġ: Le, jista' jfisser ukoll daqqiet b'mod aktar ġenerali.
colloquial.en: Marta: Does taqdib only mean whipping? Ġorġ: No, it can also mean striking more generally.
colloquial.zh: Marta：taqdib 只表示鞭打吗？Ġorġ：不是，它也可以泛指击打。

messages.speaker: Marta (学生)
messages.zh: taqdib 只表示鞭打吗？
messages.en: Does taqdib only mean whipping?

messages.speaker: Ġorġ (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, jista' jfisser ukoll daqqiet b'mod aktar ġenerali.
messages.mt_standard: Le, jista' jfisser ukoll daqqiet b'mod aktar ġenerali.
messages.zh: 不是，它也可以泛指击打。
messages.en: No, it can also mean striking more generally.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 taqdib 做两张义项卡：一张写用鞭子抽打，一张写一般击打；记住鞭打比击打的范围更具体。

gloss_zh: 食品干燥保存；脱水干燥

teaching_sense.en_definition: The drying of food to preserve it, or the removal of moisture through drying.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为保存食品而进行的干燥处理；也指通过干燥除去水分。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-tnixxif tal-ikel biex jinżamm għal żmien itwal, jew it-tneħħija tal-umdità permezz tat-tnixxif.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为延长保存时间而对食品进行的干燥处理。
干燥；脱水；除去水分的过程。

formal.mt: Il-kapitlu jiddeskrivi t-taqdid tal-laħam u tal-ħut bħala metodi ta' konservazzjoni tal-ikel permezz tat-tnixxif.
formal.en: The chapter describes the drying of meat and fish as methods of preserving food through the removal of moisture.
formal.zh: 本章介绍了肉类和鱼类的干燥处理，即通过除去水分来保存食品的方法。

colloquial.mt: Elena: X'inhu t-taqdid tal-ħut? Samwel: Huwa t-tnixxif tal-ħut biex jinżamm għal żmien itwal.
colloquial.en: Elena: What is taqdid tal-ħut? Samwel: It is drying fish so that it can be kept for longer.
colloquial.zh: Elena：taqdid tal-ħut 是什么意思？Samwel：就是把鱼干燥处理，让它能保存更长时间。

messages.speaker: Elena (学生)
messages.zh: taqdid tal-ħut 是什么意思？
messages.en: What is taqdid tal-ħut?

messages.speaker: Samwel (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa t-tnixxif tal-ħut biex jinżamm għal żmien itwal.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa t-tnixxif tal-ħut biex jinżamm għal żmien itwal.
messages.zh: 就是把鱼干燥处理，让它能保存更长时间。
messages.en: It is drying fish so that it can be kept for longer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 taqdid 和食品标签上的干制二字一起记：鱼或肉减少水分后用于保存，核心概念是干燥和脱水。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of moving a boat through water using oars, either for transport or as a sport.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用桨推动船只在水上前进的活动，也可指作为体育项目的划船运动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-attività li tmexxi dgħajsa fl-ilma bl-imqadef, għat-trasport jew bħala sport.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 划桨；用桨使船前进的活动或运动。

formal.mt: Il-klabb joffri taħriġ fit-taqdif għal dawk li għadhom jibdew.
formal.en: The club offers rowing training for beginners.
formal.zh: 该俱乐部为初学者提供划船训练。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid tiġi għat-taqdif magħna għada? Mark: Iva, imma għadni qatt ma qdift. Tgħallmuni?
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you want to come rowing with us tomorrow? Mark: Yes, but I've never rowed before. Will you teach me?
colloquial.zh: 马娅：明天想和我们一起去划船吗？马克：想，不过我从来没划过。你们教教我好吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 明天想和我们一起去划船吗？
messages.en: Do you want to come rowing with us tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma għadni qatt ma qdift. Tgħallmuni?
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma għadni qatt ma qdift. Tgħallmuni?
messages.zh: 想，不过我从来没划过。你们教教我好吗？
messages.en: Yes, but I've never rowed before. Will you teach me?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 taqdif 和双手握桨、轮流划水的画面连起来，再用“划船训练”这个搭配复习词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of allowing or causing something to age over time, for example wine or cheese.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 让某物随时间陈化或变老的过程，例如葡萄酒的陈酿或奶酪的熟成。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih xi ħaġa titħalla jew tiġi magħmula tixjieħ maż-żmien, bħall-inbid jew il-ġobon.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某物老化或陈化的过程，如让葡萄酒陈酿。

formal.mt: It-taqdim tal-inbid fil-btieti jista' jbiddel it-togħma u l-aroma tiegħu.
formal.en: Aging wine in barrels can change its flavor and aroma.
formal.zh: 在木桶中陈酿葡萄酒可以改变其风味和香气。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex dan l-inbid għandu togħma differenti? Pawlu: It-taqdim fil-bettija jista' jagħtih togħma differenti.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why does this wine taste different? Pawlu: Aging in the barrel can give it a different flavor.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这款葡萄酒为什么味道不一样？保罗：在木桶中陈酿可以让它产生不同的风味。

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex dan l-inbid għandu togħma differenti?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex dan l-inbid għandu togħma differenti?
messages.zh: 这款葡萄酒为什么味道不一样？
messages.en: Why does this wine taste different?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (酒商)
messages.mt_spoken: It-taqdim fil-bettija jista' jagħtih togħma differenti.
messages.mt_standard: It-taqdim fil-bettija jista' jagħtih togħma differenti.
messages.zh: 在木桶中陈酿可以让它产生不同的风味。
messages.en: Aging in the barrel can give it a different flavor.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象酒桶旁的日历一页页翻过：taqdim 强调让东西经历时间而陈化的过程。

gloss_zh: 命运安排（用于指定表达）

teaching_sense.en_definition: Fate or destiny as expressed in the phrase 'donnu kollox ġej bit-taqdir', meaning that everything seems to be happening as if by fate.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在 donnu kollox ġej bit-taqdir 这一表达中表示命运的安排，整句意为“一切似乎都像命中注定般发生”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Id-destin kif jidher fl-espressjoni 'donnu kollox ġej bit-taqdir', jiġifieri donnu dak kollu li jiġri jkun miktub minn qabel.

sense_translations.en_definition: In the following expression: donnu kollox ġej bit-taqdir, everything seems to be happening as if by fate
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于表达 donnu kollox ġej bit-taqdir，意思是“一切似乎都像命运安排好的一样发生”。

collocations.en: everything seems to be happening as if by fate
collocations.zh: 一切似乎都像命中注定般发生

collocations.en: the expression 'everything seems to be happening as if by fate'
collocations.zh: “一切似乎都像命中注定般发生”这一表达

formal.mt: Fl-istorja, il-kliem 'donnu kollox ġej bit-taqdir' juri kif il-karattru jinterpreta l-ġrajjiet ta' ħajtu.
formal.en: In the story, the words 'everything seems to be happening as if by fate' show how the character interprets the events of his life.
formal.zh: 在故事中，“一切似乎都像命中注定般发生”这句话表现了人物如何理解自己的人生经历。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Erġajna ltqajna bla ma ppjanajna! Donnu kollox ġej bit-taqdir. David: Veru, din it-tielet darba din il-ġimgħa!
colloquial.en: Anna: We've met again without planning it! Everything seems to be happening as if by fate. David: True, this is the third time this week!
colloquial.zh: 安娜：我们又不约而遇了！一切似乎都是命运的安排。戴维：可不是嘛，这已经是这周第三次了！

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Erġajna ltqajna bla ma ppjanajna! Donnu kollox ġej bit-taqdir.
messages.mt_standard: Erġajna ltqajna bla ma ppjanajna! Donnu kollox ġej bit-taqdir.
messages.zh: 我们又不约而遇了！一切似乎都是命运的安排。
messages.en: We've met again without planning it! Everything seems to be happening as if by fate.

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Veru, din it-tielet darba din il-ġimgħa!
messages.mt_standard: Veru, din it-tielet darba din il-ġimgħa!
messages.zh: 可不是嘛，这已经是这周第三次了！
messages.en: True, this is the third time this week!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 taqdir 放回整句记忆：接连巧遇时说 donnu kollox ġej bit-taqdir，联想“仿佛命中注定”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or process of making someone or something holy, especially in a religious context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人或某物成为神圣的行为或过程，主要用于宗教语境。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att jew il-proċess li bih persuna jew ħaġa ssir qaddisa, speċjalment f'kuntest reliġjuż.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 圣化；使人或事物成为神圣的行为或过程。

formal.mt: It-test reliġjuż jiddeskrivi t-taqdis bħala proċess li jolqot il-ħajja kollha tal-bniedem.
formal.en: The religious text describes sanctification as a process that affects a person's whole life.
formal.zh: 这篇宗教文本把圣化描述为影响一个人全部生活的过程。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Xi jfisser 'taqdis' f'dan il-ktieb? Ġużeppi: Ifisser li persuna jew ħaġa ssir qaddisa; hawnhekk qed jitkellem dwar il-ħajja tal-bniedem.
colloquial.en: Marta: What does 'taqdis' mean in this book? Ġużeppi: It means a person or thing becoming holy; here it is talking about human life.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：这本书里的 taqdis 是什么意思？朱塞佩：意思是人或事物成为神圣；这里讲的是人的生活。

messages.speaker: Marta (学生)
messages.zh: 这本书里的 taqdis 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'taqdis' mean in this book?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li persuna jew ħaġa ssir qaddisa; hawnhekk qed jitkellem dwar il-ħajja tal-bniedem.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li persuna jew ħaġa ssir qaddisa; hawnhekk qed jitkellem dwar il-ħajja tal-bniedem.
messages.zh: 意思是人或事物成为神圣；这里讲的是人的生活。
messages.en: It means a person or thing becoming holy; here it is talking about human life.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“圣化的过程”记 taqdis：重点是成为神圣这一变化，不只是描述某物已经神圣。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or practice of keeping something locked away so that access to it is controlled.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把物品锁起来保管，以控制他人接触或取用的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iż-żamma ta' xi ħaġa msakkra biċ-ċavetta biex l-aċċess għaliha jkun ikkontrollat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 将物品置于锁钥之下保管；上锁保存。

collocations.en: keeping documents under lock and key
keeping medicines under lock and key

formal.mt: It-taqfil tad-dokumenti f'armarju biċ-ċavetta jillimita l-aċċess għalihom.
formal.en: Keeping the documents in a locked cabinet limits access to them.
formal.zh: 将文件存放在上锁的柜子里，可以限制他人取阅。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn se nżommu dawn id-dokumenti? Mark: F'armarju biċ-ċavetta; it-taqfil tagħhom jgħin biex jibqgħu siguri.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where are we going to keep these documents? Mark: In a locked cabinet; keeping them locked away helps keep them safe.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这些文件我们放在哪里？马克：放在上锁的柜子里；锁起来保管有助于确保它们安全。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 这些文件我们放在哪里？
messages.en: Where are we going to keep these documents?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: F'armarju biċ-ċavetta; it-taqfil tagħhom jgħin biex jibqgħu siguri.
messages.mt_standard: F'armarju biċ-ċavetta; it-taqfil tagħhom jgħin biex jibqgħu siguri.
messages.zh: 放在上锁的柜子里；锁起来保管有助于确保它们安全。
messages.en: In a locked cabinet; keeping them locked away helps keep them safe.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象文件放进柜子后还要转动钥匙：taqfil 在这里强调锁起来保管，连同钥匙一起记。

gloss_zh: 搭建骨架或主体结构；关入笼中

teaching_sense.en_definition: The construction of the skeleton or main framework of a building or another structure.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 搭建建筑物或其他构筑物的骨架、框架或主体结构的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-bini tal-iskeletru jew tal-istruttura ewlenija ta' bini jew ta' kostruzzjoni oħra.

sense_translations.en_definition: the making of the skeleton or principal structure of a building or other construction
sense_translations.zh_definition: 搭建建筑物或其他构筑物的骨架或主体结构。
把人或动物关入笼中；装笼。

collocations.en: the construction of a building's framework

formal.mt: It-taqfis tal-bini għandu jitlesta qabel jibda x-xogħol fuq il-ħitan ta' ġewwa.
formal.en: The construction of the building's framework must be completed before work begins on the interior walls.
formal.zh: 建筑物骨架的搭建必须在内墙施工开始前完成。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Hawnhekk 'taqfis' ifisser xogħol fuq il-bini? Toni: Le, is-sentenza titkellem dwar għasafar; hawnhekk ifisser li tqegħedhom f'gaġġa.
colloquial.en: Nina: Does 'taqfis' mean construction work here? Toni: No, the sentence is about birds; here it means putting them in a cage.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这里的 taqfis 是指建筑施工吗？托尼：不是，这句话讲的是鸟；这里是指把它们关进笼子。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: 这里的 taqfis 是指建筑施工吗？
messages.en: Does 'taqfis' mean construction work here?

messages.speaker: Toni (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, is-sentenza titkellem dwar għasafar; hawnhekk ifisser li tqegħedhom f'gaġġa.
messages.mt_standard: Le, is-sentenza titkellem dwar għasafar; hawnhekk ifisser li tqegħedhom f'gaġġa.
messages.zh: 不是，这句话讲的是鸟；这里是指把它们关进笼子。
messages.en: No, the sentence is about birds; here it means putting them in a cage.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 taqfis 配两张学习卡：一张画建筑骨架，一张画鸟入笼；靠句中对象区分两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of joining separate things together or fitting parts together so that they form a whole.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把分开的事物连接起来，或把各个部件相互配合、装成整体的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tgħaqqad affarijiet separati jew tqiegħed partijiet flimkien sabiex jiffurmaw ħaġa waħda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把事物连接或结合在一起。
使各个部分相互配合并拼装在一起。

formal.mt: It-taqgħid tal-partijiet għandu jsir skont id-disinn sabiex il-mudell ikun stabbli.
formal.en: The parts should be fitted together according to the design so that the model is stable.
formal.zh: 各部件应按照设计进行装配，以确保模型稳固。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dawn iż-żewġ biċċiet jidħlu f'xulxin? Pawlu: Iva, imma t-taqgħid tagħhom irid isir bil-mod biex ma jinkisrux.
colloquial.en: Lara: Do these two pieces fit into each other? Pawlu: Yes, but they need to be fitted together gently so they don't break.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这两块能嵌合在一起吗？保罗：能，不过拼装时要轻一点，免得弄坏。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 这两块能嵌合在一起吗？
messages.en: Do these two pieces fit into each other?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma t-taqgħid tagħhom irid isir bil-mod biex ma jinkisrux.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma t-taqgħid tagħhom irid isir bil-mod biex ma jinkisrux.
messages.zh: 能，不过拼装时要轻一点，免得弄坏。
messages.en: Yes, but they need to be fitted together gently so they don't break.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象两块积木先靠近、再扣合：taqgħid 可强调连接，也可强调部件恰好配合的装配。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of restraining someone or securing something with shackles or chains.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 给人加上镣铐，或用链条将人或物锁住的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li torbot lil xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa bil-qajd jew bil-ktajjen.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 给人加上镣铐以限制其行动。
用链条将人或物拴住、锁住。

formal.mt: It-test storiku jiddeskrivi t-taqjid tal-priġunieri bil-ktajjen qabel il-vjaġġ.
formal.en: The historical text describes the chaining of the prisoners before the journey.
formal.zh: 这篇历史文献描述了启程前用链条锁住囚犯的情形。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għal xiex kienu dawn il-ktajjen? Mark: Għat-taqjid tal-priġunieri, skont it-tikketta.
colloquial.en: Lara: What were these chains used for? Mark: For chaining prisoners, according to the label.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这些链条以前是做什么用的？Mark：标签上说，是用来锁住囚犯的。

messages.speaker: Lara (博物馆参观者)
messages.zh: 这些链条以前是做什么用的？
messages.en: What were these chains used for?

messages.speaker: Mark (同行朋友)
messages.zh: 标签上说，是用来锁住囚犯的。
messages.en: For chaining prisoners, according to the label.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 taqjid 想成“镣铐扣上、链条锁紧”的动作，同时记住加镣与上链两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A brief pause taken during work to rest before continuing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 工作过程中为稍作休息而进行的短暂停顿。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Waqfa qasira waqt ix-xogħol biex wieħed jistrieħ qabel ikompli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 工作期间的短暂休息。

collocations.en: time for a brief work break

formal.mt: L-iskeda tinkludi ħames minuti għat-taqjil bejn iż-żewġ sessjonijiet ta' xogħol.
formal.en: The schedule includes five minutes for a brief break between the two work sessions.
formal.zh: 日程在两段工作之间安排了五分钟的短暂休息。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Nagħmlu ftit taqjil? Ili siegħa naħdem bla waqfien. Ġużeppi: Iva, nistrieħu ħames minuti u mbagħad inkomplu.
colloquial.en: Anna: Shall we take a short break? I've been working nonstop for an hour. Ġużeppi: Yes, let's rest for five minutes and then carry on.
colloquial.zh: Anna：我们稍微休息一下好吗？我已经连续工作一小时了。Ġużeppi：好，休息五分钟再继续。

messages.speaker: Anna (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Nagħmlu ftit taqjil? Ili siegħa naħdem bla waqfien.
messages.mt_standard: Nagħmlu ftit taqjil? Ili siegħa naħdem bla waqfien.
messages.zh: 我们稍微休息一下好吗？我已经连续工作一小时了。
messages.en: Shall we take a short break? I've been working nonstop for an hour.

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, nistrieħu ħames minuti u mbagħad inkomplu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, nistrieħu ħames minuti u mbagħad inkomplu.
messages.zh: 好，休息五分钟再继续。
messages.en: Yes, let's rest for five minutes and then carry on.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 taqjil，就想象工作计时器暂停五分钟：稍作休息，随后继续。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of hanging clothes up so that they can dry.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将衣物挂起来，使其晾干的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li ddendel il-ħwejjeġ biex jinxfu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把衣物挂起来晾干。

collocations.en: hanging laundry to dry on the roof

formal.mt: Il-bejt għandu spazju apposta għat-taqjir tal-ħwejjeġ.
formal.en: The roof has a designated area for hanging clothes to dry.
formal.zh: 屋顶设有专门用于晾晒衣物的区域。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Spiċċajt il-ħasil? David: Iva, issa jmiss it-taqjir. Tgħinni ndendel il-ħwejjeġ?
colloquial.en: Rita: Have you finished the washing? David: Yes, now it's time to hang it out. Will you help me hang up the clothes?
colloquial.zh: Rita：衣服洗完了吗？David：洗完了，现在该晾了。你帮我把衣服挂起来好吗？

messages.speaker: Rita (室友)
messages.zh: 衣服洗完了吗？
messages.en: Have you finished the washing?

messages.speaker: David (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, issa jmiss it-taqjir. Tgħinni ndendel il-ħwejjeġ?
messages.mt_standard: Iva, issa jmiss it-taqjir. Tgħinni ndendel il-ħwejjeġ?
messages.zh: 洗完了，现在该晾了。你帮我把衣服挂起来好吗？
messages.en: Yes, now it's time to hang it out. Will you help me hang up the clothes?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 taqjir 放在洗衣之后来记：湿衣服一件件挂上绳子，等待晾干。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A state of upset, disorder, or confusion in which feelings, events, or arrangements are unsettled.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 情绪受到扰动，或事情、安排失去条理而产生的不安、混乱或困惑状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Stat ta' inkwiet, diżordni jew konfużjoni li fih is-sentimenti jew l-affarijiet ma jkunux stabbli jew ċari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 情绪受到扰动而产生的不安或烦乱。
缺乏秩序、局面杂乱的状态。
因情况或信息不清而产生的困惑、混乱。

collocations.en: disruption and confusion in the schedule

formal.mt: Il-bidliet fl-aħħar minuta ħolqu taqlib fl-iskeda u konfużjoni fost il-parteċipanti.
formal.en: The last-minute changes caused disruption to the schedule and confusion among the participants.
formal.zh: 最后一刻的改动打乱了日程，也让参与者感到困惑。

colloquial.mt: Marta: X'taqlib! Fuq il-biljett hemm it-tmienja, imma fil-messaġġ hemm id-disgħa. Simon: Ċemplilhom, ħalli nkunu nafu liema ħin hu tajjeb.
colloquial.en: Marta: What a mix-up! The ticket says eight, but the message says nine. Simon: Call them so we can find out which time is right.
colloquial.zh: Marta：真乱！票上写八点，消息里却写九点。Simon：给他们打个电话，这样我们就知道哪个时间才对。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'taqlib! Fuq il-biljett hemm it-tmienja, imma fil-messaġġ hemm id-disgħa.
messages.mt_standard: X'taqlib! Fuq il-biljett hemm it-tmienja, imma fil-messaġġ hemm id-disgħa.
messages.zh: 真乱！票上写八点，消息里却写九点。
messages.en: What a mix-up! The ticket says eight, but the message says nine.

messages.speaker: Simon (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ċemplilhom, ħalli nkunu nafu liema ħin hu tajjeb.
messages.mt_standard: Ċemplilhom, ħalli nkunu nafu liema ħin hu tajjeb.
messages.zh: 给他们打个电话，这样我们就知道哪个时间才对。
messages.en: Call them so we can find out which time is right.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“一乱三感”记 taqlib：心里不安、现场混乱、脑中困惑，分别对应三个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of bringing the contents of the stomach out through the mouth.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 胃里的内容物经口排出的行为，即呕吐。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li biha dak li jkun fl-istonku joħroġ mill-ħalq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把胃里的东西吐出来；呕吐。
胃内容物经口排出的现象或行为；呕吐。

formal.mt: Fir-rekord ġie nnutat taqligħ ripetut matul il-lejl.
formal.en: Repeated vomiting during the night was noted in the record.
formal.zh: 记录中注明了夜间反复呕吐的情况。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Kif għadda l-vjaġġ bid-dgħajsa? Toni: Ħażin, kelli ħafna taqligħ. Issa nħossni aħjar.
colloquial.en: Elena: How was the boat trip? Toni: Bad; I threw up a lot. I feel better now.
colloquial.zh: Elena：坐船的旅程怎么样？Toni：不好，我吐得很厉害。现在感觉好些了。

messages.speaker: Elena (朋友)
messages.zh: 坐船的旅程怎么样？
messages.en: How was the boat trip?

messages.speaker: Toni (乘船的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħażin, kelli ħafna taqligħ. Issa nħossni aħjar.
messages.mt_standard: Ħażin, kelli ħafna taqligħ. Issa nħossni aħjar.
messages.zh: 不好，我吐得很厉害。现在感觉好些了。
messages.en: Bad; I threw up a lot. I feel better now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 taqligħ 与“晕船后吐出来”的场景绑定；两个英语义项都指呕吐这一动作。

gloss_zh: 趋于严厉或激烈的过程

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process by which something becomes more severe or vehement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某事逐渐变得更加严厉、严重或激烈的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li fih xi ħaġa ssir aktar severa jew aktar ħarxa u qawwija.

sense_translations.en_definition: process of becoming severe or vehement
sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得严厉、严重或激烈的过程。

formal.mt: It-taqlil tat-ton matul id-dibattitu għamilha aktar diffiċli biex jintlaħaq ftehim.
formal.en: The increasingly harsh tone during the debate made it more difficult to reach an agreement.
formal.zh: 辩论中语气逐渐变得严厉，使达成协议更加困难。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Innutajt it-taqlil tat-ton tiegħu? Beda jitkellem bil-kalma u spiċċa jgħajjat. Karl: Iva, aħjar inkomplu d-diskussjoni meta kulħadd ikun kalm.
colloquial.en: Nina: Did you notice his tone getting harsher? He started calmly and ended up shouting. Karl: Yes, we'd better continue the discussion when everyone is calm.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你注意到他的语气越来越严厉了吗？他开始还很平静，后来却喊了起来。Karl：注意到了，还是等大家冷静下来再继续讨论吧。

messages.speaker: Nina (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Innutajt it-taqlil tat-ton tiegħu? Beda jitkellem bil-kalma u spiċċa jgħajjat.
messages.mt_standard: Innutajt it-taqlil tat-ton tiegħu? Beda jitkellem bil-kalma u spiċċa jgħajjat.
messages.zh: 你注意到他的语气越来越严厉了吗？他开始还很平静，后来却喊了起来。
messages.en: Did you notice his tone getting harsher? He started calmly and ended up shouting.

messages.speaker: Karl (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, aħjar inkomplu d-diskussjoni meta kulħadd ikun kalm.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, aħjar inkomplu d-diskussjoni meta kulħadd ikun kalm.
messages.zh: 注意到了，还是等大家冷静下来再继续讨论吧。
messages.en: Yes, we'd better continue the discussion when everyone is calm.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“平静说话逐渐变成激烈争执”的连续画面记 taqlil，重点记住程度加剧的过程。

gloss_zh: 坐立不安的小动作；抽动不宁

teaching_sense.en_definition: Restless small movements or a tendency to make quick, twitching movements.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因不安而反复做出细小动作，或容易出现快速抽动的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Movimenti żgħar u ripetuti minħabba nuqqas ta' kwiet, jew tendenza għal movimenti qosra u f'daqqa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 因坐立不安而不停做小动作，如动手、抖腿或挪动身体。
容易出现短促抽动、身体难以保持安静的状态。

formal.mt: Waqt l-osservazzjoni ġie nnutat taqliq tas-saqajn meta l-parteċipant kien qed jistenna.
formal.en: During the observation, restless movements of the feet were noted while the participant was waiting.
formal.zh: 观察中发现，参与者等待时双脚不断做出不安的小动作。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex dan it-taqliq kollu fuq is-siġġu? Ben: Qed nistenna r-riżultat u ma nistax noqgħod kwiet.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why are you fidgeting so much in your chair? Ben: I'm waiting for the result and can't sit still.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你怎么在椅子上动来动去的？Ben：我在等结果，实在坐不住。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex dan it-taqliq kollu fuq is-siġġu?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex dan it-taqliq kollu fuq is-siġġu?
messages.zh: 你怎么在椅子上动来动去的？
messages.en: Why are you fidgeting so much in your chair?

messages.speaker: Ben (等待结果的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed nistenna r-riżultat u ma nistax noqgħod kwiet.
messages.mt_standard: Qed nistenna r-riżultat u ma nistax noqgħod kwiet.
messages.zh: 我在等结果，实在坐不住。
messages.en: I'm waiting for the result and can't sit still.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象等待结果时手脚停不下来，用这个画面记 taqliq 的小动作与抽动不宁两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of jumping over another person's head.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 跳起并从另一个人的头顶上方越过去的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed jaqbeż minn fuq ras persuna oħra.

sense_translations.en_definition: act of leaping over sb.'s head
sense_translations.zh_definition: 从某人的头顶上方跃过的动作。

collocations.zh: 从一个人的头顶上方跃过

collocations.en: leaping over someone's head during an acrobatic performance
collocations.zh: 杂技表演中跃过别人头顶的动作

formal.mt: Il-programm tal-wirja jinkludi taqlit minn fuq ras persuna oħra.
formal.en: The performance programme includes leaping over another person's head.
formal.zh: 演出节目包括从另一个人的头顶上方跃过的动作。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Rajt dak it-taqlit minn fuq ras sieħbu? Mark: Iva! Qabeż minn fuqu mingħajr ma messu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you see that leap over his partner's head? Mark: Yes! He jumped over him without touching him.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你看见他跃过搭档头顶的那个动作了吗？Mark：看见了！他跳过去时完全没碰到对方。

messages.speaker: Maja (观众)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajt dak it-taqlit minn fuq ras sieħbu?
messages.mt_standard: Rajt dak it-taqlit minn fuq ras sieħbu?
messages.zh: 你看见他跃过搭档头顶的那个动作了吗？
messages.en: Did you see that leap over his partner's head?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva! Qabeż minn fuqu mingħajr ma messu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva! Qabeż minn fuqu mingħajr ma messu.
messages.zh: 看见了！他跳过去时完全没碰到对方。
messages.en: Yes! He jumped over him without touching him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象杂技演员从搭档头顶一跃而过，把 taqlit 与这个完整动作绑定，记住重点是越过人的头顶。

gloss_zh: 滋生大量寄生虫；虫害遍布

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of becoming heavily infested with vermin, such as lice.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变得满是虱子等寄生虫或害虫的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li persuna, annimal jew ħaġa timtela b'parassiti, bħall-qamel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得满是寄生虫或害虫；遭受严重虫害的过程。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi t-taqmil tal-ħwejjeġ li nstabu fil-maħżen.
formal.en: The report describes the clothes found in the storeroom becoming infested with vermin.
formal.zh: 报告描述了在储藏室发现的衣物滋生大量寄生虫的情况。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex poġġejt dawk il-ħwejjeġ f'borża separata? Pawlu: Minħabba t-taqmil; sibt ħafna qamel fihom.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did you put those clothes in a separate bag? Pawlu: Because of the infestation; I found lots of lice in them.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你为什么把那些衣服单独装进一个袋子？Pawlu：因为它们生虫了；我在里面发现了很多虱子。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex poġġejt dawk il-ħwejjeġ f'borża separata?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex poġġejt dawk il-ħwejjeġ f'borża separata?
messages.zh: 你为什么把那些衣服单独装进一个袋子？
messages.en: Why did you put those clothes in a separate bag?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Minħabba t-taqmil; sibt ħafna qamel fihom.
messages.mt_standard: Minħabba t-taqmil; sibt ħafna qamel fihom.
messages.zh: 因为它们生虫了；我在里面发现了很多虱子。
messages.en: Because of the infestation; I found lots of lice in them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 taqmil 想成衣物上虫子越来越多的连续画面，记住它表示变得虫害遍布的过程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Madness, or behavior that seems extremely irrational.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 疯狂的状态，也可指显得极端不理智的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġenn, jew imġiba li tidher għal kollox bla raġuni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 疯狂；精神错乱；也可指荒唐而极不理智的行为。

formal.mt: L-awtur jiddeskrivi d-deċiżjoni li jitkompla l-vjaġġ fil-maltemp bħala att ta' taqmir.
formal.en: The author describes the decision to continue the journey in the storm as an act of lunacy.
formal.zh: 作者把在暴风雨中继续旅程的决定描述为疯狂之举。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Se jixtri dik id-dar mingħajr ma jaraha? David: Iva, għalija dak taqmir sħiħ!
colloquial.en: Nina: Is he going to buy that house without seeing it? David: Yes, to me that's utter lunacy!
colloquial.zh: Nina：他打算连看都不看就买下那栋房子？David：是啊，我觉得这简直太疯狂了！

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Se jixtri dik id-dar mingħajr ma jaraha?
messages.mt_standard: Se jixtri dik id-dar mingħajr ma jaraha?
messages.zh: 他打算连看都不看就买下那栋房子？
messages.en: Is he going to buy that house without seeing it?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.zh: 是啊，我觉得这简直太疯狂了！
messages.en: Yes, to me that's utter lunacy!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象听到一个极不理智的决定时脱口而出“太疯狂了”，把这种反应与 taqmir 联系起来。

gloss_zh: 踢动；坐立不安地动来动去
