teaching_sense.en_definition: Kicking movements, or restless movements made when someone cannot keep still.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 踢腿的动作，或因无法安静待着而不停扭动、动来动去。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għoti ta' daqqiet bis-saqajn, jew ċaqliq bla kwiet meta wieħed ma jistax joqgħod bi kwietu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 踢；踢腿或用脚踢动的动作。
坐立不安地动来动去；不停扭动身体或摆弄东西。

formal.mt: It-taqmis bis-saqajn tat-tifel kien qed iċaqlaq il-mejda.
formal.en: The boy's kicking was making the table move.
formal.zh: 男孩不停踢腿，把桌子都弄动了。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'inhu dan it-taqmis kollu fuq is-siġġu? Ben: Ili bilqiegħda wisq; għandi bżonn inqum ftit.
colloquial.en: Sara: What's all this fidgeting on the chair? Ben: I've been sitting too long; I need to get up for a bit.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你怎么一直在椅子上扭来扭去？Ben：我坐得太久了，得站起来活动一下。

messages.speaker: Sara (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhu dan it-taqmis kollu fuq is-siġġu?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhu dan it-taqmis kollu fuq is-siġġu?
messages.zh: 你怎么一直在椅子上扭来扭去？
messages.en: What's all this fidgeting on the chair?

messages.speaker: Ben (儿子)
messages.mt_spoken: Ili bilqiegħda wisq; għandi bżonn inqum ftit.
messages.mt_standard: Ili bilqiegħda wisq; għandi bżonn inqum ftit.
messages.zh: 我坐得太久了，得站起来活动一下。
messages.en: I've been sitting too long; I need to get up for a bit.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个动作记 taqmis：脚向外踢，以及坐在椅子上扭动；分别对应踢动和坐立不安。

gloss_zh: 衣服过紧造成的勒束不适

teaching_sense.en_definition: Discomfort caused by clothes that fit too tightly and press against the body.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 衣服过于贴紧、压迫身体而造成的勒束或不舒服的感觉。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-iskumdità li tinħass meta l-ħwejjeġ ikunu ssikkati wisq u jagħfsu fuq il-ġisem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 因衣服过紧而产生的勒束感或不适。

collocations.zh: 紧身衣物造成的勒束不适

collocations.en: discomfort from tight clothing around the waist
collocations.zh: 衣物在腰部勒得不舒服

formal.mt: Waqt il-prova tal-libsa, il-klijenta semmiet it-taqmit madwar il-qadd.
formal.en: During the dress fitting, the customer mentioned discomfort from tightness around the waist.
formal.zh: 试穿连衣裙时，顾客提到腰部勒得不舒服。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Kif inhu dak il-qalziet il-ġdid? Rita: Mhux komdu; qed inħoss ħafna taqmit mal-qadd.
colloquial.en: Anna: How are those new trousers? Rita: They're uncomfortable; they feel very tight around my waist.
colloquial.zh: Anna：那条新裤子穿着怎么样？Rita：不舒服，腰那里勒得很难受。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 那条新裤子穿着怎么样？
messages.en: How are those new trousers?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mhux komdu; qed inħoss ħafna taqmit mal-qadd.
messages.mt_standard: Mhux komdu; qed inħoss ħafna taqmit mal-qadd.
messages.zh: 不舒服，腰那里勒得很难受。
messages.en: They're uncomfortable; they feel very tight around my waist.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象裤腰太紧，坐下时腰被勒住的感觉；用这个身体体验记住 taqmit 的衣物勒束义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Putting up with someone or something unpleasant, often with difficulty or very little patience.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 忍受令人不快的人或事，常带有勉强接受、耐心接近极限的意味。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-fatt li wieħed jissaporti persuna jew sitwazzjoni li ddejqu, spiss bi tbatija jew bi ftit paċenzja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 忍受；容忍令人不快的人、行为或情况。
勉强容忍；几乎到了无法继续忍受的程度。

formal.mt: It-taqnigħ tal-istorbju ta' kuljum sar dejjem aktar diffiċli għar-residenti.
formal.en: Putting up with the daily noise became increasingly difficult for the residents.
formal.zh: 居民越来越难以忍受每天的噪声。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għadek tissaporti l-istorbju ta' ħdejk? Toni: Bilkemm; dan it-taqnigħ qed jgħejjini.
colloquial.en: Marta: Are you still putting up with the noise next door? Toni: Barely; having to put up with it is wearing me out.
colloquial.zh: Marta：你还忍得了隔壁的噪声吗？Toni：勉强吧；一直这样忍着，真让我疲惫。

messages.speaker: Marta (邻居)
messages.zh: 你还忍得了隔壁的噪声吗？
messages.en: Are you still putting up with the noise next door?

messages.speaker: Toni (居民)
messages.zh: 勉强吧；一直这样忍着，真让我疲惫。
messages.en: Barely; having to put up with it is wearing me out.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象隔壁噪声不断，自己还在勉强忍耐；把 taqnigħ 与“忍着，而且快忍不住了”联系起来。

gloss_zh: 打孔；穿孔；用皮下注射针注射；钻孔器

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make a hole in something by drilling, piercing, or a similar action.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过钻、刺等动作在某物上弄出一个孔。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħmel toqba f'xi ħaġa, pereżempju billi tħaffer fiha jew tinfidha b'għodda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 打孔；在某物上弄出一个洞。
穿孔；将某物刺穿或打出孔洞。

sense_translations.en_definition: to inject with a hypodermic needle
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用皮下注射针进行注射。
钻孔器；钻孔者。

collocations.en: drilled a hole in the wall
punched a hole in the paper
bored a hole in the wood

formal.mt: It-tekniku taqqab il-pannell tal-injam biex jgħaddi l-kejbil minnu.
formal.en: The technician drilled a hole in the wooden panel to pass the cable through it.
formal.zh: 技术人员在木板上钻了一个孔，以便让电缆穿过去。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Min taqqab il-ħajt hawn? Mark: Jien, biex indendel l-istampa.
colloquial.en: Lina: Who drilled a hole in the wall here? Mark: I did, to hang the picture.
colloquial.zh: Lina：谁在这里的墙上钻了孔？Mark：我钻的，为了挂那幅画。

messages.speaker: Lina (室友)
messages.zh: 谁在这里的墙上钻了孔？
messages.en: Who drilled a hole in the wall here?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 我钻的，为了挂那幅画。
messages.en: I did, to hang the picture.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用墙上钻孔的画面记住 taqqab 的核心动词义，再分开记穿孔、针头注射和名词钻孔器，留意词性边界。

gloss_zh: 能够穿孔的；具有穿孔能力的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Capable of making a hole through a material.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有在材料上打孔或将其穿透的能力的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu l-ħila jagħmel toqba f'materjal jew jinfdu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 能够穿孔的；具有打孔或穿透能力的。

formal.mt: L-istrument għandu tarf taqqabi li jista' jinfed il-kartun.
formal.en: The instrument has a perforating tip that can pierce cardboard.
formal.zh: 这件器具的尖端具有穿孔能力，可以刺穿硬纸板。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Dan l-istrument jista' jagħmel toqba fil-kartun? Pawlu: Iva, għandu tarf taqqabi.
colloquial.en: Rita: Can this instrument make a hole in cardboard? Pawlu: Yes, it has a tip that can perforate it.
colloquial.zh: Rita：这件器具能在硬纸板上打孔吗？Pawlu：能，它的尖端可以穿孔。

messages.speaker: Rita (手工课学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan l-istrument jista' jagħmel toqba fil-kartun?
messages.mt_standard: Dan l-istrument jista' jagħmel toqba fil-kartun?
messages.zh: 这件器具能在硬纸板上打孔吗？
messages.en: Can this instrument make a hole in cardboard?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (手工课教师)
messages.zh: 能，它的尖端可以穿孔。
messages.en: Yes, it has a tip that can perforate it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 taqqabi 贴在能刺穿纸板的工具尖端上，记成“具备穿孔能力的”；学习时用它描述性质。

gloss_zh: 增加困难的；加重负担的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Tending to make a task more difficult or a burden heavier.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容容易使事情更困难，或使重量、负担增加的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu tendenza jżid id-diffikultà ta' biċċa xogħol jew it-toqol ta' piż.

sense_translations.en_definition: tending to increase difficulty or weight
sense_translations.zh_definition: 容易增加困难或加重重量、负担的。

collocations.en: work that adds to the burden

formal.mt: Il-kumitat qies dan ir-rekwiżit bħala taqqali, għax iżid ix-xogħol meħtieġ biex titlesta l-applikazzjoni.
formal.en: The committee considered this requirement burdensome because it increases the work needed to complete the application.
formal.zh: 委员会认为这项要求加重了负担，因为它增加了完成申请所需的工作。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan ix-xogħol żejjed jidher taqqali. Mark: Iva, se jagħmilha aktar diffiċli biex nispiċċaw illum.
colloquial.en: Maja: This extra work looks burdensome. Mark: Yes, it will make it harder for us to finish today.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这些额外工作看来挺增加负担的。Mark：是啊，这会让我们更难在今天做完。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 这些额外工作看来挺增加负担的。
messages.en: This extra work looks burdensome.

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, se jagħmilha aktar diffiċli biex nispiċċaw illum.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, se jagħmilha aktar diffiċli biex nispiċċaw illum.
messages.zh: 是啊，这会让我们更难在今天做完。
messages.en: Yes, it will make it harder for us to finish today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象工作清单又添一项、背包又添一块石头：taqqali 强调让困难或负担增加。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or process of coming or moving closer to someone or something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向某人或某物靠近、使距离逐渐缩短的行为或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att jew il-proċess li wieħed jew xi ħaġa tersaq eqreb lejn persuna jew ħaġa oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 逐渐靠近、接近。

formal.mt: Waqt it-taqrib tal-vapur lejn il-port, il-passiġġieri baqgħu bilqiegħda.
formal.en: During the ship's approach to the harbour, the passengers remained seated.
formal.zh: 船只接近港口时，乘客们保持就座。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Mat-taqrib tad-dgħajsa lejn ix-xatt, se naraw il-ħut aħjar? Pawlu: Iva, minn hemm inkunu eqreb lejn l-ilma ċar.
colloquial.en: Lara: As the boat gets closer to the shore, will we see the fish better? Pawlu: Yes, from there we will be closer to the clear water.
colloquial.zh: Lara：小船靠近岸边时，我们会更看得清鱼吗？Pawlu：会，从那里我们就更靠近清澈的水域了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mat-taqrib tad-dgħajsa lejn ix-xatt, se naraw il-ħut aħjar?
messages.mt_standard: Mat-taqrib tad-dgħajsa lejn ix-xatt, se naraw il-ħut aħjar?
messages.zh: 小船靠近岸边时，我们会更看得清鱼吗？
messages.en: As the boat gets closer to the shore, will we see the fish better?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, minn hemm inkunu eqreb lejn l-ilma ċar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, minn hemm inkunu eqreb lejn l-ilma ċar.
messages.zh: 会，从那里我们就更靠近清澈的水域了。
messages.en: Yes, from there we will be closer to the clear water.

cognitive_memory_aid: 脑中播放小船一点点靠岸的画面：taqrib 记作距离逐渐缩短的过程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or process of causing a sore to form pus, usually on the foot.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使伤处产生脓液、发生化脓的作用或过程，通常涉及足部。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att jew il-proċess li jġiegħel ferita tifforma l-materja, ġeneralment fis-sieq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 引起化脓，通常发生在足部。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi t-taqrid tal-ferita fis-sieq u l-preżenza tal-materja fiha.
formal.en: The report describes the process causing the foot wound to suppurate and the presence of pus in it.
formal.zh: 报告描述了使足部伤口化脓的过程，以及伤口内存在脓液的情况。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'ifisser taqrid f'din is-sentenza dwar is-sieq? Mark: Ifisser li xi ħaġa qed iġġiegħel ferita tifforma l-materja.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does taqrid mean in this sentence about the foot? Mark: It means that something is causing a wound to form pus.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这个关于脚的句子里，taqrid 是什么意思？Mark：意思是某种因素使伤口产生脓液。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: X'ifisser taqrid f'din is-sentenza dwar is-sieq?
messages.mt_standard: X'ifisser taqrid f'din is-sentenza dwar is-sieq?
messages.zh: 这个关于脚的句子里，taqrid 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does taqrid mean in this sentence about the foot?

messages.speaker: Mark (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li xi ħaġa qed iġġiegħel ferita tifforma l-materja.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li xi ħaġa qed iġġiegħel ferita tifforma l-materja.
messages.zh: 意思是某种因素使伤口产生脓液。
messages.en: It means that something is causing a wound to form pus.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 taqrid 联想成词汇卡上的足部伤口图，并标注“使之化脓”，记住它强调引起化脓。

gloss_zh: 抢先采走；先下手取走可采之物

teaching_sense.en_definition: Taking available pickings, such as fruit, before other people can get to them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在别人有机会取得之前，抢先采走或拿走可供采摘、取用的东西，例如果实。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-teħid ta' dak li jista' jinġabar, bħall-frott, qabel ma ħaddieħor ikollu ċans jasal għalih.

sense_translations.en_definition: taking the pickings (e.g. of fruit) before others can get at them
sense_translations.zh_definition: 赶在别人能够取得之前，抢先取走可采摘或取用的东西，例如果实。

collocations.en: taking the fruit before others can get to it
collocations.zh: 抢在别人之前采走果实

collocations.en: taking the figs before others can get to them

formal.mt: It-taqrif tal-frott minn ftit persuni ħalla lill-bqija tal-grupp mingħajr xejn x'jiġbor.
formal.en: A few people taking the fruit before anyone else could reach it left the rest of the group with nothing to pick.
formal.zh: 少数人抢先采走了果实，使小组其余成员无果可摘。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex ma fadalx tin għalina? Pawlu: Minħabba t-taqrif; waslu l-oħrajn qabilna u ġabruh kollu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why are there no figs left for us? Pawlu: Because the others got to them first; they arrived before us and picked them all.
colloquial.zh: Lara：怎么没有无花果留给我们了？Pawlu：都被抢先摘走了；其他人比我们早到，把果子全摘了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 怎么没有无花果留给我们了？
messages.en: Why are there no figs left for us?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Minħabba t-taqrif; waslu l-oħrajn qabilna u ġabruh kollu.
messages.mt_standard: Minħabba t-taqrif; waslu l-oħrajn qabilna u ġabruh kollu.
messages.zh: 都被抢先摘走了；其他人比我们早到，把果子全摘了。
messages.en: Because the others got to them first; they arrived before us and picked them all.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象你提篮赶到果树下，果子已被先到的人摘走：taqrif 的关键是抢在别人之前取得。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Baldness, or the process of losing hair and becoming bald.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 头发缺失而呈现的秃发状态，也指头发逐渐脱落、变秃的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-istat ta' min hu qargħi, jew il-proċess li bih ix-xagħar jonqos u wieħed isir qargħi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 秃发；头部缺少头发的状态。
头发逐渐脱落而变秃的过程。

formal.mt: Id-deskrizzjoni tqabbel ir-ritratti biex turi t-taqrigħ gradwali matul diversi snin.
formal.en: The description compares the photographs to show gradual balding over several years.
formal.zh: 这段说明通过对比照片，展示了数年间逐渐变秃的过程。

colloquial.mt: Mark: F'dawn ir-ritratti qed ninnota t-taqrigħ tiegħi. Maja: Iva, jidher li x-xagħar naqas ftit ftit matul is-snin.
colloquial.en: Mark: I am noticing my balding in these photos. Maja: Yes, it looks as though your hair gradually thinned over the years.
colloquial.zh: Mark：看这些照片，我注意到自己逐渐变秃了。Maja：是啊，看起来这些年你的头发一点点减少了。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: F'dawn ir-ritratti qed ninnota t-taqrigħ tiegħi.
messages.mt_standard: F'dawn ir-ritratti qed ninnota t-taqrigħ tiegħi.
messages.zh: 看这些照片，我注意到自己逐渐变秃了。
messages.en: I am noticing my balding in these photos.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jidher li x-xagħar naqas ftit ftit matul is-snin.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jidher li x-xagħar naqas ftit ftit matul is-snin.
messages.zh: 是啊，看起来这些年你的头发一点点减少了。
messages.en: Yes, it looks as though your hair gradually thinned over the years.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一张秃头照片记状态，用连续多年照片记过程：taqrigħ 同时覆盖“秃发”和“逐渐变秃”。

gloss_zh: 使丈夫遭遇妻子性不忠的行为

teaching_sense.en_definition: Sexual infidelity involving a married woman and someone other than her husband, thereby making her husband a cuckold.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 已婚女性与丈夫以外的人发生性关系，使其丈夫遭受婚姻性背叛的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Infedeltà sesswali li fiha mara miżżewġa jkollha relazzjoni ma' persuna oħra u b'hekk tqarraq b'żewġha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使丈夫因妻子与他人发生性关系而遭受性背叛；俗称给丈夫戴绿帽。

collocations.zh: 有关使丈夫遭受妻子性不忠的指控
一宗妻子性不忠、背叛丈夫的事件

formal.mt: Fl-analiżi tar-rumanz, l-akkuża ta' taqrin hija deskritta bħala s-sors tal-kunflitt bejn il-karattri.
formal.en: In the analysis of the novel, the accusation of cuckolding is described as the source of the conflict between the characters.
formal.zh: 在这篇小说分析中，有关妻子性不忠的指控被描述为人物之间冲突的根源。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Meta semmew it-taqrin fl-istorja, kienu qed jgħidu li martu kellha relazzjoni ma' ħaddieħor? Mark: Iva, iżda kienet biss akkuża; l-istorja għadha ma wrietx jekk kinitx vera.
colloquial.en: Maja: When they mentioned cuckolding in the story, did they mean his wife was having a relationship with someone else? Mark: Yes, but it was only an accusation; the story has not yet shown whether it was true.
colloquial.zh: Maja：故事里提到 taqrin，是说他的妻子和别人有婚外关系吗？Mark：对，但那只是指控；故事还没交代是真是假。

messages.speaker: Maja (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta semmew it-taqrin fl-istorja, kienu qed jgħidu li martu kellha relazzjoni ma' ħaddieħor?
messages.mt_standard: Meta semmew it-taqrin fl-istorja, kienu qed jgħidu li martu kellha relazzjoni ma' ħaddieħor?
messages.zh: 故事里提到 taqrin，是说他的妻子和别人有婚外关系吗？
messages.en: When they mentioned cuckolding in the story, did they mean his wife was having a relationship with someone else?

messages.speaker: Mark (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, iżda kienet biss akkuża; l-istorja għadha ma wrietx jekk kinitx vera.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, iżda kienet biss akkuża; l-istorja għadha ma wrietx jekk kinitx vera.
messages.zh: 对，但那只是指控；故事还没交代是真是假。
messages.en: Yes, but it was only an accusation; the story has not yet shown whether it was true.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用小说人物关系图来记：妻子与他人发生婚外性关系，丈夫遭受背叛；taqrin 指这一行为。

gloss_zh: 诡计；作弊；欺骗；暗中算计

teaching_sense.en_definition: A trick or dishonest conduct involving cheating, deception, or secret scheming.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指诡计，或通过作弊、欺骗、暗中谋划等方式误导他人、谋取利益的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qerq jew imġiba diżonesta li biha wieħed iqarraq b'ħaddieħor, jikser ir-regoli biex jikseb vantaġġ, jew jippjana bil-moħbi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 诡计；用来蒙骗他人的花招。
作弊；以不诚实或违反规则的方式获取优势。
欺骗；使他人相信虚假情况的行为。
暗中算计；为达到目的而秘密策划不诚实之事。

collocations.zh: 为获取优势而进行的欺骗

formal.mt: Ir-regolament jipprojbixxi kull forma ta' taqriq fl-eżami, inkluż l-użu ta' noti mhux permessi.
formal.en: The regulations prohibit every form of cheating in the exam, including the use of unauthorised notes.
formal.zh: 考试规定禁止任何形式的作弊，包括使用未经允许的笔记。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Rajtu jaħbi karta oħra taħt il-mejda. Dan taqriq! Pawlu: Għandek raġun; ejja ngħidulu jerġa' jilgħab skont ir-regoli.
colloquial.en: Lara: I saw him hide another card under the table. That is cheating! Pawlu: You are right; let's tell him to play again according to the rules.
colloquial.zh: Lara：我看见他把另一张牌藏在桌子下面。这是作弊！Pawlu：你说得对，我们叫他按规则重新玩吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (牌友)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajtu jaħbi karta oħra taħt il-mejda. Dan taqriq!
messages.mt_standard: Rajtu jaħbi karta oħra taħt il-mejda. Dan taqriq!
messages.zh: 我看见他把另一张牌藏在桌子下面。这是作弊！
messages.en: I saw him hide another card under the table. That is cheating!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (牌友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek raġun; ejja ngħidulu jerġa' jilgħab skont ir-regoli.
messages.mt_standard: Għandek raġun; ejja ngħidulu jerġa' jilgħab skont ir-regoli.
messages.zh: 你说得对，我们叫他按规则重新玩吧。
messages.en: You are right; let's tell him to play again according to the rules.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象桌下藏牌的场面：花招是诡计，违规是作弊，蒙人是欺骗，预先密谋是算计；四个角度串记 taqriq。

gloss_zh: 捏掐；表示厌恶的面部表情

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action of pinching; also, a facial expression showing disgust.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用手指捏掐的动作；也可指表示厌恶的面部表情。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għemil li tagħfas il-ġilda bejn subgħajk; ukoll espressjoni tal-wiċċ li turi stmerrija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 捏；掐；用手指夹捏的动作
表示厌恶的面部表情

formal.mt: It-taqris fuq il-ġilda jista' jikkawża uġigħ u jħalli marki.
formal.en: Pinching the skin can cause pain and leave marks.
formal.zh: 捏掐皮肤可能造成疼痛并留下痕迹。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed iżżomm driegħek? Lara: Minħabba t-taqris ta' ħija; għedtlu jieqaf.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you holding your arm? Lara: Because my brother was pinching me; I told him to stop.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么捂着手臂？拉拉：因为弟弟刚才掐我；我叫他停下了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么捂着手臂？
messages.en: Why are you holding your arm?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Minħabba t-taqris ta' ħija; għedtlu jieqaf.
messages.mt_standard: Minħabba t-taqris ta' ħija; għedtlu jieqaf.
messages.zh: 因为弟弟刚才掐我；我叫他停下了。
messages.en: Because my brother was pinching me; I told him to stop.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把手指捏掐的动作和厌恶时的表情各画一幅图，用同一个词分别配图记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of irritating a wound; also, a very cold wind.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使伤口受到刺激的行为或作用；另一个义项指非常寒冷的风。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li jirrita ferita; jista' jfisser ukoll riħ kiesaħ ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使伤口受到刺激。
非常寒冷的风；凛冽寒风。

formal.mt: Il-pazjent iddeskriva t-taqriħ tal-ferita meta d-drapp mess mal-ġilda mweġġgħa.
formal.en: The patient described the irritation of the wound when the fabric touched the injured skin.
formal.zh: 患者描述了布料接触受伤皮肤时对伤口造成的刺激。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'taqriħ hawn barra! Pawlu: Iva, dan ir-riħ kiesaħ ħafna; ejja nidħlu.
colloquial.en: Lara: What a freezing wind out here! Pawlu: Yes, this wind is very cold; let's go inside.
colloquial.zh: Lara：外面的风真冷啊！Pawlu：是啊，这风冷极了，我们进去吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 外面的风真冷啊！
messages.en: What a freezing wind out here!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, dan ir-riħ kiesaħ ħafna; ejja nidħlu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, dan ir-riħ kiesaħ ħafna; ejja nidħlu.
messages.zh: 是啊，这风冷极了，我们进去吧。
messages.en: Yes, this wind is very cold; let's go inside.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 taqriħ 画两格词义卡：一格是伤口受刺激，一格是寒风吹脸；两义分别记，别混成同一件事。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of dividing something into parts or shares; also, division in arithmetic.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把整体划分成部分或份额的行为，也指算术中的除法。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għemil li tifred xi ħaġa f'partijiet jew f'ishma; ukoll l-operazzjoni matematika li biha numru jinqasam b'numru ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 划分；分配；数学中的除法

formal.mt: It-taqsim tax-xogħol bejn il-membri tat-tim għandu jkun ċar u ġust.
formal.en: The division of work among team members should be clear and fair.
formal.zh: 团队成员之间的工作分工应当明确、公平。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Kif se nagħmlu t-taqsim tal-ispejjeż? Nina: Inħallsu nofs kull wieħed.
colloquial.en: Mark: How shall we split the expenses? Nina: We'll each pay half.
colloquial.zh: 马克：费用怎么分摊？妮娜：我们各付一半。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 费用怎么分摊？
messages.en: How shall we split the expenses?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们各付一半。
messages.en: We'll each pay half.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把一张账单分成两份：taqsim着重记住“分”的行为，也可联系数学除法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A distinct section of a whole, a school class, or a division within an organization.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 整体中的一个部分或章节、学校中的一个班级，或机构内部的一个分部。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Parti distinta minn ħaġa sħiħa, klassi fi skola, jew diviżjoni fi ħdan organizzazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一个部分；一节；一个章节
一个班；一个班级
一个分部；一个部门；一个分区

formal.mt: It-tieni taqsima tar-rapport tippreżenta r-riżultati tal-istħarriġ.
formal.en: The second section of the report presents the survey results.
formal.zh: 报告的第二部分介绍调查结果。

colloquial.mt: Sara: F'liema taqsima tal-ktieb hemm l-eżerċizzji? Pawlu: Fl-aħħar taqsima, wara l-eżempji.
colloquial.en: Sara: Which section of the book has the exercises? Pawlu: The last section, after the examples.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：练习在书的哪个部分？保罗：在最后一部分，例子后面。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 练习在书的哪个部分？
messages.en: Which section of the book has the exercises?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.zh: 在最后一部分，例子后面。
messages.en: The last section, after the examples.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用书的一节、学校的一班和机构的一部三张卡片，记住taqsima表示分出的一个单位。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of making something shorter, including reducing a text to its main points.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物变短的行为，也包括提取文字要点、将内容概括缩短。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għemil li tagħmel xi ħaġa iqsar, inkluż li tnaqqas test għall-punti ewlenin tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 缩短；使长度减少
概括；摘要；提取主要内容

formal.mt: Fit-taqsir ta' test, għandhom jinżammu l-ideat ewlenin u jitħallew barra d-dettalji sekondarji.
formal.en: When summarising a text, the main ideas should be retained and secondary details omitted.
formal.zh: 概括文本时，应保留主要观点，省去次要细节。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kemm jiġi t-taqsir tal-kmiem? Rita: Għaxar ewro, u l-ġakketta tkun lesta għada.
colloquial.en: Lara: How much does shortening the sleeves cost? Rita: Ten euros, and the jacket will be ready tomorrow.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：改短袖子多少钱？丽塔：十欧元，外套明天就能改好。

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.zh: 改短袖子多少钱？
messages.en: How much does shortening the sleeves cost?

messages.speaker: Rita (裁缝)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaxar ewro, u l-ġakketta tkun lesta għada.
messages.mt_standard: Għaxar ewro, u l-ġakketta tkun lesta għada.
messages.zh: 十欧元，外套明天就能改好。
messages.en: Ten euros, and the jacket will be ready tomorrow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 一边想袖子变短，一边想文章只留要点；两种场景都用“缩短”串起taqsir。

gloss_zh: 肉贩用语，释作“goose skirk”，具体所指未明

teaching_sense.en_definition: A butcher's term glossed as 'goose skirk', whose precise referent is unclear.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 肉贩使用的术语，释义为“goose skirk”；其具体所指尚不明确，不宜直接对应某个确定的鹅肉部位。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Terminu tal-biċċiera bil-glossa 'goose skirk', li t-tifsira preċiża tiegħu mhijiex ċara.

sense_translations.zh_definition: （肉贩用语）“goose skirk”；该英文释义的具体所指不明，无法确定对应的中文部位名称

formal.mt: Fit-traduzzjoni tat-terminu 'taqsira', għandha tiġi ċċarata t-tifsira tiegħu fil-kuntest tal-biċċerija.
formal.en: When translating the term 'taqsira', its meaning in the butcher's context should be clarified.
formal.zh: 翻译“taqsira”这个术语时，应先明确它在肉铺语境中的具体含义。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Xi tfisser 'taqsira' hawn? Toni: Fejn rajt il-kelma? Urini s-sentenza biex nifhmu l-kuntest.
colloquial.en: Mark: What does 'taqsira' mean here? Toni: Where did you see the word? Show me the sentence so we can understand the context.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这里的“taqsira”是什么意思？托尼：你在哪里看到这个词的？把句子给我看看，我们好理解语境。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 这里的“taqsira”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'taqsira' mean here?

messages.speaker: Toni (肉贩)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn rajt il-kelma? Urini s-sentenza biex nifhmu l-kuntest.
messages.mt_standard: Fejn rajt il-kelma? Urini s-sentenza biex nifhmu l-kuntest.
messages.zh: 你在哪里看到这个词的？把句子给我看看，我们好理解语境。
messages.en: Where did you see the word? Show me the sentence so we can understand the context.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给taqsira配一张“肉铺术语，待明确所指”的卡片，先记使用领域，不猜具体部位。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action of making snips with scissors; also, the process of being ordained a priest.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用剪刀一下一下剪切的动作；也指接受祝圣、成为司铎的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għemil li taqta' b'qatgħat żgħar bl-imqass; ukoll il-proċess li bih persuna tiġi ordnata saċerdot.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用剪刀剪切；用剪刀一下一下地剪

sense_translations.en_definition: process of being ordained a priest
sense_translations.zh_definition: 接受司铎祝圣的过程；晋铎过程

formal.mt: It-taqsis bil-imqass għandu jsir b'attenzjoni, speċjalment meta t-tfal ikunu qed jaħdmu bil-karti.
formal.en: Snipping with scissors should be done carefully, especially when children are working with paper.
formal.zh: 用剪刀剪切时应当小心，尤其是儿童进行纸艺活动时。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex hemm dawn il-biċċiet żgħar kollha fuq il-mejda? Ben: Mit-taqsis tal-karti; se niġborhom issa.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why are all these little pieces on the table? Ben: They're from snipping the paper; I'll pick them up now.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：桌上怎么有这么多小碎片？本：是剪纸留下的；我现在就收拾。

messages.speaker: Anna (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex hemm dawn il-biċċiet żgħar kollha fuq il-mejda?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex hemm dawn il-biċċiet żgħar kollha fuq il-mejda?
messages.zh: 桌上怎么有这么多小碎片？
messages.en: Why are all these little pieces on the table?

messages.speaker: Ben (儿子)

messages.en: They're from snipping the paper; I'll pick them up now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 为taqsis分别画剪刀和晋铎仪式两张场景卡，分开记两个义项，不编造它们的历史联系。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action of cutting something, including chopping it into pieces.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 切开或切割某物的行为，也包括把东西砍成或剁成小块。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għemil li taqta' xi ħaġa, inkluż li tqattagħha f'biċċiet b'daqqiet ta' sikkina jew ta' mannara.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 切割；切开；剪切
砍切；剁切；砍成小块

formal.mt: Waqt it-taqtigħ tal-injam, il-ħaddiema għandhom jilbsu tagħmir protettiv adattat.
formal.en: During wood cutting, workers should wear suitable protective equipment.
formal.zh: 切割木材时，工人应穿戴合适的防护装备。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Tridni ngħinek bit-taqtigħ tal-ħaxix? Mark: Iva, jekk jogħġbok. Qatta' l-karrotti f'biċċiet żgħar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Would you like me to help you cut the vegetables? Mark: Yes, please. Cut the carrots into small pieces.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：要我帮你切菜吗？马克：好，谢谢。把胡萝卜切成小块吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 要我帮你切菜吗？
messages.en: Would you like me to help you cut the vegetables?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jekk jogħġbok. Qatta' l-karrotti f'biċċiet żgħar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jekk jogħġbok. Qatta' l-karrotti f'biċċiet żgħar.
messages.zh: 好，谢谢。把胡萝卜切成小块吧。
messages.en: Yes, please. Cut the carrots into small pieces.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把厨房切菜和户外砍木头并排想象，taqtigħ都着重表示切砍这项活动。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A fight or struggle; also, an individual act of cutting.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一场打斗或斗争，也可指一次切割动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġlieda jew sforz biex tingħeleb diffikultà; ukoll att wieħed ta' qtugħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一场打斗；一场交锋
一场斗争；一番艰苦的努力
一次切割；一次切开的动作

collocations.en: a single cut with a knife

formal.mt: Wara taqtigħa twila kontra l-marda, il-pazjent seta' jerġa' lura għax-xogħol.
formal.en: After a long struggle against illness, the patient was able to return to work.
formal.zh: 经过长期与疾病抗争，这位患者终于能够重返工作岗位。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'ġara barra? Pawlu: Kien hemm taqtigħa bejn żewġ irġiel, imma issa waqfu.

colloquial.zh: 妮娜：外面发生什么事了？保罗：刚才有两个男人打起来了，不过现在已经停下了。

messages.speaker: Nina (邻居)
messages.zh: 外面发生什么事了？
messages.en: What happened outside?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien hemm taqtigħa bejn żewġ irġiel, imma issa waqfu.
messages.mt_standard: Kien hemm taqtigħa bejn żewġ irġiel, imma issa waqfu.
messages.zh: 刚才有两个男人打起来了，不过现在已经停下了。
messages.en: There was a fight between two men, but they've stopped now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“一场打斗、一场抗争、切上一刀”三个短语记taqtigħa，分别对应三个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The killing of people or animals in large numbers.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指大量杀死人或动物的行为，即大规模杀戮或屠杀。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-qtil ta' għadd kbir ta' nies jew annimali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 大规模杀戮；成批屠杀

formal.mt: Fl-esej tiegħu, l-istudent jikkundanna t-taqtil ta' nies innoċenti u jenfasizza l-ħtieġa li jiġu protetti ċ-ċivili.
formal.en: In his essay, the student condemns the slaughter of innocent people and emphasizes the need to protect civilians.
formal.zh: 这名学生在文章中谴责对无辜民众的屠杀，并强调保护平民的必要性。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Dan il-ktieb jitkellem dwar it-taqtil waqt il-gwerra? Pawlu: Iva, imma jitkellem ukoll dwar in-nies li salvaw lil ħaddieħor.
colloquial.en: Marija: Does this book discuss slaughter during the war? Pawlu: Yes, but it also discusses the people who saved others.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：这本书讲到战争中的大规模杀戮吗？保罗：讲到了，但也讲到那些救助他人的人。

messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-ktieb jitkellem dwar it-taqtil waqt il-gwerra?

messages.zh: 这本书讲到战争中的大规模杀戮吗？
messages.en: Does this book discuss slaughter during the war?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma jitkellem ukoll dwar in-nies li salvaw lil ħaddieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma jitkellem ukoll dwar in-nies li salvaw lil ħaddieħor.
messages.zh: 讲到了，但也讲到那些救助他人的人。
messages.en: Yes, but it also discusses the people who saved others.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 taqtil 放进“谴责屠杀”的阅读场景中记忆，重点记住它表示大量杀戮，而非泛指一次死亡。

gloss_zh: 闲聊；空谈；咯咯声或呱呱声；心悸；心跳加快；紧张

teaching_sense.en_definition: Casual, continuous talking, often about unimportant things.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指轻松而持续的聊天，常涉及不重要的事情，可表示闲聊或闲谈。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Diskors ħafif u kontinwu, spiss dwar affarijiet ta' ftit importanza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 叽叽喳喳的谈话；闲聊
闲话；空谈
鸡的咯咯声或蛙的呱呱声
心悸；明显感到心脏跳动
心跳加快；快速的心跳
紧张；心神不安

formal.en: During the meeting, chatter among some participants made it difficult for the others to hear the speaker.
formal.zh: 会议期间，一些与会者的闲聊使其他人难以听清发言者的话。

colloquial.en: Lara: What's all this chatter? Ben: We're talking about yesterday's party. Come and join us!
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你们聊什么聊得这么热闹？本：我们在聊昨天的聚会。来，和我们一起坐！

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你们聊什么聊得这么热闹？
messages.en: What's all this chatter?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed nitkellmu dwar il-festa tal-bieraħ. Ejja oqgħod magħna!
messages.mt_standard: Qed nitkellmu dwar il-festa tal-bieraħ. Ejja oqgħod magħna!

messages.en: We're talking about yesterday's party. Come and join us!

teaching_sense.en_definition: The falling of liquid in separate drops, or the light pattering of rain.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 液体一滴一滴落下的过程，也可指雨点轻轻落下的淅沥声。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-waqgħa ta' likwidu qatra qatra, jew il-ħoss ħafif tax-xita nieżla.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 滴落；滴水
淅淅沥沥的雨；雨点轻落的声音

formal.mt: It-taqtir tal-ilma mis-saqaf ħalla marki fuq il-ħajt, u għalhekk intalbet tiswija.
formal.en: Water dripping from the ceiling left marks on the wall, so a repair was requested.
formal.zh: 天花板滴下的水在墙上留下了痕迹，因此有人提出了维修申请。

colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你听到那滴水声了吗？马克：听到了，水龙头没关紧。我来关。

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.zh: 你听到那滴水声了吗？

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-vit mhux magħluq sew. Nagħlqu jien.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-vit mhux magħluq sew. Nagħlqu jien.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象水龙头下一滴接一滴的水，再换成窗外轻落的雨点，用这两个画面记住 taqtir 的两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of gathering things together and tying them into bundles.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把物品聚在一起并用绳等扎成一束或一捆的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ġbir ta' affarijiet flimkien u l-irbit tagħhom f'qatet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把东西捆扎成束；扎捆

formal.mt: Wara l-ġbir tal-qasab, sar it-taqtit tiegħu biex ikun aktar faċli biex jinġarr.
formal.en: After the reeds were gathered, they were tied into bundles to make them easier to carry.
formal.zh: 芦苇收集完毕后被扎成捆，以便搬运。

colloquial.zh: 丽塔：这些树枝还需要怎么处理？托尼：只剩扎捆了。把绳子拿来，我们把它们扎成束。

messages.speaker: Rita (园艺帮手)

messages.en: What do we still need to do with the branches?

messages.mt_standard: It-taqtit biss. Ġib il-ħabel u norbtuhom f'qatet.

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small percussion instrument used to produce sharp clicking sounds.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种能发出清脆敲击声的小型打击乐器，即响板。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Strument żgħir tal-perkussjoni li jagħmel ħoss niexef u qasir meta jindaqq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 响板，一种发出清脆敲击声的打击乐器

formal.mt: Waqt il-lezzjoni tal-mużika, l-għalliema wriet kif tindaqq it-taqtuqa biex jinżamm ritmu sempliċi.
formal.en: During the music lesson, the teacher demonstrated how to play the castanet to keep a simple rhythm.
formal.zh: 音乐课上，老师示范了如何演奏响板来保持简单的节奏。

colloquial.mt: Ella: X'inhu dan l-istrument żgħir? Sara: Din taqtuqa. Trid tipprova ddoqqha?
colloquial.en: Ella: What's this little instrument? Sara: It's a castanet. Would you like to try playing it?
colloquial.zh: 埃拉：这个小乐器是什么？萨拉：这是响板。你想试着演奏一下吗？

messages.speaker: Ella (学生)
messages.zh: 这个小乐器是什么？
messages.en: What's this little instrument?

messages.speaker: Sara (音乐老师)
messages.zh: 这是响板。你想试着演奏一下吗？
messages.en: It's a castanet. Would you like to try playing it?

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 taqtuqa 时想象手中一件发出清脆咔嗒声的小乐器，并配合“这是响板”的指物句反复练习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of making something stronger, physically or figuratively.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某事物变得更强的过程，可指身体力量的增强、结构的加固或抽象方面的加强。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih xi ħaġa ssir aktar b'saħħitha, kemm fis-sens fiżiku kif ukoll f'sens figurattiv.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 加强；增强；加固

formal.mt: Il-pjan ta' manutenzjoni jinkludi t-taqwija tal-ħajt qabel ma jibda x-xogħol fuq is-saqaf.
formal.en: The maintenance plan includes strengthening the wall before work on the roof begins.
formal.zh: 维护计划包括在屋顶工程开始前加固墙体。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għaliex qed iżżidu dawn l-irfid? Ġużeppi: Għat-taqwija tal-ħajt. Hawnhekk għandu bżonn aktar appoġġ.
colloquial.en: Marta: Why are you adding these supports? Ġużeppi: To strengthen the wall. It needs more support here.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：你们为什么要加这些支撑？朱塞佩：为了加固墙体。这里需要更多支撑。

messages.speaker: Marta (住户)
messages.zh: 你们为什么要加这些支撑？
messages.en: Why are you adding these supports?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (施工人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għat-taqwija tal-ħajt. Hawnhekk għandu bżonn aktar appoġġ.
messages.mt_standard: Għat-taqwija tal-ħajt. Hawnhekk għandu bżonn aktar appoġġ.
messages.zh: 为了加固墙体。这里需要更多支撑。
messages.en: To strengthen the wall. It needs more support here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“肌肉变强”和“墙体加固”两幅前后对照图记 taqwija，抓住共同意思：使原有事物更强。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An exchange of spoken words between two or more people.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 两人或多人通过口头语言进行交流的活动，即交谈或谈话。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Skambju ta' kliem bejn żewġ persuni jew aktar li jitkellmu ma' xulxin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 交谈；谈话

formal.mt: It-taqwil bejn iż-żewġ ġirien għenhom jifhmu aħjar il-problema u jsibu soluzzjoni flimkien.
formal.en: The conversation between the two neighbors helped them understand the problem better and find a solution together.
formal.zh: 两位邻居之间的交谈帮助他们更好地理解问题，并共同找到解决办法。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Domtu ħafna flimkien illum! Pietru: Iva, kellna taqwil fit-tul dwar il-vaganzi.
colloquial.en: Anna: You spent a long time together today! Pietru: Yes, we had a lengthy conversation about the holidays.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你们今天在一起待了好久啊！彼得：是啊，我们聊假期聊了很久。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 你们今天在一起待了好久啊！
messages.en: You spent a long time together today!

messages.speaker: Pietru (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kellna taqwil fit-tul dwar il-vaganzi.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kellna taqwil fit-tul dwar il-vaganzi.
messages.zh: 是啊，我们聊假期聊了很久。
messages.en: Yes, we had a lengthy conversation about the holidays.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 taqwil 配上一张两人面对面聊天的图，再补上“朋友之间”“聊了很久”，用完整交谈场景记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action of rising or getting to one's feet.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体起身或站起来的动作，尤其指从坐着等姿势转为站立。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li wieħed iqum jew jiġi fuq saqajh.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 起身；起立的动作
站起身来；由原来的姿势转为站立

formal.mt: Waqt id-dimostrazzjoni, l-għalliem qasam il-moviment f'żewġ partijiet: it-taqwim minn fuq is-siġġu u l-mixi lejn il-bieb.
formal.en: During the demonstration, the teacher divided the movement into two parts: rising from the chair and walking toward the door.
formal.zh: 示范时，老师把动作分成两部分：从椅子上起身，以及走向门口。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Liema parti tax-xena se nerġgħu nippruvaw? David: It-taqwim minn fuq is-siġġu. Din id-darba qum bil-mod.
colloquial.en: Lina: Which part of the scene are we going to rehearse again? David: Getting up from the chair. This time, stand up slowly.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：这场戏我们要重练哪一部分？戴维：从椅子上起身的部分。这次慢慢站起来。

messages.speaker: Lina (演员)
messages.mt_spoken: Liema parti tax-xena se nerġgħu nippruvaw?
messages.mt_standard: Liema parti tax-xena se nerġgħu nippruvaw?
messages.zh: 这场戏我们要重练哪一部分？
messages.en: Which part of the scene are we going to rehearse again?

messages.speaker: David (导演)
messages.mt_spoken: It-taqwim minn fuq is-siġġu. Din id-darba qum bil-mod.
messages.mt_standard: It-taqwim minn fuq is-siġġu. Din id-darba qum bil-mod.
messages.zh: 从椅子上起身的部分。这次慢慢站起来。
messages.en: Getting up from the chair. This time, stand up slowly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象连续三格画面：坐在椅上、身体抬起、双脚站稳。用中间的起身过程记住名词 taqwim。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of shaping something into a spherical form.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某物加工或塑造成球形的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih xi ħaġa tingħata forma ta' sfera.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 将某物做成球形；此处作为名词表示这种加工过程。

formal.mt: It-taqwir tat-tafal għandu jsir b'attenzjoni biex tinkiseb forma ta' sfera.
formal.en: The clay should be shaped carefully to obtain a spherical form.
formal.zh: 应仔细进行黏土的球形塑造，以得到球体形状。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed iddawwar it-tafal bejn idejk? Pawlu: Qed nagħmel it-taqwir biex nagħtih forma ta' ballun.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you turning the clay between your hands? Pawlu: I'm shaping it into a sphere to give it the shape of a ball.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你为什么在两手之间转动黏土？Pawlu：我在把它塑成球形，让它变成一个球。

messages.speaker: Maja (手工课同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed iddawwar it-tafal bejn idejk?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed iddawwar it-tafal bejn idejk?
messages.zh: 你为什么在两手之间转动黏土？
messages.en: Why are you turning the clay between your hands?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (手工课同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed nagħmel it-taqwir biex nagħtih forma ta' ballun.
messages.mt_standard: Qed nagħmel it-taqwir biex nagħtih forma ta' ballun.
messages.zh: 我在把它塑成球形，让它变成一个球。
messages.en: I'm shaping it into a sphere to give it the shape of a ball.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象双手把黏土搓成小球，把 taqwir 与“做成球形的过程”一起记；这里用名词表达一个动作过程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of shooting arrows with a bow.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使用弓把箭射出的活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-attività li fiha wieħed jispara l-vleġeġ permezz ta' qaws.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用弓射箭的活动或动作。

formal.mt: Waqt it-taħriġ fit-taqwis, il-parteċipanti għandhom isegwu l-istruzzjonijiet tal-għalliem.
formal.en: During archery training, participants should follow the instructor's directions.
formal.zh: 参加射箭训练时，学员应遵循教练的指示。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'se tagħmel is-Sibt? Mark: Għandi taħriġ fit-taqwis; se nipprattika bil-qaws u l-vleġeġ.
colloquial.en: Lara: What are you doing on Saturday? Mark: I have archery training; I'll practise with a bow and arrows.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你星期六要做什么？Mark：我有射箭训练，要练习用弓射箭。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你星期六要做什么？
messages.en: What are you doing on Saturday?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi taħriġ fit-taqwis; se nipprattika bil-qaws u l-vleġeġ.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi taħriġ fit-taqwis; se nipprattika bil-qaws u l-vleġeġ.
messages.zh: 我有射箭训练，要练习用弓射箭。
messages.en: I have archery training; I'll practise with a bow and arrows.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在脑中连起“拉弓、放箭、命中靶子”三个画面，用 taqwis 统称射箭这项活动，记住它是名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of removing hair by shaving.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过剃刮去除毛发的动作，例如剃须。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li jitneħħa x-xagħar jew il-leħja permezz ta' leħja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 剃刮毛发的动作；剃须。

formal.mt: Wara t-taqxir tal-leħja, Mark naddaf wiċċu u l-għodda li uża.
formal.en: After shaving his beard, Mark cleaned his face and the tools he had used.
formal.zh: 剃完胡须后，Mark 清洁了脸部和用过的工具。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Lest biex noħorġu? Mark: Għadni ma spiċċajtx it-taqxir tal-leħja; agħtini żewġ minuti.
colloquial.en: Anna: Are you ready to go out? Mark: I haven't finished shaving my beard yet; give me two minutes.
colloquial.zh: Anna：准备好出门了吗？Mark：我还没剃完胡须，再给我两分钟。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 准备好出门了吗？
messages.en: Are you ready to go out?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadni ma spiċċajtx it-taqxir tal-leħja; agħtini żewġ minuti.
messages.mt_standard: Għadni ma spiċċajtx it-taqxir tal-leħja; agħtini żewġ minuti.
messages.zh: 我还没剃完胡须，再给我两分钟。
messages.en: I haven't finished shaving my beard yet; give me two minutes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象镜子前用剃刀刮去胡须的场景，把 taqxir 记成“剃刮这一动作”，不要把它记成剃刀这个工具。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action of chopping something off or severing a part with cutting blows.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用砍切的动作把某物或其一部分截断、砍掉。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li taqta' u tneħħi xi parti b'daqqiet ta' għodda li taqta'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 砍掉；用砍切的方式将某部分截断并除去。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport dwar il-ġnien isemmi t-taqċit tal-friegħi niexfa li kienu qed jagħlqu l-mogħdija.
formal.en: The garden report mentions the chopping off of dry branches that were blocking the path.
formal.zh: 花园报告提到，挡住小路的干树枝已被砍掉。

colloquial.mt: Rita: X'inhu dak il-ħoss fil-ġnien? Toni: It-taqċit tal-friegħi niexfa. Il-ġardinar qed ineħħihom.
colloquial.en: Rita: What's that noise in the garden? Toni: The chopping off of dry branches. The gardener is removing them.
colloquial.zh: Rita：花园里是什么声音？Toni：是砍干树枝的声音，园丁正在把它们清掉。

messages.speaker: Rita (住户)
messages.zh: 花园里是什么声音？
messages.en: What's that noise in the garden?

messages.speaker: Toni (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: It-taqċit tal-friegħi niexfa. Il-ġardinar qed ineħħihom.
messages.mt_standard: It-taqċit tal-friegħi niexfa. Il-ġardinar qed ineħħihom.
messages.zh: 是砍干树枝的声音，园丁正在把它们清掉。
messages.en: The chopping off of dry branches. The gardener is removing them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 taqċit 时想象一段枯枝被砍断后落地，重点记住砍切后某一部分被除去的结果。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of providing sexual services in exchange for payment; prostitution.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以获取报酬为交换而提供性服务的活动，即卖淫。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-attività li persuna tipprovdi servizzi sesswali bi ħlas; il-prostituzzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 卖淫；带贬义地指从事卖淫活动。
卖淫；以报酬为交换提供性服务的活动。

formal.mt: L-istudju jiddiskuti t-taqħib u l-kundizzjonijiet soċjali marbuta miegħu.
formal.en: The study discusses prostitution and the social conditions associated with it.
formal.zh: 该研究讨论卖淫活动及其相关的社会条件。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser 'taqħib' f'dan it-test? Mark: Hawnhekk ifisser prostituzzjoni, jiġifieri servizzi sesswali bi ħlas.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'taqħib' mean in this text? Mark: Here it means prostitution, that is, sexual services provided for payment.
colloquial.zh: 马娅：这篇文章里的 taqħib 是什么意思？马克：这里指卖淫，也就是有偿提供性服务。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这篇文章里的 taqħib 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'taqħib' mean in this text?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawnhekk ifisser prostituzzjoni, jiġifieri servizzi sesswali bi ħlas.
messages.mt_standard: Hawnhekk ifisser prostituzzjoni, jiġifieri servizzi sesswali bi ħlas.
messages.zh: 这里指卖淫，也就是有偿提供性服务。
messages.en: Here it means prostitution, that is, sexual services provided for payment.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 taqħib 与释义词 prostituzzjoni 配对记忆，再用“有偿性服务”这一概念检查理解。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A process or situation that results in something being in short supply.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某种物品或资源供应不足的过程或状况。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Proċess jew sitwazzjoni li twassal għal nuqqas fil-provvista ta' xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 导致供应不足或资源短缺的过程或状况。

collocations.en: a shortfall in the water supply
a shortfall in the food supply

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi t-taqħit fil-provvista tal-ilma wara diversi ġimgħat mingħajr xita.
formal.en: The report describes the shortfall in the water supply after several weeks without rain.
formal.zh: 报告描述了连续数周无雨后出现的供水短缺。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex illum ma wasalx l-ikel kollu? Pawlu: Hemm taqħit fil-provvista; waslet biss nofs l-ordni.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why didn't all the food arrive today? Pawlu: There's a supply shortfall; only half the order arrived.
colloquial.zh: Marija：今天的食物为什么没到齐？Pawlu：供应出现短缺，只送来了订单的一半。

messages.speaker: Marija (食堂主管)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex illum ma wasalx l-ikel kollu?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex illum ma wasalx l-ikel kollu?
messages.zh: 今天的食物为什么没到齐？
messages.en: Why didn't all the food arrive today?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (收货员)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm taqħit fil-provvista; waslet biss nofs l-ordni.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm taqħit fil-provvista; waslet biss nofs l-ordni.
messages.zh: 供应出现短缺，只送来了订单的一半。
messages.en: There's a supply shortfall; only half the order arrived.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 taqħit 配上“订单只到一半”的画面，记住它指向供应不足的形成。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A strong feeling of disgust or revulsion toward something unpleasant.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 面对令人不快的事物时产生的强烈厌恶或恶心感。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sens qawwi ta' stmerrija jew ripugnanza quddiem xi ħaġa li ddejjaq ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 厌恶、反感或恶心的感受。

formal.mt: Id-deskrizzjoni tal-ikel imħassar qanqlet sens ta' taqżiż fost il-qarrejja.
formal.en: The description of the spoiled food aroused a feeling of disgust among the readers.
formal.zh: 对变质食物的描写使读者产生了厌恶感。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex għalaqt il-kaxxa daqshekk malajr? Luqa: L-ikel imħassar fiha qajjimli sens ta' taqżiż.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why did you close the box so quickly? Luqa: The spoiled food inside gave me a feeling of disgust.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你为什么这么快就把盒子关上了？Luqa：里面变质的食物让我觉得恶心。

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.zh: 你为什么这么快就把盒子关上了？
messages.en: Why did you close the box so quickly?

messages.speaker: Luqa (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: L-ikel imħassar fiha qajjimli sens ta' taqżiż.
messages.mt_standard: L-ikel imħassar fiha qajjimli sens ta' taqżiż.
messages.zh: 里面变质的食物让我觉得恶心。
messages.en: The spoiled food inside gave me a feeling of disgust.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象打开变质食物盒后立刻皱眉的表情，把 taqżiż 与心里的厌恶感相连；记的是感受本身。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be strengthened; in a separate sense, to be fertile or capable of producing offspring.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 得到增强、变得强健；另一个独立义项是具有生育或繁殖能力。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jissaħħaħ; f'sens ieħor, ikun fertili jew kapaċi jnissel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 得到增强；变得更强健或更有力量。
具有生育力或繁殖力；能够繁衍。

collocations.en: 'tara' in the sense of being strengthened
'tara' in the sense of being fecund
collocations.zh: 表示“具有繁殖力”的 tara

formal.mt: F'din il-lezzjoni, il-verb 'tara' għandu żewġ tifsiriet distinti: jissaħħaħ u jkun fertili.
formal.en: In this lesson, the verb 'tara' has two distinct meanings: to be strengthened and to be fecund.
formal.zh: 在本课中，动词 tara 有两个独立义项：得到增强，以及具有繁殖力。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Hawnhekk 'tara' jfisser li xi ħadd jissaħħaħ? Għalliem Borg: Iva. Żomm dik it-tifsira separata mis-sens l-ieħor, li jkun fertili.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does 'tara' here mean that someone is strengthened? Teacher Borg: Yes. Keep that meaning separate from the other sense, being fecund.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这里的 tara 是指某人得到增强吗？Borg 老师：是的。要把这个意思与另一个“具有繁殖力”的义项分开记。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawnhekk 'tara' jfisser li xi ħadd jissaħħaħ?
messages.mt_standard: Hawnhekk 'tara' jfisser li xi ħadd jissaħħaħ?
messages.zh: 这里的 tara 是指某人得到增强吗？
messages.en: Does 'tara' here mean that someone is strengthened?

messages.speaker: Borg (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva. Żomm dik it-tifsira separata mis-sens l-ieħor, li jkun fertili.
messages.mt_standard: Iva. Żomm dik it-tifsira separata mis-sens l-ieħor, li jkun fertili.
messages.zh: 是的。要把这个意思与另一个“具有繁殖力”的义项分开记。
messages.en: Yes. Keep that meaning separate from the other sense, being fecund.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 tara 做两张独立记忆卡：一张画逐渐强健的身体，另一张画繁衍的生命，分别记住“增强”和“繁殖力”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To chase someone or something, to follow them, or to run after them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 追赶某人或某物，也可表示跟随或在后面追着跑。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġri wara xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa, jew isegwihom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 追赶；追逐某人或某物。
跟随；沿着某人或某物的行进方向在后面前进。
追着跑；跑在某人或某物后面试图赶上。

formal.mt: Il-kelb tarad il-qattus sal-bieb tal-ġnien.
formal.en: The dog chased the cat as far as the garden gate.
formal.zh: 那只狗追着猫，一直追到花园门口。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex il-kelb jinsab ħdejn il-bieb? Toni: Tarad il-qattus sal-bieb, imma issa waqaf.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why is the dog by the gate? Toni: He chased the cat to the gate, but he's stopped now.
colloquial.zh: Sara：狗为什么在门旁边？Toni：它追着猫跑到了门口，不过现在已经停下了。

messages.speaker: Sara (邻居)
messages.zh: 狗为什么在门旁边？
messages.en: Why is the dog by the gate?

messages.speaker: Toni (狗主人)
messages.mt_spoken: Tarad il-qattus sal-bieb, imma issa waqaf.
messages.mt_standard: Tarad il-qattus sal-bieb, imma issa waqaf.
messages.zh: 它追着猫跑到了门口，不过现在已经停下了。
messages.en: He chased the cat to the gate, but he's stopped now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tarad 配上前后两个人移动的画面：可以是一般跟随，也可以是加速追赶；“追着跑”再加上奔跑动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To sweep lightly, using a gentle sweeping motion.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用轻柔的扫动动作清扫；轻轻扫过。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiknes b'moviment ħafif u ġentili.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 轻轻地扫；以轻柔的动作清扫。

collocations.en: swept lightly with a soft brush

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem tarax it-trab minn fuq l-ixkaffa b'pinzell artab.
formal.en: The worker lightly swept the dust off the shelf with a soft brush.
formal.zh: 工人用软刷轻轻扫去了架子上的灰尘。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif neħħa t-trab minn fuq l-ixkaffa? Mark: Tarax it-trab b'pinzell artab, b'movimenti ħfief.
colloquial.en: Lara: How did he remove the dust from the shelf? Mark: He swept it away with a soft brush, using light movements.
colloquial.zh: Lara：他是怎么清除架子上的灰尘的？Mark：他用软刷轻轻地把灰尘扫掉了。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif neħħa t-trab minn fuq l-ixkaffa?
messages.mt_standard: Kif neħħa t-trab minn fuq l-ixkaffa?
messages.zh: 他是怎么清除架子上的灰尘的？
messages.en: How did he remove the dust from the shelf?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Tarax it-trab b'pinzell artab, b'movimenti ħfief.
messages.mt_standard: Tarax it-trab b'pinzell artab, b'movimenti ħfief.
messages.zh: 他用软刷轻轻地把灰尘扫掉了。
messages.en: He swept it away with a soft brush, using light movements.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一把软刷轻轻掠过架子上的薄灰，把 tarax 的“扫”与“动作轻柔”一起记住，突出用力很轻。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cause dropsy in someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 导致某人发生水肿；使某人患水肿。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jikkawża l-idropsija lil xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 引起水肿；使发生水肿。

collocations.en: 'tarbaċ' in its sense of causing a condition
collocations.zh: 表示导致病症发生的 tarbaċ

formal.mt: Il-verb 'tarbaċ' ifisser li xi ħaġa tikkawża l-idropsija lil xi ħadd.
formal.en: The verb 'tarbaċ' means that something causes dropsy in someone.
formal.zh: 动词 tarbaċ 表示某种事物导致某人发生水肿。

colloquial.mt: Nina: 'Tarbaċ' ifisser li xi ħadd għandu l-idropsija? Għalliem Borg: Ifisser li xi ħaġa tikkawża l-idropsija lil xi ħadd; il-verb jesprimi l-kawża.
colloquial.en: Nina: Does 'tarbaċ' mean that someone has dropsy? Teacher Borg: It means that something causes dropsy in someone; the verb expresses causation.
colloquial.zh: Nina：tarbaċ 是说某人患有水肿吗？Borg 老师：它表示某种事物使某人发生水肿；这个动词表达的是致病作用。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: 'Tarbaċ' ifisser li xi ħadd għandu l-idropsija?
messages.mt_standard: 'Tarbaċ' ifisser li xi ħadd għandu l-idropsija?
messages.zh: tarbaċ 是说某人患有水肿吗？
messages.en: Does 'tarbaċ' mean that someone has dropsy?

messages.speaker: Borg (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li xi ħaġa tikkawża l-idropsija lil xi ħadd; il-verb jesprimi l-kawża.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li xi ħaġa tikkawża l-idropsija lil xi ħadd; il-verb jesprimi l-kawża.
messages.zh: 它表示某种事物使某人发生水肿；这个动词表达的是致病作用。
messages.en: It means that something causes dropsy in someone; the verb expresses causation.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一条从“某种原因”指向“发生水肿”的箭头，把 tarbaċ 记在箭头上，帮助记住它表达“引起水肿”的致使意义。

gloss_zh: 水肿病；伴水肿的感染病症

teaching_sense.en_definition: An illness described as infection with dropsy, involving swelling from retained fluid.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指词条中所说的伴水肿的感染病症；水肿表现为体液积聚引起的肿胀。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Marda deskritta bħala infezzjoni bid-dropsija, b'nefħa minħabba fluwidu li jinġabar fil-ġisem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 伴水肿的感染病症；水肿病

formal.mt: Fl-eżerċizzju tal-qari, l-istudenti għandhom jidentifikaw it-tarbiċ bħala l-marda msemmija fit-test.
formal.en: In the reading exercise, students should identify tarbiċ as the illness mentioned in the text.
formal.zh: 在阅读练习中，学生应认出 tarbiċ 是文中提到的病症。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser 'tarbiċ' f'dan l-eżerċizzju? Pawlu: Hawn tfisser marda deskritta bħala infezzjoni bid-dropsija.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'tarbiċ' mean in this exercise? Pawlu: Here it means an illness described as infection with dropsy.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这道练习里的 tarbiċ 是什么意思？保罗：这里指词条所说的伴水肿的感染病症。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这道练习里的 tarbiċ 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'tarbiċ' mean in this exercise?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn tfisser marda deskritta bħala infezzjoni bid-dropsija.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn tfisser marda deskritta bħala infezzjoni bid-dropsija.
messages.zh: 这里指词条所说的伴水肿的感染病症。
messages.en: Here it means an illness described as infection with dropsy.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tarbiċ 放进阅读词卡，旁边画出肿胀的脚踝，帮助记住它与水肿病症有关；这只是记忆画面，不是诊断方法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A fez or tarboosh: a brimless hat typically shaped like a short cylinder, often with a tassel.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种无帽檐、通常呈矮圆筒形且常带流苏的帽子，称为费兹帽或塔尔布什帽。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kappell mingħajr xifer, ġeneralment f'għamla ta' ċilindru qasir u spiss b'ġummiena.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 费兹帽；塔尔布什帽

formal.mt: Fir-ritratt tal-wirja, ir-raġel liebes tarbux aħmar b'ġummiena sewda.
formal.en: In the exhibition photograph, the man is wearing a red fez with a black tassel.
formal.zh: 在展览的照片中，那名男子戴着一顶带黑色流苏的红色费兹帽。

colloquial.mt: Mark: X'jismu dak il-kappell aħmar? Sara: Dak tarbux; ara l-ġummiena sewda tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Mark: What is that red hat called? Sara: That's a fez; look at its black tassel.
colloquial.zh: 马克：那顶红帽子叫什么？萨拉：那是费兹帽，你看它的黑色流苏。

messages.speaker: Mark (游客)
messages.zh: 那顶红帽子叫什么？
messages.en: What is that red hat called?

messages.speaker: Sara (导览员)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak tarbux; ara l-ġummiena sewda tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Dak tarbux; ara l-ġummiena sewda tiegħu.
messages.zh: 那是费兹帽，你看它的黑色流苏。
messages.en: That's a fez; look at its black tassel.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 tarbux 就想象一顶没有帽檐的红色小圆筒帽，帽顶垂下一条流苏，用鲜明外形记住帽子名称。

gloss_zh: 智力障碍的（用于指人时带有贬损意味，应谨慎识别）

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing someone as intellectually disabled; this wording can be derogatory and should be treated cautiously when referring to people.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于形容有智力障碍的人；这种用语可能带有贬损意味，学习时应理解其含义并留意对人的称呼。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jiddeskrivi persuna b'diżabilità intellettwali; dan il-kliem jista' jkun dispreġġjattiv meta jintuża għal persuna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 智力迟滞的；有智力障碍的（前一种表述陈旧且可能带有贬损意味）

collocations.zh: 形容词 tardiv 的使用

formal.mt: Fl-analiżi tat-test, l-aġġettiv 'tardiv' għandu jiġi spjegat flimkien mal-effett dispreġġjattiv li jista' jkollu.
formal.en: In the textual analysis, the adjective 'tardiv' should be explained together with its potentially derogatory effect.
formal.zh: 分析文本时，应在解释形容词 tardiv 的同时说明它可能带有贬损意味。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Nista' nuża 'tardiv' biex niddeskrivi persuna? Pawlu: Aħjar tgħid 'persuna b'diżabilità intellettwali'; 'tardiv' jista' jweġġa'.
colloquial.en: Nina: Can I use 'tardiv' to describe a person? Pawlu: It's better to say 'a person with an intellectual disability'; 'tardiv' can be hurtful.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我可以用 tardiv 来形容一个人吗？保罗：最好说“有智力障碍的人”；tardiv 可能伤害对方。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: 我可以用 tardiv 来形容一个人吗？
messages.en: Can I use 'tardiv' to describe a person?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Aħjar tgħid 'persuna b'diżabilità intellettwali'; 'tardiv' jista' jweġġa'.
messages.mt_standard: Aħjar tgħid 'persuna b'diżabilità intellettwali'; 'tardiv' jista' jweġġa'.
messages.zh: 最好说“有智力障碍的人”；tardiv 可能伤害对方。
messages.en: It's better to say 'a person with an intellectual disability'; 'tardiv' can be hurtful.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 tardiv 的词卡加一个“称呼要尊重”的提醒框：理解文本中的智力障碍含义，同时记住谈论他人时选择尊重的表达。

gloss_zh: 极端的；处于边缘的；最末的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Situated at an outer edge or extreme end, including the very last position in an arrangement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 处在外缘或极端位置的，也可指排列中最末端、最后的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jinsab fit-tarf jew f'pożizzjoni estrema, jew li jkun l-aħħar wieħed f'ordni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 极端的；位于极端位置的
处于边缘的；位于外缘的
最末的；最后的

formal.mt: Fil-pjanta tas-sala, is-sit tarfi ta' kull ringiela jinsab ħdejn il-korsija.
formal.en: On the hall plan, the end seat of each row is next to the aisle.
formal.zh: 在大厅平面图上，每排最边上的座位都紧挨过道。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn trid toqgħod? Mark: Fuq is-sit tarfi, ħdejn il-korsija.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where do you want to sit? Mark: In the end seat, next to the aisle.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你想坐在哪里？马克：坐最边上的座位，挨着过道。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你想坐在哪里？
messages.en: Where do you want to sit?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 坐最边上的座位，挨着过道。
messages.en: In the end seat, next to the aisle.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一排座位，把最外侧的一张圈起来并标上 tarfi：从“边缘位置”联想到“极端位置”和“最末一个”，连起三个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Very soft or tender in texture, yielding easily when touched or pressed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 质地非常柔软、软嫩的，轻触或按压时容易变形。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Artab ħafna jew teneru ħafna, b'tessut li jċedi faċilment meta tmissu jew tagħfas fuqu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 非常柔软的；软绵绵的

formal.mt: Il-ħobż deskritt fir-riċetta għandu jkun tari baqta minn ġewwa u jkollu qoxra rqiqa.
formal.en: The bread described in the recipe should be very soft inside and have a thin crust.
formal.zh: 食谱中描述的面包应当内部非常松软，外皮较薄。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif inhu l-ħobż illum? Mark: Tari baqta! Aqta' biċċa u duqu.
colloquial.en: Sara: What's the bread like today? Mark: Very soft! Cut a piece and taste it.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：今天的面包怎么样？马克：软绵绵的！切一块尝尝。

messages.speaker: Sara (顾客)
messages.zh: 今天的面包怎么样？
messages.en: What's the bread like today?

messages.speaker: Mark (面包师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tari baqta! Aqta' biċċa u duqu.
messages.mt_standard: Tari baqta! Aqta' biċċa u duqu.
messages.zh: 软绵绵的！切一块尝尝。
messages.en: Very soft! Cut a piece and taste it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tari baqta 整体记成“手指轻按，面包就凹下去”的触感画面；它强调非常柔软，学习时不要拆词猜词源。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The tenderness of meat: the quality of being soft and easy to bite or chew.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指肉质的软嫩程度，即肉容易咬开、咀嚼的性质。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kwalità tal-laħam li jkun teneru, artab u faċli biex tigdem u tomgħod.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 嫩度；软嫩程度（用于肉质）

formal.mt: Fir-rapport tat-togħma, it-tarizza tal-laħam ġiet evalwata flimkien mat-togħma u l-aroma tiegħu.
formal.en: In the tasting report, the tenderness of the meat was assessed alongside its flavour and aroma.
formal.zh: 在品尝报告中，肉的嫩度与其味道和香气一起接受了评价。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'għoġbok l-aktar f'dan il-laħam? Toni: It-tarizza tiegħu; faċli ħafna tomogħdu.
colloquial.en: Lara: What did you like most about this meat? Toni: Its tenderness; it's very easy to chew.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这道肉你最喜欢哪一点？托尼：它的软嫩口感，嚼起来特别轻松。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 这道肉你最喜欢哪一点？
messages.en: What did you like most about this meat?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 它的软嫩口感，嚼起来特别轻松。
messages.en: Its tenderness; it's very easy to chew.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tarizza 写在一块容易咬开的嫩肉旁边，记成“肉的嫩度”这个名词；本词条说的是肉质，别联想到性格温柔。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Pasta in thin noodle-like strands, suitable for dishes such as soup.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 呈细长面条状的意面，可用于汤等菜肴。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għaġin f'ħjut irqaq li jista' jintuża, pereżempju, fis-soppa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 细面条；细条状意面

formal.mt: Żid it-tarja mal-brodu jagħli u kompli sajjar sakemm tkun lesta.
formal.en: Add the thin pasta noodles to the boiling broth and continue cooking until they are done.
formal.zh: 将细面条加入沸腾的高汤中，继续煮至熟透。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'se nżidu mas-soppa? Rita: Ftit tarja; żidha meta l-brodu jibda jagħli.
colloquial.en: Maja: What shall we add to the soup? Rita: Some thin pasta noodles; add them when the broth starts boiling.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们往汤里加什么？丽塔：加一点细面条，等高汤开始沸腾时放进去。

messages.speaker: Maja (女儿)
messages.zh: 我们往汤里加什么？
messages.en: What shall we add to the soup?

messages.speaker: Rita (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Ftit tarja; żidha meta l-brodu jibda jagħli.
messages.mt_standard: Ftit tarja; żidha meta l-brodu jibda jagħli.
messages.zh: 加一点细面条，等高汤开始沸腾时放进去。
messages.en: Some thin pasta noodles; add them when the broth starts boiling.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 tarja 就想象清汤里漂着一缕缕细面条，把“细长的形状”和“一碗面汤”一起记住，帮助区别于其他形状的意面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A hard road or ground surface made with tarmac.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用柏油或沥青材料铺成的坚硬路面或地面。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Wiċċ iebes ta' triq jew art miksi b'materjal asfaltat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 柏油路面；沥青铺面。

formal.mt: Wara t-tiswijiet, il-ħaddiema poġġew saff ġdid ta' tarmak fuq it-triq.
formal.en: After the repairs, the workers laid a new layer of tarmac on the road.
formal.zh: 维修完成后，工人在道路上铺了一层新的柏油。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ma nistgħux ngħaddu minn hawn? Mark: Għadhom kemm poġġew it-tarmak; ejja ngħaddu mit-triq l-oħra.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why can't we go through here? Mark: They've just laid the tarmac; let's take the other road.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：为什么这里不能通行？马克：他们刚铺了柏油；我们走另一条路吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (行人)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ma nistgħux ngħaddu minn hawn?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ma nistgħux ngħaddu minn hawn?
messages.zh: 为什么这里不能通行？
messages.en: Why can't we go through here?

messages.speaker: Mark (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadhom kemm poġġew it-tarmak; ejja ngħaddu mit-triq l-oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Għadhom kemm poġġew it-tarmak; ejja ngħaddu mit-triq l-oħra.
messages.zh: 他们刚铺了柏油；我们走另一条路吧。
messages.en: They've just laid the tarmac; let's take the other road.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tarmak 和道路上新铺的黑色柏油画面一起记，搭配 saff ta' tarmak 表示一层柏油。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To lay eggs; in a separate sense, to incite someone to act.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指动物产卵；另一个独立义项是煽动、怂恿他人采取行动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bied il-bajd; f'tifsira oħra, ħeġġeġ lil xi ħadd biex jagħmel xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 产卵；下蛋。
煽动；怂恿他人采取行动。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, ir-raġel tarr lin-nies kontra l-ġar tiegħu billi xerred xnigħat foloz.
formal.en: In the story, the man incited people against his neighbour by spreading false rumours.
formal.zh: 故事中，那名男子散布虚假传言，煽动人们反对他的邻居。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser tarr meta nkunu qed nitkellmu fuq it-tiġieġ? Pawlu: Ifisser bied il-bajd; hawnhekk ma jfissirx ħeġġeġ lil xi ħadd.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does tarr mean when we're talking about chickens? Pawlu: It means to lay eggs; here it doesn't mean to incite someone.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：谈到鸡的时候，tarr 是什么意思？保罗：意思是下蛋；在这里不是煽动某人的意思。

messages.speaker: Maja (马耳他语学习者)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi jfisser tarr meta nkunu qed nitkellmu fuq it-tiġieġ?
messages.mt_standard: Xi jfisser tarr meta nkunu qed nitkellmu fuq it-tiġieġ?
messages.zh: 谈到鸡的时候，tarr 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does tarr mean when we're talking about chickens?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (语言学习伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser bied il-bajd; hawnhekk ma jfissirx ħeġġeġ lil xi ħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser bied il-bajd; hawnhekk ma jfissirx ħeġġeġ lil xi ħadd.
messages.zh: 意思是下蛋；在这里不是煽动某人的意思。
messages.en: It means to lay eggs; here it doesn't mean to incite someone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 tarr 分别配上鸡窝和鼓动人群两幅图：看到 bajd 想产卵，看到人群与对立对象想煽动。

gloss_zh: 使肉变嫩；挖掘使水涌出

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make meat tender; in a separate sense, to dig so that water can rise to the surface.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使肉质变嫩；另一个独立义项是挖掘地面，使水能够升至地表。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għamel il-laħam aktar artab; f'tifsira oħra, ħaffer biex l-ilma jkun jista' jitla' fil-wiċċ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使变嫩、变软，通常指肉。

sense_translations.en_definition: to dig to allow water to rise to the surface
sense_translations.zh_definition: 挖掘以使水升至地表。

collocations.en: to dig the ground to allow water to rise

formal.mt: Il-kok tarra l-laħam bil-martell tal-laħam qabel ma sajru.
formal.en: The cook tenderised the meat with a meat mallet before cooking it.
formal.zh: 厨师在烹调之前，用肉锤把肉敲嫩。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif għamiltu daqshekk artab dan il-laħam? Mark: Il-kok tarra l-laħam bil-martell qabel sajru.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did you get this meat so tender? Mark: The cook tenderised it with a mallet before cooking it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你们怎么把这肉做得这么嫩？马克：厨师烹调前用锤子把肉敲嫩了。

messages.speaker: Maja (食客)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif għamiltu daqshekk artab dan il-laħam?
messages.mt_standard: Kif għamiltu daqshekk artab dan il-laħam?
messages.zh: 你们怎么把这肉做得这么嫩？
messages.en: How did you get this meat so tender?

messages.speaker: Mark (服务员)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kok tarra l-laħam bil-martell qabel sajru.
messages.mt_standard: Il-kok tarra l-laħam bil-martell qabel sajru.
messages.zh: 厨师烹调前用锤子把肉敲嫩了。
messages.en: The cook tenderised it with a mallet before cooking it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tarra 记成两个操作场景：厨房里敲嫩肉，地面上挖到水涌出；用宾语帮助区分义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cover something with dust or make it dusty.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使物体表面覆上灰尘，变得满是尘土。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kesa xi ħaġa bit-trab jew għamilha mimlija trab.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使覆上灰尘；使蒙尘。

collocations.en: to cover the car with dust
to cover the furniture with dust

formal.mt: Ix-xogħol ta' kostruzzjoni tarrab l-għamara fil-kamra ta' ħdejh.
formal.en: The construction work covered the furniture in the adjacent room with dust.
formal.zh: 施工使隔壁房间的家具覆上了灰尘。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex il-karozza mimlija trab? Mark: Ir-riħ tarrab il-karozza kollha; għadni kemm ħsiltha lbieraħ!
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is the car covered in dust? Mark: The wind covered the whole car with dust; I only washed it yesterday!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：车上怎么全是灰尘？马克：风把整辆车都吹得蒙了尘；我昨天才洗过！

messages.speaker: Maja (车主的朋友)
messages.zh: 车上怎么全是灰尘？
messages.en: Why is the car covered in dust?

messages.speaker: Mark (车主)
messages.mt_spoken: Ir-riħ tarrab il-karozza kollha; għadni kemm ħsiltha lbieraħ!
messages.mt_standard: Ir-riħ tarrab il-karozza kollha; għadni kemm ħsiltha lbieraħ!
messages.zh: 风把整辆车都吹得蒙了尘；我昨天才洗过！
messages.en: The wind covered the whole car with dust; I only washed it yesterday!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象刚洗好的汽车被风吹得满身灰，用 tarrab il-karozza 整组记住使某物蒙尘的动作。

gloss_zh: 紧跟不放的人；纠缠着跟随他人的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who persistently follows another person.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 持续跟随另一个人、紧跟不放的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tibqa' timxi wara persuna oħra b'mod persistenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 持续跟随别人、紧跟不放的人。

collocations.en: a persistent follower who will not leave you alone
collocations.zh: 紧跟着你、不肯让你独处的人

collocations.en: to get away from a persistent follower

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, it-tarrad baqa' jimxi wara l-protagonist minn triq għal oħra.
formal.en: In the story, the persistent follower kept following the protagonist from one street to another.
formal.zh: 故事中，那个紧跟不放的人一路跟着主人公，从一条街走到另一条街。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għadu ġej warajna dak ir-raġel? Mark: Iva, qisu tarrad; ejja nieqfu hawn ħdejn in-nies.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is that man still following us? Mark: Yes, he's like someone who won't stop following; let's stop here near the other people.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那个男人还在跟着我们吗？马克：是啊，像个紧跟不放的人；我们在人多的这里停一下吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (行人)
messages.zh: 那个男人还在跟着我们吗？
messages.en: Is that man still following us?

messages.speaker: Mark (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qisu tarrad; ejja nieqfu hawn ħdejn in-nies.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qisu tarrad; ejja nieqfu hawn ħdejn in-nies.
messages.zh: 是啊，像个紧跟不放的人；我们在人多的这里停一下吧。
messages.en: Yes, he's like someone who won't stop following; let's stop here near the other people.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 tarrad 配上走到哪儿都有人跟在后面的画面，记住这个名词指紧跟不放的人。

gloss_zh: 导致流放的；带有暗示的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Causing someone to be exiled; in a separate sense, containing a hint or indirect reference.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 导致某人被流放的；另一个独立义项是含有暗示或间接提及某事的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jwassal għall-eżilju; f'tifsira oħra, li fih ħjiel jew referenza indiretta għal xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 导致流放的；使人被放逐的。
涉及对某事的暗示的；带有含蓄提示的。

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, id-digriet tarrafi ġiegħel lill-karattru prinċipali jitlaq minn pajjiżu u jgħix fl-eżilju.
formal.en: In the novel, the decree causing exile forced the main character to leave his country and live in exile.
formal.zh: 小说中，那道导致流放的法令迫使主人公离开祖国，过起流亡生活。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Taħseb li kien qed jitkellem dwarna? Mark: Forsi. Kien kumment tarrafi; ma semma lil ħadd, imma ta ħjiel.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you think he was talking about us? Mark: Maybe. It was a hinting comment; he didn't name anyone, but he gave a hint.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你觉得他是在说我们吗？马克：也许。那句话带着暗示；他没点任何人的名字，但给了提示。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Taħseb li kien qed jitkellem dwarna?
messages.mt_standard: Taħseb li kien qed jitkellem dwarna?
messages.zh: 你觉得他是在说我们吗？
messages.en: Do you think he was talking about us?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Forsi. Kien kumment tarrafi; ma semma lil ħadd, imma ta ħjiel.
messages.mt_standard: Forsi. Kien kumment tarrafi; ma semma lil ħadd, imma ta ħjiel.
messages.zh: 也许。那句话带着暗示；他没点任何人的名字，但给了提示。
messages.en: Maybe. It was a hinting comment; he didn't name anyone, but he gave a hint.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tarrafi 的两义分卡记忆：法令让人离乡对应导致流放，评论话里有话对应带有暗示。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A craftsperson who makes shields.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 制作盾牌的工匠，指从事制盾工作的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna tas-sengħa li tagħmel it-tarki.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 盾牌制作匠；制作盾牌的人。

formal.mt: Għall-wirja, it-tarras għamel tars tal-injam u spjega lill-viżitaturi kif jinħadem.
formal.en: For the exhibition, the shieldmaker made a wooden shield and explained to visitors how it is made.
formal.zh: 为这次展览，制盾匠制作了一面木盾，并向参观者讲解盾牌的制作方法。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min għamel dan it-tars? Pawlu: Tarras tas-sengħa; għandu ħanut ħdejn il-pjazza.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who made this shield? Pawlu: A skilled shieldmaker; he has a workshop near the square.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这面盾牌是谁做的？保罗：一位手艺很好的制盾匠；他的作坊就在广场附近。

messages.speaker: Maja (参观者)
messages.zh: 这面盾牌是谁做的？
messages.en: Who made this shield?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (导览员)
messages.mt_spoken: Tarras tas-sengħa; għandu ħanut ħdejn il-pjazza.
messages.mt_standard: Tarras tas-sengħa; għandu ħanut ħdejn il-pjazza.
messages.zh: 一位手艺很好的制盾匠；他的作坊就在广场附近。
messages.en: A skilled shieldmaker; he has a workshop near the square.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tarras 和 tars 放进同一幅作坊画面：tarras 是制作的人，tars 是做出的盾牌。用人物与物品的对照记忆，不把这当作词源解释。

gloss_zh: 分成阶梯；修成梯田；形成渐变层次；楼梯建造者

teaching_sense.en_definition: To divide something into steps, shape land into terraces, or arrange something in gradual stages.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某物分成阶梯，把土地修成梯田，或使某物形成逐渐变化的层次。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qasam xi ħaġa fi skaluni, għamel l-art f'għelieqi mtarrġa, jew ħoloq gradi li jinbidlu ftit ftit.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把某物分成阶梯或台阶。
把土地修成梯田或阶地。
形成逐渐变化的层次；使呈现渐变等级。
建造楼梯的人；楼梯建造工匠。

collocations.mt: tarraġ il-kuluri minn ċar għal skur
collocations.en: to grade the colours from light to dark
collocations.zh: 使颜色从浅到深形成渐变

formal.mt: Il-bidwi tarraġ l-art fuq l-għolja biex joħloq għelieqi fuq livelli differenti.
formal.en: The farmer terraced the land on the hill to create fields at different levels.
formal.zh: 农民把山坡上的土地修成梯田，形成高低不同的田块。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min se jibni t-taraġ tad-dar? Mark: Sibt tarraġ tas-sengħa; ġej għada jieħu l-qisien.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who's going to build the stairs for the house? Mark: I found a skilled staircase builder; he's coming tomorrow to take measurements.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：谁来建房子的楼梯？马克：我找到了一位手艺好的楼梯工匠；他明天来量尺寸。

messages.speaker: Maja (屋主)
messages.zh: 谁来建房子的楼梯？
messages.en: Who's going to build the stairs for the house?

messages.speaker: Mark (共同屋主)
messages.mt_spoken: Sibt tarraġ tas-sengħa; ġej għada jieħu l-qisien.
messages.mt_standard: Sibt tarraġ tas-sengħa; ġej għada jieħu l-qisien.
messages.zh: 我找到了一位手艺好的楼梯工匠；他明天来量尺寸。
messages.en: I found a skilled staircase builder; he's coming tomorrow to take measurements.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用阶梯画面串记 tarraġ 的三个动词义：分台阶、修梯田、排渐变；另设人物卡记名词楼梯工匠。

gloss_zh: 由台阶构成的；阶梯式的；逐步的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Consisting of steps, or progressing through a sequence of distinct stages.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由台阶构成的，或按照一个个明确阶段逐步进行的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Magħmul minn skaluni, jew li jimxi minn stadju għal ieħor pass pass.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 由台阶构成的；呈阶梯结构的。
逐步的；按阶段进行的；阶梯式的。

formal.mt: Il-mudell għandu disinn tarraġi, b'kull livell ogħla minn dak ta' qablu.
formal.en: The model has a stepped design, with each level higher than the preceding one.
formal.zh: 这个模型采用阶梯式设计，每一级都比前一级高。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Irridu nagħmlu kollox f'daqqa? Mark: Le, dan hu proċess tarraġi; nibdew bl-ewwel stadju u mbagħad ngħaddu għat-tieni.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do we have to do everything at once? Mark: No, this is a stepwise process; we'll start with the first stage and then move on to the second.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们得一次把所有事都做完吗？马克：不用，这是逐步进行的；先做第一阶段，再进入第二阶段。

messages.speaker: Maja (学习小组成员)
messages.zh: 我们得一次把所有事都做完吗？
messages.en: Do we have to do everything at once?

messages.speaker: Mark (学习小组组长)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, dan hu proċess tarraġi; nibdew bl-ewwel stadju u mbagħad ngħaddu għat-tieni.
messages.mt_standard: Le, dan hu proċess tarraġi; nibdew bl-ewwel stadju u mbagħad ngħaddu għat-tieni.
messages.zh: 不用，这是逐步进行的；先做第一阶段，再进入第二阶段。
messages.en: No, this is a stepwise process; we'll start with the first stage and then move on to the second.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tarraġi 想成一幅阶梯图：描述形状时是由台阶构成，描述过程时是一级一级逐步推进。

gloss_zh: 使色彩斑斓；加上条纹；拓展并使之多样化的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: To give something varied colours or markings, or to mark it with stripes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使物体呈现不同的颜色或斑纹，也可指给物体加上条纹。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Żejjen xi ħaġa b'kuluri jew marki differenti, jew għamel strixxi fuqha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使呈现多种颜色或斑纹；使色彩斑斓。
给……加上条纹；使带有条纹。
拓展范围并使之多样化的人。

collocations.en: variegated the fabric with different colours
collocations.zh: 用不同颜色使布料呈现多彩效果

collocations.en: marked the paper with blue stripes

formal.mt: L-artist tarraż id-drapp b'kuluri differenti biex joħloq effett dekorattiv.
formal.en: The artist variegated the fabric with different colours to create a decorative effect.
formal.zh: 艺术家用不同颜色使布料呈现斑斓效果，以达到装饰目的。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min tarraż din il-karta bi strixxi blu? Mark: Jien; ridt nagħmel sfond għall-kartolina.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who put blue stripes on this paper? Mark: I did; I wanted to make a background for the greeting card.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：谁给这张纸画上了蓝色条纹？马克：是我；我想给贺卡做个背景。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Min tarraż din il-karta bi strixxi blu?
messages.mt_standard: Min tarraż din il-karta bi strixxi blu?
messages.zh: 谁给这张纸画上了蓝色条纹？
messages.en: Who put blue stripes on this paper?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 是我；我想给贺卡做个背景。
messages.en: I did; I wanted to make a background for the greeting card.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象美术课上的两步操作：先添多种颜色，再画一道道条纹，分别记住两个动词义。另给名词义单独做一张“拓展并丰富内容的人”卡片，避免混淆词性。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A protective object held in front of the body to block blows or projectiles.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 持在身体前方，用来挡住打击或投射物的防护器具，即盾牌。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Oġġett li jinżamm quddiem il-ġisem biex jilqa' d-daqqiet jew il-vleġeġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 盾牌；用于抵挡打击或投射物的防护器具。

formal.mt: Il-mużew juri tars tal-metall flimkien ma' tagħmir ieħor ta' protezzjoni.
formal.en: The museum displays a metal shield alongside other protective equipment.
formal.zh: 博物馆将一面金属盾牌与其他防护装备一同展出。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dan it-tars tqil? Toni: Iva, żommu biż-żewġ idejn.
colloquial.en: Nina: Is this shield heavy? Toni: Yes, hold it with both hands.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这面盾牌重吗？托尼：重，用双手拿住。

messages.speaker: Nina (参观者)
messages.zh: 这面盾牌重吗？
messages.en: Is this shield heavy?

messages.speaker: Toni (展览工作人员)
messages.zh: 重，用双手拿住。
messages.en: Yes, hold it with both hands.

cognitive_memory_aid: 读到 tars，就想象双手举起一面盾牌挡在身前。搭配 tal-injam 记木盾，搭配 tal-metall 记金属盾，把词义固定在具体物品上。

gloss_zh: 发出呼呼声；发出嗡嗡的运转声

teaching_sense.en_definition: To produce a continuous whirring sound, as a motor or rotating mechanism does.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 发出连续的呼呼声或嗡嗡声，例如马达或旋转机械运转时的声音。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għamel ħoss kontinwu bħal dak ta' mutur jew ta' mekkaniżmu li jdur.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 发出呼呼声或嗡嗡的旋转运转声。

formal.mt: Matul it-test, il-mutur tartar għal ftit sekondi qabel waqaf.
formal.en: During the test, the motor whirred for a few seconds before stopping.
formal.zh: 测试过程中，马达嗡嗡运转了几秒钟，随后停了下来。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Smajt dak il-ħoss? Ben: Iva, il-fann tartar għal mument meta xgħeltu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did you hear that sound? Ben: Yes, the fan whirred for a moment when I switched it on.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你听见那个声音了吗？本：听见了，我打开风扇时，它呼呼响了一会儿。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: 你听见那个声音了吗？
messages.en: Did you hear that sound?

messages.speaker: Ben (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-fann tartar għal mument meta xgħeltu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-fann tartar għal mument meta xgħeltu.
messages.zh: 听见了，我打开风扇时，它呼呼响了一会儿。
messages.en: Yes, the fan whirred for a moment when I switched it on.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tartar 配上“风扇转起来并发出呼呼声”的动作画面，记它是动词。再与 tartir 对照：前者说发声这件事，后者给这种声音命名。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A continuous whirring sound, such as the sound of a motor or rotating mechanism.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 连续的呼呼声或嗡嗡声，常用来描述马达或旋转机械运转时的声音。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħoss kontinwu bħal dak ta' mutur jew ta' mekkaniżmu li jdur.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 呼呼声；嗡嗡的旋转运转声。

formal.mt: It-tartir tal-mutur instema' fil-kamra kollha waqt l-esperiment.
