formal.en: The whirring of the motor could be heard throughout the room during the experiment.
formal.zh: 实验过程中，整个房间都能听见马达的嗡嗡运转声。

colloquial.mt: Anna: X'inhu dak it-tartir? Luqa: Il-fann; għadu mixgħul.
colloquial.en: Anna: What is that whirring sound? Luqa: The fan; it is still on.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：那是什么呼呼声？卢卡：是风扇，它还开着。

messages.speaker: Anna (室友)
messages.zh: 那是什么呼呼声？
messages.en: What is that whirring sound?

messages.speaker: Luqa (室友)
messages.zh: 是风扇，它还开着。
messages.en: The fan; it is still on.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象录音按钮收进一段风扇的呼呼声，给这段声音贴上 tartir 标签。用“听到一种声音”的名词框架记忆，再与表示发声动作的 tartar 区分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of removing dust from a surface with a brush.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用刷子刷拂表面以除去灰尘的动作或一次掸尘。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-tneħħija tat-trab minn fuq wiċċ permezz ta' xkupilja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用刷子掸去灰尘；刷拂除尘的动作。

collocations.en: a light dusting with a brush

formal.mt: Qabel il-wirja, il-qafas ingħata tarxa ħafifa b'xkupilja ratba biex jitneħħa t-trab.
formal.en: Before the exhibition, the frame was given a light dusting with a soft brush to remove the dust.
formal.zh: 展览前，工作人员用软刷轻轻掸去画框上的灰尘。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Il-qafas għadu bit-trab. Ġanni: Nagħtih tarxa b'din ix-xkupilja ratba.
colloquial.en: Rita: The frame is still dusty. Ġanni: I'll give it a dusting with this soft brush.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：画框上还有灰。詹尼：我用这把软刷给它掸一掸。

messages.speaker: Rita (家人)
messages.zh: 画框上还有灰。
messages.en: The frame is still dusty.

messages.speaker: Ġanni (家人)
messages.zh: 我用这把软刷给它掸一掸。
messages.en: I'll give it a dusting with this soft brush.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 tarxa 画一个小图标：软刷轻扫画框，灰尘随之落下。记住它指“用刷子掸尘这一次动作”，把刷子、灰尘和动作一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The condition of being unable to hear, or of having substantially reduced hearing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 无法听见声音或听力显著降低的状态，即耳聋。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kundizzjoni ta' persuna li ma tismax jew li għandha smigħ imnaqqas ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 耳聋；听觉丧失或听力显著降低的状态。

formal.mt: L-istudent għandu tarxien parzjali, u l-iskola tipprovdilu l-istruzzjonijiet ukoll bil-miktub.
formal.en: The student has partial deafness, and the school also provides him with instructions in writing.
formal.zh: 这名学生有部分听力丧失，学校也向他提供书面说明。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għandi tarxien parzjali; tista' tħares lejja meta titkellem? Lara: Żgur, u nista' nikteb id-dettalji wkoll.
colloquial.en: Marija: I have partial deafness; could you face me when you speak? Lara: Of course, and I can write down the details too.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：我有部分听力丧失，你说话时能面向我吗？拉拉：当然，也可以把具体信息写下来。

messages.speaker: Marija (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi tarxien parzjali; tista' tħares lejja meta titkellem?
messages.mt_standard: Għandi tarxien parzjali; tista' tħares lejja meta titkellem?
messages.zh: 我有部分听力丧失，你说话时能面向我吗？
messages.en: I have partial deafness; could you face me when you speak?

messages.speaker: Lara (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Żgur, u nista' nikteb id-dettalji wkoll.
messages.mt_standard: Żgur, u nista' nikteb id-dettalji wkoll.
messages.zh: 当然，也可以把具体信息写下来。
messages.en: Of course, and I can write down the details too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tarxien 放在听力状态卡片上：parzjali 对应部分听力丧失，totali 对应完全耳聋。用一张书面交流便条帮助联想词义，记住它是状态名词。

gloss_zh: 一级楼梯；台阶；楼梯踏面

teaching_sense.en_definition: One step of a staircase, especially the horizontal surface on which a person places a foot.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 楼梯中的一级台阶，尤其指供脚踩踏的水平踏面。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Waħda mill-partijiet ta' taraġ li titla' jew tinżel fuqhom, speċjalment il-wiċċ fejn tqiegħed sieqek.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一级楼梯；一级梯级
台阶；梯级
楼梯踏面；台阶上供脚踩踏的水平部分

formal.mt: L-ewwel tarġa tal-ġebel għandha xquq fil-wiċċ u teħtieġ tiswija.
formal.en: The first stone step has cracks in its surface and needs repair.
formal.zh: 第一级石台阶的表面有裂缝，需要修补。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Oqgħod attent, din it-tarġa mxarrba. Toni: Rajtha, se nitla' bil-mod.
colloquial.en: Maja: Be careful, this step is wet. Toni: I've seen it; I'll go up slowly.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：小心，这一级台阶湿了。托尼：我看到了，我会慢慢上去。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 小心，这一级台阶湿了。
messages.en: Be careful, this step is wet.

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 我看到了，我会慢慢上去。
messages.en: I've seen it; I'll go up slowly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一只脚落在某一级楼梯的平面上，把这一级标作 tarġa；用“一脚一级”的画面记住台阶和踏面两个侧重点。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A long, narrow band or mark that differs in colour or appearance from the surrounding surface.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表面上颜色或外观与周围不同的细长带状纹路或痕迹，可指条纹，也可指条痕。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Strixxa jew marka twila u dejqa li tvarja fil-kulur jew fid-dehra mill-wiċċ ta' madwarha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 条纹；颜色或外观与周围不同的狭长带状纹路。
条痕；表面上呈细长形的痕迹或色痕。

formal.mt: Id-disinn tal-bandiera jinkludi tarż aħmar fuq sfond abjad.
formal.en: The flag design includes a red stripe on a white background.
formal.zh: 这面旗帜的设计包括白色背景上的一道红色条纹。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Għandek tarż ta' żebgħa fuq il-kmiem. Mark: Veru, messni mal-ħajt waqt li kien għadu mxarrab.
colloquial.en: Elena: You have a streak of paint on your sleeve. Mark: You're right, I brushed against the wall while it was still wet.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：你袖子上有一道油漆痕。马克：还真是，墙上的油漆没干时，我蹭到墙了。

messages.speaker: Elena (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek tarż ta' żebgħa fuq il-kmiem.
messages.mt_standard: Għandek tarż ta' żebgħa fuq il-kmiem.
messages.zh: 你袖子上有一道油漆痕。
messages.en: You have a streak of paint on your sleeve.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Veru, messni mal-ħajt waqt li kien għadu mxarrab.
messages.mt_standard: Veru, messni mal-ħajt waqt li kien għadu mxarrab.
messages.zh: 还真是，墙上的油漆没干时，我蹭到墙了。
messages.en: You're right, I brushed against the wall while it was still wet.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 tarż 配两幅细长线条图：旗帜上整齐的一道是“条纹”，袖口蹭上的一道油漆是“条痕”。两义都抓住“狭长的一道”，再按场景选择中文。

gloss_zh: 分类学的；与生物分类有关的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to taxonomy, the classification of organisms into named groups.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与分类学有关的，指把生物划分为有名称的不同类群。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Marbut mat-tassonomija, jiġifieri l-klassifikazzjoni tal-organiżmi fi gruppi b'ismijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 分类学的；与生物分类体系有关的

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jindika l-grupp tassonomiku ta' kull organiżmu studjat.
formal.en: The report identifies the taxonomic group of each organism studied.
formal.zh: 报告列明了每一种受研究生物所属的分类学类群。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser 'grupp tassonomiku'? Pawlu: Grupp li fih jitqiegħdu organiżmi skont il-klassifikazzjoni tagħhom.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'taxonomic group' mean? Pawlu: A group in which organisms are placed according to their classification.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：‘分类学类群’是什么意思？保罗：就是按照分类体系把生物归入的一个组。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: ‘分类学类群’是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'taxonomic group' mean?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Grupp li fih jitqiegħdu organiżmi skont il-klassifikazzjoni tagħhom.
messages.mt_standard: Grupp li fih jitqiegħdu organiżmi skont il-klassifikazzjoni tagħhom.
messages.zh: 就是按照分类体系把生物归入的一个组。
messages.en: A group in which organisms are placed according to their classification.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它与英语 taxonomic 并排记忆，想象给生物贴上分类标签；看到 grupp tassonomiku 就联想到‘分类学类群’。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The feel of something when touched, or an individual key on a keyboard or musical instrument.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 触摸某物时感受到的触感；也指键盘或乐器上的单个按键、琴键。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Is-sensazzjoni li tagħti xi ħaġa meta tmissha; ukoll buttuna waħda fuq tastiera jew pjanu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 触感；触摸时的感觉
按键；键盘上的键或乐器的琴键

formal.mt: Il-klijent jista' jeżamina l-kulur u t-tast tad-drapp qabel jagħżel il-materjal.
formal.en: The customer can examine the colour and feel of the fabric before choosing the material.
formal.zh: 顾客可以先查看布料的颜色、感受其触感，再选择材料。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Liema tast nagħfas biex nibda? Mark: Agħfas it-tast il-kbir fin-nofs tat-tastiera.
colloquial.en: Lara: Which key do I press to start? Mark: Press the big key in the middle of the keyboard.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：我要按哪个键才能开始？马克：按键盘中间那个大键。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我要按哪个键才能开始？
messages.en: Which key do I press to start?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 按键盘中间那个大键。
messages.en: Press the big key in the middle of the keyboard.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用手指串起两个义项：手指摸布料，得到‘触感’；手指按键盘，碰到一个‘按键’。这是记忆联想，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A bevel used to check, copy, or mark an angle when working with materials.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 加工材料时用来检查、复制或标记角度的斜角规或活动角尺。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda biex tiċċekkja, tikkopja jew timmarka angolu waqt xogħol fuq materjal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 斜角规；用于比对或转移角度的活动角尺

collocations.en: check the angle with a bevel

formal.mt: Qabel il-qtugħ, il-ħaddiem uża tastatur biex jittrasferixxi l-angolu fuq il-biċċa tal-injam.
formal.en: Before cutting, the worker used a bevel to transfer the angle onto the piece of wood.
formal.zh: 切割前，工人用斜角规把角度转移到木料上。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Tgħaddili t-tastatur, jekk jogħġbok? Toni: Hawn hu; trid tiċċekkja dan l-angolu?
colloquial.en: Rita: Could you pass me the bevel, please? Toni: Here it is; do you want to check this angle?
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：请把斜角规递给我好吗？托尼：给你；你要检查这个角度吗？

messages.speaker: Rita (木工)
messages.zh: 请把斜角规递给我好吗？
messages.en: Could you pass me the bevel, please?

messages.speaker: Toni (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn hu; trid tiċċekkja dan l-angolu?
messages.mt_standard: Hawn hu; trid tiċċekkja dan l-angolu?
messages.zh: 给你；你要检查这个角度吗？
messages.en: Here it is; do you want to check this angle?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象木工先用活动角尺对准斜角，再把相同角度画到另一块木头上；把 tastatur 与‘复制角度的工具’一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A lasting picture, design, or inscription made by putting ink into the skin.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把墨水注入皮肤形成的持久图画、图案或文字，即文身。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Stampa, disinn jew kitba li tibqa' fuq il-ġilda u ssir billi tiddaħħal il-linka fiha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 文身；以墨水在皮肤中形成的图案或文字

formal.mt: Fir-ritratt jidher tattwaġġ żgħir fuq id-driegħ tax-xellug tal-persuna.
formal.en: The photograph shows a small tattoo on the person's left arm.
formal.zh: 照片中可以看到此人左臂上的一个小文身。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'jirrappreżenta t-tattwaġġ tiegħek? Lara: Fjura; għażilt id-disinn għax ifakkarni fil-ġnien tan-nanna.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does your tattoo represent? Lara: A flower; I chose the design because it reminds me of my grandmother's garden.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你的文身画的是什么？劳拉：一朵花；我选这个图案，是因为它让我想起奶奶的花园。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你的文身画的是什么？
messages.en: What does your tattoo represent?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fjura; għażilt id-disinn għax ifakkarni fil-ġnien tan-nanna.
messages.mt_standard: Fjura; għażilt id-disinn għax ifakkarni fil-ġnien tan-nanna.
messages.zh: 一朵花；我选这个图案，是因为它让我想起奶奶的花园。
messages.en: A flower; I chose the design because it reminds me of my grandmother's garden.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tattwaġġ 写在一幅手臂花朵文身的小画旁，整块记住‘皮肤上的持久图案’，并特别留意双写的 tt 和带点的 ġġ。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A lasting image or piece of writing created by inserting ink into the skin.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过把墨水注入皮肤形成的持久图像或文字，即文身。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xbieha jew kitba li ssir billi tiddaħħal il-linka fil-ġilda u tibqa' hemm.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 文身；皮肤上以墨水形成的持久图像或文字

formal.mt: Il-persuna għażlet tatù żgħir b'disinn ta' stilla fuq l-ispalla.
formal.en: The person chose a small star tattoo on the shoulder.
formal.zh: 此人选择在肩膀上文一个小星星图案。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Dak tatù ġdid fuq l-ispalla tiegħek? Nina: Iva, stilla żgħira; għamiltu l-ġimgħa li għaddiet.
colloquial.en: Mark: Is that a new tattoo on your shoulder? Nina: Yes, a little star; I got it last week.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你肩膀上那个是新文身吗？妮娜：对，是颗小星星；我上周文的。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak tatù ġdid fuq l-ispalla tiegħek?
messages.mt_standard: Dak tatù ġdid fuq l-ispalla tiegħek?
messages.zh: 你肩膀上那个是新文身吗？
messages.en: Is that a new tattoo on your shoulder?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, stilla żgħira; għamiltu l-ġimgħa li għaddiet.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, stilla żgħira; għamiltu l-ġimgħa li għaddiet.
messages.zh: 对，是颗小星星；我上周文的。
messages.en: Yes, a little star; I got it last week.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用英语 tattoo 帮助联想含义，再单独记住马耳他语拼写 tatù，尤其别漏掉 ù 上的符号；脑中配上一颗肩膀上的小星星。

gloss_zh: 地板木板；铺地板用的木板

teaching_sense.en_definition: A wooden plank used as part of a floor.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用来铺设地板、构成地面的一块木板。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tavla tal-injam li tintuża bħala parti minn art tal-injam.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 地板木板；构成木地板的一块板材

formal.mt: Waqt it-tiswija, il-ħaddiem neħħa t-tavlament bil-ħsara u qiegħed ieħor fl-istess post.
formal.en: During the repair, the worker removed the damaged floor plank and fitted another in the same place.
formal.zh: 维修时，工人拆下损坏的地板木板，并在原处装上另一块。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex qed jiċċaqlaq dan it-tavlament? Ġużeppi: Ħallieni niċċekkjah; forsi hemm bżonn inwaħħluh aħjar.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why is this floor plank moving? Ġużeppi: Let me check it; perhaps we need to secure it better.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：这块地板木板怎么会动？朱塞佩：我来检查一下；也许得把它固定得更牢。

messages.speaker: Anna (住户)
messages.zh: 这块地板木板怎么会动？
messages.en: Why is this floor plank moving?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (维修工)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħallieni niċċekkjah; forsi hemm bżonn inwaħħluh aħjar.
messages.mt_standard: Ħallieni niċċekkjah; forsi hemm bżonn inwaħħluh aħjar.
messages.zh: 我来检查一下；也许得把它固定得更牢。
messages.en: Let me check it; perhaps we need to secure it better.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象脚下有一块会晃动的长木板，需要拆下更换；把 tavlament 与‘木地板中的一块板’这个具体画面绑定记忆。

gloss_zh: 金牛座（占星术）；公牛；沙鲨

teaching_sense.en_definition: The Taurus sign in astrology; also a bull, or a sand shark, depending on context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在占星术中指金牛座；在动物语境中也可指公牛或沙鲨，需结合上下文判断。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Is-sinjal tat-Tawru fl-astroloġija; ukoll barri, jew kelb il-baħar magħruf bħala sand shark, skont il-kuntest.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 占星术中的金牛座
公牛；雄性牛
沙鲨；一种以 sand shark 为英语名称的鲨鱼

collocations.en: a sand shark in the aquarium

formal.mt: Fil-gwida tal-akkwarju, il-kelma 'tawru' tintuża għal sand shark, tip ta' kelb il-baħar.
formal.en: In the aquarium guide, the word 'tawru' is used for a sand shark, a type of shark.
formal.zh: 在水族馆导览中，tawru 一词用于指沙鲨，也就是一种鲨鱼。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Meta tgħid 'tawru', qed titkellem fuq l-annimal jew fuq is-sinjal? Mark: Fuq l-annimal: rajt tawru fl-għalqa. Nina: Mela qed tgħid barri; jien ħsibt li kont qed titkellem fuq it-Tawru fl-astroloġija.
colloquial.en: Nina: When you say 'tawru', do you mean the animal or the sign? Mark: The animal: I saw a bull in the field. Nina: So you mean a bull; I thought you were talking about Taurus in astrology.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你说 tawru，是指动物还是星座？马克：动物，我在田里看见了一头公牛。妮娜：原来你说的是公牛；我还以为你在说占星术中的金牛座。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta tgħid 'tawru', qed titkellem fuq l-annimal jew fuq is-sinjal?
messages.mt_standard: Meta tgħid 'tawru', qed titkellem fuq l-annimal jew fuq is-sinjal?
messages.zh: 你说 tawru，是指动物还是星座？
messages.en: When you say 'tawru', do you mean the animal or the sign?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 动物，我在田里看见了一头公牛。
messages.en: The animal: I saw a bull in the field.

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela qed tgħid barri; jien ħsibt li kont qed titkellem fuq it-Tawru fl-astroloġija.
messages.mt_standard: Mela qed tgħid barri; jien ħsibt li kont qed titkellem fuq it-Tawru fl-astroloġija.
messages.zh: 原来你说的是公牛；我还以为你在说占星术中的金牛座。
messages.en: So you mean a bull; I thought you were talking about Taurus in astrology.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画三张场景卡：星座图上的金牛座、田地里的公牛、水族馆里的沙鲨；三张都写 tawru，靠场景区分三个义项，不把它们当作同一种事物。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To fill a hole or other space with clumps of earth.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用一块块泥土填入坑洞或其他空间。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jimla ħofra jew spazju ieħor b'ċapep tal-ħamrija.

sense_translations.en_definition: to fill with clumps of earth
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用土块填满或填塞。

collocations.en: filled the hole with clumps of earth
filled the gap with clumps of earth

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem tawwab il-ħofra b'ċapep tal-ħamrija.
formal.en: The worker filled the hole with clumps of earth.
formal.zh: 工人用土块填了那个坑。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Kif imlejt il-ħofra? Pawlu: Tawwabtha b'ċapep tal-ħamrija li kien hemm ħdejha.
colloquial.en: Marija: How did you fill the hole? Pawlu: I filled it with the clumps of earth that were beside it.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：你怎么把坑填上的？保罗：我用旁边那些土块把它填上了。

messages.speaker: Marija (邻居)
messages.zh: 你怎么把坑填上的？
messages.en: How did you fill the hole?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (园丁)
messages.mt_spoken: Tawwabtha b'ċapep tal-ħamrija li kien hemm ħdejha.
messages.mt_standard: Tawwabtha b'ċapep tal-ħamrija li kien hemm ħdejha.
messages.zh: 我用旁边那些土块把它填上了。
messages.en: I filled it with the clumps of earth that were beside it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把一块块泥土放进坑里；把 tawwab 和“土块填坑”的动作一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a long, stretched shape rather than a round or compact one.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形状延长、呈长形的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu forma twila aktar milli tonda jew kompatta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 细长的；形状拉长的。

formal.mt: Il-kampjun għandu ġisem tawwali u wiċċ lixx.
formal.en: The specimen has an elongated body and a smooth surface.
formal.zh: 该标本具有细长的主体和光滑的表面。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Liema kontenitur nieħu? Mark: Ħu dak tawwali; il-pniezel jidħlu fih aħjar.
colloquial.en: Anna: Which container should I take? Mark: Take the elongated one; the brushes fit better in it.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：我该拿哪个容器？马克：拿那个长形的，画笔放进去更合适。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 我该拿哪个容器？
messages.en: Which container should I take?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħu dak tawwali; il-pniezel jidħlu fih aħjar.
messages.mt_standard: Ħu dak tawwali; il-pniezel jidħlu fih aħjar.
messages.zh: 拿那个长形的，画笔放进去更合适。
messages.en: Take the elongated one; the brushes fit better in it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一个圆形，再把它拉成长形；用拉长后的轮廓记住 tawwali。

gloss_zh: 损坏，尤指损坏草木；犁出深沟的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: To damage something, especially plants or other greenery.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使事物受损，尤其用于草木等植物受到破坏。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel ħsara lil xi ħaġa, speċjalment lill-pjanti jew lill-ħdura.

sense_translations.en_definition: to damage (usually used for damaged greenery)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 损坏；通常用于草木等植物受到破坏。
耕作时犁出深沟的人。

formal.mt: Ir-riħ qawwi tawwar il-ħdura tul il-mogħdija.
formal.en: The strong wind damaged the greenery along the path.
formal.zh: 强风损坏了小径沿线的草木。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għaliex il-pjanti jidhru daqshekk ħżiena? Ġużeppi: Ir-riħ tal-bieraħ tawwar il-pjanti; ejja naraw x'nistgħu nsalvaw.
colloquial.en: Rita: Why do the plants look so bad? Ġużeppi: Yesterday's wind damaged the plants; let's see what we can save.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：这些植物怎么变得这么糟？朱塞佩：昨天的风把植物损坏了；我们看看还能救回哪些。

messages.speaker: Rita (邻居)
messages.zh: 这些植物怎么变得这么糟？
messages.en: Why do the plants look so bad?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (园丁)
messages.mt_spoken: Ir-riħ tal-bieraħ tawwar il-pjanti; ejja naraw x'nistgħu nsalvaw.
messages.mt_standard: Ir-riħ tal-bieraħ tawwar il-pjanti; ejja naraw x'nistgħu nsalvaw.
messages.zh: 昨天的风把植物损坏了；我们看看还能救回哪些。
messages.en: Yesterday's wind damaged the plants; let's see what we can save.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张词性卡分开记：动词卡画受损草木，名词卡画犁出深沟的人。

gloss_zh: 嘟嘟鸣响；吹出铜管乐器声；按喇叭；吹管子的人；发出呜鸣声的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make a tooting sound, for example with a brass instrument or a vehicle horn.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 发出嘟嘟的鸣响声，例如吹奏铜管乐器或按响车辆喇叭。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel ħoss bħal dak ta' tromba jew ta' ħorn ta' vettura.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 发出短促的嘟嘟鸣响声。

sense_translations.en_definition: to make sounds typical of brass instruments (such as a trumpet)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 发出铜管乐器特有的声音，例如小号声。
按响自己的车辆喇叭。
吹奏管子或管乐器的人。
发出呜呜鸣叫声的人。

formal.mt: Is-sewwieq tawwat bil-ħorn biex iwissi lil min kien quddiem il-vettura.
formal.en: The driver honked the horn to warn the person in front of the vehicle.
formal.zh: 司机按响喇叭，提醒车辆前方的人。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Min tawwat bil-ħorn? David: Jien; ridt inwissi lil dak ir-raġel quddiem il-karozza.
colloquial.en: Marta: Who honked the horn? David: I did; I wanted to warn that man in front of the car.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：谁按喇叭了？戴维：是我；我想提醒车前面的那个男人。

messages.speaker: Marta (乘客)
messages.zh: 谁按喇叭了？
messages.en: Who honked the horn?

messages.speaker: David (司机)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien; ridt inwissi lil dak ir-raġel quddiem il-karozza.
messages.mt_standard: Jien; ridt inwissi lil dak ir-raġel quddiem il-karozza.
messages.zh: 是我；我想提醒车前面的那个男人。
messages.en: I did; I wanted to warn that man in front of the car.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用喇叭和小号的“嘟嘟声”记动词，再另记两个人物名词义：吹管者和呜鸣者。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or sound of hooting or tooting.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 发出呜呜或嘟嘟鸣响的行为，也指这种声音。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att jew il-ħoss ta' min idoqq ħorn jew jagħmel ħoss bħal ta' tromba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 呜呜鸣响；呜呜的鸣叫声。
嘟嘟鸣响；短促的嘟嘟声。

collocations.zh: 连续不断的呜呜或嘟嘟声

formal.mt: It-tawwit kontinwu tal-ħorn instema' mit-tieqa tal-uffiċċju.
formal.en: The continuous honking of the horn could be heard through the office window.
formal.zh: 透过办公室的窗户，可以听见持续不断的喇叭声。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Qed tisma' dak it-tawwit? Ben: Iva, ġej mit-triq; hemm karozza quddiem il-bieb.
colloquial.en: Lara: Can you hear that honking? Ben: Yes, it's coming from the street; there's a car outside the door.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：你听见那阵喇叭声了吗？本：听见了，是街上传来的；门外有辆车。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 你听见那阵喇叭声了吗？
messages.en: Can you hear that honking?

messages.speaker: Ben (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ġej mit-triq; hemm karozza quddiem il-bieb.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ġej mit-triq; hemm karozza quddiem il-bieb.
messages.zh: 听见了，是街上传来的；门外有辆车。
messages.en: Yes, it's coming from the street; there's a car outside the door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tawwit 写在一段喇叭录音旁，提醒自己这个名词指鸣响行为或声音。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A delay that makes an action or event happen later than intended or expected.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使行动或事件比原定或预期时间更晚发生的延误、耽搁。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dewmien li jġiegħel azzjoni jew avveniment iseħħ aktar tard milli kien maħsub jew mistenni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 延误；耽搁；拖延

formal.mt: Id-dokumenti għandhom jintbagħtu mingħajr tawħir sabiex il-proċess ikun jista' jitkompla.
formal.en: The documents should be sent without delay so that the process can continue.
formal.zh: 应立即寄送文件，以便流程能够继续进行。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Nistgħu nitilqu issa? Pawlu: Iva, ejja nitilqu mingħajr aktar tawħir.
colloquial.en: Sara: Can we leave now? Pawlu: Yes, let's leave without any further delay.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我们现在可以走了吗？保罗：可以，咱们别再耽搁了，出发吧。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们现在可以走了吗？
messages.en: Can we leave now?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ejja nitilqu mingħajr aktar tawħir.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ejja nitilqu mingħajr aktar tawħir.
messages.zh: 可以，咱们别再耽搁了，出发吧。
messages.en: Yes, let's leave without any further delay.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tawħir 想成时钟旁的一段等待时间，再整句记住 mingħajr tawħir‘毫不耽搁’，用‘赶快出发’的场景巩固含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A tax paid on income that a person or organisation earns.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对个人或组织取得的收入征收的税。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Taxxa fuq id-dħul li taqla' persuna jew organizzazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 所得税；对收入征收的税。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport juri kemm tħallset taxxa tad-dħul matul is-sena.
formal.en: The report shows how much income tax was paid during the year.
formal.zh: 报告列明了这一年缴纳的所得税金额。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Din is-somma tinkludi t-taxxa tad-dħul? Lara: Iva, it-taxxa tad-dħul diġà tnaqqset.
colloquial.en: Mark: Does this amount include income tax? Lara: Yes, income tax has already been deducted.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这个金额包含所得税吗？拉拉：包含，所得税已经扣除了。

messages.speaker: Mark (员工)
messages.zh: 这个金额包含所得税吗？
messages.en: Does this amount include income tax?

messages.speaker: Lara (会计)
messages.zh: 包含，所得税已经扣除了。
messages.en: Yes, income tax has already been deducted.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个词组和工资单上的“所得税”栏联系起来，想象收入到账前先扣去这一项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Subject to tax; describing income, goods, or other items on which tax is payable.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 须缴纳税款的，用来描述应税收入、商品或其他项目。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li fuqu trid titħallas taxxa, bħal dħul jew oġġetti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 应税的；须缴纳税款的。

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżempju ta' taħriġ, id-dħul taxxabbli jidher f'kolonna separata.
formal.en: In this training example, taxable income appears in a separate column.
formal.zh: 在这个培训示例中，应税收入列在单独的一栏。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Xi jfisser "dħul taxxabbli" f'dan l-eżerċizzju? Karl: Ifisser dħul li fuqu trid titħallas it-taxxa.
colloquial.en: Nina: What does "taxable income" mean in this exercise? Karl: It means income on which tax must be paid.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这道练习里的“应税收入”是什么意思？卡尔：指需要缴税的收入。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: 这道练习里的“应税收入”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does "taxable income" mean in this exercise?

messages.speaker: Karl (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser dħul li fuqu trid titħallas it-taxxa.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser dħul li fuqu trid titħallas it-taxxa.
messages.zh: 指需要缴税的收入。
messages.en: It means income on which tax must be paid.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象在收入项目旁贴上“应税的”标签；taxxabbli 是描述该项目性质的形容词。

gloss_zh: 应税性；是否须纳税这一属性

teaching_sense.en_definition: The status or property of being subject to tax.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 收入、款项或其他项目须纳税的性质或状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-fatt jew il-karatteristika li dħul, ħlas jew oġġett ikun suġġett għat-taxxa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 应税性；某项收入、款项或其他项目是否须纳税的性质或状态。

formal.mt: L-eżerċizzju jitlob lill-istudenti jiddiskutu t-taxxabilità ta' kull tip ta' dħul.
formal.en: The exercise asks students to discuss the taxability of each type of income.
formal.zh: 这道练习要求学生讨论每类收入的应税性。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Xi tfisser "taxxabilità" hawn? Toni: Tfisser jekk il-ħlas huwiex suġġett għat-taxxa.
colloquial.en: Elena: What does "taxability" mean here? Toni: It means whether the payment is subject to tax.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：这里的“应税性”是什么意思？托尼：指这笔款项是否需要纳税。

messages.speaker: Elena (学生)
messages.zh: 这里的“应税性”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does "taxability" mean here?

messages.speaker: Toni (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser jekk il-ħlas huwiex suġġett għat-taxxa.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser jekk il-ħlas huwiex suġġett għat-taxxa.
messages.zh: 指这笔款项是否需要纳税。
messages.en: It means whether the payment is subject to tax.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 taxxabbli 记为“应税的”，把 taxxabilità 记为“应税性”；用中文词性差别区分两词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who assesses the value of something, such as a property.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某物的价值进行估算或评定的人，例如房产估价员。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tistma l-valur ta' xi ħaġa, bħal proprjetà.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 评估员；负责估算或评定价值的人。

formal.mt: It-taxxier ħejja rapport dwar il-valur tal-proprjetà.
formal.en: The assessor prepared a report on the value of the property.
formal.zh: 评估员就该房产的价值编写了一份报告。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Meta ġej it-taxxier? Lara: Għada filgħodu, biex jistma l-valur tad-dar.
colloquial.en: Mark: When is the assessor coming? Lara: Tomorrow morning, to assess the value of the house.
colloquial.zh: 马克：估价员什么时候来？拉拉：明天上午，来评估这所房子的价值。

messages.speaker: Mark (房主)
messages.zh: 估价员什么时候来？
messages.en: When is the assessor coming?

messages.speaker: Lara (房主的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għada filgħodu, biex jistma l-valur tad-dar.
messages.mt_standard: Għada filgħodu, biex jistma l-valur tad-dar.
messages.zh: 明天上午，来评估这所房子的价值。
messages.en: Tomorrow morning, to assess the value of the house.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一位拿着估价报告查看房屋的人，把 taxxier 与“负责评估价值的人”一起记住。

gloss_zh: 塔吉克斯坦的；塔吉克斯坦人；塔吉克语

teaching_sense.en_definition: Of, from, or connected with Tajikistan.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 属于、来自塔吉克斯坦或与塔吉克斯坦有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ġej mit-Taġikistan jew li għandu x'jaqsam mat-Taġikistan.

sense_translations.en_definition: Tajik (of, from or relating to Tajikistan)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 塔吉克斯坦的；来自塔吉克斯坦或与其有关的。

sense_translations.en_definition: Tajik (native or inhabitant of Tajikistan) (usually male)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 塔吉克斯坦本地人或居民，通常指男性。
塔吉克语，语言名称。

formal.mt: Student Taġikistani ppreżenta proġett dwar il-ħajja ta' kuljum f'pajjiżu.
formal.en: A Tajik student presented a project about everyday life in his country.
formal.zh: 一名塔吉克斯坦学生展示了一个介绍其本国日常生活的项目。

colloquial.mt: Maja: L-istudent il-ġdid huwa Taġikistani? Mark: Iva, ġej mit-Taġikistan u qed jitgħallem il-Malti magħna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is the new student Tajik? Mark: Yes, he comes from Tajikistan and is learning Maltese with us.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：新来的学生是塔吉克斯坦人吗？马克：是的，他来自塔吉克斯坦，正在和我们一起学马耳他语。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 新来的学生是塔吉克斯坦人吗？
messages.en: Is the new student Tajik?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ġej mit-Taġikistan u qed jitgħallem il-Malti magħna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ġej mit-Taġikistan u qed jitgħallem il-Malti magħna.
messages.zh: 是的，他来自塔吉克斯坦，正在和我们一起学马耳他语。
messages.en: Yes, he comes from Tajikistan and is learning Maltese with us.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用国家、人物、语言三张卡片联想同一个词，再看句中位置判断是形容词、居民名称还是语言名称。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To scold or reproach someone, or to argue with someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因某人的行为而责备、指责对方，或与人发生争论。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iċanfar lil xi ħadd, jurih li ma jaqbilx mal-imġiba tiegħu, jew jargumenta miegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 责备；因某人的行为不当而训斥对方。
指责；表达对某人行为的不满或失望。
争论；因意见不合而与人争辩。

formal.mt: Il-kap taħar lill-ħaddiem għax ma segwiex l-istruzzjonijiet.
formal.en: The supervisor reproached the worker because he had not followed the instructions.
formal.zh: 主管责备了那名工人，因为他没有遵守指示。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex taħar miegħek Mark? Pawlu: Ma qbilniex fuq min kellu jagħmel ix-xogħol.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Mark argue with you? Pawlu: We disagreed about who was supposed to do the work.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Mark为什么和你争论？Pawlu：我们对该由谁来做这项工作有分歧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: Mark为什么和你争论？
messages.en: Why did Mark argue with you?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma qbilniex fuq min kellu jagħmel ix-xogħol.
messages.mt_standard: Ma qbilniex fuq min kellu jagħmel ix-xogħol.
messages.zh: 我们对该由谁来做这项工作有分歧。
messages.en: We disagreed about who was supposed to do the work.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 taħar 放进两幅学习画面：主管责备员工、朋友意见不合争论；用人物关系区分词义，不把所有用法都译成吵架。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of getting to know people and forming friendships.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 认识他人并逐渐建立友谊的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih persuna ssir taf lil oħrajn u tibni ħbiberiji magħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 交朋友；与他人建立友谊。

formal.mt: L-attivitajiet fi grupp joffru opportunitajiet għat-taħbib bejn studenti ġodda.
formal.en: Group activities offer opportunities for new students to make friends.
formal.zh: 小组活动为新生之间结交朋友提供了机会。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif sejjer it-taħbib fl-iskola l-ġdida? Lara: Tajjeb! Diġà sirt naf żewġt ibniet fil-klassi.
colloquial.en: Maja: How is making friends at your new school going? Lara: Well! I've already got to know two girls in my class.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你在新学校交朋友交得怎么样？Lara：挺好！我已经认识了班上的两个女生。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你在新学校交朋友交得怎么样？
messages.en: How is making friends at your new school going?

messages.speaker: Lara (新生)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb! Diġà sirt naf żewġt ibniet fil-klassi.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb! Diġà sirt naf żewġt ibniet fil-klassi.
messages.zh: 挺好！我已经认识了班上的两个女生。
messages.en: Well! I've already got to know two girls in my class.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 taħbib 时想象新生从打招呼到一起活动的过程：重点是建立友谊这一过程，而不是某一位朋友。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Entanglement, disorder, or trouble; also the act of causing pregnancy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 事物缠在一起的状态，也可指混乱、麻烦；另有使受孕之义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-tħabbil ta' affarijiet ma' xulxin, nuqqas ta' ordni jew inkwiet; ukoll l-att li bih mara jew annimal femminili titqal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 缠绕；多个物体纠缠在一起的状态。
混乱；缺乏秩序或条理的状态。
麻烦；使人困扰或难以处理的情况。
使受孕；使女性或雌性动物怀孕的过程。

formal.mt: Il-ħażna separata tal-kejbils tnaqqas it-taħbil tagħhom u tagħmilhom aktar faċli biex jintużaw.
formal.en: Storing cables separately reduces their entanglement and makes them easier to use.
formal.zh: 将电缆分开存放可以减少缠绕，使其更便于使用。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ara x'taħbil hemm f'dawn il-ħjut! Maja: Agħtihomli; nipprova nifridhom bil-mod.
colloquial.en: Lara: Look how tangled these threads are! Maja: Give them to me; I'll try to separate them gently.
colloquial.zh: Lara：看这些线缠成什么样了！Maja：给我吧，我试着慢慢把它们分开。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 看这些线缠成什么样了！
messages.en: Look how tangled these threads are!

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 给我吧，我试着慢慢把它们分开。
messages.en: Give them to me; I'll try to separate them gently.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用缠成一团的线记住 taħbil 的缠绕、混乱和麻烦三义；使受孕另设一张词义卡，避免套用线团画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Forecasting or predicting what will happen, or indicating a future event through signs.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对未来情况作出预测，或通过某种迹象预示将要发生的事情。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tbassir ta' dak li se jiġri, jew indikazzjoni ta' ġrajja futura permezz ta' sinjali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 预测；对未来的发展或情况作出估计。
预示；通过迹象显示某事将要发生。
预测或预言；关于未来将发生何事的判断或说法。

formal.mt: It-taħbir tat-temp jgħin lill-bdiewa jippjanaw ix-xogħol tagħhom fl-għelieqi.
formal.en: Weather forecasting helps farmers plan their work in the fields.
formal.zh: 天气预测帮助农民安排田间工作。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'jgħid it-taħbir tat-temp għal għada? Pawlu: Jgħid li se tagħmel ix-xita, mela ħu umbrella.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does the weather forecast say for tomorrow? Pawlu: It says it's going to rain, so take an umbrella.
colloquial.zh: Maja：天气预报说明天天气怎么样？Pawlu：说明天会下雨，所以带把伞吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 天气预报说明天天气怎么样？
messages.en: What does the weather forecast say for tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jgħid li se tagħmel ix-xita, mela ħu umbrella.
messages.mt_standard: Jgħid li se tagħmel ix-xita, mela ħu umbrella.
messages.zh: 说明天会下雨，所以带把伞吧。
messages.en: It says it's going to rain, so take an umbrella.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 taħbir 放在明天的天气图旁边：事情尚未发生，先预测；若强调眼前迹象，则理解为预示。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A throbbing or beating movement, the act or sound of knocking, or trouble and difficulty.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 有节奏的搏动或击打，也可指敲击的动作或声音，以及麻烦、困难。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Moviment ta' daqqiet ripetuti, bħal dawk tal-qalb, l-att jew il-ħoss ta' meta wieħed iħabbat, jew inkwiet u diffikultà.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 搏动；有节奏、较明显的跳动或脉动。
麻烦；令人费心或需要费力处理的困难。
击打；连续打击的动作。
敲击；敲门等敲打动作或其声音。

formal.mt: Wara l-ġirja, l-istudent innota żieda fit-taħbit tal-qalb tiegħu.
formal.en: After the run, the student noticed an increase in his heart rate.
formal.zh: 跑步后，这名学生注意到自己的心跳加快了。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Smajt it-taħbit fuq il-bieb? Mark: Iva, sejjer niftaħ. Naħseb li waslet Maja.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did you hear the knocking on the door? Mark: Yes, I'll go and open it. I think Maja has arrived.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你听见敲门声了吗？Mark：听见了，我去开门。我想是Maja到了。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 你听见敲门声了吗？
messages.en: Did you hear the knocking on the door?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, sejjer niftaħ. Naħseb li waslet Maja.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, sejjer niftaħ. Naħseb li waslet Maja.
messages.zh: 听见了，我去开门。我想是Maja到了。
messages.en: Yes, I'll go and open it. I think Maja has arrived.

cognitive_memory_aid: 学习时给 taħbit 配三种画面：胸口心跳、手指敲门、事情带来麻烦；依搭配判断，不把每次出现都译成心跳。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of baking; also withdrawal, meaning the act of pulling back or withdrawing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 烘焙食物的活动；另有撤回、退出之义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-attività tal-ħami; ukoll l-att li wieħed jirtira jew jiġbed lura.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 烘焙；通过烤制来制作面包等食物的活动。
撤回；退出；从原先的位置、参与或安排中退回的行为。

formal.mt: Il-workshop jinkludi taħriġ fit-taħbiż tal-ħobż u fil-preparazzjoni tal-għaġina.
formal.en: The workshop includes training in bread baking and dough preparation.
formal.zh: 这次工作坊包括面包烘焙和面团制作方面的培训。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Illum għandna jum ta' taħbiż! Mark: Mela nibdew bil-ħobż? L-għaġina lesta.
colloquial.en: Maja: Today we've got a day of baking! Mark: Shall we start with the bread, then? The dough is ready.
colloquial.zh: Maja：今天我们要烘焙一整天！Mark：那我们先做面包吧？面团准备好了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 今天我们要烘焙一整天！
messages.en: Today we've got a day of baking!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 那我们先做面包吧？面团准备好了。
messages.en: Shall we start with the bread, then? The dough is ready.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 taħbiż 建立两张独立记忆卡：一张画烤好的面包表示烘焙，一张画向后退的箭头表示撤回；这是学习分类，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of putting something to use for a practical purpose.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将某种物品、设备或资源用于实际目的的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li bih xi ħaġa titqiegħed fl-użu għal skop prattiku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把某物投入使用；使物品或资源发挥实际作用。

formal.mt: Qabel it-taħdim tal-magna, l-operatur għandu jaqra l-istruzzjonijiet kollha.
formal.en: Before putting the machine to use, the operator should read all the instructions.
formal.zh: 在将机器投入使用之前，操作人员应阅读全部说明。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Kollox lest għat-taħdim tal-magna? Pawlu: Iva, qrajt l-istruzzjonijiet u ħejjejt il-materjal.
colloquial.en: Mark: Is everything ready to put the machine to use? Pawlu: Yes, I've read the instructions and prepared the material.
colloquial.zh: Mark：机器投入使用前的一切都准备好了吗？Pawlu：好了，我读过说明，也准备好了材料。

messages.speaker: Mark (车间主管)
messages.zh: 机器投入使用前的一切都准备好了吗？
messages.en: Is everything ready to put the machine to use?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (操作员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qrajt l-istruzzjonijiet u ħejjejt il-materjal.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qrajt l-istruzzjonijiet u ħejjejt il-materjal.
messages.zh: 好了，我读过说明，也准备好了材料。
messages.en: Yes, I've read the instructions and prepared the material.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 taħdim 想成工具从架子上拿下来开始派上用场：记住核心是投入使用，关注物品实际发挥作用。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of holding someone in one's arms, especially to show affection or give comfort.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用双臂抱住他人的动作，尤其用来表达亲近或给予安慰。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed iżomm lil xi ħadd f'dirgħajh, speċjalment biex juri mħabba jew jagħti faraġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 拥抱；用双臂搂住他人。

formal.mt: It-taħdin bejn il-membri tal-familja esprima l-ferħ tagħhom meta reġgħu ltaqgħu.
formal.en: The embracing among family members expressed their joy at being reunited.
formal.zh: 家人之间的拥抱表达了他们重聚时的喜悦。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif kienet il-laqgħa man-nanna? Lara: Kien hemm ħafna taħdin! Kienet ilha ma tarani.
colloquial.en: Maja: How was seeing your grandmother? Lara: There was lots of hugging! She hadn't seen me for a long time.
colloquial.zh: Maja：和奶奶见面怎么样？Lara：抱了好久！她已经很久没见到我了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 和奶奶见面怎么样？
messages.en: How was seeing your grandmother?

messages.speaker: Lara (孙女)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien hemm ħafna taħdin! Kienet ilha ma tarani.
messages.mt_standard: Kien hemm ħafna taħdin! Kienet ilha ma tarani.
messages.zh: 抱了好久！她已经很久没见到我了。
messages.en: There was lots of hugging! She hadn't seen me for a long time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 taħdin 时想象久别重逢后张开双臂拥抱家人；把注意力放在拥抱这一动作，便于记住它是名词。

gloss_zh: 变绿；由亲友陪同前往自己的婚礼

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of becoming green; also, being accompanied by friends or others to one's wedding.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变成绿色的过程；也指由朋友等人陪同前往自己的婚礼。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih xi ħaġa ssir ħadra; ukoll, il-fatt li persuna tkun akkumpanjata mill-ħbieb jew minn oħrajn għat-tieġ tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变绿；逐渐呈现绿色。

sense_translations.en_definition: being accompanied to one's wedding by friends, etc.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 由朋友等人陪同前往自己的婚礼。

collocations.en: the groom being accompanied to his wedding by friends
collocations.zh: 新郎由朋友陪同前往婚礼

formal.mt: It-taħdir tal-għelieqi wara x-xita jidher ċar fir-ritratti mehmuża.
formal.en: The fields becoming green after the rain can be clearly seen in the attached photographs.
formal.zh: 从所附照片中可以清楚看到雨后田野变绿的景象。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Rajt it-taħdir tal-għelieqi wara x-xita? Lara: Iva, sa ftit ilu kollox kien niexef, u issa kollox aħdar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Have you noticed the fields turning green after the rain? Lara: Yes, everything was dry until recently, and now everything is green.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你注意到雨后田野变绿了吗？Lara：注意到了，前不久到处还干巴巴的，现在全绿了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你注意到雨后田野变绿了吗？
messages.en: Have you noticed the fields turning green after the rain?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, sa ftit ilu kollox kien niexef, u issa kollox aħdar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, sa ftit ilu kollox kien niexef, u issa kollox aħdar.
messages.zh: 注意到了，前不久到处还干巴巴的，现在全绿了。
messages.en: Yes, everything was dry until recently, and now everything is green.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅独立画面记忆：雨后田野慢慢变绿，以及朋友陪新郎赴婚礼；两个义项分开联想。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A conversation or a spoken presentation about a particular subject.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 围绕某个话题进行的谈话，或向听众讲解某个主题的讲座。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Konversazzjoni bejn persuni jew diskors quddiem udjenza dwar suġġett partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 谈话；就某个主题所作的讲话或讲座。

formal.mt: Il-librerija se torganizza taħdita dwar il-qari għat-tfal nhar il-Ġimgħa.
formal.en: The library will organize a talk about reading for children on Friday.
formal.zh: 图书馆将于星期五举办一场关于儿童阅读的讲座。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Kif kienet it-taħdita fil-librerija? Anna: Interessanti ħafna! Il-kelliema tatna ideat tajbin biex naqraw mat-tfal.
colloquial.en: Mark: How was the talk at the library? Anna: Very interesting! The speaker gave us good ideas for reading with children.
colloquial.zh: Mark：图书馆的讲座怎么样？Anna：很有意思！主讲人给了我们一些和孩子一起阅读的好点子。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 图书馆的讲座怎么样？
messages.en: How was the talk at the library?

messages.speaker: Anna (听众)
messages.mt_spoken: Interessanti ħafna! Il-kelliema tatna ideat tajbin biex naqraw mat-tfal.
messages.mt_standard: Interessanti ħafna! Il-kelliema tatna ideat tajbin biex naqraw mat-tfal.
messages.zh: 很有意思！主讲人给了我们一些和孩子一起阅读的好点子。
messages.en: Very interesting! The speaker gave us good ideas for reading with children.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词放进两个有声音的场景：朋友坐下交谈，或听众坐下听讲，记住核心是一次谈话或讲述。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A reduction in the weight of something, or the act of making matters proceed more quickly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 减轻某物重量的过程；也指加快事情的办理或推进。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-tnaqqis fil-piż ta' xi ħaġa, jew l-aċċellerazzjoni tax-xogħol biex affarijiet jitlestew aktar malajr.

sense_translations.en_definition: reduction in the weight of sth.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 减轻某物的重量；减重。
加快事情的处理或推进；加速办理。

collocations.en: reducing the weight of the suitcase

formal.mt: L-uffiċċju ppropona miżuri għat-taħfif tal-proċeduri sabiex it-talbiet jiġu pproċessati aktar malajr.
formal.en: The office proposed measures to speed up procedures so that applications would be processed more quickly.
formal.zh: 该办公室提出了加快程序办理的措施，以便更快处理申请。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għandek xi idea għat-taħfif tal-bagalja? Mark: Ħalli ż-żraben żejda hawn; par wieħed ikun biżżejjed.
colloquial.en: Lara: Do you have any ideas for making the suitcase lighter? Mark: Leave the extra shoes here; one pair will be enough.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你有什么办法能减轻行李箱的重量吗？Mark：把多带的鞋留在这里吧，一双就够了。

messages.speaker: Lara (旅伴)
messages.zh: 你有什么办法能减轻行李箱的重量吗？
messages.en: Do you have any ideas for making the suitcase lighter?

messages.speaker: Mark (旅伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħalli ż-żraben żejda hawn; par wieħed ikun biżżejjed.
messages.mt_standard: Ħalli ż-żraben żejda hawn; par wieħed ikun biżżejjed.
messages.zh: 把多带的鞋留在这里吧，一双就够了。
messages.en: Leave the extra shoes here; one pair will be enough.

cognitive_memory_aid: 联想行李箱拿掉重物后更轻、办事队伍推进后更快；用“重量减少、办理加快”并排记忆两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of forgiving someone; in a separate sense, digging into the ground or excavating a place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 宽恕他人的行为；另一个独立义项指挖土、开挖或发掘某处。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed jaħfer lil xi ħadd; f'tifsira separata, l-att li wieħed iħaffer l-art jew sit.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 宽恕、原谅他人的行为。
挖掘；挖土。
开挖；对某处进行挖掘或发掘。

formal.mt: L-ittra tiddeskrivi d-deċiżjoni tagħha li ma tibqax twaħħal fih bħala att ta' taħfir.
formal.en: The letter describes her decision to stop blaming him as an act of forgiveness.
formal.zh: 信中将她决定不再责怪他的举动描述为一次宽恕的行为。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Lest it-taħfir tal-ħofra għas-siġra? Lara: Kważi; għadni rrid inneħħi ftit ġebel mill-qiegħ.
colloquial.en: Mark: Have you finished digging the hole for the tree? Lara: Almost; I still need to remove a few stones from the bottom.
colloquial.zh: Mark：种树的坑挖好了吗？Lara：快了，我还得把坑底的几块石头拿出来。

messages.speaker: Mark (园艺伙伴)
messages.zh: 种树的坑挖好了吗？
messages.en: Have you finished digging the hole for the tree?

messages.speaker: Lara (园艺伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Kważi; għadni rrid inneħħi ftit ġebel mill-qiegħ.
messages.mt_standard: Kważi; għadni rrid inneħħi ftit ġebel mill-qiegħ.
messages.zh: 快了，我还得把坑底的几块石头拿出来。
messages.en: Almost; I still need to remove a few stones from the bottom.

cognitive_memory_aid: 建立两张独立记忆卡：一张是原谅朋友，另一张是拿铲子挖土；不要把宽恕与挖掘混成一个意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of imagining something, or depicting a person, place, or situation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在脑海中想象事物的活动，也可指对人物、地方或情境的描绘。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-attività li wieħed jistħajjel xi ħaġa jew jagħti stampa ta' persuna, post jew sitwazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 想象；在脑海中构想事物的活动。
描绘；用文字或形象呈现人物、事物或情境。

collocations.en: depiction of life in the countryside

formal.mt: It-taħjil tal-ħajja fil-kampanja f'dan ir-rakkont jgħin lill-qarrej jifhem l-esperjenzi tal-personaġġi.
formal.en: The depiction of countryside life in this story helps the reader understand the characters' experiences.
formal.zh: 这篇故事对乡村生活的描绘，有助于读者理解人物的经历。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'għoġbok l-aktar fir-rakkont? Pawlu: It-taħjil tar-raħal; waqt li kont naqra, stajt nistħajjel it-toroq tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: What did you like most about the story? Pawlu: The depiction of the village; as I read, I could imagine its streets.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你最喜欢这篇故事的哪一点？Pawlu：对村庄的描绘；读的时候，我能想象出村里的街道。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你最喜欢这篇故事的哪一点？
messages.en: What did you like most about the story?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: It-taħjil tar-raħal; waqt li kont naqra, stajt nistħajjel it-toroq tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: It-taħjil tar-raħal; waqt li kont naqra, stajt nistħajjel it-toroq tiegħu.
messages.zh: 对村庄的描绘；读的时候，我能想象出村里的街道。
messages.en: The depiction of the village; as I read, I could imagine its streets.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它联想成一幅脑内画面：自己在心里画是“想象”，用文字让别人看见则是“描绘”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of joining or repairing fabric with stitches, by hand or with a machine.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用针脚连接或修补布料的活动，可以手工进行，也可以使用缝纫机。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ix-xogħol li bih drapp jingħaqad jew jissewwa bil-punti, bl-idejn jew bil-magna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 缝纫；用针线缝合、制作或修补布料制品。

formal.mt: Il-kors jinkludi taħjit bl-idejn u bil-magna, kif ukoll tiswijiet sempliċi tal-ħwejjeġ.
formal.en: The course includes sewing by hand and by machine, as well as simple clothing repairs.
formal.zh: 课程包括手工缝纫、机器缝纫以及简单的衣物修补。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Tista' tgħinni nsewwi din il-qmis? Rita: Iva, għandi ftit ħin għat-taħjit illejla. Ġib il-labra u l-ħajt.
colloquial.en: Sara: Can you help me mend this shirt? Rita: Yes, I have a little time for sewing tonight. Bring the needle and thread.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你能帮我补一下这件衬衫吗？Rita：可以，我今晚有点时间做缝纫。把针和线拿来。

messages.speaker: Sara (女儿)
messages.zh: 你能帮我补一下这件衬衫吗？
messages.en: Can you help me mend this shirt?

messages.speaker: Rita (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għandi ftit ħin għat-taħjit illejla. Ġib il-labra u l-ħajt.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għandi ftit ħin għat-taħjit illejla. Ġib il-labra u l-ħajt.
messages.zh: 可以，我今晚有点时间做缝纫。把针和线拿来。
messages.en: Yes, I have a little time for sewing tonight. Bring the needle and thread.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住针线穿过布料的连续动作，把这个词和“手工缝纫、机器缝纫”两个场景一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of grating or scratching; also, social contact through mixing with particular people.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 刨碎或抓挠的活动；也可指与某些人接触、交往。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-attività li wieħed jaħkem wiċċ bi grattugia jew bid-dwiefer; ukoll, it-taħlit u l-kuntatt ma' ċerti nies.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 刨碎；用刨具将食材磨成碎屑或细丝。
抓挠；用指甲或其他物体刮擦表面。
与某些人接触、交往，尤其指有机会与特定圈子的人来往。

formal.mt: L-avveniment joffri opportunità ta' taħkik ma' artisti u kittieba minn diversi pajjiżi.
formal.en: The event offers an opportunity to rub shoulders with artists and writers from various countries.
formal.zh: 这场活动提供了与来自多个国家的艺术家和作家交流接触的机会。

colloquial.mt: Mark: X'għad fadal biex inlestu l-għaġin? Lara: It-taħkik tal-ġobon biss. Tista' tagħmlu int?
colloquial.en: Mark: What's left to do before the pasta is ready? Lara: Just grating the cheese. Can you do it?
colloquial.zh: Mark：意面做好之前还剩什么要做？Lara：只剩刨奶酪了。你能来做吗？

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 意面做好之前还剩什么要做？
messages.en: What's left to do before the pasta is ready?

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: It-taħkik tal-ġobon biss. Tista' tagħmlu int?
messages.mt_standard: It-taħkik tal-ġobon biss. Tista' tagħmlu int?
messages.zh: 只剩刨奶酪了。你能来做吗？
messages.en: Just grating the cheese. Can you do it?

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三个场景分别记义：厨房刨奶酪、手指抓皮肤、聚会接触名人；看后面的搭配判断意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of governing a country or community and exercising authority over its affairs.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 管理国家或群体事务并行使权力的活动，即治理或统治。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-attività li biha titmexxa pajjiż jew komunità u tiġi eżerċitata l-awtorità fuq l-affarijiet tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 治理；统治；行使权力并管理国家或群体事务。

formal.mt: It-taħkim ġust jitlob li dawk fil-poter jagħtu kont tad-deċiżjonijiet tagħhom.
formal.en: Just governance requires those in power to account for their decisions.
formal.zh: 公正的治理要求掌权者对自己的决策作出交代。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Fuq xiex se tikteb għall-lezzjoni tal-istorja? Adam: Fuq it-taħkim tal-gżira u kif inbidlet il-ħajja tan-nies.
colloquial.en: Nina: What will you write about for history class? Adam: About the governing of the island and how people's lives changed.
colloquial.zh: Nina：历史课的作业你打算写什么？Adam：写这座岛屿的治理，以及人们的生活发生了怎样的变化。

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq xiex se tikteb għall-lezzjoni tal-istorja?
messages.mt_standard: Fuq xiex se tikteb għall-lezzjoni tal-istorja?
messages.zh: 历史课的作业你打算写什么？
messages.en: What will you write about for history class?

messages.speaker: Adam (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq it-taħkim tal-gżira u kif inbidlet il-ħajja tan-nies.
messages.mt_standard: Fuq it-taħkim tal-gżira u kif inbidlet il-ħajja tan-nies.
messages.zh: 写这座岛屿的治理，以及人们的生活发生了怎样的变化。
messages.en: About the governing of the island and how people's lives changed.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词放进历史课的画面：有人掌权、管理地方事务，整项活动就是“治理或统治”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of requiring or formally having someone take an oath.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 要求某人宣誓或正式使某人完成宣誓的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li bih persuna tintalab tieħu ġurament jew titqiegħed formalment taħt ġurament.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某人宣誓；要求某人正式立誓，从而处于誓言约束之下。

formal.mt: F'din ix-xena, it-taħlif tax-xhud isir qabel ma jibda jagħti x-xhieda tiegħu.
formal.en: In this scene, the witness is put under oath before he begins giving his testimony.
formal.zh: 在这个场景中，证人在开始作证之前先被要求宣誓。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'qed jiġri f'din ix-xena tal-film? Pawlu: Qed isir it-taħlif tax-xhud; wara jibdew jistaqsuh.
colloquial.en: Maja: What's happening in this scene of the film? Pawlu: The witness is being put under oath; afterward they will start questioning him.
colloquial.zh: Maja：电影里的这个场景是在做什么？Pawlu：正在让证人宣誓；之后就会开始向他提问。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 电影里的这个场景是在做什么？
messages.en: What's happening in this scene of the film?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed isir it-taħlif tax-xhud; wara jibdew jistaqsuh.
messages.mt_standard: Qed isir it-taħlif tax-xhud; wara jibdew jistaqsuh.
messages.zh: 正在让证人宣誓；之后就会开始向他提问。
messages.en: The witness is being put under oath; afterward they will start questioning him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象法庭电影中有人引导证人立誓：学习重点是“使别人宣誓”这一行为和程序。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of making something sweeter, making something less tight, or undoing a knot or tie, depending on the sense.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 按不同义项，可指使食物或饮品变甜、使紧绷的东西变松，或解开绳结及绑扎。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Skont it-tifsira, l-att li xi ħaġa ssir aktar ħelwa, li xi ħaġa ssikkata tinħall ftit, jew li tinfetaħ għoqda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 加甜；使食物或饮品的味道变甜。
松开；降低某物的紧度或绷紧程度。
解开；解除绳结、绑带等形成的束缚。

formal.mt: L-eżerċizzju jinkludi l-irbit u t-taħlil ta' għoqod sempliċi f'ħabel qasir.
formal.en: The exercise includes tying and untying simple knots in a short rope.
formal.zh: 这项练习包括在一根短绳上打简单的结，再把结解开。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Tista' tgħinni niftaħ dan il-pakkett? Mark: Iva, imma t-taħlil ta' din l-għoqda se jieħu ftit ħin.
colloquial.en: Lara: Can you help me open this parcel? Mark: Yes, but untying this knot will take a little time.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你能帮我打开这个包裹吗？Mark：可以，不过解开这个结要花一点时间。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你能帮我打开这个包裹吗？
messages.en: Can you help me open this parcel?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma t-taħlil ta' din l-għoqda se jieħu ftit ħin.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma t-taħlil ta' din l-għoqda se jieħu ftit ħin.
messages.zh: 可以，不过解开这个结要花一点时间。
messages.en: Yes, but untying this knot will take a little time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 分三张卡记忆：茶杯配“加甜”，绷紧的绳子配“放松”，绳结配“解开”；靠宾语区分义项。

gloss_zh: 创造；勾起馋意；使人垂涎

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of creating things; in other senses, the act of arousing a craving or making someone's mouth water.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 创造事物的行为；其他义项指勾起馋意，或使人因想吃而口水直流。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li jinħolqu affarijiet; f'tifsiriet oħra, l-att li jitqanqal xewqat għall-ikel jew li wieħed jitħajjar jiekol tant li jiġih l-ilma f'ħalqu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 创造事物的行为；使新的事物产生。
勾起馋意；使人产生强烈的想吃欲望。
使人口水直流；让人因食物的吸引而垂涎。

collocations.en: making mouths water with photographs of food

formal.mt: Il-workshop jagħti spazju għat-taħliq ta' affarijiet ġodda minn materjali sempliċi.
formal.en: The workshop provides space for creating new things from simple materials.
formal.zh: 这个工作坊为利用简单材料创造新事物提供了空间。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Ara dawn ir-ritratti tal-kejkijiet! Adam: Dan kollu taħliq! Issa għandi aptit biċċa kejk.
colloquial.en: Nina: Look at these photos of cakes! Adam: This is all making my mouth water! Now I feel like a slice of cake.
colloquial.zh: Nina：看看这些蛋糕照片！Adam：看得我口水都要流了！现在我想吃一块蛋糕。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 看看这些蛋糕照片！
messages.en: Look at these photos of cakes!

messages.speaker: Adam (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan kollu taħliq! Issa għandi aptit biċċa kejk.
messages.mt_standard: Dan kollu taħliq! Issa għandi aptit biċċa kejk.
messages.zh: 看得我口水都要流了！现在我想吃一块蛋糕。
messages.en: This is all making my mouth water! Now I feel like a slice of cake.

cognitive_memory_aid: 分开记两个画面：工作坊里创造新东西，蛋糕照片前馋得流口水；食品语境帮助识别后两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of paying a bill, a debt, or an amount owed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 支付账单、偿还债务或付清应付款项的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għemil li bih jitħallas kont, dejn jew ammont dovut.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 付款这一行为；支付款项。

formal.mt: It-taħlis tal-kont għandu jsir qabel l-aħħar tax-xahar.
formal.en: Payment of the bill must be made before the end of the month.
formal.zh: 这笔账单必须在月底之前支付。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Min se jieħu ħsieb it-taħlis tal-kont? Pawlu: Jien, se nħallas bil-kard.
colloquial.en: Marta: Who will take care of paying the bill? Pawlu: I will. I'll pay by card.
colloquial.zh: Marta：谁来负责付账？Pawlu：我来，我用卡支付。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jieħu ħsieb it-taħlis tal-kont?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jieħu ħsieb it-taħlis tal-kont?
messages.zh: 谁来负责付账？
messages.en: Who will take care of paying the bill?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 我来，我用卡支付。
messages.en: I will. I'll pay by card.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象在账单上盖下“已付”章，把 taħlis 与完成付款这个动作联系起来记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of combining substances or things, or the mixture produced by combining them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把不同物质或事物混在一起的过程，也可指混合后形成的混合物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għemil li bih jitħalltu sustanzi jew affarijiet differenti, jew dak li jirriżulta minn dan.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 混合；把不同成分混在一起的过程。
混合物；由不同成分混合而成的东西。

formal.mt: It-taħlit tad-dqiq mal-ilma għandu jsir bil-mod biex ma jiffurmawx ċapep.
formal.en: The flour should be mixed with the water slowly to prevent lumps from forming.
formal.zh: 面粉与水应慢慢混合，以免结块。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'hemm f'dan it-taħlit ta' ħwawar? Mark: Bżar, kemmun u ftit kannella.
colloquial.en: Lara: What's in this spice mixture? Mark: Pepper, cumin, and a little cinnamon.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这份混合香料里有什么？Mark：胡椒、孜然，还有一点肉桂。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 这份混合香料里有什么？
messages.en: What's in this spice mixture?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 胡椒、孜然，还有一点肉桂。
messages.en: Pepper, cumin, and a little cinnamon.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用搅拌碗记两个义项：搅拌时是“混合”，碗里做好的东西是“混合物”，两者都对应 taħlit。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of separating seeds from cotton.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把棉籽从棉花中分离出来的加工过程，即轧棉或棉花去籽。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih iż-żrieragħ jiġu separati mill-qoton.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 棉花去籽；将棉籽与棉纤维分离的过程，即轧棉。

collocations.en: a machine for separating seeds from cotton

formal.mt: It-taħliġ tal-qoton jissepara ż-żrieragħ mill-fibri, li mbagħad jistgħu jiġu pproċessati aktar.
formal.en: Cotton ginning separates the seeds from the fibres, which can then be processed further.
formal.zh: 轧棉把棉籽与棉纤维分离，纤维随后可以进一步加工。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għal xiex kienet tintuża din il-magna? Toni: Għat-taħliġ tal-qoton. Kienet tissepara ż-żrieragħ mill-fibri.
colloquial.en: Sara: What was this machine used for? Toni: For cotton ginning. It separated the seeds from the fibres.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这台机器以前是用来做什么的？Toni：用来给棉花去籽。它把棉籽和棉纤维分开。

messages.speaker: Sara (参观者)
messages.mt_spoken: Għal xiex kienet tintuża din il-magna?
messages.mt_standard: Għal xiex kienet tintuża din il-magna?
messages.zh: 这台机器以前是用来做什么的？
messages.en: What was this machine used for?

messages.speaker: Toni (博物馆讲解员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għat-taħliġ tal-qoton. Kienet tissepara ż-żrieragħ mill-fibri.
messages.mt_standard: Għat-taħliġ tal-qoton. Kienet tissepara ż-żrieragħ mill-fibri.
messages.zh: 用来给棉花去籽。它把棉籽和棉纤维分开。
messages.en: For cotton ginning. It separated the seeds from the fibres.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住机器出口分成两堆的画面：一边是棉籽，一边是棉纤维，这个分离过程就是轧棉。

gloss_zh: 清理腾空；容人之量；苗床播种

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of cleaning out a place by removing dirt or unwanted contents.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过清除污物或不需要的东西，把一个地方清理干净、腾空的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-tneħħija tal-ħmieġ jew tal-affarijiet mhux meħtieġa minn post biex jitnaddaf u jitbattal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 清理内部；清除里面的污物或杂物，使地方腾空、干净。
容忍他人的能力；能够包容、忍耐别人的气量。
在苗床或准备好的种植畦中播撒种子。

collocations.en: the ability to bear with other people

formal.mt: It-taħmil tal-kamra għandu jitlesta qabel ma titqiegħed fiha l-għamara l-ġdida.
formal.en: The room must be cleaned out before the new furniture is placed in it.
formal.zh: 在把新家具放进房间之前，必须先完成房间的清理腾空工作。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għad fadal ħafna taħmil fil-kamra? Toni: Ftit biss; irridu nneħħu dawn il-kaxxi u nnaddfu l-art.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is there still much cleaning out to do in the room? Toni: Only a little; we need to remove these boxes and clean the floor.
colloquial.zh: Maja：房间里还有很多清理工作吗？Toni：只剩一点了；我们得搬走这些箱子，再把地板清洁一下。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 房间里还有很多清理工作吗？
messages.en: Is there still much cleaning out to do in the room?

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ftit biss; irridu nneħħu dawn il-kaxxi u nnaddfu l-art.
messages.mt_standard: Ftit biss; irridu nneħħu dawn il-kaxxi u nnaddfu l-art.
messages.zh: 只剩一点了；我们得搬走这些箱子，再把地板清洁一下。
messages.en: Only a little; we need to remove these boxes and clean the floor.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 taħmil 配三张独立记忆卡：清空房间、耐心容人、苗床撒种；阅读时根据场景选择对应义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The reddening of the face caused by embarrassment, shyness, or another emotion.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因尴尬、害羞或其他情绪而出现的面部发红。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħmura li tidher fil-wiċċ minħabba mistħija jew emozzjoni oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 脸红；因害羞、尴尬等情绪而面颊发红。

formal.mt: It-taħmir fil-wiċċ tal-istudent deher meta l-għalliem faħħru quddiem il-klassi.
formal.en: The student's blush became visible when the teacher praised him in front of the class.
formal.zh: 当老师在全班面前表扬他时，这名学生明显脸红了。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Innutajt it-taħmir f'wiċċek meta faħħrek l-għalliem. Mark: Iva, nistħi meta jfaħħruni quddiem kulħadd.
colloquial.en: Sara: I noticed your blush when the teacher praised you. Mark: Yes, I get shy when people praise me in front of everyone.
colloquial.zh: Sara：老师表扬你的时候，我注意到你脸红了。Mark：是啊，别人在大家面前夸我，我就会害羞。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Innutajt it-taħmir f'wiċċek meta faħħrek l-għalliem.
messages.mt_standard: Innutajt it-taħmir f'wiċċek meta faħħrek l-għalliem.
messages.zh: 老师表扬你的时候，我注意到你脸红了。
messages.en: I noticed your blush when the teacher praised you.

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, nistħi meta jfaħħruni quddiem kulħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, nistħi meta jfaħħruni quddiem kulħadd.
messages.zh: 是啊，别人在大家面前夸我，我就会害羞。
messages.en: Yes, I get shy when people praise me in front of everyone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象被老师当众表扬时双颊变红，把“情绪一来，脸上泛红”的画面与 taħmir 绑定记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Multiplication of a quantity by five, producing five times the original amount.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把一个数量乘以五，使结果成为原数量的五倍。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-multiplikazzjoni ta' kwantità b'ħamsa, biex ir-riżultat ikun ħames darbiet il-kwantità oriġinali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 五倍化；将原数量乘以五。

collocations.en: multiplication of the quantity by five
a fivefold multiplication of the count
collocations.zh: 把数目扩大到原来的五倍

formal.mt: It-taħmis ta' għaxar unitajiet jagħti ħamsin unità.
formal.en: Multiplying ten units by five gives fifty units.
formal.zh: 将十个单位乘以五，得到五十个单位。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Jekk għandna tliet kaxxi, kemm ikollna wara t-taħmis? Adam: Ħmistax-il kaxxa, jiġifieri ħames darbiet tlieta.
colloquial.en: Nina: If we have three boxes, how many will we have after multiplying by five? Adam: Fifteen boxes, which is five times three.
colloquial.zh: Nina：如果我们有三个箱子，乘以五以后有多少个？Adam：十五个箱子，也就是五乘以三。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Jekk għandna tliet kaxxi, kemm ikollna wara t-taħmis?
messages.mt_standard: Jekk għandna tliet kaxxi, kemm ikollna wara t-taħmis?
messages.zh: 如果我们有三个箱子，乘以五以后有多少个？
messages.en: If we have three boxes, how many will we have after multiplying by five?

messages.speaker: Adam (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħmistax-il kaxxa, jiġifieri ħames darbiet tlieta.
messages.mt_standard: Ħmistax-il kaxxa, jiġifieri ħames darbiet tlieta.
messages.zh: 十五个箱子，也就是五乘以三。
messages.en: Fifteen boxes, which is five times three.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在 taħmis 的词卡旁画五组相同物品，并写上“原数×5”；例如三箱变十五箱，结果是原来的五倍。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or process of making something dirty or foul.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物变脏、受到污损或污染的行为或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għemil li bih xi ħaġa ssir maħmuġa jew titniġġes.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 污损；使某物受到污物污染。
弄脏；使原本较干净的东西变脏。

formal.mt: It-taħmiġ tal-ilma biż-żejt jagħmel ħsara lill-ħajja fl-ilma.
formal.en: Fouling the water with oil harms aquatic life.
formal.zh: 用油污染水体会危害水生生物。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Il-logħob fit-tajn ifisser ħafna taħmiġ tal-ħwejjeġ! Ben: Naf, se nilbes ħwejjeġ qodma.
colloquial.en: Rita: Playing in the mud means getting your clothes very dirty! Ben: I know. I'll wear old clothes.
colloquial.zh: Rita：玩泥巴会把衣服弄得很脏！Ben：我知道，我会穿旧衣服。

messages.speaker: Rita (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-logħob fit-tajn ifisser ħafna taħmiġ tal-ħwejjeġ!
messages.mt_standard: Il-logħob fit-tajn ifisser ħafna taħmiġ tal-ħwejjeġ!
messages.zh: 玩泥巴会把衣服弄得很脏！
messages.en: Playing in the mud means getting your clothes very dirty!

messages.speaker: Ben (儿子)
messages.zh: 我知道，我会穿旧衣服。
messages.en: I know. I'll wear old clothes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一滴油落进清水、一个泥点落在白衣上，用“把东西弄脏”的共同画面记住 taħmiġ。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The work of forming or finishing an edge, for example along a piece of fabric.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 沿物体边缘进行制作或收整的工作，例如整理布料的边沿。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ix-xogħol li bih isir jew jiġi rfinut it-tarf ta' oġġett, bħal biċċa drapp.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 修边；沿物体边缘制作或整理边沿。
爱抚；表达亲爱之情的轻柔抚摸。

formal.mt: It-taħnik tat-truf tad-drapp għandu jsir b'attenzjoni biex ix-xogħol ikun pulit.
formal.en: The fabric edges should be finished carefully so that the work is neat.
formal.zh: 布料边缘应仔细收整，使成品整洁。

colloquial.mt: Marija: It-tifla ferħet bit-taħnik tan-nanna. Ġużeppi: Iva, in-nanna għaddiet idha bil-ħlewwa ma' wiċċha.
colloquial.en: Marija: The little girl was delighted by Grandma's caresses. Ġużeppi: Yes, Grandma gently stroked her face.
colloquial.zh: Marija：小女孩得到奶奶的爱抚，可开心了。Ġużeppi：是啊，奶奶轻轻抚摸了她的脸。

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.zh: 小女孩得到奶奶的爱抚，可开心了。
messages.en: The little girl was delighted by Grandma's caresses.

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, in-nanna għaddiet idha bil-ħlewwa ma' wiċċha.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, in-nanna għaddiet idha bil-ħlewwa ma' wiċċha.
messages.zh: 是啊，奶奶轻轻抚摸了她的脸。
messages.en: Yes, Grandma gently stroked her face.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 taħnik 配两幅分开的图：一幅是仔细整理布边，一幅是奶奶轻抚孩子；用“手工”和“亲情”语境区分两义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Gentle stroking or affectionate touching, sometimes used to soothe someone or lull them to sleep.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 轻柔地抚摸或亲昵地触碰，也可指借助温柔安抚使人平静或入睡。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-mess ħafif u affettwuż jew il-mogħdija tal-id bil-ħlewwa, xi drabi biex xi ħadd jikkalma jew jorqod.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 轻抚；用手轻轻地在表面或身体上来回抚摸。
爱抚；带着亲爱之情轻柔地触摸。
轻柔安抚；使人逐渐平静或进入睡眠。

formal.mt: It-taħnin ħafif fuq dahar it-tarbija għenha tikkalma u torqod.
formal.en: Gentle stroking on the baby's back helped her calm down and fall asleep.
formal.zh: 轻轻抚摸婴儿的背部，帮助她平静下来并入睡。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Il-qattus irid ftit taħnin. David: Se ngħaddi idi bil-mod fuq dahru.
colloquial.en: Elena: The cat wants a little stroking. David: I'll gently stroke his back.
colloquial.zh: Elena：猫咪想让人轻轻摸一摸。David：我来轻轻抚摸它的背。

messages.speaker: Elena (室友)
messages.zh: 猫咪想让人轻轻摸一摸。
messages.en: The cat wants a little stroking.

messages.speaker: David (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Se ngħaddi idi bil-mod fuq dahru.
messages.mt_standard: Se ngħaddi idi bil-mod fuq dahru.
messages.zh: 我来轻轻抚摸它的背。
messages.en: I'll gently stroke his back.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 taħnin 记成三个相邻画面：手掌轻抚猫背、亲人温柔爱抚、婴儿被安抚入睡；分别对应轻抚、爱抚和哄睡。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of becoming hoarse; also, the act of squeezing someone's throat.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 嗓音变得嘶哑的过程；也指掐住他人喉咙的行为，须根据语境区分。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih il-leħen isir maħnuq; ukoll, l-għafis ta' griżmejn persuna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 声音逐渐变得嘶哑。
扼住或掐住喉咙，使呼吸受阻的行为。

formal.mt: Wara sigħat ta' diskors, l-għalliem innota taħniq fil-leħen tiegħu.
formal.en: After hours of speaking, the teacher noticed his voice becoming hoarse.
formal.zh: 讲了几个小时后，老师发现自己的嗓音开始变得嘶哑。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Qed ninnota taħniq fil-leħen tiegħi wara l-kunċert. Lara: Tkellimt ħafna? Maja: Iva, u kantajt ukoll.
colloquial.en: Maja: I'm noticing my voice getting hoarse after the concert. Lara: Did you talk a lot? Maja: Yes, and I sang too.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：音乐会后，我发现自己的嗓音开始变哑。拉拉：你说了很多话吗？玛雅：是啊，还唱歌了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed ninnota taħniq fil-leħen tiegħi wara l-kunċert.
messages.mt_standard: Qed ninnota taħniq fil-leħen tiegħi wara l-kunċert.
messages.zh: 音乐会后，我发现自己的嗓音开始变哑。
messages.en: I'm noticing my voice getting hoarse after the concert.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你说了很多话吗？
messages.en: Did you talk a lot?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 是啊，还唱歌了。
messages.en: Yes, and I sang too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个喉咙场景记忆：说话太久会声嘶，喉咙被掐则是扼喉；看到 leħen 时优先联想嗓音义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The multiplication or proliferation of worms in a place or material.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 蠕虫在某个地方或某种物质中大量繁殖、增多的现象。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih il-vermi jitkattru f'post jew f'materjal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 蠕虫大量繁殖、数量不断增多的现象。

collocations.en: proliferation of worms in the soil

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi t-taħnix fil-frott li tħalla fil-maħżen.
formal.en: The report describes the proliferation of worms in the fruit left in the storeroom.
formal.zh: 报告描述了留在储藏室中的水果内虫子大量繁生的情况。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Hemm taħnix f'din il-kaxxa tat-tuffieħ. Rita: Mela ejja niċċekkjaw il-kaxxi l-oħra wkoll.
colloquial.en: Mark: Worms are multiplying in this box of apples. Rita: Then let's check the other boxes too.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这箱苹果里虫子大量繁生了。丽塔：那我们也检查一下其他箱子吧。

messages.speaker: Mark (仓库员工)
messages.zh: 这箱苹果里虫子大量繁生了。
messages.en: Worms are multiplying in this box of apples.

messages.speaker: Rita (仓库同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela ejja niċċekkjaw il-kaxxi l-oħra wkoll.
messages.mt_standard: Mela ejja niċċekkjaw il-kaxxi l-oħra wkoll.
messages.zh: 那我们也检查一下其他箱子吧。
messages.en: Then let's check the other boxes too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一箱水果里虫子越来越多：这个词记的是虫子繁生的现象，而非单独一条虫。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Firm or repeated insistence that something should happen or be accepted.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 坚定或反复地坚持某项要求、主张，希望某事实现或被接受。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-insistenza soda jew ripetuta biex issir xi ħaġa jew tintlaqa' talba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 坚持某项要求或主张；反复强调并要求对方接受。

formal.mt: Minkejja t-taħqiq tar-rappreżentanti, il-kumitat ma biddilx id-deċiżjoni tiegħu.
formal.en: Despite the representatives' insistence, the committee did not change its decision.
formal.zh: 尽管代表们一再坚持，委员会仍未改变决定。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex aċċettaw it-talba tiegħek fl-aħħar? Mark: Bit-taħqiq tiegħi; bqajt nitlobhom jerġgħu jaħsbuha.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did they finally accept your request? Mark: Because of my insistence; I kept asking them to reconsider.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：他们最后为什么接受了你的要求？马克：因为我一直坚持；我不断请他们重新考虑。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 他们最后为什么接受了你的要求？
messages.en: Why did they finally accept your request?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Bit-taħqiq tiegħi; bqajt nitlobhom jerġgħu jaħsbuha.
messages.mt_standard: Bit-taħqiq tiegħi; bqajt nitlobhom jerġgħu jaħsbuha.
messages.zh: 因为我一直坚持；我不断请他们重新考虑。
messages.en: Because of my insistence; I kept asking them to reconsider.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它放进反复请求的场景：别人尚未答应，你仍坚持同一要求；记住的是坚持这一行为。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The unjust or harsh treatment of people by someone who holds power over them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 掌握权力的人对他人施加不公或严酷待遇，使其受到压制。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-trattament inġust jew aħrax ta' nies minn min għandu s-setgħa fuqhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 利用权力对人进行不公正的压制或苛待。

formal.mt: L-artiklu janalizza t-taħqir tal-ħaddiema u t-talbiet tagħhom għal kundizzjonijiet aħjar.
formal.en: The article analyses the oppression of workers and their demands for better conditions.
formal.zh: 文章分析了工人遭受的压迫，以及他们改善工作条件的诉求。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fuq xiex kien id-dokumentarju? Lara: Fuq it-taħqir tal-ħaddiema u kif ingħaqdu biex jiddefendu d-drittijiet tagħhom.
colloquial.en: Maja: What was the documentary about? Lara: The oppression of workers and how they united to defend their rights.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那部纪录片讲什么？拉拉：讲工人遭受的压迫，以及他们如何团结起来维护自己的权利。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 那部纪录片讲什么？
messages.en: What was the documentary about?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq it-taħqir tal-ħaddiema u kif ingħaqdu biex jiddefendu d-drittijiet tagħhom.
messages.mt_standard: Fuq it-taħqir tal-ħaddiema u kif ingħaqdu biex jiddefendu d-drittijiet tagħhom.
messages.zh: 讲工人遭受的压迫，以及他们如何团结起来维护自己的权利。
messages.en: The oppression of workers and how they united to defend their rights.

cognitive_memory_aid: 联想权力像重物压在人身上，再用反抗压迫的场景记住 taħqir，突出不公与压制。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A fierce argument in which people strongly and angrily disagree.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 参与者因意见不合而愤怒、激烈地争执的一场争吵。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Argument qalil li fih in-nies juru n-nuqqas ta' qbil tagħhom b'rabja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一场激烈、火气很大的争吵。

formal.mt: Waqt il-laqgħa qamet taħra bejn żewġ membri dwar it-tqassim tal-fondi.
formal.en: During the meeting, a fierce argument broke out between two members over the allocation of funds.
formal.zh: 会议期间，两名成员就资金分配问题爆发了激烈争吵。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għaliex tlaqt mil-laqgħa? Mark: Qamet taħra, u ridt noħroġ ftit sakemm jikkalmaw.
colloquial.en: Rita: Why did you leave the meeting? Mark: A fierce argument broke out, and I wanted to step outside until they calmed down.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：你为什么离开会议了？马克：大家激烈地吵了起来，我想先出去一下，等他们冷静下来。

messages.speaker: Rita (同事)
messages.zh: 你为什么离开会议了？
messages.en: Why did you leave the meeting?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Qamet taħra, u ridt noħroġ ftit sakemm jikkalmaw.
messages.mt_standard: Qamet taħra, u ridt noħroġ ftit sakemm jikkalmaw.
messages.zh: 大家激烈地吵了起来，我想先出去一下，等他们冷静下来。
messages.en: A fierce argument broke out, and I wanted to step outside until they calmed down.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象会议桌两边的人越说越激动，用 qamet taħra 整块记忆为爆发了一场激烈争吵。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Escape from a place or evasion of something; also, the act of devastating or ruining something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从某处逃脱或逃避某事的行为；也指使地方遭到破坏，或使事物毁损的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħarba minn post jew l-evitar ta' xi ħaġa; ukoll, il-qerda ta' post jew il-ħsara li teqred xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 从受限制或危险的处境中逃走、脱身。
设法回避或逃避某事，例如责任或问题。
对某个地方进行严重破坏，使其荒废或满目疮痍。
使某物毁坏、受损，失去原有价值或用途。

formal.mt: Ir-rakkont jiddeskrivi pjan ta' taħrib mill-ħabs u d-diffikultajiet li l-priġunieri kellhom jegħlbu.
formal.en: The story describes a plan to escape from prison and the difficulties the prisoners had to overcome.
formal.zh: 故事描述了一项越狱计划，以及囚犯们必须克服的困难。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Meta tħalli x-xogħol kollu f'idejn ħaddieħor, dak ikun taħrib mir-responsabbiltà. Mark: Għandek raġun. Illum nagħmel il-parti tiegħi.
colloquial.en: Lara: When you leave all the work to someone else, that's evasion of responsibility. Mark: You're right. I'll do my share today.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：把所有工作都留给别人，就是逃避责任。马克：你说得对。我今天会完成自己那一份。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta tħalli x-xogħol kollu f'idejn ħaddieħor, dak ikun taħrib mir-responsabbiltà.
messages.mt_standard: Meta tħalli x-xogħol kollu f'idejn ħaddieħor, dak ikun taħrib mir-responsabbiltà.
messages.zh: 把所有工作都留给别人，就是逃避责任。
messages.en: When you leave all the work to someone else, that's evasion of responsibility.

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek raġun. Illum nagħmel il-parti tiegħi.
messages.mt_standard: Għandek raġun. Illum nagħmel il-parti tiegħi.
messages.zh: 你说得对。我今天会完成自己那一份。
messages.en: You're right. I'll do my share today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 分两组场景记忆：人离开牢房或躲开责任，地方与物品则遭到毁坏；用后面的搭配判断具体词义。

gloss_zh: 编造；编故事；换羽；落叶；脱毛

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of inventing or making up stories; also, moulting or the shedding of leaves or hair.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 编造内容或故事的行为；也指动物换羽、植物落叶或毛发脱落的过程，具体含义取决于语境。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħolqien ta' affarijiet jew stejjer mistħajla; ukoll, it-tibdil tar-rix jew il-waqgħa tal-weraq jew tax-xagħar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 凭想象编造出内容或事物。
编造故事或虚构叙述。
动物换羽或蜕换外层覆盖物的过程。
植物叶片脱落的过程，即落叶。
毛发脱落的过程，包括脱毛或掉发。

formal.mt: L-istudenti osservaw it-taħrif tal-għasafar u rreġistraw il-bidliet fir-rix tagħhom.
formal.en: The students observed the birds moulting and recorded the changes in their feathers.
formal.zh: 学生们观察了鸟类换羽，并记录了羽毛的变化。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Temmintu dak li qal? Lara: Le, dak kollu taħrif ta' stejjer. Maja: Mela ejja nistaqsu lil xi ħadd li kien hemm.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you believe what he said? Lara: No, it's all made-up stories. Maja: Then let's ask someone who was there.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你相信他说的话了吗？拉拉：没有，那些全是编出来的故事。玛雅：那我们问问当时在场的人吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你相信他说的话了吗？
messages.en: Did you believe what he said?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, dak kollu taħrif ta' stejjer.
messages.mt_standard: Le, dak kollu taħrif ta' stejjer.
messages.zh: 没有，那些全是编出来的故事。
messages.en: No, it's all made-up stories.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela ejja nistaqsu lil xi ħadd li kien hemm.
messages.mt_standard: Mela ejja nistaqsu lil xi ħadd li kien hemm.
messages.zh: 那我们问问当时在场的人吧。
messages.en: Then let's ask someone who was there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画两张记忆卡：一张是开口编故事，另一张是羽毛、树叶和毛发脱落；这是词义分组记法，不是词源解释。

gloss_zh: 色欲；对性事的过度好奇

teaching_sense.en_definition: Strong sexual desire, or excessive interest in sexual matters.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 强烈的性欲，或对性事过度关注、好奇的心理。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xewqa sesswali qawwija, jew interess żejjed fi kwistjonijiet sesswali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 强烈的性欲；色欲。
对性事的过度好奇或带有色情意味的关注。

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, it-taħrim tal-karattru jwasslu biex jittratta lill-oħrajn bħala oġġetti tax-xewqa.
formal.en: In the novel, the character's lust leads him to treat others as objects of desire.
formal.zh: 在这部小说中，这个人物的色欲使他把别人当作欲望的对象。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex il-karattru jġib ruħu hekk? Mark: Minħabba t-taħrim tiegħu; jaħseb biss fix-xewqat sesswali tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why does the character behave like that? Mark: Because of his lust; he thinks only about his sexual desires.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个人物为什么这样行事？马克：因为他的色欲；他只想着自己的性欲。

messages.speaker: Maja (读书会成员)
messages.zh: 这个人物为什么这样行事？
messages.en: Why does the character behave like that?

messages.speaker: Mark (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Minħabba t-taħrim tiegħu; jaħseb biss fix-xewqat sesswali tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Minħabba t-taħrim tiegħu; jaħseb biss fix-xewqat sesswali tiegħu.
messages.zh: 因为他的色欲；他只想着自己的性欲。
messages.en: Because of his lust; he thinks only about his sexual desires.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅画面帮助记忆：人物被强烈性欲支配，对应 lust；人物过度窥探性事，对应 prurience。两者都围绕性方面的欲望或关注。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process or act of burning something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某物燃烧的过程，或将某物烧掉的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li fih xi ħaġa tinħaraq, jew l-att li wieħed jaħraq xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 燃烧；将某物烧掉的焚烧行为。

formal.mt: It-taħriq tal-iskart fil-beraħ jista' jniġġes l-arja u jdejjaq lir-residenti.
formal.en: Burning waste in the open can pollute the air and disturb residents.
formal.zh: 露天焚烧垃圾可能污染空气，并给居民带来困扰。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Minn fejn ġej dan id-duħħan? Pawlu: Mit-taħriq tal-injam fil-ġnien ta' ħdejna.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where is this smoke coming from? Pawlu: From the burning of wood in the garden next door.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这些烟是从哪里来的？保罗：隔壁花园在烧木材，烟是那里来的。

messages.speaker: Lara (邻居)
messages.zh: 这些烟是从哪里来的？
messages.en: Where is this smoke coming from?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (邻居)
messages.zh: 隔壁花园在烧木材，烟是那里来的。
messages.en: From the burning of wood in the garden next door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词和木材燃烧、冒出烟的画面绑定；再用“焚烧垃圾”和“燃烧木材”两个搭配记住它表示燃烧这一过程或行为。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Intense drying or scorching caused by strong heat.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 强烈热力造成的烤干、干透或灼烤。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tnixxif qawwi jew ħruq fil-wiċċ ikkawżat minn sħana qawwija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 因强烈热力而烤干、变得十分干燥。
强热造成的灼烤或表面灼伤。

collocations.en: the scorching heat of the sun
