formal.mt: It-taħrir tax-xemx ħalla l-ħamrija niexfa u l-weraq mitbiel.
formal.en: The scorching heat of the sun left the soil dry and the leaves wilted.
formal.zh: 太阳的灼烤使土壤干燥、叶片枯萎。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex daħħalt il-pjanti ġewwa? Toni: Biex nipproteġihom mit-taħrir tax-xemx ta' waranofsinhar.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why did you bring the plants indoors? Toni: To protect them from the scorching afternoon sun.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你为什么把植物搬进屋了？托尼：为了保护它们，免受午后太阳的灼烤。

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.zh: 你为什么把植物搬进屋了？
messages.en: Why did you bring the plants indoors?

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex nipproteġihom mit-taħrir tax-xemx ta' waranofsinhar.
messages.mt_standard: Biex nipproteġihom mit-taħrir tax-xemx ta' waranofsinhar.
messages.zh: 为了保护它们，免受午后太阳的灼烤。
messages.en: To protect them from the scorching afternoon sun.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象烈日把泥土烤干、把叶片灼伤：泥土失水帮助记 parching，叶面受热受损帮助记 scorching。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of defending or protecting someone or something from danger or harm.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 防卫或保护人、事物，使其免受危险或伤害的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed jiddefendi jew jipproteġi lil xi ħadd jew lil xi ħaġa minn periklu jew ħsara.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 抵御威胁或攻击的防卫；防御。
使人或事物免受危险、损害的保护。

formal.mt: Il-politika tal-iskola tagħti prijorità lit-taħris tat-tfal minn kull forma ta' vjolenza.
formal.en: The school's policy prioritizes the protection of children from every form of violence.
formal.zh: 学校的政策优先保护儿童，使其免受各种形式的暴力。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex hemm xatba ħdejn il-pixxina? David: Għat-taħris tat-tfal, biex ma jidħlux waħedhom.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why is there a gate beside the pool? David: For the protection of children, so they do not go in on their own.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：泳池旁边为什么有一道门？戴维：为了保护孩子，防止他们独自进去。

messages.speaker: Sara (访客)
messages.zh: 泳池旁边为什么有一道门？
messages.en: Why is there a gate beside the pool?

messages.speaker: David (家长)
messages.mt_spoken: Għat-taħris tat-tfal, biex ma jidħlux waħedhom.
messages.mt_standard: Għat-taħris tat-tfal, biex ma jidħlux waħedhom.
messages.zh: 为了保护孩子，防止他们独自进去。
messages.en: For the protection of children, so they do not go in on their own.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“挡住危险，护住对象”串起两个义项：边境抵挡威胁是防卫，围栏护住孩子是保护，共同核心都是免受伤害。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Harsh severity in treatment or punishment, or a lack of mercy toward others.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对待或惩罚他人时的严酷，或缺乏怜悯、冷酷无情的态度。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħruxija fit-trattament jew fil-kastig, jew nuqqas ta' ħniena lejn ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对待他人或施行惩罚时的严厉、严酷。
毫无怜悯的冷酷；无情。

collocations.en: ruthlessness in the treatment of prisoners
collocations.zh: 对待囚犯时的冷酷无情

formal.mt: Ir-rapport ikkundanna t-taħrix fit-trattament tal-priġunieri u talab kundizzjonijiet aktar umani.
formal.en: The report condemned the ruthlessness in the treatment of prisoners and called for more humane conditions.
formal.zh: 报告谴责了对待囚犯时的冷酷无情，并要求提供更人道的条件。

colloquial.mt: Marta: X'ħsibt dwar id-direttur fil-film? Luqa: It-taħrix tiegħu beżżagħni; ma wera ħniena ma' ħadd.
colloquial.en: Marta: What did you think of the director in the film? Luqa: His ruthlessness frightened me; he showed mercy to no one.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：你觉得电影里的那位主管怎么样？卢卡：他的冷酷无情让我害怕；他对谁都没有怜悯。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.zh: 你觉得电影里的那位主管怎么样？
messages.en: What did you think of the director in the film?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: It-taħrix tiegħu beżżagħni; ma wera ħniena ma' ħadd.
messages.mt_standard: It-taħrix tiegħu beżżagħni; ma wera ħniena ma' ħadd.
messages.zh: 他的冷酷无情让我害怕；他对谁都没有怜悯。
messages.en: His ruthlessness frightened me; he showed mercy to no one.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它放进“处罚很严，待人无情”的场景：关注处罚的严酷程度时记 severity，关注毫无怜悯时记 ruthlessness。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Practice or organised training undertaken to develop a skill or improve performance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为掌握技能或提高表现而进行的练习，或有组织的训练与培训。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Prattika jew tagħlim organizzat biex persuna tiżviluppa ħila jew ittejjeb il-prestazzjoni tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为熟练掌握某种技能而进行的练习。
为培养能力、技能或体能而进行的训练或培训。

formal.mt: Il-kors jinkludi taħriġ prattiku biex il-parteċipanti jitgħallmu jużaw it-tagħmir.
formal.en: The course includes practical training so that participants learn to use the equipment.
formal.zh: 课程包含实操培训，让参与者学会使用设备。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għandek taħriġ illum? Maja: Iva, fis-sitta. Trid tiġi miegħi? Mark: Iva, niltaqgħu quddiem il-grawnd.
colloquial.en: Mark: Do you have training today? Maja: Yes, at six. Do you want to come with me? Mark: Yes, let's meet outside the sports ground.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你今天有训练吗？玛雅：有，六点。你想和我一起去吗？马克：想，我们在运动场外见吧。

messages.speaker: Mark (队友)
messages.zh: 你今天有训练吗？
messages.en: Do you have training today?

messages.speaker: Maja (队友)
messages.zh: 有，六点。你想和我一起去吗？
messages.en: Yes, at six. Do you want to come with me?

messages.speaker: Mark (队友)
messages.zh: 想，我们在运动场外见吧。
messages.en: Yes, let's meet outside the sports ground.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把每日反复练习和参加培训课程放在同一幅图里：两者都是为了把技能练得更熟，核心词就是 taħriġ。

gloss_zh: 为未来可能的情况作打算

teaching_sense.en_definition: Planning ahead for situations or needs that may arise in the future.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 针对未来可能出现的情况或需要，预先考虑并作出安排。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħsieb u ppjanar minn qabel għal sitwazzjonijiet jew ħtiġijiet li jistgħu jinqalgħu fil-futur.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为未来可能发生的各种情况预作打算和安排。

formal.mt: It-taħsib għal żminijiet diffiċli jinkludi t-tfaddil ta' flus għal spejjeż mhux mistennija.
formal.en: Planning for difficult times includes saving money for unexpected expenses.
formal.zh: 为困难时期预作安排，包括存钱以应付意外开支。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex qed iżżomm ftit flus fil-ġenb? Ben: Qed nagħmel ftit taħsib għall-futur, f'każ li jkolli bżonnhom.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why are you setting some money aside? Ben: I am doing a little planning for the future, in case I need it.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你为什么要留一些钱备用？本：我在为未来作些打算，以防需要用钱。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed iżżomm ftit flus fil-ġenb?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed iżżomm ftit flus fil-ġenb?
messages.zh: 你为什么要留一些钱备用？
messages.en: Why are you setting some money aside?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed nagħmel ftit taħsib għall-futur, f'każ li jkolli bżonnhom.
messages.mt_standard: Qed nagħmel ftit taħsib għall-futur, f'każ li jkolli bżonnhom.
messages.zh: 我在为未来作些打算，以防需要用钱。
messages.en: I am doing a little planning for the future, in case I need it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住“现在留一手，将来有准备”的画面：把备用金装进信封，联想到为未来可能发生的情况提前作安排。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of washing; also, the acquisition of something through one's own efforts.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 清洗、洗涤的行为；也指凭借自身努力取得某物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed jaħsel; ukoll, il-kisba ta' xi ħaġa permezz tal-isforzi tiegħu stess.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 清洗；洗涤。

sense_translations.en_definition: acquisition of a thing as a result of one's efforts
sense_translations.zh_definition: 凭借自己的努力取得某物；努力所得。

formal.mt: It-taħsil tal-idejn bis-sapun huwa parti mir-rutina ta' kuljum fl-iskola.
formal.en: Washing hands with soap is part of the daily routine at school.
formal.zh: 用肥皂洗手是学校日常活动的一部分。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Għad għandna ħafna xogħol tad-dar? Samwel: It-taħsil tal-ħwejjeġ lest; baqa' biss nonxruhom.
colloquial.en: Elena: Do we still have a lot of housework? Samwel: The clothes washing is done; we only need to hang them out.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：我们还有很多家务要做吗？萨姆韦尔：衣服已经洗好了，只剩下晾衣服。

messages.speaker: Elena (室友)
messages.zh: 我们还有很多家务要做吗？
messages.en: Do we still have a lot of housework?

messages.speaker: Samwel (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: It-taħsil tal-ħwejjeġ lest; baqa' biss nonxruhom.
messages.mt_standard: It-taħsil tal-ħwejjeġ lest; baqa' biss nonxruhom.
messages.zh: 衣服已经洗好了，只剩下晾衣服。
messages.en: The clothes washing is done; we only need to hang them out.

cognitive_memory_aid: 做两张独立的记忆卡：一张画洗手洗衣，记“洗涤”；另一张画努力后拿到成果，记“通过努力取得”。这是学习联想，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Rot or decay; also, expressions of sympathy after a death or toward someone who is suffering.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 腐烂、腐败；也指对死者亲友表示的吊唁，或对遭遇不幸者表示的同情。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li fih xi ħaġa titħassar jew tiddeterjora; ukoll, kliem ta' simpatija wara mewt jew lejn min ikun qed ibati.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有机物的腐烂；腐坏状态。
逐渐腐败、朽坏或衰败的过程。
对死者亲友表示的哀悼、慰问；吊唁。
对他人遭遇不幸或痛苦所表示的同情、怜惜与慰问。

collocations.en: words of condolence to the deceased's family
collocations.zh: 向死者家属表达的慰问

collocations.en: commiseration with those who are suffering

formal.mt: Wara l-mewt tal-għalliem, il-kap tal-iskola bagħat kliem ta' taħsir lill-familja tiegħu.
formal.en: After the teacher's death, the head of the school sent words of condolence to his family.
formal.zh: 那位教师去世后，校长向他的家属致以慰问。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għaliex warrabt dak it-tuffieħ? Ġorġ: Għandu sinjali ta' taħsir; ejja nużaw il-frott frisk.
colloquial.en: Rita: Why did you set those apples aside? Ġorġ: They show signs of rot; let's use the fresh fruit.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：你为什么把那些苹果放到一边？乔治：它们有腐烂的迹象；我们用新鲜水果吧。

messages.speaker: Rita (家人)
messages.zh: 你为什么把那些苹果放到一边？
messages.en: Why did you set those apples aside?

messages.speaker: Ġorġ (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandu sinjali ta' taħsir; ejja nużaw il-frott frisk.
messages.mt_standard: Għandu sinjali ta' taħsir; ejja nużaw il-frott frisk.
messages.zh: 它们有腐烂的迹象；我们用新鲜水果吧。
messages.en: They show signs of rot; let's use the fresh fruit.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按语境分两组记忆：食物、木材旁想到腐烂腐朽；慰问话语旁想到吊唁同情。吊唁涉及丧亲，同情可用于其他不幸，勿把两组义项混为一个。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of detecting or becoming aware of something through sensation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过感觉察觉某种事物或变化的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih wieħed iħoss jew jinduna b'xi ħaġa permezz tas-sensi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 感知；通过感觉察觉事物的过程。

formal.mt: L-esperiment juri kif it-taħsis tas-sħana jinbidel meta t-temperatura tal-ilma togħla.
formal.en: The experiment shows how the sensing of heat changes as the water temperature rises.
formal.zh: 这个实验展示了水温上升时，对热的感知如何发生变化。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'ifisser taħsis? Pawlu: Meta tħoss is-sħana ta' tazza f'idejk, dak hu eżempju ta' taħsis.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does taħsis mean? Pawlu: When you feel the warmth of a cup in your hands, that is an example of sensing.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：taħsis 是什么意思？保罗：当你感到手中杯子的温热时，那就是感知的一个例子。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: taħsis 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does taħsis mean?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta tħoss is-sħana ta' tazza f'idejk, dak hu eżempju ta' taħsis.
messages.mt_standard: Meta tħoss is-sħana ta' tazza f'idejk, dak hu eżempju ta' taħsis.
messages.zh: 当你感到手中杯子的温热时，那就是感知的一个例子。
messages.en: When you feel the warmth of a cup in your hands, that is an example of sensing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象双手捧着温热的杯子，把 taħsis 记成“察觉温度的感知过程”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: At the very bottom or in the lowest position.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 处于最底部或最低的位置，用来强调位置已经到底。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fl-aktar post baxx, fil-qiegħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在最低的位置；处于最下方
在最底部；在最底下

collocations.en: at the very bottom of the box
at the very bottom of the list

formal.mt: In-numru ta' referenza jidher taħt nett fil-paġna.
formal.en: The reference number appears at the very bottom of the page.
formal.zh: 参考编号显示在页面的最下方。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn poġġejt il-kotba l-qodma? Pawlu: Taħt nett fil-kaxxa, taħt il-ħwejjeġ.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where did you put the old books? Pawlu: At the very bottom of the box, underneath the clothes.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你把那些旧书放在哪儿了？Pawlu：箱子的最底下，在衣服下面。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你把那些旧书放在哪儿了？
messages.en: Where did you put the old books?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 箱子的最底下，在衣服下面。
messages.en: At the very bottom of the box, underneath the clothes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把箱子一层层翻到底，手指最后碰到箱底；把整个短语连同“最底下”的强调一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cough, expelling air suddenly through the throat with a short sound.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 咳嗽，即空气突然通过喉部排出并发出短促声音。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Joħroġ l-arja f'daqqa mill-gerżuma b'ħoss qasir ta' sogħla.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 咳嗽；发出咳嗽声。

formal.mt: Waqt il-qari, l-istudent taħtaħ darbtejn u mbagħad kompla jaqra.
formal.en: During the reading, the student coughed twice and then continued reading.
formal.zh: 朗读时，这名学生咳嗽了两次，随后继续朗读。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min taħtaħ? Mark: Jien. Skużani, issa nkompli naqra.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who coughed? Mark: I did. Sorry, I'll carry on reading now.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：谁刚才咳嗽了？马克：是我。抱歉，我现在继续读。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 谁刚才咳嗽了？
messages.en: Who coughed?

messages.speaker: Mark (学生)
messages.zh: 是我。抱歉，我现在继续读。
messages.en: I did. Sorry, I'll carry on reading now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 taħtaħ 分成两个短节奏来读，配上两声轻咳，帮助记住“咳嗽”这个动作。

gloss_zh: 木材的囤积；驼峰的形成

teaching_sense.en_definition: The hoarding of timber; also, the formation of a hump.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 囤积木材的行为；也指驼峰或驼背隆起的形成。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ġbir u l-ħażna tal-injam; ukoll, il-formazzjoni ta' ħotba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 囤积木材；将木材积存起来的行为。
驼峰或驼背隆起的形成。

collocations.en: formation of a hump on the back

formal.mt: It-taħtib għall-ħażna jeħtieġ post fejn l-injam jista' jinżamm niexef.
formal.en: Hoarding timber for storage requires a place where the wood can be kept dry.
formal.zh: 囤积木材需要一个能让木材保持干燥的存放地点。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Hawn taħtib ifisser il-ġbir tal-injam? Pawlu: Le, hawn qed jitkellmu dwar taħtib fid-dahar, jiġifieri l-formazzjoni ta' ħotba.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does taħtib mean collecting timber here? Pawlu: No, here they are talking about a hump forming on the back.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这里的 taħtib 是指积存木材吗？保罗：不是，这里说的是背部形成驼峰。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这里的 taħtib 是指积存木材吗？
messages.en: Does taħtib mean collecting timber here?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, hawn qed jitkellmu dwar taħtib fid-dahar, jiġifieri l-formazzjoni ta' ħotba.
messages.mt_standard: Le, hawn qed jitkellmu dwar taħtib fid-dahar, jiġifieri l-formazzjoni ta' ħotba.
messages.zh: 不是，这里说的是背部形成驼峰。
messages.en: No, here they are talking about a hump forming on the back.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 taħtib 画两张独立记忆卡：一张是囤积的木材，一张是形成的驼峰，靠上下文区分。

gloss_zh: 较低的；下层的；较低等的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Situated lower down, or inferior in level, rank, or quality.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 位置较低或位于下层的；也指等级、地位或质量较低的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jinsab aktar 'l isfel, jew li hu ta' livell, grad jew kwalità aktar baxxa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 较低的、下层的；等级或质量较低的。

formal.mt: Il-pjanta turi li l-arkivju jinsab fis-sular taħtieni tal-bini.
formal.en: The plan shows that the archive is on the lower floor of the building.
formal.zh: 平面图显示，档案室位于这栋建筑较低的一层。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Fejn hi l-kamra tal-laqgħat? Lara: Fis-sular taħtieni. Inżlu t-taraġ u ssibuha fuq il-lemin.
colloquial.en: Mark: Where is the meeting room? Lara: On the lower floor. Go down the stairs and you'll find it on the right.
colloquial.zh: 马克：会议室在哪里？拉拉：在下面一层。下楼后，你们会在右边找到它。

messages.speaker: Mark (访客)
messages.zh: 会议室在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the meeting room?

messages.speaker: Lara (接待员)
messages.mt_spoken: Fis-sular taħtieni. Inżlu t-taraġ u ssibuha fuq il-lemin.
messages.mt_standard: Fis-sular taħtieni. Inżlu t-taraġ u ssibuha fuq il-lemin.
messages.zh: 在下面一层。下楼后，你们会在右边找到它。
messages.en: On the lower floor. Go down the stairs and you'll find it on the right.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象电梯按钮中较低的一层，把 taħtieni 与“位置低、层级低”一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of snatching or grabbing something with a quick movement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用迅速的动作抢走或抓住某物的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed jaħtaf jew jaqbad xi ħaġa b'moviment ta' malajr.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 抢夺；突然将某物夺走的行为。
猛抓；迅速抓住某物的行为。

formal.mt: Ix-xhud iddeskriva t-taħtif tal-basket minn idejn il-mara.
formal.en: The witness described the snatching of the bag from the woman's hands.
formal.zh: 目击者描述了手提包从那名女子手中被抢走的经过。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex waqa' l-ballun? Mark: Minħabba t-taħtif. It-tnejn ippruvajna naqbduh fl-istess ħin.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did the ball fall? Mark: Because of the grabbing. We both tried to grab it at the same time.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：球为什么掉了？马克：因为我们都急着抓。我们俩同时伸手去抓它。

messages.speaker: Maja (队友)
messages.zh: 球为什么掉了？
messages.en: Why did the ball fall?

messages.speaker: Mark (队友)
messages.mt_spoken: Minħabba t-taħtif. It-tnejn ippruvajna naqbduh fl-istess ħin.
messages.mt_standard: Minħabba t-taħtif. It-tnejn ippruvajna naqbduh fl-istess ħin.
messages.zh: 因为我们都急着抓。我们俩同时伸手去抓它。
messages.en: Because of the grabbing. We both tried to grab it at the same time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一只手突然伸出：夺走包是“抢夺”，抓住球是“猛抓”，两幅画面帮助记住 taħtif。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of closing or securing something with a seal.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用封印或封缄将某物封闭、封好的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed jagħlaq jew jissiġilla xi ħaġa b'siġill.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 封缄；加封；用封印将某物封好。

formal.mt: It-taħtim tal-envelop bix-xama' sar wara li tpoġġiet l-ittra ġewwa.
formal.en: The envelope was sealed with wax after the letter had been placed inside.
formal.zh: 信件放入后，信封用蜡进行了封缄。

colloquial.mt: Maja: L-envelop lest? Pawlu: Għad fadal it-taħtim. Ġib ix-xama' u s-siġill.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is the envelope ready? Pawlu: It still needs sealing. Bring the wax and the seal.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：信封准备好了吗？保罗：还需要封缄。把蜡和印章拿来。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 信封准备好了吗？
messages.en: Is the envelope ready?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għad fadal it-taħtim. Ġib ix-xama' u s-siġill.
messages.mt_standard: Għad fadal it-taħtim. Ġib ix-xama' u s-siġill.
messages.zh: 还需要封缄。把蜡和印章拿来。
messages.en: It still needs sealing. Bring the wax and the seal.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象信封口滴上蜡，再压上印章，把整个“加封”的动作过程记作 taħtim。

gloss_zh: 接受割礼；接受包皮环切

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of undergoing circumcision, in which the foreskin is removed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 接受割礼或包皮环切的过程，即接受去除包皮的操作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed jgħaddi minn ċirkonċiżjoni, jiġifieri t-tneħħija tal-prepuzju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 接受割礼或包皮环切的行为、过程。

formal.mt: Qabel it-taħtin, l-adult irċieva spjegazzjoni tal-proċedura u kellu ħin biex jistaqsi mistoqsijiet.
formal.en: Before undergoing circumcision, the adult received an explanation of the procedure and had time to ask questions.
formal.zh: 接受包皮环切之前，这名成年人听取了操作说明，并有时间提出问题。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Xi jfisser taħtin f'dan il-fuljett? Lara: Ifisser li wieħed jgħaddi minn ċirkonċiżjoni.
colloquial.en: Mark: What does taħtin mean in this leaflet? Lara: It means undergoing circumcision.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这份小册子里的 taħtin 是什么意思？拉拉：意思是接受割礼或包皮环切。

messages.speaker: Mark (成年读者)
messages.zh: 这份小册子里的 taħtin 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does taħtin mean in this leaflet?

messages.speaker: Lara (护士)

messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li wieħed jgħaddi minn ċirkonċiżjoni.
messages.zh: 意思是接受割礼或包皮环切。
messages.en: It means undergoing circumcision.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 taħtin 放进“接受割礼前后”的时间线上，记住它强调的是接受这一操作的过程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The selection of someone for a post involving responsibility.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 选定某人担任负有责任的职位，即任命。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għażla ta' persuna biex tokkupa kariga b'responsabbiltà.

sense_translations.en_definition: selection of sb. to a position of responsibility
sense_translations.zh_definition: 选任某人担任负有责任的职位；任命
用棍棒殴打
棍击；棒打
下注；打赌
赌博

formal.mt: Il-kunsill approva t-taħtir ta' direttur ġdid biex imexxi ċ-ċentru.
formal.en: The council approved the appointment of a new director to lead the centre.
formal.zh: 理事会批准任命一名新主管来领导该中心。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Smajt bit-taħtir tad-direttur il-ġdid? Mark: Iva, se jibda x-xogħol it-Tnejn.
colloquial.en: Maja: Have you heard about the appointment of the new director? Mark: Yes, he starts work on Monday.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你听说任命新主管的消息了吗？Mark：听说了，他星期一开始上班。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 你听说任命新主管的消息了吗？
messages.en: Have you heard about the appointment of the new director?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)

messages.en: Yes, he starts work on Monday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用“任命主管”的场景记住常用教学义，再把棍打、下注和赌博分别做成语境卡，避免把不同义项混为一谈。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of removing goods or a load from a vehicle or container.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把货物或其他载物从车辆、货舱等处卸下的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li titneħħa merkanzija jew tagħbija minn vettura jew minn kontenitur.

sense_translations.en_definition: unloading (e.g. of merchandise, freight, the load carried in a car boot etc)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 卸货；卸下货物或载物，例如卸下商品、货运物资或汽车后备厢中的物品
书法；艺术性书写
画线；绘制线条

formal.mt: It-taħtit tal-merkanzija għandu jsir fiż-żona magħżula ħdejn il-maħżen.
formal.en: The unloading of merchandise must take place in the designated area beside the warehouse.
formal.zh: 卸货必须在仓库旁的指定区域进行。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Lestejtu t-taħtit tat-trakk? Lara: Għadna le; baqa' żewġ kaxxi.
colloquial.en: Mark: Have you finished unloading the truck? Lara: Not yet; there are two boxes left.
colloquial.zh: Mark：你们卸完卡车上的货了吗？Lara：还没有，还剩两箱。

messages.speaker: Mark (司机)
messages.zh: 你们卸完卡车上的货了吗？
messages.en: Have you finished unloading the truck?

messages.speaker: Lara (仓库工作人员)
messages.zh: 还没有，还剩两箱。
messages.en: Not yet; there are two boxes left.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“卡车旁卸箱子”记卸货义，再另画“毛笔写字”和“尺子画线”两张图，分别固定书法与画线两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Dry coughing, with no phlegm being brought up.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 不咳出痰液的咳嗽，即干咳。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sogħla niexfa li ma ttellax bżieq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 干咳；不咳出痰液的咳嗽。

formal.mt: Fir-rapport, il-pazjent iddeskriva taħtiħ matul il-lejl li kien iqajmu mill-irqad.
formal.en: In the report, the patient described dry coughing during the night that woke him from sleep.
formal.zh: 报告中，患者描述了夜间会把自己咳醒的干咳。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Irqadt tajjeb? Mark: Le, it-taħtiħ qajjimni diversi drabi.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did you sleep well? Mark: No, the dry coughing woke me several times.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你睡得好吗？马克：不好，干咳把我弄醒了好几次。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你睡得好吗？
messages.en: Did you sleep well?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 不好，干咳把我弄醒了好几次。
messages.en: No, the dry coughing woke me several times.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记忆时给 taħtiħ 配上“咳咳却没有痰”的画面，抓住“干咳”这个名词意义。

gloss_zh: 下方的；下层的；较低等的；低级别的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Situated underneath something else, or lower in level or rank.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 位于其他事物下方的，或在层次、等级上较低的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jinsab taħt xi ħaġa oħra, jew li għandu livell jew grad aktar baxx.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 位于下面的；处在下方的
下方的；较低处的
较低等的；次等的
级别低的；职位较低的

formal.mt: Is-saff taħtni tal-ħamrija fih aktar ġebel mis-saff ta' fuq.
formal.en: The lower layer of soil contains more stones than the upper layer.
formal.zh: 下层土壤所含的石块比上层更多。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Liema saff se nkejlu l-ewwel? Toni: Is-saff taħtni; imbagħad inkejlu dak ta' fuq.
colloquial.en: Maja: Which layer shall we measure first? Toni: The lower layer; then we will measure the upper one.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我们先测量哪一层？Toni：下层，然后再测量上层。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 我们先测量哪一层？
messages.en: Which layer shall we measure first?

messages.speaker: Toni (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Is-saff taħtni; imbagħad inkejlu dak ta' fuq.
messages.mt_standard: Is-saff taħtni; imbagħad inkejlu dak ta' fuq.
messages.zh: 下层，然后再测量上层。
messages.en: The lower layer; then we will measure the upper one.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画上下两层土壤，把这个形容词贴在下层；再画职位阶梯，帮助区分空间较低与级别较低两种用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Lower in rank or standing than another person or thing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 相对于另一人或事物，等级或地位较低的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu grad jew pożizzjoni aktar baxxa minn ta' ħaddieħor jew ta' xi ħaġa oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 较低等的；处于较低地位的
级别较低的；等级在下的

formal.mt: Uffiċjal taħtnieni għandu jgħaddi t-talba lill-uffiċjal responsabbli għall-approvazzjoni.
formal.en: A lower-ranking official must forward the request to the official responsible for approval.
formal.zh: 级别较低的官员必须把申请转交给负责审批的官员。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Dan l-uffiċjal jista' japprova t-talba? Sara: Le, huwa uffiċjal taħtnieni; l-approvazzjoni trid tiġi minn fuq.
colloquial.en: Mark: Can this official approve the request? Sara: No, he is a lower-ranking official; approval has to come from above.
colloquial.zh: Mark：这位官员能批准申请吗？Sara：不能，他的级别较低，需要由上级批准。

messages.speaker: Mark (办事人)
messages.zh: 这位官员能批准申请吗？
messages.en: Can this official approve the request?

messages.speaker: Sara (接待员)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, huwa uffiċjal taħtnieni; l-approvazzjoni trid tiġi minn fuq.
messages.mt_standard: Le, huwa uffiċjal taħtnieni; l-approvazzjoni trid tiġi minn fuq.
messages.zh: 不能，他的级别较低，需要由上级批准。
messages.en: No, he is a lower-ranking official; approval has to come from above.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象组织图上较低的一格，标上“级别较低”；用职位关系记这个词，不把级别高低理解为人的价值高低。

teaching_sense.en_definition: In a concealed or sneaky way, without letting others know.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以隐瞒他人、避免被发现的方式做事；偷偷地或秘密地。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'mod moħbi jew bil-moħbi, mingħajr ma jkun jaf ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 偷偷摸摸地；鬼鬼祟祟地
秘密地；在暗中进行地

formal.mt: Il-membri ltaqgħu taħtniet biex jiddiskutu l-bidla qabel il-laqgħa uffiċjali.
formal.en: The members met secretly to discuss the change before the official meeting.
formal.zh: 成员们在正式会议之前秘密会面，讨论这项变动。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex qed torganizzaw kollox taħtniet? Maja: Qed inħejju sorpriża għal Pawlu; tgħidlu xejn!
colloquial.en: Lara: Why are you organising everything in secret? Maja: We are preparing a surprise for Pawlu; don't tell him anything!
colloquial.zh: Lara：你们为什么偷偷安排这一切？Maja：我们在给Pawlu准备惊喜，别告诉他！

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你们为什么偷偷安排这一切？
messages.en: Why are you organising everything in secret?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed inħejju sorpriża għal Pawlu; tgħidlu xejn!
messages.mt_standard: Qed inħejju sorpriża għal Pawlu; tgħidlu xejn!
messages.zh: 我们在给Pawlu准备惊喜，别告诉他！
messages.en: We are preparing a surprise for Pawlu; don't tell him anything!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象朋友们压低声音筹备惊喜，把这个词贴在“怎样安排”旁边，记住它说明动作秘密进行的方式。

teaching_sense.en_definition: In secret or in private, away from public attention.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 不公开地进行，或在私下、不让外人知晓的情况下进行。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bil-moħbi jew fil-privat, mingħajr ma jsir magħruf pubblikament.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 秘密地；私下地；不公开地

collocations.en: to reach an agreement in secret

formal.mt: Ir-rappreżentanti ddiskutew il-proposta taħtnijiet qabel ma ppreżentawha lill-kumitat.
formal.en: The representatives discussed the proposal privately before presenting it to the committee.
formal.zh: 代表们先私下讨论了提案，然后才将其提交委员会。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Nistgħu nitkellmu taħtnijiet wara l-laqgħa? Mark: Iva, nistenna hawn sakemm joħorġu l-oħrajn.
colloquial.en: Sara: Can we talk privately after the meeting? Mark: Yes, I will wait here until the others leave.
colloquial.zh: Sara：会后我们能私下谈谈吗？Mark：可以，我在这里等其他人离开。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 会后我们能私下谈谈吗？
messages.en: Can we talk privately after the meeting?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, nistenna hawn sakemm joħorġu l-oħrajn.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, nistenna hawn sakemm joħorġu l-oħrajn.
messages.zh: 可以，我在这里等其他人离开。
messages.en: Yes, I will wait here until the others leave.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“会后留下来私下谈”画成小场景，整词对应“秘密地、私下地”；与相近拼写分别制作词卡，避免漏写字母。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having an empty space inside rather than being solid throughout.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 内部有空腔、并非从里到外都实心的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu spazju vojt minn ġewwa u mhuwiex solidu kollu kemm hu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 空心的；中空的；内部有空腔的

formal.mt: L-istudenti osservaw zokk taħtuħ u kejlu l-ispazju vojt ġewwa fih.
formal.en: The students observed a hollow tree trunk and measured the empty space inside it.
formal.zh: 学生们观察了一段空心树干，并测量了它内部的空腔。

colloquial.mt: Toni: Għaliex dan iz-zokk daqshekk ħafif? Maja: Għax huwa taħtuħ; ara kemm hu vojt minn ġewwa.
colloquial.en: Toni: Why is this tree trunk so light? Maja: Because it is hollow; look how empty it is inside.
colloquial.zh: Toni：这段树干为什么这么轻？Maja：因为它是空心的，你看里面多空。

messages.speaker: Toni (学生)
messages.zh: 这段树干为什么这么轻？
messages.en: Why is this tree trunk so light?

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax huwa taħtuħ; ara kemm hu vojt minn ġewwa.
messages.mt_standard: Għax huwa taħtuħ; ara kemm hu vojt minn ġewwa.
messages.zh: 因为它是空心的，你看里面多空。
messages.en: Because it is hollow; look how empty it is inside.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一段切开的树干，外面有木壁、里面有空腔；将这个词与截面图一起记，牢牢记住“中空”的形状特征。

gloss_zh: 混乱；混合物；杂乱的一堆；乱摊子；纠结

teaching_sense.en_definition: A state of disorder or confusion, or a mixture of things that are jumbled or tangled together.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 事物失去秩序、混杂或纠缠在一起的状态，也可指混在一起的东西。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Stat ta' diżordni jew konfużjoni, jew taħlita ta' affarijiet imħalltin jew imħabblin flimkien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 无序；事物没有按应有的秩序排列或运作的状态。
混合物；不同成分或事物混在一起形成的整体。
混乱；缺乏组织、难以掌控的局面。
杂乱的一堆；各种东西混杂堆放在一起。
乱摊子；凌乱、不整洁或令人困扰的状况。
纠结；线、绳等缠绕在一起形成的混乱状态。

formal.mt: It-taħwid fid-dokumenti għamilha diffiċli li nsibu l-informazzjoni meħtieġa.
formal.en: The disorder in the documents made it difficult to find the information we needed.
formal.zh: 文件杂乱无章，使我们很难找到所需的信息。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhu dan it-taħwid fuq il-mejda? Mark: Qed infittex karta; meta nsibha, nirranġa kollox.
colloquial.en: Maja: What's all this mess on the table? Mark: I'm looking for a piece of paper; once I find it, I'll tidy everything up.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：桌上怎么乱成这样？马克：我在找一张纸，找到以后就把东西都收拾好。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 桌上怎么乱成这样？
messages.en: What's all this mess on the table?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed infittex karta; meta nsibha, nirranġa kollox.
messages.mt_standard: Qed infittex karta; meta nsibha, nirranġa kollox.
messages.zh: 我在找一张纸，找到以后就把东西都收拾好。
messages.en: I'm looking for a piece of paper; once I find it, I'll tidy everything up.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象桌上纸张混成一堆、线绳缠成一团，用同一个混乱画面串联“无序、混合、杂乱、纠结”等义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of putting seeds or plants into the ground so that they can grow.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将种子或植株放入土中，使其生长的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li jitqiegħdu żrieragħ jew pjanti fil-ħamrija biex jikbru.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 种植；把种子播入土中或把植株栽入土中的行为。

formal.mt: Il-programm jinkludi t-taħwil ta' għaxar siġar fil-ġnien tal-iskola.
formal.en: The programme includes planting ten trees in the school garden.
formal.zh: 这项计划包括在学校花园里栽种十棵树。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Lest għat-taħwil tal-fjuri? Toni: Iva, il-qsari u l-ħamrija qegħdin hawn.
colloquial.en: Sara: Ready to plant the flowers? Toni: Yes, the pots and soil are here.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：准备好栽花了吗？托尼：准备好了，花盆和土都在这里。

messages.speaker: Sara (园艺伙伴)
messages.zh: 准备好栽花了吗？
messages.en: Ready to plant the flowers?

messages.speaker: Toni (园艺伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-qsari u l-ħamrija qegħdin hawn.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-qsari u l-ħamrija qegħdin hawn.
messages.zh: 准备好了，花盆和土都在这里。
messages.en: Yes, the pots and soil are here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象双手把小树苗放入土坑，再轻轻盖上泥土；把这一整套“栽种”动作与 taħwil 联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of adding spices to food to give it flavour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 往食物中加入香料，使其增添风味的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li jiżdiedu ħwawar mal-ikel biex jingħata t-togħma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 添加香料；通过加入香料为食物调味。

formal.mt: Ir-riċetta tinkludi t-taħwir tal-laħam bil-kemmun u l-bżar iswed qabel it-tisjir.
formal.en: The recipe includes seasoning the meat with cumin and black pepper before cooking.
formal.zh: 这份食谱要求在烹饪前用孜然和黑胡椒给肉调味。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'se nużaw għat-taħwir tas-soppa? Mark: Ftit kemmun u bżar iswed.
colloquial.en: Nina: What shall we use to season the soup? Mark: A little cumin and black pepper.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我们用什么香料给汤调味？马克：一点孜然和黑胡椒。

messages.speaker: Nina (一起做饭的朋友)
messages.zh: 我们用什么香料给汤调味？
messages.en: What shall we use to season the soup?

messages.speaker: Mark (一起做饭的朋友)
messages.zh: 一点孜然和黑胡椒。
messages.en: A little cumin and black pepper.

cognitive_memory_aid: 脑中放一锅正在煮的汤，手边摆着孜然和胡椒；撒入香料的那一步就是 taħwir，重点记“加香料”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Sexual intercourse involving penetration of the anus.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 涉及肛门插入的性交行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Att sesswali li jinvolvi penetrazzjoni tal-anus.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 肛交；涉及肛门插入的性交行为。

formal.mt: F'dan it-test, il-kelma 'taħwiħ' tirreferi għal att sesswali li jinvolvi penetrazzjoni tal-anus.
formal.en: In this text, the word 'taħwiħ' refers to a sexual act involving penetration of the anus.
formal.zh: 在本文中，taħwiħ 一词指涉及肛门插入的性行为。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi tfisser 'taħwiħ' f'din is-sentenza? Pawlu: Tfisser sess anali.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does 'taħwiħ' mean in this sentence? Pawlu: It means anal sex.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：这个句子里的 taħwiħ 是什么意思？保罗：意思是肛交。

messages.speaker: Lara (成年学生)
messages.zh: 这个句子里的 taħwiħ 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'taħwiħ' mean in this sentence?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (语言教师)
messages.zh: 意思是肛交。
messages.en: It means anal sex.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词放入中性的身体与性行为词汇卡片，正面写 taħwiħ，背面写“肛交”，用准确释义帮助记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of increasing the thickness of an object, such as a beam.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 增加某个物体厚度的行为，例如将梁加厚。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tiżdied il-ħxuna ta' xi ħaġa, bħal travu.

sense_translations.en_definition: the act of making sth. thicker, like a beam
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某物变厚的行为，例如增加梁的厚度。

collocations.en: increasing the thickness of the wood

formal.mt: Il-pjan juri t-taħxib tat-travu minn għaxar ċentimetri għal tnax-il ċentimetru.
formal.en: The plan shows the beam being increased in thickness from ten centimetres to twelve centimetres.
formal.zh: 图纸显示，这根梁的厚度将从十厘米增加到十二厘米。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex hemm bżonn it-taħxib ta' dan it-travu? Toni: Għax il-pjan jitlob travu eħxen.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why does this beam need to be made thicker? Toni: Because the plan calls for a thicker beam.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：为什么需要把这根梁加厚？托尼：因为图纸要求用更厚的梁。

messages.speaker: Lara (木工学徒)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex hemm bżonn it-taħxib ta' dan it-travu?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex hemm bżonn it-taħxib ta' dan it-travu?
messages.zh: 为什么需要把这根梁加厚？
messages.en: Why does this beam need to be made thicker?

messages.speaker: Toni (木工师傅)
messages.zh: 因为图纸要求用更厚的梁。
messages.en: Because the plan calls for a thicker beam.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画两根长度相同、厚度不同的梁，再画箭头从薄梁指向厚梁；把“物体加厚”的变化记为 taħxib。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of trapping or pinching a finger somewhere, eating excessively, or making a person or animal fatter.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指手指被门等夹住，也可指把自己吃得过饱，或使人或动物长胖。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-qbid u l-għafis ta' saba' xi mkien, bħal f'bieb; ukoll l-att li wieħed jiekol iżżejjed jew li jżid ix-xaħam ta' persuna jew annimal.

sense_translations.en_definition: catching one's finger somewhere (e.g. a door)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 手指被夹住，例如被门夹住。
暴食；大量进食，把自己吃得过饱。
催肥；使人或动物增加脂肪、变得更胖。

collocations.en: getting fingers caught in the door

collocations.zh: 用食物把自己塞得过饱

formal.mt: Id-disinn il-ġdid tal-bieb għandu l-għan li jnaqqas ir-riskju ta' taħxim tas-swaba'.
formal.en: The new door design aims to reduce the risk of fingers getting caught.
formal.zh: 这种新的门体设计旨在降低夹住手指的风险。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed iżżomm il-bieb miftuħ? Pawlu: Biex nevitaw it-taħxim tas-swaba' waqt li nċaqalqu din il-kaxxa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you holding the door open? Pawlu: To avoid getting our fingers caught while we move this box.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么扶着门不让它关上？保罗：这样搬这个箱子时，我们的手指就不会被夹住。

messages.speaker: Maja (搬家帮手)
messages.zh: 你为什么扶着门不让它关上？
messages.en: Why are you holding the door open?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (搬家帮手)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex nevitaw it-taħxim tas-swaba' waqt li nċaqalqu din il-kaxxa.
messages.mt_standard: Biex nevitaw it-taħxim tas-swaba' waqt li nċaqalqu din il-kaxxa.
messages.zh: 这样搬这个箱子时，我们的手指就不会被夹住。
messages.en: To avoid getting our fingers caught while we move this box.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三格学习卡分别画“门夹手指、吃得太撑、动物长胖”，每格都标 taħxim；这是分义记忆法，不表示三个义项有共同来源。

gloss_zh: 催肥；增胖；使酱汁等变稠

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or process of making a person or animal fatter, or making a liquid such as a sauce thicker.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人或动物长胖的行为或过程，也指让酱汁等液体变得更稠。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att jew il-proċess li persuna jew annimal isiru aktar ħoxnin, jew li likwidu bħal zalza jsir aktar magħqud.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 催肥；使人或动物长胖、增加脂肪的过程。
增稠；使酱汁等液体变得更稠的过程。

formal.mt: Ir-riċetta tinkludi pass għat-taħxin taz-zalza bi ftit dqiq.
formal.en: The recipe includes a step for thickening the sauce with a little flour.
formal.zh: 这份食谱包含用少量面粉使酱汁变稠的步骤。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan id-dqiq għat-taħxin taz-zalza? Mark: Iva, żid ftit minnu u ħawwad sew.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is this flour for thickening the sauce? Mark: Yes, add a little of it and stir well.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这些面粉是用来让酱汁变稠的吗？马克：对，加一点进去，再充分搅拌。

messages.speaker: Sara (烹饪学员)
messages.zh: 这些面粉是用来让酱汁变稠的吗？
messages.en: Is this flour for thickening the sauce?

messages.speaker: Mark (烹饪教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, żid ftit minnu u ħawwad sew.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, żid ftit minnu u ħawwad sew.
messages.zh: 对，加一点进去，再充分搅拌。
messages.en: Yes, add a little of it and stir well.

cognitive_memory_aid: 并排想象“动物变胖”和“酱汁变稠”两幅图，分别标出对象；记住 taħxin 的两个义项都需要结合对象理解。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of keeping something hidden from view or covering it with a veil.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物不被看见的隐藏行为，或用面纱、罩布等将其遮盖的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li xi ħaġa tinżamm moħbija mill-vista jew titgħatta b'velu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 隐藏；使事物不被看见。
蒙上面纱或罩布；遮盖。

collocations.en: covering the face with a veil

formal.mt: Fl-eżerċizzju tat-teatru, it-taħġib tal-wiċċ b'velu jintuża biex tinħeba l-identità tal-karattru.
formal.en: In the theatre exercise, covering the face with a veil is used to hide the character's identity.
formal.zh: 在这项戏剧练习中，用面纱遮脸是为了隐藏角色的身份。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex hemm bżonn it-taħġib tar-rigal? Mark: Biex Lara ma tarahx qabel il-festa; irridu nagħmlulha sorpriża.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why does the gift need to be hidden? Mark: So Lara won't see it before the party; we want to surprise her.
colloquial.zh: Anna：为什么要把礼物藏起来？Mark：这样Lara在聚会前就看不到了，我们想给她一个惊喜。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 为什么要把礼物藏起来？
messages.en: Why does the gift need to be hidden?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex Lara ma tarahx qabel il-festa; irridu nagħmlulha sorpriża.
messages.mt_standard: Biex Lara ma tarahx qabel il-festa; irridu nagħmlulha sorpriża.
messages.zh: 这样Lara在聚会前就看不到了，我们想给她一个惊喜。
messages.en: So Lara won't see it before the party; we want to surprise her.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象礼物藏进柜子、脸部蒙上面纱：前者帮助记“隐藏”，后者帮助记“遮盖”，共同画面是看不见。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of throwing stones at a person, including as a form of punishment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向人投掷石头进行攻击的行为，也可指作为惩罚方式的石刑。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li jintefa' l-ġebel lejn persuna biex tintlaqat, ukoll bħala forma ta' kastig.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 向人投掷石头；用石头砸人的攻击或惩罚行为。

collocations.zh: 对投石攻击或石刑的谴责

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jikkundanna t-taħġir u jitlob protezzjoni għall-persuni fil-periklu.
formal.en: The report condemns stoning and calls for protection for people at risk.
formal.zh: 该报告谴责投石攻击，并要求保护面临危险的人。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser taħġir f'din is-sentenza? Mark: Ifisser li jitfgħu l-ġebel lejn persuna; hawn l-awtur qed jikkundanna din il-vjolenza.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does taħġir mean in this sentence? Mark: It means throwing stones at a person; here the author is condemning this violence.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这句话里的taħġir是什么意思？Mark：指向人投掷石头；这里作者是在谴责这种暴力。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这句话里的taħġir是什么意思？
messages.en: What does taħġir mean in this sentence?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li jitfgħu l-ġebel lejn persuna; hawn l-awtur qed jikkundanna din il-vjolenza.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li jitfgħu l-ġebel lejn persuna; hawn l-awtur qed jikkundanna din il-vjolenza.
messages.zh: 指向人投掷石头；这里作者是在谴责这种暴力。
messages.en: It means throwing stones at a person; here the author is condemning this violence.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“石头被投向人”的简笔画记住动作名词，再配上“谴责投石攻击”的短语巩固语境。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A pilgrimage to Mecca; in a separate sense, the burning of a fire with strong flames.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 前往麦加朝觐；另一个独立义项指火焰旺盛燃烧。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pellegrinaġġ lejn Mekka; f'tifsira separata, il-ħruq tan-nar bi fjammi qawwija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 前往麦加朝觐。
熊熊燃烧；烈焰旺盛燃烧。

formal.mt: L-awtur jiddeskrivi t-tħejjijiet tal-familja għat-taħġiġ lejn Mekka.
formal.en: The author describes the family's preparations for the pilgrimage to Mecca.
formal.zh: 作者描述了这家人为赴麦加朝觐所作的准备。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Qed tara t-taħġiġ tan-nar fil-fuklar? Mark: Iva, il-fjammi huma għoljin; ejja nżommu s-siġġijiet ftit aktar 'il bogħod.
colloquial.en: Lara: Can you see the fire blazing in the fireplace? Mark: Yes, the flames are high; let's keep the chairs a little farther away.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你看到壁炉里的火烧得多旺了吗？Mark：看到了，火焰很高，我们把椅子放远一点吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (家人)
messages.zh: 你看到壁炉里的火烧得多旺了吗？
messages.en: Can you see the fire blazing in the fireplace?

messages.speaker: Mark (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-fjammi huma għoljin; ejja nżommu s-siġġijiet ftit aktar 'il bogħod.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-fjammi huma għoljin; ejja nżommu s-siġġijiet ftit aktar 'il bogħod.
messages.zh: 看到了，火焰很高，我们把椅子放远一点吧。
messages.en: Yes, the flames are high; let's keep the chairs a little farther away.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把赴麦加朝觐的旅行画面与壁炉烈火的画面分开放置；靠上下文中的地点或火焰判断具体义项。

gloss_zh: 能研磨的；有压碎倾向的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Able to grind material into smaller particles, or tending to crush things.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能够把材料磨成更细颗粒的；或容易将东西压碎、具有压碎倾向的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jista' jitħan materjal f'partiċelli iżgħar, jew li għandu tendenza li jgħaffeġ l-affarijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 能够研磨的；能把材料磨细的。
有压碎倾向的；容易将东西压碎的。

formal.mt: L-apparat għandu mekkaniżmu taħħani li jbiddel il-qamħ fi dqiq.
formal.en: The device has a grinding mechanism that turns wheat into flour.
formal.zh: 该设备具有能将小麦磨成面粉的研磨机构。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Xi jfisser taħħani fid-deskrizzjoni tal-apparat? Mark: Ifisser li jista' jitħan; dan, pereżempju, jitħan il-kafè.
colloquial.en: Anna: What does taħħani mean in the description of the device? Mark: It means capable of grinding; this one, for example, grinds coffee.
colloquial.zh: Anna：设备说明里的taħħani是什么意思？Mark：意思是能研磨的；比如这一台就能磨咖啡。

messages.speaker: Anna (顾客)
messages.zh: 设备说明里的taħħani是什么意思？
messages.en: What does taħħani mean in the description of the device?

messages.speaker: Mark (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li jista' jitħan; dan, pereżempju, jitħan il-kafè.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li jista' jitħan; dan, pereżempju, jitħan il-kafè.
messages.zh: 意思是能研磨的；比如这一台就能磨咖啡。
messages.en: It means capable of grinding; this one, for example, grinds coffee.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象磨豆机把豆子磨细、压力装置把东西压碎；记住这是描述能力或倾向的形容词，要搭配所描述的名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of putting on a girdle or straightening and arranging one's clothes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 穿戴束腰带的动作，也指把身上的衣服整理平整、穿戴妥当。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed jilbes faxxa mal-qadd jew jirranġa l-ħwejjeġ li jkun liebes.

sense_translations.en_definition: act of putting on a girdle
sense_translations.zh_definition: 穿戴束腰带；将束腰带围在腰间并系好的动作。
整理身上的衣服，使衣物平整、位置妥当的动作。

collocations.en: putting on a girdle around the waist

formal.mt: Wara t-taħżim, il-faxxa kienet f'postha u l-ħwejjeġ kienu rranġati għall-wirja.
formal.en: After the girdle had been put on and the clothing straightened, the sash was in place and the clothes were ready for the performance.
formal.zh: 束好腰带并整理衣服后，腰带已佩戴到位，服装也已整理好，可以上场演出。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għandi bżonn minuta għat-taħżim qabel noħroġ fuq il-palk. Nina: Ħu l-ħin tiegħek; irranġa l-ħwejjeġ u ssikka l-faxxa mal-qadd.
colloquial.en: Lara: I need a minute to put on my girdle and straighten my clothes before going on stage. Nina: Take your time; straighten your clothes and tighten the sash around your waist.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：上台前，我需要一分钟束好腰带、整理衣服。妮娜：慢慢来，把衣服整理好，再把腰间的带子系紧。

messages.speaker: Lara (演员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi bżonn minuta għat-taħżim qabel noħroġ fuq il-palk.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi bżonn minuta għat-taħżim qabel noħroġ fuq il-palk.
messages.zh: 上台前，我需要一分钟束好腰带、整理衣服。
messages.en: I need a minute to put on my girdle and straighten my clothes before going on stage.

messages.speaker: Nina (服装助理)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħu l-ħin tiegħek; irranġa l-ħwejjeġ u ssikka l-faxxa mal-qadd.
messages.mt_standard: Ħu l-ħin tiegħek; irranġa l-ħwejjeġ u ssikka l-faxxa mal-qadd.
messages.zh: 慢慢来，把衣服整理好，再把腰间的带子系紧。
messages.en: Take your time; straighten your clothes and tighten the sash around your waist.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象演员上台前先束好腰带，再抚平衣服；用这两个连续动作分别记住 taħżim 的“束腰”和“整衣”义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of becoming bad or spoiled, or a state of corruption.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 事物变坏、食物变质的过程，也可指品行或社会风气的腐败、败坏。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih xi ħaġa tmur għall-agħar jew titħassar, jew stat ta' korruzzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变坏；变质，尤指食物等逐渐失去原有品质。
腐败；腐化；品行或社会风气的败坏。

formal.mt: F'dan it-test, it-taħżin tal-morali jidher fl-imġiba diżonesta tal-karattri.
formal.en: In this text, moral corruption is evident in the characters' dishonest behaviour.
formal.zh: 在这篇文本中，人物的不诚实行为体现了道德败坏。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex qed tiċċekkja l-frott kollu? Mark: Qed infittex sinjali ta' taħżin. Din it-tuffieħa diġà għandha riħa ħażina.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why are you checking all the fruit? Mark: I'm looking for signs of it going bad. This apple already smells bad.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你为什么把所有水果都检查一遍？马克：我在找变质的迹象。这个苹果已经有异味了。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 你为什么把所有水果都检查一遍？
messages.en: Why are you checking all the fruit?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed infittex sinjali ta' taħżin. Din it-tuffieħa diġà għandha riħa ħażina.
messages.mt_standard: Qed infittex sinjali ta' taħżin. Din it-tuffieħa diġà għandha riħa ħażina.
messages.zh: 我在找变质的迹象。这个苹果已经有异味了。
messages.en: I'm looking for signs of it going bad. This apple already smells bad.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把食物变质和道德败坏并排想象：一个是物质变坏，一个是品行变坏，用同一条“变坏”线索记住两义。

gloss_zh: 用双臂抱着一大抱东西

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of holding an armful of something against the body.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用双臂把一大抱东西拢在身前抱住的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li żżomm ma' ġismek kwantità ta' affarijiet bejn dirgħajk.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用双臂抱住一大抱某物的动作。

formal.mt: Fl-istampa, it-taħżiq tal-ħatab iħalli liż-żagħżugħ mingħajr id ħielsa biex jiftaħ il-bieb.
formal.en: In the picture, holding an armful of firewood leaves the young man without a free hand to open the door.
formal.zh: 图中，年轻人抱着一大抱柴，腾不出手来开门。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan it-taħżiq tal-kotba qed jgħajjini. Tista' tieħu ftit minnhom? Pawlu: Żgur, agħtini dawk ta' fuq.
colloquial.en: Maja: Holding this armful of books is tiring me out. Can you take some of them? Pawlu: Sure, give me the ones on top.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：抱着这一大抱书真累。你能帮我拿几本吗？保罗：当然，把上面那几本给我。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan it-taħżiq tal-kotba qed jgħajjini. Tista' tieħu ftit minnhom?
messages.mt_standard: Dan it-taħżiq tal-kotba qed jgħajjini. Tista' tieħu ftit minnhom?
messages.zh: 抱着这一大抱书真累。你能帮我拿几本吗？
messages.en: Holding this armful of books is tiring me out. Can you take some of them?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.zh: 当然，把上面那几本给我。
messages.en: Sure, give me the ones on top.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象双臂抱满书，连门把手都碰不到；记忆重点是“抱着一大抱”的动作，而不是那堆书本本身。

gloss_zh: 乱写；潦草书写；随手涂画

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of writing carelessly or untidily, or making casual drawings without a clear plan.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 随意乱写、字迹潦草地书写，或没有明确计划地随手涂画的活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tikteb bl-addoċċ jew b'kitba mħarbta, jew li tagħmel tpinġijiet żgħar mingħajr pjan ċar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 乱写；随意写下杂乱的字迹或笔画。
潦草书写；写出歪斜、不整齐或难以辨认的字迹。
随手涂画；漫不经心地画小图案或线条。

collocations.zh: 在页边空白处随手涂画

formal.mt: It-taħżiż fil-marġni tal-paġna jinkludi ċrieki, vleġeġ u figuri żgħar.
formal.en: The doodling in the margin of the page includes circles, arrows and small figures.
formal.zh: 这页页边的随手涂画包括圆圈、箭头和小人。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'inhuma dawn il-forom ħdejn in-noti tiegħek? Ben: Ftit taħżiż biss. Pinġejthom waqt li kont qed nistenna.
colloquial.en: Sara: What are these shapes beside your notes? Ben: Just a bit of doodling. I drew them while I was waiting.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你笔记旁边这些形状是什么？本：只是随手画的。我等人的时候画的。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhuma dawn il-forom ħdejn in-noti tiegħek?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhuma dawn il-forom ħdejn in-noti tiegħek?
messages.zh: 你笔记旁边这些形状是什么？
messages.en: What are these shapes beside your notes?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ftit taħżiż biss. Pinġejthom waqt li kont qed nistenna.
messages.mt_standard: Ftit taħżiż biss. Pinġejthom waqt li kont qed nistenna.
messages.zh: 只是随手画的。我等人的时候画的。
messages.en: Just a bit of doodling. I drew them while I was waiting.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在脑中摆出一张纸：左边乱写文字，中间字迹潦草，右边随手画圈；三个画面对应三个相邻义项。

gloss_zh: 举止粗暴；行为滋扰他人

teaching_sense.en_definition: To behave roughly or in a way that disregards and disturbs other people.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 举止粗暴，或不顾他人而做出滋扰性的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġib ruħu b'mod goff jew b'mod li jdejjaq lil ħaddieħor u ma jirrispettahx.

sense_translations.en_definition: to act in a rough or anti-social manner
sense_translations.zh_definition: 行为粗暴或不顾公共秩序，滋扰他人。

collocations.zh: 在公共场合做出滋扰他人的行为

formal.mt: Ir-raġel tbadbad mal-passiġġieri u mbotta lil min kien ħdejh.
formal.en: The man behaved roughly towards the passengers and pushed those beside him.
formal.zh: 那名男子粗暴地对待乘客，还推搡身边的人。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex tbadbad hekk fil-kju? Mark: Skużani, ma kellix nimbotta lin-nies.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did you behave so roughly in the queue? Mark: Sorry, I shouldn't have pushed people.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你刚才排队时为什么那么粗暴？马克：对不起，我不该推别人。

messages.speaker: Lara (一起排队的朋友)
messages.zh: 你刚才排队时为什么那么粗暴？
messages.en: Why did you behave so roughly in the queue?

messages.speaker: Mark (排队者)
messages.zh: 对不起，我不该推别人。
messages.en: Sorry, I shouldn't have pushed people.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象排队时有人横冲直撞、推搡旁人，用这个具体场景记住“举止粗暴、滋扰他人”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Depending on context, sexual intercourse outside marriage, or persistent coughing; these are separate senses.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 有两个不同义项：婚姻之外的性交，即私通；或持续不断的咳嗽。须根据上下文区分。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Skont il-kuntest, relazzjonijiet sesswali barra ż-żwieġ, jew sogħla li tibqa' għaddejja; dawn huma żewġ tifsiriet differenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 私通；婚姻之外的性交。
持续不断的咳嗽；此义具有拟声性质。

formal.mt: F'dan it-test, il-kelma 'tbadbid' tirreferi għal relazzjonijiet sesswali barra ż-żwieġ.
formal.en: In this text, the word 'tbadbid' refers to sexual relations outside marriage.
formal.zh: 在这篇文本中，tbadbid 一词指婚姻之外的性关系。

colloquial.mt: Pawlu: Dan it-tbadbid ma ħallinix norqod. Maja: Qed tisgħol ħafna; trid ftit ilma?
colloquial.en: Pawlu: This persistent coughing kept me from sleeping. Maja: You're coughing a lot; would you like some water?
colloquial.zh: 保罗：这样一直咳，弄得我没法睡觉。玛雅：你咳得很厉害，要喝点水吗？

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.zh: 这样一直咳，弄得我没法睡觉。
messages.en: This persistent coughing kept me from sleeping.

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed tisgħol ħafna; trid ftit ilma?
messages.mt_standard: Qed tisgħol ħafna; trid ftit ilma?
messages.zh: 你咳得很厉害，要喝点水吗？
messages.en: You're coughing a lot; would you like some water?

cognitive_memory_aid: 给这个词准备两张独立记忆卡：一张写“私通”，另一张画“连续咳嗽”；阅读时靠上下文选择义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become damaged or messed up through handling or interference.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因被人摆弄、操作或干预而受损，或变得凌乱。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġarrab ħsara jew jitħawwad minħabba li xi ħadd imissu jew ibagħbas fih.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be damaged as a result of handling
sense_translations.zh_definition: 因被拿弄、摆弄或操作而受到损坏。
被弄乱、弄糟或搞坏。

collocations.en: The mechanism was damaged through handling.
The order of the documents got messed up.
collocations.zh: 文件的排列顺序被弄乱了。

formal.mt: Waqt l-ispezzjoni nstab li l-mekkaniżmu tbagħbas minħabba intervent mhux xieraq.
formal.en: During the inspection, the mechanism was found to have been damaged by improper interference.
formal.zh: 检查发现，机械装置因不当操作而受损。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex ma jaħdimx l-arloġġ? Mark: Tbagħbas meta ppruvajt insewwih.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why isn't the clock working? Mark: It got messed up when I tried to fix it.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：钟怎么不走了？马克：我试着修它，结果把它弄坏了。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 钟怎么不走了？
messages.en: Why isn't the clock working?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 我试着修它，结果把它弄坏了。
messages.en: It got messed up when I tried to fix it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一只钟被反复拆弄，最后停走：用“摆弄之后坏了或乱了”的结果画面记住这个动词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of handling or fondling something or someone; also corrupt interference or manipulation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 拿弄物品或抚弄他人的行为；也可指舞弊、腐败性的干预或操弄。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed imiss jew ibagħbas f'xi ħaġa jew ma' xi ħadd; jista' jirreferi wkoll għal manipulazzjoni diżonesta jew korruzzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用手拿弄、触碰或摆弄物品的行为。
抚弄、爱抚或亲昵触摸的行为。
腐败、舞弊或不诚实的操弄。

formal.mt: L-awditur sab sinjali ta' tbagħbis fil-kontijiet u talab investigazzjoni.
formal.en: The auditor found signs of manipulation in the accounts and requested an investigation.
formal.zh: 审计员发现账目存在舞弊迹象，并要求展开调查。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Nista' nħares lejn dan il-mudell? Pawlu: Iva, imma mingħajr tbagħbis; jinkiser malajr.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can I look at this model? Pawlu: Yes, but no handling; it breaks easily.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我能看看这个模型吗？保罗：可以，不过别拿弄；它很容易坏。

messages.speaker: Maja (访客)
messages.zh: 我能看看这个模型吗？
messages.en: Can I look at this model?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (收藏者)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma mingħajr tbagħbis; jinkiser malajr.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma mingħajr tbagħbis; jinkiser malajr.
messages.zh: 可以，不过别拿弄；它很容易坏。
messages.en: Yes, but no handling; it breaks easily.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三幅画面分别记义项：手拿模型、亲昵抚摸、暗改账本。它是行为名词，具体含义要看语境。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To deteriorate or develop into a worse or less acceptable state.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 逐渐退化、堕落，或发展成更差、更不可接受的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeġenera jew jinbidel għal stat agħar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 退化、堕落或恶化，变得比原先更差。

collocations.zh: 对话恶化成了相互辱骂。

formal.mt: Id-dibattitu tbagħgħal f'attakki personali, u ċ-chairperson kellu jintervjeni.
formal.en: The debate degenerated into personal attacks, and the chairperson had to intervene.
formal.zh: 辩论演变成了人身攻击，主持人不得不出面干预。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif mar id-dibattitu? Toni: Tbagħgħal; fl-aħħar kulħadd beda jinsulenta lil xulxin.
colloquial.en: Sara: How did the debate go? Toni: It degenerated; by the end, everyone was insulting each other.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：辩论进行得怎么样？托尼：变了质；到最后，大家都开始互相辱骂。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 辩论进行得怎么样？
messages.en: How did the debate go?

messages.speaker: Toni (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Tbagħgħal; fl-aħħar kulħadd beda jinsulenta lil xulxin.
messages.mt_standard: Tbagħgħal; fl-aħħar kulħadd beda jinsulenta lil xulxin.
messages.zh: 变了质；到最后，大家都开始互相辱骂。
messages.en: It degenerated; by the end, everyone was insulting each other.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象讨论从有理有据一路滑向互相辱骂，沿着“状态越来越差”的箭头记住退化、恶化之义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of walking or wading through mud.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 双脚在泥中迈动、蹚过泥泞的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed jimxi jew jgħaddi minn ġot-tajn.

sense_translations.en_definition: the act of wading through mud
sense_translations.zh_definition: 蹚过泥泞、在泥中涉行的行为。

collocations.en: wading through mud after the rain

formal.mt: It-tbagħtir fit-tajn wara x-xita naqqas il-pass tal-grupp u tawwal il-vjaġġ.
formal.en: Wading through the mud after the rain slowed the group's pace and prolonged the journey.
formal.zh: 雨后蹚行泥地使队伍放慢了脚步，也延长了行程。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex għandek iż-żraben kollha tajn? David: Wara dak it-tbagħtir fl-għalqa, ma setgħux jibqgħu nodfa!
colloquial.en: Nina: Why are your shoes covered in mud? David: After all that wading through mud in the field, they couldn't stay clean!
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你的鞋怎么全是泥？戴维：在田里蹚了那么久的泥，鞋哪还能干净！

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你的鞋怎么全是泥？
messages.en: Why are your shoes covered in mud?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Wara dak it-tbagħtir fl-għalqa, ma setgħux jibqgħu nodfa!
messages.mt_standard: Wara dak it-tbagħtir fl-għalqa, ma setgħux jibqgħu nodfa!
messages.zh: 在田里蹚了那么久的泥，鞋哪还能干净！
messages.en: After all that wading through mud in the field, they couldn't stay clean!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象靴子陷进湿泥，每一步都要费劲拔出来；这个名词记的是“蹚泥这一行为”，不是泥本身。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Unrestrained enjoyment in which people let themselves have fun freely.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 放开拘束、尽情享受欢乐的活动或状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed jiddeverti bla rażan u jħalli ruħu għall-ferħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 无拘无束地尽情享乐、纵情欢乐。

formal.mt: Wara ċ-ċerimonja, il-mistednin ingħaqdu f'lejla ta' mużika, żfin u tbahrid.
formal.en: After the ceremony, the guests came together for an evening of music, dancing, and uninhibited enjoyment.
formal.zh: 仪式结束后，宾客们欢聚一堂，在音乐和舞蹈中尽情享受欢乐。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Kif kienet il-festa? Ġanni: Kien hemm tbahrid sħiħ; żfinna u dħakna sa tard!
colloquial.en: Elena: How was the party? Ġanni: It was full-on revelry; we danced and laughed until late!
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：聚会怎么样？詹尼：大家玩得特别尽兴；我们跳舞、说笑，一直到很晚！

messages.speaker: Elena (朋友)
messages.zh: 聚会怎么样？
messages.en: How was the party?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (聚会参与者)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien hemm tbahrid sħiħ; żfinna u dħakna sa tard!
messages.mt_standard: Kien hemm tbahrid sħiħ; żfinna u dħakna sa tard!
messages.zh: 大家玩得特别尽兴；我们跳舞、说笑，一直到很晚！
messages.en: It was full-on revelry; we danced and laughed until late!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它配上一幅朋友们放开跳舞、大声欢笑的画面，重点记住“尽情、无拘束”的欢乐程度。

teaching_sense.en_definition: For a wall or another surface to be whitewashed or painted.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指墙壁或其他表面被刷白或涂上涂料。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinkesa bil-ġir jew biż-żebgħa, meta jingħad għal ħajt jew wiċċ ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被刷白；表面被涂上一层白色涂料或石灰浆。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be painted (used of walls or other surfaces)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被粉刷或涂漆，用于墙壁或其他表面。

formal.mt: Il-ħajt tal-kuritur tbajjad wara li tlestew it-tiswijiet.
formal.en: The corridor wall was painted after the repairs were completed.
formal.zh: 维修完成后，走廊的墙壁被重新粉刷了。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Il-ħajt diġà tbajjad? Pawlu: Iva, imma ż-żebgħa għadha mxarrba.
colloquial.en: Lara: Has the wall been painted already? Pawlu: Yes, but the paint is still wet.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：墙已经刷好了吗？保罗：是的，不过涂料还没干。

messages.speaker: Lara (住户)
messages.zh: 墙已经刷好了吗？
messages.en: Has the wall been painted already?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (油漆工)
messages.zh: 是的，不过涂料还没干。
messages.en: Yes, but the paint is still wet.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看着一面刚刷好的墙说“墙被粉刷了”，记住这里描述的是墙面接受粉刷后的变化。

gloss_zh: 变软；变得像熟过头的水果一样软

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become soft and lose firmness, somewhat like overripe fruit.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 失去原有的硬实感而变软，类似水果熟过头时的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir artab u jitlef is-sodezza, bħalma jiġri lil frott misjur iżżejjed.

sense_translations.en_definition: to go soft (somewhat like an overripe fruit)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 变软，软得有些像熟过头的水果。

formal.mt: Waqt l-ispezzjoni, ġie osservat li l-frott tbajtar u tilef is-sodezza tiegħu.
formal.en: During the inspection, it was observed that the fruit had gone soft and lost its firmness.
formal.zh: 检查时发现，水果已经变软，失去了原有的硬实感。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Dan il-ħawħ tbajtar? Mark: Iva, messu bil-mod; artab ħafna.
colloquial.en: Rita: Have these peaches gone soft? Mark: Yes, touch them gently; they're very soft.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：这些桃子变软了吗？马克：是的，轻轻摸，它们很软。

messages.speaker: Rita (顾客)
messages.zh: 这些桃子变软了吗？
messages.en: Have these peaches gone soft?

messages.speaker: Mark (水果摊主)
messages.zh: 是的，轻轻摸，它们很软。
messages.en: Yes, touch them gently; they're very soft.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象手指轻碰熟过头的桃子就留下凹痕，用这个触感记住动词“变软”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of becoming softer or losing firmness.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变得更软或逐渐失去硬实感的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li fih xi ħaġa ssir aktar ratba jew titlef is-sodezza tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 软化；硬实程度降低、逐渐变软的过程。

formal.mt: Matul l-osservazzjoni, ġie rreġistrat tbajtir gradwali tal-frott.
formal.en: During the observation, gradual softening of the fruit was recorded.
formal.zh: 观察期间记录到了水果逐渐软化的过程。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Innutajt it-tbajtir tal-frott? Lara: Iva, illum huwa ħafna aktar artab mill-bieraħ.
colloquial.en: Maja: Have you noticed the softening of the fruit? Lara: Yes, today it's much softer than yesterday.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你注意到水果在变软了吗？拉拉：注意到了，今天比昨天软多了。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 你注意到水果在变软了吗？
messages.en: Have you noticed the softening of the fruit?

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, illum huwa ħafna aktar artab mill-bieraħ.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, illum huwa ħafna aktar artab mill-bieraħ.
messages.zh: 注意到了，今天比昨天软多了。
messages.en: Yes, today it's much softer than yesterday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把同一颗水果连续几天的触感排成一列：由硬到软的整个变化过程，就是名词“软化”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be made to get out of bed early, usually by another person.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被别人叫醒或催促，在较早的时间起床。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġi mġiegħel iqum mis-sodda kmieni, ġeneralment minn xi ħadd ieħor.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be made to rise early
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被叫起来早起；被要求早早起床。

collocations.en: was made to get up early by his mother
was made to get up early to go to work

formal.mt: Pawlu tbakkar minn missieru biex jasal fil-ħin għall-vjaġġ.
formal.en: Paul was made to get up early by his father so that he would arrive on time for the trip.
formal.zh: 保罗被父亲早早叫起，以便准时赶上行程。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għaliex Pawlu għadu bin-ngħas? Rita: Tbakkar minn ommu biex jaqbad l-ewwel xarabank.
colloquial.en: Marta: Why is Paul still sleepy? Rita: His mother made him get up early to catch the first bus.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：保罗怎么还困着？丽塔：他妈妈早早把他叫起来，让他赶第一班公交车。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗怎么还困着？
messages.en: Why is Paul still sleepy?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tbakkar minn ommu biex jaqbad l-ewwel xarabank.
messages.mt_standard: Tbakkar minn ommu biex jaqbad l-ewwel xarabank.
messages.zh: 他妈妈早早把他叫起来，让他赶第一班公交车。
messages.en: His mother made him get up early to catch the first bus.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象天还没亮，家人就把你叫下床；把这个词和“被别人叫早起”的场景一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or practice of waking up early.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 早早醒来、起床这一行为或习惯。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att jew id-drawwa li wieħed iqum kmieni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 早起；在较早的时间醒来、起床。

collocations.en: the habit of getting up early

formal.mt: It-tbakkir jippermetti lill-ħaddiema jibdew il-ġurnata qabel is-sħana.
formal.en: Getting up early allows the workers to start their day before the heat.
formal.zh: 早起使工人们能够在天气炎热之前开始一天的工作。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif sejjer bit-tbakkir ta' kuljum? Mark: Għadni nidra, imma issa għandi ħin għall-kolazzjon.
colloquial.en: Lara: How are you getting on with getting up early every day? Mark: I'm still getting used to it, but now I have time for breakfast.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：每天早起，你适应得怎么样？马克：我还在适应，不过现在有时间吃早餐了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 每天早起，你适应得怎么样？
messages.en: How are you getting on with getting up early every day?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadni nidra, imma issa għandi ħin għall-kolazzjon.
messages.mt_standard: Għadni nidra, imma issa għandi ħin għall-kolazzjon.
messages.zh: 我还在适应，不过现在有时间吃早餐了。
messages.en: I'm still getting used to it, but now I have time for breakfast.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“每天闹钟一响就起床”想成一个习惯名称；这个名词指的就是早起这件事。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Idle talk, or a stream of speech or sounds that is unclear or lacks coherent meaning.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 没有实质内容的闲谈，也可指含混不清、缺乏连贯意义的言语或咿呀声。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kliem bla skop serju, jew sensiela ta' kliem jew ħsejjes mhux ċari jew bla rabta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 无关紧要的闲聊；缺乏实质内容的闲扯。
含混而不连贯的言语；咿咿呀呀的声音。

formal.mt: L-għalliem talab lill-istudenti jieqfu mit-tbalbil u jiffukaw fuq is-suġġett tad-diskussjoni.
formal.en: The teacher asked the students to stop their idle chatter and focus on the topic of the discussion.
formal.zh: 老师要求学生们停止闲扯，把注意力集中到讨论的主题上。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Qed tisma' t-tbalbil tat-tarbija? Ġanni: Iva, qisha trid titkellem magħna!
colloquial.en: Nina: Can you hear the baby's babbling? Gianni: Yes, it's as if she wants to talk to us!
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你听见宝宝咿咿呀呀了吗？詹尼：听见了，她好像想跟我们说话呢！

messages.speaker: Nina (母亲)
messages.zh: 你听见宝宝咿咿呀呀了吗？
messages.en: Can you hear the baby's babbling?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (父亲)
messages.zh: 听见了，她好像想跟我们说话呢！
messages.en: Yes, it's as if she wants to talk to us!

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住两幅有声音的画面：大人闲扯不停，宝宝咿呀不停；结合语境区分两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be struck forcefully, or to be made flat by blows or pressure.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受到用力捶打，或因敲击、压力而变平。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġi milqut bis-saħħa, jew isir ċatt permezz ta' daqqiet jew pressjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被用力捶打；受到重击。
被打平或压平；被弄成扁平状。

collocations.en: was flattened until it was flat

formal.mt: Il-metall tballat bil-martell sakemm sar ċatt u seta' jintuża għat-tiswija.
formal.en: The metal was pounded flat with a hammer so that it could be used for the repair.
formal.zh: 这块金属被锤子捶打平整，以便用于修理。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Dan il-metall kif sar daqshekk ċatt? Toni: Tballat bil-martell fil-ħanut tax-xogħol.
colloquial.en: Mark: How did this metal get so flat? Toni: It was pounded with a hammer in the workshop.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这块金属怎么变得这么平？托尼：它在作坊里被锤子捶平了。

messages.speaker: Mark (学徒)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-metall kif sar daqshekk ċatt?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-metall kif sar daqshekk ċatt?
messages.zh: 这块金属怎么变得这么平？
messages.en: How did this metal get so flat?

messages.speaker: Toni (工匠)
messages.zh: 它在作坊里被锤子捶平了。
messages.en: It was pounded with a hammer in the workshop.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一块金属挨锤后逐渐变平；“被捶打”强调动作，“被打平”强调结果。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A haphazard mixture of things, or the act of handling or changing something carelessly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 各种东西随意混在一起形成的杂乱混合物，也指对某物胡乱摆弄或改动的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Taħlita ta' affarijiet bla ordni, jew l-att li wieħed imiss jew ibiddel xi ħaġa bla ħsieb u bla attenzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 各种东西随意混合而成的杂乱组合。

sense_translations.en_definition: the act of messing around with sth.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 胡乱摆弄、折腾或改动某物的行为。

formal.mt: Il-pittura kienet tballis ta' kuluri mingħajr ordni ċara.
formal.en: The painting was a haphazard mixture of colours with no clear arrangement.
formal.zh: 这幅画把各种颜色杂乱地混在一起，缺乏清晰的布局。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għaliex il-magna m'għadhiex taħdem? Pawlu: Wara dak it-tballis kollu biha, aħjar insejħu tekniku.
colloquial.en: Rita: Why isn't the machine working anymore? Paul: After all that messing around with it, we'd better call a technician.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：机器怎么不运转了？保罗：刚才那么一通乱摆弄，还是叫个维修师傅吧。

messages.speaker: Rita (同事)
messages.zh: 机器怎么不运转了？
messages.en: Why isn't the machine working anymore?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Wara dak it-tballis kollu biha, aħjar insejħu tekniku.
messages.mt_standard: Wara dak it-tballis kollu biha, aħjar insejħu tekniku.
messages.zh: 刚才那么一通乱摆弄，还是叫个维修师傅吧。
messages.en: After all that messing around with it, we'd better call a technician.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“乱”串联两个义项：东西乱混成一堆，双手乱动摆弄机器；分别记住产物和行为。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of pounding something or driving or compacting it with forceful blows.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用力捶击某物，或通过重击将其打入、夯紧的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed jagħti daqqiet qawwija fuq xi ħaġa biex isawwatha, idaħħalha jew jagħfasha.

sense_translations.en_definition: the act of pounding or ramming
sense_translations.zh_definition: 捶打或冲撞夯击的行为，包括用重击将物体打入或夯实。

formal.mt: It-tballit tal-ħamrija sar f'saffi rqaq biex il-wiċċ ikun sod.
formal.en: The soil was rammed in thin layers to make the surface firm.
formal.zh: 土壤分薄层进行夯实，以使表面坚实。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Minn fejn ġej dak il-ħoss? Toni: Mit-tballit tal-ħamrija fil-bitħa; qed iħejju l-art.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where is that noise coming from? Toni: From the soil being rammed in the yard; they're preparing the ground.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：那声音是从哪儿来的？托尼：院子里在夯土，他们正在整地。

messages.speaker: Lara (邻居)
messages.zh: 那声音是从哪儿来的？
messages.en: Where is that noise coming from?

messages.speaker: Toni (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Mit-tballit tal-ħamrija fil-bitħa; qed iħejju l-art.
messages.mt_standard: Mit-tballit tal-ħamrija fil-bitħa; qed iħejju l-art.
messages.zh: 院子里在夯土，他们正在整地。
messages.en: From the soil being rammed in the yard; they're preparing the ground.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把施工时一下下夯紧泥土的动作定格；这个名词表示“捶打、夯击”这一过程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of hitting something hard and repeatedly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 接连用力击打某物的行为，强调力道大且重复发生。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed jagħti daqqiet qawwija u ripetuti fuq xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.en_definition: the act of hitting hard and repeatedly
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用力而反复地击打；连续重击的行为。

collocations.en: hard, repeated banging on the door
hard, repeated pounding on the table

formal.mt: It-tbambil fuq il-bieb kompla għal diversi minuti u qajjem lir-residenti.
formal.en: The hard, repeated banging on the door continued for several minutes and woke the residents.
formal.zh: 猛烈的连续敲门声持续了几分钟，把住户们吵醒了。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhu dan it-tbambil fuq il-bieb? Mark: Xi ħadd qed iħabbat bis-saħħa; se mmur nara min hu.
colloquial.en: Maja: What's all this pounding on the door? Mark: Someone is banging hard; I'll go and see who it is.
colloquial.zh: 玛娅：谁在这么使劲地连续敲门？马克：有人在猛敲，我去看看是谁。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 谁在这么使劲地连续敲门？
messages.en: What's all this pounding on the door?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi ħadd qed iħabbat bis-saħħa; se mmur nara min hu.
messages.mt_standard: Xi ħadd qed iħabbat bis-saħħa; se mmur nara min hu.
messages.zh: 有人在猛敲，我去看看是谁。
messages.en: Someone is banging hard; I'll go and see who it is.

cognitive_memory_aid: 脑中播放“砰、砰、砰”的猛烈敲门声；记忆重点是既用力，又接连不断地击打。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be announced publicly; in a separate sense, to be punished.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被当众宣布、向公众公布；另一个义项表示受到惩罚。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġi mħabbar fil-pubbliku; f'tifsira oħra, jiġi kkastigat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被公开宣布；被当众公布。
被惩罚；受到处罚。

collocations.en: was announced publicly in the square
was punished because of his behaviour
collocations.zh: 因自己的行为而受到惩罚

formal.mt: L-avviż tbanda fil-pjazza biex l-abitanti kollha jkunu jafu bil-laqgħa.
formal.en: The notice was announced publicly in the square so that all the inhabitants would know about the meeting.
formal.zh: 这则通知在广场上公开宣读，让所有居民都知道开会的消息。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għaliex tbanda Pawlu? Ġanni: Għax kiser ir-regoli tal-logħba apposta.
colloquial.en: Marta: Why was Paul punished? Gianni: Because he deliberately broke the rules of the game.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：保罗为什么受罚了？詹尼：因为他故意违反了游戏规则。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗为什么受罚了？
messages.en: Why was Paul punished?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (朋友)
messages.zh: 因为他故意违反了游戏规则。
messages.en: Because he deliberately broke the rules of the game.

cognitive_memory_aid: 分开记两张场景卡：广场上公布通知，违规者受到处罚；不要把两个义项混成一个意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be rocked from side to side, or to swing or rock oneself.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受到外力而左右摇晃，或自己来回摆动、荡动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li wieħed jitmexxa minn naħa għal oħra, jew jitbandal hu stess.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be rocked from side to side
sense_translations.zh_definition: 受到外力而被左右摇晃。
自己来回摆动或摇动身体，例如荡秋千。

formal.mt: Il-bastiment tbandal minn naħa għal oħra minħabba l-mewġ.
formal.en: The ship rocked from side to side because of the waves.
formal.zh: 船只因海浪而左右摇晃。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid titbandal fuq il-bandli? Leo: Iva, imma bil-mod, għax nibża' meta nitla' għoli.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you want to go on the swings? Leo: Yes, but gently, because I get scared when I go high.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你想荡秋千吗？利奥：想，不过慢一点，我荡得高会害怕。

messages.speaker: Maja (姐姐)
messages.zh: 你想荡秋千吗？
messages.en: Do you want to go on the swings?

messages.speaker: Leo (弟弟)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma bil-mod, għax nibża' meta nitla' għoli.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma bil-mod, għax nibża' meta nitla' għoli.
messages.zh: 想，不过慢一点，我荡得高会害怕。
messages.en: Yes, but gently, because I get scared when I go high.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把画面记成海浪摇船和孩子荡秋千：两者都来回移动，前者被摇，后者自己荡。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The movement of swaying, rocking, or swinging back and forth.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 左右或前后来回摆动的动作，包括摇摆、摇晃和荡动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-moviment minn naħa għal oħra jew 'il quddiem u lura, bħal dak ta' dgħajsa jew tal-bandli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 缓缓来回摇摆的动作。
来回摇晃的动作，例如船只或摇篮的摇动。
来回荡动的动作，例如秋千的摆荡。

formal.mt: It-tbandil bil-mod tal-benniena għen lit-tarbija torqod.
formal.en: The gentle rocking of the cradle helped the baby fall asleep.
formal.zh: 摇篮轻柔的摇晃帮助婴儿入睡。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan it-tbandil tad-dgħajsa qed idejjaqek? Mark: Ftit, iva. Nippreferi noqgħod bilqiegħda.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is this rocking of the boat bothering you? Mark: A little, yes. I'd rather sit down.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：船这样摇晃让你不舒服吗？马克：是的，有一点。我还是坐下吧。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 船这样摇晃让你不舒服吗？
messages.en: Is this rocking of the boat bothering you?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 是的，有一点。我还是坐下吧。
messages.en: A little, yes. I'd rather sit down.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把船、摇篮和秋千的来回运动装进同一个名词盒子；tbandil 指摇摆这个动作本身。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To develop or grow a stem, said of a plant.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指植物生长并长出茎。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li pjanta tiżviluppa zokk.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 指植物长出茎。

formal.mt: Il-ħabaq tbannat wara li dehru l-ewwel weraq.
formal.en: The basil grew a stem after the first leaves appeared.
formal.zh: 罗勒在最初的叶片出现后长出了茎。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Il-ħabaq tbannat diġà? Pawlu: Iva, ara z-zokk żgħir bejn il-weraq.
colloquial.en: Nina: Has the basil grown a stem already? Pawlu: Yes, look at the little stem between the leaves.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：罗勒已经长出茎了吗？保罗：是的，你看叶片之间那根小茎。

messages.speaker: Nina (园艺爱好者)
messages.zh: 罗勒已经长出茎了吗？
messages.en: Has the basil grown a stem already?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (园艺伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ara z-zokk żgħir bejn il-weraq.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ara z-zokk żgħir bejn il-weraq.
messages.zh: 是的，你看叶片之间那根小茎。
messages.en: Yes, look at the little stem between the leaves.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象盆里的幼苗伸出一根小茎；看到 tbannat，就把注意力放在长出茎这一变化上。

gloss_zh: 坚定表达；自信而明确地表明立场

teaching_sense.en_definition: The quality of expressing one's views, needs, or boundaries clearly and confidently.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 清楚、自信而坚定地表达自己的观点、需要或界限的特质。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħila li wieħed jesprimi l-fehmiet, il-ħtiġijiet jew il-limiti tiegħu b'mod ċar u sod.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 坚定而自信地表达观点、需要或个人界限的态度与能力。

formal.mt: It-tbannis fil-komunikazzjoni jgħin lill-impjegati jesprimu l-ħtiġijiet tagħhom b'mod ċar u b'rispett.
formal.en: Assertiveness in communication helps employees express their needs clearly and respectfully.
formal.zh: 沟通中的坚定表达有助于员工清楚而有礼地表达自己的需要。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif nista' nuri aktar tbannis fil-laqgħa? Rita: Għid x'taħseb b'mod ċar u kalm, u spjega x'għandek bżonn.
colloquial.en: Maja: How can I show more assertiveness in the meeting? Rita: Say what you think clearly and calmly, and explain what you need.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我怎样才能在会议上更坚定地表达自己？丽塔：清楚、平静地说出你的想法，并说明你需要什么。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif nista' nuri aktar tbannis fil-laqgħa?
messages.mt_standard: Kif nista' nuri aktar tbannis fil-laqgħa?
messages.zh: 我怎样才能在会议上更坚定地表达自己？
messages.en: How can I show more assertiveness in the meeting?

messages.speaker: Rita (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għid x'taħseb b'mod ċar u kalm, u spjega x'għandek bżonn.
messages.mt_standard: Għid x'taħseb b'mod ċar u kalm, u spjega x'għandek bżonn.
messages.zh: 清楚、平静地说出你的想法，并说明你需要什么。
messages.en: Say what you think clearly and calmly, and explain what you need.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住开会时平静说出我需要什么的画面；tbannis 强调表达清楚、态度坚定和自信。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process by which a plant produces or develops a stem.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 植物长出茎或形成茎的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li fih pjanta tiżviluppa zokk.

sense_translations.en_definition: the production of a stem (used of plants)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 植物产生茎、长出茎的过程。

collocations.en: the plant's development of a stem

formal.mt: L-istudenti rreġistraw il-bidu tat-tbannit tal-pjanta u kejlu z-zokk kull ġimgħa.
formal.en: The students recorded the beginning of the plant's stem development and measured the stem every week.
formal.zh: 学生们记录了植物开始长茎的时间，并每周测量茎的长度。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan iz-zokk żgħir ifisser li beda t-tbannit? Toni: Iva, issa nistgħu nkejluh u naraw kemm jikber.
colloquial.en: Lara: Does this little stem mean that stem development has begun? Toni: Yes, now we can measure it and see how much it grows.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这根小茎说明植物已经开始长茎了吗？托尼：是的，现在我们可以测量它，看看它能长多少。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan iz-zokk żgħir ifisser li beda t-tbannit?
messages.mt_standard: Dan iz-zokk żgħir ifisser li beda t-tbannit?
messages.zh: 这根小茎说明植物已经开始长茎了吗？
messages.en: Does this little stem mean that stem development has begun?

messages.speaker: Toni (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, issa nistgħu nkejluh u naraw kemm jikber.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, issa nistgħu nkejluh u naraw kemm jikber.
messages.zh: 是的，现在我们可以测量它，看看它能长多少。
messages.en: Yes, now we can measure it and see how much it grows.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把幼苗长茎拍成连续照片：tbannit 是这段形成过程的名称，可与表示长出茎的动词 tbannat 对照记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become emotionally worked up, get angry, or worry about something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 情绪变得激动、恼怒，或因某事感到担忧。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li wieħed jitħawwad emozzjonalment, jirrabja jew jinkwieta dwar xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 情绪激动起来，变得不平静。
生气，恼怒起来。
担忧，为某事感到不安。

collocations.en: got worked up because of the delay

formal.mt: Il-klijent tbaqbaq meta sar jaf li l-kunsinna kienet se tittardja b'ġimgħa.
formal.en: The customer got angry when he learned that the delivery would be delayed by a week.
formal.zh: 顾客得知送货将延误一周时生气了。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex tbaqbaqt daqshekk? Mark: Għax ma weġibnix, u bdejt ninkwieta li ġralu xi ħaġa.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did you get so worked up? Mark: Because he didn't answer me, and I started worrying that something had happened to him.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你怎么这么着急？马克：因为他没回复我，我开始担心他是不是出了什么事。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你怎么这么着急？
messages.en: Why did you get so worked up?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax ma weġibnix, u bdejt ninkwieta li ġralu xi ħaġa.
messages.mt_standard: Għax ma weġibnix, u bdejt ninkwieta li ġralu xi ħaġa.
messages.zh: 因为他没回复我，我开始担心他是不是出了什么事。
messages.en: Because he didn't answer me, and I started worrying that something had happened to him.
