cognitive_memory_aid: 用情绪温度上升的画面记忆：可能急起来、气起来或担心起来，具体意思要看上下文。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A state or feeling of anger, rage, or worry.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 愤怒、强烈怒气或担忧不安的情绪状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Stat jew sentiment ta' rabja, rabja kbira jew inkwiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 生气、愤怒的情绪。
暴怒，极其强烈的愤怒。
担忧、忧虑或心神不安。

formal.mt: It-tbaqbiq ta' rabja tiegħu kien jidher fit-ton ta' leħnu waqt il-laqgħa.
formal.en: His angry agitation was evident in his tone of voice during the meeting.
formal.zh: 会议期间，他的语气显露出愤怒激动的情绪。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għadek bit-tbaqbiq dwar ir-riżultat? Ben: Iva, ma nistax nikkalma sakemm insir naf kif mort.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are you still worried about the result? Ben: Yes, I can't calm down until I find out how I did.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你还在为结果担心吗？本：是的，知道自己考得怎么样之前，我都静不下来。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 你还在为结果担心吗？
messages.en: Are you still worried about the result?

messages.speaker: Ben (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ma nistax nikkalma sakemm insir naf kif mort.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ma nistax nikkalma sakemm insir naf kif mort.
messages.zh: 是的，知道自己考得怎么样之前，我都静不下来。
messages.en: Yes, I can't calm down until I find out how I did.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把怒气、暴怒和忧虑放在情绪名词栏里；tbaqbiq 指这种情绪本身，阅读时用语境判断是哪一种。

gloss_zh: 虱等寄生虫的侵扰；给植物浇水，尤指盆栽

teaching_sense.en_definition: An infestation of vermin such as lice; also, the watering of plants, generally those in pots.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可指虱等寄生虫的侵扰，也可指给植物浇水，通常用于盆栽植物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Infestazzjoni bil-qamel jew b'parassiti simili; ukoll, it-tisqija tal-pjanti, l-aktar dawk fil-qsari.

sense_translations.en_definition: infestation of vermin such as lice
sense_translations.zh_definition: 虱等害虫或寄生虫的侵扰、滋生。

sense_translations.en_definition: watering pf plants gen. in a pot
sense_translations.zh_definition: 给植物浇水，通常指给盆栽植物浇水。

formal.mt: It-tbaqiq tal-pjanti fil-qsari għandu jsir skont il-ħtieġa ta' kull pjanta.
formal.en: The watering of plants in pots should be carried out according to each plant's needs.
formal.zh: 给盆栽植物浇水时，应根据每种植物的需要进行。

colloquial.mt: Pawlu: Rajtu t-tbaqiq bil-qamel fuq in-nagħaġ? Marija: Iva, irridu nieħdu ħsiebhom illum.
colloquial.en: Pawlu: Did you see the lice infestation on the sheep? Marija: Yes, we need to take care of them today.
colloquial.zh: 保罗：你看到羊身上的虱子侵扰了吗？玛丽亚：看到了，我们今天得照料它们。

messages.speaker: Pawlu (牧羊人)
messages.zh: 你看到羊身上的虱子侵扰了吗？
messages.en: Did you see the lice infestation on the sheep?

messages.speaker: Marija (农场同事)
messages.zh: 看到了，我们今天得照料它们。
messages.en: Yes, we need to take care of them today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 为这个词分画两张记忆卡：一张是虱子侵扰，一张是给盆栽浇水；分别联记 qamel 和 qsari 来辨义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be broken or split with a pickaxe, especially when working stone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指石头等被镐凿开或凿碎，尤用于石工作业。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinkiser jew jinqasam bil-baqqun, speċjalment waqt xogħol fuq il-ġebel.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be broken with a pickaxe (especially in the context of stone masonry)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被镐凿开或凿碎，尤指石工作业中的石料。

collocations.en: The stone was broken with a pickaxe.
The rock was broken into small pieces with a pickaxe.

formal.mt: Waqt ix-xogħol tal-ġebel, il-blat tbaqqan bil-baqqun biex ikun jista' jitneħħa.
formal.en: During the masonry work, the rock was broken with a pickaxe so that it could be removed.
formal.zh: 在石工作业中，岩石被镐凿碎，以便清除。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Kif inkiser dan il-ġebel? Pawlu: Tbaqqan bil-baqqun dalgħodu.
colloquial.en: Mark: How was this stone broken? Pawlu: It was broken with a pickaxe this morning.
colloquial.zh: Mark：这些石头是怎么弄碎的？Pawlu：今天早上用镐凿碎的。

messages.speaker: Mark (学徒)
messages.zh: 这些石头是怎么弄碎的？
messages.en: How was this stone broken?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (石匠)
messages.zh: 今天早上用镐凿碎的。
messages.en: It was broken with a pickaxe this morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一块石头被镐一下下凿碎，把 tbaqqan 与“石头被凿碎”的画面一起记。

gloss_zh: 滋生跳蚤、虱子等害虫；被浇水

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become infested with small vermin such as fleas or lice; in another sense, to be watered.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指滋生跳蚤、虱子等小害虫；另一个义项表示被浇水，须依语境区分。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jimtela bi briegħed, qamel jew dud ieħor; f'tifsira oħra, jingħata l-ilma.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be infested with vermin (such as fleas or lice)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 滋生或满是跳蚤、虱子等害虫。
被浇水。

collocations.en: The dog became infested with fleas.
collocations.zh: 这只狗身上滋生了跳蚤。

collocations.en: The basil in the pot was watered.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jindika li l-kelb tbaqqaq bil-briegħed u kellu bżonn kura.
formal.en: The report indicates that the dog became infested with fleas and needed treatment.
formal.zh: 报告指出，这只狗身上滋生了跳蚤，需要治疗。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Il-ħabaq fil-qasrija diġà tbaqqaq? Ġanni: Iva, tbaqqaq dalgħodu.
colloquial.en: Marija: Has the basil in the pot been watered yet? Ġanni: Yes, it was watered this morning.
colloquial.zh: Marija：盆里的罗勒已经浇过水了吗？Ġanni：是的，今天早上浇过了。

messages.speaker: Marija (室友)
messages.zh: 盆里的罗勒已经浇过水了吗？
messages.en: Has the basil in the pot been watered yet?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (室友)
messages.zh: 是的，今天早上浇过了。
messages.en: Yes, it was watered this morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 tbaqqaq 配两张语境卡：狗身上有跳蚤，盆栽接受浇水；靠主语和上下文区分两义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To curdle, as when milk separates and forms clumps.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指牛奶等发生凝结，形成凝块。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħqad u jifforma biċċiet, bħalma jagħmel il-ħalib meta jagħqad.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 发生凝结、形成凝块，尤指牛奶凝结。

collocations.mt: Il-ħalib tbaqqat wara li żdied il-meraq tal-lumi.
collocations.en: The milk curdled after lemon juice was added.
collocations.zh: 加入柠檬汁后，牛奶凝结了。

formal.mt: Waqt l-esperiment, il-ħalib tbaqqat wara ż-żieda tal-meraq tal-lumi u ffurma biċċiet żgħar.
formal.en: During the experiment, the milk curdled after lemon juice was added and formed small clumps.
formal.zh: 实验中，牛奶在加入柠檬汁后凝结，形成了小凝块。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex hemm dawn il-biċċiet fil-ħalib? Rita: Il-ħalib tbaqqat meta żidt il-lumi.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why are there these clumps in the milk? Rita: The milk curdled when I added the lemon.
colloquial.zh: Lara：牛奶里为什么有这些凝块？Rita：我加入柠檬时，牛奶凝结了。

messages.speaker: Lara (女儿)
messages.zh: 牛奶里为什么有这些凝块？
messages.en: Why are there these clumps in the milk?

messages.speaker: Rita (母亲)
messages.zh: 我加入柠檬时，牛奶凝结了。
messages.en: The milk curdled when I added the lemon.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象液态牛奶变成一小块一小块，看到 tbaqqat 就回想“牛奶凝结了”这个变化。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Work done with a pickaxe, such as breaking up stone or rock.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使用镐进行的凿掘作业，例如凿碎石头或岩石。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xogħol li jsir bil-baqqun, bħal tkissir ta' ġebel jew blat.

sense_translations.en_definition: work carried out with a pickaxe
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使用镐进行的凿掘或破碎作业。

collocations.en: breaking up rock with a pickaxe

formal.mt: It-tbaqqin tal-blat sar qabel it-tneħħija tal-biċċiet mis-sit.
formal.en: The rock was broken up with a pickaxe before the pieces were removed from the site.
formal.zh: 在将碎块运离现场之前，先进行了用镐凿碎岩石的作业。

colloquial.mt: Mark: X'xogħol għandna llum? Pawlu: Għandna t-tbaqqin tal-blat ħdejn il-ħajt.
colloquial.en: Mark: What work do we have today? Pawlu: We have to break up the rock beside the wall with a pickaxe.
colloquial.zh: Mark：我们今天有什么活儿？Pawlu：要用镐凿碎墙边的岩石。

messages.speaker: Mark (学徒)
messages.zh: 我们今天有什么活儿？
messages.en: What work do we have today?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (石匠)
messages.zh: 要用镐凿碎墙边的岩石。
messages.en: We have to break up the rock beside the wall with a pickaxe.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tbaqqin 当作工地任务名称来记：日程表上写着“用镐凿石”，强调的是整项作业。

gloss_zh: 跳蚤、虱子等虫害；盆栽浇水

teaching_sense.en_definition: An infestation of small vermin such as fleas or lice; in another sense, the watering of potted plants.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指跳蚤、虱子等小害虫的侵扰或滋生；另一个义项指给盆栽植物浇水。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Infestazzjoni ta' briegħed, qamel jew dud żgħir ieħor; f'tifsira oħra, it-tisqija tal-pjanti fil-qsari.

sense_translations.en_definition: an infestation of vermin (especially small bugs such as fleas or lice)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 害虫侵扰或滋生，尤指跳蚤、虱子等小虫造成的虫害。
给盆栽植物浇水的活动。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi tbaqqiq ta' briegħed fil-friex tal-kelb.
formal.en: The report describes a flea infestation in the dog's bedding.
formal.zh: 报告描述了狗的卧具中出现的跳蚤侵扰。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Min se jieħu ħsieb it-tbaqqiq tal-pjanti fil-qsari llum? Luqa: Jien, nagħtihom l-ilma wara x-xogħol.
colloquial.en: Anna: Who will take care of watering the potted plants today? Luqa: I will; I'll water them after work.
colloquial.zh: Anna：今天谁负责给盆栽浇水？Luqa：我来，下班后我给它们浇水。

messages.speaker: Anna (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jieħu ħsieb it-tbaqqiq tal-pjanti fil-qsari llum?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jieħu ħsieb it-tbaqqiq tal-pjanti fil-qsari llum?
messages.zh: 今天谁负责给盆栽浇水？
messages.en: Who will take care of watering the potted plants today?

messages.speaker: Luqa (室友)
messages.zh: 我来，下班后我给它们浇水。
messages.en: I will; I'll water them after work.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅图记 tbaqqiq：狗窝里的跳蚤表示虫害，水壶旁的花盆表示盆栽浇水；它在两义中都是名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The curdling or coagulation of milk, during which clumps form.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 牛奶由液态形成凝块的凝结过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li fih il-ħalib jagħqad u jifforma biċċiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 牛奶的凝结或凝乳过程。

formal.mt: L-istudenti osservaw it-tbaqqit tal-ħalib wara ż-żieda tal-meraq tal-lumi.
formal.en: The students observed the curdling of milk after lemon juice was added.
formal.zh: 学生们观察了加入柠檬汁后牛奶的凝结过程。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhu t-tbaqqit tal-ħalib? Rita: Huwa meta l-ħalib jagħqad u jifforma biċċiet, bħal dawn.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is the curdling of milk? Rita: It is when milk thickens into clumps like these.
colloquial.zh: Lara：牛奶凝结是什么意思？Rita：就是牛奶凝成这样的块状。

messages.speaker: Lara (女儿)
messages.zh: 牛奶凝结是什么意思？
messages.en: What is the curdling of milk?

messages.speaker: Rita (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa meta l-ħalib jagħqad u jifforma biċċiet, bħal dawn.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa meta l-ħalib jagħqad u jifforma biċċiet, bħal dawn.
messages.zh: 就是牛奶凝成这样的块状。
messages.en: It is when milk thickens into clumps like these.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tbaqqit 写在观察记录的标题上：“牛奶凝结过程”；用标题提醒自己这是过程名词。

gloss_zh: 纺锤旋转的嗡鸣声；售价过高的买卖

teaching_sense.en_definition: The whirring noise of a spindle; in another sense, a sale made at an excessively high price.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指纺锤旋转时发出的嗡鸣声；另一个义项指以过高价格进行的买卖。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħoss ta' magħżel waqt li jdur; f'tifsira oħra, bejgħ bi prezz għoli żżejjed.

sense_translations.en_definition: the noise made by a spindle as it whirrs
sense_translations.zh_definition: 纺锤旋转时发出的嗡鸣声。
售价过高的买卖；以过高价格成交的一笔交易。

formal.mt: Waqt id-dimostrazzjoni tal-għażil, it-tbarbir tal-magħżel kien jinstema' fil-kamra.
formal.en: During the spinning demonstration, the whirring of the spindle could be heard in the room.
formal.zh: 在纺纱演示过程中，房间里能听到纺锤旋转的嗡鸣声。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Ħallast għoxrin ewro għal dan il-ktieb użat. David: Għoxrin ewro? Dan tbarbir; fl-istess ħanut il-ġdid jiswa għaxra!
colloquial.en: Marta: I paid twenty euros for this used book. David: Twenty euros? That's an overpriced sale; a new copy costs ten in the same shop!
colloquial.zh: Marta：我花了二十欧元买这本旧书。David：二十欧元？这卖得太贵了；同一家店的新书才十欧元！

messages.speaker: Marta (买书的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħallast għoxrin ewro għal dan il-ktieb użat.
messages.mt_standard: Ħallast għoxrin ewro għal dan il-ktieb użat.
messages.zh: 我花了二十欧元买这本旧书。
messages.en: I paid twenty euros for this used book.

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għoxrin ewro? Dan tbarbir; fl-istess ħanut il-ġdid jiswa għaxra!
messages.mt_standard: Għoxrin ewro? Dan tbarbir; fl-istess ħanut il-ġdid jiswa għaxra!
messages.zh: 二十欧元？这卖得太贵了；同一家店的新书才十欧元！
messages.en: Twenty euros? That's an overpriced sale; a new copy costs ten in the same shop!

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 tbarbir 分设声音卡和交易卡：一张画嗡嗡转动的纺锤，一张画标价过高的商品，分别记住两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The soft cooing sound made by pigeons.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 鸽子发出的柔和咕咕声，也指鸽子咕咕鸣叫这一行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħoss artab li jagħmel il-ħamiem meta jgorr.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鸽子的咕咕鸣叫声。

formal.mt: Filgħodu, it-tbarqim tal-ħamiem kien jinstema' mis-siġar ħdejn il-bitħa.
formal.en: In the morning, the cooing of pigeons could be heard from the trees beside the courtyard.
formal.zh: 清晨，庭院旁的树上传来了鸽子的咕咕声。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Qed tisma' dak il-ħoss? Toni: Iva, dak it-tbarqim tal-ħamiem fuq il-bejt.
colloquial.en: Nina: Can you hear that sound? Toni: Yes, that's the cooing of the pigeons on the roof.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你听到那个声音了吗？Toni：听到了，那是屋顶上鸽子的咕咕声。

messages.speaker: Nina (邻居)
messages.zh: 你听到那个声音了吗？
messages.en: Can you hear that sound?

messages.speaker: Toni (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, dak it-tbarqim tal-ħamiem fuq il-bejt.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, dak it-tbarqim tal-ħamiem fuq il-bejt.
messages.zh: 听到了，那是屋顶上鸽子的咕咕声。
messages.en: Yes, that's the cooing of the pigeons on the roof.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象清晨屋顶上的鸽子轻轻咕咕叫，把 tbarqim 与这段声音绑定，记住它是鸣叫声的名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be excluded from a group or activity, or barred from taking part.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被排除在某个群体或活动之外，或被禁止参加。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ma jitħalliex jibqa' fi grupp jew jieħu sehem f'attività.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被排除在外；不被纳入。
被禁止参与；被取消参与资格。

formal.mt: Il-kandidat tbarra mill-kompetizzjoni għax kiser ir-regoli.
formal.en: The candidate was barred from the competition because he broke the rules.
formal.zh: 该候选人因违反规则而被取消比赛资格。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex Pawlu ma jistax jieħu sehem? Luqa: Tbarra mill-kompetizzjoni għax kiser ir-regoli.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why can't Pawlu take part? Luqa: He was barred from the competition because he broke the rules.
colloquial.zh: Marija：Pawlu 为什么不能参加？Luqa：他因违反规则而被取消了比赛资格。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Pawlu ma jistax jieħu sehem?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Pawlu ma jistax jieħu sehem?
messages.zh: Pawlu 为什么不能参加？
messages.en: Why can't Pawlu take part?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.zh: 他因违反规则而被取消了比赛资格。
messages.en: He was barred from the competition because he broke the rules.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tbarra 放进“名单上没有他”的画面中记忆：既可表示被排除，也可表示被禁止参与。

gloss_zh: 被用力扭转；被使劲拧动

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be twisted vigorously or with considerable force.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受到较大力量的扭转，被使劲拧动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġi mdawwar jew mibrum b'saħħa kbira.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被用力扭转；被使劲拧动。

formal.mt: Id-drapp imxarrab tbarram bis-saħħa biex jitneħħa l-ilma żejjed.
formal.en: The wet cloth was twisted vigorously to remove the excess water.
formal.zh: 湿布被使劲拧动，以去除多余的水分。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex id-drapp hu kollu mibrum? Mark: Tbarram bis-saħħa meta għafast l-ilma minnu.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why is the cloth all twisted? Mark: It got twisted forcefully when I squeezed the water out of it.
colloquial.zh: Anna：这块布怎么全拧在一起了？Mark：我挤出里面的水时，把它使劲拧了一遍。

messages.speaker: Anna (室友)
messages.zh: 这块布怎么全拧在一起了？
messages.en: Why is the cloth all twisted?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tbarram bis-saħħa meta għafast l-ilma minnu.
messages.mt_standard: Tbarram bis-saħħa meta għafast l-ilma minnu.
messages.zh: 我挤出里面的水时，把它使劲拧了一遍。
messages.en: It got twisted forcefully when I squeezed the water out of it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 tbarram 时想象双手使劲拧湿布，突出“用力扭转”，不要只记成轻轻转动。

gloss_zh: 被反复刮擦；被反复划伤

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be scratched repeatedly, often leaving several marks on a surface.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表面受到反复刮擦，往往留下多道划痕。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġi mibrux għal ħafna drabi, spiss b'marki fuq il-wiċċ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被反复刮擦；被多次划伤表面。

formal.mt: Il-wiċċ tal-injam tbarrax meta l-bord ġie mkaxkar fuq art mhux lixxa.
formal.en: The wooden surface was repeatedly scratched when the board was dragged over rough ground.
formal.zh: 木板在粗糙地面上被拖动时，其表面遭到反复刮擦。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex il-bord hu mimli grif? David: Tbarrax meta mexxejnieh fuq l-art.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why is the board covered in scratches? David: It got scratched repeatedly when we moved it across the floor.
colloquial.zh: Sara：木板怎么满是划痕？David：我们在地上挪动它时，反复把它刮伤了。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: 木板怎么满是划痕？
messages.en: Why is the board covered in scratches?

messages.speaker: David (室友)
messages.zh: 我们在地上挪动它时，反复把它刮伤了。
messages.en: It got scratched repeatedly when we moved it across the floor.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tbarrax 配上一块满是划痕的木板来记，画面中的多道痕迹提醒你“反复被刮”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be piled up, with stones or other objects gathered into a heap.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 石头等物品被集中堆放，形成一堆。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitqiegħed f'munzell, bħal ġebel jew oġġetti oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被堆起来；被堆放成堆。

formal.mt: Il-ġebel tbarraġ ħdejn il-ħajt qabel beda x-xogħol.
formal.en: The stones were piled beside the wall before the work began.
formal.zh: 开工前，石头被堆放在墙边。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Fejn hu l-ġebel li kien hawn? Toni: Tbarraġ ħdejn il-ħajt biex inħallu l-passaġġ vojt.
colloquial.en: Rita: Where are the stones that were here? Toni: They were piled beside the wall to leave the passage clear.
colloquial.zh: Rita：原来在这里的石头去哪儿了？Toni：堆到墙边了，好把通道空出来。

messages.speaker: Rita (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn hu l-ġebel li kien hawn?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn hu l-ġebel li kien hawn?
messages.zh: 原来在这里的石头去哪儿了？
messages.en: Where are the stones that were here?

messages.speaker: Toni (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Tbarraġ ħdejn il-ħajt biex inħallu l-passaġġ vojt.
messages.mt_standard: Tbarraġ ħdejn il-ħajt biex inħallu l-passaġġ vojt.
messages.zh: 堆到墙边了，好把通道空出来。
messages.en: They were piled beside the wall to leave the passage clear.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一张“墙边石头堆”的画面记 tbarraġ：重点是东西已经被堆起来的状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action or process of twisting something repeatedly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某物反复进行扭转或拧动的动作或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni jew il-proċess ta' brim ripetut ta' xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 反复扭转；多次拧动。

formal.mt: It-tbarrim tal-kejbil jista' jagħmel ħsara lill-wajers ta' ġewwa.
formal.en: Repeated twisting of the cable can damage the wires inside.
formal.zh: 反复拧动电缆可能损坏内部导线。

colloquial.mt: Luqa: Għaliex qed tgħidli biex ma ndawwarx il-kejbil daqshekk? Rita: Għax it-tbarrim jista' jagħmel ħsara lill-wajers ta' ġewwa.
colloquial.en: Luqa: Why are you telling me not to twist the cable so much? Rita: Because repeated twisting can damage the wires inside.
colloquial.zh: Luqa：你为什么叫我别这样一直拧电缆？Rita：因为反复拧动可能损坏里面的导线。

messages.speaker: Luqa (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed tgħidli biex ma ndawwarx il-kejbil daqshekk?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed tgħidli biex ma ndawwarx il-kejbil daqshekk?
messages.zh: 你为什么叫我别这样一直拧电缆？
messages.en: Why are you telling me not to twist the cable so much?

messages.speaker: Rita (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax it-tbarrim jista' jagħmel ħsara lill-wajers ta' ġewwa.
messages.mt_standard: Għax it-tbarrim jista' jagħmel ħsara lill-wajers ta' ġewwa.
messages.zh: 因为反复拧动可能损坏里面的导线。
messages.en: Because repeated twisting can damage the wires inside.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 tbarrim 时想象同一根绳子被一遍遍扭转；把整段重复动作当作一个名词来记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Exemption from an obligation, banishment from a place, or exclusion from a group or activity, according to context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 依语境可指免除某项义务、从某地放逐，或排除在某个群体或活动之外。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Eżenzjoni minn obbligu, tkeċċija minn post, jew esklużjoni minn grupp jew attività, skont il-kuntest.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 豁免；免除原本需要履行的义务或承担的要求。
放逐；将某人驱逐出某地。
排除；不让某人被纳入或参与。

formal.mt: It-talba għat-tbarrir minn dan l-obbligu trid issir bil-miktub.
formal.en: The request for exemption from this obligation must be made in writing.
formal.zh: 申请豁免这项义务必须以书面形式提出。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex Toni hu mdejjaq? Mark: Minħabba t-tbarrir tiegħu mill-grupp; ma għadhomx iħalluh jieħu sehem.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why is Toni upset? Mark: Because of his exclusion from the group; they no longer let him take part.
colloquial.zh: Anna：Toni 为什么不开心？Mark：因为他被排除在群体之外了；他们已经不让他参加了。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: Toni 为什么不开心？
messages.en: Why is Toni upset?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Minħabba t-tbarrir tiegħu mill-grupp; ma għadhomx iħalluh jieħu sehem.
messages.mt_standard: Minħabba t-tbarrir tiegħu mill-grupp; ma għadhomx iħalluh jieħu sehem.
messages.zh: 因为他被排除在群体之外了；他们已经不让他参加了。
messages.en: Because of his exclusion from the group; they no longer let him take part.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 tbarrir 配三张场景卡：义务获豁免、人物被放逐、成员被排除；靠搭配分别记义，不把三义混用。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action of scraping a surface or scratching it with a nail, claw, or other object.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 刮擦表面以去除附着物，或用指甲、爪子等抓挠或划擦表面的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li togħrok wiċċ biex tneħħi xi ħaġa minnu, jew li tħokk wiċċ bid-dwiefer jew b'oġġett ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 刮擦；通过刮动去除表面附着物的动作。
抓挠；用指甲、爪子等抓擦或划擦的动作。

formal.mt: It-tbarrix taż-żebgħa l-qadima sar qabel ma ngħata saff ġdid.
formal.en: The old paint was scraped off before a new coat was applied.
formal.zh: 涂刷新漆之前，先刮除了旧漆。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'inhu dak il-ħoss mal-bieb? David: Dak it-tbarrix tal-qattus; irid jidħol.
colloquial.en: Sara: What's that noise at the door? David: That's the cat scratching; it wants to come in.
colloquial.zh: Sara：门边是什么声音？David：那是猫抓门的声音；它想进来。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: 门边是什么声音？
messages.en: What's that noise at the door?

messages.speaker: David (室友)
messages.zh: 那是猫抓门的声音；它想进来。
messages.en: That's the cat scratching; it wants to come in.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“刮旧漆”和“猫抓门”两幅图记 tbarrix：前者对应 scraping，后者对应 scratching，都是动作名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or process of piling up stones or other materials.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把石头等材料堆起来的行为或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni jew il-proċess li bih il-ġebel jew materjal ieħor jitqiegħed f'munzell.

sense_translations.en_definition: the piling up of stones etc.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 石头等物品的堆放或堆积。

formal.mt: It-tbarriġ tal-ġebel ħdejn id-daħla għalaq il-passaġġ.
formal.en: The piling up of stones beside the entrance blocked the passage.
formal.zh: 在入口旁堆放石头堵住了通道。

colloquial.mt: Pawlu: X'għad fadal nagħmlu fil-bitħa? Marija: It-tbarriġ tal-ġebel ħdejn il-ħajt, imbagħad innaddfu.
colloquial.en: Pawlu: What do we still need to do in the yard? Marija: Pile up the stones beside the wall, then clean up.
colloquial.zh: Pawlu：院子里还有什么要做？Marija：把石头堆到墙边，然后打扫。

messages.speaker: Pawlu (家人)
messages.zh: 院子里还有什么要做？
messages.en: What do we still need to do in the yard?

messages.speaker: Marija (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tbarriġ tal-ġebel ħdejn il-ħajt, imbagħad innaddfu.
messages.mt_standard: It-tbarriġ tal-ġebel ħdejn il-ħajt, imbagħad innaddfu.
messages.zh: 把石头堆到墙边，然后打扫。
messages.en: Pile up the stones beside the wall, then clean up.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tbarriġ 写在“今日任务：堆石头”的便签上，记住它是给堆放这项活动命名的名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be made void or deprived of validity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被宣布无效或被取消效力。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jisfa bla validità jew bla effett.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被作废；被取消效力。

formal.mt: Il-ftehim tbarważ wara li nstabet informazzjoni falza fid-dokumenti.
formal.en: The agreement was rendered void after false information was found in the documents.
formal.zh: 文件中发现虚假信息后，该协议被作废。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Il-permess għadu validu? Rita: Le, tbarważ. Trid titlob wieħed ġdid.
colloquial.en: Mark: Is the permit still valid? Rita: No, it was rendered void. You need to apply for a new one.
colloquial.zh: Mark：许可证还有效吗？Rita：没有，已经作废了。你得重新申请一张。

messages.speaker: Mark (申请人)
messages.zh: 许可证还有效吗？
messages.en: Is the permit still valid?

messages.speaker: Rita (办事员)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, tbarważ. Trid titlob wieħed ġdid.
messages.mt_standard: Le, tbarważ. Trid titlob wieħed ġdid.
messages.zh: 没有，已经作废了。你得重新申请一张。
messages.en: No, it was rendered void. You need to apply for a new one.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象许可证被盖上“作废”印章，用这个画面记住 tbarważ 表示被取消效力。

gloss_zh: 粗劣的活儿；拙劣的缝纫

teaching_sense.en_definition: Work done clumsily or carelessly, including badly executed sewing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 笨拙或马虎完成的工作，也可特指缝得很差的针线活。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xogħol magħmul bla ħila jew bla attenzjoni, inkluż ħjata magħmula ħażin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 笨拙或粗心造成的粗劣工作。
做得很差的缝纫；拙劣的针线活。

formal.mt: It-tbarwiż fil-ħjata jidher fil-punti mhux indaqs u fit-truf mhux lesti.
formal.en: The poor sewing is evident in the uneven stitches and unfinished edges.
formal.zh: 针脚不均、边缘未收好，显出了缝纫的粗劣。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ara din il-ħjata: il-punti kollha mgħawġin! Nina: Dan tbarwiż. Aħjar nerġgħu nagħmluha.
colloquial.en: Lara: Look at this seam: all the stitches are crooked! Nina: That's sloppy sewing. We'd better do it again.
colloquial.zh: Lara：看看这条缝，针脚全歪了！Nina：这针线活太粗糙了。我们最好重新缝。

messages.speaker: Lara (缝纫学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara din il-ħjata: il-punti kollha mgħawġin!
messages.mt_standard: Ara din il-ħjata: il-punti kollha mgħawġin!
messages.zh: 看看这条缝，针脚全歪了！
messages.en: Look at this seam: all the stitches are crooked!

messages.speaker: Nina (缝纫老师)
messages.zh: 这针线活太粗糙了。我们最好重新缝。
messages.en: That's sloppy sewing. We'd better do it again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把歪斜的针脚和马虎的修理并排想象：tbarwiż 可说粗劣工作，也可专说糟糕的缝纫。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become brown through baking, or to be burnt.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因烘烤而变成褐色，或被烤焦、烧焦。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jieħu kulur kannella bil-ħami, jew jinħaraq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被烘烤至表面呈褐色。
被烧焦；被烤焦。

collocations.en: the bread browned in the oven
collocations.zh: 面包在烤箱里烤成了褐色

formal.mt: Il-ħobż tbaskat fil-forn sakemm il-qoxra ħadet kulur kannella.
formal.en: The bread baked in the oven until its crust turned brown.
formal.zh: 面包在烤箱中烘烤，直至外皮变成褐色。

colloquial.mt: Ben: Għaliex il-kejk sar daqshekk skur? Sara: Ħallejtu wisq fil-forn u tbaskat. Il-qiegħ inħaraq.
colloquial.en: Ben: Why has the cake gone so dark? Sara: I left it in the oven too long and it got overbaked. The bottom burnt.
colloquial.zh: Ben：蛋糕怎么变得这么黑？Sara：我把它放在烤箱里太久，烤过头了。底部烧焦了。

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.zh: 蛋糕怎么变得这么黑？
messages.en: Why has the cake gone so dark?

messages.speaker: Sara (烘焙者)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħallejtu wisq fil-forn u tbaskat. Il-qiegħ inħaraq.
messages.mt_standard: Ħallejtu wisq fil-forn u tbaskat. Il-qiegħ inħaraq.
messages.zh: 我把它放在烤箱里太久，烤过头了。底部烧焦了。
messages.en: I left it in the oven too long and it got overbaked. The bottom burnt.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象面包外皮从褐色继续变焦：tbaskat 的两个义项要靠上下文区分褐化与烧焦。

gloss_zh: 使食物褐化的过度烘烤

teaching_sense.en_definition: Excessive baking that causes food to become brown.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 烘烤过度而使食物变成褐色的过程或现象。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħami żejjed li jġiegħel l-ikel jieħu kulur kannella.

sense_translations.en_definition: excessive baking, causing browning of food
sense_translations.zh_definition: 导致食物变成褐色的过度烘烤。

collocations.en: excessive baking that browns the bread
collocations.zh: 使面包变褐的过度烘烤

collocations.en: to avoid excessive baking and browning

formal.mt: Biex tevita t-tbaskit tal-gallettini, naqqas il-ħin tal-ħami u ċċekkja l-kulur tagħhom spiss.
formal.en: To prevent the biscuits from becoming excessively browned through baking, shorten the baking time and check their colour frequently.
formal.zh: 为避免饼干因烘烤过度而变褐，应缩短烘烤时间，并经常查看颜色。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għaliex il-gallettini saru daqshekk kannella? Pawlu: Dan ġej mit-tbaskit. Id-darba li jmiss inħalluhom inqas fil-forn.
colloquial.en: Marta: Why have the biscuits gone so brown? Pawlu: That's from excessive baking. Next time we'll leave them in the oven for less time.
colloquial.zh: Marta：饼干怎么烤得这么褐？Pawlu：这是烘烤过度造成的。下次我们少烤一会儿。

messages.speaker: Marta (烘焙学员)
messages.zh: 饼干怎么烤得这么褐？
messages.en: Why have the biscuits gone so brown?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (烘焙老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan ġej mit-tbaskit. Id-darba li jmiss inħalluhom inqas fil-forn.
messages.mt_standard: Dan ġej mit-tbaskit. Id-darba li jmiss inħalluhom inqas fil-forn.
messages.zh: 这是烘烤过度造成的。下次我们少烤一会儿。
messages.en: That's from excessive baking. Next time we'll leave them in the oven for less time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把烤箱计时器超时、饼干颜色过深连成一个画面，记住 tbaskit 是过度烘烤这一名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be stated in advance as something expected to happen.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某事在发生之前被预先判断或预报。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħad minn qabel li xi ħaġa mistennija sseħħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被预测；被预先判断会发生。

collocations.en: a decline in sales was predicted

formal.mt: Fir-rapport tbassar tnaqqis fil-bejgħ matul ix-xhur tax-xitwa.
formal.en: A decline in sales during the winter months was predicted in the report.
formal.zh: 报告预测，冬季几个月的销售额将会下降。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Għada mmorru ħdejn il-baħar? Mark: Aħjar le. Tbassar riħ qawwi.
colloquial.en: Lina: Shall we go to the seaside tomorrow? Mark: Better not. Strong wind has been forecast.
colloquial.zh: Lina：明天我们去海边吗？Mark：最好别去。预报说会有大风。

messages.speaker: Lina (朋友)
messages.zh: 明天我们去海边吗？
messages.en: Shall we go to the seaside tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 最好别去。预报说会有大风。
messages.en: Better not. Strong wind has been forecast.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到天气图上提前标出的大风，记住 tbassar 强调某件事已经被预测或预报。

gloss_zh: 勉强尝试做能力范围以外的事

teaching_sense.en_definition: To attempt an action that one does not have the skill or competence to perform.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在缺乏所需能力或技能的情况下，仍尝试做某件事。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jipprova jagħmel xi ħaġa li ma għandux il-ħila jew il-kompetenza meħtieġa għaliha.

sense_translations.en_definition: to try to perform an action that is not within one's competence
sense_translations.zh_definition: 尝试做超出自己能力或专业技能范围的事情。

collocations.en: he attempted to repair the machine without the necessary competence
collocations.zh: 他不具备所需技能却尝试修理机器

collocations.en: he attempted the sewing without the necessary skill
collocations.zh: 他没有相应手艺却尝试做针线活

formal.mt: Minkejja li ma kellux taħriġ, Pawlu tbassas biex isewwi l-magna u fl-aħħar talab l-għajnuna ta' tekniku.
formal.en: Despite having no training, Pawlu attempted to repair the machine beyond his competence and eventually asked a technician for help.
formal.zh: Pawlu 虽然没有受过培训，仍尝试修理超出自己能力范围的机器，最后向技术人员求助。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min ipprova jsewwi din il-magna? Toni: Ħija tbassas biex isewwiha, imma ma jafx kif taħdem.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who tried to repair this machine? Toni: My brother tried his hand at repairing it beyond his abilities, but he doesn't know how it works.
colloquial.zh: Maja：谁试着修过这台机器？Toni：我哥哥没这个本事却硬着头皮试着修，其实他连机器怎么运作都不知道。

messages.speaker: Maja (技术员)
messages.zh: 谁试着修过这台机器？
messages.en: Who tried to repair this machine?

messages.speaker: Toni (机器主人)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħija tbassas biex isewwiha, imma ma jafx kif taħdem.
messages.mt_standard: Ħija tbassas biex isewwiha, imma ma jafx kif taħdem.
messages.zh: 我哥哥没这个本事却硬着头皮试着修，其实他连机器怎么运作都不知道。
messages.en: My brother tried his hand at repairing it beyond his abilities, but he doesn't know how it works.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个不懂机器的人拿起工具硬着头皮尝试：tbassas 的重点是所做之事超出自身能力。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A statement about what is expected to happen, such as a forecast, prediction, or prophecy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对未来将发生之事所作的陈述，可指预报、预测或预言。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dikjarazzjoni dwar dak li mistenni jiġri fil-futur, bħal previżjoni tat-temp jew profezija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 预报，尤其指根据已有信息对天气等未来情况作出的预先报告。
预测；对未来事件或结果所作的判断。
预言；常见于宗教或神秘语境中对未来事件的宣告。

formal.mt: It-tbassir tal-bejgħ għas-sena d-dieħla huwa bbażat fuq id-dejta tal-aħħar tliet snin.
formal.en: The sales forecast for next year is based on data from the last three years.
formal.zh: 明年的销售预测以过去三年的数据为依据。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Rajt it-tbassir tat-temp għal għada? Ben: Iva, se tagħmel ix-xita. Ħu umbrella miegħek.
colloquial.en: Sara: Have you seen tomorrow's weather forecast? Ben: Yes, it's going to rain. Take an umbrella with you.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你看明天的天气预报了吗？Ben：看了，会下雨。带把伞吧。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你看明天的天气预报了吗？
messages.en: Have you seen tomorrow's weather forecast?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, se tagħmel ix-xita. Ħu umbrella miegħek.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, se tagħmel ix-xita. Ħu umbrella miegħek.
messages.zh: 看了，会下雨。带把伞吧。
messages.en: Yes, it's going to rain. Take an umbrella with you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把天气预报、销售预测、先知预言放在同一条未来时间线上，记住 tbassir 的三种语境。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be suffered or endured, especially of consequences, or to experience hardship.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指后果等被承受、被忍受，也可指人经历困苦。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġi mġarrab jew imġarrab b'tbatija, speċjalment meta jkun hemm konsegwenzi; jew jgħaddi minn żmien diffiċli.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be suffered (typically used with reference to consequences of sth.)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被承受；被忍受，通常用于某事所造成的后果。
经历困苦；遭受艰难。

collocations.en: he experienced hardship for many years

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-uġigħ li tbata wara l-inċident u l-appoġġ li ngħata lill-familja.
formal.en: The report describes the pain endured after the accident and the support provided to the family.
formal.zh: 报告描述了事故后所承受的痛苦，以及向这家人提供的支持。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Kif kien ħajtu meta tilef ix-xogħol? Marija: Tbata ħafna, imma sħabu għenuh sakemm sab xogħol ieħor.
colloquial.en: Anna: What was his life like when he lost his job? Marija: He went through a lot of hardship, but his friends helped him until he found another job.
colloquial.zh: Anna：他失业时过得怎么样？Marija：他吃了很多苦，不过朋友们一直帮着他，直到他找到另一份工作。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif kien ħajtu meta tilef ix-xogħol?
messages.mt_standard: Kif kien ħajtu meta tilef ix-xogħol?
messages.zh: 他失业时过得怎么样？
messages.en: What was his life like when he lost his job?

messages.speaker: Marija (家属)
messages.mt_spoken: Tbata ħafna, imma sħabu għenuh sakemm sab xogħol ieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Tbata ħafna, imma sħabu għenuh sakemm sab xogħol ieħor.
messages.zh: 他吃了很多苦，不过朋友们一直帮着他，直到他找到另一份工作。
messages.en: He went through a lot of hardship, but his friends helped him until he found another job.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅画记忆 tbata：一幅是痛苦被承受，另一幅是一个人熬过困苦；注意句中主语。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Hardship, suffering, or physical or emotional pain experienced by someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一个人经历的艰苦、苦难，或身体及情感上的痛苦。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Diffikultà, sofferenza jew uġigħ li persuna tgħaddi minnhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 艰苦；困苦；生活或处境上的艰难。
苦难；身心所承受的痛苦。
疼痛；身体或情感上的痛楚。

formal.mt: L-għajnuna lill-familji għandha l-għan li tnaqqas it-tbatija kkawżata mill-faqar.
formal.en: The assistance for families aims to reduce the suffering caused by poverty.
formal.zh: 这项家庭援助旨在减轻贫困造成的痛苦。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Kif għaddiet il-ġurnata? Pawlu: B'ħafna tbatija; dahri għadu juġagħni. Marija: Oqgħod bilqiegħda ftit, ħa ngħinek jien.
colloquial.en: Marija: How did the day go? Pawlu: With a lot of pain; my back still hurts. Marija: Sit down for a while; let me help you.
colloquial.zh: Marija：今天过得怎么样？Pawlu：挺痛苦的，我的背还在疼。Marija：坐下来歇一会儿，我来帮你。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 今天过得怎么样？
messages.en: How did the day go?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 挺痛苦的，我的背还在疼。
messages.en: With a lot of pain; my back still hurts.

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Oqgħod bilqiegħda ftit, ħa ngħinek jien.
messages.mt_standard: Oqgħod bilqiegħda ftit, ħa ngħinek jien.
messages.zh: 坐下来歇一会儿，我来帮你。
messages.en: Sit down for a while; let me help you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tbatija 放进三个画面记忆：生活艰难、心里难受、身体疼痛，共同核心都是承受痛苦。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become empty when the contents are removed or drained.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因内容物被取出、倒出或排出而变空。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir vojt wara li jitneħħa jew joħroġ dak li jkun fih.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被倒空；被清空；被排空。

formal.mt: It-tank tbattal kompletament qabel ma beda x-xogħol ta' tindif.
formal.en: The tank was completely emptied before the cleaning work began.
formal.zh: 清洁工作开始前，储罐已被完全排空。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għad hemm ilma fil-barmil? Mark: Le, il-barmil tbattal. Lara: Mela nimlieh mill-ġdid.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is there still water in the bucket? Mark: No, the bucket has been emptied. Lara: Then I'll fill it again.
colloquial.zh: Lara：桶里还有水吗？Mark：没有，桶已经倒空了。Lara：那我再把它装满。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 桶里还有水吗？
messages.en: Is there still water in the bucket?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 没有，桶已经倒空了。
messages.en: No, the bucket has been emptied.

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 那我再把它装满。
messages.en: Then I'll fill it again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住桶里最后一滴水也被倒出的画面：tbattal 说的是容器变空这一变化。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be covered with plaster, or to become hard.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表面被抹上灰浆，或材料变得坚硬。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinkesa b'saff ta' tikħil, jew isir iebes.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被抹灰；表面被涂覆灰浆。
变硬；硬化。

formal.mt: Il-ħajt tbattam biex jitnaqqas id-dħul tal-ilma.
formal.en: The wall was plastered to reduce water penetration.
formal.zh: 墙面经过抹灰处理，以减少水分渗入。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dan it-tajn għadu artab? Toni: Le, tbattam wara li nixef. Nina: Issa nifhem għaliex hu daqshekk iebes.
colloquial.en: Nina: Is this mud still soft? Toni: No, it hardened after it dried. Nina: Now I understand why it is so hard.
colloquial.zh: Nina：这些泥还软吗？Toni：不软了，干了以后就变硬了。Nina：现在我明白为什么这么硬了。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 这些泥还软吗？
messages.en: Is this mud still soft?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 不软了，干了以后就变硬了。
messages.en: No, it hardened after it dried.

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Issa nifhem għaliex hu daqshekk iebes.
messages.mt_standard: Issa nifhem għaliex hu daqshekk iebes.
messages.zh: 现在我明白为什么这么硬了。
messages.en: Now I understand why it is so hard.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个画面分别记义：墙面被抹上灰浆，湿泥干后变硬；遇到 tbattam 先看主语和上下文。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of emptying something or discharging its contents.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将某物内部的内容物倒出、清除或排出的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih jitneħħa jew joħroġ dak li jkun hemm ġewwa xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 倒空；清空；移除内部内容物的过程。
排空；排出体内内容物，如排尿。

formal.mt: It-tbattil tat-tank għandu jitlesta qabel l-ispezzjoni.
formal.en: The emptying of the tank must be completed before the inspection.
formal.zh: 储罐的排空必须在检查前完成。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Imiss lil min it-tbattil tal-bins illum? Luqa: Lili. Noħroġhom wara l-ikel. Sara: Grazzi, illum mimlijin.
colloquial.en: Sara: Whose turn is it to empty the bins today? Luqa: Mine. I'll take them out after the meal. Sara: Thanks, they're full today.
colloquial.zh: Sara：今天轮到谁清空垃圾桶？Luqa：轮到我。吃完饭我就把它们拿出去。Sara：谢谢，今天桶都满了。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Imiss lil min it-tbattil tal-bins illum?
messages.mt_standard: Imiss lil min it-tbattil tal-bins illum?
messages.zh: 今天轮到谁清空垃圾桶？
messages.en: Whose turn is it to empty the bins today?

messages.speaker: Luqa (室友)
messages.zh: 轮到我。吃完饭我就把它们拿出去。
messages.en: Mine. I'll take them out after the meal.

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: 谢谢，今天桶都满了。
messages.en: Thanks, they're full today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tbattil 当作过程名称来记：倒空水箱是一次排空，膀胱排出尿液也是一种排空。

gloss_zh: 防水抹灰；涂抹防水灰浆

teaching_sense.en_definition: The application of plaster to a surface, such as a wall, for waterproofing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为防水而在墙面等表面涂抹灰浆的施工过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kisi ta' wiċċ, bħal ħajt, b'saff ta' tikħil biex ma jgħaddix ilma.

sense_translations.en_definition: to plaster (e.g. a wall) for waterproofing
sense_translations.zh_definition: 防水抹灰；为防止渗水而给墙面等涂抹灰浆的作业。

formal.mt: Il-proġett jinkludi t-tbattim tal-ġibjun biex jitnaqqas it-tnixxija tal-ilma.
formal.en: The project includes waterproof plastering of the cistern to reduce water leakage.
formal.zh: 该项目包括蓄水池的防水抹灰作业，以减少漏水。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għaliex hemm bżonn it-tbattim ta' dan il-ħajt? Ġużeppi: Biex l-ilma ma jgħaddix minnu. Rita: Tajjeb, issa fhimt għalxiex se jsir ix-xogħol.
colloquial.en: Rita: Why does this wall need waterproof plastering? Ġużeppi: To stop water passing through it. Rita: Good, now I understand what the work is for.
colloquial.zh: Rita：为什么这面墙需要做防水抹灰？Ġużeppi：为了防止水从墙里渗过去。Rita：好，现在我明白这项工程的用途了。

messages.speaker: Rita (屋主)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex hemm bżonn it-tbattim ta' dan il-ħajt?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex hemm bżonn it-tbattim ta' dan il-ħajt?
messages.zh: 为什么这面墙需要做防水抹灰？
messages.en: Why does this wall need waterproof plastering?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (泥瓦匠)
messages.zh: 为了防止水从墙里渗过去。
messages.en: To stop water passing through it.

messages.speaker: Rita (屋主)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, issa fhimt għalxiex se jsir ix-xogħol.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, issa fhimt għalxiex se jsir ix-xogħol.
messages.zh: 好，现在我明白这项工程的用途了。
messages.en: Good, now I understand what the work is for.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象给蓄水池内壁抹上一层防水灰浆，把 tbattim 记成这项施工的名称，重点是防止渗水。

gloss_zh: 频繁或反复给动物断尾

teaching_sense.en_definition: The frequent or repeated practice of docking an animal's tail.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 频繁或反复实施动物尾部截短的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-prattika ta' qtugħ ta' parti minn denb annimal, magħmula ta' spiss jew ripetutament.

sense_translations.en_definition: frequent or repeated docking of an animal's tail
sense_translations.zh_definition: 频繁或反复给动物断尾，即截短动物尾部的行为。

collocations.zh: 频繁或反复的断尾行为

collocations.en: the practice of frequent or repeated tail docking
collocations.zh: 频繁或反复实施断尾的做法

collocations.en: a report on frequent or repeated tail docking
collocations.zh: 关于频繁或反复断尾的报告

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-prattika tat-tbattir tad-denb fl-annimali u l-frekwenza tagħha.
formal.en: The report describes the practice of repeated tail docking in animals and its frequency.
formal.zh: 该报告描述了反复给动物断尾的做法及其发生频率。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser 'tbattir' f'dan it-test? David: Tfisser qtugħ ta' parti minn denb annimal, magħmul ta' spiss jew ripetutament. Maja: Mela hawn il-kelma tenfasizza li l-prattika tirrepeti ruħha.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'tbattir' mean in this text? David: It means cutting off part of an animal's tail, done frequently or repeatedly. Maja: So here the word emphasizes that the practice is repeated.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这篇文章里的 tbattir 是什么意思？David：指频繁或反复地截去动物尾巴的一部分。Maja：所以这里这个词强调这种做法反复发生。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这篇文章里的 tbattir 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'tbattir' mean in this text?

messages.speaker: David (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser qtugħ ta' parti minn denb annimal, magħmul ta' spiss jew ripetutament.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser qtugħ ta' parti minn denb annimal, magħmul ta' spiss jew ripetutament.
messages.zh: 指频繁或反复地截去动物尾巴的一部分。
messages.en: It means cutting off part of an animal's tail, done frequently or repeatedly.

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela hawn il-kelma tenfasizza li l-prattika tirrepeti ruħha.
messages.mt_standard: Mela hawn il-kelma tenfasizza li l-prattika tirrepeti ruħha.
messages.zh: 所以这里这个词强调这种做法反复发生。
messages.en: So here the word emphasizes that the practice is repeated.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tbattir 旁边写上两个提示：动物尾巴、频繁反复；记忆时两项都保留，避免只记成普通剪短。

gloss_zh: 田地变成牧地；转为放牧地

teaching_sense.en_definition: For a field or agricultural land to become pasture or grazing land.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指田地或农业用地变成供牲畜吃草的牧地。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħad għal raba' li jsir mergħa jew art fejn jirgħu l-annimali.

sense_translations.en_definition: to become pasture or grazing land (used of fields)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 变成牧地或放牧地；用于描述田地。

collocations.en: a field that became grazing land

formal.mt: Ir-raba' tbawwar u issa jintuża biex jirgħu n-nagħaġ.
formal.en: The farmland became pasture and is now used for grazing sheep.
formal.zh: 这片农田变成了牧地，现在用于放羊。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għadhom ikabbru l-ħxejjex f'dik l-għalqa? Pietru: Le, tbawwret; issa jirgħu n-nagħaġ fiha. Anna: Mela issa hi mergħa.
colloquial.en: Anna: Do they still grow vegetables in that field? Pietru: No, it became grazing land; sheep graze there now. Anna: So it is pasture now.
colloquial.zh: Anna：那块田里还种蔬菜吗？Pietru：不种了，已经变成放牧地，现在羊在那里吃草。Anna：那现在就是牧地了。

messages.speaker: Anna (邻居)
messages.zh: 那块田里还种蔬菜吗？
messages.en: Do they still grow vegetables in that field?

messages.speaker: Pietru (农民)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, tbawwret; issa jirgħu n-nagħaġ fiha.
messages.mt_standard: Le, tbawwret; issa jirgħu n-nagħaġ fiha.
messages.zh: 不种了，已经变成放牧地，现在羊在那里吃草。
messages.en: No, it became grazing land; sheep graze there now.

messages.speaker: Anna (邻居)
messages.zh: 那现在就是牧地了。
messages.en: So it is pasture now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象同一块田从种菜变成羊群吃草的地方；tbawwar 要记住的是田地用途变为放牧。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To remain idle or to spend one's life without working.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 闲着不做事，或过着不工作的生活。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Joqgħod bla ma jagħmel xejn jew jgħix mingħajr ma jaħdem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 闲着；无所事事。
不工作地生活；过着不做工的日子。

collocations.en: he lived without working for a long time
collocations.zh: 他很长一段时间都没有工作地过日子

formal.mt: Fil-ġrajja, il-karattru prinċipali tbaxraq għal żmien twil u għex mingħajr ma ħadem.
formal.en: In the story, the main character remained idle for a long time and lived without working.
formal.zh: 故事中的主人公长期无所事事，过着不工作的生活。

colloquial.mt: Elena: X'għamel Toni waqt il-vaganzi? Mark: Tbaxraq id-dar il-ġurnata kollha. Elena: Lanqas ħareġ għal mixja? Mark: Le, baqa' fuq is-sufan.
colloquial.en: Elena: What did Toni do during the holidays? Mark: He idled at home all day. Elena: Didn't he even go out for a walk? Mark: No, he stayed on the sofa.
colloquial.zh: Elena：Toni 假期里做了什么？Mark：他整天在家闲着。Elena：连出去散步都没有？Mark：没有，一直待在沙发上。

messages.speaker: Elena (朋友)
messages.zh: Toni 假期里做了什么？
messages.en: What did Toni do during the holidays?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 他整天在家闲着。
messages.en: He idled at home all day.

messages.speaker: Elena (朋友)
messages.zh: 连出去散步都没有？
messages.en: Didn't he even go out for a walk?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 没有，一直待在沙发上。
messages.en: No, he stayed on the sofa.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用沙发上的一天来记 tbaxraq：短时是闲着不做事，拉长到生活状态就是不工作地过日子。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become known through an announcement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过宣布或公告而被人知晓，强调消息被公布。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir magħruf permezz ta' avviż jew stqarrija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被宣布；被公布

collocations.en: the opening of the centre was announced
collocations.zh: 中心开放的消息公布了

formal.mt: Ir-riżultat tal-konkors tbaxxar waqt il-laqgħa pubblika.
formal.en: The result of the competition was announced during the public meeting.
formal.zh: 比赛结果在公开会议上公布了。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ir-riżultat tbaxxar diġà? Ben: Iva, tbaxxar dalgħodu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Has the result been announced already? Ben: Yes, it was announced this morning.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：结果已经公布了吗？本：是的，今天早上公布了。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 结果已经公布了吗？
messages.en: Has the result been announced already?

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.zh: 是的，今天早上公布了。
messages.en: Yes, it was announced this morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它放进“结果被公布”的画面记忆：主语是结果或消息，重点是被宣布，而不是谁来宣布。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A loss or lowering of dignity or worth, including the act of belittling oneself.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 尊严或价值受到贬损，也可指主动贬低自己、使自己显得卑微。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tnaqqis fid-dinjità jew fil-valur ta' persuna, inkluż meta persuna ċċekken lilha nnifisha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 尊严或价值的贬损；使人受辱的贬低
自我贬抑；主动贬低自己或表现得卑微

formal.mt: L-awtur jiddistingwi bejn l-umiltà u t-tbaxxija: persuna tista' tagħraf l-iżbalji tagħha mingħajr ma tiċħad il-valur tagħha stess.
formal.en: The author distinguishes humility from self-abasement: a person can acknowledge their mistakes without denying their own worth.
formal.zh: 作者区分了谦逊与自我贬抑：一个人可以承认自己的错误，而不必否定自身的价值。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Biex nitlob skuża, irrid ngħid li ma niswa għal xejn? Sara: Le, dik tkun tbaxxija, mhux apoloġija.
colloquial.en: Maja: To apologise, do I have to say that I am worthless? Sara: No, that would be self-abasement, not an apology.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：道歉就得说自己一无是处吗？萨拉：不用，那是自我贬抑，不是道歉。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex nitlob skuża, irrid ngħid li ma niswa għal xejn?
messages.mt_standard: Biex nitlob skuża, irrid ngħid li ma niswa għal xejn?
messages.zh: 道歉就得说自己一无是处吗？
messages.en: To apologise, do I have to say that I am worthless?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, dik tkun tbaxxija, mhux apoloġija.
messages.mt_standard: Le, dik tkun tbaxxija, mhux apoloġija.
messages.zh: 不用，那是自我贬抑，不是道歉。
messages.en: No, that would be self-abasement, not an apology.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“尊严被压低”的画面串起两个义项：别人贬低你是贬损，自己贬低自己是自我贬抑；这是学习联想。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of something being announced, or the act of making an announcement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某事被宣布、被公布的过程，或作出宣布这一行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih xi ħaġa ssir magħrufa, jew l-att li wieħed jagħmel avviż jew stqarrija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被宣布；被公布这一过程
作出宣布；发布公告这一行为

formal.mt: It-tbaxxir tar-riżultati se jsir wara li jitlestew il-verifiki kollha.
formal.en: The announcement of the results will take place after all checks have been completed.
formal.zh: 结果将在所有核查完成后公布。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Meta se jsir it-tbaxxir tar-riżultati? Mark: Għada filgħodu; imbagħad inkunu nafu min rebaħ.
colloquial.en: Nina: When will the announcement of the results take place? Mark: Tomorrow morning; then we will know who won.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：什么时候公布结果？马克：明天早上，到时就知道谁赢了。

messages.speaker: Nina (参赛者)
messages.zh: 什么时候公布结果？
messages.en: When will the announcement of the results take place?

messages.speaker: Mark (参赛者)
messages.mt_spoken: Għada filgħodu; imbagħad inkunu nafu min rebaħ.
messages.mt_standard: Għada filgħodu; imbagħad inkunu nafu min rebaħ.
messages.zh: 明天早上，到时就知道谁赢了。
messages.en: Tomorrow morning; then we will know who won.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把一次公布活动当作一个整体来记：从消息看是“被公布”，从发布者看是“作出宣布”，这里两者都是名词意义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To grow fat or become heavier through an increase in body fat.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体脂肪增多而变胖。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir aktar oħxon minħabba żieda fix-xaħam tal-ġisem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 长胖；身体变胖。

formal.mt: Il-kelb tbaċċan matul ix-xitwa, u sidu nnota l-bidla fid-daqs tiegħu.
formal.en: The dog grew fat over the winter, and its owner noticed the change in its size.
formal.zh: 这只狗在冬天里长胖了，主人注意到了它体形的变化。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Il-kelb tbaċċan minn meta rajtu l-aħħar. Mark: Iva, iċ-ċinga l-qadima issa ssikkata wisq.
colloquial.en: Lara: The dog has grown fatter since I last saw him. Mark: Yes, his old harness is now too tight.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这只狗比我上次见它时胖了。马克：是啊，原来的胸背带现在太紧了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kelb tbaċċan minn meta rajtu l-aħħar.
messages.mt_standard: Il-kelb tbaċċan minn meta rajtu l-aħħar.
messages.zh: 这只狗比我上次见它时胖了。
messages.en: The dog has grown fatter since I last saw him.

messages.speaker: Mark (狗的主人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, iċ-ċinga l-qadima issa ssikkata wisq.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, iċ-ċinga l-qadima issa ssikkata wisq.
messages.zh: 是啊，原来的胸背带现在太紧了。
messages.en: Yes, his old harness is now too tight.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用狗长胖后胸背带变紧的画面记忆，重点记住这是“变胖”的动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become plump, with a fuller or rounder body.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体变得较丰满、较圆润。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir aktar mimli u tond fil-ġisem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得丰满；身体变得圆润。

formal.mt: Matul ix-xahar, il-qattus tbaċċaċ ftit u deher aktar mimli.
formal.en: Over the month, the cat became a little plumper and looked fuller.
formal.zh: 这个月里，猫变得圆润了一点，看起来更丰满了。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-qattus tbaċċaċ ftit, hux? Pawlu: Iva, ara kemm sar tond!
colloquial.en: Maja: The cat has become a little plumper, hasn't he? Pawlu: Yes, look how round he has become!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这只猫变圆润了一点，对吧？保罗：是啊，看它现在多圆！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这只猫变圆润了一点，对吧？
messages.en: The cat has become a little plumper, hasn't he?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (猫的主人)
messages.zh: 是啊，看它现在多圆！
messages.en: Yes, look how round he has become!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象小猫的轮廓逐渐变圆，用前后两张照片记住“变得丰满”这个变化动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of becoming fat or making an animal fat.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体长胖的过程，也可指使动物增肥的育肥过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih annimal isir jew jitkabbar aktar oħxon.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 育肥；使身体增肥或身体长胖的过程。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi t-tbaċċin tal-ħnieżer fir-razzett u jirreġistra l-piż tagħhom.
formal.en: The report describes the fattening of pigs on the farm and records their weight.
formal.zh: 报告介绍了农场里猪的育肥过程，并记录了它们的体重。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan l-għalf għat-tbaċċin tal-ħnieżer? Toni: Iva, u nżomm nota tal-piż tagħhom kull ġimgħa.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is this feed for fattening the pigs? Toni: Yes, and I keep a record of their weight every week.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这些饲料是用来给猪育肥的吗？托尼：是的，我还每周记录它们的体重。

messages.speaker: Sara (农场访客)
messages.zh: 这些饲料是用来给猪育肥的吗？
messages.en: Is this feed for fattening the pigs?

messages.speaker: Toni (农场工作人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u nżomm nota tal-piż tagħhom kull ġimgħa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u nżomm nota tal-piż tagħhom kull ġimgħa.
messages.zh: 是的，我还每周记录它们的体重。
messages.en: Yes, and I keep a record of their weight every week.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象农场的饲料袋旁放着体重记录表，把 tbaċċin 和“育肥这个过程”一起记忆。

gloss_zh: 变丰满的过程；身体变圆润

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of becoming plump or fuller in body.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体逐渐变得丰满、圆润的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih il-ġisem isir aktar mimli u tond.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得丰满或圆润的过程。

formal.mt: It-tbaċċiċ tal-qattus kien gradwali u deher meta tqabblu r-ritratti tiegħu.
formal.en: The cat's becoming plumper was gradual and became apparent when its photographs were compared.
formal.zh: 这只猫是逐渐变圆润的，对比它的照片时便能看出这种变化。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Innutajt it-tbaċċiċ tal-qattus? Pawlu: Iva, fir-ritratt il-qadim jidher ħafna irqaq.
colloquial.en: Maja: Have you noticed the cat's becoming plumper? Pawlu: Yes, he looks much thinner in the old photograph.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你注意到这只猫变圆润的变化了吗？保罗：注意到了，旧照片里的它瘦多了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你注意到这只猫变圆润的变化了吗？
messages.en: Have you noticed the cat's becoming plumper?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (猫的主人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, fir-ritratt il-qadim jidher ħafna irqaq.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, fir-ritratt il-qadim jidher ħafna irqaq.
messages.zh: 注意到了，旧照片里的它瘦多了。
messages.en: Yes, he looks much thinner in the old photograph.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把几张由瘦到圆润的照片排成一列，整段“变丰满的过程”就是这个名词所指的内容。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of rinsing something with water, for example to remove soap or remaining dirt.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用水冲洗或漂洗物品，以去除肥皂或残留污物的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed jgħaddi l-ilma fuq xi ħaġa biex ineħħi s-sapun jew il-ħmieġ li jkun fadal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用水冲洗、漂洗的行为。

formal.mt: Wara l-ħasil bis-sapun, huwa meħtieġ tbaħbiħ bl-ilma nadif biex jitneħħa s-sapun li jkun fadal.
formal.en: After washing with soap, rinsing with clean water is necessary to remove any remaining soap.
formal.zh: 用肥皂洗涤后，需要用清水漂洗，以去除残留的肥皂。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Dawn il-ħwejjeġ għad għandhom is-sapun? Luqa: Iva, għandhom bżonn tbaħbiħ ieħor.
colloquial.en: Marija: Do these clothes still have soap in them? Luqa: Yes, they need another rinse.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：这些衣服上还有肥皂吗？卢卡：有，还得再漂洗一次。

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.zh: 这些衣服上还有肥皂吗？
messages.en: Do these clothes still have soap in them?

messages.speaker: Luqa (儿子)
messages.zh: 有，还得再漂洗一次。
messages.en: Yes, they need another rinse.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象衣服洗完仍带泡沫，再过一遍清水；用“清水带走残留泡沫”的动作记住冲洗、漂洗。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Fooling around or behaving in a silly, foolish way.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 胡闹、做傻事或表现得愚傻的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-aġir ta' min jagħmel il-buffu jew iġib ruħu b'mod iblah.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 胡闹；耍闹或做出逗弄人的傻举动。
做傻事；表现得愚蠢或欠缺判断。

formal.mt: L-għalliem spjega li t-tbaħnin waqt il-lezzjoni jfixkel lill-istudenti l-oħra.
formal.en: The teacher explained that fooling around during the lesson distracts the other students.
formal.zh: 老师解释说，上课时胡闹会分散其他学生的注意力。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Biżżejjed tbaħnin, irridu nlestu! Mark: Tajjeb, issa noqgħod serju.
colloquial.en: Maja: Enough fooling around, we need to finish! Mark: All right, I'll be serious now.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：别再胡闹了，我们得做完！马克：好，我现在认真起来。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 别再胡闹了，我们得做完！
messages.en: Enough fooling around, we need to finish!

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 好，我现在认真起来。
messages.en: All right, I'll be serious now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象同学忙着扮鬼脸，旁人说“别胡闹了”；把这个词与具体的傻举动联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be treated by fumigation; in a separate sense, to be travelled across or through by boat or ship.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 接受熏蒸处理；另一个独立义项指水域被船只航行经过。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġi trattat bil-fumigazzjoni; f'tifsira oħra, jiġi traversat minn dgħajsa jew vapur.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被熏蒸，接受熏蒸处理。
指水域被船只航行经过或穿越。

collocations.en: The canal was navigated at night.
collocations.zh: 船只在夜间航行通过了运河。

formal.mt: Skont ir-rapport, il-maħżen tbaħħar qabel ma reġa' ntuża għall-ħażna.
formal.en: According to the report, the warehouse was fumigated before being used for storage again.
formal.zh: 据报告，仓库在重新用于储物之前接受了熏蒸处理。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Dan il-kanal qatt tbaħħar billejl? Pietru: Iva, il-kaptan qal li diġà għadda minnu billejl.
colloquial.en: Anna: Has this canal ever been navigated at night? Pietru: Yes, the captain said he has already taken a boat through it at night.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：以前有船在夜间航行通过这条运河吗？彼得：有，船长说他以前就曾在夜里驾船经过这里。

messages.speaker: Anna (乘客)
messages.zh: 以前有船在夜间航行通过这条运河吗？
messages.en: Has this canal ever been navigated at night?

messages.speaker: Pietru (船员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-kaptan qal li diġà għadda minnu billejl.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-kaptan qal li diġà għadda minnu billejl.
messages.zh: 有，船长说他以前就曾在夜里驾船经过这里。
messages.en: Yes, the captain said he has already taken a boat through it at night.

cognitive_memory_aid: 建立两张独立记忆卡：仓库接受熏蒸、船只通过运河。看到主语和场景后再选义，不强行把两个意思合并。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To have other people speak badly about you or make false, damaging statements about you.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 遭到他人背后贬损，或受到损害名誉的不实指控。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħad kliem ħażin fuq persuna, jew jingħadu affarijiet foloz li jagħmlu ħsara lir-reputazzjoni tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被人说坏话；遭到言语贬损。
遭到诽谤；被不实言论损害名誉。

collocations.en: he was bad-mouthed behind his back
he was bad-mouthed in front of everyone
collocations.zh: 他当着众人的面遭到贬损

formal.mt: L-impjegat tbaħħat quddiem il-kollegi tiegħu, għalkemm ma kien hemm ebda prova kontra tiegħu.
formal.en: The employee was slandered in front of his colleagues, although there was no evidence against him.
formal.zh: 这名员工当着同事的面遭到诽谤，尽管并没有任何对他不利的证据。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Mark ma jridx jiġi? Lara: Tbaħħat wara dahru, u issa ma jafx lil min jafda.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why doesn't Mark want to come? Lara: People bad-mouthed him behind his back, and now he doesn't know whom to trust.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克为什么不愿意来？拉拉：有人在背后说他的坏话，他现在不知道该信任谁。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克为什么不愿意来？
messages.en: Why doesn't Mark want to come?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tbaħħat wara dahru, u issa ma jafx lil min jafda.
messages.mt_standard: Tbaħħat wara dahru, u issa ma jafx lil min jafda.
messages.zh: 有人在背后说他的坏话，他现在不知道该信任谁。
messages.en: People bad-mouthed him behind his back, and now he doesn't know whom to trust.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个动词放进“他被人在背后说坏话”的画面，重点记住主语是受到贬损的人。

gloss_zh: 被清空；变得空无；变得荒凉

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be emptied or become empty, devoid of contents, or desolate.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被腾空，变得空无内容，或变得荒凉冷清。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitbattal, jispiċċa bla kontenut jew isir vojt u mitluq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被倒空、腾空或清空其中的东西。
变得空无，失去原有的内容。
变得荒凉、冷清或无人活动。

collocations.en: The words became devoid of meaning.

collocations.zh: 这个地方变得冷清荒凉。

formal.mt: Il-maħżen tbaħħaħ kompletament qabel ma beda x-xogħol ta' tiswija.
formal.en: The warehouse was completely emptied before repair work began.
formal.zh: 维修工程开始前，仓库已被彻底清空。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Fejn marru n-nies kollha? Karl: Telqu wara l-kunċert; il-post tbaħħaħ f'daqqa.
colloquial.en: Rita: Where did everyone go? Karl: They left after the concert; the place suddenly became deserted.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：人都去哪儿了？卡尔：音乐会结束后就走了；这里一下子变得空荡荡的。

messages.speaker: Rita (观众)
messages.zh: 人都去哪儿了？
messages.en: Where did everyone go?

messages.speaker: Karl (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Telqu wara l-kunċert; il-post tbaħħaħ f'daqqa.
messages.mt_standard: Telqu wara l-kunċert; il-post tbaħħaħ f'daqqa.
messages.zh: 音乐会结束后就走了；这里一下子变得空荡荡的。
messages.en: They left after the concert; the place suddenly became deserted.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“空了”串起三幅图：仓库货物搬空、话语内容落空、人群散去场地空。再按语境区分具体义项。

gloss_zh: 驱邪或避邪眼的熏烟仪式；航行；导航

teaching_sense.en_definition: Sailing or navigating; also, ritual fumigation intended to drive away evil spirits or ward off the evil eye.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 乘船航行或导航；另可指以驱邪或避邪眼为目的的熏烟仪式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed ibaħħar jew jinnaviga; ukoll, l-użu ritwali tad-duħħan biex jitkeċċew l-ispirti ħżiena jew titwarrab l-għajn ħażina.

sense_translations.en_definition: fumigation for the purposes of exorcism or to ward off the evil eye
sense_translations.zh_definition: 以驱邪或避邪眼为目的的熏烟仪式。
航行；乘船在水上行进。
导航；确定位置、规划航线并引导航行。

collocations.en: navigation with the help of the stars

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, it-tbaħħir bl-inċens isir bħala rit biex titwarrab l-għajn ħażina.
formal.en: In the story, fumigation with incense is performed as a ritual intended to ward off the evil eye.
formal.zh: 在这篇故事中，人们举行焚香熏烟仪式，意在避开邪眼。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Tħobb it-tbaħħir? Pawlu: Iva, speċjalment meta l-baħar ikun kalm.
colloquial.en: Lara: Do you like sailing? Pawlu: Yes, especially when the sea is calm.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你喜欢航海吗？保罗：喜欢，尤其是在海面平静的时候。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你喜欢航海吗？
messages.en: Do you like sailing?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, speċjalment meta l-baħar ikun kalm.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, speċjalment meta l-baħar ikun kalm.
messages.zh: 喜欢，尤其是在海面平静的时候。
messages.en: Yes, especially when the sea is calm.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给这个词配两张学习卡：一张画船与航线，一张画仪式中的香烟；依靠上下文区分词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of speaking badly about someone or making false statements that damage their reputation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 贬损他人，或以不实言论损害他人名誉的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li jingħad kliem ħażin fuq xi ħadd, jew affarijiet foloz li jagħmlu ħsara lir-reputazzjoni tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 诽谤行为；用不实言论损害他人的名誉。
说坏话的行为；以贬损性的言语议论他人。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddistingwi bejn kritika bbażata fuq il-fatti u tbaħħit li jagħmel ħsara lir-reputazzjoni ta' persuna.
formal.en: The report distinguishes between criticism based on facts and slander that damages a person's reputation.
formal.zh: 报告区分了基于事实的批评与损害个人名誉的诽谤行为。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Ma rridx aktar tbaħħit fuq Lara. Mark: Sewwa, ejja nitkellmu magħha direttament.
colloquial.en: Rita: I don't want any more bad-mouthing of Lara. Mark: All right, let's speak to her directly.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：我不想再听到有人说拉拉的坏话了。马克：好，我们直接和她谈吧。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma rridx aktar tbaħħit fuq Lara.
messages.mt_standard: Ma rridx aktar tbaħħit fuq Lara.
messages.zh: 我不想再听到有人说拉拉的坏话了。
messages.en: I don't want any more bad-mouthing of Lara.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 好，我们直接和她谈吧。
messages.en: All right, let's speak to her directly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它记作“说坏话这件事”的名词；与表示“遭到说坏话”的动词 tbaħħat 对照练习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of making something empty, or a state of emptiness and desolation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物排空或清空的行为，也可指空无、荒凉的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li xi ħaġa titħalla vojta, jew stat ta' vojt u ħerba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 排空；使内部原有的内容物排出。
清空；移走某处或某容器内的东西。
荒凉；空荡、萧条的状态。

formal.mt: Il-kittieb jiddeskrivi s-sens ta' tbaħħiħ li ħalla warajh l-għeluq tal-fabbrika.
formal.en: The writer describes the sense of desolation left by the closure of the factory.
formal.zh: 作者描写了工厂关闭后留下的荒凉感。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Kif sejjer it-tbaħħiħ tal-maħżen? Rita: Kważi lest; baqa' biss żewġ kaxxi.
colloquial.en: Mark: How is the emptying of the warehouse going? Rita: Almost done; there are only two boxes left.
colloquial.zh: 马克：仓库清空得怎么样了？丽塔：快好了，只剩两个箱子。

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.zh: 仓库清空得怎么样了？
messages.en: How is the emptying of the warehouse going?

messages.speaker: Rita (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Kważi lest; baqa' biss żewġ kaxxi.
messages.mt_standard: Kważi lest; baqa' biss żewġ kaxxi.
messages.zh: 快好了，只剩两个箱子。
messages.en: Almost done; there are only two boxes left.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先想象仓库被清空，再想象空仓库带来的荒凉感，用同一幅画面串起动作义和状态义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become ill or start suffering from an illness.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 开始生病，由原本没有生病的状态转为患病。

messages.en: He became ill yesterday and stayed at home today.

gloss_zh: 需要持续医疗照护的频繁患病

teaching_sense.en_definition: Frequent episodes of illness that require continuing medical attention.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 反复、频繁地生病，以致需要持续接受医疗照护的情况。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mard ta' spiss li jeħtieġ kura medika kontinwa.

sense_translations.en_definition: frequent illness requiring constant medical attention
sense_translations.zh_definition: 需要持续医疗照护的频繁患病；反复生病并需经常接受诊治的情况

collocations.zh: 需要持续照护的频繁患病

collocations.en: a period of recurrent illness requiring ongoing medical attention
collocations.zh: 一段反复患病、需要持续诊治的时期

formal.mt: Minħabba t-tbażbiż tiegħu, l-istudent kellu bżonn segwitu mediku kontinwu u appoġġ biex ilaħħaq mal-lezzjonijiet.

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif inhu ħuk dan l-aħħar? Sara: Għadu għaddej minn żmien ta' tbażbiż; jimrad ta' spiss u għandu bżonn kura medika kontinwa.
colloquial.en: Maja: How has your brother been lately? Sara: He is still going through a period of recurrent illness; he gets ill often and needs ongoing medical care.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你兄弟最近怎么样？萨拉：他还是反复生病，经常不舒服，需要持续接受医疗照护。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be covered with pepper, especially when pepper is added to food.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被撒上或覆盖上胡椒，通常用于描述食物经过胡椒调味后的状态。

colloquial.en: Mark: Has the fish been covered with pepper already? Rita: Yes, it has been well peppered; now we can cook it.
colloquial.zh: 马克：鱼已经撒上胡椒了吗？丽塔：是的，已经撒好了，现在可以烹调了。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of sprinkling pepper over food.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把胡椒撒在食物上的动作或调味步骤。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed iroxx il-bżar fuq l-ikel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 撒胡椒的动作；撒胡椒调味这一行为

collocations.en: the sprinkling of pepper over the meat
the sprinkling of pepper over the vegetables

formal.mt: It-tbażżir tal-ħaxix isir fl-aħħar tal-preparazzjoni, qabel il-ħaxix jitqiegħed fil-forn.
formal.en: Pepper is sprinkled over the vegetables at the end of preparation, before they are placed in the oven.

colloquial.zh: 妮娜：煮肉之前还差哪一步？托尼：就差撒胡椒了，请把胡椒递给我。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of removing someone or something, or of being removed from a place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将人或物移走、移除的行为，也可指人或物被移走、被移除。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed ineħħi jew ibiegħed lil xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa minn post, jew li jitneħħa hu stess.

formal.en: Among the nest materials, the student found a short, thin piece of dry straw.
formal.zh: 学生在鸟巢材料中发现了一小截细细的干麦秆。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'għandu l-għasfur f'ħalqu? Mark: Għandu tbejna; qed jeħodha lejn il-bejta.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does the bird have in its beak? Mark: It has a short piece of straw; it is taking it to the nest.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那只鸟嘴里叼着什么？马克：一小截麦秆；它正把麦秆带到巢里去。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 那只鸟嘴里叼着什么？
messages.en: What does the bird have in its beak?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandu tbejna; qed jeħodha lejn il-bejta.
messages.mt_standard: Għandu tbejna; qed jeħodha lejn il-bejta.
messages.zh: 一小截麦秆；它正把麦秆带到巢里去。
messages.en: It has a short piece of straw; it is taking it to the nest.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象鸟嘴里叼着一小截干麦秆，以“短短一截”的画面记住这个指小名词。

gloss_zh: 被迅速喝下；被一口喝掉

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be drunk or downed quickly, said of a drink.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指饮料被迅速喝下，常可理解为被一口或几大口喝掉。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinxtorob malajr, meta jingħad għal xi xarba.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be downed quickly (used of drinks)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被迅速喝下、被很快喝掉；用于饮料。

collocations.en: the juice was downed in one go

formal.mt: Il-meraq tbekbek fi ftit sekondi wara li ġie servut.
formal.en: The juice was downed within a few seconds of being served.
formal.zh: 果汁端上来后，几秒钟内就被喝掉了。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn mar il-meraq kollu? Mark: Tbekbek f'daqqa; konna għatxana ħafna!
colloquial.en: Maja: Where did all the juice go? Mark: It was downed in one go; we were very thirsty!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：果汁怎么全没了？马克：一口气就喝光了；我们太渴了！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 果汁怎么全没了？
messages.en: Where did all the juice go?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 一口气就喝光了；我们太渴了！
messages.en: It was downed in one go; we were very thirsty!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象满杯果汁转眼变成空杯，把这个动词记成饮料“被迅速喝掉”，同时记住饮料是句子的主角。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be made to cry, or to complain in a whining manner.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因他人的行为或某件事情而被弄哭；也指带着哭腔哼唧、抱怨。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġie mġiegħel jibki, jew qagħad jilmenta b'leħen ta' biki.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被弄哭；受到某种刺激而哭起来。
哼唧；用带哭腔的声音抱怨。

collocations.en: was made to cry by the pain

collocations.mt: tbekka għax ma kisibx li ried
collocations.en: whined because he did not get what he wanted
collocations.zh: 因没有得到想要的东西而哼唧抱怨

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, it-tifel tbekka meta sħabu bdew jidħku bih.
formal.en: In the story, the boy was made to cry when his companions began laughing at him.
formal.zh: 故事中，那个男孩因同伴们开始嘲笑他而被弄哭了。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex it-tifel tbekka hekk? Lara: Għax ma ħallewhx jilgħab; qagħad jilmenta li ma kienx ġust.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did the boy whine like that? Lara: Because they would not let him play; he kept complaining that it was unfair.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那个男孩为什么那样哼唧？拉拉：因为他们不让他玩；他一直抱怨说这不公平。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 那个男孩为什么那样哼唧？
messages.en: Why did the boy whine like that?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax ma ħallewhx jilgħab; qagħad jilmenta li ma kienx ġust.
messages.mt_standard: Għax ma ħallewhx jilgħab; qagħad jilmenta li ma kienx ġust.
messages.zh: 因为他们不让他玩；他一直抱怨说这不公平。
messages.en: Because they would not let him play; he kept complaining that it was unfair.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住两幅带哭腔的画面：受了委屈被弄哭，没得到东西就哼唧；借情境区分两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To receive a blow or to be beaten.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受到一下击打，或遭到殴打；重点在承受打击的一方。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Irċieva daqqa jew ġie msawwat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被击中；受到一下打击。
被打；遭到殴打。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jgħid li Paul tbekket b'daqqa ta' ballun waqt il-logħba.
formal.en: The report states that Paul was struck by a ball during the game.
formal.zh: 报告指出，保罗在比赛中被球击中了。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'ġara lil Paul waqt il-logħba? Mark: Tbekket b'daqqa ta' ballun, imma issa jinsab tajjeb.
colloquial.en: Maja: What happened to Paul during the game? Mark: He was struck by a ball, but he is fine now.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗在比赛中怎么了？马克：他被球击中了，不过现在没事了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗在比赛中怎么了？
messages.en: What happened to Paul during the game?

messages.speaker: Mark (队友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tbekket b'daqqa ta' ballun, imma issa jinsab tajjeb.
messages.mt_standard: Tbekket b'daqqa ta' ballun, imma issa jinsab tajjeb.
messages.zh: 他被球击中了，不过现在没事了。
messages.en: He was struck by a ball, but he is fine now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象球飞来后有人挨了一下：这个动词把镜头放在被击中、被打的人身上。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of beating or striking someone or something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对人或物施加击打的行为，可指殴打，也可指敲打、敲击。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għoti ta' daqqiet lil xi ħadd jew lil xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 打、殴打或连续敲打的行为。
击打；敲击的动作。

formal.mt: It-tbekkit tal-metall bil-martell ipproduċa ħoss qawwi fil-ħanut tax-xogħol.
formal.en: The beating of the metal with a hammer produced a loud noise in the workshop.
formal.zh: 用锤子敲打金属的动作在工坊里产生了很大的声响。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhu dak il-ħoss? Toni: Huwa t-tbekkit tal-metall; qed naħdem bil-martell.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is that noise? Toni: It is the beating of metal; I am working with a hammer.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：那是什么声音？托尼：是敲打金属的声音；我正在用锤子干活。

messages.speaker: Lara (访客)
messages.zh: 那是什么声音？
messages.en: What is that noise?

messages.speaker: Toni (工匠)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa t-tbekkit tal-metall; qed naħdem bil-martell.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa t-tbekkit tal-metall; qed naħdem bil-martell.
messages.zh: 是敲打金属的声音；我正在用锤子干活。
messages.en: It is the beating of metal; I am working with a hammer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 听见锤子当当响，就把这整件敲打行为装进一个名词盒子：tbekkit 指敲打这件事。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To move from side to side in a swaying motion.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向两侧来回摇摆或晃动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tħarrek minn naħa għal oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 摇摆；来回晃动。

formal.mt: L-arblu tbelbel minn naħa għal oħra minħabba r-riħ qawwi.
formal.en: The pole swayed from side to side because of the strong wind.
formal.zh: 那根杆子因强风而左右摇摆。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Rajt l-arblu ħdejn il-bieb? Mark: Iva, tbelbel mar-riħ, imma baqa' wieqaf.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you see the pole beside the door? Mark: Yes, it swayed in the wind, but it stayed upright.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你看到门旁边那根杆子了吗？马克：看到了，它随风摇晃，但仍然立着。

messages.speaker: Maja (邻居)
messages.zh: 你看到门旁边那根杆子了吗？
messages.en: Did you see the pole beside the door?

messages.speaker: Mark (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, tbelbel mar-riħ, imma baqa' wieqaf.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, tbelbel mar-riħ, imma baqa' wieqaf.
messages.zh: 看到了，它随风摇晃，但仍然立着。
messages.en: Yes, it swayed in the wind, but it stayed upright.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把手指当作风中的杆子，左右摆动两次；用这个动作记住 tbelbel 的摇摆含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The flapping or fluttering movement of wings, cloth, or similar things.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 翅膀、布料等反复拍动、扑动或轻轻飘动的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-moviment ripetut ta' ġwienaħ, drapp jew affarijiet simili meta jitħarrku fl-arja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 拍动；扑动，尤指翅膀或布料反复摆动。
轻轻扑动；颤动或飘动。

formal.mt: L-osservatur sema' t-tbelbil tal-ġwienaħ meta l-għasfur telaq minn fuq il-fergħa.
formal.en: The observer heard the flapping of wings when the bird left the branch.
formal.zh: 鸟儿离开树枝时，观察者听到了翅膀拍动的声音。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhu dak il-ħoss ħdejn it-tieqa? Toni: Huwa t-tbelbil tal-bandiera fir-riħ.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is that sound near the window? Toni: It is the flapping of the flag in the wind.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：窗边那是什么声音？托尼：是旗帜在风中拍动的声音。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 窗边那是什么声音？
messages.en: What is that sound near the window?

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.zh: 是旗帜在风中拍动的声音。
messages.en: It is the flapping of the flag in the wind.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象鸟翼扑扑拍、旗角轻轻飘；tbelbil 是给这些拍动和飘动动作起的名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become angry or to be filled with intense anger.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 生起气来，或陷入强烈愤怒、怒火中烧的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Irrabja jew imtela b'rabja kbira.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be angry, to be inflamed with anger
sense_translations.zh_definition: 生气；满腔怒火，怒火中烧。

formal.mt: Ir-raġel tbelgħen meta sema' l-akkuża, iżda pprova jwieġeb bil-kalma.
formal.en: The man became furious when he heard the accusation, but he tried to respond calmly.
formal.zh: 那个男人听到指控后怒火中烧，但仍试着平静地回应。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Mark tbelgħen hekk? Lara: Xi ħadd insulentah quddiem kulħadd.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Mark get so angry? Lara: Someone insulted him in front of everyone.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克为什么那么生气？拉拉：有人当着大家的面侮辱了他。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克为什么那么生气？
messages.en: Why did Mark get so angry?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 有人当着大家的面侮辱了他。
messages.en: Someone insulted him in front of everyone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用中文的怒火中烧作情境联想：听到冒犯的话，心里的怒气一下升高；这只是记忆画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become moistened or to be dunked or dipped in a liquid.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被弄得潮湿，或被放入液体中浸一下、蘸一下。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sar niedi jew iddaħħal f'likwidu biex jixxarrab.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被润湿；被弄得潮湿。
被浸入液体中；被泡一下。
被蘸入液体中；被蘸一下。

formal.mt: Il-ħobż tbell fil-ħalib qabel ma tpoġġa fl-iskutella.
formal.en: The bread was dipped in milk before it was placed in the bowl.
formal.zh: 面包先在牛奶里蘸了一下，然后才被放进碗里。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-ħobż tbell fil-ħalib? Mark: Iva, għalhekk sar artab.
colloquial.en: Maja: Was this bread dunked in milk? Mark: Yes, that is why it became soft.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这块面包在牛奶里浸过吗？马克：浸过，所以它变软了。

messages.speaker: Maja (家人)
messages.zh: 这块面包在牛奶里浸过吗？
messages.en: Was this bread dunked in milk?

messages.speaker: Mark (家人)
messages.zh: 浸过，所以它变软了。
messages.en: Yes, that is why it became soft.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象干面包接触液体：露水让它潮湿，牛奶让它浸软，轻蘸也会沾湿；三个义项都围绕沾液体。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be made or forced to swallow something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被人迫使吞咽某物；主语是承受这种强迫的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġie mġiegħel jibla' xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: bella' 的中间被动形式，表示主语承受被迫吞咽的动作。
被迫吞下；受到强迫而咽下某物。

collocations.en: was forced to swallow the pill
was forced to swallow a bitter drink
collocations.zh: 被迫咽下一种苦涩的饮料

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-priġunier tbella' xarba morra kontra qalbu.
formal.en: In the story, the prisoner was forced to swallow a bitter drink against his will.
formal.zh: 故事中，那个囚犯被迫违心地咽下了一种苦涩的饮料。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'ġara lill-karattru fl-istorja? Mark: Tbella' xarba morra kontra qalbu.
colloquial.en: Maja: What happened to the character in the story? Mark: He was forced to swallow a bitter drink against his will.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：故事里的那个人物遭遇了什么？马克：他被迫咽下了一种苦涩的饮料，自己并不情愿。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 故事里的那个人物遭遇了什么？
messages.en: What happened to the character in the story?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 他被迫咽下了一种苦涩的饮料，自己并不情愿。
messages.en: He was forced to swallow a bitter drink against his will.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把人物皱眉咽下苦饮的画面与被迫吞下绑定；记忆重点是吞咽者并不情愿。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To behave foolishly or to go mad.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 做出愚蠢、欠考虑的举动；也可表示发疯、失去理智。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li wieħed iġib ruħu bla għaqal jew jitlef il-bilanċ mentali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 表现得愚蠢；做出傻事。
发疯；失去理智。

collocations.en: behaved foolishly in front of everyone

collocations.zh: 在比赛中做出愚蠢举动

formal.mt: Waqt il-laqgħa, Pawlu tbellah u beda jagħmel ċajt li ma kienx xieraq għas-sitwazzjoni.
formal.en: During the meeting, Pawlu behaved foolishly and began making jokes that were inappropriate for the situation.
formal.zh: 开会时，保罗做出了愚蠢的举动，开始讲不合时宜的笑话。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mark tbellah fil-klassi llum. Lara: X'għamel? Maja: Beda jgħajjat waqt li l-għalliema kienet qed tispjega.
colloquial.en: Maja: Mark behaved foolishly in class today. Lara: What did he do? Maja: He started shouting while the teacher was explaining.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克今天在课堂上做傻事了。拉拉：他做了什么？玛雅：老师讲解时，他突然大喊大叫。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 马克今天在课堂上做傻事了。
messages.en: Mark behaved foolishly in class today.

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 他做了什么？
messages.en: What did he do?

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Beda jgħajjat waqt li l-għalliema kienet qed tispjega.
messages.mt_standard: Beda jgħajjat waqt li l-għalliema kienet qed tispjega.
messages.zh: 老师讲解时，他突然大喊大叫。
