messages.en: He started shouting while the teacher was explaining.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tbellah 记成一个人突然做傻事的画面；另一个义项是发疯，阅读时要根据语境区分轻重。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To ripen, as fruit does when it becomes mature.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指果实等逐渐成熟、变熟。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li l-frott isir misjur.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 成熟；指果实等变熟。

formal.mt: Il-frott tbellaq fuq is-siġra qabel ma nġabar.
formal.en: The fruit ripened on the tree before it was picked.
formal.zh: 这些果实在采摘前已经在树上成熟了。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Il-frott tbellaq? Pawlu: Iva, issa nistgħu niġbruh.
colloquial.en: Lara: Has the fruit ripened? Pawlu: Yes, we can pick it now.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：果实熟了吗？保罗：熟了，现在可以摘了。

messages.speaker: Lara (家人)
messages.zh: 果实熟了吗？
messages.en: Has the fruit ripened?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (家人)
messages.zh: 熟了，现在可以摘了。
messages.en: Yes, we can pick it now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象树上的果实由青变熟，用 tbellaq 记住“变熟”这个动作；可与表示成熟迹象的名词 tbelliq 对照。

gloss_zh: 被天鹅绒覆盖；变得有天鹅绒质感

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become covered with velvet or develop a texture like velvet.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表面被天鹅绒覆盖，或逐渐具有天鹅绒般柔软的质感。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li xi ħaġa tinkesa bil-bellus jew tikseb tessut bħal dak tal-bellus.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被天鹅绒覆盖。

sense_translations.en_definition: to acquire the texture of velvet
sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得具有天鹅绒般的质感。

collocations.en: a surface that acquired a velvety texture
collocations.zh: 变得具有天鹅绒质感的表面
变得有天鹅绒质感的布料

formal.mt: Wara t-trattament, il-wiċċ tad-drapp tbelles u sar artab mal-mess.
formal.en: After treatment, the surface of the fabric acquired a velvety texture and became soft to the touch.
formal.zh: 经过处理后，布料表面具有了天鹅绒般的质感，摸起来很柔软。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex dan id-drapp sar daqshekk artab? Mark: Il-wiċċ tiegħu tbelles wara t-trattament.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why has this fabric become so soft? Mark: Its surface acquired a velvety texture after treatment.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这块布怎么变得这么柔软？马克：处理之后，它的表面有了天鹅绒般的质感。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex dan id-drapp sar daqshekk artab?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex dan id-drapp sar daqshekk artab?
messages.zh: 这块布怎么变得这么柔软？
messages.en: Why has this fabric become so soft?

messages.speaker: Mark (裁缝)
messages.zh: 处理之后，它的表面有了天鹅绒般的质感。
messages.en: Its surface acquired a velvety texture after treatment.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用手摸天鹅绒的柔软触感来记 tbelles；既可能是覆盖了天鹅绒，也可能只是质感变得像天鹅绒。

gloss_zh: 行为变得城市化；养成城市人的举止

teaching_sense.en_definition: To adopt behaviour and habits typical of a city-dweller.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指一个人的行为和习惯逐渐带有城市居民的特点。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li wieħed jadotta drawwiet u mġiba tipiċi ta' min jgħix fil-belt.

sense_translations.en_definition: to become urbanised (used of a person whose behaviour is typical of a city-dweller)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得城市化，指人的行为举止逐渐具有城市居民的典型特点。

collocations.zh: 行为举止变得像城市居民

collocations.mt: tbellet wara li mar jgħix fil-belt
collocations.en: adopted city habits after moving to the city
collocations.zh: 搬到城市居住后养成了城市生活习惯

formal.mt: Wara snin jgħix fil-belt, Pawlu tbellet fid-drawwiet u fl-imġiba tiegħu.
formal.en: After years of living in the city, Pawlu adopted city-dweller habits and behaviour.
formal.zh: 在城市居住多年后，保罗的习惯和举止逐渐带上了城市居民的特点。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Minn meta mar jgħix fil-belt, Pawlu tbellet. Lara: Iva, anki d-drawwiet tiegħu nbidlu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Since moving to the city, Pawlu has adopted city ways. Lara: Yes, even his habits have changed.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗搬到城市后，举止越来越像城里人了。拉拉：是啊，连他的习惯都变了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Minn meta mar jgħix fil-belt, Pawlu tbellet.
messages.mt_standard: Minn meta mar jgħix fil-belt, Pawlu tbellet.
messages.zh: 保罗搬到城市后，举止越来越像城里人了。
messages.en: Since moving to the city, Pawlu has adopted city ways.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 是啊，连他的习惯都变了。
messages.en: Yes, even his habits have changed.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tbellet 放进“搬进城市后，人的习惯举止发生变化”的小故事；这里说的是人，不是城市建筑的扩张。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of forcing someone to eat or swallow something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 强迫某人吃东西或吞下某物的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed iġiegħel lil xi ħadd jiekol jew jibla' xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.en_definition: the act of forcing sb. to eat or swallow sth.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 强迫某人吃下或吞下某物的行为。

collocations.en: forcing a person to eat or swallow against their will
collocations.zh: 违背本人意愿的强迫进食或吞咽

formal.mt: Id-dokument jiddistingwi bejn għajnuna waqt l-ikel u tbelligħ kontra r-rieda tal-persuna.
formal.en: The document distinguishes between assistance during meals and forcing a person to eat or swallow against their will.
formal.zh: 这份文件区分了用餐时提供帮助与违背本人意愿强迫其进食或吞咽的行为。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Ma jridx jiekol aktar; it-tbelligħ mhux soluzzjoni. Pawlu: Naqbel, inħalluh jiddeċiedi jekk iridx aktar.
colloquial.en: Marija: He doesn't want to eat any more; forcing him to eat isn't a solution. Pawlu: I agree, let's let him decide whether he wants more.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：他不想再吃了，强迫他吃不是办法。保罗：我同意，让他自己决定还要不要吃吧。

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma jridx jiekol aktar; it-tbelligħ mhux soluzzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Ma jridx jiekol aktar; it-tbelligħ mhux soluzzjoni.
messages.zh: 他不想再吃了，强迫他吃不是办法。
messages.en: He doesn't want to eat any more; forcing him to eat isn't a solution.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Naqbel, inħalluh jiddeċiedi jekk iridx aktar.
messages.mt_standard: Naqbel, inħalluh jiddeċiedi jekk iridx aktar.
messages.zh: 我同意，让他自己决定还要不要吃吧。
messages.en: I agree, let's let him decide whether he wants more.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 tbelligħ 时抓住“强迫别人吞下去”的场景；它是行为名词，不能只理解为普通的吃饭或吞咽。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Foolish or silly behaviour showing a lack of good sense.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 缺乏理智或判断力的愚蠢举动，也可指胡闹。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Imġiba bla għaqal jew għemil iblah.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 愚蠢的行为；胡闹。

formal.mt: It-tbellih waqt id-diskussjoni fixkel lill-parteċipanti u ħela l-ħin tal-laqgħa.
formal.en: The foolish behaviour during the discussion distracted the participants and wasted meeting time.
formal.zh: 讨论期间的胡闹行为分散了与会者的注意力，也浪费了会议时间。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan it-tbellih qed jaħlilna l-ħin. Mark: Għandek raġun; issa niffoka fuq ix-xogħol.
colloquial.en: Lara: This foolishness is wasting our time. Mark: You're right; I'll focus on the work now.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这样胡闹是在浪费我们的时间。马克：你说得对，我现在专心干活。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 这样胡闹是在浪费我们的时间。
messages.en: This foolishness is wasting our time.

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek raġun; issa niffoka fuq ix-xogħol.
messages.mt_standard: Għandek raġun; issa niffoka fuq ix-xogħol.
messages.zh: 你说得对，我现在专心干活。
messages.en: You're right; I'll focus on the work now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tbellih 贴在“这一通胡闹”的场景上，记住它是行为名词；与动词 tbellah“做傻事”配对练习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of dipping or dunking something into a liquid.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某物蘸入或浸入液体的动作，例如用面包蘸酱或把饼干浸入茶中。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed idaħħal xi ħaġa f'likwidu, bħal ħobż fiz-zalza jew gallettini fit-te.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 蘸入液体的动作。
把某物浸入液体的动作，例如把饼干浸入饮料中。

formal.mt: Ir-riċetta tissuġġerixxi tbellil qasir tal-ħobż fiz-zalza qabel ma jiġi servut.
formal.en: The recipe suggests briefly dipping the bread in the sauce before serving it.
formal.zh: 食谱建议上桌前把面包在酱汁中短暂蘸一下。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Tħobb it-tbellil tal-gallettini fit-te? Lara: Iva, iżda għal ftit biss, inkella jitfarrku fit-tazza.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you like dunking biscuits in tea? Lara: Yes, but only briefly, otherwise they crumble in the cup.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你喜欢把饼干浸在茶里吃吗？拉拉：喜欢，不过只能浸一下，不然就会碎在杯子里。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你喜欢把饼干浸在茶里吃吗？
messages.en: Do you like dunking biscuits in tea?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, iżda għal ftit biss, inkella jitfarrku fit-tazza.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, iżda għal ftit biss, inkella jitfarrku fit-tazza.
messages.zh: 喜欢，不过只能浸一下，不然就会碎在杯子里。
messages.en: Yes, but only briefly, otherwise they crumble in the cup.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象饼干在茶里浸一下再拿出来，用这个动作记 tbellil；面包蘸酱和饼干浸茶都能帮助记住这个名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The showing of signs that fruit is becoming ripe.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 果实开始显出成熟迹象的现象，并不一定表示已经完全成熟。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-fatt li l-frott jibda juri sinjali li qed isir misjur.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 显出成熟迹象；呈现正在变熟的征兆。

formal.mt: Il-bidla fil-kulur tal-ħawħ turi tbelliq, iżda l-frott għadu mhux misjur għal kollox.
formal.en: The change in the peaches' colour shows signs of ripeness, but the fruit is not yet fully ripe.
formal.zh: 桃子颜色的变化显示出成熟迹象，但果实尚未完全成熟。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Dan il-ħawħ diġà lest biex nikluh? Maja: Għadu mhux misjur għal kollox; dak il-kulur juri tbelliq.
colloquial.en: Mark: Are these peaches ready for us to eat already? Maja: They're not fully ripe yet; that colour shows signs of ripeness.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这些桃子已经可以吃了吗？玛雅：还没完全熟，那个颜色说明它们开始显出成熟迹象了。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-ħawħ diġà lest biex nikluh?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-ħawħ diġà lest biex nikluh?
messages.zh: 这些桃子已经可以吃了吗？
messages.en: Are these peaches ready for us to eat already?

messages.speaker: Maja (水果摊主)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadu mhux misjur għal kollox; dak il-kulur juri tbelliq.
messages.mt_standard: Għadu mhux misjur għal kollox; dak il-kulur juri tbelliq.
messages.zh: 还没完全熟，那个颜色说明它们开始显出成熟迹象了。
messages.en: They're not fully ripe yet; that colour shows signs of ripeness.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到果皮开始变色，就联想 tbelliq“显出成熟迹象”；记住这是名词，出现迹象还不等于完全熟透。

gloss_zh: 被调得可口；被摇晃；被轻轻左右摇动

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be made tasty, or to be rocked or swung gently from side to side.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指食物被调得可口，也指人或物被摇晃、被轻轻地左右摇动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir aktar tajjeb fit-togħma, jew jitbandal jew jitmexxa bil-mod minn naħa għal oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被调得可口；被做得更有滋味。
被摇晃；受到来回摇动。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be swung gently from side to side
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被轻轻地左右摇动。

collocations.en: the broth was made tasty with herbs and spices
collocations.zh: 肉汤加了香草和香料，变得可口

collocations.en: the boy was rocked in the cradle
collocations.zh: 小男孩在摇篮里被轻轻摇晃

collocations.mt: tbennen bil-mod minn naħa għal oħra
collocations.en: was swung gently from side to side

formal.mt: Il-brodu tbennen biż-żieda tal-ħwawar u mbagħad ġie servut.
formal.en: The broth was made tasty by adding herbs and spices and was then served.
formal.zh: 肉汤加入香草和香料调得可口后，便端上了桌。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif raqad it-tifel? Rita: Tbennen bil-mod fil-benniena sakemm għalaq għajnejh.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did the boy fall asleep? Rita: He was gently rocked in the cradle until he closed his eyes.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：小男孩是怎么睡着的？丽塔：他在摇篮里被轻轻摇着，直到闭上眼睛。

messages.speaker: Maja (家人)
messages.zh: 小男孩是怎么睡着的？
messages.en: How did the boy fall asleep?

messages.speaker: Rita (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Tbennen bil-mod fil-benniena sakemm għalaq għajnejh.
messages.mt_standard: Tbennen bil-mod fil-benniena sakemm għalaq għajnejh.
messages.zh: 他在摇篮里被轻轻摇着，直到闭上眼睛。
messages.en: He was gently rocked in the cradle until he closed his eyes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用厨房和摇篮两张卡片记忆：厨房对应被调得可口，摇篮对应被摇晃或被轻轻左右摇动。

gloss_zh: 使食物可口的调制；摇摇篮

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of making food tasty, or the rocking of a cradle.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使食物变得可口的调制行为，也指摇动摇篮的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li tagħmel l-ikel aktar tajjeb fit-togħma, jew li tbandal benniena.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某物变得可口的调制行为。
摇动摇篮的动作。

formal.mt: Il-lezzjoni tat-tisjir tinkludi t-tbennin tal-brodu b'ħwawar differenti.
formal.en: The cooking lesson includes making the broth tasty with different herbs and spices.
formal.zh: 这堂烹饪课包括用不同的香草和香料把肉汤调得可口。

colloquial.mt: Mark: X'għen lit-tarbija torqod? Rita: It-tbennin tal-benniena; kont inbandalha bil-mod.
colloquial.en: Mark: What helped the baby fall asleep? Rita: The rocking of the cradle; I was rocking it gently.
colloquial.zh: 马克：什么帮助宝宝睡着了？丽塔：摇摇篮；我当时在轻轻地摇它。

messages.speaker: Mark (父亲)
messages.zh: 什么帮助宝宝睡着了？
messages.en: What helped the baby fall asleep?

messages.speaker: Rita (母亲)
messages.zh: 摇摇篮；我当时在轻轻地摇它。
messages.en: The rocking of the cradle; I was rocking it gently.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个名词记成两项活动的名称：一项是调出好味道，一项是轻摇摇篮；都着重表示行为本身。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become twisted; also, to feel slightly unwell.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指物体变得扭曲，也可指人身体不舒服、状态欠佳。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jieħu għamla mgħawġa; jista' jingħad ukoll għal persuna li tħossha xi ftit ma tiflaħx.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被扭曲；变得弯扭。
身体有些不适；感觉不太舒服。

collocations.en: felt a little under the weather

formal.mt: Il-wajer tbenċel waqt li kienu qed iġorru l-apparat.
formal.en: The wire became twisted while the equipment was being carried.
formal.zh: 搬运设备时，电线扭曲了。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Mark baqa' d-dar? Pawlu: Tbenċel ftit u ried jistrieħ.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Mark stay home? Pawlu: He felt a little under the weather and wanted to rest.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克为什么待在家里？保罗：他有些不舒服，想休息一下。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克为什么待在家里？
messages.en: Why did Mark stay home?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 他有些不舒服，想休息一下。
messages.en: He felt a little under the weather and wanted to rest.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个画面记忆：电线扭曲、人没精神；分别对应物体扭曲和身体不适两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action of twisting something or making it turn round and round.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 扭转某物或使其连续旋转的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li ddawwar xi ħaġa fuqha nfisha jew tagħmilha ddur dawra wara oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 扭转；使某物发生扭曲的动作。
旋转；使某物转圈的动作。

formal.mt: It-tbenċil tal-wajer waqt l-installazzjoni jista' jagħmel il-konnessjoni aktar diffiċli.
formal.en: Twisting the wire during installation can make the connection more difficult.
formal.zh: 安装过程中扭转电线，可能会增加连接的难度。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'għoġbok fiż-żifna? Nina: It-tbenċil taż-żigarella; kienet iddur fl-arja.
colloquial.en: Lara: What did you like about the dance? Nina: The twirling of the ribbon; it was spinning in the air.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你喜欢那支舞的什么地方？妮娜：丝带旋转的动作；丝带在空中转圈。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你喜欢那支舞的什么地方？
messages.en: What did you like about the dance?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 丝带旋转的动作；丝带在空中转圈。
messages.en: The twirling of the ribbon; it was spinning in the air.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象双手扭电线，再想象手腕转丝带；这个名词把扭转和转圈两种动作装进同一幅记忆图。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To develop a bruise after a knock, pressure, or injury.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因碰撞、挤压或受伤而出现瘀青。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikollu marka blu jew vjola fuq il-ġilda wara daqqa, pressjoni jew korriment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 出现瘀伤；因碰撞等而变得青紫。

formal.mt: Driegħ il-ħaddiem tbenġel meta ħabat mat-tarf tal-mejda.
formal.en: The worker's arm became bruised when it hit the edge of the table.
formal.zh: 工人的手臂撞到桌边后出现了瘀青。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'ġara lil driegħek? Mark: Ħbattu mal-bieb u tbenġel.
colloquial.en: Maja: What happened to your arm? Mark: I knocked it against the door and it became bruised.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你的手臂怎么了？马克：我撞到门上了，碰青了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你的手臂怎么了？
messages.en: What happened to your arm?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我撞到门上了，碰青了。
messages.en: I knocked it against the door and it became bruised.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个动词配上手臂撞门后变青的连续画面，重点记住它表达出现瘀伤这一变化。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Bruising, or a bruise left on the skin after a knock or injury.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 碰撞或受伤后出现瘀青的现象，也可指留下的瘀伤。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-formazzjoni ta' marki blu jew vjola fuq il-ġilda wara daqqa jew korriment, jew marka bħal din.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 瘀伤的形成或出现；皮肤瘀青的现象。
瘀伤；碰撞等造成的青紫色痕迹。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi tbenġil fuq id-driegħ tal-lemin wara l-waqgħa.
formal.en: The report describes bruising on the right arm after the fall.
formal.zh: 报告描述了摔倒后右臂出现的瘀伤。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għandek xi marka minn meta waqajt? Toni: Iva, għandi ftit tbenġil fuq driegħi.
colloquial.en: Sara: Do you have any marks from your fall? Toni: Yes, I have some bruising on my arm.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你摔倒后留下什么痕迹了吗？托尼：有，手臂上有些瘀青。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek xi marka minn meta waqajt?
messages.mt_standard: Għandek xi marka minn meta waqajt?
messages.zh: 你摔倒后留下什么痕迹了吗？
messages.en: Do you have any marks from your fall?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għandi ftit tbenġil fuq driegħi.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għandi ftit tbenġil fuq driegħi.
messages.zh: 有，手臂上有些瘀青。
messages.en: Yes, I have some bruising on my arm.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它放在有些瘀青这一短语里记忆：既能概括瘀伤现象，也能指具体留下的瘀伤。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An individual bruise: a discoloured mark on the skin after a knock or injury.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一处具体的瘀伤，即碰撞或受伤后皮肤上留下的青紫色痕迹。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Marka waħda blu jew vjola fuq il-ġilda li tidher wara daqqa jew korriment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一处瘀伤；一块因碰撞等造成的瘀青。

formal.mt: Wara l-waqgħa, dehret tbenġila żgħira fuq l-irkoppa tax-xellug.
formal.en: After the fall, a small bruise appeared on the left knee.
formal.zh: 摔倒后，左膝上出现了一小块瘀青。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dik x'inhi fuq irkopptok? Lara: Tbenġila żgħira; waqajt waqt il-logħba.
colloquial.en: Nina: What's that on your knee? Lara: A small bruise; I fell during the game.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你膝盖上那是什么？拉拉：一小块瘀青；我比赛时摔倒了。

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.zh: 你膝盖上那是什么？
messages.en: What's that on your knee?

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 一小块瘀青；我比赛时摔倒了。
messages.en: A small bruise; I fell during the game.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象手指指着膝盖上的一块青紫色痕迹，说一处瘀伤，把这个词与单个可指出的瘀青联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be wasted or used carelessly without worthwhile benefit.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指金钱、时间等被挥霍或白白耗费，没有产生有价值的结果。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinħela jew jintuża bla ħsieb u bla ma jġib benefiċċju ta' siwi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被挥霍；被无节制或无益地耗费。

formal.mt: Il-ħin allokat għal-laqgħa tberbaq f'diskussjonijiet li ma kellhomx x'jaqsmu mal-aġenda.
formal.en: The time allocated to the meeting was squandered on discussions unrelated to the agenda.
formal.zh: 分配给会议的时间被耗费在与议程无关的讨论上。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Lestejtu x-xogħol ilbieraħ? Mark: Le, il-ħin tberbaq fuq affarijiet bla bżonn.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you finish the work yesterday? Mark: No, the time was squandered on unnecessary things.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你们昨天把工作做完了吗？马克：没有，时间都浪费在没必要的事情上了。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 你们昨天把工作做完了吗？
messages.en: Did you finish the work yesterday?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, il-ħin tberbaq fuq affarijiet bla bżonn.
messages.mt_standard: Le, il-ħin tberbaq fuq affarijiet bla bżonn.
messages.zh: 没有，时间都浪费在没必要的事情上了。
messages.en: No, the time was squandered on unnecessary things.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象钱袋和时钟都被白白耗空，用钱被挥霍、时间被浪费两个搭配记住这个动词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be stolen or taken without the owner's permission.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指物品未经主人许可被人偷走。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jittieħed minn xi ħadd mingħajr il-permess ta' sidu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被偷走；遭窃。

formal.mt: Skont ir-rapport, l-arloġġ tberbex mill-kamra waqt li s-sid kien barra.
formal.en: According to the report, the watch was stolen from the room while its owner was out.
formal.zh: 据报告，主人外出期间，手表在房间里被偷走了。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn hu l-arloġġ tiegħek? Mark: Tberbex mill-basket tiegħi lbieraħ.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is your watch? Mark: It was stolen from my bag yesterday.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你的手表呢？Mark：昨天被人从我的包里偷走了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你的手表呢？
messages.en: Where is your watch?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 昨天被人从我的包里偷走了。
messages.en: It was stolen from my bag yesterday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象手表原本在包里，后来遭窃不见了；把这个词与物品“被偷走”的结果联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Wasteful use of resources, especially spending money carelessly or excessively.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对资源的浪费，尤其指不加节制或不负责任地花钱。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħela ta' riżorsi, speċjalment infiq ta' flus bla ħsieb jew bla rażan.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 挥霍；浪费，尤其指金钱。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport identifika tberbiq ta' flus fuq xiri li ma kienx meħtieġ.
formal.en: The report identified money squandered on unnecessary purchases.
formal.zh: 报告指出，有资金被挥霍在不必要的采购上。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Se tixtri par żarbun ieħor? Diġà għandek ħafna. Pawlu: Għandek raġun, ikun tberbiq ta' flus.
colloquial.en: Sara: Are you buying another pair of shoes? You already have plenty. Pawlu: You're right; it would be a waste of money.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你还要再买一双鞋？你已经有很多了。Pawlu：你说得对，那样太浪费钱了。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Se tixtri par żarbun ieħor? Diġà għandek ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Se tixtri par żarbun ieħor? Diġà għandek ħafna.
messages.zh: 你还要再买一双鞋？你已经有很多了。
messages.en: Are you buying another pair of shoes? You already have plenty.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek raġun, ikun tberbiq ta' flus.
messages.mt_standard: Għandek raġun, ikun tberbiq ta' flus.
messages.zh: 你说得对，那样太浪费钱了。
messages.en: You're right; it would be a waste of money.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象不断购买用不上的东西，钱包越来越空；用“钱花得没有节制”的画面记住挥霍之义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The stealing of small items or small amounts, often secretly or repeatedly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 偷取小物品或少量财物的行为，常指偷偷进行或反复发生的小偷小摸。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Serq ta' oġġetti żgħar jew ta' ammonti żgħar, spiss bil-moħbi jew għal darba wara oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小额盗窃；偷取价值较低财物的行为。
小偷小摸；偷偷取走少量物品或财物。

formal.mt: Il-ħanut introduċa kontrolli ġodda biex inaqqas it-tberbix ta' oġġetti żgħar.
formal.en: The shop introduced new checks to reduce the pilfering of small items.
formal.zh: 商店引入了新的检查措施，以减少小件物品失窃。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għaliex qed jgħoddu l-oġġetti kuljum? Toni: Għax kien hemm tberbix mill-maħżen.
colloquial.en: Rita: Why are they counting the items every day? Toni: Because there has been pilfering from the storeroom.
colloquial.zh: Rita：他们为什么每天都清点物品？Toni：因为库房里发生了小偷小摸。

messages.speaker: Rita (店员)
messages.zh: 他们为什么每天都清点物品？
messages.en: Why are they counting the items every day?

messages.speaker: Toni (同事)
messages.zh: 因为库房里发生了小偷小摸。
messages.en: Because there has been pilfering from the storeroom.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象货架上的小东西一次少一件：这个名词强调小偷小摸，注意区别于表示挥霍的 tberbiq。

gloss_zh: 常去妓院；场所变成妓院

teaching_sense.en_definition: To frequent brothels; when said of a place, to be turned into a brothel.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指人经常出入妓院；用于场所时，指该处被变成妓院。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Imur ta' spiss fil-burdelli; meta jingħad għal post, jinbidel f'burdell.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 经常出入妓院；常去嫖娼。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be turned into a brothel (used of a location)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被变成妓院，用于描述地点或建筑。

collocations.zh: 曾经常出入妓院的男子

collocations.en: a building that was turned into a brothel

formal.mt: L-istoriku kiteb li l-bini tberdel wara li nbidel sidu.
formal.en: The historian wrote that the building was turned into a brothel after it changed ownership.
formal.zh: 历史学家写道，这栋建筑易主后被变成了妓院。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fir-rumanz jgħid li dak ir-raġel tberdel. Xi jfisser? Mark: Ifisser li kien imur ta' spiss fil-burdelli.
colloquial.en: Maja: The novel says that man frequented brothels. What does that mean? Mark: It means he used to go to brothels often.
colloquial.zh: Maja：小说里用 tberdel 描述那个男人，是什么意思？Mark：意思是他过去经常去妓院。

messages.speaker: Maja (读者)
messages.mt_spoken: Fir-rumanz jgħid li dak ir-raġel tberdel. Xi jfisser?
messages.mt_standard: Fir-rumanz jgħid li dak ir-raġel tberdel. Xi jfisser?
messages.zh: 小说里用 tberdel 描述那个男人，是什么意思？
messages.en: The novel says that man frequented brothels. What does that mean?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li kien imur ta' spiss fil-burdelli.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li kien imur ta' spiss fil-burdelli.
messages.zh: 意思是他过去经常去妓院。
messages.en: It means he used to go to brothels often.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用主语区分两个意思：主语是人，理解为常去妓院；主语是建筑，理解为变成妓院。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The practice of visiting prostitutes or frequenting brothels.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指嫖娼或经常出入妓院的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-prattika li wieħed imur għand prostituti jew iżur il-burdelli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 嫖娼；寻求卖淫者提供性服务的行为。

formal.mt: Fl-analiżi tar-rumanz, it-tberdil tal-protagonist jitqies bħala waħda mill-kawżi tal-kunflitt fil-familja.
formal.en: In the analysis of the novel, the protagonist's visits to prostitutes are considered one of the causes of the family conflict.
formal.zh: 在这篇小说分析中，主人公嫖娼被视为家庭冲突的原因之一。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex hemm tant ġlied fil-familja fir-rumanz? Pawlu: It-tberdil tal-missier hu waħda mir-raġunijiet.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why is there so much fighting in the family in the novel? Pawlu: The father's visits to prostitutes are one of the reasons.
colloquial.zh: Sara：小说里的这个家庭为什么总是争吵？Pawlu：父亲嫖娼是原因之一。

messages.speaker: Sara (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex hemm tant ġlied fil-familja fir-rumanz?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex hemm tant ġlied fil-familja fir-rumanz?
messages.zh: 小说里的这个家庭为什么总是争吵？
messages.en: Why is there so much fighting in the family in the novel?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (读书会成员)
messages.zh: 父亲嫖娼是原因之一。
messages.en: The father's visits to prostitutes are one of the reasons.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它记作行为的名称：tberdel 可描述人常去妓院，tberdil 则把这种嫖娼行为作为名词来谈。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become frayed at the edges; figuratively, to lose one's good sense.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指布料等边缘磨损、散线或起毛；也可比喻人失去理智或判断力。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitħarbat fit-truf u joħorġulu l-ħjut; f'sens figurattiv, jitlef is-sens tajjeb tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 磨损起毛；边缘散线。
失去理智；不再作出明智判断。

collocations.en: he seems to have lost his good sense

formal.mt: It-tarf tad-drapp tberfel wara ħafna ħasil u użu.
formal.en: The edge of the fabric became frayed after repeated washing and use.
formal.zh: 经过多次洗涤和使用，布料的边缘磨损散线了。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Pawlu jrid jonfoq il-flus kollha fuq karozza oħra. Ben: Donnu tberfel! Għadu kemm xtara waħda.
colloquial.en: Lara: Pawlu wants to spend all his money on another car. Ben: He seems to have lost his good sense! He's only just bought one.
colloquial.zh: Lara：Pawlu 想把所有钱都花在另一辆车上。Ben：他好像失去理智了！他才刚买了一辆。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu jrid jonfoq il-flus kollha fuq karozza oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu jrid jonfoq il-flus kollha fuq karozza oħra.
messages.zh: Pawlu 想把所有钱都花在另一辆车上。
messages.en: Pawlu wants to spend all his money on another car.

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Donnu tberfel! Għadu kemm xtara waħda.
messages.mt_standard: Donnu tberfel! Għadu kemm xtara waħda.
messages.zh: 他好像失去理智了！他才刚买了一辆。
messages.en: He seems to have lost his good sense! He's only just bought one.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先想象布边散线，再用“思路也散乱了”的画面辅助记忆失去理智之义；这只是学习联想。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of finishing or hemming a fabric edge with ribbon.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用丝带缝饰或包住布料边缘的缝纫工序。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħjata ta' żigarella mat-tarf ta' drapp biex it-tarf ikun lest u pulit.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用丝带缝边或包边。

collocations.en: hemming the skirt edge with ribbon

formal.mt: Il-ħajjata temmet it-tberfil tat-tarf tad-dublett b'żigarella blu.
formal.en: The dressmaker finished hemming the skirt edge with blue ribbon.
formal.zh: 裁缝用蓝色丝带完成了裙边的包缝。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'jonqos biex tlesti d-dublett? Rita: It-tberfil biss; għad irrid inħit iż-żigarella mat-tarf.
colloquial.en: Maja: What's left before you finish the skirt? Rita: Just the ribbon hemming; I still need to sew the ribbon along the edge.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这条裙子还差什么才做完？Rita：只差丝带包边；我还得把丝带缝到边上。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.zh: 这条裙子还差什么才做完？
messages.en: What's left before you finish the skirt?

messages.speaker: Rita (裁缝)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tberfil biss; għad irrid inħit iż-żigarella mat-tarf.
messages.mt_standard: It-tberfil biss; għad irrid inħit iż-żigarella mat-tarf.
messages.zh: 只差丝带包边；我还得把丝带缝到边上。
messages.en: Just the ribbon hemming; I still need to sew the ribbon along the edge.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象沿裙边缝上一圈丝带，把它记成具体缝纫工序；不要因拼写相近就把它理解为磨损散线。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become inflamed; also, to become angry.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指身体部位出现炎症；也可指人变得生气或愤怒。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tiżviluppa fih infjammazzjoni; jingħad ukoll għal min jirrabja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 发炎；出现炎症。
生气；发怒。

formal.mt: Fir-rapport ġie nnutat li l-ġog tbergħen u li l-pazjent ħass uġigħ waqt il-moviment.
formal.en: The report noted that the joint became inflamed and that the patient felt pain during movement.
formal.zh: 报告记载，该关节出现了炎症，患者活动时感到疼痛。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex telaq Mark? Pawlu: Tbergħen meta sema' l-kumment u ħareġ barra.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did Mark leave? Pawlu: He got angry when he heard the comment and went outside.
colloquial.zh: Sara：Mark 为什么走了？Pawlu：他听到那句话就生气了，随后走到了外面。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: Mark 为什么走了？
messages.en: Why did Mark leave?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tbergħen meta sema' l-kumment u ħareġ barra.
messages.mt_standard: Tbergħen meta sema' l-kumment u ħareġ barra.
messages.zh: 他听到那句话就生气了，随后走到了外面。
messages.en: He got angry when he heard the comment and went outside.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个画面并排记忆：关节红肿对应发炎，人物听到一句话后动怒对应生气；根据主语和语境选择义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An infestation in which fleas are present on an animal or in a place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 动物身上或某个地方出现、滋生跳蚤的情况。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-preżenza ta' briegħed fuq annimal jew f'post.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 跳蚤侵扰；动物身上或某处滋生跳蚤。

collocations.en: a flea infestation in the bedding

collocations.zh: 针对跳蚤侵扰的处理措施

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi t-tbergħid fil-friex tal-kelb u jirrakkomanda tindif bir-reqqa.
formal.en: The report describes the flea infestation in the dog's bedding and recommends thorough cleaning.
formal.zh: 报告描述了狗窝寝具中的跳蚤侵扰，并建议彻底清洁。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Il-veterinarju sab tbergħid fuq il-kelb. Mark: Mela rridu nsegwu l-parir tiegħu u nnaddfu l-friex ukoll.
colloquial.en: Lara: The vet found a flea infestation on the dog. Mark: Then we need to follow his advice and clean the bedding too.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：兽医发现狗身上有跳蚤侵扰。马克：那我们得听从他的建议，也把狗窝的寝具清洁一下。

messages.speaker: Lara (宠物主人)
messages.zh: 兽医发现狗身上有跳蚤侵扰。
messages.en: The vet found a flea infestation on the dog.

messages.speaker: Mark (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela rridu nsegwu l-parir tiegħu u nnaddfu l-friex ukoll.
messages.mt_standard: Mela rridu nsegwu l-parir tiegħu u nnaddfu l-friex ukoll.
messages.zh: 那我们得听从他的建议，也把狗窝的寝具清洁一下。
messages.en: Then we need to follow his advice and clean the bedding too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个名词配上一幅狗窝里有跳蚤的画面，记住它表示跳蚤侵扰的情况，而不是单只跳蚤。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of becoming angry or beginning to feel anger.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 情绪变得愤怒、开始生气的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li fih persuna tibda tirrabja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 开始生气；情绪转为愤怒的过程。

formal.mt: L-għalliem innota sinjali ta' tbergħin waqt id-diskussjoni u ppropona pawża qasira.
formal.en: The teacher noticed signs of rising anger during the discussion and proposed a short break.
formal.zh: 老师注意到讨论中有人开始发怒，于是提议短暂休息。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Innutajt it-tbergħin tiegħu meta sema' l-aħbar? Lara: Iva, beda jgħolli leħnu, allura tajnieh ftit ħin biex jikkalma.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you notice him getting angry when he heard the news? Lara: Yes, he started raising his voice, so we gave him a little time to calm down.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你注意到他听到消息时开始生气了吗？拉拉：注意到了，他开始提高嗓门，所以我们给了他一点时间冷静。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Innutajt it-tbergħin tiegħu meta sema' l-aħbar?
messages.mt_standard: Innutajt it-tbergħin tiegħu meta sema' l-aħbar?
messages.zh: 你注意到他听到消息时开始生气了吗？
messages.en: Did you notice him getting angry when he heard the news?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, beda jgħolli leħnu, allura tajnieh ftit ħin biex jikkalma.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, beda jgħolli leħnu, allura tajnieh ftit ħin biex jikkalma.
messages.zh: 注意到了，他开始提高嗓门，所以我们给了他一点时间冷静。
messages.en: Yes, he started raising his voice, so we gave him a little time to calm down.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象情绪温度计从平静逐渐升到愤怒，把这个名词记成生起气来的过程。

gloss_zh: 祝福；复活节后神父到访家庭的年度祝福仪式

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of giving a blessing, including the annual blessing of homes by the parish priest after Easter.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 施予祝福的行为；也指复活节后由堂区神父主持的年度家庭祝福仪式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għoti ta' barka; ukoll il-barka annwali tad-djar mill-kappillan fil-perjodu ta' wara l-Għid.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 施予祝福的行为；祝福仪式。

sense_translations.en_definition: the annual blessing of homes by the parish priest, held in the period following Easter
sense_translations.zh_definition: 复活节后由堂区神父主持的年度家庭祝福仪式。

formal.mt: Il-parroċċa ħabbret li t-tberik annwali tad-djar se jsir fil-ġimgħat ta' wara l-Għid.
formal.en: The parish announced that the annual blessing of homes would take place in the weeks after Easter.
formal.zh: 堂区宣布，年度家庭祝福仪式将在复活节后的几周内举行。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Meta ġej il-kappillan għat-tberik tad-dar? Omm: Nhar il-Ħamis wara nofsinhar; ħallejt l-avviż fuq il-mejda.
colloquial.en: Maja: When is the parish priest coming to bless the house? Mother: On Thursday afternoon; I left the notice on the table.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：堂区神父什么时候来家里主持祝福仪式？妈妈：星期四下午；我把通知放在桌上了。

messages.speaker: Maja (女儿)
messages.zh: 堂区神父什么时候来家里主持祝福仪式？
messages.en: When is the parish priest coming to bless the house?

messages.speaker: Omm (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Nhar il-Ħamis wara nofsinhar; ħallejt l-avviż fuq il-mejda.
messages.mt_standard: Nhar il-Ħamis wara nofsinhar; ħallejt l-avviż fuq il-mejda.
messages.zh: 星期四下午；我把通知放在桌上了。
messages.en: On Thursday afternoon; I left the notice on the table.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个场景一起记：餐桌前为食物祝福，以及复活节后神父到家中祝福；两者都可用这个名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To blossom or produce flowers.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 植物开花，长出花朵。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Joħroġ il-fjuri jew jibda jagħmel il-fjuri.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 开花；绽放花朵。

formal.mt: Il-pjanta tberklet fir-rebbiegħa, u l-istudenti rreġistraw id-data meta dehru l-ewwel fjuri.
formal.en: The plant blossomed in spring, and the students recorded the date when the first flowers appeared.
formal.zh: 这株植物在春天开了花，学生们记录了第一批花朵出现的日期。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ara, il-pjanta tberklet! Mark: Veru! Ilbieraħ ma kienx hemm dawn il-fjuri.
colloquial.en: Lara: Look, the plant has blossomed! Mark: It has! These flowers weren't there yesterday.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：看，这株植物开花了！马克：真的！昨天还没有这些花呢。

messages.speaker: Lara (园艺爱好者)
messages.zh: 看，这株植物开花了！
messages.en: Look, the plant has blossomed!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Veru! Ilbieraħ ma kienx hemm dawn il-fjuri.
messages.mt_standard: Veru! Ilbieraħ ma kienx hemm dawn il-fjuri.
messages.zh: 真的！昨天还没有这些花呢。
messages.en: It has! These flowers weren't there yesterday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把花苞打开的连续画面配给这个动词，记住它表达植物开花这一变化。

gloss_zh: 开花；开花现象（如卷心菜开花）

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process or occurrence of blossoming, used for plants such as cabbages.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 植物开花的过程或现象，可用于描述卷心菜等植物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess jew il-fenomenu li fih pjanta, bħall-kaboċċa, toħroġ il-fjuri.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 开花的过程或现象，例如卷心菜开花。

formal.mt: L-istudju jiddeskrivi t-tberkil tal-kaboċċi u jqabbel id-dati meta dehru l-ewwel fjuri f'żewġ għelieqi.
formal.en: The study describes the blossoming of cabbages and compares the dates when the first flowers appeared in two fields.
formal.zh: 这项研究描述了卷心菜开花的现象，并比较了两块田里第一批花朵出现的日期。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan hu l-bidu tat-tberkil tal-kaboċċi? Pawlu: Iva, ara l-fjuri żgħar li bdew jidhru.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this the beginning of the cabbages blossoming? Pawlu: Yes, look at the little flowers that have started to appear.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这就是卷心菜开始开花了吗？保罗：是的，看那些刚开始长出来的小花。

messages.speaker: Maja (园艺学徒)
messages.zh: 这就是卷心菜开始开花了吗？
messages.en: Is this the beginning of the cabbages blossoming?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (园丁)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ara l-fjuri żgħar li bdew jidhru.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ara l-fjuri żgħar li bdew jidhru.
messages.zh: 是的，看那些刚开始长出来的小花。
messages.en: Yes, look at the little flowers that have started to appear.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给卷心菜开花的照片写上这个名词，提醒自己这里命名的是开花现象；与表示动作的动词分开记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action of twirling something around or twisting it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使物体旋转，或将其扭转的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li ddawwar xi ħaġa fuqha nfisha jew li tgħawwiġha billi ddawwarha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 旋转；使某物打转的动作。
扭转；使某物拧转的动作。

formal.mt: L-għalliem wera kif it-tbermiċ tal-wajer jista' jagħtih forma ta' spirali.
formal.en: The teacher demonstrated how twisting the wire can give it a spiral shape.
formal.zh: 老师演示了如何通过扭转金属丝使其形成螺旋状。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan it-tbermiċ taż-żigarella kif tagħmlu? Lara: Naqbadha minn tarf wieħed u ndawwar idi bil-mod.
colloquial.en: Maja: How do you do that ribbon twirling? Lara: I hold it at one end and slowly move my hand in a circle.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你是怎么让彩带这样旋转的？拉拉：我抓住它的一端，慢慢转动手。

messages.speaker: Maja (舞蹈学员)
messages.zh: 你是怎么让彩带这样旋转的？
messages.en: How do you do that ribbon twirling?

messages.speaker: Lara (舞蹈老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Naqbadha minn tarf wieħed u ndawwar idi bil-mod.
messages.mt_standard: Naqbadha minn tarf wieħed u ndawwar idi bil-mod.
messages.zh: 我抓住它的一端，慢慢转动手。
messages.en: I hold it at one end and slowly move my hand in a circle.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用手做两个动作来记：让彩带打转表示旋转，把金属丝拧成螺旋表示扭转；这个名词涵盖两种动作。

gloss_zh: 直盯着看；目不转睛地注视

teaching_sense.en_definition: To stare steadily at someone or something without shifting one's gaze.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 目光固定在某人或某物上，直直地盯着看。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iħares fiss lejn xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa mingħajr ma jwarrab ħarstu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 目不转睛地盯着看；凝视。

collocations.zh: 目不转睛地看着那幅画

formal.mt: Waqt iż-żjara fil-mużew, l-istudent tberraq lejn l-istampa għal diversi minuti biex jifli d-dettalji tagħha.
formal.en: During the museum visit, the student stared fixedly at the picture for several minutes to examine its details.
formal.zh: 参观博物馆时，这名学生凝视那幅画好几分钟，仔细观察其中的细节。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Mark tberraq lejn l-iskrin u ma qal xejn? Lara: Kien qed jipprova jaqra l-kitba żgħira fir-ritratt.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Mark stare at the screen without saying anything? Lara: He was trying to read the small writing in the photo.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克为什么一言不发地直盯着屏幕？拉拉：他当时正想看清照片里的小字。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Mark tberraq lejn l-iskrin u ma qal xejn?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Mark tberraq lejn l-iskrin u ma qal xejn?
messages.zh: 马克为什么一言不发地直盯着屏幕？
messages.en: Why did Mark stare at the screen without saying anything?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien qed jipprova jaqra l-kitba żgħira fir-ritratt.
messages.mt_standard: Kien qed jipprova jaqra l-kitba żgħira fir-ritratt.
messages.zh: 他当时正想看清照片里的小字。
messages.en: He was trying to read the small writing in the photo.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象目光像被固定在一幅画上，久久不移开；用这个画面记住直盯着看的动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be opened wide, or to be made public so that information becomes known.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被敞开、被大大打开；也指信息被公开，让人知晓。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinfetaħ beraħ; jew, dwar informazzjoni, isir magħruf pubblikament.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被大大打开；被敞开。
被公开；被公之于众。

formal.mt: Il-bieb tas-sala tberraħ biex il-parteċipanti jkunu jistgħu jidħlu faċilment.
formal.en: The hall door was opened wide so that participants could enter easily.
formal.zh: 大厅的门被大大打开，方便参与者进入。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Il-pjan tberraħ dalgħodu? Lara: Iva, issa kulħadd jista' jaqrah fuq is-sit.
colloquial.en: Mark: Was the plan made public this morning? Lara: Yes, everyone can now read it on the website.
colloquial.zh: 马克：计划今天上午公开了吗？拉拉：公开了，现在大家都能在网站上看到了。

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.zh: 计划今天上午公开了吗？
messages.en: Was the plan made public this morning?

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, issa kulħadd jista' jaqrah fuq is-sit.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, issa kulħadd jista' jaqrah fuq is-sit.
messages.zh: 公开了，现在大家都能在网站上看到了。
messages.en: Yes, everyone can now read it on the website.

cognitive_memory_aid: 并排想象一扇被敞开的门和一份被公开的计划，用两幅画面分别记住这个动词的两个义项。

gloss_zh: 名词义未说明；动词：被冷却、变凉

teaching_sense.en_definition: A noun listed as 'Tberred'; the supplied entry does not specify its meaning.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 所给词条收录的名词，但材料没有说明其具体含义；应与“被冷却”的动词义分开学习。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nom imniżżel bħala 'Tberred', iżda t-tifsira tiegħu mhix spjegata fil-materjal mogħti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 名词条目“Tberred”；所给材料未说明具体释义。
被冷却；变凉。

collocations.zh: 在空气中冷却（动词用法）

formal.mt: Fl-eżerċizzju, 'Tberred' huwa mniżżel bħala nom mingħajr tifsira spjegata; fis-sentenza 'It-te tberred', il-kelma tintuża bħala verb.
formal.en: In the exercise, 'Tberred' is listed as a noun without an explained meaning; in the sentence 'The tea cooled', the word is used as a verb.
formal.zh: 练习中，“Tberred”被列为名词，但没有给出具体释义；在“It-te tberred”（茶变凉了）这句话里，该词用作动词。

colloquial.mt: Maja: It-te għadu jaħraq? Mark: Le, tberred. Tista' tixorbu issa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is the tea still hot? Mark: No, it has cooled. You can drink it now.
colloquial.zh: Maja：茶还烫吗？Mark：不，已经凉下来了。你现在可以喝了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 茶还烫吗？
messages.en: Is the tea still hot?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 不，已经凉下来了。你现在可以喝了。
messages.en: No, it has cooled. You can drink it now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用“一杯热茶慢慢变凉”记住动词义；名词另留一格，注明材料未释义，不把两种词性混为一谈。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To lower the body into a lying position.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把身体放低，进入躺卧的姿势。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iniżżel ġismu u jieħu pożizzjoni mimduda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 躺下；卧下。

formal.mt: Wara l-mixja, il-ġemel tberrek mal-art għad-dell ta' siġra.
formal.en: After the walk, the camel lay down on the ground in the shade of a tree.
formal.zh: 行走之后，骆驼在树荫下的地面上卧了下来。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn hu l-ġemel? Pawlu: Hemm, taħt is-siġra. Tberrek biex jistrieħ.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where is the camel? Pawlu: There, under the tree. It lay down to rest.
colloquial.zh: Lara：骆驼在哪儿？Pawlu：在那儿，树底下。它卧下来休息了。

messages.speaker: Lara (游客)
messages.zh: 骆驼在哪儿？
messages.en: Where is the camel?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (导游)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm, taħt is-siġra. Tberrek biex jistrieħ.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm, taħt is-siġra. Tberrek biex jistrieħ.
messages.zh: 在那儿，树底下。它卧下来休息了。
messages.en: There, under the tree. It lay down to rest.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象骆驼走到树荫下，把身体放低卧下来；把整个卧下动作与 tberrek 连在一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To have a hole bored in it with an auger.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指某物被螺旋钻钻出孔洞，侧重接受钻孔的物件。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Issir fih toqba permezz ta' barrina.

sense_translations.en_definition: to have a hole drilled with an auger
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被螺旋钻钻出孔洞。

collocations.en: had a hole bored in the middle

formal.mt: Il-blokk tal-injam tberren b'barrina fil-punt immarkat.
formal.en: The wooden block had a hole bored with an auger at the marked point.
formal.zh: 木块在标记处被螺旋钻钻出了一个孔。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-blokk diġà għandu toqba? Toni: Iva, tberren b'barrina dalgħodu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does this block already have a hole? Toni: Yes, it had a hole bored with an auger this morning.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这块木头已经有孔了吗？Toni：有了，今天早上已经用螺旋钻钻过孔了。

messages.speaker: Maja (学徒)
messages.zh: 这块木头已经有孔了吗？
messages.en: Does this block already have a hole?

messages.speaker: Toni (木匠)
messages.zh: 有了，今天早上已经用螺旋钻钻过孔了。
messages.en: Yes, it had a hole bored with an auger this morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把镜头对准木块：螺旋钻转进去，木块被钻出孔；用“物件接受钻孔”的画面记住这个动词。

gloss_zh: 冷却；让自己处于穿堂风中

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of making something cooler or allowing it to become cooler.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物温度降低，或让其自然变凉的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih xi ħaġa ssir jew titħalla ssir aktar kiesħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 冷却；降温的过程。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih xi ħaġa ssir aktar kiesħa.

sense_translations.en_definition: exposure of oneself to a draught
sense_translations.zh_definition: 让自己处于穿堂风或持续气流中的行为。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-fatt li wieħed joqgħod espost għal kurrent tal-arja.

collocations.en: exposure of oneself to a draught

formal.mt: Wara t-tisjir, it-tberrid tal-ikel inaqqas it-temperatura tiegħu.
formal.en: After cooking, the cooling of food lowers its temperature.
formal.zh: 烹饪完成后，食物的冷却过程会降低其温度。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Nista' npoġġi l-krema fuq il-kejk issa? Mark: Stenna ftit; it-tberrid tal-kejk għadu ma spiċċax.
colloquial.en: Nina: Can I put the cream on the cake now? Mark: Wait a little; the cake has not finished cooling.
colloquial.zh: Nina：现在可以往蛋糕上抹奶油了吗？Mark：再等一会儿，蛋糕还没有完全冷却。

messages.speaker: Nina (烘焙学徒)
messages.mt_spoken: Nista' npoġġi l-krema fuq il-kejk issa?
messages.mt_standard: Nista' npoġġi l-krema fuq il-kejk issa?
messages.zh: 现在可以往蛋糕上抹奶油了吗？
messages.en: Can I put the cream on the cake now?

messages.speaker: Mark (烘焙师)
messages.mt_spoken: Stenna ftit; it-tberrid tal-kejk għadu ma spiċċax.
messages.mt_standard: Stenna ftit; it-tberrid tal-kejk għadu ma spiċċax.
messages.zh: 再等一会儿，蛋糕还没有完全冷却。
messages.en: Wait a little; the cake has not finished cooling.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅画面分别记义：蛋糕放着降温是“冷却”，人站在穿堂风里是“让自己吹风”；两者都用名词记。

gloss_zh: 公鸡促使母鸡蹲伏以便交配的行为

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of a cockerel causing a hen to squat for mating.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 公鸡促使母鸡蹲伏下来，以便进行交配的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li bih serduk iġiegħel tiġieġa titbaxxa biex jitgħammru.

sense_translations.en_definition: a cockerel's causing a hen to squat for copulation
sense_translations.zh_definition: 公鸡促使母鸡蹲伏以便交配的行为。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-att ta' serduk li jġiegħel tiġieġa titbaxxa għall-għammir.

collocations.en: the male birds' causing hens to squat for mating
collocations.zh: 雄鸡促使母鸡蹲伏交配的行为

collocations.en: observation of a cockerel causing a hen to squat for mating
collocations.zh: 对公鸡促使母鸡蹲伏交配这一行为的观察

formal.mt: Fir-rapport dwar l-imġiba tat-tiġieġ, it-tberrik jiddeskrivi kif is-serduk iġiegħel lit-tiġieġa titbaxxa għall-għammir.
formal.en: In the report on chicken behaviour, tberrik describes how the cockerel causes the hen to squat for mating.
formal.zh: 在这份鸡类行为报告中，tberrik 描述的是公鸡促使母鸡蹲伏以便交配的行为。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser tberrik fin-noti tiegħek? Pawlu: Meta s-serduk iġiegħel lit-tiġieġa titbaxxa biex jitgħammru.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does tberrik mean in your notes? Pawlu: It is when the cockerel causes the hen to squat so they can mate.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你笔记里的 tberrik 是什么意思？Pawlu：就是公鸡促使母鸡蹲伏下来，以便交配的行为。

messages.speaker: Maja (农业学生)
messages.zh: 你笔记里的 tberrik 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does tberrik mean in your notes?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (养鸡人)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta s-serduk iġiegħel lit-tiġieġa titbaxxa biex jitgħammru.
messages.mt_standard: Meta s-serduk iġiegħel lit-tiġieġa titbaxxa biex jitgħammru.
messages.zh: 就是公鸡促使母鸡蹲伏下来，以便交配的行为。
messages.en: It is when the cockerel causes the hen to squat so they can mate.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按“公鸡发起、母鸡蹲伏、准备交配”三个环节记忆；整个促使蹲伏的行为才是这个名词的重点。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of boring a hole with a gimlet, a small hand-operated boring tool.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使用手捻钻这种小型手动钻孔工具钻孔的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li ssir toqba b'barrina żgħira tal-idejn.

sense_translations.en_definition: act of boring with a gimlet
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用手捻钻钻孔的动作。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed itaqqab b'barrina żgħira tal-idejn.

collocations.en: boring into wood with a gimlet
collocations.zh: 用手捻钻在木头上钻孔

collocations.en: boring with a small hand gimlet

formal.mt: It-tberrin b'barrina żgħira tal-idejn ħoloq toqba fil-biċċa injam.
formal.en: Boring with a small hand gimlet made a hole in the piece of wood.
formal.zh: 使用小型手捻钻钻孔，在这块木头上形成了一个孔洞。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif għamilt din it-toqba żgħira? Toni: Bit-tberrin, b'barrina żgħira tal-idejn.
colloquial.en: Lara: How did you make this small hole? Toni: By boring it with a small hand gimlet.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这个小孔是怎么做出来的？Toni：用小型手捻钻钻出来的。

messages.speaker: Lara (手工课学生)
messages.zh: 这个小孔是怎么做出来的？
messages.en: How did you make this small hole?

messages.speaker: Toni (手工课教师)
messages.zh: 用小型手捻钻钻出来的。
messages.en: By boring it with a small hand gimlet.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象手指握住小钻柄，一圈圈转出木孔；tberrin 记的是钻孔这件事，tberren 则配合物件被钻孔的画面记。

gloss_zh: 闪电；惊讶地睁大眼睛；盯视

teaching_sense.en_definition: Flashes of lightning in the sky.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 天空中闪电产生的一次次亮光。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-beraħ tad-dawl fis-sema meta jseħħ is-sajjetti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 闪电的闪光；电光。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dawl qawwi u qasir fis-sema mis-sajjetti.

sense_translations.en_definition: widening of the eyes in surprise
sense_translations.zh_definition: 因惊讶而睁大眼睛的动作。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-ftuħ tal-għajnejn aktar mis-soltu minħabba sorpriża.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 盯视；目不转睛地看。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħars fiss u fit-tul lejn xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa.

collocations.en: widening of the eyes in surprise

formal.mt: Matul il-lejl, it-tberriq fis-sema kien jidher mit-tieqa tal-istazzjon.
formal.en: During the night, lightning flashes in the sky were visible from the station window.
formal.zh: 夜间，从观测站的窗户可以看见天空中的闪电。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Rajt it-tberriq fis-sema? Mark: Iva, rajtu mit-tieqa. Kien qawwi ħafna!
colloquial.en: Sara: Did you see the lightning flashes in the sky? Mark: Yes, I saw them from the window. They were very bright!
colloquial.zh: Sara：你看见天空中的闪电了吗？Mark：看见了，我从窗户那里看到的。特别亮！

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你看见天空中的闪电了吗？
messages.en: Did you see the lightning flashes in the sky?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, rajtu mit-tieqa. Kien qawwi ħafna!
messages.mt_standard: Iva, rajtu mit-tieqa. Kien qawwi ħafna!
messages.zh: 看见了，我从窗户那里看到的。特别亮！
messages.en: Yes, I saw them from the window. They were very bright!

cognitive_memory_aid: 做三张场景卡：天空闪电、惊讶瞪眼、持续盯视；用“发生在哪里、眼睛怎样动”来区分三个名词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of becoming covered with dust.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 物体、衣物等逐渐沾上灰尘或被灰尘覆盖的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih xi ħaġa tinkesa bit-trab.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 沾上灰尘；被灰尘覆盖的过程。

formal.mt: L-għata tgħin biex jitnaqqas it-tberrix tal-għamara waqt ix-xogħol.
formal.en: The covering helps reduce the furniture's accumulation of dust during the work.
formal.zh: 施工期间，遮盖物有助于减少家具蒙尘。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex għattejt is-siġġijiet? Toni: Biex nevitaw it-tberrix waqt li nnaddfu l-kamra.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you cover the chairs? Toni: To keep them from getting covered with dust while we clean the room.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么把椅子盖起来？托尼：这样我们打扫房间时，椅子就不会沾满灰尘。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 你为什么把椅子盖起来？
messages.en: Why did you cover the chairs?

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex nevitaw it-tberrix waqt li nnaddfu l-kamra.
messages.mt_standard: Biex nevitaw it-tberrix waqt li nnaddfu l-kamra.
messages.zh: 这样我们打扫房间时，椅子就不会沾满灰尘。
messages.en: To keep them from getting covered with dust while we clean the room.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象施工时给家具盖布的画面：这个名词强调的是“逐渐蒙尘”的过程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of opening doors and windows.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把门和窗户打开的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li jinfetħu l-bibien u t-twieqi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 打开门窗的行为。

collocations.en: opening doors and windows in the morning

formal.mt: It-tberriħ tal-bibien u t-twieqi filgħodu jħalli l-arja friska tidħol fil-kamra.
formal.en: Opening the doors and windows in the morning lets fresh air into the room.
formal.zh: 早晨打开门窗，可以让新鲜空气进入房间。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Hawn ħafna sħana. Niftħu l-bibien u t-twieqi? Luqa: Iva, ftit tberriħ jagħmel tajjeb.
colloquial.en: Sara: It is very hot in here. Shall we open the doors and windows? Luqa: Yes, opening them for a bit would help.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这里好热。我们把门窗打开吧？Luqa：好，开一会儿门窗会舒服些。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn ħafna sħana. Niftħu l-bibien u t-twieqi?
messages.mt_standard: Hawn ħafna sħana. Niftħu l-bibien u t-twieqi?
messages.zh: 这里好热。我们把门窗打开吧？
messages.en: It is very hot in here. Shall we open the doors and windows?

messages.speaker: Luqa (室友)
messages.zh: 好，开一会儿门窗会舒服些。
messages.en: Yes, opening them for a bit would help.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象早晨依次推开房门和窗户，把“开门加开窗”这一整套动作记作 tberriħ。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of playing a reed-pipe or fife.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 吹奏苇管或横笛这类管乐器的活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Id-daqq ta' strument tan-nifs bħal qasba jew flejguta.

sense_translations.en_definition: playing of the reed-pipe or fife
sense_translations.zh_definition: 苇管或横笛的吹奏。

collocations.en: reed-pipe or fife playing during the celebration
collocations.zh: 庆典期间的苇管或横笛吹奏

formal.mt: Il-programm jinkludi t-tbetbit tal-qasba u l-kant.
formal.en: The programme includes reed-pipe playing and singing.
formal.zh: 节目包括苇管吹奏和歌唱。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'se nisimgħu fil-festa? Pawlu: Se jkun hemm it-tbetbit tal-qasba u ftit kant.
colloquial.en: Lara: What will we hear at the celebration? Pawlu: There will be reed-pipe playing and some singing.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：庆典上我们能听到什么？保罗：会有苇管吹奏，还有一些歌唱。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 庆典上我们能听到什么？
messages.en: What will we hear at the celebration?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Se jkun hemm it-tbetbit tal-qasba u ftit kant.
messages.mt_standard: Se jkun hemm it-tbetbit tal-qasba u ftit kant.
messages.zh: 会有苇管吹奏，还有一些歌唱。
messages.en: There will be reed-pipe playing and some singing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词配上手持小管乐器吹奏的动作，记住它指“吹奏活动”，不是乐器本身。

gloss_zh: 变得松垮下垂；健康衰退

teaching_sense.en_definition: To grow fleshy and droopy, especially in the face; to become flabby or decline in health.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 尤指面部变得肉多而下垂，也可指身体变松垮或健康状况衰退。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir imlaħħam u mdendel, speċjalment fil-wiċċ; isir laxk fil-ġisem jew imur lura f'saħħtu.

sense_translations.en_definition: to grow fleshy and droopy (especially one's face)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得肉多且下垂，尤指人的面部。
变得松弛、松垮。
健康状况衰退；身体变差。

collocations.en: grew fleshy and droopy in the face

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-karattru tbettaħ f'wiċċu hekk kif għaddew is-snin.
formal.en: In the story, the character's face grew fleshy and droopy as the years passed.
formal.zh: 故事中，随着岁月流逝，这个人物的脸变得肉多而下垂。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'jiġifieri li l-karattru tbettaħ f'wiċċu? Mark: Li wiċċu sar aktar imlaħħam u mdendel.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does it mean that the character grew fleshy and droopy in the face? Mark: It means his face became fleshier and sagged.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：说这个人物的脸变得松垮下垂，是什么意思？马克：就是说他的脸肉更多了，也下垂了。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 说这个人物的脸变得松垮下垂，是什么意思？
messages.en: What does it mean that the character grew fleshy and droopy in the face?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Li wiċċu sar aktar imlaħħam u mdendel.
messages.mt_standard: Li wiċċu sar aktar imlaħħam u mdendel.
messages.zh: 就是说他的脸肉更多了，也下垂了。
messages.en: It means his face became fleshier and sagged.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三个小画面串记：脸肉下垂、身体松垮、健康走下坡；具体义项由上下文决定。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of becoming flabby or droopy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体部位等逐渐失去紧实感，变得松弛或下垂的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih xi ħaġa ssir laxka jew imdendla.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得松弛、松垮或下垂的过程。

collocations.en: the skin becoming flabby or droopy
the face becoming flabby or droopy

formal.mt: It-test jiddeskrivi t-tbettiħ tal-ġilda bħala bidla fid-dehra tal-karattru.
formal.en: The text describes the skin becoming flabby as a change in the character's appearance.
formal.zh: 文本将皮肤变松弛描述为人物外貌的一种变化。

colloquial.mt: Sara: It-tbettiħ tal-wiċċ ifisser li l-wiċċ sar aktar laxk? Toni: Iva, jew li beda jidher imdendel.
colloquial.en: Sara: Does the face becoming flabby mean that it has become less firm? Toni: Yes, or that it has started to look droopy.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：面部变松垮，是说脸没有以前紧实了吗？托尼：对，也可以说脸开始显得下垂了。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tbettiħ tal-wiċċ ifisser li l-wiċċ sar aktar laxk?
messages.mt_standard: It-tbettiħ tal-wiċċ ifisser li l-wiċċ sar aktar laxk?
messages.zh: 面部变松垮，是说脸没有以前紧实了吗？
messages.en: Does the face becoming flabby mean that it has become less firm?

messages.speaker: Toni (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jew li beda jidher imdendel.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jew li beda jidher imdendel.
messages.zh: 对，也可以说脸开始显得下垂了。
messages.en: Yes, or that it has started to look droopy.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它当作一段慢动作：原本紧实的轮廓逐渐松弛下垂；这个名词给变化过程命名。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become empty or vacant after people or things are no longer there.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 原先有人或有东西的地方变空，或变成无人占用的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir vojt jew bla nies jew oġġetti fih.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变空；变得无人占用或空置。

formal.mt: Il-post tbewwagħ wara li telqu l-aħħar viżitaturi.
formal.en: The place became empty after the last visitors left.
formal.zh: 最后一批访客离开后，这个地方变得空无一人。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għad hemm ħafna nies fil-ħanut? Mark: Le, il-ħanut tbewwagħ; il-klijenti kollha telqu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Are there still many people in the shop? Mark: No, the shop has emptied out; all the customers have left.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：店里还有很多人吗？马克：没有，店里已经空了，顾客都走了。

messages.speaker: Lara (店员)
messages.zh: 店里还有很多人吗？
messages.en: Are there still many people in the shop?

messages.speaker: Mark (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, il-ħanut tbewwagħ; il-klijenti kollha telqu.
messages.mt_standard: Le, il-ħanut tbewwagħ; il-klijenti kollha telqu.
messages.zh: 没有，店里已经空了，顾客都走了。
messages.en: No, the shop has emptied out; all the customers have left.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象店里最后一位顾客离开，画面从有人变成空荡荡，抓住“变空”的变化。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become loose, open up, or become hollow, depending on the object described.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 根据所描述的事物，可指变得松动、张开，或内部变成空心。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir laxk, jinfetaħ jew isir vojt minn ġewwa, skont il-ħaġa deskritta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变松；变得松动。
张开；打开。
变成空心；内部变空。

formal.mt: Iz-zokk tbewwaq minn ġewwa, għalkemm minn barra kien għadu jidher sħiħ.
formal.en: The trunk became hollow inside, although it still looked intact from the outside.
formal.zh: 树干内部变成了空心，尽管从外面看仍然完好。

colloquial.mt: Pawlu: Għaliex il-ħabel m'għadux issikkat? Maja: Tbewwaq; irridu nerġgħu nissikkawh.
colloquial.en: Pawlu: Why is the rope no longer tight? Maja: It has become loose; we need to tighten it again.
colloquial.zh: 保罗：绳子怎么不紧了？玛雅：它变松了，我们得重新拉紧。

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 绳子怎么不紧了？
messages.en: Why is the rope no longer tight?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 它变松了，我们得重新拉紧。
messages.en: It has become loose; we need to tighten it again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用绳子松开、开口张开、树干空心三个画面分别记义；看到主语再选择合适解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To urinate because of fear.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因为害怕或受到惊吓而排尿，通常可理解为吓得尿出来。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel l-awrina minħabba l-biża'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 因恐惧而排尿；吓得尿出来。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, it-tifel tbewwel bil-biża' meta sema' l-isplużjoni.
formal.en: In the story, the boy urinated out of fear when he heard the explosion.
formal.zh: 故事中，男孩听到爆炸声，吓得尿了出来。

colloquial.mt: Sara: It-tifel tbewwel bil-biża'? Toni: Iva, nħasad ħafna. Ejja ngħinuh u nsibulu ħwejjeġ nodfa.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did the boy wet himself out of fear? Toni: Yes, he was very frightened. Let's help him and find him clean clothes.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：男孩是吓得尿裤子了吗？托尼：是的，他受了很大的惊吓。我们帮帮他，给他找些干净衣服。

messages.speaker: Sara (照护者)
messages.zh: 男孩是吓得尿裤子了吗？
messages.en: Did the boy wet himself out of fear?

messages.speaker: Toni (照护者)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, nħasad ħafna. Ejja ngħinuh u nsibulu ħwejjeġ nodfa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, nħasad ħafna. Ejja ngħinuh u nsibulu ħwejjeġ nodfa.
messages.zh: 是的，他受了很大的惊吓。我们帮帮他，给他找些干净衣服。
messages.en: Yes, he was very frightened. Let's help him and find him clean clothes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 将“受到惊吓”和“尿出来”连成因果画面；记忆重点是恐惧这一原因，不只是普通排尿。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To kiss one another; in a more specific sense, to kiss using the tongue.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 彼此亲吻；在较具体的义项中，指用舌头接吻，即舌吻。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ibusu lil xulxin; f'sens aktar speċifiku, ibusu lil xulxin bl-ilsien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 互相亲吻；彼此接吻。
舌吻；用舌头接吻。

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, Mark tbewwes ma' Rita qabel ma telaq.
formal.en: In the novel, Mark and Rita kissed before he left.
formal.zh: 小说中，马克离开前与丽塔互相亲吻。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Meta ngħidu li xi ħadd tbewwes, dejjem ifisser bl-ilsien? Pawlu: Le, jista' jfisser ukoll li tnejn biesu lil xulxin.
colloquial.en: Lara: When we say someone 'tbewwes', does it always mean French kissing? Pawlu: No, it can also mean that two people kissed one another.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：说某人“tbewwes”，一定是指舌吻吗？保罗：不是，也可以只是指两个人互相亲吻。

messages.speaker: Lara (成年学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta ngħidu li xi ħadd tbewwes, dejjem ifisser bl-ilsien?
messages.mt_standard: Meta ngħidu li xi ħadd tbewwes, dejjem ifisser bl-ilsien?
messages.zh: 说某人“tbewwes”，一定是指舌吻吗？
messages.en: When we say someone 'tbewwes', does it always mean French kissing?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (成年同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, jista' jfisser ukoll li tnejn biesu lil xulxin.
messages.mt_standard: Le, jista' jfisser ukoll li tnejn biesu lil xulxin.
messages.zh: 不是，也可以只是指两个人互相亲吻。
messages.en: No, it can also mean that two people kissed one another.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先记“两个人互相亲吻”的画面，再单独记较具体的“舌吻”义；依据语境区分两者。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of standing on duty at the entrance to a building.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在建筑物入口站岗、值守的活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħidma ta' min joqgħod għassa mal-bieb ta' bini.

sense_translations.en_definition: to stand on duty at the door to a building
sense_translations.zh_definition: 在建筑物门口站岗、值守。

collocations.en: standing on duty at the building's entrance
long hours of duty at the door

formal.mt: Waqt l-avveniment, it-tbewwib mal-bieb prinċipali kien f'idejn żewġ impjegati.
formal.en: During the event, two employees were responsible for standing on duty at the main entrance.
formal.zh: 活动期间，两名员工负责在正门值守。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Illum kien imissek it-tbewwib? Pawlu: Iva, qgħadt mal-bieb tas-sala għal sagħtejn.
colloquial.en: Maja: Was it your turn to be on door duty today? Pawlu: Yes, I stood at the hall entrance for two hours.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：今天轮到你守门吗？保罗：是啊，我在大厅门口站了两个小时。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 今天轮到你守门吗？
messages.en: Was it your turn to be on door duty today?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (值班员工)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qgħadt mal-bieb tas-sala għal sagħtejn.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qgħadt mal-bieb tas-sala għal sagħtejn.
messages.zh: 是啊，我在大厅门口站了两个小时。
messages.en: Yes, I stood at the hall entrance for two hours.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个名词放进“轮到我在门口值班”的画面中记忆，重点是持续值守这一活动。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The occurrence of urinating frequently.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 频繁排尿、反复需要小便的现象。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-fatt li wieħed jagħmel l-awrina ta' spiss.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 频繁排尿；尿频。

formal.mt: Il-pazjent semma t-tbewwil matul il-lejl waqt il-konsultazzjoni.
formal.en: The patient mentioned frequent urination during the night at the consultation.
formal.zh: 患者在问诊时提到了夜间频繁排尿的情况。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Dan it-tbewwil qed iqajjimni bil-lejl. Maja: Kemm-il darba tqum? Mark: Tliet darbiet, xi drabi erbgħa.
colloquial.en: Mark: This frequent urination keeps waking me up at night. Maja: How many times do you get up? Mark: Three times, sometimes four.
colloquial.zh: 马克：老是要小便，夜里总被弄醒。玛雅：你一晚起来几次？马克：三次，有时四次。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 老是要小便，夜里总被弄醒。
messages.en: This frequent urination keeps waking me up at night.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你一晚起来几次？
messages.en: How many times do you get up?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 三次，有时四次。
messages.en: Three times, sometimes four.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“夜里一次又一次起床去厕所”的画面记忆，抓住频繁发生，而非单次排尿。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of making something hollow, or a feeling of emptiness in the stomach.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某物内部挖空的行为，也可指胃里空空的感觉。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tħaffer xi ħaġa minn ġewwa biex issir vojta, jew sensazzjoni ta' vojt fl-istonku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 挖去内部、使某物中空的行为。

sense_translations.en_definition: a feeling of emptiness in one's stomach
sense_translations.zh_definition: 胃里空空的感觉。

collocations.en: the hollowing out of a piece of wood
a feeling of emptiness in the stomach

formal.mt: It-tbewwiq tal-biċċa injam sar b'attenzjoni biex il-ħitan tal-oġġett ma jinkisrux.
formal.en: The piece of wood was hollowed out carefully so that the walls of the object would not break.
formal.zh: 这块木头的内部经过仔细挖空，以免制品的侧壁破裂。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandi tbewwiq fl-istonku. Mark: Għadek ma kiltx? Maja: Le, għadni ma kilt xejn minn dalgħodu.
colloquial.en: Maja: My stomach feels empty. Mark: Haven't you eaten yet? Maja: No, I haven't eaten anything since this morning.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我胃里空空的。马克：你还没吃东西吗？玛雅：没有，从今天早上到现在什么都没吃。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我胃里空空的。
messages.en: My stomach feels empty.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 你还没吃东西吗？
messages.en: Haven't you eaten yet?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, għadni ma kilt xejn minn dalgħodu.
messages.mt_standard: Le, għadni ma kilt xejn minn dalgħodu.
messages.zh: 没有，从今天早上到现在什么都没吃。
messages.en: No, I haven't eaten anything since this morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把木头被挖空和胃里空空并排想象，用“内部空了”串联两个义项；这只是学习联想。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of kissing frequently or repeatedly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 频繁或接连亲吻的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għoti ta' ħafna bews jew ta' bews ta' spiss.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 频繁亲吻；接连不断地亲吻。

formal.mt: Il-wasla tan-nanna ntlaqgħet b'ħafna tgħanniq u tbewwis min-neputijiet.
formal.en: The grandmother's arrival was greeted with plenty of hugging and repeated kissing from her grandchildren.
formal.zh: 奶奶到来时，孙辈们热情地拥抱她，接连亲吻她。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Biżżejjed tbewwis, nanna! Nanna: Bewsa oħra biss, u mbagħad inħallik tilgħab.
colloquial.en: Lina: Enough kisses, Grandma! Grandma: Just one more kiss, and then I'll let you play.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：奶奶，亲够啦！奶奶：就再亲一下，然后就让你去玩。

messages.speaker: Lina (孙女)
messages.zh: 奶奶，亲够啦！
messages.en: Enough kisses, Grandma!

messages.speaker: Nanna (奶奶)
messages.mt_spoken: Bewsa oħra biss, u mbagħad inħallik tilgħab.
messages.mt_standard: Bewsa oħra biss, u mbagħad inħallik tilgħab.
messages.zh: 就再亲一下，然后就让你去玩。
messages.en: Just one more kiss, and then I'll let you play.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象亲人见面时左脸右脸接连亲吻，记住这个名词强调亲吻反复发生。

gloss_zh: 把东西放进口袋；把钱等揣入袋中

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of putting something, such as money, into a pocket.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把钱或其他物品放进口袋的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li ddaħħal xi ħaġa, bħal flus, fil-but.

sense_translations.en_definition: the act of pocketing sth. (such as money)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 把某物（如钱）放进口袋、揣入袋中的行为。

formal.mt: L-eżerċizzju tat-teatru kien jinkludi t-tbewwit ta' munita mingħajr ma taqa' mal-art.
formal.en: The drama exercise included pocketing a coin without dropping it on the floor.
formal.zh: 这项戏剧练习包括把一枚硬币放进口袋，同时不让它掉到地上。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex dan it-tbewwit tal-muniti kollha? Mark: Għax il-portmoni tiegħi nkiser, u għalissa qed inpoġġihom fil-but.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you putting all those coins in your pocket? Mark: Because my wallet broke, so I'm keeping them in my pocket for now.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你怎么把那些硬币全往口袋里装？马克：因为我的钱包坏了，暂时先放口袋里。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你怎么把那些硬币全往口袋里装？
messages.en: Why are you putting all those coins in your pocket?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax il-portmoni tiegħi nkiser, u għalissa qed inpoġġihom fil-but.
messages.mt_standard: Għax il-portmoni tiegħi nkiser, u għalissa qed inpoġġihom fil-but.
messages.zh: 因为我的钱包坏了，暂时先放口袋里。
messages.en: Because my wallet broke, so I'm keeping them in my pocket for now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“拿起硬币，再放进口袋”的连续动作记忆，词义重点在把东西收入袋中。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of slipping away or leaving in a hurry.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 悄悄溜走或匆忙离开的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-tluq bil-moħbi jew bl-għaġla minn post.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不引人注意地溜走。
匆忙离开；急急忙忙走掉。

formal.mt: It-tbewwiġ tiegħu mil-laqgħa qabel ma ntemmet ħalla diversi mistoqsijiet bla tweġiba.
formal.en: His slipping away from the meeting before it ended left several questions unanswered.
formal.zh: 他在会议结束前溜走，留下了几个尚未得到回答的问题。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex dan it-tbewwiġ kollu? Mark: Waslet il-karozza tal-linja, u ma rridx nitlifha!
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you rushing off like this? Mark: The bus is here, and I don't want to miss it!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：怎么这么急着走？马克：公交车到了，我可不想错过！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 怎么这么急着走？
messages.en: Why are you rushing off like this?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Waslet il-karozza tal-linja, u ma rridx nitlifha!
messages.mt_standard: Waslet il-karozza tal-linja, u ma rridx nitlifha!
messages.zh: 公交车到了，我可不想错过！
messages.en: The bus is here, and I don't want to miss it!

cognitive_memory_aid: 联想两种离场画面：一个人悄悄溜走，另一个人赶车急走；两种都突出离开这一行为。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become wet from being out in a drizzle.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因身处毛毛雨中而被淋湿。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jixxarrab bix-xita ħafifa.

sense_translations.en_definition: to get wet in a drizzle
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被毛毛雨淋湿；在细雨中弄湿身子。

collocations.en: got wet in a drizzle during the walk
collocations.zh: 散步时被毛毛雨淋湿了

formal.mt: Il-parteċipant tbexbex waqt il-mixja minħabba x-xita ħafifa li bdiet qabel wasal lura.
formal.en: The participant got wet during the walk because a drizzle began before he returned.
formal.zh: 这名参与者在步行途中被淋湿了，因为他返回前下起了毛毛雨。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mark tbexbex waqt li kien ġej hawn. Pawlu: Mela kien hemm ix-xita? Maja: Iva, ftit xita ħafifa biss.
colloquial.en: Maja: Mark got wet in a drizzle on his way here. Pawlu: Oh, was it raining? Maja: Yes, just a little drizzle.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克来这里的路上被毛毛雨淋湿了。保罗：哦，下雨了吗？玛雅：是啊，只下了一点毛毛雨。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mark tbexbex waqt li kien ġej hawn.
messages.mt_standard: Mark tbexbex waqt li kien ġej hawn.
messages.zh: 马克来这里的路上被毛毛雨淋湿了。
messages.en: Mark got wet in a drizzle on his way here.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 哦，下雨了吗？
messages.en: Oh, was it raining?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 是啊，只下了一点毛毛雨。
messages.en: Yes, just a little drizzle.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象细小雨点慢慢打湿衣服，把这个动词记成“人被毛毛雨淋湿”的过程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The time when daylight first begins to appear in the morning.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 清晨天光刚开始出现的时候，即黎明、破晓。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħin ta' filgħodu meta jibda jidher l-ewwel dawl tal-jum.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 破晓；清晨天色开始发亮的时候。
黎明；晨光初现的时刻。

formal.mt: It-tim beda l-osservazzjoni tal-għasafar mat-tbexbix, hekk kif deher l-ewwel dawl.
formal.en: The team began observing the birds at daybreak, as the first light appeared.
formal.zh: 第一缕晨光出现时，团队在破晓时分开始观察鸟类。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex se nitilqu daqshekk kmieni? Mark: Irrid nasal ħdejn il-baħar qabel it-tbexbix. Maja: Tajjeb, inġib ftit kafè magħna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are we leaving so early? Mark: I want to reach the seaside before dawn. Maja: All right, I'll bring some coffee for us.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们为什么要这么早出发？马克：我想在黎明前到海边。玛雅：好，那我带点咖啡一起去。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们为什么要这么早出发？
messages.en: Why are we leaving so early?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Irrid nasal ħdejn il-baħar qabel it-tbexbix.
messages.mt_standard: Irrid nasal ħdejn il-baħar qabel it-tbexbix.
messages.zh: 我想在黎明前到海边。
messages.en: I want to reach the seaside before dawn.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 好，那我带点咖啡一起去。
messages.en: All right, I'll bring some coffee for us.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象海边天空刚露出第一线光，把名词与“黎明时分”相连，并整块记住 mat-tbexbix。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To open a little or become slightly open, especially of a door or window.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 稍微打开，或变得留有一道缝，尤指门窗。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinfetaħ ftit jew jibqa' kemxejn miftuħ, speċjalment bieb jew tieqa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 稍微打开；开启一道小缝。
变得半掩；呈现未完全关闭的状态。

formal.mt: Matul il-lejl, il-bieb tbexxaq bir-riħ u daħlet arja kiesħa fil-kamra.
formal.en: During the night, the door opened slightly in the wind and cold air entered the room.
formal.zh: 夜里，门被风吹开了一道缝，冷空气进入了房间。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed tidħol arja kiesħa? Pawlu: Il-bieb tbexxaq. Nagħlqu issa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is cold air coming in? Pawlu: The door has come ajar. I'll close it now.
colloquial.zh: Maja：怎么有冷风进来？Pawlu：门开了一道缝。我现在把它关上。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 怎么有冷风进来？
messages.en: Why is cold air coming in?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.zh: 门开了一道缝。我现在把它关上。
messages.en: The door has come ajar. I'll close it now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它配上一幅门只开一道细缝的画面：想到微开或半掩，就回忆 tbexxaq。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To have liquid sprayed or sprinkled onto something repeatedly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 反复受到液体的喷洒或洒淋。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jirċievi raxx ta' likwidu diversi drabi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被反复喷洒；多次受到喷淋。

formal.mt: Waqt il-kura tal-pjanti, il-weraq tbexxex bl-ilma diversi drabi permezz ta' sprejer żgħir.
formal.en: While the plants were being tended, the foliage was sprayed with water several times using a small sprayer.
formal.zh: 养护植物时，叶片用小喷壶反复喷了几次水。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex il-weraq għadu mxarrab? Mark: Tbexxex bl-ilma diversi drabi dalgħodu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why is the foliage still wet? Mark: It was sprayed with water several times this morning.
colloquial.zh: Lara：叶子怎么还湿着？Mark：今天早上反复喷过几次水。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 叶子怎么还湿着？
messages.en: Why is the foliage still wet?

messages.speaker: Mark (园艺爱好者)
messages.zh: 今天早上反复喷过几次水。
messages.en: It was sprayed with water several times this morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象叶片接连被喷壶喷湿，把反复受到喷洒的画面与 tbexxex 一起记住。

gloss_zh: 门窗的微开；使门窗半掩

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of opening a door or window slightly or leaving it ajar.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把门窗稍微打开，或让门窗留有一道缝的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ftuħ ta' bieb jew tieqa ftit biss, jew iż-żamma tagħhom kemxejn miftuħin.

sense_translations.en_definition: opening or leaving ajar (used of a door or window)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 微微打开或保持半掩的行为，用于门或窗。

collocations.en: opening or leaving the door ajar
collocations.zh: 把门微微打开或留一道缝

collocations.en: opening or leaving the window ajar
collocations.zh: 把窗户微微打开或留一道缝

formal.mt: It-tbexxiq tat-tieqa jippermetti li tidħol ftit arja mingħajr ma tinfetaħ it-tieqa kollha.
formal.en: Leaving the window ajar allows a little air to enter without opening the window fully.
formal.zh: 让窗户留一道缝，可以在不完全打开窗户的情况下让少量空气进入。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandi niftaħ it-tieqa kollha? Lara: Le, it-tbexxiq tat-tieqa biżżejjed għalissa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Should I open the window all the way? Lara: No, leaving it ajar is enough for now.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我要把窗户完全打开吗？Lara：不用，暂时留一道缝就够了。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 我要把窗户完全打开吗？
messages.en: Should I open the window all the way?

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 不用，暂时留一道缝就够了。
messages.en: No, leaving it ajar is enough for now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给门窗留缝这个动作贴上名词标签 tbexxiq，并用 tal-bieb 联想门的微开。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of sprinkling liquid, especially water onto plants.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把液体以小水滴的形式洒出或喷出，尤指给植物洒水。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li jinxtered likwidu fi qtar żgħar, speċjalment ilma fuq il-pjanti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 洒水或喷洒，尤指向植物洒水。

formal.mt: Waqt it-tbexxix tal-pjanti, l-ilma tqassam fi qtar żgħar fuq il-weraq.
formal.en: During the sprinkling of the plants, the water was distributed in small droplets over the foliage.
formal.zh: 给植物洒水时，水以细小水滴的形式分布在叶片上。

colloquial.mt: Mark: X'qed tagħmel bl-isprejer? Lara: Qed nagħmel ftit tbexxix bl-ilma fuq il-pjanti.
colloquial.en: Mark: What are you doing with the sprayer? Lara: I'm giving the plants a little sprinkling of water.
colloquial.zh: Mark：你拿喷壶在做什么？Lara：我在给植物稍微喷点水。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 你拿喷壶在做什么？
messages.en: What are you doing with the sprayer?

messages.speaker: Lara (园艺爱好者)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed nagħmel ftit tbexxix bl-ilma fuq il-pjanti.
messages.mt_standard: Qed nagħmel ftit tbexxix bl-ilma fuq il-pjanti.
messages.zh: 我在给植物稍微喷点水。
messages.en: I'm giving the plants a little sprinkling of water.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tbexxix 写在喷壶图旁，记住它是洒水这个行为的名词，可搭配植物和水。

gloss_zh: 变得松软而多肉；身体变得绵软丰腴

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become soft and fleshy in bodily appearance or texture.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体或身体部位变得松软、多肉，呈现绵软丰腴的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir artab u mimli laħam fil-ġisem jew f'parti minnu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得松软而多肉；身体变得绵软丰腴。

collocations.en: his body became soft and fleshy
collocations.zh: 他的身体变得松软而多肉

collocations.en: became soft and fleshy over time
collocations.zh: 随着时间推移变得松软丰腴

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, il-kittieb jiddeskrivi kif ġisem il-karattru tbezzen maż-żmien u tilef id-dehra soda li kellu qabel.
formal.en: In the novel, the writer describes how the character's body became soft and fleshy over time and lost its former firm appearance.
formal.zh: 小说中，作者描写了那个角色的身体如何逐渐变得松软而多肉，失去了从前结实的外观。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser li ġismu tbezzen? Rita: Ifisser li sar aktar artab u mimli laħam.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does it mean that his body tbezzen? Rita: It means that it became softer and fleshier.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：说他的身体 tbezzen 是什么意思？丽塔：意思是他的身体变得更松软、更多肉了。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 说他的身体 tbezzen 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does it mean that his body tbezzen?

messages.speaker: Rita (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li sar aktar artab u mimli laħam.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li sar aktar artab u mimli laħam.
messages.zh: 意思是他的身体变得更松软、更多肉了。
messages.en: It means that it became softer and fleshier.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用身体轮廓由紧实变得松软丰腴的前后对照图记忆，同时抓住松软和多肉两个特点；这是描述变化的动词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity or process of baking bread rolls.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将小面包送入烤炉烤制的活动或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att jew il-proċess li fih jinħmew il-panini fil-forn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小面包的烘烤；烤制小面包的过程。
肿胀，指皮肤的肿起。

formal.mt: Fil-forn tar-raħal, it-tbezzin tal-panini jibda kmieni filgħodu sabiex ikunu lesti għall-ewwel klijenti.
formal.en: At the village bakery, the baking of bread rolls begins early in the morning so that they are ready for the first customers.
formal.zh: 村里的面包店清晨便开始烤制小面包，以便在第一批顾客到来时准备好。

colloquial.mt: Mark: It-tbezzin hawnhekk ifisser il-ħami tal-panini? Rita: Iva; iżda meta nitkellmu fuq il-ġilda, jista' jfisser nefħa.
colloquial.en: Mark: Does tbezzin here mean baking bread rolls? Rita: Yes; but when we are talking about skin, it can mean swelling.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这里的 tbezzin 是指烤小面包吗？丽塔：是的；不过，谈到皮肤时，它也可以指肿胀。

messages.speaker: Mark (学生)
messages.zh: 这里的 tbezzin 是指烤小面包吗？
messages.en: Does tbezzin here mean baking bread rolls?

messages.speaker: Rita (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva; iżda meta nitkellmu fuq il-ġilda, jista' jfisser nefħa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva; iżda meta nitkellmu fuq il-ġilda, jista' jfisser nefħa.
messages.zh: 是的；不过，谈到皮肤时，它也可以指肿胀。
messages.en: Yes; but when we are talking about skin, it can mean swelling.
