cognitive_memory_aid: 做两张独立记忆卡：面包店里烤小面包，身体语境里皮肤肿胀；依靠上下文选义，不把两种意思当作因果关系。

gloss_zh: 受训斥；遭严厉斥责；受到震惊

teaching_sense.en_definition: To receive a reprimand or severe criticism, or to be shocked by something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受到训斥或严厉责备，也可指因某事感到震惊。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġi mwiddeb jew ikkritikat bl-aħrax, jew jieħu skoss qawwi minħabba xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 受到训斥；因行为不当而被责备。
遭到严厉斥责或猛烈批评。
因某事受到震惊；对某事感到惊愕。

formal.mt: L-impjegat tbeżbeż mill-maniġer wara li naqas milli jsegwi l-istruzzjonijiet.
formal.en: The employee was reprimanded by the manager after failing to follow the instructions.
formal.zh: 这名员工因未遵守指示而受到经理训斥。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif ħadha Pawlu l-aħbar? Mark: Tbeżbeż meta semagħha; ma stenniex hekk.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did Pawlu take the news? Mark: He was shocked when he heard it; he hadn't expected that.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Pawlu听到消息后是什么反应？Mark：他听了很震惊，完全没料到会这样。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: Pawlu听到消息后是什么反应？
messages.en: How did Pawlu take the news?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tbeżbeż meta semagħha; ma stenniex hekk.
messages.mt_standard: Tbeżbeż meta semagħha; ma stenniex hekk.
messages.zh: 他听了很震惊，完全没料到会这样。
messages.en: He was shocked when he heard it; he hadn't expected that.

cognitive_memory_aid: 联想一个人听完话后愣住：可能是挨了训，也可能被消息震住，具体含义看语境。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of reprimanding someone or warning them about their conduct or a possible consequence.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 训斥某人，或就其行为及可能后果加以告诫的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed iċanfar lil xi ħadd jew iwissih dwar l-imġiba tiegħu jew konsegwenza possibbli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 训斥某人的行为；对某人加以责备。
警告或告诫某人的行为。

formal.mt: It-tbeżbiż tal-maniġer kien indirizzat lil dawk li ma kinux segwew l-istruzzjonijiet.
formal.en: The manager's reprimand was directed at those who had not followed the instructions.
formal.zh: 经理的训斥针对那些没有遵守指示的人。

colloquial.mt: Pawlu: Għaliex dan it-tbeżbiż kollu? Maja: Għax erġajt ħallejt il-bieb miftuħ.
colloquial.en: Pawlu: Why all this scolding? Maja: Because you left the door open again.
colloquial.zh: Pawlu：怎么训了这么一大通？Maja：因为你又没关门。

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.zh: 怎么训了这么一大通？
messages.en: Why all this scolding?

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 因为你又没关门。
messages.en: Because you left the door open again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把一整段训话想成一个可命名的行为：tbeżbiż 表示训斥或告诫，记住它是名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become excessively soft or mushy as a result of being cooked for too long.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 食物因烹煮时间过长而变得过软或软烂。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jirtab iżżejjed jew isir qisu għaġna minħabba li jkun issajjar għal żmien twil wisq.

sense_translations.en_definition: to become overcooked, going soft as a result
sense_translations.zh_definition: 因煮得过久而变软烂；煮过头。

collocations.en: the rice became mushy from overcooking
collocations.zh: 米饭煮过头而变得软烂

collocations.en: the pasta became too soft from overcooking
collocations.zh: 意大利面煮过头而变得过软

formal.mt: L-għaġin tbeżlak għax baqa' fl-ilma jagħli għal żmien twil wisq.
formal.en: The pasta became mushy because it remained in the boiling water for too long.
formal.zh: 意大利面在沸水中煮得太久，结果变得软烂。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex ir-ross artab daqshekk? Mark: Tbeżlak għax ħallejtu jsajjar wisq.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why is the rice so soft? Mark: It went mushy because I let it cook too long.
colloquial.zh: Lara：米饭怎么这么软？Mark：我让它煮得太久，煮烂了。

messages.speaker: Lara (家人)
messages.zh: 米饭怎么这么软？
messages.en: Why is the rice so soft?

messages.speaker: Mark (做饭的家人)
messages.zh: 我让它煮得太久，煮烂了。
messages.en: It went mushy because I let it cook too long.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象忘记关火的一锅面越煮越烂，用这个变化过程记住动词 tbeżlak。

gloss_zh: 煮得软烂或黏滑的食物

teaching_sense.en_definition: Food that has been overcooked and has become excessively soft, mushy, or slimy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因烹煮过度而变得过软、糊烂或黏滑的食物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikel li jkun issajjar iżżejjed u sar artab ħafna, qisu għaġna jew jiżloq.

sense_translations.en_definition: overcooked food with a soft or slimy consistency
sense_translations.zh_definition: 煮过头而质地软烂或黏滑的食物。

formal.mt: Wara tisjir twil wisq, l-għaġin sar tbeżlik u tilef il-konsistenza tiegħu.
formal.en: After being cooked for too long, the pasta became overcooked mush and lost its texture.
formal.zh: 意大利面煮得太久，成了软烂的一团，失去了原有的口感。

colloquial.mt: Pawlu: Kif ġie l-għaġin? Maja: Ħallejtu wisq fuq in-nar; sar tbeżlik.
colloquial.en: Pawlu: How did the pasta turn out? Maja: I left it on the heat too long; it turned into mush.
colloquial.zh: Pawlu：意大利面煮得怎么样？Maja：我让它在火上煮太久了，已经烂成一团。

messages.speaker: Pawlu (家人)
messages.zh: 意大利面煮得怎么样？
messages.en: How did the pasta turn out?

messages.speaker: Maja (做饭的家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħallejtu wisq fuq in-nar; sar tbeżlik.
messages.mt_standard: Ħallejtu wisq fuq in-nar; sar tbeżlik.
messages.zh: 我让它在火上煮太久了，已经烂成一团。
messages.en: I left it on the heat too long; it turned into mush.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把盘里煮烂的一团食物标作 tbeżlik：这是软烂成品的名词，重点记住食物及其口感。

gloss_zh: 反复被吐唾沫；变得烦躁易怒

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become irritable and easily annoyed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变得烦躁、容易生气或动辄抱怨。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir irritabbli u jiddejjaq jew jirrabja malajr.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 反复被人吐唾沫。
变得烦躁易怒、爱闹脾气。

collocations.en: became peevish after a long wait

formal.mt: Wara sigħat ta' stennija bla mistrieħ, ir-raġel tbeżżaq u beda jilmenta dwar kull ħaġa.
formal.en: After hours of waiting without a break, the man became irritable and began complaining about everything.
formal.zh: 连续等了几个小时又没有休息后，那个男人变得烦躁起来，开始事事抱怨。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Pawlu qed jilmenta dwar kollox illum? Rita: Tbeżżaq għax ma raqadx tajjeb.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is Pawlu complaining about everything today? Rita: He has become irritable because he did not sleep well.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗今天怎么什么都抱怨？丽塔：他没睡好，所以变得烦躁了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Pawlu qed jilmenta dwar kollox illum?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Pawlu qed jilmenta dwar kollox illum?
messages.zh: 保罗今天怎么什么都抱怨？
messages.en: Why is Pawlu complaining about everything today?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 他没睡好，所以变得烦躁了。
messages.en: He has become irritable because he did not sleep well.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅画面分开记忆：一幅是反复被吐唾沫，另一幅是久等后烦躁抱怨；这是两个义项，不要强行合成一个意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To suffer misfortune or have something unfortunate happen to oneself.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 遭遇不幸，或碰上使自己受损、受苦的事情。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tiġrilu xi diżgrazzja jew jgħaddi minn xi ġrajja sfortunata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 遭遇不幸；碰上厄运。

formal.mt: Il-bidwi tbeżżel meta l-maltempata qerdet l-għelieqi tiegħu u ħallietu bla dħul.
formal.en: The farmer suffered misfortune when the storm destroyed his fields and left him without an income.
formal.zh: 暴风雨毁掉了那位农民的田地，使他失去了收入，他因此遭遇了不幸。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif mar il-vjaġġ ta' Pawlu? Rita: Tbeżżel, miskin; tilef il-bagalja u mbagħad marad.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did Pawlu's trip go? Rita: He had bad luck, poor thing; he lost his suitcase and then fell ill.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗这趟旅行怎么样？丽塔：他真倒霉，怪可怜的；先丢了行李箱，接着又病了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗这趟旅行怎么样？
messages.en: How did Pawlu's trip go?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tbeżżel, miskin; tilef il-bagalja u mbagħad marad.
messages.mt_standard: Tbeżżel, miskin; tilef il-bagalja u mbagħad marad.
messages.zh: 他真倒霉，怪可怜的；先丢了行李箱，接着又病了。
messages.en: He had bad luck, poor thing; he lost his suitcase and then fell ill.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象旅行中先丢行李、随后生病，把这个动词记作当事人自己碰上厄运；重点是遭遇不幸，而不是让别人倒霉。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of making someone feel afraid.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人感到害怕的行为，即惊吓或吓唬。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li ġġiegħel lil xi ħadd iħoss il-biża'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 惊吓某人；使某人害怕的行为。

formal.mt: It-tbeżżigħ tat-tfal b'ħsejjes qawwija mhuwiex mod xieraq kif tgħallimhom joqogħdu attenti.
formal.en: Frightening children with loud noises is not an appropriate way to teach them to be careful.
formal.zh: 用巨大的声响吓唬孩子，并不是教他们小心行事的恰当方法。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Se tinħeba wara l-bieb biex tbeżża' lil ħuk? Pawlu: Le, biżżejjed tbeżżigħ għal-lum.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are you going to hide behind the door to scare your brother? Pawlu: No, enough scaring people for today.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你要躲到门后面吓你弟弟吗？保罗：不了，今天已经吓唬够了。

messages.speaker: Maja (姐姐)
messages.mt_spoken: Se tinħeba wara l-bieb biex tbeżża' lil ħuk?
messages.mt_standard: Se tinħeba wara l-bieb biex tbeżża' lil ħuk?
messages.zh: 你要躲到门后面吓你弟弟吗？
messages.en: Are you going to hide behind the door to scare your brother?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (弟弟)
messages.zh: 不了，今天已经吓唬够了。
messages.en: No, enough scaring people for today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它配上躲在门后突然吓人的画面，记住这是吓唬这个行为的名词，不是被吓到的人，也不是害怕的情绪本身。

gloss_zh: 使人遭遇不幸的行为；给人招致祸患

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of causing someone to suffer misfortune.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使别人遭遇不幸或给别人带来祸患的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li ġġib sfortuna jew xi diżgrazzja fuq xi ħadd.

sense_translations.en_definition: the act of causing sb. misfortune
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某人遭遇不幸、给某人招致祸患的行为。

collocations.en: the act of bringing misfortune upon others
collocations.zh: 给他人招致不幸的行为
故意使人遭遇不幸的行为

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, it-tbeżżil ta' ħaddieħor jidher fl-għemil tal-karattru li jeqred l-għodda tal-ġar u jħallih bla xogħol.
formal.en: In the story, causing others misfortune is illustrated by the character who destroys his neighbour's tools and leaves him without work.
formal.zh: 故事中，那个角色毁坏邻居的工具，使邻居失去工作，体现了给别人招致不幸的行为。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser tbeżżil f'dan ir-rakkont? Rita: Li ġġib sfortuna fuq xi ħadd, bħal meta l-karattru jeqred l-għodda tal-ġar.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does tbeżżil mean in this story? Rita: Bringing misfortune upon someone, as when the character destroys his neighbour's tools.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这篇故事里的 tbeżżil 是什么意思？丽塔：就是给别人带来不幸，比如那个角色毁掉邻居工具的行为。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 这篇故事里的 tbeżżil 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does tbeżżil mean in this story?

messages.speaker: Rita (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Li ġġib sfortuna fuq xi ħadd, bħal meta l-karattru jeqred l-għodda tal-ġar.
messages.mt_standard: Li ġġib sfortuna fuq xi ħadd, bħal meta l-karattru jeqred l-għodda tal-ġar.
messages.zh: 就是给别人带来不幸，比如那个角色毁掉邻居工具的行为。
messages.en: Bringing misfortune upon someone, as when the character destroys his neighbour's tools.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用箭头从造成祸患的人指向受害者，帮助记住它表示给别人带来不幸的行为；与自己遭遇不幸的 tbeżżel 分开记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of expelling saliva from the mouth.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把唾液从口中吐出的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li toħroġ il-bżieq minn ħalqek billi tobżoq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 吐唾沫；吐口水。

formal.mt: Ir-regolamenti tal-faċilità jipprojbixxu t-tbeżżiq fl-art u jitolbu lill-viżitaturi jżommu l-post nadif.
formal.en: The facility's regulations prohibit spitting on the ground and ask visitors to keep the premises clean.
formal.zh: 该场所的规定禁止随地吐口水，并要求访客保持环境清洁。

colloquial.mt: Mark: X'jgħid dak l-avviż ħdejn il-bieb? Rita: Li t-tbeżżiq fl-art huwa pprojbit.
colloquial.en: Mark: What does that notice by the door say? Rita: That spitting on the ground is prohibited.
colloquial.zh: 马克：门边那张告示写了什么？丽塔：上面说禁止随地吐口水。

messages.speaker: Mark (访客)
messages.zh: 门边那张告示写了什么？
messages.en: What does that notice by the door say?

messages.speaker: Rita (工作人员)
messages.zh: 上面说禁止随地吐口水。
messages.en: That spitting on the ground is prohibited.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象公共场所一张禁止吐口水的告示，把这个词和吐出的动作相连；它是行为名词，不是唾液这种物质的名称。

gloss_zh: 开始表现得像野兽；变得粗野蛮横

teaching_sense.en_definition: To begin behaving in a beastly, brutally rough, or animal-like manner.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 开始表现得像野兽一样，行为变得粗暴、蛮横或失去克制。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jibda jġib ruħu bħal bhima, b'mod feroċi jew bla rażan.

sense_translations.en_definition: to start behaving in an animal-like or beastly fashion
sense_translations.zh_definition: 开始像动物或野兽一样行事；行为变得粗野蛮横。

collocations.en: began behaving like a beast during the fight
collocations.zh: 在打斗中开始像野兽一样行事

collocations.en: became beastly and started smashing things
collocations.zh: 变得粗野失控，开始砸东西

formal.mt: Fl-aħħar xena tad-dramm, il-karattru tbhejjem u beda jkisser l-għamara, filwaqt li l-oħrajn ippruvaw jikkalmawh.
formal.en: In the final scene of the play, the character began behaving like a beast and smashing the furniture while the others tried to calm him down.
formal.zh: 在戏剧的最后一幕中，那个角色开始像野兽般失控，动手砸家具，其他人则试图让他冷静下来。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'ġara lill-karattru fl-aħħar xena? Rita: Tbhejjem; beda jgħajjat u jkisser is-siġġijiet.
colloquial.en: Maja: What happened to the character in the final scene? Rita: He became beastly; he started shouting and smashing the chairs.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：最后一幕里那个角色怎么了？丽塔：他像野兽一样失控了，开始大喊大叫，还砸起了椅子。

messages.speaker: Maja (观众)
messages.zh: 最后一幕里那个角色怎么了？
messages.en: What happened to the character in the final scene?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tbhejjem; beda jgħajjat u jkisser is-siġġijiet.
messages.mt_standard: Tbhejjem; beda jgħajjat u jkisser is-siġġijiet.
messages.zh: 他像野兽一样失控了，开始大喊大叫，还砸起了椅子。
messages.en: He became beastly; he started shouting and smashing the chairs.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象戏中人物突然失去克制，大吼并砸椅子，把这个词记作开始像野兽般行事；重点是行为变化，不是身体变成动物。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be made to flow over a container's edge or to be spilled out of it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指液体受到外力或其他作用，从容器边缘溢出或被洒出来。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitwassab likwidu 'l barra minn reċipjent jew minn fuq ix-xifer tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被弄得溢出容器边缘
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jitwassab likwidu minn fuq ix-xifer ta' reċipjent.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被洒出；被泼洒出来

collocations.en: The water was spilled onto the floor.

formal.mt: Meta l-kontenitur inqaleb, il-likwidu tbidded fuq il-mejda.
formal.en: When the container tipped over, the liquid was spilled onto the table.
formal.zh: 容器翻倒时，里面的液体洒到了桌上。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex hemm il-ħalib fuq il-mejda? Ben: It-tazza nqalbet u l-ħalib tbidded.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why is there milk on the table? Ben: The cup tipped over and the milk spilled.
colloquial.zh: Anna：桌上怎么有牛奶？Ben：杯子倒了，牛奶洒出来了。

messages.speaker: Anna (室友)
messages.zh: 桌上怎么有牛奶？
messages.en: Why is there milk on the table?

messages.speaker: Ben (室友)
messages.zh: 杯子倒了，牛奶洒出来了。
messages.en: The cup tipped over and the milk spilled.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象杯子一倒，液体越过杯沿流到桌上：用这个动作画面记住 tbidded 的溢出和洒出两义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be altered, replaced, or exchanged for something else.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某物被改动、替换，或被拿去换成另一个东西。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinbidel xi ħaġa, jew tingħata ħaġa minflok oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被改变；被改动或更换
被交换；被换成另一个东西

collocations.en: The shirt was exchanged for another one.
collocations.zh: 这件衬衫被换成了另一件。

formal.mt: Il-ħin tal-laqgħa tbiddel mid-disgħa għall-għaxra.
formal.en: The meeting time was changed from nine to ten.
formal.zh: 会议时间从九点改到了十点。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Il-flokk tbiddel ma' wieħed akbar? Mark: Iva, u dan joqgħodni sew.
colloquial.en: Lina: Was the shirt exchanged for a larger one? Mark: Yes, and this one fits me well.
colloquial.zh: Lina：衬衫换成大一号的了吗？Mark：换了，这件很合身。

messages.speaker: Lina (陪同购物的朋友)
messages.zh: 衬衫换成大一号的了吗？
messages.en: Was the shirt exchanged for a larger one?

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 换了，这件很合身。
messages.en: Yes, and this one fits me well.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个日常画面记 tbiddel：日程被改时间，衣服被换尺码；共同点是原来的东西发生了改变。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Pouring out abundantly or flowing over the edge of a container.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容大量倾泻而出，或多得越过容器边缘而溢出的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li joħroġ bil-kotra jew ifur minn fuq ix-xifer ta' reċipjent.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 大量倾泻而出的；奔涌而出的
满溢的；越过容器边缘而流出的

collocations.zh: 表示倾泻或满溢状态的词 tbiddid

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, il-kelma 'tbiddid' tiddeskrivi ilma li joħroġ bil-kotra jew ifur minn reċipjent.
formal.en: In this exercise, the word 'tbiddid' describes water pouring out abundantly or overflowing from a container.
formal.zh: 在本练习中，tbiddid 描述水大量倾泻而出或从容器中满溢的状态。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Liema stampa turi t-tifsira ta' 'tbiddid'? David: Dik bil-barmil mimli u l-ilma ħiereġ minn fuq ix-xifer.
colloquial.en: Maja: Which picture shows the meaning of 'tbiddid'? David: The one with the full bucket and water flowing over the edge.
colloquial.zh: Maja：哪张图表现了 tbiddid 的意思？David：水桶装满、水从桶沿流出来的那张。

messages.speaker: Maja (语言课程学生)
messages.zh: 哪张图表现了 tbiddid 的意思？
messages.en: Which picture shows the meaning of 'tbiddid'?

messages.speaker: David (语言课程同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik bil-barmil mimli u l-ilma ħiereġ minn fuq ix-xifer.
messages.mt_standard: Dik bil-barmil mimli u l-ilma ħiereġ minn fuq ix-xifer.
messages.zh: 水桶装满、水从桶沿流出来的那张。
messages.en: The one with the full bucket and water flowing over the edge.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用装得过满的水桶作记忆图：水不断倾泻、越过桶沿，帮助记住 tbiddid 描述的满溢状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or process of changing something or exchanging one thing for another.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 改变或更换某物的行为，也指用一个东西换取另一个东西的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni jew il-proċess li bih tinbidel xi ħaġa jew tingħata ħaġa minflok oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 改变或更换某物的行为、过程
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li biha tinbidel xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 交换；以一物换另一物的行为、过程

formal.mt: It-tbiddil tal-ħin tal-laqgħa ġie kkomunikat lill-parteċipanti permezz ta' ittra.
formal.en: The change to the meeting time was communicated to the participants by letter.
formal.zh: 会议时间的更改已通过信函通知各位参与者。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Meta se jsir it-tbiddil ta' rigali? Pawlu: Wara l-ikel, meta jkun wasal kulħadd.
colloquial.en: Elena: When will the gift exchange take place? Pawlu: After the meal, once everyone has arrived.
colloquial.zh: Elena：什么时候交换礼物？Pawlu：吃完饭，等大家都到了以后。

messages.speaker: Elena (聚会参加者)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta se jsir it-tbiddil ta' rigali?
messages.mt_standard: Meta se jsir it-tbiddil ta' rigali?
messages.zh: 什么时候交换礼物？
messages.en: When will the gift exchange take place?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (聚会组织者)
messages.mt_spoken: Wara l-ikel, meta jkun wasal kulħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Wara l-ikel, meta jkun wasal kulħadd.
messages.zh: 吃完饭，等大家都到了以后。
messages.en: After the meal, once everyone has arrived.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tbiddil 记成活动名称：改会议时间是改变，互送并交换礼物是交换；两种语境都在谈这一过程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be exchanged for another item or replacement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指某物被拿来交换，或被另一件物品替换。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li oġġett jingħata u jittieħed oġġett ieħor minfloku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被交换；被换成另一件物品。

collocations.en: was exchanged for a new one
was exchanged for a larger size

formal.mt: Il-prodott difettuż tbiedel ma' wieħed ġdid wara li l-klijent ippreżenta l-irċevuta.
formal.en: The defective product was exchanged for a new one after the customer presented the receipt.
formal.zh: 顾客出示收据后，有缺陷的商品被换成了一件新品。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-flokk kien żgħir wisq? Mark: Iva, imma tbiedel għal daqs akbar fil-ħanut.
colloquial.en: Maja: Was the shirt too small? Mark: Yes, but it was exchanged for a larger size at the shop.
colloquial.zh: Maja：那件上衣太小了吗？Mark：对，不过已经在店里换成大一码的了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 那件上衣太小了吗？
messages.en: Was the shirt too small?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma tbiedel għal daqs akbar fil-ħanut.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma tbiedel għal daqs akbar fil-ħanut.
messages.zh: 对，不过已经在店里换成大一码的了。
messages.en: Yes, but it was exchanged for a larger size at the shop.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象拿着收据换上衣：旧件交回，新件拿来，用这个交换画面记住“被换成”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To feel hatred toward one another.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指双方或多方彼此怀有憎恨、互相仇视。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li żewġ persuni jew aktar iħossu mibegħda lejn xulxin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 彼此产生或怀有憎恨；互相仇视。

collocations.en: came to hate each other after an argument
came to hate each other because of jealousy

formal.mt: Iż-żewġ aħwa tbiegħdu wara t-tilwima dwar il-wirt u għal snin sħaħ ħassew mibegħda lejn xulxin.
formal.en: The two siblings came to hate each other after the dispute over the inheritance and felt mutual hatred for years.
formal.zh: 这对兄弟姐妹在遗产争议后彼此生恨，多年来一直互相仇视。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex Mark u Pawlu ma jitkellmux? Nina: Tbiegħdu wara dik it-tilwima u issa jobogħdu lil xulxin.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why don't Mark and Pawlu speak to each other? Nina: They came to hate each other after that argument, and now they hate one another.
colloquial.zh: Lara：Mark和Pawlu为什么互不说话？Nina：他们在那次争吵后彼此生恨，现在互相憎恨。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Mark u Pawlu ma jitkellmux?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Mark u Pawlu ma jitkellmux?
messages.zh: Mark和Pawlu为什么互不说话？
messages.en: Why don't Mark and Pawlu speak to each other?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tbiegħdu wara dik it-tilwima u issa jobogħdu lil xulxin.
messages.mt_standard: Tbiegħdu wara dik it-tilwima u issa jobogħdu lil xulxin.
messages.zh: 他们在那次争吵后彼此生恨，现在互相憎恨。
messages.en: They came to hate each other after that argument, and now they hate one another.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把词尾的a当作个人记忆标签，联想双方争吵后互相仇视；与表示保持距离的tbiegħed对照记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To keep oneself away from someone or something, or to hold someone or something at a distance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指自己与某人或某物保持距离，也可指使某人或某物保持在一定距离之外。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li wieħed iżomm ruħu 'l bogħod minn xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa, jew iżomm lil xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa f'distanza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 自己保持距离；与某人或某物保持一定距离。
使某人或某物保持在一定距离之外；保持疏远。

collocations.en: kept his distance from the crowd

formal.mt: L-osservatur tbiegħed mill-folla sabiex ikun jista' jara x'kien qed jiġri.
formal.en: The observer kept his distance from the crowd so that he could see what was happening.
formal.zh: 观察员与人群保持距离，以便看清正在发生的事情。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex Ġanni tbiegħed min-nar? Luqa: Għax kien qed iħoss wisq sħana.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did Ġanni move away from the fire? Luqa: Because he was feeling too hot.
colloquial.zh: Sara：Ġanni为什么离火远了一些？Luqa：因为他觉得太热了。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: Ġanni为什么离火远了一些？
messages.en: Why did Ġanni move away from the fire?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax kien qed iħoss wisq sħana.
messages.mt_standard: Għax kien qed iħoss wisq sħana.
messages.zh: 因为他觉得太热了。
messages.en: Because he was feeling too hot.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象人在火堆旁后退一步，留出空隙：自己保持距离，也可让别人或物品保持距离。

gloss_zh: 举止粗野如兽；表现得野蛮

teaching_sense.en_definition: To behave in a beastly or animal-like way, showing roughness or a lack of restraint.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指行为粗野、缺乏克制，表现得如同野兽一般。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li wieħed iġib ruħu bħal bhima, b'mod goff jew bla rażan.

sense_translations.en_definition: to behave in an animal-like or beastly fashion
sense_translations.zh_definition: 举止如同动物或野兽一般；表现得粗野、野蛮。

collocations.en: behaved like a beast in anger
collocations.zh: 因愤怒而表现得粗暴如兽

collocations.en: behaved in a beastly manner during the argument

formal.mt: Il-karattru fir-rakkont tbiehem bir-rabja, beda jgħajjat u kisser is-siġġu.
formal.en: The character in the story behaved like a beast in anger, started shouting, and broke the chair.
formal.zh: 故事中的人物怒得举止如兽，开始大喊大叫，还砸坏了椅子。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'ġara lil dak ir-raġel fil-film? Ben: Tbiehem bir-rabja u beda jkisser kollox.
colloquial.en: Maja: What happened to that man in the film? Ben: He behaved like a beast in anger and started smashing everything.
colloquial.zh: Maja：电影里那个男人怎么了？Ben：他气得举止如兽，开始乱砸东西。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 电影里那个男人怎么了？
messages.en: What happened to that man in the film?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tbiehem bir-rabja u beda jkisser kollox.
messages.mt_standard: Tbiehem bir-rabja u beda jkisser kollox.
messages.zh: 他气得举止如兽，开始乱砸东西。
messages.en: He behaved like a beast in anger and started smashing everything.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用电影中人物怒吼砸椅子的画面记忆，重点是人的行为变得粗野，而不是身体变成动物。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To receive a blessing; in a separate sense, to be cursed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指受到祝福；另有受到诅咒的义项，理解时须根据具体语境区分。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li wieħed jirċievi barka; f'tifsira oħra, li wieħed jiġi misħut.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 受到祝福；获得祝祷。
受到诅咒；被咒骂。

collocations.zh: 在旅途开始前受到祝福

formal.mt: Il-pellegrin tbierek mill-qassis qabel ma beda l-vjaġġ tiegħu.
formal.en: The pilgrim was blessed by the priest before beginning his journey.
formal.zh: 朝圣者在启程前接受了神父的祝福。

colloquial.mt: Lara: F'din is-sentenza, 'tbierek' tfisser li rċieva barka? Marija: Le, hawn tfisser li ġie misħut.
colloquial.en: Lara: In this sentence, does 'tbierek' mean that he received a blessing? Marija: No, here it means that he was cursed.
colloquial.zh: Lara：在这个句子里，tbierek是说他受到了祝福吗？Marija：不是，这里是说他受到了诅咒。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: F'din is-sentenza, 'tbierek' tfisser li rċieva barka?
messages.mt_standard: F'din is-sentenza, 'tbierek' tfisser li rċieva barka?
messages.zh: 在这个句子里，tbierek是说他受到了祝福吗？
messages.en: In this sentence, does 'tbierek' mean that he received a blessing?

messages.speaker: Marija (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, hawn tfisser li ġie misħut.
messages.mt_standard: Le, hawn tfisser li ġie misħut.
messages.zh: 不是，这里是说他受到了诅咒。
messages.en: No, here it means that he was cursed.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画两张语境卡，一张写祝福、一张写诅咒；同一个词分开记义，再用上下文决定选哪张。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process or activity of producing text or images on paper by printing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指通过印刷在纸张上制作文字或图像的过程或活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih jiġu prodotti kliem jew stampi fuq il-karta permezz ta' magna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 印刷；把文字或图像印到纸张上的制作过程。

formal.mt: It-tbigħ tal-kotba jibda wara li jiġu approvati t-test u l-istampi.
formal.en: The printing of the books begins after the text and images have been approved.
formal.zh: 文字和图像获得批准后，书籍的印刷工作开始。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-kotba lesti? Mark: Għadhom le; it-tbigħ jibda għada.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are the books ready? Mark: Not yet; printing starts tomorrow.
colloquial.zh: Maja：书做好了吗？Mark：还没有，明天才开始印刷。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.zh: 书做好了吗？
messages.en: Are the books ready?

messages.speaker: Mark (印刷店店员)
messages.zh: 还没有，明天才开始印刷。
messages.en: Not yet; printing starts tomorrow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象印刷机吐出一页页书稿，把本条tbigħ与“书籍印刷”整组记忆，并在词卡上标明名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of bringing other people's hatred upon oneself through one's actions or words.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因自己的行为或言语而招致他人憎恨的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li bih wieħed jiġbed fuqu l-mibegħda ta' ħaddieħor permezz ta' għemilu jew kliemu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 招致他人憎恨的行为。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed jiġbed fuqu l-mibegħda ta' ħaddieħor.

collocations.en: incurring hatred because of cruel actions
collocations.zh: 因残酷行为而招致憎恨

formal.mt: Fl-analiżi tal-imġiba tiegħu, it-tbigħid ġie marbut mal-insulti ripetuti lejn il-ġirien.
formal.en: In the analysis of his behaviour, his incurring hatred was linked to repeated insults against the neighbours.
formal.zh: 在对其行为的分析中，他招致他人憎恨一事被归因于他反复辱骂邻居。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'ifisser 'tbigħid' hawn? Mark: Ifisser li wieħed jiġbed fuqu l-mibegħda ta' ħaddieħor, bħal meta jibqa' jinsulta lin-nies.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'tbigħid' mean here? Mark: It means bringing other people's hatred upon yourself, as when you keep insulting people.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这里的“tbigħid”是什么意思？马克：意思是招致别人的憎恨，比如不停地辱骂别人。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这里的“tbigħid”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'tbigħid' mean here?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li wieħed jiġbed fuqu l-mibegħda ta' ħaddieħor, bħal meta jibqa' jinsulta lin-nies.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li wieħed jiġbed fuqu l-mibegħda ta' ħaddieħor, bħal meta jibqa' jinsulta lin-nies.
messages.zh: 意思是招致别人的憎恨，比如不停地辱骂别人。
messages.en: It means bringing other people's hatred upon yourself, as when you keep insulting people.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人反复出言伤人，周围的人逐渐对他产生憎恨；把这个“惹来憎恨”的过程与本词相连。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of grinding a substance until it becomes powder.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某种物质研磨成粉末的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih materjal jintaħan sakemm isir trab.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 将物质磨成粉末；研粉。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-tħin ta' materjal sakemm isir trab.

formal.mt: It-tbik tal-ħwawar għandu jkompli sakemm jinkiseb trab fin.
formal.en: The grinding of the spices should continue until a fine powder is obtained.
formal.zh: 应继续研磨香料，直到得到细粉。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Lest it-tbik tal-ħwawar? Ġanni: Kważi, imma għad fadal ftit biċċiet kbar.
colloquial.en: Marija: Have you finished grinding the spices into powder? Ġanni: Almost, but there are still a few large pieces left.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：香料磨成粉了吗？詹尼：快了，不过还剩几块比较大的。

messages.speaker: Marija (厨师)
messages.zh: 香料磨成粉了吗？
messages.en: Have you finished grinding the spices into powder?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (厨房助手)
messages.mt_spoken: Kważi, imma għad fadal ftit biċċiet kbar.
messages.mt_standard: Kważi, imma għad fadal ftit biċċiet kbar.
messages.zh: 快了，不过还剩几块比较大的。
messages.en: Almost, but there are still a few large pieces left.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把完整香料放进研钵，想象颗粒逐渐变成细粉；用“最后成为粉末”这个结果来记住本词。

gloss_zh: 惊呆；说不出话；变得不能说话

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become unable to speak, especially because of surprise or strong emotion.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变得说不出话，尤指因惊讶或强烈情绪而一时无言。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ma jibqax jista' jitkellem, speċjalment minħabba sorpriża jew emozzjoni qawwija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 惊呆；震惊得不知说什么。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jibqa' mistagħġeb tant li ma jkunx jaf x'se jgħid.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 因某事而说不出话；一时无言以对。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jibqa' bla kliem minħabba xi ħaġa li tiġri jew li jisma'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得不能说话；失去说话能力。

collocations.en: was left speechless by the beauty

formal.mt: Meta tħabbar ir-riżultat, ir-rebbieħ tbikkem għal ftit mumenti qabel irringrazzja lill-ġurija.
formal.en: When the result was announced, the winner was speechless for a few moments before thanking the jury.
formal.zh: 结果公布时，获奖者一时说不出话，过了片刻才向评审团致谢。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif irreaġixxa ħuk meta ra r-rigal? Luqa: Tbikkem! Imbagħad għannaqni u qalli grazzi.
colloquial.en: Sara: How did your brother react when he saw the present? Luqa: He was speechless! Then he hugged me and thanked me.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你哥哥看到礼物时是什么反应？卢卡：他惊讶得说不出话！然后抱了抱我，向我道谢。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif irreaġixxa ħuk meta ra r-rigal?
messages.mt_standard: Kif irreaġixxa ħuk meta ra r-rigal?
messages.zh: 你哥哥看到礼物时是什么反应？
messages.en: How did your brother react when he saw the present?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tbikkem! Imbagħad għannaqni u qalli grazzi.
messages.mt_standard: Tbikkem! Imbagħad għannaqni u qalli grazzi.
messages.zh: 他惊讶得说不出话！然后抱了抱我，向我道谢。
messages.en: He was speechless! Then he hugged me and thanked me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象收到意外礼物后张着嘴却发不出话，先记住“变得说不出话”；再按语境区分惊呆、一时无言和失去说话能力。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The state of being unable to speak or find words, for example because of strong emotion.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 无法开口或找不到话语表达的状态，例如因强烈情绪而一时无言。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-istat li fih wieħed ma jkunx jista' jitkellem jew ma jsibx kliem, pereżempju minħabba emozzjoni qawwija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 说不出话；无言的状态。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-istat li wieħed ikun bla kliem jew ma jkunx jista' jitkellem.

formal.mt: It-tbikkim tal-udjenza wara x-xena finali wera kemm kienet qawwija l-emozzjoni.
formal.en: The audience's speechlessness after the final scene showed how powerful the emotion was.
formal.zh: 最后一幕结束后，观众久久无言，显现出情绪的强烈程度。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex ktibt 'tbikkim' fid-deskrizzjoni tiegħu? Adam: Għax kien tant sorpriż li għal mument ma seta' jgħid xejn.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why did you write 'speechlessness' in your description of him? Adam: Because he was so surprised that for a moment he could not say anything.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你为什么在描写他时用了“无言”这个词？亚当：因为他太惊讶了，一时间什么也说不出来。

messages.speaker: Nina (写作课同学)
messages.zh: 你为什么在描写他时用了“无言”这个词？
messages.en: Why did you write 'speechlessness' in your description of him?

messages.speaker: Adam (写作课同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax kien tant sorpriż li għal mument ma seta' jgħid xejn.
messages.mt_standard: Għax kien tant sorpriż li għal mument ma seta' jgħid xejn.
messages.zh: 因为他太惊讶了，一时间什么也说不出来。
messages.en: Because he was so surprised that for a moment he could not say anything.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把镜头定格在人物想说却说不出话的一刻：tbikkim 是这种“无言状态”的名称，可与动词 tbikkem 对照记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of shutting something firmly so that it is tightly closed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某物牢牢关上，使其处于紧闭状态的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed jagħlaq xi ħaġa sewwa biex tibqa' magħluqa sew.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 关紧；使某物紧密关闭。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-għeluq ta' xi ħaġa b'mod li tkun magħluqa sew.

formal.mt: Wara l-mili tal-kontenitur, it-tbiq tal-għatu għandu jsir b'attenzjoni biex il-likwidu ma jnixxix.
formal.en: After the container is filled, the lid should be shut tight with care to prevent the liquid from leaking.
formal.zh: 容器装满后，应仔细盖紧盖子，防止液体渗漏。

colloquial.mt: Rita: X'ifisser 'tbiq tal-għatu' f'dawn l-istruzzjonijiet? Toni: Li tagħlaq l-għatu sew, biex ma joħroġ xejn.
colloquial.en: Rita: What does 'shutting the lid tight' mean in these instructions? Toni: Closing the lid firmly so that nothing comes out.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：说明里的“把盖子盖紧”是什么意思？托尼：就是把盖子牢牢盖好，让里面的东西漏不出来。

messages.speaker: Rita (室友)
messages.zh: 说明里的“把盖子盖紧”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'shutting the lid tight' mean in these instructions?

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Li tagħlaq l-għatu sew, biex ma joħroġ xejn.
messages.mt_standard: Li tagħlaq l-għatu sew, biex ma joħroġ xejn.
messages.zh: 就是把盖子牢牢盖好，让里面的东西漏不出来。
messages.en: Closing the lid firmly so that nothing comes out.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把盖子压到完全贴合、瓶内液体不再漏出的动作；抓住“紧”字，把本词记作关紧或盖紧的过程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of smiling, the act of making someone smile, or a smile itself.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 微笑的动作、使别人微笑的行为，或呈现出来的笑容。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed jitbissem, l-att li wieħed iġiegħel lil xi ħadd jitbissem, jew it-tbissima nnifisha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 微笑这一动作或活动。
使某人微笑；逗人露出笑容。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed iġiegħel lil xi ħadd jitbissem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 微笑；脸上呈现的笑容。

collocations.en: a smile on the boy's face

formal.mt: It-tbissim tal-mistednin waqt il-laqgħa ta merħba ħoloq atmosfera ta' ħbiberija.
formal.en: The guests' smiling during the welcome meeting created a friendly atmosphere.
formal.zh: 欢迎会上宾客们的微笑营造了友好的氛围。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Rajt dak it-tbissim fuq wiċċ it-tifel? Ben: Iva, feraħ ħafna meta tajnieh il-ktieb.
colloquial.en: Elena: Did you see that smile on the boy's face? Ben: Yes, he was very happy when we gave him the book.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：你看到男孩脸上的笑容了吗？本：看到了，我们把书送给他时，他特别高兴。

messages.speaker: Elena (志愿者)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajt dak it-tbissim fuq wiċċ it-tifel?
messages.mt_standard: Rajt dak it-tbissim fuq wiċċ it-tifel?
messages.zh: 你看到男孩脸上的笑容了吗？
messages.en: Did you see that smile on the boy's face?

messages.speaker: Ben (志愿者)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, feraħ ħafna meta tajnieh il-ktieb.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, feraħ ħafna meta tajnieh il-ktieb.
messages.zh: 看到了，我们把书送给他时，他特别高兴。
messages.en: Yes, he was very happy when we gave him the book.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三幅连续画面记三个义项：自己微笑、逗别人微笑、看到脸上的笑容；分别对应动作、使人产生动作和表情本身。

gloss_zh: 卷入有损自身处境的事情

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become involved in a situation that puts one's reputation or position at risk.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 卷入使自己的名誉或地位受到威胁、令人难堪的处境。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jidħol f'sitwazzjoni li tista' tagħmel ħsara lir-reputazzjoni jew lill-pożizzjoni tiegħu.

sense_translations.en_definition: to become involved in a compromising situation
sense_translations.zh_definition: 卷入有损自身名誉、地位或体面的处境。

collocations.en: became involved in a suspicious affair

formal.mt: L-uffiċjal tbixkel f'affari suspettuża li għamlet ħsara lir-reputazzjoni tiegħu.
formal.en: The official became involved in a suspicious affair that damaged his reputation.
formal.zh: 这名官员卷入一桩可疑事件，名誉因此受损。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Pawlu jinsab inkwetat? Lara: Tbixkel f'affari suspettuża u issa jrid jagħti spjegazzjoni.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is Pawlu worried? Lara: He got involved in a suspicious affair and now has to explain himself.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗为什么这么担心？拉拉：他卷入了一桩可疑事件，现在得作出解释。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗为什么这么担心？
messages.en: Why is Pawlu worried?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tbixkel f'affari suspettuża u issa jrid jagħti spjegazzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Tbixkel f'affari suspettuża u issa jrid jagħti spjegazzjoni.
messages.zh: 他卷入了一桩可疑事件，现在得作出解释。
messages.en: He got involved in a suspicious affair and now has to explain himself.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人被卷进可疑事件，越解释越难堪；用“卷入麻烦处境”的画面记住这个动词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The entwining of things around one another; also, cheating or deceptive conduct.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 事物彼此缠绕的过程或状态；也指欺骗、作弊的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-tgeżwir ta' affarijiet ma' xulxin; ukoll, qerq jew imġiba qarrieqa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 缠绕；使事物彼此交缠的过程或状态。
欺骗；通过不诚实的手段作弊。

formal.mt: It-tbixkil tal-friegħi ma' xulxin ħoloq barriera naturali tul il-mogħdija.
formal.en: The entwining of the branches created a natural barrier along the path.
formal.zh: 树枝彼此缠绕，在小径沿线形成了一道天然屏障。

colloquial.mt: Mark: It-tbixkil fil-logħob iħassar il-gost. Nina: Naqbel, ejja nilagħbu skont ir-regoli.
colloquial.en: Mark: Cheating in games spoils the fun. Nina: I agree; let's play by the rules.
colloquial.zh: 马克：玩游戏作弊会破坏乐趣。妮娜：同意，咱们按规则玩吧。

messages.speaker: Mark (玩伴)
messages.zh: 玩游戏作弊会破坏乐趣。
messages.en: Cheating in games spoils the fun.

messages.speaker: Nina (玩伴)
messages.zh: 同意，咱们按规则玩吧。
messages.en: I agree; let's play by the rules.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅独立画面记两个义项：一幅是线条相互缠绕，另一幅是玩家偷偷作弊；不要把两个意思混成一个。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be slaughtered, or to have one's appearance badly damaged.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指动物被宰杀，也可指人的容貌受到严重毁损。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinqatel annimal għall-laħam, jew titħassar serjament id-dehra ta' persuna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被宰杀，通常指动物被杀来取肉
容貌被严重损伤；被毁容

formal.mt: Skont ir-rapport, wiċċ ir-raġel tbiċċer fl-inċident.
formal.en: According to the report, the man's face was disfigured in the accident.
formal.zh: 报告指出，该男子的面容在事故中遭到了毁损。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'ġara lir-raġel fl-istorja? Mark: Wiċċu tbiċċer f'inċident, imma baqa' ħaj.
colloquial.en: Lara: What happened to the man in the story? Mark: His face was disfigured in an accident, but he survived.
colloquial.zh: Lara：故事里的那个男子怎么了？Mark：他在事故中毁了容，但活了下来。

messages.speaker: Lara (读书会成员)
messages.zh: 故事里的那个男子怎么了？
messages.en: What happened to the man in the story?

messages.speaker: Mark (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Wiċċu tbiċċer f'inċident, imma baqa' ħaj.
messages.mt_standard: Wiċċu tbiċċer f'inċident, imma baqa' ħaj.
messages.zh: 他在事故中毁了容，但活了下来。
messages.en: His face was disfigured in an accident, but he survived.

cognitive_memory_aid: 为 tbiċċer 做两张语境卡：动物对应被宰杀，面容对应被毁损；用主语帮助选择词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be cut or chopped into small pieces.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被切或剁成小块，强调东西受到切碎的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinqata' f'biċċiet żgħar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被切碎；被剁成小块

collocations.en: The wood was chopped into pieces.

formal.mt: Il-basal tbiċċeċ f'biċċiet żgħar qabel żdied mas-soppa.
formal.en: The onion was chopped into small pieces before being added to the soup.
formal.zh: 洋葱先被切成小块，再加入汤中。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-basal tbiċċeċ diġà? Pawlu: Iva, issa nistgħu nżiduh mas-soppa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Has the onion been chopped already? Pawlu: Yes, we can add it to the soup now.
colloquial.zh: Maja：洋葱已经切碎了吗？Pawlu：是的，现在可以把它加进汤里了。

messages.speaker: Maja (一起做饭的朋友)
messages.zh: 洋葱已经切碎了吗？
messages.en: Has the onion been chopped already?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (一起做饭的朋友)
messages.zh: 是的，现在可以把它加进汤里了。
messages.en: Yes, we can add it to the soup now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把洋葱从完整到碎块的画面连起来记：tbiċċeċ 表示它被切碎，注意动作承受者是洋葱。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of slaughtering animals or cutting up their bodies for meat.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 宰杀动物，或为取得肉品而分割动物躯体的活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-attività tal-qtil tal-annimali għall-laħam jew tal-qtugħ ta' ġisimhom f'biċċiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 宰杀动物的活动
屠宰并分割动物以取得肉品的活动

formal.mt: Il-kapitlu jiddeskrivi t-tbiċċir tal-annimali u l-preparazzjoni tal-laħam għall-bejgħ.
formal.en: The chapter describes the slaughtering of animals and the preparation of meat for sale.
formal.zh: 本章介绍动物的宰杀以及供销售的肉品的制备。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan il-ktieb jitkellem ukoll dwar it-tbiċċir? Ġużeppi: Iva, u jispjega kif jitħejja l-laħam għall-bejgħ.
colloquial.en: Sara: Does this book also discuss slaughtering? Ġużeppi: Yes, and it explains how meat is prepared for sale.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这本书也讲屠宰吗？Ġużeppi：讲，还解释了如何制备供销售的肉品。

messages.speaker: Sara (烹饪课程学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-ktieb jitkellem ukoll dwar it-tbiċċir?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-ktieb jitkellem ukoll dwar it-tbiċċir?
messages.zh: 这本书也讲屠宰吗？
messages.en: Does this book also discuss slaughtering?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (烹饪课程教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u jispjega kif jitħejja l-laħam għall-bejgħ.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u jispjega kif jitħejja l-laħam għall-bejgħ.
messages.zh: 讲，还解释了如何制备供销售的肉品。
messages.en: Yes, and it explains how meat is prepared for sale.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tbiċċir 放在肉品加工这一场景里记，涵盖宰杀和屠宰分割；与泛指切碎的 tbiċċiċ 对照。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action or process of chopping something into small pieces.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把东西切或剁成小块这一动作或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni jew il-proċess li bih xi ħaġa tinqata' f'biċċiet żgħar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把东西切碎或剁成小块的动作
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-qtugħ ta' xi ħaġa f'biċċiet żgħar.

formal.mt: It-tbiċċiċ tal-ħaxix f'biċċiet żgħar jagħmel it-tisjir aktar mgħaġġel.
formal.en: Chopping vegetables into small pieces makes cooking faster.
formal.zh: 把蔬菜切成小块可以缩短烹饪时间。

colloquial.mt: Nina: It-tbiċċiċ tal-ħaxix jieħu ħafna ħin? Toni: Ftit biss, jekk ikollok sikkina tajba.
colloquial.en: Nina: Does chopping up the vegetables take a long time? Toni: Only a little while, if you have a good knife.
colloquial.zh: Nina：切碎蔬菜很费时间吗？Toni：有一把好刀的话，只要一会儿。

messages.speaker: Nina (学做饭的朋友)
messages.zh: 切碎蔬菜很费时间吗？
messages.en: Does chopping up the vegetables take a long time?

messages.speaker: Toni (教做饭的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ftit biss, jekk ikollok sikkina tajba.
messages.mt_standard: Ftit biss, jekk ikollok sikkina tajba.
messages.zh: 有一把好刀的话，只要一会儿。
messages.en: Only a little while, if you have a good knife.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tbiċċiċ 当作厨房任务名称来记：不是说某物已经碎了，而是在说切碎这项工作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be made less severe, intense, or harsh.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指严重程度、强度或严厉程度有所降低，得到减轻或缓和。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li xi ħaġa ssir inqas ħarxa, inqas qawwija jew inqas gravi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被减轻；得到缓和；严重或严厉程度降低。

formal.mt: Il-kastig tbiġġel wara li tqiesu ċ-ċirkostanzi tal-każ.
formal.en: The punishment was mitigated after the circumstances of the case were considered.
formal.zh: 在考虑了案件的具体情况后，惩罚得到了减轻。

colloquial.mt: Nina: L-uġigħ għadu qawwi? Pawlu: Le, tbiġġel wara ftit mistrieħ.
colloquial.en: Nina: Is the pain still intense? Pawlu: No, it eased after a little rest.
colloquial.zh: Nina：还是很疼吗？Pawlu：没有了，休息了一会儿后缓解了。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 还是很疼吗？
messages.en: Is the pain still intense?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 没有了，休息了一会儿后缓解了。
messages.en: No, it eased after a little rest.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象疼痛刻度从八降到三：事情仍然存在，但程度减轻，用下降的刻度记住这个动词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A reduction in severity or harshness, or leniency shown in treating someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指严重或严厉程度的减轻、缓和，也指对人的宽容或宽大处理。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tnaqqis fil-ħruxija jew fil-gravità ta' xi ħaġa, jew ħniena fit-trattament ta' persuna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 减轻；缓和；降低严重或严厉程度。
宽容；宽大；从轻处理。

formal.mt: Il-kumitat approva t-talba għal tbiġġil tal-kastig wara li eżamina ċ-ċirkostanzi.
formal.en: The committee approved the request for mitigation of the punishment after examining the circumstances.
formal.zh: 委员会审查具体情况后，批准了减轻惩罚的请求。

colloquial.mt: Ben: X'talab l-istudent lill-għalliem? Sara: Talab tbiġġil, għax kienet l-ewwel darba li kiser ir-regola.
colloquial.en: Ben: What did the student ask the teacher for? Sara: He asked for leniency because it was the first time he had broken the rule.
colloquial.zh: Ben：那个学生向老师请求什么？Sara：他请求宽大处理，因为这是他第一次违反规定。

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.zh: 那个学生向老师请求什么？
messages.en: What did the student ask the teacher for?

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Talab tbiġġil, għax kienet l-ewwel darba li kiser ir-regola.
messages.mt_standard: Talab tbiġġil, għax kienet l-ewwel darba li kiser ir-regola.
messages.zh: 他请求宽大处理，因为这是他第一次违反规定。
messages.en: He asked for leniency because it was the first time he had broken the rule.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“减轻惩罚”和“请求宽大”写在同一张名词卡上；与tbiġġel表示“得到减轻”的动作对照记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of preparing food by cooking it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过加热等烹调方式把食材做成食物的活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-attività li biha wieħed jipprepara l-ikel billi jsajru.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 烹饪；做饭。

formal.mt: Il-ħin tat-tbiħ jiddependi mid-daqs tal-biċċiet tal-laħam.
formal.en: The cooking time depends on the size of the pieces of meat.
formal.zh: 烹饪时间取决于肉块的大小。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhu l-ħin tat-tbiħ għal din is-soppa? Pawlu: Madwar nofs siegħa, sakemm il-ħaxix jirtab.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is the cooking time for this soup? Pawlu: About half an hour, until the vegetables soften.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这道汤要煮多久？保罗：大约半小时，煮到蔬菜变软。

messages.speaker: Lara (学做饭的女儿)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhu l-ħin tat-tbiħ għal din is-soppa?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhu l-ħin tat-tbiħ għal din is-soppa?
messages.zh: 这道汤要煮多久？
messages.en: What is the cooking time for this soup?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Madwar nofs siegħa, sakemm il-ħaxix jirtab.
messages.mt_standard: Madwar nofs siegħa, sakemm il-ħaxix jirtab.
messages.zh: 大约半小时，煮到蔬菜变软。
messages.en: About half an hour, until the vegetables soften.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用锅里正在煮汤的画面记忆：本词指“动手烹饪”的活动，可以搭配烹调对象或所需时间。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The style of cooking and characteristic dishes associated with a place or community.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某个地区或群体所具有的烹饪风格及其代表性菜肴。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-istil tat-tisjir u l-platti tipiċi ta' post jew ta' komunità.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 菜系；某地或某个群体的烹饪风格及特色菜肴。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-istil tat-tisjir u l-ikel tipiku ta' post jew ta' komunità.

collocations.zh: 传统菜系；传统烹饪风格

formal.mt: Il-ktieb jippreżenta t-tbiħa Maltija permezz ta' riċetti u deskrizzjonijiet ta' platti tradizzjonali.
formal.en: The book presents Maltese cuisine through recipes and descriptions of traditional dishes.
formal.zh: 这本书通过食谱和传统菜肴的介绍来展现马耳他菜。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Trid tipprova t-tbiħa Maltija llejla? David: Iva! Agħżel post li jservi platti tradizzjonali.
colloquial.en: Anna: Would you like to try Maltese cuisine tonight? David: Yes! Choose a place that serves traditional dishes.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：今晚想尝尝马耳他菜吗？戴维：想！选一家供应传统菜肴的店吧。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 今晚想尝尝马耳他菜吗？
messages.en: Would you like to try Maltese cuisine tonight?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva! Agħżel post li jservi platti tradizzjonali.
messages.mt_standard: Iva! Agħżel post li jservi platti tradizzjonali.
messages.zh: 想！选一家供应传统菜肴的店吧。
messages.en: Yes! Choose a place that serves traditional dishes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象菜单上按地区排列的一整组特色菜，把本词记成“某地的一套风味”；可与表示做饭活动的 tbiħ 对照记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become diligent or hard-working in one's work or studies.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在工作或学习中变得认真勤勉、愿意付出努力。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir aktar bieżel u jagħmel aktar sforz fix-xogħol jew fl-istudju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得勤勉；做事变得认真、用心。
变得勤奋；更加努力、积极地工作。

formal.mt: Wara li stabbilixxa miri ċari, l-istudent tbiżżel fl-istudju u tejjeb ir-riżultati tiegħu.
formal.en: After setting clear goals, the student became diligent in his studies and improved his results.
formal.zh: 设定明确目标后，这名学生学习变得勤奋，成绩也提高了。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Rajt kemm qed jistudja Mark? Lara: Iva, tbiżżel minn meta ddeċieda li jgħaddi mill-eżami.
colloquial.en: Sara: Have you seen how much Mark is studying? Lara: Yes, he became diligent after deciding to pass the exam.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你看到马克现在多用功了吗？拉拉：看到了，他下定决心通过考试后就变勤奋了。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 你看到马克现在多用功了吗？
messages.en: Have you seen how much Mark is studying?

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, tbiżżel minn meta ddeċieda li jgħaddi mill-eżami.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, tbiżżel minn meta ddeċieda li jgħaddi mill-eżami.
messages.zh: 看到了，他下定决心通过考试后就变勤奋了。
messages.en: Yes, he became diligent after deciding to pass the exam.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把画面定在“以前拖拉、现在主动学习”的变化上，记住它强调变得勤奋，而不只是静态地形容勤奋。

gloss_zh: 使人勤奋；促使人勤勉的过程

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of making or encouraging someone to become hard-working.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过鼓励或引导，使某人变得勤奋的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih persuna titħeġġeġ jew titwassal biex issir aktar bieżla.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某人变得勤奋这一过程或作用。

formal.mt: It-tbiżżil tal-istudenti jeħtieġ inkoraġġiment regolari u miri li jistgħu jilħqu.
formal.en: Encouraging students to become hard-working requires regular encouragement and goals they can achieve.
formal.zh: 促使学生变得勤奋，需要经常给予鼓励，并设定他们能够实现的目标。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif sejjer it-tbiżżil ta' Mark fl-istudju? Sara: Qed jgħin ħafna l-inkoraġġiment; issa jibda jistudja minn jeddu.
colloquial.en: Maja: How is getting Mark to become diligent in his studies going? Sara: The encouragement is helping a lot; now he starts studying on his own.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：引导马克勤奋学习这件事进展怎么样？萨拉：鼓励很有帮助，他现在会主动开始学习了。

messages.speaker: Maja (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif sejjer it-tbiżżil ta' Mark fl-istudju?
messages.mt_standard: Kif sejjer it-tbiżżil ta' Mark fl-istudju?
messages.zh: 引导马克勤奋学习这件事进展怎么样？
messages.en: How is getting Mark to become diligent in his studies going?

messages.speaker: Sara (家长)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed jgħin ħafna l-inkoraġġiment; issa jibda jistudja minn jeddu.
messages.mt_standard: Qed jgħin ħafna l-inkoraġġiment; issa jibda jistudja minn jeddu.
messages.zh: 鼓励很有帮助，他现在会主动开始学习了。
messages.en: The encouragement is helping a lot; now he starts studying on his own.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象老师不断鼓励，学生逐渐主动用功；把整个“使人变勤奋的过程”装进一个名词来记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become foolish or lose the ability to judge sensibly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变得糊涂、不明智，或失去原有的理智判断。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir iblah jew jitlef il-ħila li jiġġudika bil-għaqal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得愚蠢、糊涂；开始做出不明智的行为。
失去理智；不再能够作出明智判断。

collocations.en: he seems to have lost his good sense

formal.mt: Ir-rakkont juri kif ir-re tbleħħen u beda jieħu deċiżjonijiet mingħajr ma jaħseb fil-konsegwenzi.
formal.en: The story shows how the king lost his good sense and began making decisions without considering the consequences.
formal.zh: 故事展现了国王如何失去理智，开始不顾后果地作出决定。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Toni jrid jonfoq il-paga kollha fuq logħba waħda. Mark: Donnu tbleħħen! Aħjar nitkellmu miegħu.
colloquial.en: Nina: Toni wants to spend his entire pay on one game. Mark: He seems to have lost his good sense! We'd better talk to him.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：托尼想把全部工资花在一个游戏上。马克：他好像糊涂了！我们最好跟他谈谈。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Toni jrid jonfoq il-paga kollha fuq logħba waħda.
messages.mt_standard: Toni jrid jonfoq il-paga kollha fuq logħba waħda.
messages.zh: 托尼想把全部工资花在一个游戏上。
messages.en: Toni wants to spend his entire pay on one game.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 他好像糊涂了！我们最好跟他谈谈。
messages.en: He seems to have lost his good sense! We'd better talk to him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个原本会权衡后果的人，突然接连作出糊涂决定；用“判断力掉线”的情景记住这个动词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Medicine as the field of studying, preventing, and treating illness.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 研究疾病及其预防、治疗的医学领域，也包括医疗实践。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-qasam tal-istudju, il-prevenzjoni u l-kura tal-mard.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 医学；研究和治疗疾病的学科与医疗实践。

formal.mt: L-istudju tat-tbubija jgħaqqad l-għarfien xjentifiku mal-kura tal-pazjenti.
formal.en: The study of medicine combines scientific knowledge with patient care.
formal.zh: 医学学习将科学知识与患者照护结合起来。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi trid tistudja fl-università? Pawlu: It-tbubija, għax nixtieq insir tabib.
colloquial.en: Lara: What do you want to study at university? Pawlu: Medicine, because I'd like to become a doctor.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你想在大学学什么？保罗：医学，因为我想成为医生。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你想在大学学什么？
messages.en: What do you want to study at university?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (学生)
messages.zh: 医学，因为我想成为医生。
messages.en: Medicine, because I'd like to become a doctor.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象大学里的医学课堂，再接上医生照顾患者的场景；把它记作医学领域和医疗实践。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To produce text or images on paper by printing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过印刷或打印，把文字或图像呈现在纸上。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jipproduċi kliem jew stampi fuq il-karta permezz tal-istampar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 印刷；打印文字或图像。

formal.mt: L-istampatur teba' mitt kopja tal-fuljett għall-konferenza.
formal.en: The printer printed one hundred copies of the leaflet for the conference.
formal.zh: 印刷人员为会议印制了一百份宣传单。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min teba' dawn ir-ritratti? Mark: Pawlu teba' żewġ kopji ta' kull ritratt.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who printed these photos? Mark: Pawlu printed two copies of each photo.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这些照片是谁打印的？马克：保罗打印的，每张都印了两份。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这些照片是谁打印的？
messages.en: Who printed these photos?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu teba' żewġ kopji ta' kull ritratt.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu teba' żewġ kopji ta' kull ritratt.
messages.zh: 保罗打印的，每张都印了两份。
messages.en: Pawlu printed two copies of each photo.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词写在打印机吐出的纸张旁，联想“文字图像印到纸上”；抄写时特别留意词尾的撇号。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To put text or images onto paper through a printing process.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 利用印刷或打印过程，将文字或图像制作到纸上。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iqiegħed kliem jew stampi fuq il-karta permezz ta' proċess ta' stampar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 印刷；打印文字或图像。

formal.mt: L-istampatur tebagħ il-programm tal-laqgħa u ħejja kopja għal kull parteċipant.
formal.en: The printer printed the meeting programme and prepared a copy for each participant.
formal.zh: 印刷人员印制了会议日程，并为每位参会者准备了一份。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Mark tebagħ id-dokument? Nina: Iva, u ħalla l-kopja fuq il-mejda.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did Mark print the document? Nina: Yes, and he left the copy on the table.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：马克打印文件了吗？妮娜：打印了，他把打印件放在桌上了。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 马克打印文件了吗？
messages.en: Did Mark print the document?

messages.speaker: Nina (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u ħalla l-kopja fuq il-mejda.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u ħalla l-kopja fuq il-mejda.
messages.zh: 打印了，他把打印件放在桌上了。
messages.en: Yes, and he left the copy on the table.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“文件从屏幕变成纸张”的画面记住打印义；另做一张拼写卡，完整保留词尾的 għ。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To grind something thoroughly, breaking it down completely through grinding.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某物充分研磨，使其彻底磨碎。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Itħan xi ħaġa sew u għalkollox.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 充分磨碎；彻底研磨

formal.mt: Tebbak il-ħwawar qabel iżżidhom mat-taħlita, sabiex ma jibqgħux biċċiet kbar.
formal.en: Grind the spices thoroughly before adding them to the mixture, so that no large pieces remain.
formal.zh: 将香料充分磨碎后再加入混合物中，确保没有大块残留。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Tebbak il-ħwawar ftit ieħor, jekk jogħġbok. Mark: Għad hemm biċċiet kbar? Maja: Iva, ara hawn.
colloquial.en: Maja: Please grind the spices a little more thoroughly. Mark: Are there still large pieces? Maja: Yes, look here.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：请把香料再磨充分一点。马克：还有大块吗？玛雅：有，你看这里。

messages.speaker: Maja (一起做饭的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tebbak il-ħwawar ftit ieħor, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.mt_standard: Tebbak il-ħwawar ftit ieħor, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.zh: 请把香料再磨充分一点。
messages.en: Please grind the spices a little more thoroughly.

messages.speaker: Mark (一起做饭的朋友)
messages.zh: 还有大块吗？
messages.en: Are there still large pieces?

messages.speaker: Maja (一起做饭的朋友)
messages.zh: 有，你看这里。
messages.en: Yes, look here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tebbak 和“香料磨到没有大块”的画面一起记：重点是研磨充分。可用词尾 k 区别于 tebbaq；这只是拼写记忆提示。

gloss_zh: 平分为两半；分成相等的两份

teaching_sense.en_definition: To divide something into two halves that are equal in size or amount.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某物分成大小或数量相等的两半。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Aqsam xi ħaġa f'żewġ nofsijiet indaqs.

sense_translations.en_definition: to divide into two equal halves
sense_translations.zh_definition: 把某物平分成相等的两半

collocations.en: divide the loaf into two equal halves
collocations.zh: 把一条面包平分成两半

collocations.en: divide the apple into two equal halves

formal.mt: Tebbaq it-tuffieħa u agħti nofs lil kull tifel, sabiex it-tnejn jieħdu l-istess ammont.
formal.en: Divide the apple into two equal halves and give one half to each boy, so that both receive the same amount.
formal.zh: 把苹果平分成两半，给两个男孩各一半，让两人得到相同的分量。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Tebbaq il-ħobża, jekk jogħġbok. Pawlu: Nofs għalik u nofs għalija? Sara: Iva, hekk ikollna l-istess ammont.
colloquial.en: Sara: Please divide the loaf into two equal halves. Pawlu: Half for you and half for me? Sara: Yes, that way we'll have the same amount.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：请把面包平分成两半。保罗：一半给你，一半给我？萨拉：对，这样我们就一样多了。

messages.speaker: Sara (一起吃饭的朋友)
messages.zh: 请把面包平分成两半。
messages.en: Please divide the loaf into two equal halves.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (一起吃饭的朋友)
messages.zh: 一半给你，一半给我？
messages.en: Half for you and half for me?

messages.speaker: Sara (一起吃饭的朋友)
messages.zh: 对，这样我们就一样多了。
messages.en: Yes, that way we'll have the same amount.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tebbaq 和“一个苹果分成相等两半”的画面一起记：既要分成两份，也要两份相等。可用词尾 q 区别于 tebbak；这只是拼写记忆提示。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become straw, as plant material dries.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指植物材料干燥后变成稻草或干草秆。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir tiben, bħall-ħaxix meta jinxef.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变成稻草或干草秆。

collocations.en: a stalk that turned to straw

formal.mt: Wara żmien twil fix-xemx, il-ħaxix tebben u sar niexef.
formal.en: After a long time in the sun, the grass turned to straw and became dry.
formal.zh: 在太阳下放了很长时间后，青草变成了干草，干透了。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'ġara mill-ħaxix li ħallejna barra? Pawlu: Tebben; issa sar tiben.
colloquial.en: Maja: What happened to the grass we left outside? Pawlu: It turned to straw; it's straw now.
colloquial.zh: 玛娅：我们留在外面的草怎么了？保罗：变成干草了；现在已经是干草了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们留在外面的草怎么了？
messages.en: What happened to the grass we left outside?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 变成干草了；现在已经是干草了。
messages.en: It turned to straw; it's straw now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一把青草晒干后变成草秆，用 tebben 记住这个变化过程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person whose work is printing texts, pictures, or books.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以印制文字、图片或书籍为工作的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li xogħolha hu li tipprintja testi, stampi jew kotba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 印刷工；从事印刷工作的人。

formal.mt: It-tebbiegħ ħejja l-paġni għall-istampar u ċċekkja li t-test kien ċar.
formal.en: The printer prepared the pages for printing and checked that the text was clear.
formal.zh: 印刷工准备好了待印的页面，并检查了文字是否清晰。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min se jistampa dawn il-fuljetti? Mark: It-tebbiegħ se jistampahom għada.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who is going to print these leaflets? Mark: The printer will print them tomorrow.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：谁来印这些传单？马克：印刷工明天会印。

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.zh: 谁来印这些传单？
messages.en: Who is going to print these leaflets?

messages.speaker: Mark (印刷店店员)
messages.zh: 印刷工明天会印。
messages.en: The printer will print them tomorrow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tebbiegħ 和印刷工检查纸上文字的画面联系起来，记住它表示从事印刷的人。

gloss_zh: 会造成污渍的；会使物品染上污迹的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Causing stains or leaving unwanted marks on a surface or material.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容会在表面或材料上造成污渍、留下污迹的东西。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jħalli tbajja' fuq wiċċ jew materjal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 会造成污渍的；会使表面或材料染上污迹的

collocations.zh: 会使接触物染上污迹的材料

formal.mt: Dan il-likwidu huwa tebbiegħi u m'għandux jiġi f'kuntatt mal-ħwejjeġ.
formal.en: This liquid causes staining and should not come into contact with clothing.
formal.zh: 这种液体会造成污渍，不应与衣物接触。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan il-likwidu huwa tebbiegħi? Mark: Iva, oqgħod attenta li ma jaqax fuq il-qmis.
colloquial.en: Lara: Does this liquid cause stains? Mark: Yes, be careful not to spill it on your shirt.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这种液体会留下污渍吗？马克：会，小心别把它洒到你的衬衫上。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 这种液体会留下污渍吗？
messages.en: Does this liquid cause stains?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, oqgħod attenta li ma jaqax fuq il-qmis.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, oqgħod attenta li ma jaqax fuq il-qmis.
messages.zh: 会，小心别把它洒到你的衬衫上。
messages.en: Yes, be careful not to spill it on your shirt.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tebbiegħi 和“一滴液体落下，白衬衫留下污渍”的画面绑定；它形容会造成污渍的东西，记住动作结果即可。

gloss_zh: 磨粉者；把材料磨成粉末的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who grinds material into powder.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把材料研磨成粉末的人，强调执行磨粉工作的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li titħan materjal sakemm isir trab.

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who grinds to a powder
sense_translations.zh_definition: 把材料磨成粉末的人。

collocations.en: a person who grinds spices into powder
an experienced person who grinds materials into powder

formal.mt: It-tebbiek ħadem bir-reqqa biex jagħmel il-ħwawar trab fin.
formal.en: The person grinding the spices worked carefully to turn them into a fine powder.
formal.zh: 磨粉者仔细操作，把香料磨成细粉。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min se jitħan il-ħwawar? Mark: It-tebbiek se jagħmilhom trab fin.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who is going to grind the spices? Mark: The spice grinder will turn them into a fine powder.
colloquial.zh: Lara：谁来磨这些香料？Mark：磨粉师傅会把它们磨成细粉。

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.zh: 谁来磨这些香料？
messages.en: Who is going to grind the spices?

messages.speaker: Mark (店员)
messages.zh: 磨粉师傅会把它们磨成细粉。
messages.en: The spice grinder will turn them into a fine powder.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tebbiek 与“磨粉师傅”的画面配对：师傅把香料磨成细粉。记住这个名词指做磨粉工作的人，背词时用“谁在磨粉？”来提示自己。

gloss_zh: 用于研磨的；供磨碎用的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Used for grinding material into smaller particles or powder.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于把材料磨碎或磨成粉末的，说明器具或设备的用途。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jintuża biex jitħan materjal f'biċċiet iżgħar jew fi trab.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于研磨的；供磨碎材料使用的。

formal.mt: L-apparat tebbieki jintuża biex il-ħwawar isiru trab fin.
formal.en: The grinding apparatus is used to turn spices into a fine powder.
formal.zh: 这台研磨装置用于把香料磨成细粉。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan l-apparat tebbieki tajjeb għall-ħwawar? Mark: Iva, bih tista' tagħmel trab fin.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is this grinding apparatus suitable for spices? Mark: Yes, you can use it to make a fine powder.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这台研磨装置适合磨香料吗？Mark：适合，用它可以磨出细粉。

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.zh: 这台研磨装置适合磨香料吗？
messages.en: Is this grinding apparatus suitable for spices?

messages.speaker: Mark (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, bih tista' tagħmel trab fin.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, bih tista' tagħmel trab fin.
messages.zh: 适合，用它可以磨出细粉。
messages.en: Yes, you can use it to make a fine powder.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tebbieki 想成设备上的“研磨用”标签，连着 apparat tebbieki 一起记。用“这个装置用来做什么？”提示其形容词义，并与指人的 tebbiek 对照记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who sells straw, for example for animal bedding.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 出售稻草、麦秸等秸秆的人，例如向农场供应动物垫料的商贩。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tbigħ it-tiben, pereżempju biex jintuża bħala friex għall-annimali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 卖稻草或其他秸秆的人；秸秆商。

collocations.en: a straw seller at the market

formal.mt: Il-bidwi xtara t-tiben mingħand it-tebbien biex jużah bħala friex għall-annimali.
formal.en: The farmer bought straw from the straw seller to use as bedding for the animals.
formal.zh: 农夫向秸秆商购买了秸秆，用作动物的垫料。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Minn fejn se nixtru t-tiben għall-istalla? Mark: Hemm tebbien fis-suq; nistgħu nixtru mingħandu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where are we going to buy straw for the stable? Mark: There's a straw seller at the market; we can buy from him.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们去哪里买马厩要用的秸秆？马克：市场上有个秸秆商，我们可以向他买。

messages.speaker: Maja (农场主)
messages.mt_spoken: Minn fejn se nixtru t-tiben għall-istalla?
messages.mt_standard: Minn fejn se nixtru t-tiben għall-istalla?
messages.zh: 我们去哪里买马厩要用的秸秆？
messages.en: Where are we going to buy straw for the stable?

messages.speaker: Mark (农场工人)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm tebbien fis-suq; nistgħu nixtru mingħandu.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm tebbien fis-suq; nistgħu nixtru mingħandu.
messages.zh: 市场上有个秸秆商，我们可以向他买。
messages.en: There's a straw seller at the market; we can buy from him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tebbien 放进农场采购画面：农夫买一捆秸秆，收钱的卖家就是这个词所指的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person or thing that divides something into two equal parts.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某物分成两个相等部分的人或事物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna jew ħaġa li taqsam xi ħaġa f'żewġ partijiet indaqs.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 将某物二等分的人或事物。

collocations.en: a bisector of a line segment

formal.mt: Fid-dijagramma, it-tebbieq jaqsam l-angolu f'żewġ angoli ndaqs.
formal.en: In the diagram, the bisector divides the angle into two equal angles.
formal.zh: 图中，角平分线将这个角分成两个相等的角。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex din il-linja tissejjaħ tebbieq? Pawlu: Għax taqsam l-angolu f'żewġ angoli ndaqs.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why is this line called a bisector? Pawlu: Because it divides the angle into two equal angles.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：为什么这条线叫平分线？保罗：因为它把这个角分成了两个相等的角。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 为什么这条线叫平分线？
messages.en: Why is this line called a bisector?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (数学老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax taqsam l-angolu f'żewġ angoli ndaqs.
messages.mt_standard: Għax taqsam l-angolu f'żewġ angoli ndaqs.
messages.zh: 因为它把这个角分成了两个相等的角。
messages.en: Because it divides the angle into two equal angles.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个角被一条线分成大小相同的两半；tebbieq 指完成二等分的人或物，重点记住两半相等。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Tending to divide something into two equal parts.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有将某物分成两个相等部分的倾向的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu tendenza jaqsam xi ħaġa f'żewġ partijiet indaqs.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 倾向于将某物二等分的。

collocations.zh: 倾向于造成二等分的作用
倾向于将物体二等分的机构

formal.mt: Il-mekkaniżmu għandu effett tebbieqi: għandu tendenza jaqsam il-materjal f'żewġ partijiet indaqs.
formal.en: The mechanism has an effect tending to bisect: it tends to divide the material into two equal parts.
formal.zh: 这个机构具有使材料二等分的倾向，即倾向于把材料分成两个相等的部分。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Xi jfisser effett tebbieqi? David: Ifisser li għandu tendenza jaqsam xi ħaġa f'żewġ partijiet indaqs.
colloquial.en: Nina: What does an effect tending to bisect mean? David: It means it tends to divide something into two equal parts.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：具有二等分倾向的作用是什么意思？戴维：意思是它倾向于把某物分成两个相等的部分。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: 具有二等分倾向的作用是什么意思？
messages.en: What does an effect tending to bisect mean?

messages.speaker: David (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li għandu tendenza jaqsam xi ħaġa f'żewġ partijiet indaqs.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li għandu tendenza jaqsam xi ħaġa f'żewġ partijiet indaqs.
messages.zh: 意思是它倾向于把某物分成两个相等的部分。
messages.en: It means it tends to divide something into two equal parts.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用词性对照记忆：tebbieq 指二等分者或工具，tebbieqi 描述二等分的倾向；这是学习对照，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who prepares and cooks food, especially as a job.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 准备食材并烹调食物的人，尤指以烹饪为职业的厨师。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tipprepara u ssajjar l-ikel, speċjalment bħala xogħol.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 做饭的人；负责准备和烹调食物的人员
专业厨师；以烹饪为职业、具备烹调技艺的人

formal.mt: It-tebbieħ tar-ristorant jipprepara l-ikliet b'ingredjenti friski u jsegwi r-regoli tal-iġjene.
formal.en: The restaurant's chef prepares meals with fresh ingredients and follows hygiene rules.
formal.zh: 餐厅厨师使用新鲜食材制作餐点，并遵守卫生规定。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min hu t-tebbieħ illum? Mark: Pawlu. Trid tistaqsih kif għamel is-soppa?
colloquial.en: Sara: Who is the cook today? Mark: Pawlu. Do you want to ask him how he made the soup?
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：今天的厨师是谁？马克：保罗。你想问问他这道汤是怎么做的吗？

messages.speaker: Sara (顾客)
messages.zh: 今天的厨师是谁？
messages.en: Who is the cook today?

messages.speaker: Mark (服务员)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu. Trid tistaqsih kif għamel is-soppa?
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu. Trid tistaqsih kif għamel is-soppa?
messages.zh: 保罗。你想问问他这道汤是怎么做的吗？
messages.en: Pawlu. Do you want to ask him how he made the soup?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象厨房门口挂着 tebbieħ 的名牌，戴厨师帽的人正在煮汤；把这个词和“负责做饭的人”联系起来，同时覆盖 cook 和 chef 两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Either of the two rounded fleshy parts at the back of the body below the waist.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 腰部以下、身体后侧两块圆隆肌肉和软组织中的一侧，即一侧臀部。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Waħda miż-żewġ partijiet imlaħħma u tondi fuq wara tal-ġisem, taħt il-qadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一侧臀部；臀瓣。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi tbenġila fuq tebqa tas-sorm wara waqgħa.
formal.en: The report describes a bruise on one buttock after a fall.
formal.zh: 报告描述了跌倒后出现在一侧臀部上的一处瘀青。

colloquial.mt: Ben: Fejn weġġajt meta waqajt? Lara: Weġġajt f'tebqa tas-sorm, u issa tweġġagħni meta noqgħod bilqiegħda.
colloquial.en: Ben: Where did you hurt yourself when you fell? Lara: I hurt one buttock, and now it hurts when I sit down.
colloquial.zh: 本：你摔倒时伤到哪里了？拉拉：伤到了一侧臀部，现在坐下就疼。

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.zh: 你摔倒时伤到哪里了？
messages.en: Where did you hurt yourself when you fell?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Weġġajt f'tebqa tas-sorm, u issa tweġġagħni meta noqgħod bilqiegħda.
messages.mt_standard: Weġġajt f'tebqa tas-sorm, u issa tweġġagħni meta noqgħod bilqiegħda.
messages.zh: 伤到了一侧臀部，现在坐下就疼。
messages.en: I hurt one buttock, and now it hurts when I sit down.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把完整短语作为一个身体部位名称记忆：想象坐下时左右两侧臀部中的一侧，避免误记成整个臀部。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An act or instance of cooking food.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 烹煮食物这一行为，或一次具体的烹饪过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att jew darba li fiha wieħed isajjar l-ikel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一次烹煮；烹饪这一行为。

formal.mt: Wara t-tebħa tal-ikel, l-istudenti naddfu l-għodod kollha li kienu użaw.
formal.en: After cooking the food, the students cleaned all the utensils they had used.
formal.zh: 烹煮食物之后，学生们清洗了所有用过的厨具。

colloquial.mt: Rita: X'se nagħmlu wara t-tebħa? Sam: L-ewwel nieklu, imbagħad naħslu l-borom.
colloquial.en: Rita: What shall we do after the cooking? Sam: First we'll eat, then we'll wash the pots.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：做完这顿饭之后我们做什么？萨姆：先吃饭，然后洗锅。

messages.speaker: Rita (室友)
messages.zh: 做完这顿饭之后我们做什么？
messages.en: What shall we do after the cooking?

messages.speaker: Sam (室友)
messages.zh: 先吃饭，然后洗锅。
messages.en: First we'll eat, then we'll wash the pots.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象从开火到关火的一次做饭过程，把整次烹煮装进 tebħa 这个名词里，记的是行为而不是菜名。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to Germany, its people, or its language.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与德国、德国人或德语有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-Ġermanja, man-nies tagħha jew mal-lingwa tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 德国的；德国人的；德语的。

formal.mt: Il-programm kulturali jinkludi diskussjoni dwar rumanz ta' kittieb Tedesk.
formal.en: The cultural programme includes a discussion of a novel by a German writer.
formal.zh: 文化活动安排中包括一场关于某位德国作家小说的讨论。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min kiteb dan ir-rumanz? Mark: Kittieb Tedesk; qed naqrah fi traduzzjoni Maltija.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who wrote this novel? Mark: A German writer; I'm reading it in Maltese translation.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这部小说是谁写的？马克：一位德国作家，我读的是马耳他语译本。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这部小说是谁写的？
messages.en: Who wrote this novel?

messages.speaker: Mark (读者)
messages.mt_spoken: Kittieb Tedesk; qed naqrah fi traduzzjoni Maltija.
messages.mt_standard: Kittieb Tedesk; qed naqrah fi traduzzjoni Maltija.
messages.zh: 一位德国作家，我读的是马耳他语译本。
messages.en: A German writer; I'm reading it in Maltese translation.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象书封上的作者来自德国，用 kittieb Tedesk 整组记忆；Tedesk 在这里修饰作家，表示德国的。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A device used to put out a fire or flame.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于扑灭火灾或熄灭火焰的器具。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Apparat li jintuża biex jitfi nar jew fjamma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 灭火器；用于熄灭火焰的器具。

formal.mt: Il-pjan tal-bini juri fejn jinsab it-teffej tan-nar f'kull sular.
formal.en: The building plan shows where the fire extinguisher is located on each floor.
formal.zh: 建筑平面图标明了各楼层灭火器所在的位置。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Fejn hu t-teffej tan-nar? Karl: Qiegħed mal-ħajt ħdejn il-bieb.
colloquial.en: Anna: Where is the fire extinguisher? Karl: It's on the wall beside the door.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：灭火器在哪里？卡尔：在门旁边的墙上。

messages.speaker: Anna (新员工)
messages.zh: 灭火器在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the fire extinguisher?

messages.speaker: Karl (同事)
messages.zh: 在门旁边的墙上。
messages.en: It's on the wall beside the door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 teffej 与门旁墙上的灭火器画面绑定，再整组记住 teffej tan-nar，看到器具就联想到熄灭火焰。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who throws something, such as a ball.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将物体投出或扔出的人，例如投球的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li titfa' xi ħaġa, bħal ballun.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 投掷东西的人；投掷者。

collocations.en: a person who throws the ball

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, it-teffiegħ jitfa' l-ballun lejn sieħbu u mbagħad ibiddel ir-rwol miegħu.
formal.en: In this exercise, the thrower throws the ball towards their partner and then swaps roles with them.
formal.zh: 在这项练习中，投掷者把球投向同伴，然后与同伴交换角色。

colloquial.mt: Luca: Min se jkun it-teffiegħ f'dan ir-rawnd? Sara: Jien nitfa' l-ballun, u int taqbdu.
colloquial.en: Luca: Who will be the thrower in this round? Sara: I'll throw the ball, and you catch it.
colloquial.zh: 卢卡：这一轮谁来投球？萨拉：我来投，你来接。

messages.speaker: Luca (队友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jkun it-teffiegħ f'dan ir-rawnd?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jkun it-teffiegħ f'dan ir-rawnd?
messages.zh: 这一轮谁来投球？
messages.en: Who will be the thrower in this round?

messages.speaker: Sara (队友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien nitfa' l-ballun, u int taqbdu.
messages.mt_standard: Jien nitfa' l-ballun, u int taqbdu.
messages.zh: 我来投，你来接。
messages.en: I'll throw the ball, and you catch it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象两人传球：把球扔出去的那个人就是 teffiegħ；用投球者与接球者的角色区别帮助记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Inclined to throw things, especially as a habitual way of behaving.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容有扔东西倾向或习惯的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu tendenza jew drawwa jitfa' l-affarijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 倾向于扔东西的；爱扔东西的。

collocations.en: a boy who tends to throw things
a man who tends to throw things

formal.mt: L-għalliem innota li t-tifel kien teffiegħi waqt il-logħob.
formal.en: The teacher noted that the boy tended to throw things during play.
formal.zh: 老师注意到，这个男孩玩耍时爱扔东西。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Nista' nħalli l-vażun hawn? Pawlu: Aħjar le; it-tifel teffiegħi u jista' jitfa' l-vażun mal-art.
colloquial.en: Marija: Can I leave the vase here? Pawlu: Better not; the boy tends to throw things and might throw the vase onto the floor.
colloquial.zh: Marija：我可以把花瓶放在这里吗？Pawlu：最好别放；那个男孩爱扔东西，可能会把花瓶扔到地上。

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.zh: 我可以把花瓶放在这里吗？
messages.en: Can I leave the vase here?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Aħjar le; it-tifel teffiegħi u jista' jitfa' l-vażun mal-art.
messages.mt_standard: Aħjar le; it-tifel teffiegħi u jista' jitfa' l-vażun mal-art.
messages.zh: 最好别放；那个男孩爱扔东西，可能会把花瓶扔到地上。
messages.en: Better not; the boy tends to throw things and might throw the vase onto the floor.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 teffiegħi 配上孩子不断扔玩具的画面，记住它形容爱扔东西的习惯。

gloss_zh: 小口啃食；吃得很少；用指尖摆弄

teaching_sense.en_definition: To nibble food or eat very little; also to handle something with the tips of the fingers.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 小口啃食或只吃一点点；也指用指尖拿弄某物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiekol b'gdimiet żgħar jew jiekol ftit ħafna; ukoll imiss jew jaqbad xi ħaġa bil-ponot tas-swaba'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小口啃食；一点一点地咬着吃。
吃得很少；只稍微吃一点。

sense_translations.en_definition: to handle sth. using the tips of the fingers
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用指尖拿弄或摆弄某物。

collocations.en: handled the fabric with his fingertips

formal.mt: Waqt l-ikla, Pawlu teftef biċċa ħobż u ma kiel xejn aktar.
formal.en: During the meal, Pawlu nibbled a piece of bread and ate nothing else.
formal.zh: 吃饭时，Pawlu 小口啃了一块面包，没有再吃其他东西。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Pawlu kiel sew illum? Marija: Le, teftef ftit ħobż biss; ma kellux ħafna ġuħ.
colloquial.en: Anna: Did Pawlu eat much today? Marija: No, he only nibbled a little bread; he wasn't very hungry.
colloquial.zh: Anna：Pawlu 今天吃得多吗？Marija：不多，他只小口吃了一点面包；他不太饿。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: Pawlu 今天吃得多吗？
messages.en: Did Pawlu eat much today?

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, teftef ftit ħobż biss; ma kellux ħafna ġuħ.
messages.mt_standard: Le, teftef ftit ħobż biss; ma kellux ħafna ġuħ.
messages.zh: 不多，他只小口吃了一点面包；他不太饿。
messages.en: No, he only nibbled a little bread; he wasn't very hungry.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个小动作记 teftef：嘴巴小口啃面包，指尖轻轻摆弄布料。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who eats very little.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 吃得很少、食量很小的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tiekol ftit ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 吃得很少的人；食量很小的人。

collocations.en: a small portion for a light eater
collocations.zh: 给食量小的人的一小份食物

formal.mt: Pawlu huwa teftief u ġeneralment jiekol porzjon żgħir biss.
formal.en: Pawlu is a light eater and generally eats only a small portion.
formal.zh: Pawlu 食量很小，通常只吃一小份。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Nagħmel porzjon kbir għal Pawlu? Anna: Le, hu teftief; porzjon żgħir ikun biżżejjed.
colloquial.en: Marija: Shall I make a large portion for Pawlu? Anna: No, he's a light eater; a small portion will be enough.
colloquial.zh: Marija：我要给 Pawlu 做一大份吗？Anna：不用，他食量很小；一小份就够了。

messages.speaker: Marija (主人)
messages.zh: 我要给 Pawlu 做一大份吗？
messages.en: Shall I make a large portion for Pawlu?

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, hu teftief; porzjon żgħir ikun biżżejjed.
messages.mt_standard: Le, hu teftief; porzjon żgħir ikun biżżejjed.
messages.zh: 不用，他食量很小；一小份就够了。
messages.en: No, he's a light eater; a small portion will be enough.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 teftief 想象一位只吃小半碗饭的人，用小饭碗提醒自己这是指人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing someone who tends to touch things with their fingers.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容经常或习惯用手指触摸、摆弄东西的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu t-tendenza jmiss l-affarijiet b'subgħajh.

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who tends to touch things with their fingers
sense_translations.zh_definition: 形容爱用手指触摸或摆弄东西的人。

collocations.en: a boy who tends to touch things with his fingers
collocations.zh: 一个爱用手指摸东西的男孩

collocations.en: a visitor who tends to touch things with his fingers
collocations.zh: 一个爱用手指摸东西的参观者

formal.mt: Il-gwida tal-mużew talbet lill-viżitatur teftiefi biex ma jmissx l-oġġetti esposti.
