formal.en: The museum guide asked the visitor who kept touching things not to touch the objects on display.
formal.zh: 博物馆导览员请那位爱摸东西的参观者不要触摸展品。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex qiegħed tmexxi l-figurini? Marija: Għax it-tifel teftiefi u jmiss kull ħaġa li jara.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why are you moving the figurines? Marija: Because the boy likes touching things and touches everything he sees.
colloquial.zh: Anna：你为什么把小摆件移开？Marija：因为那个男孩爱摸东西，看见什么都要摸一下。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么把小摆件移开？
messages.en: Why are you moving the figurines?

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax it-tifel teftiefi u jmiss kull ħaġa li jara.
messages.mt_standard: Għax it-tifel teftiefi u jmiss kull ħaġa li jara.
messages.zh: 因为那个男孩爱摸东西，看见什么都要摸一下。
messages.en: Because the boy likes touching things and touches everything he sees.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 teftiefi 记成看见摆件就伸出手指的人物特征，重点联想爱摸东西。

gloss_zh: 琐事；断断续续；小口啃食；少量

teaching_sense.en_definition: Small nibbles or amounts, the act of nibbling, trivial things, or activity occurring in fits and starts.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可指小口吃下的食物、少量东西或啃食这一动作，也可指无关紧要的琐事或断断续续的进行状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Gdimiet jew kwantitajiet żgħar, l-att li tiekol ftit ftit, affarijiet bla importanza, jew attività li ssir b'waqfiet u bidu mill-ġdid.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 无关紧要的事情；琐事。
时断时续、停停做做的进行状态。
小口啃下或吃下的一点点食物。
微不足道的小事或东西。
小口啃食；一点一点地吃这一动作。
少量；零星的一点点。

collocations.en: work done in fits and starts

formal.mt: Ix-xogħol sar bit-teftif, b'ħafna waqfiet bejn biċċa xogħol u oħra.
formal.en: The work was done in fits and starts, with many pauses between tasks.
formal.zh: 这项工作断断续续地进行，各项任务之间有许多停顿。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Kilt ikla sħiħa llum? Pawlu: Le, kilt bit-teftif biss: ftit ħobż u ftit ġobon.
colloquial.en: Anna: Did you have a full meal today? Pawlu: No, I only ate little bits: some bread and some cheese.
colloquial.zh: Anna：你今天正经吃过一顿饭吗？Pawlu：没有，我只是零零星星吃了一点面包和奶酪。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 你今天正经吃过一顿饭吗？
messages.en: Did you have a full meal today?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, kilt bit-teftif biss: ftit ħobż u ftit ġobon.
messages.mt_standard: Le, kilt bit-teftif biss: ftit ħobż u ftit ġobon.
messages.zh: 没有，我只是零零星星吃了一点面包和奶酪。
messages.en: No, I only ate little bits: some bread and some cheese.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用零零碎碎作学习联想：食物一点点、工作停停做做、事情微不足道，再按语境区分词义。

gloss_zh: 无关紧要的小事或东西

teaching_sense.en_definition: A thing or matter of no importance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 没有重要性的小事或东西；微不足道的一件事。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa jew kwistjoni bla importanza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 无关紧要的小事或东西。

formal.mt: Il-kumitat qies il-kwistjoni bħala teftufa u kompla jiddiskuti l-problemi ewlenin.
formal.en: The committee regarded the matter as a trifle and continued discussing the main problems.
formal.zh: 委员会认为这只是件小事，便继续讨论主要问题。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Insejt inġib is-srievet; tinkwieta? Marija: Le, dik teftufa; għandna oħrajn hawn.
colloquial.en: Anna: I forgot to bring the napkins; are you worried? Marija: No, that's a small thing; we have others here.
colloquial.zh: Anna：我忘了带餐巾，你担心吗？Marija：不担心，那只是件小事；我们这里还有。

messages.speaker: Anna (客人)
messages.zh: 我忘了带餐巾，你担心吗？
messages.en: I forgot to bring the napkins; are you worried?

messages.speaker: Marija (主人)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, dik teftufa; għandna oħrajn hawn.
messages.mt_standard: Le, dik teftufa; għandna oħrajn hawn.
messages.zh: 不担心，那只是件小事；我们这里还有。
messages.en: No, that's a small thing; we have others here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把一件小事写在很小的纸条上，提醒自己 teftufa 是无关紧要的一件事。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A threat or a single act of threatening someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一次威胁，或某次对他人表示威吓的言语或行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Att wieħed jew kliem li bih xi ħadd jhedded lil persuna oħra.

sense_translations.en_definition: a threat, a single instance of threatening
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一次威胁；一次具体的威吓言行。

formal.mt: Fir-rapport, ix-xhud iddeskriva tehdida diretta li rċieva waqt il-laqgħa.
formal.en: In the report, the witness described a direct threat he received during the meeting.
formal.zh: 证人在报告中描述了他在会议期间受到的一次直接威胁。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex salvajt dak il-messaġġ? Pawlu: Għax fih tehdida; qal li se jkisser it-twieqi tiegħi.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why did you save that message? Pawlu: Because it contains a threat; he said he would smash my windows.
colloquial.zh: Anna：你为什么保存那条消息？Pawlu：因为里面有威胁的话；他说要砸碎我家的窗户。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么保存那条消息？
messages.en: Why did you save that message?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax fih tehdida; qal li se jkisser it-twieqi tiegħi.
messages.mt_standard: Għax fih tehdida; qal li se jkisser it-twieqi tiegħi.
messages.zh: 因为里面有威胁的话；他说要砸碎我家的窗户。
messages.en: Because it contains a threat; he said he would smash my windows.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tehdida 联想成手机里一条具体的威胁消息，记住它可指一次威吓言行。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of cooking food slowly over a fire.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将食物放在火上慢慢烹煮的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-tisjir tal-ikel bil-mod fuq in-nar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在火上慢慢烹煮；用火慢煮食物的过程。

collocations.en: slow cooking of meat over a fire
slow cooking over a low flame

formal.mt: It-tehdim tal-laħam fuq nar baxx jieħu ż-żmien u jeħtieġ attenzjoni.
formal.en: Slow cooking of meat over a low flame takes time and requires attention.
formal.zh: 用小火慢煮肉需要时间，也需要留心照看。

colloquial.mt: Pawlu: Għaliex l-ikel għadu mhux lest? Marija: Qed isir bit-tehdim fuq nar baxx; irid aktar ħin.
colloquial.en: Pawlu: Why isn't the food ready yet? Marija: It's being cooked slowly over a low flame; it needs more time.
colloquial.zh: Pawlu：饭怎么还没好？Marija：正在用小火慢煮，还需要一些时间。

messages.speaker: Pawlu (家人)
messages.zh: 饭怎么还没好？
messages.en: Why isn't the food ready yet?

messages.speaker: Marija (做饭的家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed isir bit-tehdim fuq nar baxx; irid aktar ħin.
messages.mt_standard: Qed isir bit-tehdim fuq nar baxx; irid aktar ħin.
messages.zh: 正在用小火慢煮，还需要一些时间。
messages.en: It's being cooked slowly over a low flame; it needs more time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象锅下燃着小火、旁边时钟慢慢走，把 tehdim 与在火上慢煮的过程一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of expressing praise or admiration, including praise directed to God.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表达赞美、颂扬或敬意的行为，也可特指赞美上帝。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għoti ta' tifħir jew kliem ta' ammirazzjoni, ukoll bħala tifħir lil Alla.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 赞颂；颂扬某人或某事。
赞美上帝；向上帝表达颂赞。

formal.mt: Il-kor fetaħ iċ-ċerimonja b'għanja ta' tehlil lil Alla.
formal.en: The choir opened the ceremony with a song of praise to God.
formal.zh: 合唱团以一首赞美上帝的歌曲为仪式揭幕。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex kulħadd qed jgħid kliem ta' tehlil lil Sara? Pawlu: Għax għenet lill-ġirien kollha waqt il-maltemp.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why is everyone saying such words of praise about Sara? Pawlu: Because she helped all the neighbours during the storm.
colloquial.zh: Marija：为什么大家都在赞颂萨拉？Pawlu：因为她在暴风雨期间帮助了所有邻居。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex kulħadd qed jgħid kliem ta' tehlil lil Sara?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex kulħadd qed jgħid kliem ta' tehlil lil Sara?
messages.zh: 为什么大家都在赞颂萨拉？
messages.en: Why is everyone saying such words of praise about Sara?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax għenet lill-ġirien kollha waqt il-maltemp.
messages.mt_standard: Għax għenet lill-ġirien kollha waqt il-maltemp.
messages.zh: 因为她在暴风雨期间帮助了所有邻居。
messages.en: Because she helped all the neighbours during the storm.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象合唱团齐声颂赞的画面，把 tehlil 与“赞颂”相连；对象是 Alla 时，就是赞美上帝。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of causing someone to feel anxious or worried.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过言语、行为等使某人感到焦虑或担忧的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għemil jew il-kliem li jġiegħel lil xi ħadd jinkwieta jew iħoss ansjetà.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某人焦虑；使某人担心不安。

formal.mt: Il-kliem ta' tehmim qabel l-eżami jista' jżid l-ansjetà tal-istudenti.
formal.en: Words that cause worry before an examination can increase students' anxiety.
formal.zh: 考试前令人担忧的话语可能加重学生的焦虑。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan it-tehmim kollu dwar l-eżami mhux qed jgħinni. Mark: Għandek raġun. Ejja naraw x'għandek tistudja llum.
colloquial.en: Lara: All this making me anxious about the exam isn't helping me. Mark: You're right. Let's see what you need to study today.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这样不断让我为考试担心，对我没有帮助。Mark：你说得对。我们看看你今天需要学什么吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan it-tehmim kollu dwar l-eżami mhux qed jgħinni.
messages.mt_standard: Dan it-tehmim kollu dwar l-eżami mhux qed jgħinni.
messages.zh: 这样不断让我为考试担心，对我没有帮助。
messages.en: All this making me anxious about the exam isn't helping me.

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek raġun. Ejja naraw x'għandek tistudja llum.
messages.mt_standard: Għandek raġun. Ejja naraw x'għandek tistudja llum.
messages.zh: 你说得对。我们看看你今天需要学什么吧。
messages.en: You're right. Let's see what you need to study today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住“有人说了让你心里发紧的话”这个场景：tehmim 强调使别人焦虑这一作用。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of fastening or attaching something, for example with a safety pin or drawing pin.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把东西别住、钉上或固定到另一物体上的动作，例如使用安全别针或图钉。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li twaħħal jew iżżomm xi ħaġa f'postha, pereżempju b'labra tas-sigurtà jew b'pinn.

sense_translations.en_definition: fastening or attaching (e.g. with a safety or drawing pin)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 扣牢、别住或附着固定，例如使用安全别针或图钉。

formal.mt: Għat-tehmiż tal-avviżi mal-bord, użaw pinnijiet żgħar.
formal.en: Use small pins to attach the notices to the board.
formal.zh: 请用小图钉把通知固定到告示板上。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għat-tehmiż ta' din il-biċċa drapp, għandek labra tas-sigurtà? Rita: Iva, hawn waħda. Waħħalha minn ġewwa.
colloquial.en: Nina: Do you have a safety pin for fastening this piece of fabric? Rita: Yes, here's one. Pin it on the inside.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你有安全别针吗？我想把这块布别牢。Rita：有，这里有一枚。从里面别上吧。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għat-tehmiż ta' din il-biċċa drapp, għandek labra tas-sigurtà?
messages.mt_standard: Għat-tehmiż ta' din il-biċċa drapp, għandek labra tas-sigurtà?
messages.zh: 你有安全别针吗？我想把这块布别牢。
messages.en: Do you have a safety pin for fastening this piece of fabric?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hawn waħda. Waħħalha minn ġewwa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hawn waħda. Waħħalha minn ġewwa.
messages.zh: 有，这里有一枚。从里面别上吧。
messages.en: Yes, here's one. Pin it on the inside.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象用安全别针把布料别住，再用图钉固定通知；这两个“固定上去”的动作都可帮助记住 tehmiż。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action of striking something repeatedly and forcefully, often to crush it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 连续用力击打某物的动作，常指把东西捣碎或舂碎。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li tolqot xi ħaġa b'forza għal darba wara oħra, spiss biex tfarrakha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 捣击；舂捣；连续用力敲打。

formal.mt: It-tehriż tal-ħwawar fit-tikħil ikisser iż-żrieragħ f'biċċiet iżgħar.
formal.en: Pounding the spices in a mortar breaks the seeds into smaller pieces.
formal.zh: 在研钵中捣香料，会把种子捣成较小的碎块。

colloquial.mt: Toni: Dan it-tehriż qed jagħmel ħafna storbju! Marija: Għadni qed infarrak il-ħwawar; dalwaqt inlesti.
colloquial.en: Toni: This pounding is making a lot of noise! Marija: I'm still crushing the spices; I'll be finished soon.
colloquial.zh: Toni：这样捣东西声音真大！Marija：我还在捣香料，很快就好了。

messages.speaker: Toni (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan it-tehriż qed jagħmel ħafna storbju!
messages.mt_standard: Dan it-tehriż qed jagħmel ħafna storbju!
messages.zh: 这样捣东西声音真大！
messages.en: This pounding is making a lot of noise!

messages.speaker: Marija (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadni qed infarrak il-ħwawar; dalwaqt inlesti.
messages.mt_standard: Għadni qed infarrak il-ħwawar; dalwaqt inlesti.
messages.zh: 我还在捣香料，很快就好了。
messages.en: I'm still crushing the spices; I'll be finished soon.

cognitive_memory_aid: 脑中播放研钵里“咚、咚、咚”捣香料的画面，用反复有力的敲击动作记住 tehriż。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Shaking, agitation, or quaking, including movements of the ground in earthquakes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 摇动、震荡或震颤，也可指地面震动及地震。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Moviment ta' tbandil jew rogħda, jew taqlib qawwi; jista' jirreferi wkoll għal terremoti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 摇动；晃动；抖动。
激荡；扰动；躁动。
震颤；剧烈颤动。
地震；大地发生的震动。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi t-tehżiż tal-art li nħass fir-raħal matul il-lejl.
formal.en: The report describes the ground shaking felt in the village during the night.
formal.zh: 报告描述了村里夜间感受到的地面震动。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Ħassejt dak it-tehżiż? Il-mejda ċċaqalqet. David: Iva, ħassejtu wkoll. Ejja naraw jekk hemmx xi aħbar.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did you feel that shaking? The table moved. David: Yes, I felt it too. Let's see whether there's any news.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你感觉到刚才的震动了吗？桌子动了。David：感觉到了，我也察觉了。我们看看有没有消息。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: 你感觉到刚才的震动了吗？桌子动了。
messages.en: Did you feel that shaking? The table moved.

messages.speaker: David (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħassejtu wkoll. Ejja naraw jekk hemmx xi aħbar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħassejtu wkoll. Ejja naraw jekk hemmx xi aħbar.
messages.zh: 感觉到了，我也察觉了。我们看看有没有消息。
messages.en: Yes, I felt it too. Let's see whether there's any news.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“瓶子在晃、桌子在颤、大地在震”三个画面串联 tehżiż，记住它可以表示不同规模的摇动与震动。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cut off someone's head.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 砍掉某人的头，即将某人斩首。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jaqta' ras xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 砍掉某人的头；将某人斩首。

formal.mt: Fil-ġrajja fittizja, is-suldat tejjeż lill-priġunier wara li rċieva l-ordni.
formal.en: In the fictional story, the soldier beheaded the prisoner after receiving the order.
formal.zh: 在这个虚构故事中，士兵接到命令后将囚犯斩首。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser 'tejjeż' f'din il-ġrajja? Mark: Ifisser li qata' ras xi ħadd. Hija ġrajja vjolenti.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'tejjeż' mean in this story? Mark: It means that he cut off someone's head. It is a violent story.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个故事里的 tejjeż 是什么意思？马克：意思是他砍掉了某人的头。这是个充满暴力的故事。

messages.speaker: Maja（读者）
messages.zh: 这个故事里的 tejjeż 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'tejjeż' mean in this story?

messages.speaker: Mark（朋友）
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li qata' ras xi ħadd. Hija ġrajja vjolenti.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li qata' ras xi ħadd. Hija ġrajja vjolenti.
messages.zh: 意思是他砍掉了某人的头。这是个充满暴力的故事。
messages.en: It means that he cut off someone's head. It is a violent story.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用故事词卡记住 tejjeż 对应斩首这一动作，释义必须包含砍掉某人的头。

gloss_zh: 改进者；使事物变好的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who improves something or makes it better.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某事物作出改进、使其变得更好的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li ttejjeb xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 作出改进的人；使事物变得更好的人。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport isemmi lil Mark bħala tejjieb tal-proċess, għax il-bidliet tiegħu naqqsu l-ħin ta' stennija.
formal.en: The report names Mark as an improver of the process because his changes reduced waiting time.
formal.zh: 报告称马克为流程改进者，因为他所作的调整缩短了等待时间。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex sejjaħt lil Mark tejjieb tas-servizz? Pawlu: Għax għamel bidliet li għenu lill-klijenti jinqdew aktar malajr.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you call Mark an improver of the service? Pawlu: Because he made changes that helped customers get served faster.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么称马克为服务改进者？保罗：因为他作出的调整让顾客更快地得到了服务。

messages.speaker: Maja（同事）
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex sejjaħt lil Mark tejjieb tas-servizz?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex sejjaħt lil Mark tejjieb tas-servizz?
messages.zh: 你为什么称马克为服务改进者？
messages.en: Why did you call Mark an improver of the service?

messages.speaker: Pawlu（经理）
messages.mt_spoken: Għax għamel bidliet li għenu lill-klijenti jinqdew aktar malajr.
messages.mt_standard: Għax għamel bidliet li għenu lill-klijenti jinqdew aktar malajr.
messages.zh: 因为他作出的调整让顾客更快地得到了服务。
messages.en: Because he made changes that helped customers get served faster.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一位不断把流程改好的同事，给这个人贴上 tejjieb 标签，记住它指改进者。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The complexity of something, especially when it has many connected parts or details.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 事物具有许多相互关联的部分或细节所呈现的复杂性。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kumplessità ta' xi ħaġa li għandha ħafna partijiet jew dettalji marbutin ma' xulxin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 复杂性；复杂程度。

formal.mt: Minħabba t-tekbib tal-problema, l-awtur qasam l-ispjegazzjoni f'diversi taqsimiet.
formal.en: Because of the complexity of the problem, the author divided the explanation into several sections.
formal.zh: 由于问题较为复杂，作者将说明分成了几个部分。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex hemm tant passi? Mark: Dan it-tekbib kollu ġej mir-regoli differenti. Ejja narawhom waħda waħda.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are there so many steps? Mark: All this complexity comes from the different rules. Let's go through them one by one.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：为什么有这么多步骤？马克：这么复杂是因为有各种不同的规则。我们逐条来看吧。

messages.speaker: Maja（学生）
messages.zh: 为什么有这么多步骤？
messages.en: Why are there so many steps?

messages.speaker: Mark（同学）
messages.mt_spoken: Dan it-tekbib kollu ġej mir-regoli differenti. Ejja narawhom waħda waħda.
messages.mt_standard: Dan it-tekbib kollu ġej mir-regoli differenti. Ejja narawhom waħda waħda.
messages.zh: 这么复杂是因为有各种不同的规则。我们逐条来看吧。
messages.en: All this complexity comes from the different rules. Let's go through them one by one.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一张连线很多的步骤图，把 tekbib 写在旁边，用相互关联的细节记住复杂性。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Irritation, annoyance, or vexation caused by something troublesome.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 令人烦心的事情所引起的烦躁、恼怒或烦恼。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dwejjaq jew rabja li tqanqal xi ħaġa tedjanti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 烦躁；受到烦扰时产生的不快。
恼怒；被人或事情惹烦的感觉。
烦恼；令人苦恼或气恼的情绪。

formal.mt: Id-dewmien ripetut sar sors ta' tekdid għall-parteċipanti.
formal.en: The repeated delays became a source of annoyance for the participants.
formal.zh: 一再延误让参与者感到烦躁。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Reġgħu biddlu l-ħin tal-laqgħa? Mark: Iva, u dan it-tekdid kollu qed idejjaqni. Ma nistax nippjana l-ġurnata.
colloquial.en: Maja: Have they changed the meeting time again? Mark: Yes, and all this annoyance is getting to me. I can't plan my day.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：他们又改会议时间了吗？马克：是啊，这些烦心事真让我受不了。我都没法安排一天的事情。

messages.speaker: Maja（同事）
messages.zh: 他们又改会议时间了吗？
messages.en: Have they changed the meeting time again?

messages.speaker: Mark（同事）
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u dan it-tekdid kollu qed idejjaqni. Ma nistax nippjana l-ġurnata.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u dan it-tekdid kollu qed idejjaqni. Ma nistax nippjana l-ġurnata.
messages.zh: 是啊，这些烦心事真让我受不了。我都没法安排一天的事情。
messages.en: Yes, and all this annoyance is getting to me. I can't plan my day.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象会议时间反复更改带来的烦躁，把 tekdid 与烦扰、恼怒、烦恼三个近义词一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The chemical element called technetium.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 化学元素锝，英语名称为 technetium。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Element kimiku magħruf bħala technetium bl-Ingliż.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 锝，一种化学元素。

formal.mt: Fir-rapport tal-laboratorju, il-kampjun ġie identifikat bħala teknezju.
formal.en: In the laboratory report, the sample was identified as technetium.
formal.zh: 实验室报告将该样品鉴定为锝。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif ngħid 'technetium' bil-Malti? Mark: Teknezju. Huwa isem ta' element kimiku.
colloquial.en: Maja: How do I say 'technetium' in Maltese? Mark: Teknezju. It is the name of a chemical element.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：technetium 用马耳他语怎么说？马克：Teknezju，是一种化学元素的名称。

messages.speaker: Maja（学生）
messages.zh: technetium 用马耳他语怎么说？
messages.en: How do I say 'technetium' in Maltese?

messages.speaker: Mark（同学）
messages.mt_spoken: Teknezju. Huwa isem ta' element kimiku.
messages.mt_standard: Teknezju. Huwa isem ta' element kimiku.
messages.zh: Teknezju，是一种化学元素的名称。
messages.en: Teknezju. It is the name of a chemical element.

cognitive_memory_aid: 制作三语元素卡，把 teknezju、technetium 和锝并排写，用名称对照来记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A particular method or skill used to carry out an activity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 完成某项活动时采用的具体方法、技巧或技法。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Metodu jew ħila partikolari li tintuża biex issir xi attività.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 技巧；技法；进行某项活动的具体方法。

formal.mt: L-għalliema wriet teknika tal-pittura li tgħin lill-istudenti joħolqu dellijiet aktar ċari.
formal.en: The teacher demonstrated a painting technique that helps students create more clearly defined shadows.
formal.zh: 老师演示了一种绘画技法，帮助学生画出轮廓更清晰的阴影。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif għamilt dawn id-dellijiet? Mark: Użajt teknika li tgħallimt fil-klassi. Trid nurik kif?
colloquial.en: Maja: How did you make these shadows? Mark: I used a technique I learned in class. Do you want me to show you how?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这些阴影你是怎么画出来的？马克：我用了课堂上学的一种技法。要我演示给你看吗？

messages.speaker: Maja（同学）
messages.zh: 这些阴影你是怎么画出来的？
messages.en: How did you make these shadows?

messages.speaker: Mark（同学）
messages.mt_spoken: Użajt teknika li tgħallimt fil-klassi. Trid nurik kif?
messages.mt_standard: Użajt teknika li tgħallimt fil-klassi. Trid nurik kif?
messages.zh: 我用了课堂上学的一种技法。要我演示给你看吗？
messages.en: I used a technique I learned in class. Do you want me to show you how?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 teknika 和英语 technique 做成配对词卡，再想象老师示范绘画技法的场景。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A particular technical or procedural detail, especially one affecting whether something meets a rule or requirement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 技术或程序上的具体细节，尤其指影响某事是否符合规则或要求的细节。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dettall tekniku jew proċedurali, speċjalment wieħed li jaffettwa jekk xi ħaġa tissodisfax regola jew rekwiżit.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 技术性或程序性的细节、具体规定。

collocations.zh: 由于某项技术性或程序性细节

formal.mt: L-applikazzjoni ġiet miċħuda minħabba teknikalità fil-proċedura.
formal.en: The application was rejected because of a procedural technicality.
formal.zh: 该申请因程序上的一项细节问题而被驳回。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ma aċċettawx l-applikazzjoni? Mark: Minħabba teknikalità: kienet nieqsa firma waħda.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why didn't they accept the application? Mark: Because of a technicality: one signature was missing.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：他们为什么没接受申请？马克：因为一个程序细节：少了一个签名。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 他们为什么没接受申请？
messages.en: Why didn't they accept the application?

messages.speaker: Mark (申请人)
messages.mt_spoken: Minħabba teknikalità: kienet nieqsa firma waħda.
messages.mt_standard: Minħabba teknikalità: kienet nieqsa firma waħda.
messages.zh: 因为一个程序细节：少了一个签名。
messages.en: Because of a technicality: one signature was missing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把申请表上漏掉的小签名作为记忆画面：细节虽小，却可能影响是否合规。

teaching_sense.en_definition: From a technical point of view, or according to a strict interpretation of facts or rules.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从技术角度来看，或按照事实、规则的严格解释来说。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mil-lat tekniku, jew skont interpretazzjoni stretta tal-fatti jew tar-regoli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在技术上；按照严格的定义或规则来说。

collocations.zh: 严格来说正确的；技术上正确的

formal.mt: Is-soluzzjoni hija teknikament possibbli, iżda teħtieġ aktar riżorsi.
formal.en: The solution is technically possible, but it requires more resources.
formal.zh: 这个方案在技术上可行，但需要更多资源。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Nista' nibgħat il-formola għada? Mark: Teknikament iva, għax l-iskadenza hija f'nofsinhar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can I send the form tomorrow? Mark: Technically yes, because the deadline is at noon.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我明天可以提交表格吗？马克：严格来说可以，因为截止时间是中午。

messages.speaker: Maja (申请人)
messages.zh: 我明天可以提交表格吗？
messages.en: Can I send the form tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Mark (办事员)
messages.mt_spoken: Teknikament iva, għax l-iskadenza hija f'nofsinhar.
messages.mt_standard: Teknikament iva, għax l-iskadenza hija f'nofsinhar.
messages.zh: 严格来说可以，因为截止时间是中午。
messages.en: Technically yes, because the deadline is at noon.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住两个观察角度：工程师看技术能否做到，办事员看规则是否允许，都可用这个副词。

gloss_zh: 技术官僚；专家型管理者

teaching_sense.en_definition: An expert who holds administrative or political authority and bases decisions mainly on technical knowledge.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 担任行政或政治管理职务，并主要依据专业技术知识作出决策的专家。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espert li għandu setgħa amministrattiva jew politika u jibbaża d-deċiżjonijiet l-aktar fuq għarfien tekniku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 依靠专业技术知识参与行政管理或政治决策的技术官僚、专家型管理者。

collocations.en: a government led by a technocrat
collocations.zh: 由技术官僚领导的政府

formal.mt: Il-kumitat ippropona li teknokrata indipendenti jmexxi r-riforma amministrattiva.
formal.en: The committee proposed that an independent technocrat lead the administrative reform.
formal.zh: 委员会提议由一位独立的技术官僚领导行政改革。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhu teknokrata? Mark: Espert li jieħu deċiżjonijiet fil-gvern jew fl-amministrazzjoni abbażi tal-għarfien tekniku tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is a technocrat? Mark: An expert who makes decisions in government or administration based on their technical knowledge.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：什么是技术官僚？马克：就是依据自己的专业技术知识，在政府或行政部门作决策的专家。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 什么是技术官僚？
messages.en: What is a technocrat?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Espert li jieħu deċiżjonijiet fil-gvern jew fl-amministrazzjoni abbażi tal-għarfien tekniku tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Espert li jieħu deċiżjonijiet fil-gvern jew fl-amministrazzjoni abbażi tal-għarfien tekniku tiegħu.
messages.zh: 就是依据自己的专业技术知识，在政府或行政部门作决策的专家。
messages.en: An expert who makes decisions in government or administration based on their technical knowledge.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一位带着专业报告参加政府决策会议的专家；这个词指参与管理的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A system of government or administration in which technical experts hold decision-making authority.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由专业技术专家掌握决策权的政府或行政管理制度。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sistema ta' gvern jew amministrazzjoni li fiha esperti tekniċi għandhom is-setgħa li jieħdu d-deċiżjonijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 由专业技术专家主导决策的治理制度，即技术官僚制。

collocations.zh: 关于技术官僚制的辩论

formal.mt: L-istudju jeżamina r-rwol tal-esperti fit-teknokrazija u r-responsabbiltà tagħhom lejn il-pubbliku.
formal.en: The study examines the role of experts in technocracy and their accountability to the public.
formal.zh: 该研究考察专家在技术官僚制中的角色，以及他们对公众承担的责任。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'tfisser teknokrazija? Mark: Sistema fejn l-esperti tekniċi għandhom is-setgħa li jieħdu d-deċiżjonijiet.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does technocracy mean? Mark: A system in which technical experts have the authority to make decisions.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：技术官僚制是什么意思？马克：就是由专业技术专家掌握决策权的制度。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 技术官僚制是什么意思？
messages.en: What does technocracy mean?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Sistema fejn l-esperti tekniċi għandhom is-setgħa li jieħdu d-deċiżjonijiet.
messages.mt_standard: Sistema fejn l-esperti tekniċi għandhom is-setgħa li jieħdu d-deċiżjonijiet.
messages.zh: 就是由专业技术专家掌握决策权的制度。
messages.en: A system in which technical experts have the authority to make decisions.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把专家坐在决策桌旁的画面扩大为整套治理制度：人是 teknokrata，制度是 teknokrazija。

gloss_zh: 在科技方面；从科技角度

teaching_sense.en_definition: With regard to technology or the development and use of technological tools and systems.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 就科技而言，或从技术工具与系统的发展、应用角度来看。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fir-rigward tat-teknoloġija jew tal-iżvilupp u l-użu ta' għodod u sistemi teknoloġiċi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在科技方面；就技术的发展或应用而言。

collocations.zh: 在科技方面依赖他人的

formal.mt: Il-laboratorju huwa teknoloġikament avvanzat u joffri tagħmir modern għar-riċerka.
formal.en: The laboratory is technologically advanced and offers modern research equipment.
formal.zh: 该实验室科技先进，提供现代化的研究设备。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif inhu l-laboratorju l-ġdid? Mark: Teknoloġikament huwa avvanzat ħafna; għandu tagħmir li qatt ma użajt qabel.
colloquial.en: Maja: What's the new laboratory like? Mark: Technologically, it's very advanced; it has equipment I've never used before.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：新实验室怎么样？马克：科技方面很先进，有些设备我以前从没用过。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 新实验室怎么样？
messages.en: What's the new laboratory like?

messages.speaker: Mark (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Teknoloġikament huwa avvanzat ħafna; għandu tagħmir li qatt ma użajt qabel.
messages.mt_standard: Teknoloġikament huwa avvanzat ħafna; għandu tagħmir li qatt ma użajt qabel.
messages.zh: 科技方面很先进，有些设备我以前从没用过。
messages.en: Technologically, it's very advanced; it has equipment I've never used before.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象参观配满现代设备的实验室，评价它在科技方面有多先进，用这个副词限定评价角度。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An object or mechanism that makes a ticking sound.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 发出滴答声的物件或机械装置。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Oġġett jew mekkaniżmu li jagħmel ħoss ta' tik-tik.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 发出滴答声的东西或装置。

collocations.zh: 发出滴答声的机械物件

formal.mt: Għall-eżerċizzju tas-smigħ, l-għalliem poġġa tektiek żgħir fuq il-mejda.
formal.en: For the listening exercise, the teacher placed a small ticking object on the table.
formal.zh: 为了进行听辨练习，老师把一个发出滴答声的小物件放在桌上。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhu dak it-tektiek fuq il-mejda? Mark: Mekkaniżmu żgħir; isma' l-ħoss li jagħmel.
colloquial.en: Maja: What's that ticking thing on the table? Mark: A small mechanism; listen to the sound it makes.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：桌上那个滴答响的东西是什么？马克：一个小机械装置，你听它发出的声音。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 桌上那个滴答响的东西是什么？
messages.en: What's that ticking thing on the table?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Mekkaniżmu żgħir; isma' l-ħoss li jagħmel.
messages.mt_standard: Mekkaniżmu żgħir; isma' l-ħoss li jagħmel.
messages.zh: 一个小机械装置，你听它发出的声音。
messages.en: A small mechanism; listen to the sound it makes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 听到滴答声后指向发声的物件，用 tektiek 给这个东西命名，重点记住它是名词。

gloss_zh: 容易发出滴答声的；爱滴答响的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a tendency to make a ticking sound.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有容易或经常发出滴答声这一倾向的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu tendenza li jagħmel ħoss ta' tik-tik.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 容易或经常发出滴答声的。

collocations.en: a mechanism that tends to tick
collocations.zh: 容易发出滴答声的机械装置

collocations.en: a clock that tends to tick

formal.mt: Il-mekkaniżmu tektieki ntuża biex l-istudenti jagħrfu ħoss ripetut.
formal.en: The mechanism that tends to tick was used to help students recognize a repeated sound.
formal.zh: 这个容易发出滴答声的机械装置被用于帮助学生辨认重复的声音。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan l-arloġġ huwa tektieki ħafna. Mark: Iva, bil-lejl nisimgħu minn kamra oħra.
colloquial.en: Maja: This clock really tends to tick. Mark: Yes, at night I can hear it from another room.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个钟特别爱滴答响。马克：是啊，晚上我在另一个房间都听得到。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 这个钟特别爱滴答响。
messages.en: This clock really tends to tick.

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, bil-lejl nisimgħu minn kamra oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, bil-lejl nisimgħu minn kamra oħra.
messages.zh: 是啊，晚上我在另一个房间都听得到。
messages.en: Yes, at night I can hear it from another room.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给钟贴上爱滴答响的标签来记忆：tektieki 描写物件的发声倾向，是形容词。

gloss_zh: 轻敲；滴答作响；咔嗒作响

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action or sound of tapping, ticking, or clacking.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 轻敲、滴答作响或咔嗒作响的动作及其声音。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni jew il-ħoss ta' daqqiet ħfief, ta' tik-tik jew ta' tħabbit b'ħoss iebes u qasir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 轻敲的动作或轻轻敲击产生的声音。
滴答作响的动作或滴答声。
咔嗒作响的动作或硬物碰击产生的短促响声。

formal.mt: Waqt il-qari fis-skiet, it-tektik regolari tal-arloġġ kien jinstema' fil-kamra.
formal.en: During silent reading, the regular ticking of the clock could be heard in the room.
formal.zh: 默读时，房间里能听到钟有规律的滴答声。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Tisma' dak it-tektik? Mark: Iva, ġej mit-tastiera; Sara qed tikteb.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can you hear that clacking? Mark: Yes, it's coming from the keyboard; Sara is typing.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你听到那个咔嗒声了吗？马克：听到了，是键盘发出的，萨拉正在打字。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 你听到那个咔嗒声了吗？
messages.en: Can you hear that clacking?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ġej mit-tastiera; Sara qed tikteb.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ġej mit-tastiera; Sara qed tikteb.
messages.zh: 听到了，是键盘发出的，萨拉正在打字。
messages.en: Yes, it's coming from the keyboard; Sara is typing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 依次想象指尖轻敲桌面、钟滴答走动、键盘咔嗒作响，用三种声音记住这个动作及声音名词。

gloss_zh: 投大硬币击倒小硬币堆的赌钱游戏

teaching_sense.en_definition: A game played for money in which a large coin is thrown at a heap of smaller coins to knock them over.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种赌钱游戏：玩家向一堆小硬币投掷大硬币，试图将小硬币击倒。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Logħba għall-flus li fiha l-plejers jitfgħu munita kbira lejn munz muniti iżgħar biex iwaqqgħuhom.

sense_translations.en_definition: Name of a game for money (the players throw a large coin at a heap of smaller coins to overthrow them. The coin is thrown around the heap (għaċ-ċirku) or flat (għaċ-ċatt) against it either with full force or slowly)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一种赌钱游戏的名称：玩家向小硬币堆投掷大硬币，试图将其击倒；投法可以是绕向硬币堆（għaċ-ċirku），也可以是将硬币平着投向硬币堆（għaċ-ċatt），可用全力，也可缓缓投出。

collocations.zh: 一场投币击堆赌钱游戏

formal.mt: Fit-tektikija, il-plejers jitfgħu munita kbira lejn munz muniti iżgħar bil-għan li jwaqqgħuhom.
formal.en: In tektikija, players throw a large coin at a heap of smaller coins with the aim of knocking them over.
formal.zh: 在 tektikija 这种游戏中，玩家向一堆小硬币投掷大硬币，目的是把小硬币击倒。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif tintlagħab it-tektikija? Pawlu: Titfa' munita kbira lejn munz muniti żgħar biex twaqqagħhom.
colloquial.en: Maja: How do you play tektikija? Pawlu: You throw a large coin at a heap of small coins to knock them over.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：tektikija 怎么玩？保罗：把一枚大硬币投向一堆小硬币，试着把它们击倒。

messages.speaker: Maja (学习者)
messages.zh: tektikija 怎么玩？
messages.en: How do you play tektikija?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (讲解者)
messages.mt_spoken: Titfa' munita kbira lejn munz muniti żgħar biex twaqqagħhom.
messages.mt_standard: Titfa' munita kbira lejn munz muniti żgħar biex twaqqagħhom.
messages.zh: 把一枚大硬币投向一堆小硬币，试着把它们击倒。
messages.en: You throw a large coin at a heap of small coins to knock them over.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tektikija 和“大币撞倒小币堆”的画面绑定记忆；这幅画面帮助记住它是具体的赌钱游戏名称。

gloss_zh: 易滴答作响的；爱喋喋不休的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Tending to tick or beat; also describing someone who talks a great deal.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容容易发出滴答声或搏动的；也形容一个人话很多、爱喋喋不休。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu tendenza jtektek jew iħabbat; jingħad ukoll għal min jitkellem ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 容易发出滴答声或有节奏地敲击、搏动的。
形容人话特别多、爱喋喋不休的。

collocations.en: a clock that tends to tick

collocations.zh: 一个爱说个不停的男孩

formal.mt: L-aġġettiv tektuki jista' jiddeskrivi arloġġ li jtektek jew persuna li titkellem ħafna.
formal.en: The adjective tektuki can describe a ticking clock or a person who talks a great deal.
formal.zh: 形容词 tektuki 可以描述滴答作响的钟，也可以描述话很多的人。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ħuk tektuki, hux? Lara: Iva, dejjem għandu xi ħaġa x'jgħid!
colloquial.en: Maja: Your brother is a chatterbox, isn't he? Lara: Yes, he always has something to say!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你弟弟很爱说话，对吧？拉拉：是啊，他总有话说！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你弟弟很爱说话，对吧？
messages.en: Your brother is a chatterbox, isn't he?

messages.speaker: Lara (姐姐)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, dejjem għandu xi ħaġa x'jgħid!
messages.mt_standard: Iva, dejjem għandu xi ħaġa x'jgħid!
messages.zh: 是啊，他总有话说！
messages.en: Yes, he always has something to say!

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 tektuki 配两幅学习画面：钟表滴答不停、孩子说话不停；用“持续出声”串联两个义项，不把它当作词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A device used to speak to someone at a distance through a telephone connection.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过电话连接与远处的人交谈的通信设备。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Apparat li jintuża biex titkellem ma' persuna li tinsab 'il bogħod permezz ta' konnessjoni telefonika.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 电话；用于远距离通话的电话机或电话设备。

formal.mt: Jekk jogħġbok, ikteb in-numru tat-telefon tiegħek fuq il-formola sabiex inkunu nistgħu nikkuntattjawk.
formal.en: Please write your telephone number on the form so that we can contact you.
formal.zh: 请在表格上填写您的电话号码，以便我们与您联系。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Qed idoqq it-telefon. Tista' twieġeb? Mark: Iva, inwieġeb jien.
colloquial.en: Maja: The telephone is ringing. Can you answer it? Mark: Yes, I'll answer it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：电话响了，你能接一下吗？马克：可以，我来接。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 电话响了，你能接一下吗？
messages.en: The telephone is ringing. Can you answer it?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 可以，我来接。
messages.en: Yes, I'll answer it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 telefon 和英语 telephone 对照朗读，再连着记 numru tat-telefon“电话号码”，用熟悉的通话场景巩固词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The loss of something, or a defeat in a contest or competition.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 失去某物或由此造成的损失；也指在比赛或竞争中落败。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-fatt li titlef xi ħaġa, jew li ma tirbaħx f'logħba jew f'kompetizzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 失去；损失，指原有的东西、资源或价值不再拥有或有所减少。
失败；落败，指在比赛、较量或竞争中未能获胜。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi t-telf ta' flus li ġarrbet il-kumpanija matul is-sena.
formal.en: The report describes the loss of money suffered by the company during the year.
formal.zh: 报告说明了公司在这一年遭受的金钱损失。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Kif ħassejtek wara t-telf tat-tim? Pawlu: Kont imdejjaq, imma nittama li nirbħu l-logħba li jmiss.
colloquial.en: Mark: How did you feel after the team's defeat? Pawlu: I was upset, but I hope we win the next game.
colloquial.zh: 马克：球队输了以后，你感觉怎么样？保罗：我很难过，不过希望我们下一场能赢。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 球队输了以后，你感觉怎么样？
messages.en: How did you feel after the team's defeat?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (球迷)
messages.mt_spoken: Kont imdejjaq, imma nittama li nirbħu l-logħba li jmiss.
messages.mt_standard: Kont imdejjaq, imma nittama li nirbħu l-logħba li jmiss.
messages.zh: 我很难过，不过希望我们下一场能赢。
messages.en: I was upset, but I hope we win the next game.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 telf 时并排想象“钱包少了钱”和“球队输了球”：前者是损失，后者是落败，两个义项分别练习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action of going upwards, or the upward slope of a surface or route.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向上移动或上行这一过程；也指地面或路线向上倾斜的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li titla' 'l fuq, jew l-inklinazzjoni 'l fuq ta' wiċċ jew ta' triq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 上升；上行，指向较高位置移动这一过程。
向上倾斜；上坡，指地面或路线逐渐升高的状态。

collocations.en: the upward slope of the road

formal.mt: Minħabba t-telgħan tat-triq, il-grupp mexa bil-mod u għamel diversi waqfiet.
formal.en: Because of the upward slope of the road, the group walked slowly and made several stops.
formal.zh: 由于道路向上倾斜，一行人走得很慢，中途停了几次。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex waqaft waqt it-telgħan? Mark: Għejjejt ftit. Nistrieħ minuta u nkompli.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you stop during the ascent? Mark: I got a little tired. I'll rest for a minute and carry on.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你怎么在上行途中停下来了？马克：有点累了。我歇一分钟再继续。

messages.speaker: Maja (徒步同伴)
messages.zh: 你怎么在上行途中停下来了？
messages.en: Why did you stop during the ascent?

messages.speaker: Mark (徒步同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Għejjejt ftit. Nistrieħ minuta u nkompli.
messages.mt_standard: Għejjejt ftit. Nistrieħ minuta u nkompli.
messages.zh: 有点累了。我歇一分钟再继续。
messages.en: I got a little tired. I'll rest for a minute and carry on.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 telgħan 画一条向上的斜线：沿线移动是“上行”，线本身的坡势是“向上倾斜”；本条把两者都作为名词意义记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A worker who repairs dents and damage in the metal body panels of vehicles.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 修复车辆金属车身板件凹痕和损伤的工人，即汽车钣金修理工。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħaddiem li jsewwi daqqiet u ħsarat fil-partijiet tal-metall tal-karozzerija tal-vetturi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 汽车钣金修理工，负责整修车身金属板件的凹痕和变形。

collocations.en: to take the car to the panel-beater
collocations.zh: 把汽车送去给钣金工修理

formal.mt: It-tellar eżamina l-ħsara fil-bieba tal-karozza u ħejja stima tal-ispiża tat-tiswija.
formal.en: The panel-beater examined the damage to the car door and prepared an estimate of the repair cost.
formal.zh: 钣金修理工检查了车门的损伤，并编制了维修费用估算。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għandi daqqa fil-bieba tal-karozza. Taf xi tellar tajjeb? Lara: Iva, nagħtik in-numru tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Mark: I have a dent in my car door. Do you know a good panel-beater? Lara: Yes, I'll give you his number.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我的车门凹了一块。你认识手艺好的钣金工吗？拉拉：认识，我把他的号码给你。

messages.speaker: Mark (车主)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi daqqa fil-bieba tal-karozza. Taf xi tellar tajjeb?
messages.mt_standard: Għandi daqqa fil-bieba tal-karozza. Taf xi tellar tajjeb?
messages.zh: 我的车门凹了一块。你认识手艺好的钣金工吗？
messages.en: I have a dent in my car door. Do you know a good panel-beater?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 认识，我把他的号码给你。
messages.en: Yes, I'll give you his number.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tellar 放进“车门凹了，找人敲平”的维修画面，再连记 tellar tal-karozzi，明确他负责车身钣金。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The Eurasian stone-curlew, Burhinus oedicnemus; also a person who talks a great deal.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 欧石鸻，学名 Burhinus oedicnemus；也指话特别多、爱说个不停的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasfur tal-ispeċi Burhinus oedicnemus; il-kelma tintuża wkoll għal persuna li titkellem ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 欧石鸻，学名 Burhinus oedicnemus，一种鸟。
话匣子；话特别多、爱喋喋不休的人。

collocations.en: a Eurasian stone-curlew in the field
a chatterbox who never stops talking
collocations.zh: 一个说起话来没完的话匣子

formal.mt: Fil-lista tal-għasafar osservati hemm it-tellerit, bl-isem xjentifiku Burhinus oedicnemus.
formal.en: The list of observed birds includes the Eurasian stone-curlew, with the scientific name Burhinus oedicnemus.
formal.zh: 观察到的鸟类名单中包括欧石鸻，其学名为 Burhinus oedicnemus。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Pawlu tellerit, hux? Mark: Iva, jekk tibda titkellem miegħu, dejjem ikollu storja oħra!
colloquial.en: Maja: Pawlu is a chatterbox, isn't he? Mark: Yes, once you start talking to him, he always has another story!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗是个话匣子，对吧？马克：是啊，一跟他聊起来，他总有下一个故事！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗是个话匣子，对吧？
messages.en: Pawlu is a chatterbox, isn't he?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jekk tibda titkellem miegħu, dejjem ikollu storja oħra!
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jekk tibda titkellem miegħu, dejjem ikollu storja oħra!
messages.zh: 是啊，一跟他聊起来，他总有下一个故事！
messages.en: Yes, once you start talking to him, he always has another story!

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 tellerit 做一张双面词卡：一面写“欧石鸻”和学名，另一面画说个不停的人；分别记住鸟名与“话匣子”两个名词义。

gloss_zh: 造成损失的；导致亏损的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Causing or resulting in a loss.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 会造成损失或以损失告终的，也可描述导致经济亏损的事情。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jwassal għal telf jew li jġib telf.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 造成损失的；结果导致损失或亏损的。

collocations.en: an agreement that results in a loss

formal.mt: Il-ftehim kien telliefi għall-kumpanija, għax l-ispejjeż kienu ogħla mid-dħul.
formal.en: The agreement resulted in a loss for the company because the costs were higher than the revenue.
formal.zh: 这份协议给公司造成了亏损，因为支出高于收入。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Dan in-negozju telliefi? Lara: Iva, qed nonfqu aktar milli naqilgħu.
colloquial.en: Mark: Is this business making a loss? Lara: Yes, we're spending more than we're earning.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这门生意在亏钱吗？拉拉：是啊，我们花的比赚的多。

messages.speaker: Mark (生意合伙人)
messages.zh: 这门生意在亏钱吗？
messages.en: Is this business making a loss?

messages.speaker: Lara (生意合伙人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qed nonfqu aktar milli naqilgħu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qed nonfqu aktar milli naqilgħu.
messages.zh: 是啊，我们花的比赚的多。
messages.en: Yes, we're spending more than we're earning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 telliefi 写在“支出大于收入”的账本旁，记成“造成损失的”这一形容词；与 telf“损失”对照练习词性。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who raises or lifts something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某物举起、提升或升起的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tgħolli jew ittella' xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把某物举起、提升或升起的人。

collocations.en: a person who raises the flag
a person who raises the curtain

formal.mt: Waqt iċ-ċerimonja, it-telliegħ tal-bandiera għandu jistenna s-sinjal qabel jibda.
formal.en: During the ceremony, the person raising the flag must wait for the signal before beginning.
formal.zh: 仪式中，升旗的人必须等待信号才能开始。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min se jkun it-telliegħ tal-bandiera llum? Pawlu: Jien. Se nistenna s-sinjal tiegħek.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who will raise the flag today? Pawlu: I will. I'll wait for your signal.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：今天谁来升旗？保罗：我来。我会等你的信号。

messages.speaker: Maja (活动组织者)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jkun it-telliegħ tal-bandiera llum?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jkun it-telliegħ tal-bandiera llum?
messages.zh: 今天谁来升旗？
messages.en: Who will raise the flag today?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (志愿者)
messages.zh: 我来。我会等你的信号。
messages.en: I will. I'll wait for your signal.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象仪式上负责把旗帜升起的人，用“升起某物的执行者”记住这个名词。

gloss_zh: 赛马放马员；遗弃配偶的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who releases the horses at a horse race; in another sense, a person who abandons their spouse.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 赛马时负责放出马匹的人；另一个义项指遗弃配偶的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li titlaq iż-żwiemel fit-tiġrijiet; f'tifsira oħra, persuna li tabbanduna lil żewġha jew lil martha.

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who lets the horses out during horse races
sense_translations.zh_definition: 赛马时负责放出马匹、让马匹起跑的人。
遗弃自己配偶的人。

collocations.en: the person who releases the racehorses
the role of the person who releases the horses

formal.mt: Qabel it-tiġrija, it-tellieq għandu jistenna s-sinjal biex jitlaq iż-żwiemel.
formal.en: Before the race, the person responsible for releasing the horses must wait for the signal to let them go.
formal.zh: 比赛开始前，放马员必须等待信号才能放出马匹。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dak ir-raġel ħdejn iż-żwiemel x'jagħmel? Mark: Hu t-tellieq; jitlaqhom meta jingħata s-sinjal.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does that man next to the horses do? Mark: He's the person who releases them; he lets them go when the signal is given.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：马匹旁边那个人是做什么的？马克：他是放马员，收到信号就放马起跑。

messages.speaker: Lara (观众)
messages.zh: 马匹旁边那个人是做什么的？
messages.en: What does that man next to the horses do?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu t-tellieq; jitlaqhom meta jingħata s-sinjal.
messages.mt_standard: Hu t-tellieq; jitlaqhom meta jingħata s-sinjal.
messages.zh: 他是放马员，收到信号就放马起跑。
messages.en: He's the person who releases them; he lets them go when the signal is given.

cognitive_memory_aid: 分成两幅情境图记忆：赛场上放出马匹的人，家庭中遗弃配偶的人；读句子时靠语境选义。

gloss_zh: 使增至三倍的；制作三份的

teaching_sense.en_definition: That makes a quantity three times its original size or produces three copies.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使数量变为原来三倍的，或把内容制作成三份的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jimmultiplika kwantità bi tlieta jew jipproduċi tliet kopji.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使数量或数值变为原来三倍的。
将同一内容制作成三份的。

collocations.en: a mechanism that trebles a quantity
collocations.zh: 使数量增至三倍的机制

collocations.en: a device that produces three copies

formal.mt: L-apparat tellieti deskritt f'dan l-eżempju jipproduċi tliet kopji ta' kull dokument.
formal.en: The triplicating device described in this example produces three copies of each document.
formal.zh: 本例描述的三份复制设备会为每份文件制作三份副本。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'jiġifieri apparat tellieti f'dan l-eżempju? David: Jiġifieri li jagħmel tliet kopji tal-istess dokument.
colloquial.en: Nina: What does a triplicating device mean in this example? David: It means a device that makes three copies of the same document.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这个例子里的三份复制设备是什么意思？戴维：就是能把同一份文件复制成三份的设备。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: 这个例子里的三份复制设备是什么意思？
messages.en: What does a triplicating device mean in this example?

messages.speaker: David (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Jiġifieri li jagħmel tliet kopji tal-istess dokument.
messages.mt_standard: Jiġifieri li jagħmel tliet kopji tal-istess dokument.
messages.zh: 就是能把同一份文件复制成三份的设备。
messages.en: It means a device that makes three copies of the same document.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在词卡旁画“数量乘三”和“文件三份”两幅图，分别记住增至三倍与制作三份两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A sack or pouch used to hold or carry things.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于装盛或携带物品的袋子，可以指大袋或小袋。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xkora jew borża żgħira li tintuża biex iżżomm jew iġġorr l-affarijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 袋子、囊袋；可指大袋或小袋。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem poġġa l-qamħ fit-tellisa u għalaqha sew qabel ġarrha lejn il-maħżen.
formal.en: The worker put the wheat in the sack and closed it securely before carrying it to the storehouse.
formal.zh: 工人把小麦装进袋子，扎紧袋口后将它搬到仓库。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Fejn inpoġġi dawn iż-żrieragħ? Ġużi: Poġġihom fit-tellisa żgħira ħdejn il-bieb.
colloquial.en: Anna: Where shall I put these seeds? Ġużi: Put them in the small pouch by the door.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：这些种子放在哪里？朱齐：放进门边那个小袋里。

messages.speaker: Anna (园艺学员)
messages.zh: 这些种子放在哪里？
messages.en: Where shall I put these seeds?

messages.speaker: Ġużi (园丁)
messages.zh: 放进门边那个小袋里。
messages.en: Put them in the small pouch by the door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把散落的种子收进一个袋子，再把袋口扎好，用“装东西的袋”这一画面记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The chemical element tellurium.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 化学元素碲的名称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-element kimiku magħruf bħala tellurju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 碲，一种化学元素。

formal.mt: Fir-rapport tal-laboratorju, l-istudenta ddeskriviet il-kampjun ta' tellurju li eżaminat.
formal.en: In the laboratory report, the student described the sample of tellurium she examined.
formal.zh: 学生在实验报告中描述了她检验的碲样品。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'hemm miktub fuq din it-tikketta? Daniel: Tellurju. Hu l-isem ta' element kimiku.
colloquial.en: Sara: What's written on this label? Daniel: Tellurium. It's the name of a chemical element.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这个标签上写的是什么？丹尼尔：碲。是一种化学元素的名称。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 这个标签上写的是什么？
messages.en: What's written on this label?

messages.speaker: Daniel (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tellurju. Hu l-isem ta' element kimiku.
messages.mt_standard: Tellurju. Hu l-isem ta' element kimiku.
messages.zh: 碲。是一种化学元素的名称。
messages.en: Tellurium. It's the name of a chemical element.

cognitive_memory_aid: 制作一张三语标签，把 tellurju、tellurium 和“碲”并排写在同一张元素词卡上记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A state of weariness, low energy, or sluggishness.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 感到疲乏、缺少精力或精神萎靡的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Stat ta' għeja, nuqqas ta' enerġija jew nuqqas ta' ħeġġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 倦怠；身心疲乏、提不起劲的状态。
萎靡无力；精神不振、行动迟缓的状态。

formal.mt: Wara l-vjaġġ twil, ħasset telqa kbira u sabitha diffiċli biex tikkonċentra fuq il-qari.
formal.en: After the long journey, she felt very lethargic and found it difficult to concentrate on reading.
formal.zh: 长途旅行后，她感到十分倦怠，很难集中精神阅读。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex qed titkellem daqshekk bil-mod illum? Toni: Għandi telqa kbira wara l-vjaġġ; irrid nistrieħ ftit.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why are you speaking so slowly today? Toni: I feel very sluggish after the journey; I need to rest a little.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：你今天怎么说话这么慢？托尼：旅行回来浑身没劲，想休息一会儿。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed titkellem daqshekk bil-mod illum?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed titkellem daqshekk bil-mod illum?
messages.zh: 你今天怎么说话这么慢？
messages.en: Why are you speaking so slowly today?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi telqa kbira wara l-vjaġġ; irrid nistrieħ ftit.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi telqa kbira wara l-vjaġġ; irrid nistrieħ ftit.
messages.zh: 旅行回来浑身没劲，想休息一会儿。
messages.en: I feel very sluggish after the journey; I need to rest a little.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象长途旅行后瘫坐在椅子上，连翻书都提不起劲，用这份倦怠感记住 telqa。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To give food to someone or something, or to provide the means for someone to live.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 给人或动物提供食物；也指提供生活所需，维持某人的生计。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħti l-ikel lil xi ħadd jew lil xi annimal, jew jipprovdi lil xi ħadd b'dak li jeħtieġ biex jgħix.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 喂食；给人或动物提供食物。

sense_translations.en_definition: to maintain, to provide a living
sense_translations.zh_definition: 供养；提供生活所需，维持某人的生计。

formal.mt: Għal ħafna snin, tema' lill-familja tiegħu bid-dħul mix-xogħol tiegħu.
formal.en: For many years, he provided for his family with the income from his work.
formal.zh: 多年来，他用自己的工作收入供养家人。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Min tema' lill-kelb dalgħodu? Luqa: Jien. Tajtu l-ikel qabel ħriġt.
colloquial.en: Rita: Who fed the dog this morning? Luqa: I did. I gave him his food before I went out.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：今天早上谁喂了狗？卢卡：我喂的。我出门前给它吃了东西。

messages.speaker: Rita (母亲)
messages.zh: 今天早上谁喂了狗？
messages.en: Who fed the dog this morning?

messages.speaker: Luqa (儿子)
messages.zh: 我喂的。我出门前给它吃了东西。
messages.en: I did. I gave him his food before I went out.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先想“把饭送到嘴边”的喂养，再扩展到“让一家人有饭吃”的供养，串联两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The conclusion of something or the act of bringing it to completion.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某事的结束，或把某项事情做完、使其完成的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-tmiem ta' xi ħaġa jew l-att li wieħed ilestiha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 结束；某件事情告一段落或终结。
完成的行为；把某件事情做完。

formal.mt: Wara t-temim tax-xogħol, il-grupp ippreżenta rapport dwar ir-riżultati.
formal.en: After the completion of the work, the group presented a report on the results.
formal.zh: 工作完成后，小组提交了一份关于成果的报告。

colloquial.mt: Elena: X'għad fadal għat-temim tal-proġett? Samwel: Irridu niċċekkjaw l-aħħar paġna, u mbagħad ikun lest.
colloquial.en: Elena: What remains to be done to complete the project? Samwel: We need to check the last page, and then it'll be ready.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：项目完成前还剩什么要做？萨姆韦尔：我们还要检查最后一页，然后就完成了。

messages.speaker: Elena (项目组长)
messages.zh: 项目完成前还剩什么要做？
messages.en: What remains to be done to complete the project?

messages.speaker: Samwel (组员)
messages.mt_spoken: Irridu niċċekkjaw l-aħħar paġna, u mbagħad ikun lest.
messages.mt_standard: Irridu niċċekkjaw l-aħħar paġna, u mbagħad ikun lest.
messages.zh: 我们还要检查最后一页，然后就完成了。
messages.en: We need to check the last page, and then it'll be ready.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象任务清单的最后一个方框被打勾：既表示事情结束，也表示把事情完成这一行为。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The fulfilment of a promise, wish, or obligation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 承诺、愿望或义务得到兑现、实现或履行。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-twettiq ta' wegħda, xewqa jew obbligu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 履行；兑现；实现
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-twettiq ta' dak li jkun imwiegħed, mixtieq jew meħtieġ.

formal.mt: Il-ftuħ tal-iskola kien it-temma ta' wegħda magħmula lill-komunità.
formal.en: The opening of the school was the fulfilment of a promise made to the community.
formal.zh: 学校的落成开放兑现了向社区作出的承诺。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser 'it-temma ta' xewqa'? Pawlu: Tfisser li x-xewqa ssir realtà, bħal meta fl-aħħar iżżur post li dejjem xtaqt tara.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'the fulfilment of a wish' mean? Pawlu: It means the wish becomes reality, like finally visiting a place you have always wanted to see.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：‘愿望的实现’是什么意思？保罗：就是愿望变成现实，比如终于去到一个一直想看的地方。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: ‘愿望的实现’是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'the fulfilment of a wish' mean?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser li x-xewqa ssir realtà, bħal meta fl-aħħar iżżur post li dejjem xtaqt tara.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser li x-xewqa ssir realtà, bħal meta fl-aħħar iżżur post li dejjem xtaqt tara.
messages.zh: 就是愿望变成现实，比如终于去到一个一直想看的地方。
messages.en: It means the wish becomes reality, like finally visiting a place you have always wanted to see.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把承诺旁边画上兑现的勾，用这个画面记住 temma 表示履行或实现。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To feed someone or make someone eat; in another sense, to throw something at someone's face.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 给某人喂食或使某人进食；另一个义项是把东西朝某人的脸扔去。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħti lil xi ħadd x'jiekol jew iġiegħlu jiekol; f'tifsira oħra, iwaddab xi ħaġa f'wiċċ xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某人进食；给某人喂食
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jagħti lil xi ħadd x'jiekol jew iġiegħlu jiekol.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把东西朝某人的脸扔去
sense_translations.mt_definition: Iwaddab xi ħaġa f'wiċċ xi ħadd.

collocations.en: fed the boy with a spoon

formal.mt: Il-missier temma' lit-tarbija bil-mod, skont il-parir tal-infermiera.
formal.en: The father fed the baby slowly, following the nurse's advice.
formal.zh: 父亲按照护士的建议，慢慢地给婴儿喂食。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min temma' lit-tarbija dalgħodu? Mark: Jien. Kielet ftit u mbagħad raqdet.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who fed the baby this morning? Mark: I did. She ate a little and then fell asleep.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：今天早上谁给宝宝喂食了？马克：我喂的。她吃了一点，然后就睡着了。

messages.speaker: Lara (母亲)
messages.zh: 今天早上谁给宝宝喂食了？
messages.en: Who fed the baby this morning?

messages.speaker: Mark (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien. Kielet ftit u mbagħad raqdet.
messages.mt_standard: Jien. Kielet ftit u mbagħad raqdet.
messages.zh: 我喂的。她吃了一点，然后就睡着了。
messages.en: I did. She ate a little and then fell asleep.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用拿勺喂宝宝的画面记住喂食义，再单独记住朝脸投掷义；留意词尾的撇号。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make something perfect or fully developed, or to fulfil a promise or obligation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某事物达到完善的状态；也指履行承诺或义务。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel xi ħaġa perfetta jew żviluppata għalkollox, jew iwettaq wegħda jew obbligu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使完善；使达到完美
履行；兑现；实现
sense_translations.mt_definition: Iwettaq dak li jkun imwiegħed jew meħtieġ.

collocations.zh: 使自己的技艺臻于完善

formal.mt: L-artist temmem is-sengħa tiegħu permezz ta' snin ta' studju u prattika.
formal.en: The artist perfected his craft through years of study and practice.
formal.zh: 这位艺术家通过多年的学习与实践，使自己的技艺臻于完善。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex tgħid li n-nannu temmem il-wegħda tiegħu? Luqa: Għax wiegħed li jgħallimni naqra, u hekk għamel.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why do you say that Grandad fulfilled his promise? Luqa: Because he promised to teach me to read, and he did.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你为什么说爷爷兑现了承诺？卢卡：因为他答应教我认字，而且真的做到了。

messages.speaker: Sara (姐姐)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex tgħid li n-nannu temmem il-wegħda tiegħu?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex tgħid li n-nannu temmem il-wegħda tiegħu?
messages.zh: 你为什么说爷爷兑现了承诺？
messages.en: Why do you say that Grandad fulfilled his promise?

messages.speaker: Luqa (弟弟)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax wiegħed li jgħallimni naqra, u hekk għamel.
messages.mt_standard: Għax wiegħed li jgħallimni naqra, u hekk għamel.
messages.zh: 因为他答应教我认字，而且真的做到了。
messages.en: Because he promised to teach me to read, and he did.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把打磨作品和兑现承诺并排记忆：temmem 既能表示使完善，也能表示履行。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who gives food to another person or to animals.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 给他人喂食或给动物提供食物的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tagħti l-ikel lil persuni oħra jew lill-annimali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 喂食的人；给人或动物提供食物的人
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xi ħadd li jagħti l-ikel lil ħaddieħor jew lill-annimali.

formal.mt: It-temmiegħ tal-annimali jqassam l-ikel skont il-ħtiġijiet ta' kull annimal.
formal.en: The person who feeds the animals distributes food according to each animal's needs.
formal.zh: 饲喂者根据每只动物的需要分配食物。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Min hu t-temmiegħ tal-għasafar hawn? Toni: Jien nagħtihom l-ikel kull filgħodu.
colloquial.en: Nina: Who feeds the birds here? Toni: I give them food every morning.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这里谁负责给鸟喂食？托尼：我每天早上给它们喂食。

messages.speaker: Nina (访客)
messages.zh: 这里谁负责给鸟喂食？
messages.en: Who feeds the birds here?

messages.speaker: Toni (饲养员)
messages.zh: 我每天早上给它们喂食。
messages.en: I give them food every morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象提着食物桶来喂动物的人，把 temmiegħ 记成人物名称：喂食者。

gloss_zh: 与喂食有关的；饲喂方面的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Connected with feeding a person or an animal.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与给人或动物喂食这一活动有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-għoti tal-ikel lil persuna jew lil annimal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 与喂食有关的；与饲喂有关的

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi r-rwol temmiegħi tal-ġenituri fil-kura tal-frieħ.
formal.en: The report describes the parents' feeding role in caring for their young.
formal.zh: 报告描述了亲代在照料幼体时承担的喂食职责。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser 'rwol temmiegħi' f'dan it-test? Rita: Ifisser ir-rwol li wieħed ikollu biex jagħti l-ikel, bħal għasfur li jitma' lill-frieħ.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'a feeding role' mean in this text? Rita: It means the role someone has in providing food, like a bird feeding its young.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这篇文章里的‘喂食职责’是什么意思？丽塔：就是提供食物的职责，比如鸟给幼鸟喂食。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这篇文章里的‘喂食职责’是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'a feeding role' mean in this text?

messages.speaker: Rita (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser ir-rwol li wieħed ikollu biex jagħti l-ikel, bħal għasfur li jitma' lill-frieħ.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser ir-rwol li wieħed ikollu biex jagħti l-ikel, bħal għasfur li jitma' lill-frieħ.
messages.zh: 就是提供食物的职责，比如鸟给幼鸟喂食。
messages.en: It means the role someone has in providing food, like a bird feeding its young.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 temmiegħi 写在喂食流程图旁，提醒自己这是形容词，表示与喂食有关。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who brings an activity, discussion, or other undertaking to a conclusion.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某项活动、讨论或其他事情结束的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li ġġib attività, diskussjoni jew xi ħaġa oħra fi tmiemha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某事结束的人；负责收尾的人
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xi ħadd li jġib xi ħaġa fi tmiemha.

collocations.en: a person who brings the discussion to a close
a person who concludes the meeting

formal.mt: Bħala temmiem tad-diskussjoni, il-moderatur ġabar il-punti ewlenin u rringrazzja lill-parteċipanti.
formal.en: As the person bringing the discussion to a close, the moderator summarized the main points and thanked the participants.
formal.zh: 作为为讨论收尾的人，主持人概括了要点，并向参与者致谢。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min se jkun it-temmiem tad-diskussjoni? Mark: Jien. Se niġbor il-punti u nagħlaq il-laqgħa.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who will bring the discussion to a close? Mark: I will. I'll summarize the points and close the meeting.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：谁来为讨论收尾？马克：我来。我会概括要点，然后结束会议。

messages.speaker: Lara (会议组织者)
messages.zh: 谁来为讨论收尾？
messages.en: Who will bring the discussion to a close?

messages.speaker: Mark (主持人)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien. Se niġbor il-punti u nagħlaq il-laqgħa.
messages.mt_standard: Jien. Se niġbor il-punti u nagħlaq il-laqgħa.
messages.zh: 我来。我会概括要点，然后结束会议。
messages.en: I will. I'll summarize the points and close the meeting.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象会议最后站起来概括并宣布结束的人，temmiem 就是这样的收尾者。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Providing a definite conclusion or settling a question.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能够得出明确结论或使某个问题得到定论的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jwassal għal konklużjoni ċara jew jaqta' kwistjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 结论性的；确凿而足以定论的
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jagħti konklużjoni ċara u jsolvi d-dubju dwar kwistjoni.

collocations.zh: 足以得出明确结论的结果

formal.mt: L-esperiment ta riżultat temmiemi li solva l-kwistjoni.
formal.en: The experiment produced a conclusive result that settled the question.
formal.zh: 实验得出了足以定论的结果，解决了这一问题。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dan ir-riżultat huwa temmiemi? Pawlu: Iva, issa għandna tweġiba ċara għall-mistoqsija.
colloquial.en: Nina: Is this result conclusive? Pawlu: Yes, we now have a clear answer to the question.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这个结果足以得出定论吗？保罗：是的，现在我们对这个问题有了明确的答案。

messages.speaker: Nina (研究助理)
messages.zh: 这个结果足以得出定论吗？
messages.en: Is this result conclusive?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (研究员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, issa għandna tweġiba ċara għall-mistoqsija.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, issa għandna tweġiba ċara għall-mistoqsija.
messages.zh: 是的，现在我们对这个问题有了明确的答案。
messages.en: Yes, we now have a clear answer to the question.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个结果让问号变成句号，用这个画面记住 temmiemi 表示足以定论的。

gloss_zh: 情绪多变的；喜怒无常的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having moods that change quickly or reacting emotionally in an unpredictable way.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 情绪容易迅速变化，或情绪反应难以预料的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jibdel il-burdata malajr jew jirreaġixxi b'mod emozzjonali diffiċli biex tbassar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 情绪多变的；喜怒无常的
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li l-burdata tiegħu tinbidel malajr u b'mod diffiċli biex tbassar.

formal.mt: Il-bijografija tiddeskrivi lill-artist bħala temperamentali u tagħti eżempji ta' bidliet f'daqqa fil-burdata tiegħu.
formal.en: The biography describes the artist as temperamental and gives examples of sudden changes in his mood.
formal.zh: 这部传记将艺术家描述为情绪多变的人，并举例说明他的情绪如何突然变化。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex tgħid li hu temperamentali? Luqa: Għax mument ikun ferrieħi u ftit wara jirrabja, u ma nkunx naf għaliex.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why do you say he's temperamental? Luqa: Because one moment he's cheerful and shortly afterwards he gets angry, and I don't know why.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你为什么说他喜怒无常？卢卡：因为他一会儿很开心，没多久又生气了，我也不知道为什么。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么说他喜怒无常？
messages.en: Why do you say he's temperamental?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax mument ikun ferrieħi u ftit wara jirrabja, u ma nkunx naf għaliex.
messages.mt_standard: Għax mument ikun ferrieħi u ftit wara jirrabja, u ma nkunx naf għaliex.
messages.zh: 因为他一会儿很开心，没多久又生气了，我也不知道为什么。
messages.en: Because one moment he's cheerful and shortly afterwards he gets angry, and I don't know why.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把笑脸和生气脸交替排列，记住 temperamentali 描述情绪变化快、反应难预测的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Self-control that keeps one's consumption, desires, or behaviour within moderate limits.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在饮食、欲望或行为方面保持适度、避免过量的自我约束。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kontroll fuq ix-xewqat u l-imġiba biex wieħed iżomm il-qies u jevita l-eċċessi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 节制；适度；避免过量或过度的自我约束。

formal.mt: It-temperanza fl-ikel u x-xorb tgħinna nevitaw l-eċċessi.
formal.en: Moderation in food and drink helps us avoid excess.
formal.zh: 在饮食方面保持节制，有助于我们避免过量。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Se tieħu biċċa kejk oħra? Mark: Le, grazzi. Illum qed nipprova nuri ftit temperanza.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are you having another piece of cake? Mark: No, thanks. Today I'm trying to show a little moderation.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你还要再吃一块蛋糕吗？马克：不了，谢谢。我今天想稍微节制一点。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你还要再吃一块蛋糕吗？
messages.en: Are you having another piece of cake?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, grazzi. Illum qed nipprova nuri ftit temperanza.
messages.mt_standard: Le, grazzi. Illum qed nipprova nuri ftit temperanza.
messages.zh: 不了，谢谢。我今天想稍微节制一点。
messages.en: No, thanks. Today I'm trying to show a little moderation.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象面对第二块蛋糕时轻轻摆手，把 temperanza 记成懂得适可而止的节制。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Mild or moderate rather than extreme, especially in climate or behaviour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 温和、适度而不极端的，尤其用于气候或人的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li mhuwiex estrem jew eċċessiv, speċjalment meta jiddeskrivi klima jew imġiba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 温和的；气候温带的；适度而有节制的。

formal.mt: Dan ir-reġjun għandu klima temperata, mingħajr sħana jew kesħa estrema.
formal.en: This region has a temperate climate, without extreme heat or cold.
formal.zh: 这个地区气候温和，没有极端的炎热或寒冷。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Hemmhekk tagħmel ħafna kesħa? Pawlu: Le, il-klima hi temperata u t-temperaturi mhumiex estremi.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is it very cold there? Pawlu: No, the climate is temperate and the temperatures aren't extreme.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：那里很冷吗？保罗：不，那里气候温和，气温不极端。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 那里很冷吗？
messages.en: Is it very cold there?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, il-klima hi temperata u t-temperaturi mhumiex estremi.
messages.mt_standard: Le, il-klima hi temperata u t-temperaturi mhumiex estremi.
messages.zh: 不，那里气候温和，气温不极端。
messages.en: No, the climate is temperate and the temperatures aren't extreme.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 temperat 放在冷热刻度的中间来记：气候不冷不热，行为不过度；搭配阴性 klima 时用 temperata。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Marked by violent storms, strong winds, or rough seas.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 有猛烈暴风雨、强风或汹涌海浪的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li fih hemm tempesti, riħ qawwi jew mewġ qalil.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 暴风雨猛烈的；狂风大作的；风浪汹涌的。

formal.mt: Minħabba l-baħar tempestuż, il-vjaġġ bid-dgħajsa ġie pospost.
formal.en: Because of the stormy sea, the boat trip was postponed.
formal.zh: 由于海上风浪猛烈，乘船行程被推迟了。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Se noħorġu bid-dgħajsa llum? Toni: Le, il-baħar tempestuż wisq. Aħjar nibqgħu fuq l-art.
colloquial.en: Lara: Are we going out in the boat today? Toni: No, the sea is too stormy. We'd better stay on land.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我们今天要出海吗？托尼：不，海上风浪太大了。我们最好留在岸上。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们今天要出海吗？
messages.en: Are we going out in the boat today?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, il-baħar tempestuż wisq. Aħjar nibqgħu fuq l-art.
messages.mt_standard: Le, il-baħar tempestuż wisq. Aħjar nibqgħu fuq l-art.
messages.zh: 不，海上风浪太大了。我们最好留在岸上。
messages.en: No, the sea is too stormy. We'd better stay on land.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 tempestuż 时想象小船被大浪摇晃，再连读 baħar tempestuż，把词和猛烈风浪的画面绑在一起。

teaching_sense.en_definition: For a limited period of time, rather than permanently.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 只在有限的一段时间内，用来说明某种状态或行动并非永久持续。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għal żmien limitat biss, mhux b'mod permanenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 暂时地；临时地；仅在一段有限时间内。

formal.mt: Il-mużew se jkun magħluq temporanjament waqt ix-xogħlijiet ta' manutenzjoni.
formal.en: The museum will be temporarily closed during maintenance work.
formal.zh: 博物馆将在维护施工期间暂时关闭。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għadek taħdem fl-istess uffiċċju? David: Le, qed naħdem temporanjament mid-dar sakemm jitlesta x-xogħol fl-uffiċċju.
colloquial.en: Nina: Are you still working in the same office? David: No, I'm temporarily working from home until the work at the office is finished.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你还在原来的办公室工作吗？戴维：没有，我暂时在家工作，等办公室的工程完工。

messages.speaker: Nina (同事)
messages.zh: 你还在原来的办公室工作吗？
messages.en: Are you still working in the same office?

messages.speaker: David (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, qed naħdem temporanjament mid-dar sakemm jitlesta x-xogħol fl-uffiċċju.
messages.mt_standard: Le, qed naħdem temporanjament mid-dar sakemm jitlesta x-xogħol fl-uffiċċju.
messages.zh: 没有，我暂时在家工作，等办公室的工程完工。
messages.en: No, I'm temporarily working from home until the work at the office is finished.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象门上贴着会被取下的暂停营业告示：temporanjament 回答状态持续多久，意思是暂时地。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Intended to last or be used for a limited time only.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 只打算持续或使用一段有限时间的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jdum jew jintuża għal żmien limitat biss.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 暂时的；临时的；非永久的。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem ingħata kuntratt temporanju għal tliet xhur.
formal.en: The worker was given a temporary contract for three months.
formal.zh: 这名员工获得了一份为期三个月的临时合同。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Sibt xogħol ġdid? Ġanni: Iva, xogħol temporanju għal dan is-sajf.
colloquial.en: Marta: Have you found a new job? Ġanni: Yes, a temporary job for this summer.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：你找到新工作了吗？詹尼：找到了，是今年夏天的一份临时工作。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.zh: 你找到新工作了吗？
messages.en: Have you found a new job?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, xogħol temporanju għal dan is-sajf.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, xogħol temporanju għal dan is-sajf.
messages.zh: 找到了，是今年夏天的一份临时工作。
messages.en: Yes, a temporary job for this summer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 temporanju 贴在有到期日的工作合同上，记住它描述事物是临时的；temporanjament 则表示暂时地。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A disruption of fluent speech involving repeated sounds, prolonged sounds, or difficulty getting words out.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 说话流畅性受到阻碍，出现语音重复、拖长或难以说出词语的现象，即口吃。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Diffikultà fit-taħdit li fiha persuna tirrepeti jew ittawwal ħsejjes, jew issibha diffiċli biex toħroġ il-kliem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 口吃；说话时出现语音重复、停顿或卡住的现象。
口吃；说话时出现语音重复、拖长或发音阻塞的现象。

formal.mt: Waqt il-lezzjoni dwar it-temtim, l-għalliema enfasizzat li għandna nisimgħu mingħajr ma ninterrompu.
formal.en: During the lesson about stuttering, the teacher emphasised that we should listen without interrupting.
formal.zh: 在讲解口吃的课堂上，老师强调我们应该倾听，不要打断别人。

colloquial.mt: Luca: Kultant it-temtim jagħmilha diffiċli għalija biex inlesti sentenza. Sara: Ħu l-ħin tiegħek, qed nisma'.
colloquial.en: Luca: Sometimes my stuttering makes it hard for me to finish a sentence. Sara: Take your time, I'm listening.
colloquial.zh: 卢卡：有时口吃让我很难把一句话说完。萨拉：慢慢来，我在听。

messages.speaker: Luca (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kultant it-temtim jagħmilha diffiċli għalija biex inlesti sentenza.
messages.mt_standard: Kultant it-temtim jagħmilha diffiċli għalija biex inlesti sentenza.
messages.zh: 有时口吃让我很难把一句话说完。
messages.en: Sometimes my stuttering makes it hard for me to finish a sentence.

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 慢慢来，我在听。
messages.en: Take your time, I'm listening.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 temtim 写在说话现象这一栏：它指口吃本身；再和表示人的 temtum 分开记，避免混淆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who stammers or stutters.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 说话时有口吃现象的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li ttemtem meta titkellem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 口吃的人；说话时会结巴的人。

collocations.en: listen to a person who stammers
talk with a person who stammers

formal.mt: Il-kelma 'temtum' hija nom li jirreferi għal persuna li ttemtem.
formal.en: The word 'temtum' is a noun referring to a person who stammers.
formal.zh: temtum 是一个名词，指说话有口吃现象的人。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser 'temtum' f'din is-sentenza? Pawlu: Ifisser persuna li ttemtem meta titkellem.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'temtum' mean in this sentence? Pawlu: It means a person who stammers when speaking.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个句子里的 temtum 是什么意思？保罗：意思是说话时会口吃的人。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 这个句子里的 temtum 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'temtum' mean in this sentence?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser persuna li ttemtem meta titkellem.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser persuna li ttemtem meta titkellem.
messages.zh: 意思是说话时会口吃的人。
messages.en: It means a person who stammers when speaking.

cognitive_memory_aid: 做两张配对卡片：temtim 对应口吃现象，temtum 对应口吃的人，用现象与人物的区别帮助记忆。

gloss_zh: 说话容易结巴的；有口吃倾向的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Tending to stammer or stutter when speaking.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 说话时容易出现口吃或结巴现象的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu tendenza li jtemtem meta jitkellem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有口吃倾向的；说话容易结巴的。

collocations.en: a speaker who tends to stammer
collocations.zh: 说话容易结巴的发言者

collocations.en: a boy who tends to stammer

formal.mt: Waqt id-diskussjoni, l-għalliem ta biżżejjed ħin lil tifel temtumi biex jesprimi l-ideat tiegħu.
formal.en: During the discussion, the teacher gave a boy who tends to stammer enough time to express his ideas.
formal.zh: 讨论时，老师给了一名说话容易结巴的男孩足够的时间，让他表达自己的想法。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Xi jfisser 'temtumi' meta jiddeskrivi kelliem? Nina: Ifisser li għandu tendenza li jtemtem meta jitkellem.
colloquial.en: Mark: What does 'temtumi' mean when it describes a speaker? Nina: It means that the person tends to stammer when speaking.
colloquial.zh: 马克：用 temtumi 形容发言者时是什么意思？妮娜：意思是这个人说话时容易结巴。

messages.speaker: Mark (学生)
messages.zh: 用 temtumi 形容发言者时是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'temtumi' mean when it describes a speaker?

messages.speaker: Nina (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li għandu tendenza li jtemtem meta jitkellem.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li għandu tendenza li jtemtem meta jitkellem.
messages.zh: 意思是这个人说话时容易结巴。
messages.en: It means that the person tends to stammer when speaking.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三个格子记词性：temtim 是口吃现象，temtum 是口吃的人，temtumi 是形容说话容易结巴的。

gloss_zh: 拍打软垫使其变软的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who softens cushions or similar items by beating them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过拍打使软垫等物品变软的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tħabbat il-kuxxini jew oġġetti simili biex tagħmilhom aktar rotob.

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who softens cushions etc. by beating them
sense_translations.zh_definition: 通过拍打使软垫等物品变软的人。

collocations.en: a person who softens cushions by beating them
collocations.zh: 拍打软垫使其变软的人

collocations.en: the work of the person who softens cushions by beating them
collocations.zh: 拍打软垫使其变软的人的工作

formal.mt: It-tenfiex ħabbat il-kuxxini biex jagħmilhom aktar rotob.
formal.en: The cushion beater beat the cushions to make them softer.
formal.zh: 负责拍软垫子的人拍打了这些垫子，使它们更加柔软。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min se jrattab dawn il-kuxxini? Pawlu: It-tenfiex. Se jħabbathom biex isiru aktar rotob.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who is going to soften these cushions? Pawlu: The cushion beater. He will beat them to make them softer.
colloquial.zh: Maja：谁来把这些垫子弄软？Pawlu：负责拍软垫子的人。他会拍打它们，让它们更柔软。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.zh: 谁来把这些垫子弄软？
messages.en: Who is going to soften these cushions?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tenfiex. Se jħabbathom biex isiru aktar rotob.
messages.mt_standard: It-tenfiex. Se jħabbathom biex isiru aktar rotob.
messages.zh: 负责拍软垫子的人。他会拍打它们，让它们更柔软。
messages.en: The cushion beater. He will beat them to make them softer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人反复拍打垫子，让垫子变软；把 tenfiex 和画面中“做这件事的人”一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having an effect that makes something softer.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有使某物变得更柔软的作用的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu l-effett li jagħmel xi ħaġa aktar ratba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有软化作用的；能使某物变得更柔软的。

formal.mt: It-trattament għandu effett tenfiexi fuq id-drapp u jagħmlu aktar artab.
formal.en: The treatment has a softening effect on the fabric and makes it softer.
formal.zh: 这种处理对布料具有软化作用，使其更加柔软。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan it-trattament jrattab id-drapp? Mark: Iva, għandu effett tenfiexi u jagħmel id-drapp aktar artab.
colloquial.en: Sara: Does this treatment soften the fabric? Mark: Yes, it has a softening effect and makes the fabric softer.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这种处理能让布料变软吗？Mark：能，它有软化作用，会让布料更加柔软。

messages.speaker: Sara (顾客)
messages.zh: 这种处理能让布料变软吗？
messages.en: Does this treatment soften the fabric?

messages.speaker: Mark (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għandu effett tenfiexi u jagħmel id-drapp aktar artab.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għandu effett tenfiexi u jagħmel id-drapp aktar artab.
messages.zh: 能，它有软化作用，会让布料更加柔软。
messages.en: Yes, it has a softening effect and makes the fabric softer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象同一块布处理前硬、处理后软，用 tenfiexi 描述这种“有软化作用的”效果；连着 effett tenfiexi 一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To play a stringed instrument by sweeping the fingers across several strings to produce a chord or rhythmic accompaniment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用手指扫过弦乐器的多根琴弦，奏出和弦或节奏性伴奏。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iddoqq strument tal-kordi billi tgħaddi subgħajk fuq diversi kordi biex toħloq akkordi jew akkumpanjament ritmiku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 扫弦；用手指拨扫弦乐器的多根琴弦。

formal.mt: Waqt il-prova, il-mużiċist tenkel il-kitarra biex jakkumpanja lill-kantanta.
formal.en: During the rehearsal, the musician strummed the guitar to accompany the singer.
formal.zh: 排练时，乐手扫动吉他琴弦，为女歌手伴奏。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif indoqq din il-parti? Mark: Tenkel il-kordi bil-mod u żomm ritmu regolari.
colloquial.en: Maja: How do I play this part? Mark: Strum the strings slowly and keep a steady rhythm.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这一段怎么弹？马克：慢慢扫弦，保持稳定的节奏。

messages.speaker: Maja（吉他学生）
messages.zh: 这一段怎么弹？
messages.en: How do I play this part?

messages.speaker: Mark（吉他老师）
messages.mt_spoken: Tenkel il-kordi bil-mod u żomm ritmu regolari.
messages.mt_standard: Tenkel il-kordi bil-mod u żomm ritmu regolari.
messages.zh: 慢慢扫弦，保持稳定的节奏。
messages.en: Strum the strings slowly and keep a steady rhythm.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tenkel 和手指扫过吉他多根琴弦的动作绑定记忆：看到这个动词，就想象一下一扫奏出和弦的动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action or technique of sweeping the fingers across several strings of an instrument to produce chords or rhythmic accompaniment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用手指扫过弦乐器多根琴弦以奏出和弦或节奏性伴奏的动作或奏法。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni jew it-teknika li tgħaddi subgħajk fuq diversi kordi ta' strument biex toħloq akkordi jew akkumpanjament ritmiku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 扫弦；扫动弦乐器多根琴弦的动作或演奏方式。

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, it-tenkil tal-kitarra għandu jkun regolari biex jgħin lill-istudent iżomm ir-ritmu.
formal.en: In this exercise, the guitar strumming should be steady to help the student keep the rhythm.
formal.zh: 在这项练习中，吉他扫弦应当平稳，以帮助学生保持节奏。
