colloquial.zh: 玛雅：说这只动物是 tewwiemi，是什么意思？托尼：就是它有产双胎的倾向，不一定每次都如此。

messages.speaker: Maja (畜牧学徒)
messages.mt_spoken: X'jiġifieri li dan l-annimal hu tewwiemi?
messages.mt_standard: X'jiġifieri li dan l-annimal hu tewwiemi?
messages.zh: 说这只动物是 tewwiemi，是什么意思？
messages.en: What does it mean that this animal is tewwiemi?

messages.speaker: Toni (饲养员)
messages.mt_spoken: Li għandu tendenza li jwelled tewmin; mhux bilfors kull darba.
messages.mt_standard: Li għandu tendenza li jwelled tewmin; mhux bilfors kull darba.

gloss_zh: 制作衣领的人；衣领工匠

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who makes collars for garments.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为衣物制作衣领的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tagħmel għenuq għall-ħwejjeġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 制作衣领的人。

collocations.en: a collar maker in a tailoring shop

formal.zh: 衣领工匠按照顾客的尺寸，为衬衫制作了一个新衣领。

messages.mt_spoken: Min jista' jagħmilli għonq ġdid għal din il-qmis?
messages.mt_standard: Min jista' jagħmilli għonq ġdid għal din il-qmis?
messages.zh: 谁能帮我给这件衬衫做个新衣领？
messages.en: Who can make me a new collar for this shirt?

messages.speaker: Rita (店员)
messages.zh: 那家店里的衣领工匠可以帮你。
messages.en: The collar maker in that shop can help you.

gloss_zh: 闲聊者；话匣子；爱说闲话的

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who talks a lot, especially about unimportant things.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 话很多、尤其喜欢谈论无关紧要事情的人；闲聊者或话匣子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li titkellem ħafna, speċjalment fuq affarijiet ta' ftit importanza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 爱说闲话、常谈论无关紧要事情的人。
话匣子；说起话来滔滔不绝的人。
爱说闲话的；常谈论无关紧要事情的。
话多的；像话匣子一样说个不停的。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-ġar huwa raġel tewwiet li jqatta' ħafna ħin jitkellem fuq affarijiet ta' ftit importanza.
formal.en: In the story, the neighbour is a talkative man who spends a lot of time discussing unimportant things.
formal.zh: 在这个故事里，邻居是个爱说闲话的男人，花很多时间谈论无关紧要的事情。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Pawlu għadu jitkellem? Mark: Iva, dak tewwiet! Għadu kemm beda storja oħra.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is Pawlu still talking? Mark: Yes, he's a chatterbox! He's just started another story.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Pawlu 还在说吗？Mark：是啊，他就是个话匣子！他刚又开始讲另一个故事。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: Pawlu 还在说吗？
messages.en: Is Pawlu still talking?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, dak tewwiet! Għadu kemm beda storja oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, dak tewwiet! Għadu kemm beda storja oħra.
messages.zh: 是啊，他就是个话匣子！他刚又开始讲另一个故事。
messages.en: Yes, he's a chatterbox! He's just started another story.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tewwiet 配上“一打开就停不下来的话匣子”画面；单独指人是名词，修饰人时可作形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Unification: the process of bringing separate parts or groups together as one.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 统一、合一，即把原本分开的部分或群体结合成一个整体的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih partijiet jew gruppi separati jingħaqdu f'ħaġa waħda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 统一；使分开的部分或群体合为一个整体。

formal.mt: Id-dokument jipproponi proċess ta' tewħid biex iż-żewġ gruppi jiffurmaw organizzazzjoni waħda.
formal.en: The document proposes a process of unification so that the two groups form a single organization.
formal.zh: 该文件提出一个统一过程，使两个群体组成一个组织。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Iż-żewġ gruppi se jsiru grupp wieħed? Mark: Iva, qed nitkellmu dwar it-tewħid tagħhom. Maja: Mela jkollna laqgħa waħda għal kulħadd.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are the two groups going to become one group? Mark: Yes, we're discussing their unification. Maja: Then we'll have one meeting for everyone.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这两个小组要合成一个小组吗？Mark：是的，我们正在讨论它们的合一。Maja：那我们就可以让大家一起开一次会了。

messages.speaker: Maja (小组成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iż-żewġ gruppi se jsiru grupp wieħed?
messages.mt_standard: Iż-żewġ gruppi se jsiru grupp wieħed?
messages.zh: 这两个小组要合成一个小组吗？
messages.en: Are the two groups going to become one group?

messages.speaker: Mark (小组协调员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qed nitkellmu dwar it-tewħid tagħhom.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qed nitkellmu dwar it-tewħid tagħhom.
messages.zh: 是的，我们正在讨论它们的合一。
messages.en: Yes, we're discussing their unification.

messages.speaker: Maja (小组成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela jkollna laqgħa waħda għal kulħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Mela jkollna laqgħa waħda għal kulħadd.
messages.zh: 那我们就可以让大家一起开一次会了。
messages.en: Then we'll have one meeting for everyone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画两个分开的圆，再画箭头把它们合成一个圆，在箭头旁写 tewħid，用“从分开到合一”的过程记住名词含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A craving or strong desire to eat a particular food.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 特别想吃某种食物的感觉，即嘴馋或对食物的强烈渴望。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xewqa qawwija li tiekol xi ikel partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对食物产生强烈渴望；特别想吃东西。

formal.mt: Fid-djarju tagħha, Marija kitbet li ħasset tewħim għall-ħelu wara l-ikla.
formal.en: In her diary, Marija wrote that she felt a craving for sweets after the meal.
formal.zh: 玛丽娅在日记中写道，吃完饭后她特别想吃甜食。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għandi tewħim għal xi ħaġa ħelwa. Pawlu: Trid biċċa kejk?
colloquial.en: Marija: I'm craving something sweet. Pawlu: Would you like a piece of cake?
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：我特别想吃点甜的。保罗：你想吃块蛋糕吗？

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi tewħim għal xi ħaġa ħelwa.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi tewħim għal xi ħaġa ħelwa.
messages.zh: 我特别想吃点甜的。
messages.en: I'm craving something sweet.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 你想吃块蛋糕吗？
messages.en: Would you like a piece of cake?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tewħim 和饭后仍惦记蛋糕的画面一起记，重点是对食物的嘴馋感。

gloss_zh: 恐怖感；对超自然事物等的惊惧

teaching_sense.en_definition: A feeling of horror or dread, especially concerning supernatural things.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因超自然事物等而产生的恐怖、惊惧或深深的不安。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sens ta' biża' kbira, speċjalment minn affarijiet sopranaturali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对超自然事物等产生的恐怖感或惊惧。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, l-ilħna misterjużi fid-dar vojta jqajmu sens ta' tewħix.
formal.en: In the story, mysterious voices in the empty house evoke a sense of horror.
formal.zh: 故事中，空屋里的神秘声音引起了一种恐怖感。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dik l-istorja tal-fatati qajmet fija sens ta' tewħix. Mark: Ejja nitkellmu fuq xi ħaġa oħra.
colloquial.en: Lara: That ghost story gave me a feeling of horror. Mark: Let's talk about something else.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：那个鬼故事让我心里发毛。马克：我们聊点别的吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik l-istorja tal-fatati qajmet fija sens ta' tewħix.
messages.mt_standard: Dik l-istorja tal-fatati qajmet fija sens ta' tewħix.
messages.zh: 那个鬼故事让我心里发毛。
messages.en: That ghost story gave me a feeling of horror.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja nitkellmu fuq xi ħaġa oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja nitkellmu fuq xi ħaġa oħra.
messages.zh: 我们聊点别的吧。
messages.en: Let's talk about something else.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tewħix 放进听鬼故事后背发凉的画面里，记住它表示惊惧和恐怖感。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To produce a hissing sound, like a prolonged 'sss'.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 发出类似持续“嘶——”的声音。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jagħmel ħoss bħal 'sss' fit-tul.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 发出嘶嘶声。
产生或发出一种嘶嘶的声音。

collocations.zh: 在煎锅里发出了嘶嘶声
在炉火上发出了嘶嘶声

formal.mt: Il-butir textex hekk kif mess il-wiċċ sħun tat-taġen.
formal.en: The butter hissed as soon as it touched the hot surface of the frying pan.
formal.zh: 黄油一碰到煎锅滚热的表面，就发出了嘶嘶声。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Smajt? Il-butir textex fit-taġen. Ben: Iva, smajt dak il-ħoss ukoll.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did you hear that? The butter hissed in the pan. Ben: Yes, I heard that sound too.
colloquial.zh: Lara：听见了吗？黄油在锅里嘶嘶响了。Ben：听见了，我也听到了那个声音。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 听见了吗？黄油在锅里嘶嘶响了。
messages.en: Did you hear that? The butter hissed in the pan.

messages.speaker: Ben (室友)
messages.zh: 听见了，我也听到了那个声音。
messages.en: Yes, I heard that sound too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 读 textex 时联想黄油落入热锅后持续的“嘶嘶”声，记住它表示“发声”这个动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Tending to make a hissing sound, as food may do while being fried.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 容易发出嘶嘶声的，例如食物煎炸时表现出的发声特性。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu tendenza jagħmel ħoss bħal 'sss', bħal ikel waqt il-qali.

sense_translations.en_definition: tending to hiss (as of sth. being fried)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 容易发出嘶嘶声的，如正在煎炸的食物。

collocations.zh: 容易发出嘶嘶声的食物

formal.mt: L-aġġettiv 'textiexi' jista' jiddeskrivi ikel li għandu tendenza jagħmel ħoss waqt il-qali.
formal.en: The adjective 'textiexi' can describe food that tends to make a hissing sound while being fried.
formal.zh: 形容词 textiexi 可以形容煎炸时容易发出嘶嘶声的食物。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dan l-ikel textiexi, hux? Toni: Iva, isma' l-ħoss li qed jagħmel fit-taġen!
colloquial.en: Nina: This food tends to hiss, doesn't it? Toni: Yes, listen to the sound it's making in the pan!
colloquial.zh: Nina：这食物挺容易嘶嘶响的，是吧？Toni：是啊，听听它在锅里发出的声音！

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 这食物挺容易嘶嘶响的，是吧？
messages.en: This food tends to hiss, doesn't it?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, isma' l-ħoss li qed jagħmel fit-taġen!
messages.mt_standard: Iva, isma' l-ħoss li qed jagħmel fit-taġen!
messages.zh: 是啊，听听它在锅里发出的声音！
messages.en: Yes, listen to the sound it's making in the pan!

cognitive_memory_aid: 在食物图片旁贴上 textiexi 标签，表示它“容易嘶嘶响”的特性；重点记住这是形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A hissing sound; also excitement or a feeling of anticipation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 嘶嘶的声音；也可指兴奋的情绪或等待某事发生时的期待感。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħoss bħal 'sss'; ukoll eċċitament jew sens ta' stennija għal xi ħaġa li se tiġri.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 嘶嘶声；发出嘶嘶声这一现象。
兴奋；激动的情绪。
期待感；等待某事即将发生时的心情。

formal.mt: Waqt il-qali, it-textix taż-żejt seta' jinstema' mill-kamra ta' ħdejn il-kċina.
formal.en: During frying, the hissing of the oil could be heard from the room next to the kitchen.
formal.zh: 煎炸时，在厨房旁边的房间里也能听见油的嘶嘶声。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Hawn ħafna textix qabel il-kunċert! Leo: Iva, kulħadd qed jistenna li jibda.
colloquial.en: Maja: There's so much excitement here before the concert! Leo: Yes, everyone is waiting for it to start.
colloquial.zh: Maja：音乐会还没开始，这里就已经很兴奋了！Leo：是啊，大家都盼着它开始。

messages.speaker: Maja (观众)
messages.zh: 音乐会还没开始，这里就已经很兴奋了！
messages.en: There's so much excitement here before the concert!

messages.speaker: Leo (观众)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kulħadd qed jistenna li jibda.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kulħadd qed jistenna li jibda.
messages.zh: 是啊，大家都盼着它开始。
messages.en: Yes, everyone is waiting for it to start.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 textix 做两张记忆卡：一张画热油的嘶嘶声，一张画开演前兴奋期待的观众，按语境选义。

gloss_zh: 马耳他传统佐鱼刺山柑酱

teaching_sense.en_definition: A traditional Maltese caper sauce served with fish.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种马耳他传统刺山柑酱，用来搭配鱼类食用。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Zalza tradizzjonali Maltija tal-kappar li tiġi servuta mal-ħut.

sense_translations.en_definition: Traditional Maltese recipe for a caper sauce to accompany fish
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一种制作佐鱼刺山柑酱的马耳他传统配方，也指按此配方制成的酱汁。

collocations.zh: 配马耳他传统刺山柑酱的鱼

collocations.en: a recipe for textuxa caper sauce
collocations.zh: 马耳他传统佐鱼刺山柑酱的食谱

formal.mt: Il-menu joffri ħut bit-textuxa, zalza tradizzjonali Maltija tal-kappar.
formal.en: The menu offers fish with textuxa, a traditional Maltese caper sauce.
formal.zh: 菜单提供搭配 textuxa 的鱼；textuxa 是一种马耳他传统刺山柑酱。

colloquial.mt: Mark: X'inhi t-textuxa? Sara: Zalza tal-kappar li tmur mal-ħut. Trid ftit mal-ħuta tiegħek?
colloquial.en: Mark: What is textuxa? Sara: A caper sauce that goes with fish. Would you like some with your fish?
colloquial.zh: Mark：textuxa 是什么？Sara：是一种配鱼吃的刺山柑酱。你的鱼要配一点吗？

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: textuxa 是什么？
messages.en: What is textuxa?

messages.speaker: Sara (服务员)
messages.mt_spoken: Zalza tal-kappar li tmur mal-ħut. Trid ftit mal-ħuta tiegħek?
messages.mt_standard: Zalza tal-kappar li tmur mal-ħut. Trid ftit mal-ħuta tiegħek?
messages.zh: 是一种配鱼吃的刺山柑酱。你的鱼要配一点吗？
messages.en: A caper sauce that goes with fish. Would you like some with your fish?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 textuxa 写在“鱼旁边的一小碟刺山柑酱”图片上，用食物搭配记住它，避免只记成泛指酱汁。

gloss_zh: 把人逼疯；使人烦乱不堪

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of driving someone mad, including making them extremely frustrated or mentally overwhelmed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某人逼得发疯的行为，也可用于夸张地表示使人极度烦躁、心烦意乱。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li ġġiegħel lil xi ħadd jiġġennen, jew, b'mod figurattiv, iħoss dwejjaq u konfużjoni kbira.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把某人逼疯；使某人烦乱到难以忍受。

collocations.zh: 不停地把人折腾得发疯
用接连不断的问题把人问烦

formal.mt: Fl-istorja, it-teħbil tal-protagonist b'mistoqsijiet bla waqfien iwasslu biex jitlaq mil-laqgħa.
formal.en: In the story, driving the protagonist mad with relentless questions causes him to leave the meeting.
formal.zh: 故事中，接连不断的问题把主人公逼得受不了，导致他离开了会议。

colloquial.mt: Pawlu: Biżżejjed teħbil bil-mistoqsijiet għal-lum! Anna: Tajjeb, nieqaf. Ħu ftit ħin għalik.
colloquial.en: Pawlu: That's enough driving me mad with questions for today! Anna: All right, I'll stop. Take some time for yourself.
colloquial.zh: Pawlu：今天别再用这些问题把我问疯了！Anna：好，我不问了。你自己休息一会儿吧。

messages.speaker: Pawlu (哥哥)
messages.zh: 今天别再用这些问题把我问疯了！
messages.en: That's enough driving me mad with questions for today!

messages.speaker: Anna (妹妹)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, nieqaf. Ħu ftit ħin għalik.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, nieqaf. Ħu ftit ħin għalik.
messages.zh: 好，我不问了。你自己休息一会儿吧。
messages.en: All right, I'll stop. Take some time for yourself.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象被一连串问题缠得抱头大喊“我要疯了”，用这个夸张场景记住 teħbil 的“把人逼疯”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A feeling that something will happen before it occurs, especially something unpleasant.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 事情发生之前便觉得它将发生的感觉，尤其指对不愉快事情的预感。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sens minn qabel li se jiġri xi ħaġa, speċjalment xi ħaġa ħażina.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 预感；对尚未发生之事的先兆性感觉。

formal.mt: Fil-bidu tar-rumanz, il-protagonista tħoss teħbir ta' periklu qabel ma tidħol fid-dar.
formal.en: At the beginning of the novel, the protagonist has a premonition of danger before entering the house.
formal.zh: 小说开头，女主人公在走进房子之前，便有危险将至的预感。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għandi teħbir li xi ħaġa mhix se tmur sew. Luqa: X'qed iġiegħlek tħoss hekk? Marta: Ma nafx; huwa biss sens li għandi.
colloquial.en: Marta: I have a premonition that something is going to go wrong. Luqa: What's making you feel that way? Marta: I don't know; it's just a feeling I have.
colloquial.zh: Marta：我预感有什么事情会出岔子。Luqa：是什么让你有这种感觉？Marta：不知道，只是一种感觉。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi teħbir li xi ħaġa mhix se tmur sew.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi teħbir li xi ħaġa mhix se tmur sew.
messages.zh: 我预感有什么事情会出岔子。
messages.en: I have a premonition that something is going to go wrong.

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.zh: 是什么让你有这种感觉？
messages.en: What's making you feel that way?

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma nafx; huwa biss sens li għandi.
messages.mt_standard: Ma nafx; huwa biss sens li għandi.
messages.zh: 不知道，只是一种感觉。
messages.en: I don't know; it's just a feeling I have.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 teħbir 配上“事情还没发生，心里先有感觉”的时间顺序，记忆重点是提前出现的预感。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A state of feeling sleepy or fatigued, with reduced energy or alertness.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 感到想睡或疲惫的状态，表现为精力不足或警觉性下降。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Stat ta' ngħas jew għeja, b'inqas enerġija jew attenzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 困倦；昏昏欲睡。
疲劳；疲乏；精力不足。

collocations.en: a feeling of drowsiness or fatigue
drowsiness due to lack of sleep

formal.mt: Wara lejl ta' ftit irqad, l-istudenta ħasset teħdil waqt il-lezzjoni u sabitha diffiċli biex tikkonċentra.
formal.en: After a night with little sleep, the student felt drowsy during the lesson and found it difficult to concentrate.
formal.zh: 一夜没睡多久后，这名学生上课时感到困倦，难以集中注意力。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Għandi teħdil wara l-ikel u għajnejja qed jingħalqu. Marija: Strieħ ftit; nistgħu nkomplu naqraw wara.
colloquial.en: Elena: I feel drowsy after lunch, and my eyes are closing. Marija: Rest for a bit; we can carry on reading later.
colloquial.zh: Elena：吃完午饭我好困，眼睛都快闭上了。Marija：休息一会儿吧，我们可以晚点继续读。

messages.speaker: Elena (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi teħdil wara l-ikel u għajnejja qed jingħalqu.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi teħdil wara l-ikel u għajnejja qed jingħalqu.
messages.zh: 吃完午饭我好困，眼睛都快闭上了。
messages.en: I feel drowsy after lunch, and my eyes are closing.

messages.speaker: Marija (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Strieħ ftit; nistgħu nkomplu naqraw wara.
messages.mt_standard: Strieħ ftit; nistgħu nkomplu naqraw wara.
messages.zh: 休息一会儿吧，我们可以晚点继续读。
messages.en: Rest for a bit; we can carry on reading later.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象饭后眼皮下垂、全身没劲的样子，把 teħdil 同时连到“想睡的困倦”和“没力的疲乏”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of taking, collecting, or obtaining something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某物拿走、取来或取得的行为，具体含义由所取的事物决定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed jieħu xi ħaġa, jiġborha jew jiksibha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 拿取某物的行为；取用或取得某物。

formal.mt: It-teħid ta' kampjuni tal-ilma jsir kull ġimgħa biex tiġi ċċekkjata l-kwalità tiegħu.
formal.en: Water samples are taken every week to check the water's quality.
formal.zh: 每周采集水样，以检查水质。

colloquial.mt: Lara: It-teħid ta' ritratti huwa permess hawn? Mark: Iva, imma mingħajr flash.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is taking photographs allowed here? Mark: Yes, but without flash.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这里允许拍照吗？ Mark：允许，但不能使用闪光灯。

messages.speaker: Lara (参观者)
messages.mt_spoken: It-teħid ta' ritratti huwa permess hawn?
messages.mt_standard: It-teħid ta' ritratti huwa permess hawn?
messages.zh: 这里允许拍照吗？
messages.en: Is taking photographs allowed here?

messages.speaker: Mark (博物馆工作人员)
messages.zh: 允许，但不能使用闪光灯。
messages.en: Yes, but without flash.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 teħid 放进“取什么”的空格里记：取样本是采样，取影像是拍照；它命名的是取得的行为。

gloss_zh: 过度享用；无节制地放纵

teaching_sense.en_definition: Excessive indulgence in food, drink, or other pleasures.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在饮食或其他享受上超过适当限度，缺乏节制的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-eċċess fl-ikel, fix-xorb jew fit-tgawdija ta' pjaċiri oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 过度享用；在饮食或其他享乐方面无节制地放纵自己。

formal.mt: L-awtur jikkritika t-teħjim fl-ikel u fix-xorb waqt il-festi tal-palazz.
formal.en: The author criticizes the overindulgence in food and drink during the palace festivities.
formal.zh: 作者批评宫廷庆典中无节制地吃喝享乐的行为。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Wara t-teħjim tal-bieraħ, illum irrid ikla sempliċi. Nina: Jien ukoll; ilbieraħ ħadt wisq deżerta.
colloquial.en: Sara: After yesterday's overindulgence, I want a simple meal today. Nina: Me too; I had too much dessert yesterday.
colloquial.zh: Sara：昨天吃得太放纵了，今天我想简单吃点。 Nina：我也是，昨天甜点吃太多了。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Wara t-teħjim tal-bieraħ, illum irrid ikla sempliċi.
messages.mt_standard: Wara t-teħjim tal-bieraħ, illum irrid ikla sempliċi.
messages.zh: 昨天吃得太放纵了，今天我想简单吃点。
messages.en: After yesterday's overindulgence, I want a simple meal today.

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien ukoll; ilbieraħ ħadt wisq deżerta.
messages.mt_standard: Jien ukoll; ilbieraħ ħadt wisq deżerta.
messages.zh: 我也是，昨天甜点吃太多了。
messages.en: Me too; I had too much dessert yesterday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 teħjim 可想象甜点已经吃饱还继续加盘；抓住“享用超过限度”，并与强调吃得急的 teħġim 区分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of removing the husks or shells from something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 除去某物外部的皮壳或硬壳的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess tat-tneħħija tal-qxur minn xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 去除外壳或硬壳；脱壳的过程。

formal.mt: Wara t-teħlif tal-lewż, il-qlub jinġabru f'kontenitur nadif.
formal.en: After the almonds are shelled, the kernels are collected in a clean container.
formal.zh: 杏仁去壳后，仁被收集到干净的容器中。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Tgħinni fit-teħlif tal-ġewż? Ġanni: Żgur; inti iftaħ il-qxur u jien niġbor il-qlub.
colloquial.en: Rita: Will you help me shell the walnuts? Ġanni: Sure; you crack the shells and I'll collect the kernels.
colloquial.zh: Rita：你能帮我给核桃去壳吗？ Ġanni：当然，你敲开壳，我来收集核桃仁。

messages.speaker: Rita (姐姐)
messages.zh: 你能帮我给核桃去壳吗？
messages.en: Will you help me shell the walnuts?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (弟弟)
messages.mt_spoken: Żgur; inti iftaħ il-qxur u jien niġbor il-qlub.
messages.mt_standard: Żgur; inti iftaħ il-qxur u jien niġbor il-qlub.
messages.zh: 当然，你敲开壳，我来收集核桃仁。
messages.en: Sure; you crack the shells and I'll collect the kernels.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住 teħlif 的厨房画面：硬壳放一边，果仁放另一边；这个词指把壳除去的整个过程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The experience or activity of having dreams during sleep.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 睡眠中经历梦境、产生梦中画面的活动或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-esperjenza jew l-attività li wieħed ikollu ħolm waqt l-irqad.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 做梦；经历梦境的活动或过程。

formal.mt: Fid-djarju tagħha, il-kittieba tiddeskrivi t-teħlim dwar postijiet li qatt ma żaret.
formal.en: In her diary, the writer describes dreaming about places she has never visited.
formal.zh: 作家在日记中描述了自己梦见从未去过的地方的经历。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Dal-lejl erġajt ħlomt bil-baħar. Luqa: Għadek bit-teħlim dwar il-vaganza, mela!
colloquial.en: Anna: I dreamed about the sea again last night. Luqa: So you're still dreaming about the holiday!
colloquial.zh: Anna：昨晚我又梦见大海了。 Luqa：看来你还在梦里想着那次假期呢！

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 昨晚我又梦见大海了。
messages.en: I dreamed about the sea again last night.

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.zh: 看来你还在梦里想着那次假期呢！
messages.en: So you're still dreaming about the holiday!

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 teħlim，想象睡着后脑中播放梦境电影；记住它强调做梦这一活动或过程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of freeing someone from confinement or control, or granting them freedom.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人摆脱拘禁或控制，或者给予其自由的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed jeħles lil xi ħadd mill-priġunerija jew mill-kontroll, jew jagħtih il-libertà.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 解放；使人摆脱拘禁、压迫或控制。
给予自由；准许某人恢复或获得自由。

collocations.zh: 摆脱奴役；从奴役中获得解放

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, it-teħlis mill-jasar jimmarka l-bidu ta' ħajja ġdida għall-protagonista.
formal.en: In the novel, liberation from slavery marks the beginning of a new life for the protagonist.
formal.zh: 小说中，摆脱奴役标志着主人公新生活的开始。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Kif spiċċa l-ktieb? David: Bit-teħlis tal-priġunier; fl-aħħar ħareġ u mar lura għand familtu.
colloquial.en: Marta: How did the book end? David: With the prisoner's release; he finally got out and went back to his family.
colloquial.zh: Marta：那本书是怎么结尾的？ David：以囚犯获释结尾，他终于走了出来，回到家人身边。

messages.speaker: Marta (读书会成员)
messages.zh: 那本书是怎么结尾的？
messages.en: How did the book end?

messages.speaker: David (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Bit-teħlis tal-priġunier; fl-aħħar ħareġ u mar lura għand familtu.
messages.mt_standard: Bit-teħlis tal-priġunier; fl-aħħar ħareġ u mar lura għand familtu.
messages.zh: 以囚犯获释结尾，他终于走了出来，回到家人身边。
messages.en: With the prisoner's release; he finally got out and went back to his family.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“牢门打开，人走向自由”的画面记 teħlis；既可强调摆脱束缚，也可强调自由被给予。

gloss_zh: 逐渐沉默；变得不愿交流

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of falling silent or becoming less willing to communicate.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从说话转为沉默，或者逐渐变得不愿与人交流的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li wieħed isir sieket jew jibda jikkomunika inqas mal-oħrajn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 逐渐停止说话、陷入沉默的过程。
逐渐变得寡言、不愿与人交流的过程。

formal.mt: Ir-rakkont juri t-teħmid gradwali tal-karattru, li maż-żmien jibda jevita l-konversazzjonijiet.
formal.en: The story portrays the character's gradual withdrawal from communication as he increasingly begins to avoid conversations.
formal.zh: 故事描写了这个人物逐渐变得不愿交流的过程：随着时间推移，他开始越来越回避交谈。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Innutajt it-teħmid ta' Toni wara l-argument? Karl: Iva, qabel kien jitkellem ħafna, imma issa bilkemm iwieġeb.
colloquial.en: Elena: Have you noticed how Toni has become uncommunicative since the argument? Karl: Yes, he used to talk a lot, but now he barely answers.
colloquial.zh: Elena：你注意到 Toni 争吵后变得不爱说话了吗？ Karl：注意到了，他以前话很多，现在几乎都不回应。

messages.speaker: Elena (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Innutajt it-teħmid ta' Toni wara l-argument?
messages.mt_standard: Innutajt it-teħmid ta' Toni wara l-argument?
messages.zh: 你注意到 Toni 争吵后变得不爱说话了吗？
messages.en: Have you noticed how Toni has become uncommunicative since the argument?

messages.speaker: Karl (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qabel kien jitkellem ħafna, imma issa bilkemm iwieġeb.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qabel kien jitkellem ħafna, imma issa bilkemm iwieġeb.
messages.zh: 注意到了，他以前话很多，现在几乎都不回应。
messages.en: Yes, he used to talk a lot, but now he barely answers.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 teħmid 时想象聊天气泡越来越少，最后消失；它强调变得沉默的过程，也能指逐渐不愿交流。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of fermentation; in another sense, the process of drying and flaking.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指发酵的过程；另一个义项指变干并出现片状剥落的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess tal-fermentazzjoni; f'tifsira oħra, il-proċess li xi ħaġa tinxef u tibda titqaxxar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 发酵；物质发生发酵变化的过程。
干燥并起屑；变干并呈片状剥落的过程。

collocations.zh: 油漆干燥并呈片状剥落

formal.mt: Il-furnar josserva t-teħmir tal-għaġina qabel ma jifforma l-ħobż.
formal.en: The baker observes the fermentation of the dough before shaping the bread.
formal.zh: 面包师在给面包整形之前观察面团的发酵情况。

colloquial.mt: Marija: X'inhu dan it-teħmir taż-żebgħa ħdejn it-tieqa? Pawlu: Iż-żebgħa nixfet u bdiet titqaxxar; ara l-biċċiet żgħar mal-art.
colloquial.en: Marija: What's this drying and flaking of the paint by the window? Pawlu: The paint has dried out and started flaking; look at the little pieces on the floor.
colloquial.zh: Marija：窗边这油漆怎么干得起屑了？ Pawlu：油漆干了，开始片状脱落；你看地上那些小碎片。

messages.speaker: Marija (住户)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhu dan it-teħmir taż-żebgħa ħdejn it-tieqa?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhu dan it-teħmir taż-żebgħa ħdejn it-tieqa?
messages.zh: 窗边这油漆怎么干得起屑了？
messages.en: What's this drying and flaking of the paint by the window?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (维修工)
messages.mt_spoken: Iż-żebgħa nixfet u bdiet titqaxxar; ara l-biċċiet żgħar mal-art.
messages.mt_standard: Iż-żebgħa nixfet u bdiet titqaxxar; ara l-biċċiet żgħar mal-art.
messages.zh: 油漆干了，开始片状脱落；你看地上那些小碎片。
messages.en: The paint has dried out and started flaking; look at the little pieces on the floor.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 teħmir 分别配两张记忆图：面团正在发酵，以及表面干燥后片状脱落；用上下文判断是哪一个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of producing chick-peas.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 生产鹰嘴豆的农业活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-attività tal-produzzjoni taċ-ċiċri.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 生产鹰嘴豆；鹰嘴豆生产。

collocations.zh: 这座农场的鹰嘴豆生产

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi t-teħmis f'din ir-razzett u l-ispejjeż marbuta miegħu.
formal.en: The report describes chick-pea production on this farm and the costs associated with it.
formal.zh: 报告介绍了这座农场的鹰嘴豆生产及其相关成本。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Qed tkabbru ċ-ċiċri hawn? Pawlu: Iva, it-teħmis huwa parti mix-xogħol tagħna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are you growing chick-peas here? Pawlu: Yes, producing chick-peas is part of our work.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你们在这里种鹰嘴豆吗？保罗：是的，生产鹰嘴豆是我们工作的一部分。

messages.speaker: Maja（参观者）
messages.zh: 你们在这里种鹰嘴豆吗？
messages.en: Are you growing chick-peas here?

messages.speaker: Pawlu（农场主）
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, it-teħmis huwa parti mix-xogħol tagħna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, it-teħmis huwa parti mix-xogħol tagħna.
messages.zh: 是的，生产鹰嘴豆是我们工作的一部分。
messages.en: Yes, producing chick-peas is part of our work.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 teħmis 联想成农场里一整套生产鹰嘴豆的工作，重点记住它指生产活动。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The condition known as piles or haemorrhoids.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 称为痔疮的病症；英语 piles 与 haemorrhoids 在这里指同一种病症。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kundizzjoni magħrufa bħala emorrojdi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 痔疮；此处 piles 是病症名称。
痔疮；与本词条中 piles 的含义相同。

formal.mt: Il-pazjent iddeskriva lit-tabib is-sintomi tat-teħra u l-iskumdità li kien qed iħoss.
formal.en: The patient described the symptoms of haemorrhoids and the discomfort he was experiencing to the doctor.
formal.zh: 患者向医生描述了痔疮的症状以及自己的不适。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'jiġifieri 'teħra'? Mark: Tfisser emorrojdi; bl-Ingliż tista' tgħid 'piles' jew 'haemorrhoids'.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'teħra' mean? Mark: It means haemorrhoids; in English you can say 'piles' or 'haemorrhoids'.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：teħra 是什么意思？马克：意思是痔疮，英语可以说 piles，也可以说 haemorrhoids。

messages.speaker: Maja（学生）
messages.zh: teħra 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'teħra' mean?

messages.speaker: Mark（同学）
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser emorrojdi; bl-Ingliż tista' tgħid 'piles' jew 'haemorrhoids'.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser emorrojdi; bl-Ingliż tista' tgħid 'piles' jew 'haemorrhoids'.
messages.zh: 意思是痔疮，英语可以说 piles，也可以说 haemorrhoids。
messages.en: It means haemorrhoids; in English you can say 'piles' or 'haemorrhoids'.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 teħra、piles、haemorrhoids 写在同一张痔疮词卡上，三个词一起对应同一种病症。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of eating food very quickly and greedily.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 非常急切、贪急地进食的行为，即狼吞虎咽。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed jiekol b'għaġla kbira u b'regħba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 狼吞虎咽地吃东西；急切而贪急的进食行为。

collocations.en: wolfing down food during a meal

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, it-teħġim tal-ikel juri kemm kien bil-ġuħ il-vjaġġatur.
formal.en: In the story, the wolfing down of food shows how hungry the traveller was.
formal.zh: 故事中，旅人狼吞虎咽的吃相显示出他有多么饥饿。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Dan it-teħġim kollu għax ilek ma tiekol? Pawlu: Iva, ma kilt xejn minn dalgħodu!
colloquial.en: Marija: Are you wolfing everything down because you haven't eaten for a while? Pawlu: Yes, I haven't eaten anything since this morning!
colloquial.zh: Marija：你这么狼吞虎咽，是因为很久没吃东西了吗？ Pawlu：对啊，我从今天早上到现在什么都没吃！

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan it-teħġim kollu għax ilek ma tiekol?
messages.mt_standard: Dan it-teħġim kollu għax ilek ma tiekol?
messages.zh: 你这么狼吞虎咽，是因为很久没吃东西了吗？
messages.en: Are you wolfing everything down because you haven't eaten for a while?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ma kilt xejn minn dalgħodu!
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ma kilt xejn minn dalgħodu!
messages.zh: 对啊，我从今天早上到现在什么都没吃！
messages.en: Yes, I haven't eaten anything since this morning!

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住 teħġim 时，想象饥饿的旅人一口接一口猛吃；重点是吃得急、吃得贪的行为。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be saved or set aside for later use, especially of money.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指钱等被存下来或留作日后使用。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jitwarrab għal aktar tard, speċjalment meta jkun hemm referenza għal flus.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be saved (used of money etc)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被存下或积攒起来，用于钱等。

collocations.zh: 被一点一点地积攒下来

collocations.en: was saved for a time of need
collocations.zh: 被存下来以备不时之需

formal.mt: Dan l-ammont tfaddal matul is-sena biex ikopri spejjeż mhux mistennija.
formal.en: This amount was saved over the year to cover unexpected expenses.
formal.zh: 这笔钱是在一年中积攒下来的，用于支付意外开支。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dan l-ammont kollu tfaddal għas-safar? Pawlu: Iva, ftit ftit matul is-sena.
colloquial.en: Nina: Was this whole amount saved for travelling? Pawlu: Yes, little by little over the year.
colloquial.zh: Nina：这一整笔钱都是存下来准备旅行的吗？Pawlu：是啊，是这一年里一点一点攒的。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 这一整笔钱都是存下来准备旅行的吗？
messages.en: Was this whole amount saved for travelling?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 是啊，是这一年里一点一点攒的。
messages.en: Yes, little by little over the year.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一笔钱被放进储蓄罐，给画面标注 tfaddal；记忆重点是“钱被存下来”的视角。

gloss_zh: 储蓄；节俭；银行储蓄账户

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of saving money or the habit of spending carefully; also a savings account at a bank.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 存钱的行为，或谨慎花钱、节俭的习惯；也可指银行中的储蓄账户。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed ifaddal il-flus jew id-drawwa li jonfoq bil-għaqal; ukoll kont ta' tfaddil f'bank.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 储蓄；把钱存下来以供日后使用的行为。
节俭；谨慎花钱、避免浪费的习惯。

sense_translations.en_definition: a savings account in a bank
sense_translations.zh_definition: 银行中的储蓄账户。

formal.mt: Il-pjan tal-familja jinkludi tfaddil regolari, b'ammont żgħir imwarrab kull xahar għal spejjeż futuri.
formal.en: The family's plan includes regular saving, with a small amount set aside each month for future expenses.
formal.zh: 这个家庭的计划包括定期储蓄，每个月留出一小笔钱，用于将来的开支。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Irrid nibda kont ta' tfaddil. Ben: Tajjeb! Tista' twarrab ftit flus kull xahar.
colloquial.en: Lara: I want to open a savings account. Ben: Great! You can set aside a little money each month.
colloquial.zh: Lara：我想开一个储蓄账户。Ben：好啊！你可以每个月存一点钱。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我想开一个储蓄账户。
messages.en: I want to open a savings account.

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb! Tista' twarrab ftit flus kull xahar.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb! Tista' twarrab ftit flus kull xahar.
messages.zh: 好啊！你可以每个月存一点钱。
messages.en: Great! You can set aside a little money each month.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三格画面记 tfaddil：往罐里存钱是“储蓄”，买东西先算账是“节俭”，银行账户页是“储蓄账户”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action of throwing something or delivering hits or blows.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 投掷物体的行为，或击打、施加打击的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li wieħed iwaddab xi ħaġa jew jagħti daqqiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 投掷；把物体抛出去的动作。
击打；用力打击人或物的动作。

formal.mt: It-tfajjir tal-ġebel lejn il-vetturi jista' jikkawża ħsara serja.
formal.en: Throwing stones at vehicles can cause serious damage.
formal.zh: 向车辆投掷石块可能造成严重损坏。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'kien dak l-istorbju fil-bitħa? Mark: Kien hemm tfajjir tal-ġebel lejn il-ħajt.
colloquial.en: Maja: What was that noise in the yard? Mark: There were stones being thrown at the wall.
colloquial.zh: Maja：院子里刚才是什么声音？Mark：有人在朝墙扔石头。

messages.speaker: Maja (邻居)
messages.zh: 院子里刚才是什么声音？
messages.en: What was that noise in the yard?

messages.speaker: Mark (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien hemm tfajjir tal-ġebel lejn il-ħajt.
messages.mt_standard: Kien hemm tfajjir tal-ġebel lejn il-ħajt.
messages.zh: 有人在朝墙扔石头。
messages.en: There were stones being thrown at the wall.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把画面记成“石头抛出去，拳头打过去”：tfajjir表示投掷或击打的动作，具体看后面的搭配。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A female adolescent or a young woman.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 处于青春期的女孩，或年轻的成年女子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna ta' sess femminili fl-età tal-adolexxenza jew mara żagħżugħa.

sense_translations.en_definition: female adolescent or young woman; girl (in this sense)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 少女或年轻女子；此义中的“女孩”指青春期女性或年轻女性。

collocations.en: a local girl or young woman
collocations.zh: 一位本地女孩或年轻女子

formal.mt: Tfajla tal-lokal rebħet l-ewwel premju fil-kompetizzjoni tal-kitba.
formal.en: A local young woman won first prize in the writing competition.
formal.zh: 一位本地年轻女子在写作比赛中获得了一等奖。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min hi dik it-tfajla ħdejn il-bieb? Nina: Dik oħti, qed tistennieni.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who is that young woman by the door? Nina: That's my sister; she's waiting for me.
colloquial.zh: Lara：门边那位年轻女子是谁？Nina：那是我姐姐，她在等我。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min hi dik it-tfajla ħdejn il-bieb?
messages.mt_standard: Min hi dik it-tfajla ħdejn il-bieb?
messages.zh: 门边那位年轻女子是谁？
messages.en: Who is that young woman by the door?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 那是我姐姐，她在等我。
messages.en: That's my sister; she's waiting for me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住“门边的一位年轻女子”这个人物画面，把tfajla与少女、年轻女性联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be remembered in people's thoughts or commemorated through an act of remembrance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被人记起、怀念，或通过纪念活动受到追念。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinġieb fil-ħsieb tan-nies jew jiġi onorat permezz ta' att ta' tifkira.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被记起；被人想起或怀念。
被纪念；通过活动、仪式等受到追念。

formal.mt: Il-poeta tfakkar b'ċerimonja fil-librerija tal-belt.
formal.en: The poet was commemorated with a ceremony at the city library.
formal.zh: 市图书馆举行了仪式，纪念这位诗人。

colloquial.mt: Sara: In-nannu tfakkar waqt l-ikla tal-familja? David: Iva, kulħadd irrakkonta xi ħaġa sabiħa dwaru.
colloquial.en: Sara: Was Grandpa remembered during the family meal? David: Yes, everyone shared a lovely memory of him.
colloquial.zh: Sara：家庭聚餐时大家有追念爷爷吗？David：有，每个人都分享了一段关于他的美好回忆。

messages.speaker: Sara (孙女)
messages.zh: 家庭聚餐时大家有追念爷爷吗？
messages.en: Was Grandpa remembered during the family meal?

messages.speaker: David (孙子)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kulħadd irrakkonta xi ħaġa sabiħa dwaru.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kulħadd irrakkonta xi ħaġa sabiħa dwaru.
messages.zh: 有，每个人都分享了一段关于他的美好回忆。
messages.en: Yes, everyone shared a lovely memory of him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“名字再次被提起”的画面记tfakkar：饭桌上被怀念，仪式中被纪念，主语都是被追念的对象。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of commemorating, honouring, or preserving the memory of a person or event.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 纪念或向某人、某事件致敬，以及使其长久留在人们记忆中的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li bih persuna jew ġrajja tiġi mfakkra, onorata jew tinżamm ħajja fil-memorja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 纪念；以活动或其他方式追念某人或某事。
致敬；以纪念的方式表达尊重或敬意。
使留下纪念；通过记录、纪念物等保存对某人或某事的记忆。

formal.mt: Il-kunsill organizza ċerimonja ta' tfakkir għall-vittmi tal-inċident.
formal.en: The council organised a commemorative ceremony for the victims of the accident.
formal.zh: 地方议会为事故遇难者举办了纪念仪式。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Se tmur għaċ-ċerimonja ta' tfakkir għada? Pietru: Iva, se nieħu l-fjuri miegħi.
colloquial.en: Anna: Are you going to the commemorative ceremony tomorrow? Pietru: Yes, I'll take some flowers with me.
colloquial.zh: Anna：你明天去参加纪念仪式吗？Pietru：去，我会带些花。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Se tmur għaċ-ċerimonja ta' tfakkir għada?
messages.mt_standard: Se tmur għaċ-ċerimonja ta' tfakkir għada?
messages.zh: 你明天去参加纪念仪式吗？
messages.en: Are you going to the commemorative ceremony tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Pietru (朋友)
messages.zh: 去，我会带些花。
messages.en: Yes, I'll take some flowers with me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把tfakkir放进“纪念仪式、纪念日”两个词组里记，中心意思是纪念、致敬和保存记忆这一行为。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A large number of children, or actions that show childish behaviour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 数量众多的孩子，或表现得幼稚、不成熟的举动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għadd kbir ta' tfal, jew għemejjel li juru mġiba infantili.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 许多孩子；一大群儿童。
幼稚的举动；像小孩子般不成熟的行为。

collocations.en: a crowd of children in the yard

formal.mt: Waqt il-festa kien hemm tfalijiet fil-pjazza, u l-organizzaturi ħejjew logħob għalihom.
formal.en: During the festival, there were large numbers of children in the square, and the organisers prepared games for them.
formal.zh: 节庆期间，广场上有许多孩子，组织者为他们准备了游戏。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Biżżejjed tfalijiet, agħtini lura l-kappell! Toni: Tajjeb, hawn hu. Kont qed niċċajta.
colloquial.en: Marta: Enough childish behaviour, give me back my hat! Toni: All right, here it is. I was joking.
colloquial.zh: Marta：别闹了，把帽子还给我！Toni：好，给你。我只是开个玩笑。

messages.speaker: Marta (姐姐)
messages.zh: 别闹了，把帽子还给我！
messages.en: Enough childish behaviour, give me back my hat!

messages.speaker: Toni (弟弟)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, hawn hu. Kont qed niċċajta.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, hawn hu. Kont qed niċċajta.
messages.zh: 好，给你。我只是开个玩笑。
messages.en: All right, here it is. I was joking.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记两个场景：广场上“孩子一大群”，争抢帽子时“举动很幼稚”；根据语境区分人数和行为两义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become irritated or feel offended by something said or done.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因某人的言语或行为而恼怒，或觉得自己受到了冒犯。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jirrabja jew iħossu offiż minħabba xi kliem jew xi għemil.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 恼怒起来；变得烦躁或不高兴。
觉得受到了冒犯，并因此生气或不悦。

collocations.zh: 因一句玩笑而觉得受冒犯

formal.mt: Il-parteċipant tfantas bil-kritika u talab li l-kumment jiġi spjegat.
formal.en: The participant took offence at the criticism and asked for the comment to be explained.
formal.zh: 这位参与者觉得批评冒犯了自己，要求对方解释那番话。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għaliex telaq Pawlu? Ben: Tfantas minħabba ċ-ċajta dwar il-karozza tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Rita: Why did Pawlu leave? Ben: He took offence at the joke about his car.
colloquial.zh: Rita：Pawlu为什么走了？Ben：有人拿他的车开玩笑，他觉得受冒犯了。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: Pawlu为什么走了？
messages.en: Why did Pawlu leave?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfantas minħabba ċ-ċajta dwar il-karozza tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Tfantas minħabba ċ-ċajta dwar il-karozza tiegħu.
messages.zh: 有人拿他的车开玩笑，他觉得受冒犯了。
messages.en: He took offence at the joke about his car.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人听完玩笑突然板起脸：tfantas记的是“开始恼怒、觉得受冒犯”这一变化。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A feeling of irritation, or sulking that expresses displeasure.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 恼怒、不悦的情绪，或通过生闷气、闹别扭表现这种不满。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sens ta' rabja jew dwejjaq, jew imġiba ta' min iżomm il-geddum biex juri li mhux kuntent.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 恼怒；因不顺心或受冒犯而产生的不悦情绪。
生闷气；以沉默、摆脸色等方式闹别扭。

formal.mt: It-tfantis tiegħu wara l-laqgħa għamilha diffiċli biex il-grupp ikompli bid-diskussjoni.
formal.en: His sulking after the meeting made it difficult for the group to continue the discussion.
formal.zh: 他在会后闹别扭，让小组难以继续讨论。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Dan it-tfantis kollu għaliex? Luqa: Ma stednux lili, u ħassejtni mwarrab.
colloquial.en: Elena: What's all this sulking about? Luqa: They didn't invite me, and I felt left out.
colloquial.zh: Elena：你这是为什么闹别扭？Luqa：他们没邀请我，我觉得自己被冷落了。

messages.speaker: Elena (朋友)
messages.zh: 你这是为什么闹别扭？
messages.en: What's all this sulking about?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma stednux lili, u ħassejtni mwarrab.
messages.mt_standard: Ma stednux lili, u ħassejtni mwarrab.
messages.zh: 他们没邀请我，我觉得自己被冷落了。
messages.en: They didn't invite me, and I felt left out.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把tfantis记成“板着脸、不说话”的状态；与动词tfantas对照学习：一个说恼怒起来，一个指恼怒或闹别扭。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be caused to burst or explode; also, to develop a rounder face.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受外力或其他作用而破裂、爆炸；也指脸变得圆润。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġi mġiegħel jinfaqa' jew jisplodi; ukoll, wiċċu jsir aktar tond.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被弄破；在外力等作用下胀破或破裂。
被引爆；受到某种作用而发生爆炸。
脸变圆；面部变得圆润。

collocations.en: a ball that was made to burst

formal.mt: Il-ballun tfaqqa' minħabba pressjoni żejda waqt il-prova.
formal.en: The ball was caused to burst by excessive pressure during the test.
formal.zh: 测试过程中，这个球因压力过大而破裂。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'ġara mill-ballun? Mark: Tfaqqa' meta għaddiet il-karozza minn fuqu.
colloquial.en: Maja: What happened to the ball? Mark: It burst when the car ran over it.
colloquial.zh: Maja：球怎么了？Mark：汽车从上面轧过去，把它轧破了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 球怎么了？
messages.en: What happened to the ball?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfaqqa' meta għaddiet il-karozza minn fuqu.
messages.mt_standard: Tfaqqa' meta għaddiet il-karozza minn fuqu.
messages.zh: 汽车从上面轧过去，把它轧破了。
messages.en: It burst when the car ran over it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三张卡片分开记：球被弄破、装置被引爆、人脸变圆。三种都是所给词义，切勿把脸变圆理解成脸爆炸。

gloss_zh: 大摇大摆；变得趾高气扬

teaching_sense.en_definition: To swagger or become pompous, behaving as though one is especially important.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 大摇大摆地表现自己，或变得自命不凡、趾高气扬。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jimxi jew iġib ruħu b'arja ta' kburija, jew jibda jaħseb li hu importanti ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 大摇大摆地走动或举止张扬，显出自负的样子。
变得自命不凡，开始摆出高人一等的姿态。

collocations.en: swaggered in front of his friends
collocations.zh: 在朋友面前大摇大摆地显摆

formal.mt: Wara li nħatar kap, tfaqqam u beda jitkellem mal-kollegi b'arja ta' superjorità.
formal.en: After being appointed head, he became pompous and began speaking to his colleagues with an air of superiority.
formal.zh: 被任命为负责人后，他变得趾高气扬，开始以高人一等的口气对同事说话。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Innutajt kif inbidel Pawlu minn meta ħa l-premju? Mark: Iva, tfaqqam sew; issa jaħseb li jaf kollox.
colloquial.en: Sara: Have you noticed how Pawlu has changed since he won the award? Mark: Yes, he has become really pompous; now he thinks he knows everything.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你注意到保罗获奖后变了多少吗？马克：是啊，他变得可傲慢了，现在觉得自己什么都懂。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Innutajt kif inbidel Pawlu minn meta ħa l-premju?
messages.mt_standard: Innutajt kif inbidel Pawlu minn meta ħa l-premju?
messages.zh: 你注意到保罗获奖后变了多少吗？
messages.en: Have you noticed how Pawlu has changed since he won the award?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, tfaqqam sew; issa jaħseb li jaf kollox.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, tfaqqam sew; issa jaħseb li jaf kollox.
messages.zh: 是啊，他变得可傲慢了，现在觉得自己什么都懂。
messages.en: Yes, he has become really pompous; now he thinks he knows everything.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人获奖后昂首踱步、说话摆架子，把这个词和“得意得大摇大摆”连在一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become poor or suffer financial ruin.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 生活变得贫困，或因严重经济损失而陷入财务困境乃至破产。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir fqir jew jitlef il-flus u l-ġid tiegħu b'mod li jispiċċa f'qagħda finanzjarja ħażina ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得贫穷，生活陷入贫困。
在经济上遭受毁灭性损失，陷入破产或近乎破产的境地。

collocations.en: became impoverished after losing his job

formal.mt: In-negozjant tfaqqar wara li n-negozju tiegħu falla u baqa' b'dejn kbir.
formal.en: The businessman was financially ruined after his business failed and left him with substantial debt.
formal.zh: 这名商人在生意失败并背上巨额债务后，经济上陷入了破产境地。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għaliex Ġanni qed jitlob l-għajnuna? Luqa: Tfaqqar wara li tilef xogħlu; issa bilkemm għandu biex jixtri l-ikel.
colloquial.en: Marta: Why is Ġanni asking for help? Luqa: He became impoverished after losing his job; now he barely has enough to buy food.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：詹尼为什么在求助？卢卡：他失业后陷入了贫困，现在连买食物的钱都快不够了。

messages.speaker: Marta (邻居)
messages.zh: 詹尼为什么在求助？
messages.en: Why is Ġanni asking for help?

messages.speaker: Luqa (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfaqqar wara li tilef xogħlu; issa bilkemm għandu biex jixtri l-ikel.
messages.mt_standard: Tfaqqar wara li tilef xogħlu; issa bilkemm għandu biex jixtri l-ikel.
messages.zh: 他失业后陷入了贫困，现在连买食物的钱都快不够了。
messages.en: He became impoverished after losing his job; now he barely has enough to buy food.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“失业、积蓄减少、生活变穷”的连续画面记忆，重点记住这是变得贫困的过程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be hatched, emerging from an egg.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被孵化出来，指幼小动物从卵或蛋中破壳而出。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Joħroġ mill-bajda bħala ferħ ta' għasfur jew ta' annimal ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被孵出，从卵或蛋中破壳而出。

formal.mt: L-ewwel fellus tfaqqas dalgħodu u baqa' qrib it-tiġieġa.
formal.en: The first chick hatched this morning and stayed close to the hen.
formal.zh: 第一只小鸡今天早晨孵了出来，并一直待在母鸡身边。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Ara, il-fellus tfaqqas! Pawlu: Kemm hu żgħir! Ħallih qrib ommu.
colloquial.en: Nina: Look, the chick has hatched! Pawlu: It is so tiny! Leave it near its mother.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：看，小鸡孵出来了！保罗：它好小啊！让它待在妈妈身边吧。

messages.speaker: Nina (女儿)
messages.zh: 看，小鸡孵出来了！
messages.en: Look, the chick has hatched!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm hu żgħir! Ħallih qrib ommu.
messages.mt_standard: Kemm hu żgħir! Ħallih qrib ommu.
messages.zh: 它好小啊！让它待在妈妈身边吧。
messages.en: It is so tiny! Leave it near its mother.

cognitive_memory_aid: 脑中播放小鸡顶开蛋壳的瞬间，把这个动词直接配上“已经孵出来了”的画面。

gloss_zh: 响亮的声响；噼啪声；爆裂声

teaching_sense.en_definition: Loud noises or cracking sounds, such as repeated sharp reports or the crackling of wood.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 响亮的声响，或物体发出的噼啪、爆裂等清脆声。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħsejjes qawwija jew ħsejjes ta' qsim u ta' xi ħaġa li tfaqqa', bħall-injam fin-nar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 响亮的声响，尤指突然而明显的响声。
噼啪声、爆裂声或物体开裂时的清脆响声。

collocations.zh: 响亮的噼啪声或砰砰声

collocations.en: the crackling of wood in the fire
collocations.zh: 木柴在火中燃烧的噼啪声

formal.mt: Matul il-lejl, it-tfaqqigħ qawwi tal-logħob tan-nar instema' minn diversi toroq.
formal.en: During the night, the loud reports of the fireworks could be heard from several streets.
formal.zh: 夜间，好几条街上都能听到烟花响亮的爆裂声。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'inhu dak it-tfaqqigħ? Mark: Hu l-injam fin-nar; qed jaqbad sew.
colloquial.en: Sara: What is that crackling sound? Mark: It is the wood in the fire; it is burning well.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：那是什么噼啪声？马克：是火里的木柴，正烧得旺呢。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 那是什么噼啪声？
messages.en: What is that crackling sound?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu l-injam fin-nar; qed jaqbad sew.
messages.mt_standard: Hu l-injam fin-nar; qed jaqbad sew.
messages.zh: 是火里的木柴，正烧得旺呢。
messages.en: It is the wood in the fire; it is burning well.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个名词配上两段声音：烟花砰砰响、木柴噼啪响，记住它描述的是听见的声响。

gloss_zh: 大摇大摆的举止；摆架子

teaching_sense.en_definition: Swaggering or pompous behavior that displays an exaggerated sense of importance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以大摇大摆、自命不凡的方式表现自己的行为或姿态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Imġiba ta' min jimxi jew jitkellem b'arja kbira u juri li jaħseb wisq fih innifsu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 大摇大摆、神气十足地表现自己的举止。
摆架子、装腔作势或自命不凡的行为。

collocations.en: to walk with a pronounced swagger

formal.mt: It-tfaqqim tal-kelliem naqqas l-effett tal-messaġġ tiegħu, għax deher aktar interessat fih innifsu milli fis-suġġett.
formal.en: The speaker's pomposity weakened his message because he seemed more interested in himself than in the subject.
formal.zh: 演讲者摆架子的作风削弱了讲话的效果，因为他显得更关心自己，而不是所谈的主题。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għoġbok kif tkellem il-preżentatur? Luqa: Le, kien hemm wisq tfaqqim; seta' jitkellem b'mod aktar sempliċi.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you like the way the presenter spoke? Luqa: No, there was too much pomposity; he could have spoken more simply.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你喜欢主持人说话的方式吗？卢卡：不喜欢，太摆架子了，他本来可以说得更朴实些。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你喜欢主持人说话的方式吗？
messages.en: Did you like the way the presenter spoke?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, kien hemm wisq tfaqqim; seta' jitkellem b'mod aktar sempliċi.
messages.mt_standard: Le, kien hemm wisq tfaqqim; seta' jitkellem b'mod aktar sempliċi.
messages.zh: 不喜欢，太摆架子了，他本来可以说得更朴实些。
messages.en: No, there was too much pomposity; he could have spoken more simply.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象昂首走路、拿腔说话的一整套举止，用“摆架子这种行为”记住它的名词用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of making people poor or reducing their material resources.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人或群体的经济资源减少、生活陷入贫困的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih persuni jew komunitajiet isiru foqra jew jitilfu r-riżorsi meħtieġa għall-għajxien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 贫困化；经济资源流失、生活变得贫穷的过程或结果。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi kif it-telf tal-impjiegi u ż-żieda fil-prezzijiet wasslu għat-tfaqqir ta' ħafna familji.
formal.en: The report describes how job losses and rising prices led to the impoverishment of many families.
formal.zh: 报告描述了失业和物价上涨如何导致许多家庭陷入贫困。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Fuq xiex kien il-programm tal-bieraħ? Mark: Fuq it-tfaqqir tal-familji; tkellmu dwar nies li jaħdmu iżda xorta ma jlaħħqux mal-ispejjeż.
colloquial.en: Anna: What was yesterday's program about? Mark: The impoverishment of families; they discussed people who work but still cannot cover their expenses.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：昨天的节目讲什么？马克：讲家庭贫困化，谈到有些人虽然工作，却仍然负担不起生活开支。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 昨天的节目讲什么？
messages.en: What was yesterday's program about?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq it-tfaqqir tal-familji; tkellmu dwar nies li jaħdmu iżda xorta ma jlaħħqux mal-ispejjeż.
messages.mt_standard: Fuq it-tfaqqir tal-familji; tkellmu dwar nies li jaħdmu iżda xorta ma jlaħħqux mal-ispejjeż.
messages.zh: 讲家庭贫困化，谈到有些人虽然工作，却仍然负担不起生活开支。
messages.en: The impoverishment of families; they discussed people who work but still cannot cover their expenses.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把家庭账本中收入减少、开支增加的画面连起来，记成“生活一步步变穷的过程”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process or event in which young animals emerge from eggs.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 幼小动物从卵或蛋中孵出、破壳而出的过程或事件。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess jew il-mument meta l-frieħ joħorġu mill-bajd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 孵化；幼体从卵或蛋中破壳而出的过程。

formal.mt: L-istudenti osservaw it-tfaqqis tal-bajd u rreġistraw il-ħin meta ħareġ kull fellus.
formal.en: The students observed the hatching of the eggs and recorded the time when each chick emerged.
formal.zh: 学生们观察了鸡蛋孵化的过程，并记录了每只小鸡出壳的时间。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Nistgħu naraw it-tfaqqis tal-bajd? Maja: Iva, imma noqogħdu ftit 'il bogħod biex ma ndejqux lit-tiġieġa.
colloquial.en: Nina: Can we watch the eggs hatch? Maja: Yes, but we will stay a little way back so we do not disturb the hen.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我们可以看小鸡孵出来吗？玛雅：可以，不过我们站远一点，免得打扰母鸡。

messages.speaker: Nina (女儿)
messages.zh: 我们可以看小鸡孵出来吗？
messages.en: Can we watch the eggs hatch?

messages.speaker: Maja (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma noqogħdu ftit 'il bogħod biex ma ndejqux lit-tiġieġa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma noqogħdu ftit 'il bogħod biex ma ndejqux lit-tiġieġa.
messages.zh: 可以，不过我们站远一点，免得打扰母鸡。
messages.en: Yes, but we will stay a little way back so we do not disturb the hen.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个名词想成一段标题为“孵化过程”的录像：蛋壳裂开，小鸡慢慢钻出来。

gloss_zh: 被掸去灰尘；掸净自己身上的灰尘

teaching_sense.en_definition: To have dust removed, or to brush dust and dirt off one's own body or clothes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被掸去灰尘，或把自己身体、衣服上的灰尘和污物掸掉。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitneħħa t-trab minn fuqu, jew ineħħi t-trab u l-ħmieġ minn fuqu nnifsu jew minn ħwejġu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被掸去灰尘；表面的尘土被清除。
掸掉自己身上或衣服上的灰尘、泥土等。

collocations.zh: 进去之前掸了掸身上的灰尘

formal.mt: Il-ktieb il-qadim tfarfar bir-reqqa qabel tqiegħed fil-vetrina.
formal.en: The old book was carefully dusted before being placed in the display case.
formal.zh: 这本旧书被小心地掸去灰尘后，放进了陈列柜。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Pawlu waqaf mal-bieb? Sara: Tfarfar qabel daħal; kellu ħafna trab fuq ħwejġu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Pawlu stop at the door? Sara: He brushed himself down before coming in; his clothes were very dusty.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗为什么在门口停下来了？萨拉：他进来之前掸了掸身上的灰，他衣服上有很多灰尘。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 保罗为什么在门口停下来了？
messages.en: Why did Pawlu stop at the door?

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfarfar qabel daħal; kellu ħafna trab fuq ħwejġu.
messages.mt_standard: Tfarfar qabel daħal; kellu ħafna trab fuq ħwejġu.
messages.zh: 他进来之前掸了掸身上的灰，他衣服上有很多灰尘。
messages.en: He brushed himself down before coming in; his clothes were very dusty.

cognitive_memory_aid: 联想门口拍掉衣服灰尘的动作，再换成书被掸净的画面，同时记住自身清理和被清理两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of removing dust or brushing loose material off a surface.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 擦去表面灰尘，或用刷子等刷掉松散附着物的活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-attività li jitneħħa t-trab minn wiċċ jew li jitneħħa materjal maħlul b'pinzell jew b'xi ħaġa simili.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 擦拭或清扫表面灰尘；除尘。
用刷子等刷去表面附着物。

formal.mt: It-tfarfir regolari tal-ixkafef jgħin biex il-kotba jinżammu nodfa.
formal.en: Regular dusting of the shelves helps keep the books clean.
formal.zh: 定期给书架除尘有助于保持书籍清洁。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'baqa' x'nagħmlu qabel jiġu l-mistednin? Mark: It-tfarfir tal-mejda biss, u nkunu lesti.
colloquial.en: Maja: What's left to do before the guests arrive? Mark: Just dusting the table, and we'll be ready.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：客人到之前，我们还剩什么要做？马克：只剩给桌子除尘，做完就准备好了。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 客人到之前，我们还剩什么要做？
messages.en: What's left to do before the guests arrive?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tfarfir tal-mejda biss, u nkunu lesti.
messages.mt_standard: It-tfarfir tal-mejda biss, u nkunu lesti.
messages.zh: 只剩给桌子除尘，做完就准备好了。
messages.en: Just dusting the table, and we'll be ready.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tfarfir 配上掸子扫过桌面的画面：灰尘被掸走，衣服上的浮尘也能被刷走，两个义项一起记。

gloss_zh: 从一套或一对中分离；落单

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become separated from the collection or pair to which an item belongs.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指物件与原来所属的一套或一对分离，成为落单的一件。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinfired mis-sett jew mill-par li jagħmel parti minnu.

sense_translations.en_definition: to become separated (specifically, of items which are separate from their collection or pair)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 与原属的一套或一对分离；特指成套或成对物件中的某件落单。

collocations.zh: 与配成一对的另一件分离了

collocations.en: became separated from the rest of the set
collocations.zh: 与同套的其余物件分离了

formal.mt: Matul it-trasport, platt wieħed tfarrad mill-bqija tas-sett u tpoġġa f'kaxxa oħra.
formal.en: During transport, one plate became separated from the rest of the set and was placed in another box.
formal.zh: 运输过程中，一只盘子与同套的其余盘子分开，被放进了另一个箱子。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex hawn żarbun wieħed biss? Pawlu: Tfarrad mill-par tiegħu meta ċċaqlaqna l-kaxxi; l-ieħor qiegħed hemm.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why is there only one shoe here? Pawlu: It got separated from its pair when we moved the boxes; the other one is over there.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这里怎么只有一只鞋？保罗：我们搬箱子时，它和另一只分开了；另一只在那边。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 这里怎么只有一只鞋？
messages.en: Why is there only one shoe here?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfarrad mill-par tiegħu meta ċċaqlaqna l-kaxxi; l-ieħor qiegħed hemm.
messages.mt_standard: Tfarrad mill-par tiegħu meta ċċaqlaqna l-kaxxi; l-ieħor qiegħed hemm.
messages.zh: 我们搬箱子时，它和另一只分开了；另一只在那边。
messages.en: It got separated from its pair when we moved the boxes; the other one is over there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 tfarrad 时想象鞋架上落单的一只鞋：重点是物件离开原来的一对或一套，可用来描述物件落单。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To break into pieces; also, to become extremely tired or exhausted.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 物体碎成多块；也可形容人极度疲劳、累得筋疲力尽。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinkiser f'biċċiet; jingħad ukoll dwar persuna li tgħejja ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 碎裂；破成许多块。
筋疲力尽；累垮。

formal.mt: Il-vażun waqa' minn fuq l-ixkaffa u tfarrak f'biċċiet żgħar.
formal.en: The vase fell from the shelf and broke into small pieces.
formal.zh: 花瓶从架子上掉下来，摔成了小碎片。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Mark ġej magħna llejla? Maja: Le, tfarrak bix-xogħol illum u mar jorqod kmieni.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is Mark coming with us tonight? Maja: No, he was exhausted from work today and went to bed early.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：马克今晚和我们一起去吗？玛雅：不去，他今天工作累垮了，早早就睡了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克今晚和我们一起去吗？
messages.en: Is Mark coming with us tonight?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, tfarrak bix-xogħol illum u mar jorqod kmieni.
messages.mt_standard: Le, tfarrak bix-xogħol illum u mar jorqod kmieni.
messages.zh: 不去，他今天工作累垮了，早早就睡了。
messages.en: No, he was exhausted from work today and went to bed early.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个画面记 tfarrak：花瓶摔得粉碎，人工作后累得散架。“碎了”和“累垮了”分别对应它的两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To find consolation or emotional comfort in someone or something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从某人或某事中得到安慰，使悲伤、失落或不安有所缓解。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isib faraġ f'xi ħadd jew f'xi ħaġa u jħoss serħan mid-dwejjaq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在悲伤或失落中得到慰藉。
得到情感上的安慰或宽慰。

collocations.en: found comfort in a friend's words
collocations.zh: 从朋友的话中得到安慰

collocations.mt: tfarraġ bil-ħsieb li ma kienx waħdu
collocations.en: found consolation in the thought that he was not alone
collocations.zh: 想到自己并非孤身一人而得到慰藉

formal.mt: Wara t-telfa, Pawlu tfarraġ bl-appoġġ tal-familja u bil-preżenza ta' sħabu.
formal.en: After the loss, Pawlu found consolation in his family's support and his friends' presence.
formal.zh: 遭遇失落之后，保罗从家人的支持和朋友的陪伴中得到了慰藉。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif inhu Mark wara l-aħbar ħażina? Lara: Għadu mdejjaq, imma tfarraġ meta tkellem ma' ħuh.
colloquial.en: Maja: How is Mark after the bad news? Lara: He's still upset, but he found some comfort when he spoke to his brother.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：听到那个坏消息后，马克怎么样了？拉拉：他还是很难过，不过和哥哥聊过之后得到了一些安慰。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif inhu Mark wara l-aħbar ħażina?
messages.mt_standard: Kif inhu Mark wara l-aħbar ħażina?
messages.zh: 听到那个坏消息后，马克怎么样了？
messages.en: How is Mark after the bad news?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadu mdejjaq, imma tfarraġ meta tkellem ma' ħuh.
messages.mt_standard: Għadu mdejjaq, imma tfarraġ meta tkellem ma' ħuh.
messages.zh: 他还是很难过，不过和哥哥聊过之后得到了一些安慰。
messages.en: He's still upset, but he found some comfort when he spoke to his brother.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tfarraġ 记成一个温暖场景：难过的人与朋友交谈后心里松了一些。用“得到安慰”这个动作来记忆。

gloss_zh: 成套物件的残缺；缺件状态

teaching_sense.en_definition: The incompleteness of a set of objects because one or more items have been broken, lost, or otherwise become missing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一套物件因其中一些损坏、遗失等而不再齐全的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-qagħda ta' sett ta' oġġetti li ma jibqax sħiħ minħabba ksur, telf jew nuqqas ta' xi biċċa.

sense_translations.en_definition: incompleteness of a set of objects, due to breakage, loss etc.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一套物件因破损、遗失等原因造成的不齐全或残缺状态。

collocations.en: the incompleteness of a set of plates
a set becoming incomplete through breakage or loss
collocations.zh: 因破损或遗失造成的成套物件残缺

formal.mt: L-inventarju jiddokumenta t-tfarrid tas-sett ta' platti wara li nkisru żewġ biċċiet.
formal.en: The inventory documents the incompleteness of the plate set after two pieces were broken.
formal.zh: 清单记录了这套餐盘在两件破损之后出现的缺件情况。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex trid tixtri żewġ platti oħra? Lara: Minħabba t-tfarrid tas-sett: wieħed inkiser u ieħor intilef.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why do you want to buy two more plates? Lara: Because the set is incomplete: one broke and another went missing.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你为什么想再买两个盘子？拉拉：因为这套盘子缺件了：一个碎了，另一个丢了。

messages.speaker: Mark (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex trid tixtri żewġ platti oħra?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex trid tixtri żewġ platti oħra?
messages.zh: 你为什么想再买两个盘子？
messages.en: Why do you want to buy two more plates?

messages.speaker: Lara (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Minħabba t-tfarrid tas-sett: wieħed inkiser u ieħor intilef.
messages.mt_standard: Minħabba t-tfarrid tas-sett: wieħed inkiser u ieħor intilef.
messages.zh: 因为这套盘子缺件了：一个碎了，另一个丢了。
messages.en: Because the set is incomplete: one broke and another went missing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tfarrid 配上餐具盒里空着的两个格子：一件摔碎、一件遗失，结果整套不齐。记住它指“缺件状态”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or process of breaking something into pieces.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把物体弄碎，或物体破成多块的行为或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att jew il-proċess li bih xi ħaġa tinkiser f'biċċiet.

sense_translations.en_definition: the act of breaking into pieces
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使物体破成多块的行为；打碎或碎裂的过程。

collocations.en: the breaking of glass into pieces
the breaking of stone into pieces

formal.mt: It-tfarrik tal-ġebel f'biċċiet iżgħar sar qabel it-trasport tiegħu.
formal.en: The stone was broken into smaller pieces before being transported.
formal.zh: 石块在运输之前先被破碎成了较小的块状。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'kien dak il-ħoss qawwi? Mark: Kien il-ħoss tat-tfarrik ta' vażun; waqa' minn fuq il-mejda.
colloquial.en: Lara: What was that loud noise? Mark: It was the sound of a vase breaking into pieces; it fell off the table.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：刚才那声巨响是什么？马克：是花瓶摔碎的声音；它从桌子上掉下来了。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 刚才那声巨响是什么？
messages.en: What was that loud noise?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien il-ħoss tat-tfarrik ta' vażun; waqa' minn fuq il-mejda.
messages.mt_standard: Kien il-ħoss tat-tfarrik ta' vażun; waqa' minn fuq il-mejda.
messages.zh: 是花瓶摔碎的声音；它从桌子上掉下来了。
messages.en: It was the sound of a vase breaking into pieces; it fell off the table.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 tfarrik 时把画面暂停在石块正在碎开的瞬间：它是名词，强调“破碎这个过程”，可与 tfarrak 的动作例句对照学习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Consolation that brings emotional relief to someone who is sad or distressed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能缓解悲伤或苦恼、带来情感宽慰的安慰或慰藉。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Faraġ li jagħti serħan lil min ikun imdejjaq jew imnikket.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 安慰；使悲伤或失落得到缓解的慰藉。

formal.mt: Il-preżenza tal-ħbieb kienet sors ta' tfarriġ għall-familja fi żmien diffiċli.
formal.en: The presence of friends was a source of consolation for the family during a difficult time.
formal.zh: 在艰难时期，朋友们的陪伴给这个家庭带来了慰藉。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ma nafx x'ngħid lil Lara; għadha mdejqa ħafna. Mark: Ftit kliem ta' tfarriġ u ftit ħin magħha jistgħu jgħinu.
colloquial.en: Maja: I don't know what to say to Lara; she's still very upset. Mark: A few words of consolation and some time with her may help.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我不知道该对拉拉说什么；她还是很难过。马克：说几句安慰的话，再陪她待一会儿，可能会有帮助。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma nafx x'ngħid lil Lara; għadha mdejqa ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Ma nafx x'ngħid lil Lara; għadha mdejqa ħafna.
messages.zh: 我不知道该对拉拉说什么；她还是很难过。
messages.en: I don't know what to say to Lara; she's still very upset.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ftit kliem ta' tfarriġ u ftit ħin magħha jistgħu jgħinu.
messages.mt_standard: Ftit kliem ta' tfarriġ u ftit ħin magħha jistgħu jgħinu.
messages.zh: 说几句安慰的话，再陪她待一会儿，可能会有帮助。
messages.en: A few words of consolation and some time with her may help.

cognitive_memory_aid: 将 tfarriġ 放进短语 kliem ta' tfarriġ，想象朋友递来一张写着安慰话语的卡片；卡片带来的就是“慰藉”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To lose hair on the head and become bald.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 头发逐渐脱落，变得秃顶。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitlef ix-xagħar ta' rasu u jsir qargħi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 逐渐变秃；因头发脱落而秃顶。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-protagonist beda jitfartas meta kellu madwar erbgħin sena.
formal.en: In the story, the protagonist began to go bald when he was about forty.
formal.zh: 故事中，主人公在四十岁左右开始秃顶。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan ir-raġel fir-ritratt hu zijuk? Mark: Iva, dak hu. Minn dakinhar tfartas, imma għad għandu l-istess tbissima.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this man in the photo your uncle? Mark: Yes, that's him. He's gone bald since then, but he still has the same smile.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：照片里的这个人是你叔叔吗？马克：对，就是他。从那以后他变秃了，不过笑容还是一样。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 照片里的这个人是你叔叔吗？
messages.en: Is this man in the photo your uncle?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, dak hu. Minn dakinhar tfartas, imma għad għandu l-istess tbissima.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, dak hu. Minn dakinhar tfartas, imma għad għandu l-istess tbissima.
messages.zh: 对，就是他。从那以后他变秃了，不过笑容还是一样。
messages.en: Yes, that's him. He's gone bald since then, but he still has the same smile.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用前后两张人物照片记 tfartas：早年头发浓密，后来头顶稀疏。把词和“逐渐变秃”的变化过程联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A strong wind that blows with considerable force.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 风力很强的风，可用于描述海边、户外等环境中的大风。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Riħ qawwi li jonfoħ b'ħafna saħħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 强风；风力很大的风。

formal.mt: Minħabba t-tfartin, l-attività fil-beraħ ġiet posposta.
formal.en: Because of the strong wind, the outdoor activity was postponed.
formal.zh: 由于强风，户外活动延期了。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Hemm tfartin illum; immorru nimxu xorta? Mark: Aħjar nibqgħu ġewwa sakemm jonqos ir-riħ.
colloquial.en: Maja: There's a strong wind today; shall we still go for a walk? Mark: We'd better stay indoors until the wind eases.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：今天风很大，我们还去散步吗？马克：我们最好待在室内，等风小一点。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm tfartin illum; immorru nimxu xorta?
messages.mt_standard: Hemm tfartin illum; immorru nimxu xorta?
messages.zh: 今天风很大，我们还去散步吗？
messages.en: There's a strong wind today; shall we still go for a walk?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Aħjar nibqgħu ġewwa sakemm jonqos ir-riħ.
messages.mt_standard: Aħjar nibqgħu ġewwa sakemm jonqos ir-riħ.
messages.zh: 我们最好待在室内，等风小一点。
messages.en: We'd better stay indoors until the wind eases.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tfartin 和海边帽子被大风吹走的画面联系起来，记住它指强风，而非普通微风。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of losing hair and gradually becoming bald.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 头发逐渐脱落、头部逐渐变秃的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li fih persuna titlef xagħarha u bil-mod issir qargħa.

sense_translations.en_definition: the process of losing one's hair
sense_translations.zh_definition: 头发逐渐脱落的过程；脱发过程。
逐渐变秃；秃发的过程。

formal.mt: Ir-ritratti meħuda matul is-snin juru t-tfartis gradwali tar-raġel.
formal.en: The photographs taken over the years show the man's gradual balding.
formal.zh: 多年来拍摄的照片显示出这名男子逐渐秃发的过程。

colloquial.mt: Mark: F'dan ir-ritratt qed nara l-bidu tat-tfartis tiegħi. Maja: Qed tqabblu mar-ritratt ta' għaxar snin ilu?
colloquial.en: Mark: In this photo I can see the beginning of my hair loss. Maja: Are you comparing it with the photo from ten years ago?
colloquial.zh: 马克：在这张照片里，我看得出自己开始脱发了。玛雅：你是在拿它和十年前的照片比较吗？

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: F'dan ir-ritratt qed nara l-bidu tat-tfartis tiegħi.
messages.mt_standard: F'dan ir-ritratt qed nara l-bidu tat-tfartis tiegħi.
messages.zh: 在这张照片里，我看得出自己开始脱发了。
messages.en: In this photo I can see the beginning of my hair loss.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed tqabblu mar-ritratt ta' għaxar snin ilu?
messages.mt_standard: Qed tqabblu mar-ritratt ta' għaxar snin ilu?
messages.zh: 你是在拿它和十年前的照片比较吗？
messages.en: Are you comparing it with the photo from ten years ago?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象同一个人多年照片里头发越来越少，用连续变化的画面记住 tfartis 强调脱发、变秃的过程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become red in the face, especially because of embarrassment or shyness.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 脸部变红，尤其指因尴尬、害羞等情绪而脸红。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir aħmar f'wiċċu, speċjalment minħabba l-mistħija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 脸红；因害羞或尴尬等而面部泛红。

formal.mt: L-istudent tfarwad meta l-għalliema faħħret ix-xogħol tiegħu quddiem il-klassi.
formal.en: The student blushed when the teacher praised his work in front of the class.
formal.zh: 老师当着全班的面表扬他的作业时，这名学生脸红了。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Mark tfarwad hekk? Lara: Għax kulħadd faħħar il-kant tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Mark blush like that? Lara: Because everyone praised his singing.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克怎么脸红成那样？拉拉：因为大家都夸他唱得好。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克怎么脸红成那样？
messages.en: Why did Mark blush like that?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 因为大家都夸他唱得好。
messages.en: Because everyone praised his singing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“受到夸奖，他脸红了”的小故事记 tfarwad；这里要记的是脸变红这一动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The reddening of the face, for example from embarrassment or heat.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 脸部变红的现象或过程，例如因害羞或炎热而面部泛红。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-bidla li fiha l-wiċċ isir aħmar, pereżempju minħabba l-mistħija jew is-sħana.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 脸部变红；涨红了脸的现象或过程。
面部泛红；脸部潮红。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, it-tfarwid fil-wiċċ tal-karattru juri l-mistħija tiegħu.
formal.en: In the story, the reddening of the character's face shows his embarrassment.
formal.zh: 在故事中，这个人物脸部泛红，表现出他的窘迫。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Innutajt it-tfarwid f'wiċċ Mark? Lara: Iva, beda malli sema' t-tifħir.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you notice the flushing in Mark's face? Lara: Yes, it started as soon as he heard the praise.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你注意到马克脸红了吗？拉拉：注意到了，他一听到夸奖就开始脸红。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你注意到马克脸红了吗？
messages.en: Did you notice the flushing in Mark's face?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 注意到了，他一听到夸奖就开始脸红。
messages.en: Yes, it started as soon as he heard the praise.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tfarwid 放进“脸红这一现象”中记忆，并与动词 tfarwad 对照：一个给现象命名，一个描述脸红的动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be planned or designed, with the arrangement or details worked out.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某项计划、空间或事物经过规划或设计，其安排、形式或细节得到确定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġi ppjanat jew iddisinjat, bl-arranġament jew id-dettalji tiegħu stabbiliti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被规划；经过筹划或安排。
被设计；其形式或结构经过设计。

collocations.en: the programme was planned in advance
collocations.zh: 活动安排事先经过了规划

collocations.en: the garden was designed by an architect

formal.mt: Il-proġett tfassal biex jipprovdi aktar spazju għall-attivitajiet tal-istudenti.
formal.en: The project was designed to provide more space for student activities.
formal.zh: 这个项目旨在通过设计为学生活动提供更多空间。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-ġnien tfassal għat-tfal? Mark: Iva, għalhekk hemm ħafna spazju biex jilagħbu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Was this garden designed for children? Mark: Yes, that's why there's plenty of space for them to play.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个花园是为孩子们设计的吗？马克：是的，所以这里有很大的空间让他们玩。

messages.speaker: Maja (居民)
messages.zh: 这个花园是为孩子们设计的吗？
messages.en: Was this garden designed for children?

messages.speaker: Mark (居民)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għalhekk hemm ħafna spazju biex jilagħbu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għalhekk hemm ħafna spazju biex jilagħbu.
messages.zh: 是的，所以这里有很大的空间让他们玩。
messages.en: Yes, that's why there's plenty of space for them to play.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象花园从图纸变成实景，用“花园被设计好了”记 tfassal，并注意本词条给出的是被规划、被设计的意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Design work, or the cutting out of fabric pieces when making clothes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 设计事物的工作；在制衣语境中，也指按照所需形状裁剪布料。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ix-xogħol ta' disinn, jew il-qtugħ tad-drapp fil-forom meħtieġa biex isiru l-ħwejjeġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 设计；构思并确定形式或安排的工作。

sense_translations.en_definition: cutting out (used in the context of dress-making)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 裁剪；制衣时按所需形状将布料裁成衣片。

collocations.en: the cutting out of fabric for clothing

formal.mt: Fil-kors tal-ħjata, l-istudenti jitgħallmu t-tfassil tad-drapp qabel jgħaddu għall-ħjata.
formal.en: In the sewing course, students learn to cut out fabric before moving on to sewing.
formal.zh: 在缝纫课程中，学生先学习裁剪布料，再学习缝制。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min ħa ħsieb it-tfassil ta' dan il-ġnien? Mark: Oħti; għażlet fejn ikunu l-mogħdijiet u s-siġar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who took care of the design of this garden? Mark: My sister; she chose where the paths and trees would go.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个花园是谁负责设计的？马克：我姐姐；小路和树木的位置都是她选的。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min ħa ħsieb it-tfassil ta' dan il-ġnien?
messages.mt_standard: Min ħa ħsieb it-tfassil ta' dan il-ġnien?
messages.zh: 这个花园是谁负责设计的？
messages.en: Who took care of the design of this garden?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Oħti; għażlet fejn ikunu l-mogħdijiet u s-siġar.
messages.mt_standard: Oħti; għażlet fejn ikunu l-mogħdijiet u s-siġar.
messages.zh: 我姐姐；小路和树木的位置都是她选的。
messages.en: My sister; she chose where the paths and trees would go.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 tfassil 配两幅学习图：桌上的设计图，以及裁衣桌上的布料；用具体语境区分“设计”和“裁剪”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be flattened, or to drop heavily into a sitting position, such as in an armchair.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被压平或压扁；也指身体一下子落到座位上，例如一屁股坐进扶手椅。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġi ċċattjat, jew jinżel bilqiegħda b'toqol, pereżempju f'pultruna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被压平；被压扁。

sense_translations.en_definition: to drop into a sitting position (e.g. in an armchair)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一下子坐下；一屁股坐到座位上，例如坐进扶手椅。

collocations.en: the bread was flattened under the weight

formal.mt: Il-ħobż tfattar taħt il-piż tal-kaxxa li tqiegħdet fuqu.
formal.en: The bread was flattened by the weight of the box placed on top of it.
formal.zh: 放在面包上的箱子把面包压扁了。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mark daħal u tfattar fil-pultruna. Lara: Wara dik il-mixja twila, żgur kien għajjien!
colloquial.en: Maja: Mark came in and dropped into the armchair. Lara: After that long walk, he must have been tired!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克一进门就一屁股坐进了扶手椅。拉拉：走了那么远，他肯定累了！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克一进门就一屁股坐进了扶手椅。
messages.en: Mark came in and dropped into the armchair.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Wara dik il-mixja twila, żgur kien għajjien!
messages.mt_standard: Wara dik il-mixja twila, żgur kien għajjien!
messages.zh: 走了那么远，他肯定累了！
messages.en: After that long walk, he must have been tired!

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个画面分别记 tfattar 的两义：面包被箱子压扁，以及累坏的人一下坐进扶手椅；不要把两义混译。

gloss_zh: 面团的展压；把面团摊开

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of opening out dough by spreading or flattening it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将面团压展、摊开，使其成为较宽或较薄面片的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li fih l-għaġina tinfetaħ u tiġi ċċattjata biex issir usa' jew irqaq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 面团的展压；将面团摊开、压展的过程。

formal.mt: Waqt it-tfattir tal-għaġina, agħfas bil-mod miċ-ċentru lejn it-truf biex tikseb saff uniformi.
formal.en: When opening out the dough, press gently from the centre towards the edges to obtain an even layer.
formal.zh: 展压面团时，从中心向边缘轻轻按压，使面片厚薄均匀。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Tgħinni bit-tfattir tal-għaġina għall-pizza? Mark: Iva, nagħmlu dan bl-idejn?
colloquial.en: Maja: Will you help me open out the dough for the pizza? Mark: Yes, shall we do it by hand?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你能帮我把披萨面团压展开吗？马克：可以，我们用手来做吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你能帮我把披萨面团压展开吗？
messages.en: Will you help me open out the dough for the pizza?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 可以，我们用手来做吗？
messages.en: Yes, shall we do it by hand?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一团披萨面团被双手从中心向外压成圆片，用这个过程记 tfattir，并把它和 tal-għaġina 一起练习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become so full that the contents spill over the edge.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 容器等被装得过满，以致里面的东西从边缘溢出。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jimtela tant li dak li jkun fih jibda joħroġ minn fuq it-tarf.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被装满至溢出；满得漫过边缘

collocations.en: The tank filled to overflowing with water.
collocations.zh: 水箱里的水满得溢了出来。

formal.mt: Wara x-xita qawwija, it-tank tfawwar u l-ilma niżel fil-bitħa.
formal.en: After the heavy rain, the tank filled to overflowing and water ran down into the courtyard.
formal.zh: 大雨过后，水箱满溢，水流到了院子里。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għaliex hemm l-ilma mal-art? Pawlu: Il-barmil tfawwar. Se nagħlaq il-vit.
colloquial.en: Marta: Why is there water on the floor? Pawlu: The bucket filled to overflowing. I'll turn off the tap.
colloquial.zh: Marta：地上怎么有水？Pawlu：水桶满溢了。我这就关水龙头。

messages.speaker: Marta (室友)
messages.zh: 地上怎么有水？
messages.en: Why is there water on the floor?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.zh: 水桶满溢了。我这就关水龙头。
messages.en: The bucket filled to overflowing. I'll turn off the tap.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tfawwar 和水桶边缘不断往外流的画面连起来：重点是已经满到溢出，而不只是装满。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The spilling of contents over an edge because something is too full; also a state of strong excitement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 东西因装得过满而溢出的现象；也指强烈激动或兴奋的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħruġ ta' dak li jkun f'kontenitur minn fuq it-tarf għax ikun mimli wisq; ukoll stat ta' eċċitament qawwi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 满溢；因过满而从边缘溢出的现象
激动；兴奋的情绪或状态

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi t-tfawwir tal-ilma mit-tank u l-ħsara li kkawża.
formal.en: The report describes the overflowing of water from the tank and the damage it caused.
formal.zh: 报告描述了水从水箱溢出的情况及其造成的损坏。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif laqgħuh lit-tim meta rebaħ? Mark: B'tfawwir ta' ferħ! Kulħadd beda jgħajjat u jċapċap.
colloquial.en: Lara: How did they welcome the team when it won? Mark: With an outpouring of joyful excitement! Everyone started shouting and clapping.
colloquial.zh: Lara：球队获胜时，大家是怎么迎接他们的？Mark：大家喜悦之情涌现！所有人都欢呼鼓掌。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 球队获胜时，大家是怎么迎接他们的？
messages.en: How did they welcome the team when it won?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: B'tfawwir ta' ferħ! Kulħadd beda jgħajjat u jċapċap.
messages.mt_standard: B'tfawwir ta' ferħ! Kulħadd beda jgħajjat u jċapċap.
messages.zh: 大家喜悦之情涌现！所有人都欢呼鼓掌。
messages.en: With an outpouring of joyful excitement! Everyone started shouting and clapping.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅画记 tfawwir：水满得溢出，喜悦也仿佛涌出来。前者记现象，后者记兴奋情绪。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To grow very large, or to become spoiled through excessive indulgence.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 长得非常大；也可指因受到过度纵容而被宠坏。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kiber ħafna fid-daqs, jew sar imħassar għax dejjem tawh li ried.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 长得非常大，体形或尺寸显著增大。
被宠坏，因受到过度纵容而变得任性。

collocations.en: a boy who has become spoiled

formal.mt: Il-kelb tfaħħal ħafna matul l-ewwel sena ta' ħajtu.
formal.en: The dog grew very large during the first year of its life.
formal.zh: 这只狗在出生后的第一年里长得很大。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Ben jibki kull darba li tgħidlu le? Rita: Tfaħħal għax dejjem tajnieh li ried.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why does Ben cry every time you tell him no? Rita: He's become spoiled because we've always given him what he wanted.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：为什么你每次对本说不，他都会哭？丽塔：因为我们以前总是满足他的要求，把他宠坏了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Ben jibki kull darba li tgħidlu le?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Ben jibki kull darba li tgħidlu le?
messages.zh: 为什么你每次对本说不，他都会哭？
messages.en: Why does Ben cry every time you tell him no?

messages.speaker: Rita (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfaħħal għax dejjem tajnieh li ried.
messages.mt_standard: Tfaħħal għax dejjem tajnieh li ried.
messages.zh: 因为我们以前总是满足他的要求，把他宠坏了。
