messages.en: He's become spoiled because we've always given him what he wanted.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅画面区分义项：小狗长成大狗，对应“长得很大”；孩子事事被迁就，对应“被宠坏”。这是情境记忆，不是词源解释。

gloss_zh: 被烧焦；长得很大；变得自满

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become charred, grow very large, or develop an exaggerated opinion of oneself.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被烧得焦黑；也可指长得很大，或变得自满、自视过高。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Inħaraq sakemm sar iswed, kiber ħafna fid-daqs, jew beda jaħseb wisq fih innifsu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被烧焦，表面因烧灼而变黑。
长得非常大，体形或尺寸显著增大。
变得自满、自负，过分看重自己。

collocations.en: became full of himself after his success

formal.mt: Il-ħobż tfaħħam għax tħalla fil-forn għal żmien twil wisq.
formal.en: The bread became charred because it was left in the oven for too long.
formal.zh: 面包在烤箱里放得太久，因此被烤焦了。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Minn meta rebaħ, Mark ma jridx jisma' l-pariri tagħna. Pawlu: Iva, tfaħħam wara dak is-suċċess.
colloquial.en: Lara: Since he won, Mark hasn't wanted to listen to our advice. Pawlu: Yes, he's become full of himself after that success.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：自从获胜以后，马克就不愿听我们的建议了。保罗：是啊，那次成功以后，他变得自满了。

messages.speaker: Lara (队友)
messages.mt_spoken: Minn meta rebaħ, Mark ma jridx jisma' l-pariri tagħna.
messages.mt_standard: Minn meta rebaħ, Mark ma jridx jisma' l-pariri tagħna.
messages.zh: 自从获胜以后，马克就不愿听我们的建议了。
messages.en: Since he won, Mark hasn't wanted to listen to our advice.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (队友)
messages.zh: 是啊，那次成功以后，他变得自满了。
messages.en: Yes, he's become full of himself after that success.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按主语和上下文分三格记忆：面包对应“烧焦”，体形对应“长大”，成功后的态度对应“自满”；不要把三个义项混成一个意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To receive praise or approval for an action, quality, or achievement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因某种行为、品质或成就而受到他人的赞扬或肯定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Irċieva kliem ta' tifħir jew approvazzjoni għal xi għemil, kwalità jew kisba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 受到赞扬或表扬，得到他人的口头或书面肯定。

collocations.zh: 因自己的工作而受到表扬

formal.mt: L-istudent tfaħħar mill-għalliem għall-preċiżjoni u ċ-ċarezza tar-rapport tiegħu.
formal.en: The student was praised by the teacher for the accuracy and clarity of his report.
formal.zh: 这名学生因报告准确、清晰而受到老师的表扬。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif mar ħuk fl-iskola llum? Lara: Tfaħħar mill-għalliema għax għen lil sieħbu.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did your brother get on at school today? Lara: He was praised by the teacher because he helped his classmate.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你弟弟今天在学校怎么样？拉拉：他帮助了同学，受到老师的表扬。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你弟弟今天在学校怎么样？
messages.en: How did your brother get on at school today?

messages.speaker: Lara (姐姐)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfaħħar mill-għalliema għax għen lil sieħbu.
messages.mt_standard: Tfaħħar mill-għalliema għax għen lil sieħbu.
messages.zh: 他帮助了同学，受到老师的表扬。
messages.en: He was praised by the teacher because he helped his classmate.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象老师把一颗表扬星贴到学生本子上：学生是接受赞扬的人。把 tfaħħar 与“受到表扬”这一完整情境一起记。

gloss_zh: 变得下流；行为淫荡、放纵

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become indecent or to behave in a sexually unrestrained way.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变得下流、不雅，或在性行为方面表现得放纵、淫荡。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sar indiċenti jew ġab ruħu bla rażan fl-imġiba sesswali tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得下流、不雅，言行失去应有的端正。
行为淫荡，在性行为方面放纵、不加约束。

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, il-protagonist tfaħħax fl-imġiba tiegħu, u dan wassal għal kunflitt ma' dawk ta' madwaru.
formal.en: In the novel, the protagonist became licentious in his conduct, which led to conflict with those around him.
formal.zh: 在小说中，主人公的行为变得淫荡放纵，由此与周围的人发生冲突。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex tlaqt minn ħdejn Mark? Sara: Tfaħħax fi kliemu, u ma ridtx nibqa' nisma'.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why did you move away from Mark? Sara: His speech became indecent, and I didn't want to keep listening.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你为什么从马克身边走开了？萨拉：他说话变得下流，我不想继续听。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么从马克身边走开了？
messages.en: Why did you move away from Mark?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfaħħax fi kliemu, u ma ridtx nibqa' nisma'.
messages.mt_standard: Tfaħħax fi kliemu, u ma ridtx nibqa' nisma'.
messages.zh: 他说话变得下流，我不想继续听。
messages.en: His speech became indecent, and I didn't want to keep listening.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“话语越说越下流”和“行为越来越放纵”两种场景记忆；这个词带有负面评价，不能只记成普通的“随意”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Sexually unrestrained conduct or a state of sexual indulgence.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 性行为方面缺乏约束的放纵行为或状态，带有贬义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Imġiba sesswali bla rażan jew nuqqas ta' kontroll f'dan il-qasam.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 淫荡；性行为方面不加约束的放纵。

formal.mt: Il-kritiku janalizza kif ir-rumanz juri t-tfaħħil tal-personaġġ prinċipali u l-effetti tiegħu fuq ir-relazzjonijiet tiegħu.
formal.en: The critic analyzes how the novel portrays the main character's licentiousness and its effects on his relationships.
formal.zh: 评论者分析了小说如何描写主人公的淫荡放纵，以及这种行为对其人际关系的影响。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'ried jgħid l-awtur b'ħajja ta' tfaħħil? Mark: Ried jgħid ħajja ta' mġiba sesswali bla rażan.
colloquial.en: Lara: What did the author mean by a life of licentiousness? Mark: He meant a life of sexually unrestrained behavior.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：作者所说的“淫荡放纵的生活”是什么意思？马克：他指的是性行为不加约束的生活。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: X'ried jgħid l-awtur b'ħajja ta' tfaħħil?
messages.mt_standard: X'ried jgħid l-awtur b'ħajja ta' tfaħħil?
messages.zh: 作者所说的“淫荡放纵的生活”是什么意思？
messages.en: What did the author mean by a life of licentiousness?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ried jgħid ħajja ta' mġiba sesswali bla rażan.
messages.mt_standard: Ried jgħid ħajja ta' mġiba sesswali bla rażan.
messages.zh: 他指的是性行为不加约束的生活。
messages.en: He meant a life of sexually unrestrained behavior.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它放进“某种生活状态”的框架：ħajja ta' tfaħħil，指淫荡放纵的生活。记住这里是名词，用来命名行为或状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Excessive body weight; the state of weighing too much.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体所具有的过多重量，或体重过重的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Piż eċċessiv tal-ġisem, jew il-qagħda ta' min jiżen iżżejjed.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 体重过重；身体重量过多的状态。

formal.mt: F'dan it-test, il-kelma tfaħħim tirreferi għall-piż eċċessiv tal-ġisem.
formal.en: In this text, the word tfaħħim refers to excessive body weight.
formal.zh: 在这篇文章中，tfaħħim 一词指身体重量过多。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'ifisser tfaħħim f'din is-sentenza? Pawlu: Ifisser piż żejjed tal-ġisem.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does tfaħħim mean in this sentence? Pawlu: It means excessive body weight.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这句话里的 tfaħħim 是什么意思？保罗：它指体重过重。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这句话里的 tfaħħim 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does tfaħħim mean in this sentence?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.zh: 它指体重过重。
messages.en: It means excessive body weight.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象体重秤旁写着“过多的重量”，把 tfaħħim 整体记为体重过重这一名词概念；学习时同时记住 piż żejjed 这个释义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of expressing approval or admiration for someone or something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某人或某事表达肯定、欣赏或赞美的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed jesprimi approvazzjoni jew ammirazzjoni għal xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 赞扬或表扬的行为，即表达欣赏与肯定。

formal.mt: It-tfaħħir għall-isforz tal-istudenti għandu jkun ċar u marbut ma' dak li jkunu għamlu.
formal.en: Praise for students' effort should be clear and linked to what they have done.
formal.zh: 对学生努力的表扬应当明确，并与他们实际做过的事情相联系。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għoġbok dak li qalet l-għalliema? Ben: Iva, it-tfaħħir tagħha għall-isforz tiegħi ferraħni.
colloquial.en: Nina: Did you like what the teacher said? Ben: Yes, her praise for my effort made me happy.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你喜欢老师刚才说的话吗？本：喜欢，她表扬我付出的努力，让我很开心。

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.zh: 你喜欢老师刚才说的话吗？
messages.en: Did you like what the teacher said?

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, it-tfaħħir tagħha għall-isforz tiegħi ferraħni.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, it-tfaħħir tagħha għall-isforz tiegħi ferraħni.
messages.zh: 喜欢，她表扬我付出的努力，让我很开心。
messages.en: Yes, her praise for my effort made me happy.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“老师说出肯定的话”整件事装进一个名词盒子，盒子标签就是 tfaħħir：赞扬这一行为，而不是某个人的身份。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Obscene acts, or a state of lustful and indecent desire or behavior.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 猥亵、不雅的行为；也可指带有强烈性欲意味的淫荡、好色状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Atti oxxeni, jew xewqa u mġiba sesswali indiċenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 猥亵行为；具有下流、不雅性质的举动。
淫荡、好色；显露强烈性欲的下流状态或倾向。

formal.mt: L-analiżi letterarja tiddiskuti t-tfaħħix tal-personaġġ u kif jidher fi kliemu u fl-imġiba tiegħu.
formal.en: The literary analysis discusses the character's lasciviousness and how it appears in his speech and behavior.
formal.zh: 这篇文学分析讨论了该人物的淫荡好色，以及这种特征如何体现在他的言语和行为中。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex ma għoġbokx dak l-ispettaklu? Mark: Kien fih ħafna atti ta' tfaħħix, u ma ħassejtnix komdu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why didn't you like that show? Mark: It contained many obscene acts, and I didn't feel comfortable.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你为什么不喜欢那场演出？马克：里面有很多猥亵举动，让我觉得不舒服。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么不喜欢那场演出？
messages.en: Why didn't you like that show?

messages.speaker: Mark (观众)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien fih ħafna atti ta' tfaħħix, u ma ħassejtnix komdu.
messages.mt_standard: Kien fih ħafna atti ta' tfaħħix, u ma ħassejtnix komdu.
messages.zh: 里面有很多猥亵举动，让我觉得不舒服。
messages.en: It contained many obscene acts, and I didn't feel comfortable.

cognitive_memory_aid: 分成“具体举动”和“人物倾向”两栏记忆：前者是猥亵行为，后者是淫荡好色。两栏都带负面评价，依据上下文选择中文译法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To have a notch cut into an edge or surface.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 边缘或表面被切出、刻出一个缺口。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Issirlu talja fit-tarf jew fil-wiċċ tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被刻出或切出缺口

collocations.en: The wood was notched with a knife.
collocations.zh: 木料被用刀刻出了缺口。

formal.mt: It-tarf tal-biċċa tal-injam tfażżar sabiex ikun jista' jidħol fih il-ħabel.
formal.en: The edge of the piece of wood was notched so that the rope could fit into it.
formal.zh: 这块木料的边缘被刻出了缺口，以便让绳子嵌进去。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex dan it-tarf għandu talja? Toni: Tfażżar biex il-ħabel jibqa' f'postu.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why does this edge have a notch? Toni: It was notched to keep the rope in place.
colloquial.zh: Nina：这个边缘为什么有个缺口？Toni：这是刻出来的，好让绳子固定在原位。

messages.speaker: Nina (学徒)
messages.zh: 这个边缘为什么有个缺口？
messages.en: Why does this edge have a notch?

messages.speaker: Toni (木匠)
messages.zh: 这是刻出来的，好让绳子固定在原位。
messages.en: It was notched to keep the rope in place.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 tfażżar 时想象木条边缘被刻出一个小缺口，再把绳子卡进去；注意主语是被刻的东西。

gloss_zh: 被刻出缺口的过程；开缺口加工

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process in which a notch is cut into an object.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 物体被切出或刻出缺口的加工过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li fih issir talja f'oġġett.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被刻出或切出缺口的过程

collocations.en: the process of the wood being notched
collocations.zh: 木料被刻出缺口的过程

collocations.en: the process of the edge being notched
collocations.zh: 边缘被开出缺口的过程

formal.mt: Matul it-tfażżir tal-injam, il-biċċa għandha tinżamm fis-sod sabiex it-talja ssir fil-post mixtieq.
formal.en: During the process of the wood being notched, the piece should be held firmly so that the notch is made in the intended place.
formal.zh: 木料开缺口时，应将其固定牢靠，使缺口位于预定位置。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kemm jieħu ħin it-tfażżir ta' din il-biċċa? Ġużeppi: Ftit minuti, iżda l-ewwel irridu nimmarkaw fejn se tkun it-talja.
colloquial.en: Sara: How long does the notching of this piece take? Ġużeppi: A few minutes, but first we need to mark where the notch will be.
colloquial.zh: Sara：给这块料开缺口要多久？Ġużeppi：几分钟，不过我们得先标出缺口的位置。

messages.speaker: Sara (学徒)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm jieħu ħin it-tfażżir ta' din il-biċċa?
messages.mt_standard: Kemm jieħu ħin it-tfażżir ta' din il-biċċa?
messages.zh: 给这块料开缺口要多久？
messages.en: How long does the notching of this piece take?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (木匠)
messages.mt_spoken: Ftit minuti, iżda l-ewwel irridu nimmarkaw fejn se tkun it-talja.
messages.mt_standard: Ftit minuti, iżda l-ewwel irridu nimmarkaw fejn se tkun it-talja.
messages.zh: 几分钟，不过我们得先标出缺口的位置。
messages.en: A few minutes, but first we need to mark where the notch will be.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tfażżir 记成一段加工录像：标位置、固定木料、刻出缺口。它指整个过程，不只是成品上的缺口。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become tame through handling or training, becoming calmer and more accustomed to people.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 动物经过接触或训练而被驯服，变得较温顺并习惯与人相处。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir aktar kalm u jidra lin-nies permezz tal-kura jew tat-taħriġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被驯服；变得温顺而习惯与人接触

formal.mt: Wara diversi xhur ta' taħriġ regolari, iż-żiemel tfeddel u seta' jitmexxa b'aktar faċilità.
formal.en: After several months of regular training, the horse was tamed and could be led more easily.
formal.zh: 经过数月的规律训练，这匹马被驯服了，牵引起来也更容易。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Dan iż-żiemel għadu jibża' min-nies? David: Le, tfeddel. Issa joqgħod kalm meta nersqu lejh.
colloquial.en: Marija: Is this horse still afraid of people? David: No, it has been tamed. Now it stays calm when we approach it.
colloquial.zh: Marija：这匹马还怕人吗？David：不怕了，已经驯服了。现在我们靠近时，它很平静。

messages.speaker: Marija (访客)
messages.zh: 这匹马还怕人吗？
messages.en: Is this horse still afraid of people?

messages.speaker: David (驯马师)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, tfeddel. Issa joqgħod kalm meta nersqu lejh.
messages.mt_standard: Le, tfeddel. Issa joqgħod kalm meta nersqu lejh.
messages.zh: 不怕了，已经驯服了。现在我们靠近时，它很平静。
messages.en: No, it has been tamed. Now it stays calm when we approach it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 tfeddel 时想象一匹原本怕人的马，经过耐心训练后安静地让人靠近，用前后变化记住“被驯服”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be made clear through an explanation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某件事、一个步骤或一个意思通过解释而得到说明。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġi ċċarat permezz ta' spjegazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被解释；被加以说明

collocations.en: was explained with a clear example
collocations.zh: 通过清楚的例子得到了说明

formal.mt: Kull pass tal-proċess tfehem fid-dettall waqt il-laqgħa ta' taħriġ.
formal.en: Every step of the process was explained in detail during the training meeting.
formal.zh: 培训会议上，这一流程的每个步骤都得到了详细说明。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Dan il-pass tfehem fil-lezzjoni? Luqa: Iva, l-għalliema użat eżempju ċar.
colloquial.en: Anna: Was this step explained in the lesson? Luqa: Yes, the teacher used a clear example.
colloquial.zh: Anna：课堂上解释过这个步骤吗？Luqa：解释过，老师用了一个很清楚的例子。

messages.speaker: Anna (同学)
messages.zh: 课堂上解释过这个步骤吗？
messages.en: Was this step explained in the lesson?

messages.speaker: Luqa (同学)
messages.zh: 解释过，老师用了一个很清楚的例子。
messages.en: Yes, the teacher used a clear example.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tfehem 放进课堂画面：黑板上的一个步骤被老师讲清楚。记住这里接受解释的是步骤或内容。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of making an idea, instruction, or situation clear to someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向别人讲清某个想法、指示或情况的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tagħmel idea, istruzzjoni jew sitwazzjoni ċara lil xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 解释的行为；向人讲解或说明

formal.mt: L-għalliem iddedika l-ewwel parti tal-lezzjoni għat-tfehim tar-regoli permezz ta' eżempji prattiċi.
formal.en: The teacher devoted the first part of the lesson to explaining the rules through practical examples.
formal.zh: 老师用这堂课的前一部分，通过实际例子讲解规则。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Għaliex għadna ma bdejniex il-logħba? Samwel: It-tfehim tar-regoli jieħu ftit ħin. Nibdew dalwaqt.
colloquial.en: Elena: Why haven't we started the game yet? Samwel: Explaining the rules takes a little time. We'll start soon.
colloquial.zh: Elena：我们怎么还没开始游戏？Samwel：讲解规则需要一点时间。马上就开始。

messages.speaker: Elena (游戏参与者)
messages.zh: 我们怎么还没开始游戏？
messages.en: Why haven't we started the game yet?

messages.speaker: Samwel (游戏主持人)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tfehim tar-regoli jieħu ftit ħin. Nibdew dalwaqt.
messages.mt_standard: It-tfehim tar-regoli jieħu ftit ħin. Nibdew dalwaqt.
messages.zh: 讲解规则需要一点时间。马上就开始。
messages.en: Explaining the rules takes a little time. We'll start soon.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 tfehim 时想象主持人在游戏开始前讲规则：把“讲解这件事”整体装进名词篮子，便能记住它的用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be cured of an illness or health problem.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 疾病或健康问题得到治疗而痊愈。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jirkupra minn marda jew problema tas-saħħa wara l-kura.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被治愈；疾病得到医治而痊愈

formal.mt: Ir-rapport mediku jikkonferma li l-pazjent tfejjaq mill-infezzjoni wara li temm it-trattament.
formal.en: The medical report confirms that the patient was cured of the infection after completing treatment.
formal.zh: 医疗报告确认，该患者完成治疗后，感染已被治愈。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Kif inhu ħuk issa? Ġanni: Tfejjaq mill-infezzjoni u reġa' beda jaħdem.
colloquial.en: Rita: How is your brother now? Ġanni: He has been cured of the infection and has gone back to work.
colloquial.zh: Rita：你哥哥现在怎么样？Ġanni：他的感染已经治好了，也恢复工作了。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 你哥哥现在怎么样？
messages.en: How is your brother now?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfejjaq mill-infezzjoni u reġa' beda jaħdem.
messages.mt_standard: Tfejjaq mill-infezzjoni u reġa' beda jaħdem.
messages.zh: 他的感染已经治好了，也恢复工作了。
messages.en: He has been cured of the infection and has gone back to work.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tfejjaq 与病人完成治疗后恢复日常生活的画面联系起来；记忆重点是“已经治愈”这一结果。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of curing an illness or restoring someone to health.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 医治疾病、使人恢复健康的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih tiġi kkurata marda jew persuna terġa' tikseb saħħitha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 医治；使疾病痊愈的过程

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-metodi użati għat-tfejjiq tal-marda.
formal.en: The report describes the methods used to cure the illness.
formal.zh: 报告描述了用于医治这种疾病的方法。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'qed taqra? Toni: Ktieb dwar it-tfejjiq tal-mard. Maja: Tista' turini?
colloquial.en: Maja: What are you reading? Toni: A book about curing illnesses. Maja: Can you show me?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你在读什么？托尼：一本讲疾病医治的书。玛雅：能给我看看吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你在读什么？
messages.en: What are you reading?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 一本讲疾病医治的书。
messages.en: A book about curing illnesses.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 能给我看看吗？
messages.en: Can you show me?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词配上一幅医生医治病人的画面，记住它是表示医治过程的名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To suffer a sprain in a joint, such as the wrist or ankle.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 关节发生扭伤，如手腕或脚踝扭伤。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġarrab weġgħa f'ġog, bħal polz jew għaksa, meta dan jitgħawweġ iżżejjed.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被扭伤；发生扭伤

formal.mt: Il-polz tal-plejer tfekkek waqt il-logħba.
formal.en: The player's wrist was sprained during the match.
formal.zh: 这名球员的手腕在比赛中扭伤了。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex għandek faxxa ma' idek? Toni: Il-polz tfekkek meta waqajt. Maja: Għadu juġgħek?
colloquial.en: Maja: Why do you have a bandage on your hand? Toni: My wrist was sprained when I fell. Maja: Does it still hurt?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你的手上为什么缠着绷带？托尼：我跌倒时扭伤了手腕。玛雅：现在还疼吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你的手上为什么缠着绷带？
messages.en: Why do you have a bandage on your hand?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 我跌倒时扭伤了手腕。
messages.en: My wrist was sprained when I fell.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 现在还疼吗？
messages.en: Does it still hurt?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象跌倒后扶着手腕说扭伤了，把 tfekkek 记成关节发生扭伤的动词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or occurrence of spraining a joint.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使关节扭伤的过程，或发生扭伤这一事件。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess jew il-każ li fih ġog, bħal polz jew għaksa, jitgħawweġ iżżejjed u jweġġa'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 扭伤的过程；发生扭伤

formal.mt: Il-lezzjoni tittratta t-tfekkik tal-ġogi waqt l-attività sportiva.
formal.en: The lesson deals with the spraining of joints during sporting activity.
formal.zh: 这节课讲解运动过程中关节扭伤的问题。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dwar xiex kienet il-lezzjoni? Toni: Dwar it-tfekkik tal-għaksa waqt l-isport. Maja: Uri x'għamiltu.
colloquial.en: Maja: What was the lesson about? Toni: About spraining the ankle during sport. Maja: Show me what you did.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那节课讲了什么？托尼：讲运动时脚踝扭伤的问题。玛雅：给我看看你们做了什么。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 那节课讲了什么？
messages.en: What was the lesson about?

messages.speaker: Toni (同学)
messages.zh: 讲运动时脚踝扭伤的问题。
messages.en: About spraining the ankle during sport.

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 给我看看你们做了什么。
messages.en: Show me what you did.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tfekkik 放在扭伤风险这个名词短语里记，区别于表示扭伤了的动词 tfekkek。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of walking slowly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以缓慢速度行走这一活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-mixi b'pass bil-mod.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 慢慢走路；缓慢行走

formal.mt: Fit-test, it-tfekrin tal-karattru lejn il-bieb juri li ma jridx jitlaq.
formal.en: In the text, the character's slow walk towards the door shows that he does not want to leave.
formal.zh: 文中，这个人物慢慢走向门口，表现出他不愿离开。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex dan it-tfekrin kollu? Toni: M'għandniex għaġla; ejja nimxu bil-mod. Maja: Sewwa, nieħdu gost bil-mixja.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why all this slow walking? Toni: We're in no hurry; let's walk slowly. Maja: All right, let's enjoy the walk.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：怎么走得这么慢？托尼：我们不赶时间，慢慢走吧。玛雅：好，那就享受一下散步。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 怎么走得这么慢？
messages.en: Why all this slow walking?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们不赶时间，慢慢走吧。
messages.en: We're in no hurry; let's walk slowly.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 好，那就享受一下散步。
messages.en: All right, let's enjoy the walk.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把走路画面调成慢速播放，用 tfekrin 给慢慢走路这件事贴上名词标签。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become curly, used of someone's hair.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指人的头发变得卷曲。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jieħu forma ta' nokkli, meta jingħad dwar ix-xagħar.

sense_translations.en_definition: to become curly (used of one's hair)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得卷曲，指人的头发

formal.mt: Wara li tneħħew ir-rombli, ix-xagħar tfelfel fit-truf.
formal.en: After the rollers were removed, the hair became curly at the ends.
formal.zh: 取下卷发筒后，发梢变卷了。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara, xagħri tfelfel! Toni: Iva, speċjalment fit-truf. Maja: Jogħġobni hekk.
colloquial.en: Maja: Look, my hair has gone curly! Toni: Yes, especially at the ends. Maja: I like it like this.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：看，我的头发变卷了！托尼：是啊，尤其是发梢。玛雅：我喜欢这样。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 看，我的头发变卷了！
messages.en: Look, my hair has gone curly!

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 是啊，尤其是发梢。
messages.en: Yes, especially at the ends.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我喜欢这样。
messages.en: I like it like this.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一根直发逐渐弯成小卷，把 tfelfel 和头发变卷这个变化动作一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of curling, especially the shaping of hair into curls.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形成卷曲的过程，尤指把头发弄成卷发。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih ix-xagħar jieħu forma ta' nokkli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 卷曲；使头发形成卷曲的过程

formal.mt: Il-kors jinkludi taħriġ fit-tfelfil tax-xagħar permezz tar-rombli.
formal.en: The course includes training in curling hair using rollers.
formal.zh: 这门课程包括使用卷发筒卷发的训练。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dawn ir-rombli għal xiex huma? Rita: Għat-tfelfil tax-xagħar. Maja: Tista' turini kif tużahom?
colloquial.en: Maja: What are these rollers for? Rita: For curling hair. Maja: Can you show me how to use them?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这些卷发筒是做什么用的？丽塔：用来卷头发的。玛雅：能教我怎么用吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.zh: 这些卷发筒是做什么用的？
messages.en: What are these rollers for?

messages.speaker: Rita (理发师)
messages.zh: 用来卷头发的。
messages.en: For curling hair.

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.zh: 能教我怎么用吗？
messages.en: Can you show me how to use them?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把卷发筒旁的操作说明想成 tfelfil：它给卷发这个过程命名，可与动词 tfelfel 对照记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To decline in health and become less physically well.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 健康状况下降，身体变得不如以前。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Imur lura f'saħħtu u ma jibqax f'saħħtu daqs qabel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 健康衰退；身体状况变差

formal.mt: Skont ir-rakkont, Pawlu tfellek f'saħħtu matul dawk is-snin.
formal.en: According to the account, Pawlu's health declined during those years.
formal.zh: 根据这段记述，保罗的健康在那些年间逐渐衰退。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif inhu n-nannu? Toni: Dan l-aħħar tfellek f'saħħtu. Maja: Immorru narawh għada.
colloquial.en: Maja: How is Grandpa? Toni: His health has declined lately. Maja: Let's go and see him tomorrow.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：爷爷怎么样了？托尼：他最近身体变差了。玛雅：我们明天去看看他吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (孙女)
messages.zh: 爷爷怎么样了？
messages.en: How is Grandpa?

messages.speaker: Toni (孙子)
messages.zh: 他最近身体变差了。
messages.en: His health has declined lately.

messages.speaker: Maja (孙女)
messages.zh: 我们明天去看看他吧。
messages.en: Let's go and see him tomorrow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象健康记录上的曲线慢慢下降，把 tfellek 记成身体状况变差，而不是一次具体的受伤。

gloss_zh: 被切成片；开裂，尤指脚跟

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be cut into slices; also, to develop cracks, especially in the skin of the heels.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被切成薄片；也指产生裂口，尤其用于脚跟皮肤开裂。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinqata' f'fetet; jew jiżviluppa xquq, speċjalment fil-ġilda tal-għarqbejn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被切成片
开裂，尤其指脚跟皮肤开裂

formal.mt: Il-ħobż tfellel f'fetet irqaq qabel ma tqiegħed fuq il-mejda.
formal.en: The bread was cut into thin slices before being placed on the table.
formal.zh: 面包先被切成薄片，然后摆到桌上。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed timxi bil-mod? Toni: L-għarqub tfellel u qed juġgħani. Maja: Ejja noqogħdu bilqiegħda ftit.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you walking slowly? Toni: My heel has cracked and it hurts. Maja: Let's sit down for a bit.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你怎么走得这么慢？托尼：我的脚跟开裂了，走着疼。玛雅：我们坐一会儿吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你怎么走得这么慢？
messages.en: Why are you walking slowly?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 我的脚跟开裂了，走着疼。
messages.en: My heel has cracked and it hurts.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们坐一会儿吧。
messages.en: Let's sit down for a bit.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 tfellel 配两张独立记忆卡：一张是切片面包，一张是开裂脚跟；用主语判断当前义项。

gloss_zh: 开始萌芽；开始长出芽苞

teaching_sense.en_definition: To begin producing buds, as a plant or tree does.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指植物或树木开始长出芽苞。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Beda joħroġ il-blanzuni, bħalma tagħmel pjanta jew siġra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 开始萌芽；开始长出芽苞。

collocations.en: began to bud after the rain

formal.mt: Skont in-noti tal-ġardinar, il-lewż tfelles kmieni din is-sena.
formal.en: According to the gardener's notes, the almond tree began to bud early this year.
formal.zh: 根据园丁的记录，这棵扁桃树今年很早就开始萌芽了。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Rajtu l-lewż fil-ġnien? Tfelles! Ben: Iva, il-blanzuni għadhom żgħar ħafna.
colloquial.en: Lara: Have you seen the almond tree in the garden? It has started budding! Ben: Yes, the buds are still very small.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你看到花园里的扁桃树了吗？它开始萌芽了！Ben：看到了，芽苞还很小。

messages.speaker: Lara (园丁)
messages.zh: 你看到花园里的扁桃树了吗？它开始萌芽了！
messages.en: Have you seen the almond tree in the garden? It has started budding!

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.zh: 看到了，芽苞还很小。
messages.en: Yes, the buds are still very small.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tfelles 配上枝头刚冒出小芽的画面，重点记住“开始萌芽”，不要把它记成已经开花。

gloss_zh: 操舵不稳；手淫；管理不善；笨拙出错

teaching_sense.en_definition: Unsteady steering, mismanagement, or blundering; in a separate sexual sense, masturbation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可指操舵不稳、管理不善或笨拙出错；另有独立的性行为义，指手淫，需根据语境区分。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tmexxija mhux soda ta' vettura jew dgħajsa, amministrazzjoni ħażina, jew aġir mimli żbalji; f'sens sesswali separat, masturbazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 操舵不稳；驾驶时方向控制不稳定。
手淫；自慰行为。
管理不善；对事务的组织或处理失当。
笨拙行事而出错；冒失地接连犯错。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jorbot id-dewmien ma' tfellik fl-amministrazzjoni tal-proġett.
formal.en: The report links the delay to mismanagement of the project.
formal.zh: 报告将延误归因于项目管理不善。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Dan it-tfellik fit-tmun qed iħawwad id-dgħajsa. Rita: Għandek raġun. Se nżomm it-tmun aktar sod.
colloquial.en: Mark: This unsteady steering is making the boat sway. Rita: You're right. I'll hold the helm more steadily.
colloquial.zh: Mark：这样掌舵不稳，把船弄得摇来晃去。Rita：你说得对。我会把舵握得更稳一些。

messages.speaker: Mark (乘船的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan it-tfellik fit-tmun qed iħawwad id-dgħajsa.
messages.mt_standard: Dan it-tfellik fit-tmun qed iħawwad id-dgħajsa.
messages.zh: 这样掌舵不稳，把船弄得摇来晃去。
messages.en: This unsteady steering is making the boat sway.

messages.speaker: Rita (掌舵者)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek raġun. Se nżomm it-tmun aktar sod.
messages.mt_standard: Għandek raġun. Se nżomm it-tmun aktar sod.
messages.zh: 你说得对。我会把舵握得更稳一些。
messages.en: You're right. I'll hold the helm more steadily.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 tfellik 分设四张语境卡：船舵摇摆、事务失管、做事出错、自慰行为；靠上下文选义，不把四义强行解释成同一来源。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of cutting something into slices.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把物体，尤其是食物，切成一片片的动作或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att jew il-proċess li taqta' xi ħaġa fi flieli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 切片的动作；把东西切成片的过程。

formal.mt: It-tfellil tal-ħobż għandu jsir b'sikkina adattata biex il-flieli jkunu ndaqs.
formal.en: Bread should be sliced with a suitable knife so that the slices are even.
formal.zh: 给面包切片时应使用合适的刀，以便切出的面包片厚薄均匀。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Min se jieħu ħsieb it-tfellil tal-ħobż? Pawlu: Jien. Trid il-flieli rqaq jew ħoxnin?
colloquial.en: Nina: Who's going to take care of slicing the bread? Pawlu: I am. Do you want thin or thick slices?
colloquial.zh: Nina：谁来负责给面包切片？Pawlu：我来。你想要薄片还是厚片？

messages.speaker: Nina (一起做饭的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jieħu ħsieb it-tfellil tal-ħobż?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jieħu ħsieb it-tfellil tal-ħobż?
messages.zh: 谁来负责给面包切片？
messages.en: Who's going to take care of slicing the bread?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (一起做饭的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien. Trid il-flieli rqaq jew ħoxnin?
messages.mt_standard: Jien. Trid il-flieli rqaq jew ħoxnin?
messages.zh: 我来。你想要薄片还是厚片？
messages.en: I am. Do you want thin or thick slices?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一条面包被连续切成整齐薄片，把整个“切片过程”贴上 tfellil 的标签；这个名词指动作过程。

gloss_zh: 插入楔子；打入楔子的动作

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of inserting a wedge into a gap or opening.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把楔子插入或打入缝隙、开口中的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li ddaħħal feles fi qasma jew f'fetħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 插入楔子；把楔子塞入或打入某处的动作。

collocations.en: insertion of a wedge into the crack

formal.mt: It-tfellis fil-qasma sar bil-mod sabiex il-ġebla ma tinqasamx aktar.
formal.en: The wedge was inserted into the crack slowly so that the stone would not split further.
formal.zh: 楔子被缓慢地插入裂缝，以免石块进一步裂开。

colloquial.mt: Toni: Lest it-tfellis fil-qasma? Marija: Kważi. Il-feles għad irid jidħol ftit aktar.
colloquial.en: Toni: Have you finished inserting the wedge into the crack? Marija: Almost. The wedge still needs to go in a little further.
colloquial.zh: Toni：往裂缝里插楔子的活儿做完了吗？Marija：快了。楔子还得再进去一点。

messages.speaker: Toni (工匠)
messages.zh: 往裂缝里插楔子的活儿做完了吗？
messages.en: Have you finished inserting the wedge into the crack?

messages.speaker: Marija (学徒)
messages.mt_spoken: Kważi. Il-feles għad irid jidħol ftit aktar.
messages.mt_standard: Kważi. Il-feles għad irid jidħol ftit aktar.
messages.zh: 快了。楔子还得再进去一点。
messages.en: Almost. The wedge still needs to go in a little further.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tfellis 记成“楔子进入缝隙”的动作画面，并与 tfellil 的“切成片”分别配图，避免只凭相近拼写混记。

gloss_zh: 在传统游戏中被滚向目标标记

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be rolled towards a target mark in a traditional game.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指传统游戏中的物件被滚动着送向目标标记。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġie mgerbeb lejn marka fil-mira waqt logħba tradizzjonali.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be rolled towards a mark (used in the context of a traditional game)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 在传统游戏中被滚向某个目标标记。

collocations.en: was rolled slowly towards the mark
collocations.zh: 被缓慢地滚向目标标记

formal.mt: Matul id-dimostrazzjoni tal-logħba tradizzjonali, il-ballun tfenda lejn il-marka.
formal.en: During the demonstration of the traditional game, the ball was rolled towards the mark.
formal.zh: 在这项传统游戏的示范过程中，球被滚向目标标记。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Fejn waqaf il-ballun li tfenda lejn il-marka? Ġorġ: Eżatt ħdejha. Kien tassew qrib!
colloquial.en: Marta: Where did the ball that was rolled towards the mark stop? Ġorġ: Right beside it. It was really close!
colloquial.zh: Marta：那个被滚向目标标记的球停在哪里了？Ġorġ：就停在标记旁边。真的很近！

messages.speaker: Marta (观看游戏的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn waqaf il-ballun li tfenda lejn il-marka?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn waqaf il-ballun li tfenda lejn il-marka?
messages.zh: 那个被滚向目标标记的球停在哪里了？
messages.en: Where did the ball that was rolled towards the mark stop?

messages.speaker: Ġorġ (游戏参与者)
messages.zh: 就停在标记旁边。真的很近！
messages.en: Right beside it. It was really close!

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 tfenda 画一条从球通往目标标记的箭头，记住“被滚向目标”的动作及传统游戏语境；朝目标滚去并不保证命中。

gloss_zh: 在传统游戏中向目标标记滚送的动作

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action of rolling an object towards a target mark in a traditional game.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在传统游戏中，把物件滚向目标标记的动作或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li tgerbeb oġġett lejn marka fil-mira waqt logħba tradizzjonali.

sense_translations.en_definition: rolling towards a mark (used in the context of a traditional game)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 在传统游戏中向目标标记滚送物件的动作。

collocations.en: rolling the ball towards the mark

formal.mt: F'din il-logħba tradizzjonali, it-tfendija tal-ballun lejn il-marka teħtieġ kontroll tal-forza u tad-direzzjoni.
formal.en: In this traditional game, rolling the ball towards the mark requires control of force and direction.
formal.zh: 在这项传统游戏中，把球滚向目标标记需要控制力度和方向。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Kif kienet it-tfendija tiegħi? David: Id-direzzjoni kienet tajba, imma l-ballun mar ftit 'il bogħod wisq.
colloquial.en: Anna: How was my roll towards the mark? David: The direction was good, but the ball went a little too far.
colloquial.zh: Anna：我这次朝目标滚球滚得怎么样？David：方向不错，不过球滚得稍微远了点。

messages.speaker: Anna (游戏初学者)
messages.zh: 我这次朝目标滚球滚得怎么样？
messages.en: How was my roll towards the mark?

messages.speaker: David (一起玩游戏的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Id-direzzjoni kienet tajba, imma l-ballun mar ftit 'il bogħod wisq.
messages.mt_standard: Id-direzzjoni kienet tajba, imma l-ballun mar ftit 'il bogħod wisq.
messages.zh: 方向不错，不过球滚得稍微远了点。
messages.en: The direction was good, but the ball went a little too far.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tfendija 当作“一次朝目标滚送”的动作名称，与动词 tfenda 配对学习：一个给动作命名，一个描述物件被滚向目标。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be made to flutter, or to become anxious and unsettled.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受到作用而轻轻颤动、飘动；也可指人变得焦虑、心神不定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiċċaqlaq b'movimenti ħfief u mgħaġġla, jew isir anzjuż u bla kwiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被弄得轻轻颤动或飘动。
感到焦虑，变得心神不定。

collocations.en: the cloth fluttered in the wind

formal.mt: Id-drapp irqiq tferfer mar-riħ li daħal mit-tieqa miftuħa.
formal.en: The thin cloth fluttered in the wind coming through the open window.
formal.zh: 薄布随着从敞开的窗户吹进来的风轻轻飘动。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Pawlu tferfer meta sema' li r-riżultati kienu lesti. Lara: Nifhmu; ilu jistennihom ġimgħa.
colloquial.en: Marija: Pawlu became anxious when he heard that the results were ready. Lara: I understand him; he has been waiting for them for a week.
colloquial.zh: Marija：Pawlu一听说成绩出来了，就紧张不安起来。Lara：我理解他；他已经等了一个星期了。

messages.speaker: Marija (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu tferfer meta sema' li r-riżultati kienu lesti.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu tferfer meta sema' li r-riżultati kienu lesti.
messages.zh: Pawlu一听说成绩出来了，就紧张不安起来。
messages.en: Pawlu became anxious when he heard that the results were ready.

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 我理解他；他已经等了一个星期了。
messages.en: I understand him; he has been waiting for them for a week.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把两个学习画面并排记：窗边薄布轻颤，等成绩的人心里发颤；分别对应飘动与焦虑，不作为词源解释。

gloss_zh: 变得慌乱；一时不知所措

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become unsettled or confused by something unexpected and lose one's composure.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因意外情况而失去镇定，变得慌乱或一时不知如何应对。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitlef il-kalma u jitħawwad minħabba xi ħaġa mhux mistennija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 受到意外情况影响而慌乱、失去镇定或不知所措。

collocations.en: he was disconcerted by the question
collocations.zh: 他被这个问题弄得不知所措

collocations.en: he became flustered in front of the audience

formal.mt: Il-kelliem tferfex meta saritlu mistoqsija mhux mistennija, iżda wara pawża qasira wieġeb b'mod ċar.
formal.en: The speaker became disconcerted when he was asked an unexpected question, but after a short pause he answered clearly.
formal.zh: 发言者被一个意料之外的问题弄得有些慌乱，但稍作停顿后便清楚地作出了回答。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Mark tferfex meta talbuh jitkellem mingħajr ma kien ipprepara. Marija: Mela nagħtuh ftit ħin biex jiġbor ħsibijietu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Mark became flustered when they asked him to speak without having prepared. Marija: Then let's give him a little time to gather his thoughts.
colloquial.zh: Lara：他们让Mark在没有准备的情况下发言，他一下子慌了神。Marija：那我们给他一点时间整理思路吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Mark tferfex meta talbuh jitkellem mingħajr ma kien ipprepara.
messages.mt_standard: Mark tferfex meta talbuh jitkellem mingħajr ma kien ipprepara.
messages.zh: 他们让Mark在没有准备的情况下发言，他一下子慌了神。
messages.en: Mark became flustered when they asked him to speak without having prepared.

messages.speaker: Marija (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela nagħtuh ftit ħin biex jiġbor ħsibijietu.
messages.mt_standard: Mela nagħtuh ftit ħin biex jiġbor ħsibijietu.
messages.zh: 那我们给他一点时间整理思路吧。
messages.en: Then let's give him a little time to gather his thoughts.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住临时被点名发言的场景：原本镇定，突然脑中空白；用这个转折记住“慌了神、不知所措”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Anxiety or excitement, or the sensation of the heart beating noticeably and rapidly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 焦虑或兴奋激动的状态；也可指明显感到心跳急促的心悸感。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Stat ta' ansjetà jew eċċitament, jew sensazzjoni ta' taħbit mgħaġġel u qawwi tal-qalb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 焦虑；因担忧而产生的不安。
心悸；明显感觉到心脏急促或有力跳动。
激动；兴奋的情绪状态。

formal.mt: Fil-ġurnal tagħha, l-istudenta ddeskriviet it-tferfir ta' qabel l-eżami u s-serħan li ħasset meta spiċċat.
formal.en: In her journal, the student described her anxiety before the exam and the relief she felt when she finished.
formal.zh: 这名学生在日记中描述了考试前的焦虑，以及考完时感受到的轻松。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għandi tferfir fil-qalb qabel ma nitla' fuq il-palk. Pawlu: Qed tħossok anzjuża jew eċċitata? Marija: It-tnejn, għax din l-ewwel darba tiegħi.
colloquial.en: Marija: My heart is fluttering before I go on stage. Pawlu: Are you feeling anxious or excited? Marija: Both, because this is my first time.
colloquial.zh: Marija：上台前我感觉心跳得厉害。Pawlu：你是紧张还是兴奋？Marija：都有，因为这是我第一次上台。

messages.speaker: Marija (表演者)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi tferfir fil-qalb qabel ma nitla' fuq il-palk.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi tferfir fil-qalb qabel ma nitla' fuq il-palk.
messages.zh: 上台前我感觉心跳得厉害。
messages.en: My heart is fluttering before I go on stage.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 你是紧张还是兴奋？
messages.en: Are you feeling anxious or excited?

messages.speaker: Marija (表演者)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tnejn, għax din l-ewwel darba tiegħi.
messages.mt_standard: It-tnejn, għax din l-ewwel darba tiegħi.
messages.zh: 都有，因为这是我第一次上台。
messages.en: Both, because this is my first time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用上台前的三个观察点记忆：心里担忧是焦虑，胸口急跳是心悸，期待登场是兴奋；根据语境区分三个名词义项。

gloss_zh: 混乱；缺乏计划的忙乱；过度仓促

teaching_sense.en_definition: Chaos or disorganized activity caused by poor planning, or an excessive rush to act.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 混乱的状态，尤指缺乏计划造成的忙乱；也可指做事过于仓促。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kaos jew attività bla ordni minħabba nuqqas ta' ppjanar, jew għaġla żejda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 混乱；缺乏秩序的状态。

sense_translations.en_definition: disorderly activity due to lack of planning
sense_translations.zh_definition: 因缺乏计划而出现的无序活动或忙乱。
过度仓促；做事急躁、匆忙过头。

collocations.en: disorganized activity caused by a lack of planning
work done in an excessive rush
collocations.zh: 过于仓促地完成的工作

formal.mt: In-nuqqas ta' pjan ċar wassal għal tferfix fit-tqassim tal-kompiti u għal dewmien fil-bidu tal-attività.
formal.en: The lack of a clear plan led to confusion in assigning tasks and a delay in starting the activity.
formal.zh: 由于缺乏明确计划，任务分配陷入混乱，活动开始的时间也因此推迟。

colloquial.mt: Mark: X'inhu dan it-tferfix? Kulħadd qed jagħmel kollox f'daqqa! Lara: Ejja nieqfu minuta u nqassmu x-xogħol.
colloquial.en: Mark: What's all this chaos? Everyone is doing everything at once! Lara: Let's stop for a minute and divide up the work.
colloquial.zh: Mark：怎么乱成这样？大家都在同时做所有事情！Lara：我们先停一分钟，把工作分一下吧。

messages.speaker: Mark (活动志愿者)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhu dan it-tferfix? Kulħadd qed jagħmel kollox f'daqqa!
messages.mt_standard: X'inhu dan it-tferfix? Kulħadd qed jagħmel kollox f'daqqa!
messages.zh: 怎么乱成这样？大家都在同时做所有事情！
messages.en: What's all this chaos? Everyone is doing everything at once!

messages.speaker: Lara (活动协调员)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja nieqfu minuta u nqassmu x-xogħol.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja nieqfu minuta u nqassmu x-xogħol.
messages.zh: 我们先停一分钟，把工作分一下吧。
messages.en: Let's stop for a minute and divide up the work.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象活动开始前没人分工、人人抢着做事：眼前是混乱，原因是没计划，动作是过度仓促，串起三个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A lack of restraint in one's behavior, speech, or actions.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 言语、行为或行动缺乏节制，不能适当地约束自己。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nuqqas ta' rażan fl-imġiba, fil-kliem jew fl-għemil.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 缺乏克制或约束；言行没有节制。

collocations.en: a lack of restraint in behavior
a lack of restraint in speech

formal.mt: L-għalliem spjega li t-tfergħin fl-imġiba waqt id-diskussjoni kien qed itellef lill-istudenti l-oħra.
formal.en: The teacher explained that the lack of restraint in behavior during the discussion was distracting the other students.
formal.zh: 老师解释说，讨论时缺乏克制的行为正在干扰其他学生。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan it-tfergħin fil-kliem qed iweġġa' lin-nies. Mark: Għandek raġun; nista' ngħid x'naħseb b'aktar rispett.
colloquial.en: Lara: This lack of restraint in what you say is hurting people. Mark: You're right; I can say what I think more respectfully.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你这样说话不加节制，正在伤害别人。Mark：你说得对；我可以更尊重地表达自己的想法。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan it-tfergħin fil-kliem qed iweġġa' lin-nies.
messages.mt_standard: Dan it-tfergħin fil-kliem qed iweġġa' lin-nies.
messages.zh: 你这样说话不加节制，正在伤害别人。
messages.en: This lack of restraint in what you say is hurting people.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek raġun; nista' ngħid x'naħseb b'aktar rispett.
messages.mt_standard: Għandek raġun; nista' ngħid x'naħseb b'aktar rispett.
messages.zh: 你说得对；我可以更尊重地表达自己的想法。
messages.en: You're right; I can say what I think more respectfully.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把言行想成需要调节的音量：一直开到最大、没有收敛，就是缺乏克制；用这个场景记住名词含义。

gloss_zh: 被用拨火棍拨旺；被拨动

teaching_sense.en_definition: For a fire or its fuel to be kindled or stirred with a poker.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指炉火或燃料被用拨火棍拨动，使火燃起或烧得更旺。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-nar jew il-faħam jitqalleb b'ħadida tan-nar biex in-nar jaqbad jew jissaħħaħ.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be kindled or stirred with a poker
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被用拨火棍拨动或拨燃，使炉火燃起或变旺。

collocations.en: the fire was stirred up with a poker
collocations.zh: 炉火被用拨火棍拨旺了

collocations.en: the coal was stirred with the poker

formal.mt: In-nar tferken bil-ħadida tan-nar, u l-fjammi reġgħu għolew fil-fuklar.
formal.en: The fire was stirred with the poker, and the flames rose again in the fireplace.
formal.zh: 炉火被用拨火棍拨动后，壁炉中的火焰又升了起来。

colloquial.mt: Pawlu: In-nar tferken, hux? Issa qed jaqbad aħjar. Marija: Iva, qlibt il-faħam bil-ħadida tan-nar.
colloquial.en: Pawlu: The fire has been poked, hasn't it? It's burning better now. Marija: Yes, I stirred the coal with the poker.
colloquial.zh: Pawlu：炉火刚才拨过了吧？现在烧得更旺了。Marija：是的，我用拨火棍拨了拨煤块。

messages.speaker: Pawlu (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: In-nar tferken, hux? Issa qed jaqbad aħjar.
messages.mt_standard: In-nar tferken, hux? Issa qed jaqbad aħjar.
messages.zh: 炉火刚才拨过了吧？现在烧得更旺了。
messages.en: The fire has been poked, hasn't it? It's burning better now.

messages.speaker: Marija (家人)
messages.zh: 是的，我用拨火棍拨了拨煤块。
messages.en: Yes, I stirred the coal with the poker.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象拨火棍伸进炉膛、煤块翻动、火苗升起；句子的主角是被拨动的炉火或煤块，据此记住动词用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To have a surface scraped, or to become untidy and disordered.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表面受到刮擦；也可指地方或事物变得杂乱、失去秩序。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinbarax fuq il-wiċċ, jew isir imħarbat u bla ordni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被刮擦；表面受到摩擦或刮削。
变得杂乱或无序。

collocations.en: the surface of the table was scraped

formal.mt: Waqt it-trasport, il-wiċċ tal-mejda tferkex meta għadda ma' xifer tal-metall.
formal.en: During transport, the surface of the table was scraped as it passed against a metal edge.
formal.zh: 运输过程中，桌面擦过一处金属边缘，受到了刮擦。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Il-post tferkex wara l-festa. Minn fejn nibdew? Pawlu: Ejja niġbru t-tazzi l-ewwel, imbagħad inpoġġu s-siġġijiet f'posthom.
colloquial.en: Marija: The place became a mess after the party. Where do we start? Pawlu: Let's collect the glasses first, then put the chairs back in place.
colloquial.zh: Marija：聚会后这里变得乱糟糟的。我们从哪里开始收拾？Pawlu：先把杯子收起来，再把椅子放回原位吧。

messages.speaker: Marija (聚会主人)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-post tferkex wara l-festa. Minn fejn nibdew?
messages.mt_standard: Il-post tferkex wara l-festa. Minn fejn nibdew?
messages.zh: 聚会后这里变得乱糟糟的。我们从哪里开始收拾？
messages.en: The place became a mess after the party. Where do we start?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja niġbru t-tazzi l-ewwel, imbagħad inpoġġu s-siġġijiet f'posthom.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja niġbru t-tazzi l-ewwel, imbagħad inpoġġu s-siġġijiet f'posthom.
messages.zh: 先把杯子收起来，再把椅子放回原位吧。
messages.en: Let's collect the glasses first, then put the chairs back in place.

cognitive_memory_aid: 分别记两张图：桌面擦过金属边留下刮痕，聚会结束后房间一片杂乱；看到主语与场景再选择对应义项。

gloss_zh: 用拨火棍拨旺炉火的动作

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action of stirring a fire with a poker to make the flames burn more strongly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用拨火棍拨动炉火或燃料，使火焰烧得更旺的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li tqalleb in-nar jew il-faħam b'ħadida tan-nar biex il-fjammi jissaħħu.

sense_translations.en_definition: to stir up flames using a poker
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用拨火棍拨旺火焰这一动作；拨火。

collocations.en: stirring up the fire with a poker
stirring the coal with the poker

formal.mt: It-tferkin tal-faħam bil-ħadida tan-nar għen biex il-fjammi jerġgħu jissaħħu fil-fuklar.
formal.en: Stirring the coal with the poker helped the flames grow stronger again in the fireplace.
formal.zh: 用拨火棍拨动煤块，使壁炉里的火焰重新旺了起来。

colloquial.mt: Lara: It-tferkin tan-nar għen ħafna; issa l-kamra qed tisħon. Pawlu: Iva, ftit qlib bil-ħadida tan-nar kien biżżejjed.
colloquial.en: Lara: Poking the fire helped a lot; now the room is warming up. Pawlu: Yes, a little stirring with the poker was enough.
colloquial.zh: Lara：拨一拨炉火真有用，现在房间暖和起来了。Pawlu：是啊，用拨火棍稍微拨动一下就够了。

messages.speaker: Lara (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tferkin tan-nar għen ħafna; issa l-kamra qed tisħon.
messages.mt_standard: It-tferkin tan-nar għen ħafna; issa l-kamra qed tisħon.
messages.zh: 拨一拨炉火真有用，现在房间暖和起来了。
messages.en: Poking the fire helped a lot; now the room is warming up.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ftit qlib bil-ħadida tan-nar kien biżżejjed.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ftit qlib bil-ħadida tan-nar kien biżżejjed.
messages.zh: 是啊，用拨火棍稍微拨动一下就够了。
messages.en: Yes, a little stirring with the poker was enough.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“拨动煤块让火旺起来”整段动作装进一个名词里记忆；tferkin指拨火这件事，可搭配“炉火的拨动”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action of scraping a surface or grating something into small pieces.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 刮擦物体表面，或把东西擦磨成细小碎屑的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li tobrox wiċċ jew tħokk xi ħaġa biex tagħmilha biċċiet żgħar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 刮擦；刮除表面物质的动作。
擦碎；用磨擦的方式把东西弄成细屑。

formal.mt: It-tferkix taż-żebgħa l-qadima għandu jsir b'attenzjoni biex il-wiċċ tal-injam ma jiġix imħassar.
formal.en: The scraping off of the old paint should be done carefully so that the wooden surface is not damaged.
formal.zh: 刮除旧油漆时应当小心，以免损坏木材表面。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għadek ma lestejtx il-bieb? Mark: Le, it-tferkix taż-żebgħa qed jieħu ħafna ħin.
colloquial.en: Maja: Have you still not finished the door? Mark: No, scraping off the paint is taking a long time.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你还没把门弄好吗？马克：还没有，刮掉油漆很费时间。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你还没把门弄好吗？
messages.en: Have you still not finished the door?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, it-tferkix taż-żebgħa qed jieħu ħafna ħin.
messages.mt_standard: Le, it-tferkix taż-żebgħa qed jieħu ħafna ħin.
messages.zh: 还没有，刮掉油漆很费时间。
messages.en: No, scraping off the paint is taking a long time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词配上两幅动作图：刮掉门上的漆，以及把奶酪擦成细屑，分别记住刮擦与磨碎。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become extremely angry or be driven into a state of frenzy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变得极其愤怒，或受到刺激而陷入狂乱状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jidħol fi stat ta' rabja kbira jew jitwassal għal stat ta' eċċitament bla kontroll.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 暴怒；变得怒不可遏。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be driven to a frenzy
sense_translations.zh_definition: 受到刺激而陷入狂乱或失去控制的激动状态。

collocations.en: became enraged when he heard the news

formal.mt: Ir-raġel tferneż meta sar jaf li xi ħadd kien qered ix-xogħol tiegħu.
formal.en: The man became enraged when he learned that someone had destroyed his work.
formal.zh: 那名男子得知有人毁掉了他的劳动成果后，勃然大怒。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex beda jgħajjat hekk Pawlu? Nina: Xi ħadd kissirlu t-telefon u tferneż bir-rabja.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did Pawlu start shouting like that? Nina: Someone broke his phone, and he became furious.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：保罗为什么那样大喊起来？妮娜：有人弄坏了他的手机，他气得发狂。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗为什么那样大喊起来？
messages.en: Why did Pawlu start shouting like that?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi ħadd kissirlu t-telefon u tferneż bir-rabja.
messages.mt_standard: Xi ħadd kissirlu t-telefon u tferneż bir-rabja.
messages.zh: 有人弄坏了他的手机，他气得发狂。
messages.en: Someone broke his phone, and he became furious.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人听到坏消息后气得大喊，把整个词和从生气升级到暴怒失控的画面相连。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Burning, understood as the action or experience of burning heat.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 灼烧这一过程，或受到灼热时的感受。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni tal-ħruq jew is-sensazzjoni ta' sħana li taħraq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 灼烧；烧灼的过程或灼热感。

collocations.en: the burning heat of the sun
a burning sensation in the skin

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiema fittxew kenn fid-dell minħabba t-tferniq tax-xemx.
formal.en: The workers sought shelter in the shade because of the burning heat of the sun.
formal.zh: 由于烈日灼热，工人们到阴凉处躲避。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex mort fid-dell? Toni: Ma flaħtx aktar għat-tferniq tax-xemx.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did you go into the shade? Toni: I could not stand the burning heat of the sun any longer.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你怎么到阴凉处去了？托尼：太阳晒得灼热，我实在受不了了。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你怎么到阴凉处去了？
messages.en: Why did you go into the shade?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 太阳晒得灼热，我实在受不了了。
messages.en: I could not stand the burning heat of the sun any longer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用烈日晒得皮肤发烫的感觉记住这个名词：重点是灼烧与灼热，而非普通的温暖。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A state or expression of intense, uncontrolled anger.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 强烈而失控的愤怒状态，或这种愤怒的表现。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Stat jew wirja ta' rabja qawwija u bla kontroll.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 发怒；狂怒或暴怒的状态与表现。

formal.mt: It-tferniż tiegħu fixkel il-laqgħa u ma ħalla lil ħadd jitkellem bil-kalma.
formal.en: His raging disrupted the meeting and prevented anyone from speaking calmly.
formal.zh: 他的暴怒打乱了会议，使大家都无法平静地发言。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Stajtu tkellmu miegħu? Mark: Le, bit-tferniż kollu tiegħu ma stajna ngħidu xejn.
colloquial.en: Maja: Were you able to speak to him? Mark: No, with all his raging, we could not say anything.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你们能跟他说上话吗？马克：不能，他大发雷霆，我们什么也说不了。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 你们能跟他说上话吗？
messages.en: Were you able to speak to him?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, bit-tferniż kollu tiegħu ma stajna ngħidu xejn.
messages.mt_standard: Le, bit-tferniż kollu tiegħu ma stajna ngħidu xejn.
messages.zh: 不能，他大发雷霆，我们什么也说不了。
messages.en: No, with all his raging, we could not say anything.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把大发雷霆的整个场面装进一个名词盒子：这个词指暴怒状态，可用他的暴怒来帮助记忆。

gloss_zh: 被倒出；被倒空；长出枝条

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be poured out, to be emptied of contents, or, of a plant, to grow branches.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指液体等被倒出、容器被倒空，或植物长出枝条。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitferra' bħala kontenut, jitbattal minn dak li jkun fih, jew, fil-każ ta' pjanta, joħroġ friegħi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被倒出；被倾倒。
被倒空；里面的东西被清空。
长出枝条；生出分枝。

collocations.en: the water was poured into the bucket

formal.mt: L-ilma tferragħ f'kontenitur nadif qabel ma beda l-esperiment.
formal.en: The water was poured into a clean container before the experiment began.
formal.zh: 实验开始前，水被倒入一个干净的容器中。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn mar l-ilma li kien fil-buqar? Toni: Tferragħ fil-barmil biex insaqqu l-pjanti.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where did the water in the jug go? Toni: It was poured into the bucket so we could water the plants.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：水壶里的水去哪儿了？托尼：倒进桶里了，用来给植物浇水。

messages.speaker: Lara (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn mar l-ilma li kien fil-buqar?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn mar l-ilma li kien fil-buqar?
messages.zh: 水壶里的水去哪儿了？
messages.en: Where did the water in the jug go?

messages.speaker: Toni (家人)
messages.zh: 倒进桶里了，用来给植物浇水。
messages.en: It was poured into the bucket so we could water the plants.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三张独立图片记义：水被倒出、桶被倒空、树长枝条；这是记忆分组，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be separated from others or to be kept apart from them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与其他人或事物分开，或被安排保持彼此隔开的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinfired minn oħrajn jew jinżamm separat minnhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被分开；与原来在一起的人或事物分离。
被隔开；被安排保持分离状态。

collocations.en: the group was separated into two parts
collocations.zh: 这个群体被分成两部分

collocations.en: was kept apart from the rest

formal.mt: Il-grupp tferraq f'żewġ partijiet, u kull parti ngħatat kamra differenti.
formal.en: The group was separated into two parts, and each part was assigned a different room.
formal.zh: 这个群体被分成两部分，每部分被安排在不同的房间。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex m'aħniex ilkoll fl-istess kamra? Maja: Il-grupp tferraq għax kamra waħda ma kinitx biżżejjed.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why are we not all in the same room? Maja: The group was split up because one room was not enough.
colloquial.zh: 马克：为什么我们没有全在同一个房间？玛雅：一间房容纳不下，所以大家被分开了。

messages.speaker: Mark (活动参加者)
messages.zh: 为什么我们没有全在同一个房间？
messages.en: Why are we not all in the same room?

messages.speaker: Maja (活动组织者)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-grupp tferraq għax kamra waħda ma kinitx biżżejjed.
messages.mt_standard: Il-grupp tferraq għax kamra waħda ma kinitx biżżejjed.
messages.zh: 一间房容纳不下，所以大家被分开了。
messages.en: The group was split up because one room was not enough.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一群人被安排到两间房：分开的动作对应第一义，继续保持隔开对应第二义。

gloss_zh: 使自己快乐；出生（用于动物）

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make oneself happy or, when referring to an animal, to be born.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 让自己快乐起来；也可用于动物，表示出生。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel lilu nnifsu ferħan jew, meta jingħad dwar annimal, jitwieled.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使自己高兴；让自己快乐起来。
出生；用于动物。

collocations.en: made himself happy in the company of friends
collocations.zh: 与朋友相聚，让自己开心起来

formal.mt: Wara ġimgħa diffiċli, Pawlu tferraħ billi qatta' ftit ħin mal-ħbieb tiegħu.
formal.en: After a difficult week, Pawlu made himself happy by spending some time with his friends.
formal.zh: 度过艰难的一周后，保罗与朋友们相聚了一会儿，让自己开心起来。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan il-fellus ilbieraħ ma kienx hawn, hux? Nina: Le, tferraħ dalgħodu.
colloquial.en: Sara: This chick was not here yesterday, was it? Nina: No, it was born this morning.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这只小鸡昨天还不在这里，对吧？妮娜：对，它是今天早上出生的。

messages.speaker: Sara (农场访客)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-fellus ilbieraħ ma kienx hawn, hux?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-fellus ilbieraħ ma kienx hawn, hux?
messages.zh: 这只小鸡昨天还不在这里，对吧？
messages.en: This chick was not here yesterday, was it?

messages.speaker: Nina (农场主人)
messages.zh: 对，它是今天早上出生的。
messages.en: No, it was born this morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先看主语再选意思：人让自己开心，动物则可表示出生；用朋友聚会与小鸡出生两幅图分别记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be dispersed over an area or spread across a surface or place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 分散到某个区域各处，或被铺散、散布在某个表面或地方。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinxtered f'diversi postijiet jew fuq wiċċ jew żona.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被分散；散开到不同位置。
被散布；被铺散或扩散开来。

collocations.en: the dust was dispersed by the wind
the salt was spread over the table

formal.mt: It-trab tferrex fuq żona wiesgħa minħabba r-riħ qawwi.
formal.en: The dust was dispersed over a wide area because of the strong wind.
formal.zh: 由于强风，灰尘散布到了很大一片区域。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'ġara hawn? Il-mejda kollha mielħa! Toni: Waqa' l-kontenitur u l-melħ tferrex kullimkien.
colloquial.en: Nina: What happened here? The whole table is covered in salt! Toni: The container fell, and the salt scattered everywhere.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这里怎么了？整张桌子都是盐！托尼：容器掉下来了，盐撒得到处都是。

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.zh: 这里怎么了？整张桌子都是盐！
messages.en: What happened here? The whole table is covered in salt!

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Waqa' l-kontenitur u l-melħ tferrex kullimkien.
messages.mt_standard: Waqa' l-kontenitur u l-melħ tferrex kullimkien.
messages.zh: 容器掉下来了，盐撒得到处都是。
messages.en: The container fell, and the salt scattered everywhere.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象盐罐掉落后，盐粒从一处散到整张桌子；用从集中到四处分布的画面记住分散与散布。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The dense growth or arrangement of branches on a tree or plant.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 树木或植物的枝条密集生长、形成繁密分枝的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-tkabbir jew l-arranġament ta' ħafna friegħi qrib xulxin fuq siġra jew pjanta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 枝条密集生长；繁密的分枝状态。

formal.mt: It-tferrigħ dens tas-siġra jnaqqas id-dawl li jilħaq l-art taħtha.
formal.en: The tree's dense branching reduces the light reaching the ground beneath it.
formal.zh: 这棵树枝条密生，使照到树下地面的光线减少。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex hawn tant dell taħt din is-siġra? Pawlu: Minħabba t-tferrigħ dens tagħha; il-friegħi jgħattu ħafna mid-dawl.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is there so much shade under this tree? Pawlu: Because of its dense branching; the branches block much of the light.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这棵树下面怎么这么阴凉？Pawlu：因为它枝条很密，挡住了很多光线。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex hawn tant dell taħt din is-siġra?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex hawn tant dell taħt din is-siġra?
messages.zh: 这棵树下面怎么这么阴凉？
messages.en: Why is there so much shade under this tree?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Minħabba t-tferrigħ dens tagħha; il-friegħi jgħattu ħafna mid-dawl.
messages.mt_standard: Minħabba t-tferrigħ dens tagħha; il-friegħi jgħattu ħafna mid-dawl.
messages.zh: 因为它枝条很密，挡住了很多光线。
messages.en: Because of its dense branching; the branches block much of the light.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象树冠里枝条密密交错、阳光难以穿过的画面，把 tferrigħ 与“繁密分枝”一起记。

gloss_zh: 拉开打斗者；使打斗双方保持分开

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of separating people who are fighting and keeping them apart.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把正在打斗的人拉开，并使双方保持分开的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tifred nies li jkunu qed jiġġieldu u żżommhom 'il bogħod minn xulxin.

sense_translations.en_definition: the act of holding apart (used of people in a fight who are separated)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 将打斗中的人拉开，并使他们保持分开的行为。

collocations.mt: it-tferriq ta' żewġ persuni li qed jiġġieldu
collocations.en: separating two people who are fighting
collocations.zh: 拉开两名正在打斗的人

collocations.en: to help keep the fighters apart
collocations.zh: 协助拉开并隔住打斗者

formal.mt: L-għalliema għenu fit-tferriq taż-żewġ studenti li kienu qed jiġġieldu fil-bitħa.
formal.en: The teachers helped separate the two students who were fighting in the playground.
formal.zh: 老师们协助拉开了两名正在操场上打斗的学生。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min għen fit-tferriq taż-żewġ subien? Pawlu: L-għalliem; żammhom 'il bogħod minn xulxin sakemm ikkalmaw.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who helped separate the two boys? Pawlu: The teacher; he kept them apart until they calmed down.
colloquial.zh: Maja：是谁帮忙拉开那两个男孩的？Pawlu：老师；他把两人隔开，直到他们冷静下来。

messages.speaker: Maja (家长)
messages.zh: 是谁帮忙拉开那两个男孩的？
messages.en: Who helped separate the two boys?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (家长)
messages.mt_spoken: L-għalliem; żammhom 'il bogħod minn xulxin sakemm ikkalmaw.
messages.mt_standard: L-għalliem; żammhom 'il bogħod minn xulxin sakemm ikkalmaw.
messages.zh: 老师；他把两人隔开，直到他们冷静下来。
messages.en: The teacher; he kept them apart until they calmed down.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象老师站在两个打斗者中间，双臂把双方隔开；用这个动作记住 tferriq 的劝架分隔义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The scattering, spreading, or distribution of something across an area or among recipients.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使事物散布或扩散到某个范围，也指把东西分发给不同的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-tixrid ta' xi ħaġa f'żona jew it-tqassim tagħha fost diversi persuni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 散布；分散到不同地方。
扩散；逐渐向周围传播或散开。
分发；把物品等分配给不同的人或地点。

formal.mt: Ir-riħ jgħin fit-tferrix taż-żrieragħ lejn żoni aktar imbiegħda mill-pjanta.
formal.en: The wind helps disperse seeds to areas farther from the plant.
formal.zh: 风有助于把种子散布到离植株更远的地方。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min se jieħu ħsieb it-tferrix tal-fuljetti? Pawlu: Jien u Sara; se nagħtuhom lin-nies ħdejn id-daħla.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who will take care of distributing the leaflets? Pawlu: Sara and I; we will hand them to people near the entrance.
colloquial.zh: Maja：谁来负责分发传单？Pawlu：我和 Sara；我们会在入口附近把传单发给大家。

messages.speaker: Maja (活动组织者)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jieħu ħsieb it-tferrix tal-fuljetti?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jieħu ħsieb it-tferrix tal-fuljetti?
messages.zh: 谁来负责分发传单？
messages.en: Who will take care of distributing the leaflets?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (志愿者)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien u Sara; se nagħtuhom lin-nies ħdejn id-daħla.
messages.mt_standard: Jien u Sara; se nagħtuhom lin-nies ħdejn id-daħla.
messages.zh: 我和 Sara；我们会在入口附近把传单发给大家。
messages.en: Sara and I; we will hand them to people near the entrance.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把种子散开、气味扩散、传单分发排成三幅图，记住 tferrix 都涉及向不同地方或对象散开。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of bringing joy to other people; also, the bearing of young by an animal.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 给他人带来喜悦的行为；也指动物产下幼崽。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għoti ta' ferħ lil ħaddieħor; ukoll, il-fatt li annimal ikollu l-frieħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使他人高兴、给他人带来喜悦的行为。
生育后代；产下幼崽。

collocations.en: to bring joy to the children
the bearing of young by rabbits

formal.mt: L-attivitajiet ġew organizzati għat-tferriħ tat-tfal li kienu qed joqogħdu fl-isptar.
formal.en: The activities were organized to bring joy to the children staying in hospital.
formal.zh: 这些活动是为住院的孩子们安排的，目的是让他们开心。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ġibt dawn il-logħob kollu? Pawlu: Għat-tferriħ tat-tfal; illum irrid narahom jidħku.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you bring all these games? Pawlu: To bring joy to the children; I want to see them laughing today.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你怎么带来了这么多游戏？Pawlu：为了让孩子们开心；我今天想看到他们笑。

messages.speaker: Maja (活动志愿者)
messages.zh: 你怎么带来了这么多游戏？
messages.en: Why did you bring all these games?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (活动志愿者)
messages.mt_spoken: Għat-tferriħ tat-tfal; illum irrid narahom jidħku.
messages.mt_standard: Għat-tferriħ tat-tfal; illum irrid narahom jidħku.
messages.zh: 为了让孩子们开心；我今天想看到他们笑。
messages.en: To bring joy to the children; I want to see them laughing today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张画面分别记义：一张是逗孩子开心，一张是动物产崽；看到 tferriħ 时依上下文选择。

gloss_zh: 挥舞双臂，尤指愤怒或焦急时

teaching_sense.en_definition: The waving of one's arms, especially as an expression of anger or anxiety.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 挥舞双臂的动作，尤其指因愤怒或焦虑而挥动手臂。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iċ-ċaqliq tad-dirgħajn fl-arja, speċjalment minħabba rabja jew ansjetà.

sense_translations.en_definition: waving of the arms (especially in anger or anxiety)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 挥舞双臂，尤指在愤怒或焦急时做出的动作。

formal.mt: It-tfertil ta' dirgħajh waqt id-diskussjoni wera kemm kien irrabjat.
formal.en: His waving of his arms during the discussion showed how angry he was.
formal.zh: 讨论时他不断挥舞双臂，显露出他有多么愤怒。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex dak it-tfertil kollu? Pawlu: Kont inkwetat għax ma stajtx insib lil ibni fil-folla.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why all that waving of your arms? Pawlu: I was anxious because I could not find my son in the crowd.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你刚才怎么一直挥舞双臂？Pawlu：我在人群里找不到儿子，急坏了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你刚才怎么一直挥舞双臂？
messages.en: Why all that waving of your arms?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Kont inkwetat għax ma stajtx insib lil ibni fil-folla.
messages.mt_standard: Kont inkwetat għax ma stajtx insib lil ibni fil-folla.
messages.zh: 我在人群里找不到儿子，急坏了。
messages.en: I was anxious because I could not find my son in the crowd.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人急得双臂挥个不停，用手臂动作加上焦急表情来记 tfertil。

gloss_zh: 开始拖步走；开始挪着脚走

teaching_sense.en_definition: To start moving with shuffling steps.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 开始以拖着脚、挪着小步的方式行走。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Beda jimxi b'passi żgħar waqt li jkaxkar saqajh.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 开始拖步行走；开始挪着脚走。

formal.mt: Wara li qam mis-siġġu, ir-raġel tferċaħ lejn il-bieb b'passi żgħar.
formal.en: After getting up from the chair, the man began shuffling towards the door with small steps.
formal.zh: 从椅子上起身后，那个男人开始拖着脚，以小步向门口走去。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex tferċaħ lejn il-kċina hekk kif qam? Luqa: Kien għadu bin-ngħas u ma kienx għadu miexi sew.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did he start shuffling towards the kitchen as soon as he got up? Luqa: He was still sleepy and wasn't walking properly yet.
colloquial.zh: Sara：他怎么一起床就拖着脚往厨房走？Luqa：他还困着呢，走路还没走利索。

messages.speaker: Sara (姐姐)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex tferċaħ lejn il-kċina hekk kif qam?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex tferċaħ lejn il-kċina hekk kif qam?
messages.zh: 他怎么一起床就拖着脚往厨房走？
messages.en: Why did he start shuffling towards the kitchen as soon as he got up?

messages.speaker: Luqa (哥哥)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien għadu bin-ngħas u ma kienx għadu miexi sew.
messages.mt_standard: Kien għadu bin-ngħas u ma kienx għadu miexi sew.
messages.zh: 他还困着呢，走路还没走利索。
messages.en: He was still sleepy and wasn't walking properly yet.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象刚起床的人开始拖着拖鞋挪步，把 tferċaħ 的重点放在“开始这样走”的瞬间，同时记住它是动词。

gloss_zh: 急促碎步移动；拖步行走

teaching_sense.en_definition: Movement with quick small steps, or movement with shuffling steps.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用急促小步移动的动作，也可指拖着脚挪步行走；具体方式由语境判断。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Moviment b'passi żgħar u mgħaġġla, jew mixi b'passi żgħar waqt li wieħed ikaxkar saqajh.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 急促地迈小步移动；碎步疾行。
拖步行走；拖着脚挪动。

formal.mt: L-osservatur irreġistra t-tferċiħ tal-granċ fuq ir-ramel qabel ma dan daħal taħt blata.
formal.en: The observer recorded the crab's scuttling across the sand before it went under a rock.
formal.zh: 观察者记录了螃蟹钻入岩石下方之前，在沙地上急促爬动的过程。

colloquial.mt: Elena: X'inhu dak it-tferċiħ fil-kuritur? Mark: Pawlu qed jimxi bil-papoċċi u jkaxkar saqajh.
colloquial.en: Elena: What's that shuffling in the corridor? Mark: Pawlu is walking in his slippers and dragging his feet.
colloquial.zh: Elena：走廊里那拖拖沓沓的脚步声是什么？Mark：Pawlu穿着拖鞋，拖着脚走路呢。

messages.speaker: Elena (室友)
messages.zh: 走廊里那拖拖沓沓的脚步声是什么？
messages.en: What's that shuffling in the corridor?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu qed jimxi bil-papoċċi u jkaxkar saqajh.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu qed jimxi bil-papoċċi u jkaxkar saqajh.
messages.zh: Pawlu穿着拖鞋，拖着脚走路呢。
messages.en: Pawlu is walking in his slippers and dragging his feet.

cognitive_memory_aid: 为 tferċiħ 配两段画面：螃蟹急促迈小步、人穿拖鞋拖步走；两种移动方式分别对应词义，并记住它是动作名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To wrap oneself in covering such as warm clothes or a blanket; also, to have a shell removed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用保暖衣物或毯子等把自己裹起来；也指外壳被剥除。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitgeżwer fi ħwejjeġ sħan jew f'kutra; ukoll, titneħħielu l-qoxra.

sense_translations.en_definition: to swathe oneself (e.g. in warm clothes)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 把自己裹起来，例如裹进保暖衣物里。
被剥去外壳；被去壳。

formal.mt: Malli beda jħoss il-bard, Mark tfesdaq f'kutra ħoxna.
formal.en: As soon as he began to feel cold, Mark wrapped himself in a thick blanket.
formal.zh: Mark 一开始觉得冷，就把自己裹进了一条厚毯子里。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Mark tfesdaq f'dik il-kutra? Pawlu: Għax għandu l-bard u jrid jisħon.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Mark wrap himself in that blanket? Pawlu: Because he is cold and wants to warm up.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Mark 为什么把自己裹进那条毯子里？Pawlu：因为他觉得冷，想暖和一下。

messages.speaker: Maja (母亲)
messages.zh: Mark 为什么把自己裹进那条毯子里？
messages.en: Why did Mark wrap himself in that blanket?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax għandu l-bard u jrid jisħon.
messages.mt_standard: Għax għandu l-bard u jrid jisħon.
messages.zh: 因为他觉得冷，想暖和一下。
messages.en: Because he is cold and wants to warm up.

cognitive_memory_aid: 分开记两幅图：人把自己裹进毯子，杏仁被剥去硬壳；主语和上下文帮助判断 tfesdaq 的意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of wrapping or swathing; also, the removal of a protective shell or pod.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 包裹或裹覆的行为；也指去掉保护性的外壳或豆荚。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tgeżwer jew tgħatti lil xi ħadd jew lil xi ħaġa; ukoll, it-tneħħija ta' qoxra jew miżwed.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 包裹；把人或物包在覆盖物里面。
裹覆；用布、衣物等包住。

sense_translations.en_definition: removal of a protective shell or pod
sense_translations.zh_definition: 去除保护性的外壳或荚壳。
去壳；剥除硬壳。
剥壳或剥荚，取出里面的部分。

collocations.en: the swathing of the baby in a blanket

formal.mt: Wara t-tfesdiq tal-lewż, il-qlub inġabru fi skutella għat-tħin.
formal.en: After the almonds were shelled, the kernels were collected in a bowl for grinding.
formal.zh: 杏仁去壳后，果仁被收集到碗里，准备研磨。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Nistgħu nibdew bit-tħin tal-lewż? Pawlu: L-ewwel hemm bżonn it-tfesdiq; għad irridu nneħħu l-qoxra iebsa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can we start grinding the almonds? Pawlu: They need shelling first; we still have to remove the hard shells.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我们可以开始磨杏仁了吗？Pawlu：得先去壳；硬壳还没剥掉呢。

messages.speaker: Maja (烹饪学员)
messages.zh: 我们可以开始磨杏仁了吗？
messages.en: Can we start grinding the almonds?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (烹饪老师)
messages.mt_spoken: L-ewwel hemm bżonn it-tfesdiq; għad irridu nneħħu l-qoxra iebsa.
messages.mt_standard: L-ewwel hemm bżonn it-tfesdiq; għad irridu nneħħu l-qoxra iebsa.
messages.zh: 得先去壳；硬壳还没剥掉呢。
messages.en: They need shelling first; we still have to remove the hard shells.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 tfesdiq 做两张义项卡：一张画毯子包住婴儿，另一张画剥开杏仁壳或豌豆荚，分别记牢。

gloss_zh: 被低声说出；被悄声传达

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be said or communicated in a whisper.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以耳语或很轻的声音被说出、被传达。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħad jew jitwassal b'leħen baxx ħafna, kważi bla ħoss.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被低声说出；被用耳语传达。

formal.mt: L-isem tal-mistieden tfesfes f'widnejn l-organizzatur qabel bdiet iċ-ċerimonja.
formal.en: The guest's name was whispered in the organizer's ear before the ceremony began.
formal.zh: 仪式开始前，有人在组织者耳边低声说出了来宾的名字。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'tfesfes waqt il-laqgħa? Pawlu: Tfesfes biss li l-laqgħa se tispiċċa kmieni.
colloquial.en: Maja: What was whispered during the meeting? Pawlu: Only that the meeting would finish early.
colloquial.zh: Maja：开会时有人悄声说了什么？Pawlu：只是说会议会提前结束。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 开会时有人悄声说了什么？
messages.en: What was whispered during the meeting?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfesfes biss li l-laqgħa se tispiċċa kmieni.
messages.mt_standard: Tfesfes biss li l-laqgħa se tispiċċa kmieni.
messages.zh: 只是说会议会提前结束。
messages.en: Only that the meeting would finish early.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tfesfes 想成一句话贴着耳朵被轻轻说出，记住重点是“话被低声传达”的被动意义。

gloss_zh: 低语；窃窃私语；闲言碎语

teaching_sense.en_definition: Speaking very quietly, or quiet talk about other people's affairs.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 很轻声地说话；也可指私下议论别人的闲话。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Taħdit b'leħen baxx ħafna, jew taħdit fil-moħbi dwar ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 低声说话；窃窃私语
闲话；私下议论他人的闲言碎语
一句低语；一阵轻声细语

formal.mt: Waqt l-eżami, it-tfesfis bejn l-istudenti mhuwiex permess.
formal.en: During the examination, whispering between students is not allowed.
formal.zh: 考试期间，不允许学生之间窃窃私语。

colloquial.en: Maja: What's that whispering in the corridor? Rita: They're speaking quietly so they don't wake the baby.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：走廊里怎么有人窃窃私语？丽塔：他们在轻声说话，免得吵醒宝宝。
