messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed jitkellmu bil-mod biex ma jqajmux lit-tarbija.
messages.mt_standard: Qed jitkellmu bil-mod biex ma jqajmux lit-tarbija.
messages.zh: 他们在轻声说话，免得吵醒宝宝。
messages.en: They're speaking quietly so they don't wake the baby.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把词中反复出现的 fs 想成两阵轻轻的耳语；再用语境区分普通低语和议论他人的闲话。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be wrapped snugly in a cloth or blanket, especially as a baby.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被布或毯子贴身包裹，尤指婴儿被包在襁褓里。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġi mgeżwer sew f'ċarruta jew kutra, speċjalment meta jkun tarbija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被用布或毯子包裹在襁褓里

formal.mt: Wara l-ħasil, it-tifel tfessaq f'kutra nadifa.
formal.en: After being washed, the baby boy was swaddled in a clean blanket.
formal.zh: 洗澡后，男婴被包在一条干净的毯子里。

colloquial.mt: Rita: It-tifel tfessaq diġà? Mark: Iva, issa qiegħed jorqod f'ħoġor ommu.
colloquial.en: Rita: Has the baby boy been swaddled already? Mark: Yes, he's sleeping in his mother's lap now.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：宝宝已经包好襁褓了吗？马克：是的，现在正睡在妈妈怀里。

messages.speaker: Rita (家人)
messages.zh: 宝宝已经包好襁褓了吗？
messages.en: Has the baby boy been swaddled already?

messages.speaker: Mark (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, issa qiegħed jorqod f'ħoġor ommu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, issa qiegħed jorqod f'ħoġor ommu.
messages.zh: 是的，现在正睡在妈妈怀里。
messages.en: Yes, he's sleeping in his mother's lap now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 tfessaq 就想象宝宝被毯子包住的画面，重点记住主语是接受包裹的宝宝。

gloss_zh: 被包裹在襁褓中的状态或过程

teaching_sense.en_definition: The state or process of being wrapped snugly in a cloth or blanket as a baby.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 婴儿被布或毯子贴身包裹的状态或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-istat jew il-proċess li fih tarbija tkun imgeżwra sew f'ċarruta jew kutra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被包在襁褓里的状态
被包上襁褓这一过程

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi r-reazzjoni tat-tarbija waqt it-tfessiq.
formal.en: The report describes the baby's reaction while being swaddled.
formal.zh: 报告描述了婴儿在被包上襁褓时的反应。

colloquial.mt: Maja: It-tarbija bkiet waqt it-tfessiq? Rita: Le, baqgħet kalma l-ħin kollu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did the baby cry while being swaddled? Rita: No, she stayed calm the whole time.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：宝宝被包上襁褓时哭了吗？丽塔：没有，她一直很安静。

messages.speaker: Maja (家人)
messages.zh: 宝宝被包上襁褓时哭了吗？
messages.en: Did the baby cry while being swaddled?

messages.speaker: Rita (母亲)
messages.zh: 没有，她一直很安静。
messages.en: No, she stayed calm the whole time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tfessiq 配上“襁褓中的宝宝”这张名词卡片，记的是被包裹的状态或过程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become twisted or wound together with something else, or around it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与别的东西交缠在一起，或缠绕在某物周围。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitgħawweġ u jitħabbel ma' xi ħaġa oħra jew madwarha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被缠绕；与其他东西交缠在一起

collocations.zh: 与另一根线交缠在一起

formal.mt: Matul ix-xogħol, il-ħajt l-aħmar tfettel mal-ħajt l-abjad.
formal.en: During the work, the red thread became entwined with the white thread.
formal.zh: 作业过程中，红线与白线缠在了一起。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex il-ħajt ma jiċċaqlaqx? Rita: Tfettel mal-ħajt l-ieħor; irridu nħolluh bil-mod.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why won't the thread move? Rita: It got entwined with the other thread; we need to untangle it gently.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这根线怎么拉不动？丽塔：它和另一根线缠在一起了；我们得慢慢解开。

messages.speaker: Maja (手工课学员)
messages.zh: 这根线怎么拉不动？
messages.en: Why won't the thread move?

messages.speaker: Rita (手工课教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfettel mal-ħajt l-ieħor; irridu nħolluh bil-mod.
messages.mt_standard: Tfettel mal-ħajt l-ieħor; irridu nħolluh bil-mod.
messages.zh: 它和另一根线缠在一起了；我们得慢慢解开。
messages.en: It got entwined with the other thread; we need to untangle it gently.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tfettel 中并排的两个 t 想成两根交缠的线，用线团画面记住“缠绕在一起”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be cut into slices, or to be dipped into a liquid.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被切成片；也可指食物被浸入液体中。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinqata' fi flieli, jew jitgħaddas f'likwidu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被切成片
被浸入液体中，如饼干被浸入茶里

formal.mt: Il-ħobż tfettet fi flieli rqaq qabel ma tqiegħed fuq il-mejda.
formal.en: The bread was cut into thin slices before being placed on the table.
formal.zh: 面包被切成薄片后摆上了餐桌。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Dan il-gallettin tfettet fit-te? Rita: Iva, għalhekk issa artab.
colloquial.en: Mark: Was this biscuit dunked in tea? Rita: Yes, that's why it's soft now.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这块饼干在茶里浸过吗？丽塔：是的，所以现在软了。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 这块饼干在茶里浸过吗？
messages.en: Was this biscuit dunked in tea?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 是的，所以现在软了。
messages.en: Yes, that's why it's soft now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 tfettet 画两格记忆图：第一格面包被切片，第二格饼干浸茶；靠搭配判断具体词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Insistence on every detail being perfect, or the habit of finding faults.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 坚持每个细节都必须完美的做派，或不断挑找缺点的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Insistenza li kull dettall ikun perfett, jew drawwa li wieħed isib id-difetti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 凡事力求完美的态度或做派
挑毛病；找缺点

collocations.zh: 过分追求完美或过度挑剔

formal.mt: It-tfettiq fuq kull dettall dewwem it-tlestija tar-rapport.
formal.en: Finding fault with every detail delayed the completion of the report.
formal.zh: 对每个细节都挑毛病，拖延了报告的完成。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għadek qed tibdel il-kulur tat-titlu? Maja: Iva, imma dan it-tfettiq kollu qed jeħodli wisq ħin.
colloquial.en: Mark: Are you still changing the title colour? Maja: Yes, but all this perfectionism is taking up too much of my time.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你还在改标题的颜色吗？玛雅：是啊，不过这样追求完美实在太费时间了。

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.zh: 你还在改标题的颜色吗？
messages.en: Are you still changing the title colour?

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma dan it-tfettiq kollu qed jeħodli wisq ħin.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma dan it-tfettiq kollu qed jeħodli wisq ħin.
messages.zh: 是啊，不过这样追求完美实在太费时间了。
messages.en: Yes, but all this perfectionism is taking up too much of my time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象有人拿着放大镜反复检查每个细节：对自己是求完美，对别人可能就是挑毛病。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action or process of cutting something into slices.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某物切成片的动作或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni jew il-proċess ta' qtugħ ta' xi ħaġa fi flieli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 切片；把东西切成片的动作或过程

formal.mt: It-tfettit tal-ħaxix fi flieli tal-istess ħxuna jgħin biex jissajjar b'mod indaqs.
formal.en: Slicing vegetables into slices of equal thickness helps them cook evenly.
formal.zh: 把蔬菜切成厚度一致的片，有助于使其受热均匀。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Tista' tieħu ħsieb it-tfettit tal-ħobż? Mark: Iva, trid il-flieli rqaq jew ħoxnin?
colloquial.en: Rita: Can you take care of slicing the bread? Mark: Yes, would you like thin or thick slices?
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：你能负责把面包切片吗？马克：可以，你想要薄片还是厚片？

messages.speaker: Rita (家人)
messages.zh: 你能负责把面包切片吗？
messages.en: Can you take care of slicing the bread?

messages.speaker: Mark (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, trid il-flieli rqaq jew ħoxnin?
messages.mt_standard: Iva, trid il-flieli rqaq jew ħoxnin?
messages.zh: 可以，你想要薄片还是厚片？
messages.en: Yes, would you like thin or thick slices?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tfettit 配上“一整条面包变成一排薄片”的连续画面，记住它是切片这个动作的名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An increase in the size, volume, or extent of something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某物在大小、体积或范围上的增大。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Żieda fid-daqs, fil-volum jew fil-firxa ta' xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 扩张；膨胀；大小、体积或范围的增大

formal.mt: L-esperiment juri t-tfettiħ tal-metall meta t-temperatura togħla.
formal.en: The experiment demonstrates the expansion of metal as the temperature rises.
formal.zh: 这个实验展示了金属随温度升高而发生的膨胀。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex il-virga saret itwal meta saħħanniha? Rita: Minħabba t-tfettiħ tal-metall bis-sħana.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did the rod get longer when we heated it? Rita: Because of the metal's expansion with heat.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：为什么我们加热后，这根金属棒变长了？丽塔：因为金属受热膨胀了。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex il-virga saret itwal meta saħħanniha?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex il-virga saret itwal meta saħħanniha?
messages.zh: 为什么我们加热后，这根金属棒变长了？
messages.en: Why did the rod get longer when we heated it?

messages.speaker: Rita (教师)
messages.zh: 因为金属受热膨胀了。
messages.en: Because of the metal's expansion with heat.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tfettiħ 写在向外展开的箭头中间，联想物体体积或范围变大，记住“扩张、膨胀”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become breezy or to receive fresh air through ventilation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指某处开始有微风流动，或因空气流通而得到通风。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jibda jgħaddi r-riħ minn post, jew post jieħu arja friska permezz tal-ventilazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 开始有微风；变得有风吹拂。
得到通风；有新鲜空气流通。

collocations.en: The place became breezy as the wind blew.
collocations.zh: 风吹起来，这个地方有了微风。

collocations.mt: Il-kuritur tfewweġ wara li nfetħu t-twieqi.
collocations.en: The corridor was ventilated after the windows were opened.
collocations.zh: 窗户打开后，走廊得到了通风。

formal.mt: Wara li nfetħu t-twieqi fuq iż-żewġ naħat, is-salott tfewweġ u l-arja bdiet tiċċirkola.
formal.en: After the windows on both sides were opened, the sitting room was ventilated and the air began to circulate.
formal.zh: 两侧的窗户打开后，客厅得到了通风，空气开始流通。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Is-salott tfewweġ issa? Pawlu: Iva, minn meta ftaħna t-tieqa qed tidħol arja friska.
colloquial.en: Marija: Has the sitting room had some ventilation now? Pawlu: Yes, fresh air has been coming in since we opened the window.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：客厅现在通风了吗？保罗：通风了，我们打开窗户后，新鲜空气就一直在进来。

messages.speaker: Marija (室友)
messages.zh: 客厅现在通风了吗？
messages.en: Has the sitting room had some ventilation now?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, minn meta ftaħna t-tieqa qed tidħol arja friska.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, minn meta ftaħna t-tieqa qed tidħol arja friska.
messages.zh: 通风了，我们打开窗户后，新鲜空气就一直在进来。
messages.en: Yes, fresh air has been coming in since we opened the window.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象打开窗户后窗帘轻轻摆动，用这个画面把 tfewweġ 的“起微风”和“得到通风”两个动词义一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of releasing gas from the stomach through the mouth; belching.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 胃中的气体经口排出的行为，即嗳气，也常俗称打嗝。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħruġ ta' gass mill-istonku minn ġol-ħalq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 嗳气；胃内气体经口排出，俗称打嗝。

formal.mt: Fid-djalogu miktub, it-tfewwiq qawwi ta' wieħed mill-mistednin interrompa l-konversazzjoni waqt l-ikla.
formal.en: In the written dialogue, one guest's loud burping interrupted the conversation during the meal.
formal.zh: 在这段书面对话中，一位客人大声打嗝，打断了用餐时的交谈。

colloquial.mt: Pawlu: Skużani għat-tfewwiq; għadni kemm xrobt xarba bil-gass. Marija: Ma jimpurtax, kompli għidli dwar il-vjaġġ.
colloquial.en: Pawlu: Sorry about the burping; I've just had a fizzy drink. Marija: No problem, carry on telling me about the trip.
colloquial.zh: 保罗：不好意思打嗝了，我刚喝了汽水。玛丽亚：没关系，继续跟我说说旅行的事吧。

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Skużani għat-tfewwiq; għadni kemm xrobt xarba bil-gass.
messages.mt_standard: Skużani għat-tfewwiq; għadni kemm xrobt xarba bil-gass.
messages.zh: 不好意思打嗝了，我刚喝了汽水。
messages.en: Sorry about the burping; I've just had a fizzy drink.

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma jimpurtax, kompli għidli dwar il-vjaġġ.
messages.mt_standard: Ma jimpurtax, kompli għidli dwar il-vjaġġ.
messages.zh: 没关系，继续跟我说说旅行的事吧。
messages.en: No problem, carry on telling me about the trip.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tfewwiq 和喝完汽水后从嘴里排出气体的画面联系起来，记作“嗳气”，区别于连续抽动的呃逆。

gloss_zh: 微风习习；空气流通、通风舒畅的状态

teaching_sense.en_definition: The quality of having a light breeze or a pleasant flow of fresh air.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指微风流动的状态，或某处空气流通、通风舒畅的特性。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-preżenza ta' żiffa ħafifa jew il-kwalità ta' post fejn tgħaddi arja friska.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有微风吹拂的状态；微风习习。
空气流通、通风舒畅的特性。

collocations.zh: 阳台上微风习习的状态

formal.mt: Il-viżitaturi faħħru t-tfewwiġ tal-kamra, fejn it-twieqi miftuħa kienu jħallu l-arja tgħaddi liberament.
formal.en: The visitors praised the airiness of the room, where the open windows allowed air to flow freely.
formal.zh: 访客们称赞房间通风舒畅，敞开的窗户让空气自由流通。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Jogħġobni t-tfewwiġ ta' din il-gallarija. Mark: Lili wkoll; ejja noqogħdu hawn u nieħdu kafè.
colloquial.en: Lara: I like how breezy this balcony is. Mark: So do I; let's sit here and have a coffee.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我喜欢这个阳台微风习习的感觉。马克：我也是，我们坐在这里喝杯咖啡吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我喜欢这个阳台微风习习的感觉。
messages.en: I like how breezy this balcony is.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Lili wkoll; ejja noqogħdu hawn u nieħdu kafè.
messages.mt_standard: Lili wkoll; ejja noqogħdu hawn u nieħdu kafè.
messages.zh: 我也是，我们坐在这里喝杯咖啡吧。
messages.en: So do I; let's sit here and have a coffee.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tfewwiġ 配上一张阳台吹着轻风的照片，记住它是给“微风感、通风感”这种状态起名字的名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of giving something or a place a pleasant fragrance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向物品或空间添加香气，使其散发宜人气味的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għoti ta' riħa pjaċevoli lil xi ħaġa jew lil post.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 添加香气；为物品或空间加香。

formal.mt: Fil-workshop, il-parteċipanti tgħallmu dwar it-tfewwiħ tas-sapun billi żiedu ftit żejt imfewwaħ mat-taħlita.
formal.en: In the workshop, participants learned about adding fragrance to soap by mixing a little scented oil into the mixture.
formal.zh: 在工作坊中，参与者通过向混合物加入少量香油，学习如何给肥皂加香。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'se nużaw għat-tfewwiħ tal-kamra? David: Għandna dan l-isprej; ejja nużaw ftit minnu.
colloquial.en: Nina: What shall we use to add fragrance to the room? David: We have this spray; let's use a little of it.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我们用什么给房间添香？戴维：我们有这瓶喷雾，用一点吧。

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.zh: 我们用什么给房间添香？
messages.en: What shall we use to add fragrance to the room?

messages.speaker: David (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandna dan l-isprej; ejja nużaw ftit minnu.
messages.mt_standard: Għandna dan l-isprej; ejja nużaw ftit minnu.
messages.zh: 我们有这瓶喷雾，用一点吧。
messages.en: We have this spray; let's use a little of it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象往无香肥皂里滴入香油，把 tfewwiħ 记为“添加香气的过程”，重点记住动作过程而不是香味本身。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A state of panic or difficulty keeping one's attention focused.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 惊慌失措的状态，或心思散乱、难以集中注意力的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Stat ta' paniku jew ta' nuqqas ta' konċentrazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 惊慌；慌乱失措。
注意力不集中；心思散乱。

formal.mt: It-tfewwiġ tal-kamra ma kienx is-suġġett tal-laqgħa; iżda t-tfexfix tal-parteċipanti wassal biex diversi punti fuq l-aġenda ma ġewx diskussi sew.
formal.en: The airiness of the room was not the subject of the meeting; however, the participants' lack of focus meant that several agenda items were not properly discussed.
formal.zh: 房间是否通风舒畅并非会议主题；然而，参与者注意力不集中，导致议程上的几个事项未得到充分讨论。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan it-tfexfix qabel l-eżami qed ifixkilni. Mark: Ejja nikkonċentraw fuq mistoqsija waħda kull darba.
colloquial.en: Lara: This panic before the exam is getting in my way. Mark: Let's focus on one question at a time.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：考试前这么慌乱，弄得我学不进去。马克：我们一次集中看一道题吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan it-tfexfix qabel l-eżami qed ifixkilni.
messages.mt_standard: Dan it-tfexfix qabel l-eżami qed ifixkilni.
messages.zh: 考试前这么慌乱，弄得我学不进去。
messages.en: This panic before the exam is getting in my way.

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja nikkonċentraw fuq mistoqsija waħda kull darba.

gloss_zh: Urospermum picroides（植物名，英文称 prickly goldenfleece）

gloss_zh: 分离；使自己与他人分开；被隔开

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become separated from others, including by keeping oneself apart, or to be kept apart.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与他人分离，也可指主动使自己与他人保持分开，或被隔开。

sense_translations.zh_definition: 分离；也可用于反身意义，指使自己与他人分开或保持距离。
被隔开；被保持在彼此分离的状态。

formal.zh: 旅途中，一名参与者与队伍分开，较晚才到达集合地点。

formal.en: The article distinguishes between the affection children need and excessive pampering.
formal.zh: 这篇文章区分了孩子需要的关爱与过分的宠爱。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Se terġa' tixtrilu ġugarell għax beda jibki? Pawlu: Le, dak ikun tfissid żejjed. Se nkellmu bil-kalma.
colloquial.en: Marija: Are you going to buy him another toy because he started crying? Pawlu: No, that would be excessive pampering. I'll talk to him calmly.
colloquial.zh: Marija：他一哭，你就又要给他买玩具吗？Pawlu：不会，那样就太宠他了。我会平静地跟他谈谈。

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Se terġa' tixtrilu ġugarell għax beda jibki?
messages.mt_standard: Se terġa' tixtrilu ġugarell għax beda jibki?
messages.zh: 他一哭，你就又要给他买玩具吗？
messages.en: Are you going to buy him another toy because he started crying?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, dak ikun tfissid żejjed. Se nkellmu bil-kalma.
messages.mt_standard: Le, dak ikun tfissid żejjed. Se nkellmu bil-kalma.
messages.zh: 不会，那样就太宠他了。我会平静地跟他谈谈。
messages.en: No, that would be excessive pampering. I'll talk to him calmly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象孩子一哭就得到新玩具，把 tfissid 与“爱抚纵容过了头”一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or process of explaining something so that its meaning becomes clear.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过解释或说明，使某件事的意思变得清楚的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għoti ta' spjegazzjoni biex it-tifsira ta' xi ħaġa ssir ċara.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被解释；得到说明。

formal.mt: It-tfissir tal-kunċetti ewlenin jgħin lill-istudenti jifhmu t-test.
formal.en: Explaining the key concepts helps students understand the text.
formal.zh: 对主要概念进行解释，有助于学生理解课文。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif sejjer bit-tfissir tal-kliem fil-klassi? David: Aħjar issa. Nuża stampa u eżempju għal kull kelma.
colloquial.en: Lara: How is explaining the words in class going? David: Better now. I use a picture and an example for each word.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你在课堂上讲解词语，进行得怎么样？David：现在好多了。每个词我都配一张图片和一个例子。

messages.speaker: Lara (教师同事)
messages.zh: 你在课堂上讲解词语，进行得怎么样？
messages.en: How is explaining the words in class going?

messages.speaker: David (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Aħjar issa. Nuża stampa u eżempju għal kull kelma.
messages.mt_standard: Aħjar issa. Nuża stampa u eżempju għal kull kelma.
messages.zh: 现在好多了。每个词我都配一张图片和一个例子。
messages.en: Better now. I use a picture and an example for each word.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tfissir 配上老师逐步讲解词语的画面，重点记住“解释说明的过程”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An explanation that makes the meaning of something clear.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某件事或某个表达的意思变得清楚的一项解释。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Spjegazzjoni li tagħmel it-tifsira ta' xi ħaġa ċara.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一个解释；一项说明。

formal.mt: Il-gwida tagħti tfissira ċara ta' kull simbolu użat fil-mappa.
formal.en: The guide gives a clear explanation of each symbol used on the map.
formal.zh: 这份指南对地图上使用的每个符号都作了清楚的解释。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Tista' tagħtini tfissira ta' din il-frażi? Mark: Iva. Hawnhekk tfisser li għandna nistennew ftit.
colloquial.en: Nina: Can you give me an explanation of this phrase? Mark: Yes. Here it means that we should wait a little.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你能给我解释一下这个短语吗？Mark：可以。在这里，它的意思是我们应该等一会儿。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' tagħtini tfissira ta' din il-frażi?
messages.mt_standard: Tista' tagħtini tfissira ta' din il-frażi?
messages.zh: 你能给我解释一下这个短语吗？
messages.en: Can you give me an explanation of this phrase?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva. Hawnhekk tfisser li għandna nistennew ftit.
messages.mt_standard: Iva. Hawnhekk tfisser li għandna nistennew ftit.
messages.zh: 可以。在这里，它的意思是我们应该等一会儿。
messages.en: Yes. Here it means that we should wait a little.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象在难懂的短语旁贴上一张解释便签，把这一项具体说明记作 tfissira。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be sought or researched through an effort to locate something or learn about it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 成为寻找或研究的对象，以便被找到或得到了解。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikun l-oġġett ta' tfittxija jew studju sabiex jinstab jew ikun magħruf aħjar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被寻找；成为搜寻的对象。
被研究；受到调查研究。

collocations.en: to be searched for in the archives

formal.mt: L-oriġini tal-isem għandha titfittex fid-dokumenti storiċi.
formal.en: The origin of the name should be researched in historical documents.
formal.zh: 这个名称的起源应通过历史文献来考察。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn tista' titfittex din l-informazzjoni? Ġanni: Fil-katalgu tal-librerija. Nistgħu niċċekkjawh flimkien.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where can this information be searched for? Ġanni: In the library catalogue. We can check it together.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这些信息可以在哪里查找？Ġanni：在图书馆目录里。我们可以一起查。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 这些信息可以在哪里查找？
messages.en: Where can this information be searched for?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (图书管理员)
messages.zh: 在图书馆目录里。我们可以一起查。
messages.en: In the library catalogue. We can check it together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把待查的信息画在放大镜下面，记住这里强调它“被寻找、被研究”的角色。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of looking for something or examining a subject to obtain information.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为找到某物或获取信息而进行的搜寻、研究或调查活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-attività li biha wieħed ifittex xi ħaġa jew jistudja suġġett biex jikseb tagħrif.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 搜寻；查找。
研究；资料探究。
调查；查究。

formal.mt: It-tfittix fl-arkivji pprovda informazzjoni ġdida dwar l-istorja tar-raħal.
formal.en: Research in the archives provided new information about the village's history.
formal.zh: 档案研究提供了有关这个村庄历史的新信息。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Kif sejjer it-tfittix dwar il-familja tiegħek? Toni: Sibt żewġ ritratti qodma, imma għadni ma nafx min hemm fihom.
colloquial.en: Elena: How is the research into your family going? Toni: I found two old photographs, but I still don't know who is in them.
colloquial.zh: Elena：你对自己家族的调查进行得怎么样？Toni：我找到了两张老照片，不过还不知道照片里的人是谁。

messages.speaker: Elena (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif sejjer it-tfittix dwar il-familja tiegħek?
messages.mt_standard: Kif sejjer it-tfittix dwar il-familja tiegħek?
messages.zh: 你对自己家族的调查进行得怎么样？
messages.en: How is the research into your family going?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Sibt żewġ ritratti qodma, imma għadni ma nafx min hemm fihom.
messages.mt_standard: Sibt żewġ ritratti qodma, imma għadni ma nafx min hemm fihom.
messages.zh: 我找到了两张老照片，不过还不知道照片里的人是谁。
messages.en: I found two old photographs, but I still don't know who is in them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象翻档案、找照片、核对人物的整套活动，用 tfittix 串起“搜寻、研究、调查”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To stumble physically or become confused while trying to understand or do something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体被绊而踉跄，或在理解、处理事情时变得困惑。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitlef il-bilanċ minħabba xi ħaġa f'saqajh, jew jitħawwad waqt li jipprova jifhem jew jagħmel xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 绊了一下；踉跄。
变得困惑；弄糊涂。

collocations.en: became confused while doing the calculations

formal.mt: L-istudent tfixkel meta pprova jsegwi żewġ settijiet differenti ta' struzzjonijiet.
formal.en: The student became confused when he tried to follow two different sets of instructions.
formal.zh: 这名学生试图按照两套不同的指示操作时，弄糊涂了。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għaliex waqaf Mark ħdejn il-bieb? Luqa: Tfixkel fit-tapit, imma ma waqax. Issa jinsab tajjeb.
colloquial.en: Rita: Why did Mark stop by the door? Luqa: He stumbled on the carpet, but he didn't fall. He's fine now.
colloquial.zh: Rita：Mark 为什么在门边停下来了？Luqa：他被地毯绊了一下，不过没摔倒。现在没事了。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: Mark 为什么在门边停下来了？
messages.en: Why did Mark stop by the door?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfixkel fit-tapit, imma ma waqax. Issa jinsab tajjeb.
messages.mt_standard: Tfixkel fit-tapit, imma ma waqax. Issa jinsab tajjeb.
messages.zh: 他被地毯绊了一下，不过没摔倒。现在没事了。
messages.en: He stumbled on the carpet, but he didn't fall. He's fine now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“脚步绊住、思路卡住”这两个画面记 tfixkel，分别对应身体踉跄和心里困惑。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A snag, obstruction, or hardship that makes an action or progress difficult.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使行动或进展变得困难的障碍、阻碍或困境。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ostaklu jew diffikultà li tagħmel azzjoni jew progress aktar diffiċli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 妨碍进展的麻烦；意外障碍。
阻碍；障碍。
困难；艰苦处境。

formal.mt: Ix-xogħlijiet fit-triq jistgħu joħolqu tfixkil fit-traffiku matul il-ġimgħa.
formal.en: The roadworks may cause traffic disruption during the week.
formal.zh: 道路施工可能在本周造成交通阻碍。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Kollox lest għall-vjaġġ? Simon: Kważi. Hemm tfixkil żgħir bil-biljetti, imma qed insolvu l-problema.
colloquial.en: Marta: Is everything ready for the trip? Simon: Almost. There's a small snag with the tickets, but we're sorting out the problem.
colloquial.zh: Marta：旅行的事情都准备好了吗？Simon：差不多了。票出了点小问题，不过我们正在处理。

messages.speaker: Marta (旅伴)
messages.zh: 旅行的事情都准备好了吗？
messages.en: Is everything ready for the trip?

messages.speaker: Simon (旅伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Kważi. Hemm tfixkil żgħir bil-biljetti, imma qed insolvu l-problema.
messages.mt_standard: Kważi. Hemm tfixkil żgħir bil-biljetti, imma qed insolvu l-problema.
messages.zh: 差不多了。票出了点小问题，不过我们正在处理。
messages.en: Almost. There's a small snag with the tickets, but we're sorting out the problem.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象前进路上出现一块绊脚石，把 tfixkil 记成阻碍进展的麻烦、障碍或困难。

gloss_zh: 举止粗鲁；哀叹；挑剔难满足

teaching_sense.en_definition: To behave boorishly, lament, or show that one is difficult to please.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表现得粗鲁无礼，发出哀叹，或显得挑剔而难以满足。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġib ruħu bla manjieri, jilmenta b'niket, jew juri li diffiċli jogħġbu xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 举止粗鲁；表现得无礼。
哀叹；悲叹。
挑剔；难以取悦或满足。

collocations.en: was hard to please about the food

formal.mt: Matul il-laqgħa, wieħed mill-parteċipanti tfonqol mal-mistednin u rrifjuta li jismagħhom.
formal.en: During the meeting, one of the participants behaved boorishly towards the guests and refused to listen to them.
formal.zh: 会议期间，一名与会者对客人举止粗鲁，并拒绝听取他们的意见。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Mark għoġbu l-ikel? Ben: Le, reġa' tfonqol dwar l-ikel. La għoġbitu s-soppa u lanqas il-ħobż.
colloquial.en: Anna: Did Mark like the food? Ben: No, he was hard to please about the food again. He liked neither the soup nor the bread.
colloquial.zh: Anna：Mark 喜欢这些食物吗？Ben：不喜欢，他又对食物挑三拣四了。汤和面包他都不喜欢。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: Mark 喜欢这些食物吗？
messages.en: Did Mark like the food?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, reġa' tfonqol dwar l-ikel. La għoġbitu s-soppa u lanqas il-ħobż.
messages.mt_standard: Le, reġa' tfonqol dwar l-ikel. La għoġbitu s-soppa u lanqas il-ħobż.
messages.zh: 不喜欢，他又对食物挑三拣四了。汤和面包他都不喜欢。
messages.en: No, he was hard to please about the food again. He liked neither the soup nor the bread.

cognitive_memory_aid: 为 tfonqol 画三张情景卡：待客粗鲁、低头哀叹、吃饭挑剔；按语境分别回忆三个义项。

gloss_zh: 受骗；遭到毁坏，陷入困境

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be cheated, or to end up ruined or seriously damaged.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受到欺骗，或遭到严重破坏而落入很糟的境地。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jisfa mqarraq, jew jispiċċa mħarbat jew f'qagħda ħażina ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 受骗；因他人的欺诈而吃亏。
被毁掉；遭到严重破坏或陷入困境。

formal.mt: Il-klijent tfotta fil-ftehim meta ħallas għal prodott li qatt ma wasal.
formal.en: The customer was cheated in the deal when he paid for a product that never arrived.
formal.zh: 顾客付款购买的商品始终没有送达，他在这笔交易中受骗了。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Mark hu daqshekk irrabjat? Lara: Tfotta fil-ftehim; ħallas u ma rċieva xejn.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is Mark so angry? Lara: He was cheated in the deal; he paid and received nothing.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Mark 为什么这么生气？Lara：他在交易中受骗了，付了钱却什么也没收到。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: Mark 为什么这么生气？
messages.en: Why is Mark so angry?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfotta fil-ftehim; ħallas u ma rċieva xejn.
messages.mt_standard: Tfotta fil-ftehim; ħallas u ma rċieva xejn.
messages.zh: 他在交易中受骗了，付了钱却什么也没收到。
messages.en: He was cheated in the deal; he paid and received nothing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把两个画面连起来记：交易中付钱却空手，是“受骗”；安排好的计划彻底泡汤，是“被毁”。共同点都是主体遭遇坏结果。

gloss_zh: 幼稚的；具有儿童特点的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Childish or immature, or characteristic of children.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容言行幼稚、不够成熟，也可表示具有儿童常见的特点。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li juri nuqqas ta' maturità, jew li jkun tipiku tat-tfal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 幼稚的；言行欠成熟的，通常带批评意味。
具有儿童典型特点的；像孩子一般的。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-atteġġjament tiegħu waqt il-laqgħa bħala tfuli.
formal.en: The report describes his attitude during the meeting as childish.
formal.zh: 报告将他在会议上的态度描述为幼稚。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Rajt lil Pawlu meta fetaħ ir-rigal? Maja: Iva, kellu entużjażmu tfuli u tbissima kbira!
colloquial.en: Lara: Did you see Pawlu when he opened the present? Maja: Yes, he had childlike enthusiasm and a huge smile!
colloquial.zh: Lara：你看到 Pawlu 拆礼物时的样子了吗？Maja：看到了，他像孩子一样兴奋，笑得特别开心！

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajt lil Pawlu meta fetaħ ir-rigal?
messages.mt_standard: Rajt lil Pawlu meta fetaħ ir-rigal?
messages.zh: 你看到 Pawlu 拆礼物时的样子了吗？
messages.en: Did you see Pawlu when he opened the present?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kellu entużjażmu tfuli u tbissima kbira!
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kellu entużjażmu tfuli u tbissima kbira!
messages.zh: 看到了，他像孩子一样兴奋，笑得特别开心！
messages.en: Yes, he had childlike enthusiasm and a huge smile!

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“像孩子”串起两义：放在态度上可能批评幼稚，放在热情上则可描写童真；判断褒贬要看它修饰什么。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be thrown or sent through the air by someone's action.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被人投掷或扔出，描述物体受到投掷的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġi mitfugħ minn xi ħadd minn post għal ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被投掷；被扔出。

formal.mt: Il-ballun tgara minn naħa għall-oħra tal-bitħa waqt il-logħba.
formal.en: The ball was thrown from one side of the yard to the other during the game.
formal.zh: 比赛中，球从院子的一侧被扔到了另一侧。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Fejn mar il-ballun? Lara: Tgara wara l-ħajt; ejja nfittxuh.
colloquial.en: Mark: Where did the ball go? Lara: It was thrown behind the wall; let's look for it.
colloquial.zh: Mark：球到哪里去了？Lara：被扔到墙后面了，我们去找找吧。

messages.speaker: Mark (玩伴)
messages.zh: 球到哪里去了？
messages.en: Where did the ball go?

messages.speaker: Lara (玩伴)
messages.zh: 被扔到墙后面了，我们去找找吧。
messages.en: It was thrown behind the wall; let's look for it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把镜头对准飞出去的球，心里说“球被扔出去了”；记住这里关注的是承受投掷的物体。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Loud, deep bellowing or roaring, such as the sound made by a large animal.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 低沉而响亮的吼叫或咆哮，例如大型动物发出的声音。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħoss qawwi u fond ta' għajjat, bħal dak ta' barri jew iljun.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 低沉响亮的吼叫，尤指类似牛吼的声音。
咆哮；洪亮而强烈的吼声。

formal.mt: It-tgargir tal-barri nstema' minn tarf għall-ieħor tar-razzett.
formal.en: The bull's bellowing could be heard from one end of the farm to the other.
formal.zh: 公牛的吼叫声响彻了整个农场。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhu dak il-ħoss qawwi? Mark: Dak hu t-tgargir tal-barri fir-razzett ta' ħdejna.
colloquial.en: Maja: What's that loud noise? Mark: That's the bellowing of the bull on the farm next to us.
colloquial.zh: Maja：那是什么响声？Mark：那是旁边农场里公牛的吼叫声。

messages.speaker: Maja (访客)
messages.zh: 那是什么响声？
messages.en: What's that loud noise?

messages.speaker: Mark (农场主)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak hu t-tgargir tal-barri fir-razzett ta' ħdejna.
messages.mt_standard: Dak hu t-tgargir tal-barri fir-razzett ta' ħdejna.
messages.zh: 那是旁边农场里公牛的吼叫声。
messages.en: That's the bellowing of the bull on the farm next to us.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在脑中播放公牛低吼、狮子咆哮的声音，把它们归入“低沉响亮的吼声”这一名词概念；这是声音联想，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be enjoyed or experienced with pleasure by someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被人愉快地体验、享受或欣赏，主语通常是带来乐趣的事物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġi esperjenzat bi pjaċir minn xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被享受；被人愉快地体验或欣赏。

collocations.zh: 让所有人都享受到了乐趣

formal.mt: Il-kunċert tgawda minn udjenza ta' kull età.
formal.en: The concert was enjoyed by an audience of all ages.
formal.zh: 各个年龄层的观众都欣赏了这场音乐会，并从中获得乐趣。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif kien il-kunċert? Mark: Kien sabiħ u tgawda minn kulħadd!
colloquial.en: Lara: How was the concert? Mark: It was lovely, and everyone enjoyed it!
colloquial.zh: Lara：音乐会怎么样？Mark：很精彩，大家都听得很开心！

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 音乐会怎么样？
messages.en: How was the concert?

messages.speaker: Mark (观众)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien sabiħ u tgawda minn kulħadd!
messages.mt_standard: Kien sabiħ u tgawda minn kulħadd!
messages.zh: 很精彩，大家都听得很开心！
messages.en: It was lovely, and everyone enjoyed it!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象音乐会站在句子的主语位置：“这场音乐会被大家欣赏、享受了。”这样记住它描述的是事物被享受。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Enjoyment, pleasure, or joy felt when experiencing something welcome or satisfying.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 体验令人喜欢或满足的事物时产生的享受、愉悦或喜悦。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-pjaċir jew il-ferħ li wieħed iħoss meta jesperjenza xi ħaġa li togħġbu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 享受；从某种活动或体验中获得乐趣。
愉悦；令人感到舒服、满足的快乐感受。
喜悦；内心感到高兴和欢欣的情绪。

formal.mt: Il-ġnien joffri spazju għall-mistrieħ u għat-tgawdija tan-natura.
formal.en: The garden offers a space for rest and the enjoyment of nature.
formal.zh: 这座花园提供了休息和享受自然的空间。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għoġbitek il-mixja ħdejn il-baħar? Lara: Ħafna! Kienet siegħa ta' tgawdija u mistrieħ.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you enjoy the walk by the sea? Lara: Very much! It was an hour of enjoyment and rest.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你喜欢这次海边散步吗？Lara：非常喜欢！那是一个小时的享受和放松。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你喜欢这次海边散步吗？
messages.en: Did you enjoy the walk by the sea?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħafna! Kienet siegħa ta' tgawdija u mistrieħ.
messages.mt_standard: Ħafna! Kienet siegħa ta' tgawdija u mistrieħ.
messages.zh: 非常喜欢！那是一个小时的享受和放松。
messages.en: Very much! It was an hour of enjoyment and rest.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用海边散步的一刻记三个译法：过程很“享受”，感受很“愉悦”，内心有“喜悦”；三者都可用这个名词表达。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become sturdier or develop a more muscular body.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体变得更加结实强壮，或肌肉逐渐发达起来。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir aktar b'saħħtu jew jiżviluppa aktar muskoli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得结实、壮实或强健。
肌肉变得发达；身体变得更有肌肉。

collocations.zh: 通过训练变得更有肌肉

formal.mt: Matul is-sena, l-atleta tgeddel bit-taħriġ regolari.
formal.en: Over the year, the athlete became sturdier and more muscular through regular training.
formal.zh: 这一年里，这名运动员通过规律训练变得更加壮实，肌肉也更发达了。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Rajt lil Mark dan l-aħħar? Lara: Iva, tgeddel minn meta beda jitħarreġ regolarment.
colloquial.en: Maja: Have you seen Mark lately? Lara: Yes, he's become more muscular since he started training regularly.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你最近见过 Mark 吗？Lara：见过，他开始规律训练后，变得更有肌肉了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你最近见过 Mark 吗？
messages.en: Have you seen Mark lately?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, tgeddel minn meta beda jitħarreġ regolarment.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, tgeddel minn meta beda jitħarreġ regolarment.
messages.zh: 见过，他开始规律训练后，变得更有肌肉了。
messages.en: Yes, he's become more muscular since he started training regularly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象训练前后的两张照片：后来身体更结实，肌肉也更明显。用“变壮了”记住这个表示变化的动词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To show displeasure by becoming quiet, withdrawn, or unwilling to engage with others.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因不高兴而沉默、退缩或不愿理人，表现出闹别扭、生闷气的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Juri li hu mdejjaq jew irrabjat billi jibqa' sieket, jingħalaq fih innifsu jew ma jkunx irid jitkellem mal-oħrajn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 闹别扭；生闷气，以沉默或不理人的方式表示不满。

collocations.en: sulked because they did not take him along
collocations.zh: 因为别人没带他一起去而闹别扭

formal.mt: Wara li ma ntgħażilx għat-tim, it-tifel tgeddem u għal xi ħin ma ried jitkellem ma' ħadd.
formal.en: After he was not selected for the team, the boy sulked and did not want to speak to anyone for a while.
formal.zh: 那个男孩没被选入队伍后便生起闷气，一时间谁也不想理。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex tgeddem Pawlu? | Rita: Għax ma ħadniehx magħna. Se mmur nitkellem miegħu.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why did Pawlu sulk? | Rita: Because we didn't take him with us. I'll go and talk to him.
colloquial.zh: Marija：Pawlu怎么闹别扭了？ | Rita：因为我们没带他一起去。我去跟他聊聊。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: Pawlu怎么闹别扭了？
messages.en: Why did Pawlu sulk?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax ma ħadniehx magħna. Se mmur nitkellem miegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Għax ma ħadniehx magħna. Se mmur nitkellem miegħu.
messages.zh: 因为我们没带他一起去。我去跟他聊聊。
messages.en: Because we didn't take him with us. I'll go and talk to him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tgeddem 配上一个抱着双臂、扭头不理人的画面：心里不高兴，嘴上不说话，就是“生闷气”。

gloss_zh: 变结实；变得肌肉发达的过程

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of becoming sturdier or developing a more muscular body.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体逐渐变得结实，或肌肉逐渐发达的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih il-ġisem isir aktar b'saħħtu jew jiżviluppa aktar muskoli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得结实、强健的过程。
肌肉逐渐发达、身体变得健壮的过程。

collocations.en: the body becoming sturdier or more muscular
collocations.zh: 身体变结实或肌肉变发达的过程

collocations.en: gradual development of a sturdier or more muscular build

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi t-tgeddil tal-ġisem tal-atleta matul diversi xhur ta' taħriġ.
formal.en: The report describes the athlete's body becoming sturdier and more muscular over several months of training.
formal.zh: 报告描述了这名运动员经过数月训练，身体逐渐变得结实、肌肉更加发达的过程。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Qed tara xi bidla minn meta bdejt it-taħriġ? | Mark: Iva, qed ninnota tgeddil fil-ġisem, u l-ħwejjeġ qed jiġuni differenti.
colloquial.en: Lara: Have you seen any change since you started training? | Mark: Yes, I'm noticing my body getting more muscular, and my clothes fit differently.
colloquial.zh: Lara：开始训练以后，你发现有什么变化了吗？ | Mark：有啊，我发现身体更健壮了，衣服穿起来也不一样了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed tara xi bidla minn meta bdejt it-taħriġ?
messages.mt_standard: Qed tara xi bidla minn meta bdejt it-taħriġ?
messages.zh: 开始训练以后，你发现有什么变化了吗？
messages.en: Have you seen any change since you started training?

messages.speaker: Mark (健身学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qed ninnota tgeddil fil-ġisem, u l-ħwejjeġ qed jiġuni differenti.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qed ninnota tgeddil fil-ġisem, u l-ħwejjeġ qed jiġuni differenti.
messages.zh: 有啊，我发现身体更健壮了，衣服穿起来也不一样了。
messages.en: Yes, I'm noticing my body getting more muscular, and my clothes fit differently.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用训练前后的两张体形照片记 tgeddil：从单薄到结实、肌肉渐显，重点记住它表示“变壮的过程”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of gathering things into a heap, or the act of holding someone close affectionately.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把东西聚拢成堆的行为；也指亲昵地把人搂在怀里的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tqiegħed affarijiet f'munzell, jew l-att li żżomm lil xi ħadd qrib tiegħek b'għożża.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 堆积；把东西聚拢、堆放成堆。
亲昵搂抱；依偎着拥抱。

formal.mt: It-tgeddis tal-kaxxi quddiem il-bieb għamel id-dħul fil-maħżen aktar diffiċli.
formal.en: The heaping of boxes in front of the door made entry into the storeroom more difficult.
formal.zh: 把箱子堆在门前，使进入储藏室变得更加困难。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Nista' noqgħod ħdejk ftit qabel norqod? | Marija: Mela le! Ejja hawn għal ftit tgeddis.
colloquial.en: Nina: Can I sit beside you for a bit before I go to sleep? | Marija: Of course! Come here for a little cuddle.
colloquial.zh: Nina：睡觉前我能在你旁边坐一会儿吗？ | Marija：当然可以！过来，让我抱抱你。

messages.speaker: Nina (女儿)
messages.mt_spoken: Nista' noqgħod ħdejk ftit qabel norqod?
messages.mt_standard: Nista' noqgħod ħdejk ftit qabel norqod?
messages.zh: 睡觉前我能在你旁边坐一会儿吗？
messages.en: Can I sit beside you for a bit before I go to sleep?

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela le! Ejja hawn għal ftit tgeddis.
messages.mt_standard: Mela le! Ejja hawn għal ftit tgeddis.
messages.zh: 当然可以！过来，让我抱抱你。
messages.en: Of course! Come here for a little cuddle.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 tgeddis 做两张情景卡：一张是衣物堆成一堆，一张是亲人相拥；分别记“堆积”和“亲昵搂抱”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of brushing soil off vegetables.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用刷拭的方式去除蔬菜表面泥土的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tneħħi l-ħamrija minn fuq il-ħaxix billi tfarfarha b'pinzell jew b'xi ħaġa simili.

sense_translations.en_definition: brushing of the soil off vegetables
sense_translations.zh_definition: 刷去蔬菜表面泥土的动作或过程。

collocations.en: brushing soil off vegetables with a dry brush
collocations.zh: 用干刷子刷去蔬菜上的泥土

formal.mt: Waqt it-tgelbil tal-patata, il-ħaddiema jużaw xkupilji biex ineħħu l-ħamrija minn fuq il-qoxra.
formal.en: When brushing the soil off potatoes, the workers use brushes to remove the soil from the skins.
formal.zh: 刷除土豆上的泥土时，工人用刷子清除土豆皮表面的泥土。

colloquial.mt: Pawlu: X'qed tagħmel b'dak il-pinzell? | Rita: Qed inneħħi l-ħamrija minn fuq il-patata. Għad fadalli ftit tgelbil.
colloquial.en: Pawlu: What are you doing with that brush? | Rita: I'm removing the soil from the potatoes. I've still got a little brushing to do.
colloquial.zh: Pawlu：你拿那个刷子做什么呢？ | Rita：我在刷掉土豆上的泥土。还剩一点没刷完。

messages.speaker: Pawlu (家人)
messages.zh: 你拿那个刷子做什么呢？
messages.en: What are you doing with that brush?

messages.speaker: Rita (做饭者)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed inneħħi l-ħamrija minn fuq il-patata. Għad fadalli ftit tgelbil.
messages.mt_standard: Qed inneħħi l-ħamrija minn fuq il-patata. Għad fadalli ftit tgelbil.
messages.zh: 我在刷掉土豆上的泥土。还剩一点没刷完。
messages.en: I'm removing the soil from the potatoes. I've still got a little brushing to do.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象手拿干刷子，把土豆表面的泥土一刷刷扫落；用这个具体动作记 tgelbil，抓住“蔬菜、泥土、刷除”三点。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become physically weak or to decline in health.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体逐渐虚弱，或健康状况变差。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir dgħajjef fil-ġisem jew tmur lura saħħtu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得虚弱或不健康；身体状况转差。

collocations.en: became weak after a long illness
became weak because of a lack of food
collocations.zh: 因食物不足而身体衰弱

formal.mt: Wara perjodu twil ta' mard, ir-raġel tgelgel u kellu bżonn l-għajnuna biex jagħmel ix-xogħol ta' kuljum.
formal.en: After a long period of illness, the man became weak and needed help with everyday tasks.
formal.zh: 长期患病之后，这名男子身体变得虚弱，做日常事务也需要帮助。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif inhu n-nannu wara l-marda? | Mark: Tgelgel ftit, imma llum ħareġ jimxi magħna.
colloquial.en: Lara: How is your grandfather after his illness? | Mark: He became a little weak, but today he went out for a walk with us.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你爷爷病后怎么样了？ | Mark：身体虚弱了一些，不过今天他和我们出去散步了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你爷爷病后怎么样了？
messages.en: How is your grandfather after his illness?

messages.speaker: Mark (孙子)
messages.mt_spoken: Tgelgel ftit, imma llum ħareġ jimxi magħna.
messages.mt_standard: Tgelgel ftit, imma llum ħareġ jimxi magħna.
messages.zh: 身体虚弱了一些，不过今天他和我们出去散步了。
messages.en: He became a little weak, but today he went out for a walk with us.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tgelgel 放进“病前走路有力、病后需要搀扶”的对比画面，记住它强调身体由强转弱或健康变差。

gloss_zh: 流水的汩汩声；液体涌流

teaching_sense.en_definition: The gurgling sound of running water, or the gushing flow of water or another liquid.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 流水发出的汩汩声；也指水或其他液体涌流的现象。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħoss li jagħmel l-ilma meta jiġri, jew il-ħruġ b'ħeffa u bil-kotra ta' ilma jew likwidu ieħor.

sense_translations.en_definition: gurgling sound made by running water
sense_translations.zh_definition: 流水发出的汩汩声、潺潺声。

sense_translations.en_definition: gushing of water or other liquid
sense_translations.zh_definition: 水或其他液体的涌出、涌流。

collocations.en: the gurgling of the water in the river
the gushing of water from the pipe

formal.mt: Wara li nfetaħ il-valv, it-tgelgil tal-ilma mill-pajp mela l-ġibjun żgħir fi ftit minuti.
formal.en: After the valve was opened, the gushing water from the pipe filled the small reservoir in a few minutes.
formal.zh: 阀门打开后，水从管道中涌出，几分钟内就注满了小蓄水池。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Tisma' t-tgelgil tal-ilma minn hawn? | Toni: Iva, ix-xmara qiegħda eżatt wara dawk is-siġar.
colloquial.en: Sara: Can you hear the gurgling water from here? | Toni: Yes, the river is just behind those trees.
colloquial.zh: Sara：在这里能听见流水的汩汩声吗？ | Toni：能，河就在那些树后面。

messages.speaker: Sara (散步者)
messages.zh: 在这里能听见流水的汩汩声吗？
messages.en: Can you hear the gurgling water from here?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ix-xmara qiegħda eżatt wara dawk is-siġar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ix-xmara qiegħda eżatt wara dawk is-siġar.
messages.zh: 能，河就在那些树后面。
messages.en: Yes, the river is just behind those trees.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 tgelgil 时先听想象中的汩汩流水声，再看管口涌出的水；分别对应“声音”和“液体涌流”两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To move by rolling, or to turn over onto another side.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过滚动而移动，或翻转到另一面。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiċċaqlaq billi jdur fuq wiċċ, jew jinqaleb minn naħa għal oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 滚动；以滚动的方式移动。
翻转；翻到另一面或另一侧。

collocations.en: turned over onto the other side

formal.mt: Il-barmil vojt tgerbeb fit-triq sakemm waqaf ħdejn il-ħajt.
formal.en: The empty barrel rolled along the road until it stopped beside the wall.
formal.zh: 空桶沿着道路滚动，直到墙边才停下来。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għadu rieqed it-tifel? | Pawlu: Iva, tgerbeb fuq in-naħa l-oħra u baqa' rieqed.
colloquial.en: Marija: Is the boy still asleep? | Pawlu: Yes, he turned over onto his other side and stayed asleep.
colloquial.zh: Marija：孩子还在睡吗？ | Pawlu：是啊，他翻了个身，继续睡着。

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.zh: 孩子还在睡吗？
messages.en: Is the boy still asleep?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, tgerbeb fuq in-naħa l-oħra u baqa' rieqed.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, tgerbeb fuq in-naħa l-oħra u baqa' rieqed.
messages.zh: 是啊，他翻了个身，继续睡着。
messages.en: Yes, he turned over onto his other side and stayed asleep.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个动作记 tgerbeb：桶在路上一路滚，是“滚动”；睡觉时翻到另一侧，是“翻转、翻身”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To suffer damage or to be subjected to rough handling.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受到损坏，或遭到粗暴、不小心的搬弄。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġarrab ħsara jew jiġi mċaqlaq jew trattat b'mod goff u bla ħsieb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 受损；遭到损坏。
遭粗暴搬弄；被不小心地摆弄或搬动。

collocations.en: was handled roughly as it passed from hand to hand
collocations.zh: 在多人传递过程中遭到粗暴搬弄

formal.mt: Waqt it-trasport, il-kontenitur tgerbeġ u l-għatu ma baqax jagħlaq sew.
formal.en: During transport, the container was damaged and its lid no longer closed properly.
formal.zh: 运输过程中，容器受了损，盖子再也无法正常合上。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għaliex il-pakkett kollu mgħaffeġ? | Mark: Tgerbeġ meta tefgħuh fuq l-art. Ejja naraw jekk hemmx xi ħaġa miksura ġewwa.
colloquial.en: Rita: Why is the package all crushed? | Mark: It was handled roughly when they threw it on the floor. Let's see whether anything inside is broken.
colloquial.zh: Rita：包裹怎么全压瘪了？ | Mark：他们把它扔到地上，搬弄得太粗暴了。看看里面有没有东西摔坏。

messages.speaker: Rita (收件人)
messages.zh: 包裹怎么全压瘪了？
messages.en: Why is the package all crushed?

messages.speaker: Mark (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Tgerbeġ meta tefgħuh fuq l-art. Ejja naraw jekk hemmx xi ħaġa miksura ġewwa.
messages.mt_standard: Tgerbeġ meta tefgħuh fuq l-art. Ejja naraw jekk hemmx xi ħaġa miksura ġewwa.
messages.zh: 他们把它扔到地上，搬弄得太粗暴了。看看里面有没有东西摔坏。
messages.en: It was handled roughly when they threw it on the floor. Let's see whether anything inside is broken.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象包裹被粗暴抛来抛去，最后边角压坏；用“遭粗暴搬弄”和“结果受损”两个画面记住 tgerbeġ。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The movement of something rolling along a surface or tumbling over.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 物体沿表面滚动，或翻转着滚落的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-moviment ta' xi ħaġa li ddur fuq wiċċ jew tinqaleb waqt li tinżel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 滚动；物体转动着沿表面移动。
翻滚；失去平衡后翻转或滚落。

formal.mt: It-tgerbib tal-ġebel mal-ġenb tal-għolja ħoloq periklu għan-nies fit-triq.
formal.en: The tumbling of stones down the hillside created a danger for people on the road.
formal.zh: 石块沿山坡翻滚，给路上的人造成了危险。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhu dak il-ħoss fit-taraġ? Toni: Huwa t-tgerbib tal-ballun; waqa' minn idi.
colloquial.en: Maja: What's that noise on the stairs? Toni: It's the ball tumbling down; it slipped out of my hand.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：楼梯上是什么声音？托尼：是球滚下去的声音；它从我手里滑掉了。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 楼梯上是什么声音？
messages.en: What's that noise on the stairs?

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa t-tgerbib tal-ballun; waqa' minn idi.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa t-tgerbib tal-ballun; waqa' minn idi.
messages.zh: 是球滚下去的声音；它从我手里滑掉了。
messages.en: It's the ball tumbling down; it slipped out of my hand.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象球沿楼梯一级级翻滚：平地上是滚动，失去平衡滚下去就是翻滚。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Damage to an object caused by handling it roughly or without sufficient care.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因粗暴搬运、摆弄或不够小心地处理物品而造成的损坏。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħsara lil oġġett minħabba li jkun ġie mmaniġġjat b'mod goff jew mingħajr attenzjoni biżżejjed.

sense_translations.en_definition: damage caused due to rough handling
sense_translations.zh_definition: 因粗暴搬运或摆弄而造成的损坏。

collocations.en: damage from rough handling during transport
collocations.zh: 运输过程中粗暴搬运造成的损坏

collocations.en: damage to furniture from rough handling
collocations.zh: 粗暴搬弄造成的家具损坏

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi t-tgerbiġ tal-għamara kkawżat minn ġarr mingħajr attenzjoni.
formal.en: The report describes the damage to the furniture caused by careless handling during transport.
formal.zh: 报告描述了搬运不慎给家具造成的损坏。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex ħadt ritratti tal-mejda? Mark: Biex nuri t-tgerbiġ li sar waqt il-ġarr.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did you take photos of the table? Mark: To show the damage caused by rough handling during transport.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你为什么给桌子拍照？马克：为了展示搬运时粗暴操作造成的损坏。

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.zh: 你为什么给桌子拍照？
messages.en: Why did you take photos of the table?

messages.speaker: Mark (搬运员)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex nuri t-tgerbiġ li sar waqt il-ġarr.
messages.mt_standard: Biex nuri t-tgerbiġ li sar waqt il-ġarr.
messages.zh: 为了展示搬运时粗暴操作造成的损坏。
messages.en: To show the damage caused by rough handling during transport.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住一张搬运后磕坏的桌子：这个词强调粗暴操作留下的损坏结果。

gloss_zh: 变得凌乱；失去原有秩序

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become disordered or have an orderly, composed state disturbed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变得凌乱，或原本整齐、安定的状态受到扰乱。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitlef l-ordni jew il-qagħda rranġata tiegħu u jsir imħawwad.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 受到扰乱；失去原本整齐或安定的状态。
处于凌乱、杂乱无序的状态。

formal.mt: Il-kexxun tgerfex waqt it-tfittxija, u d-dokumenti kellhom jerġgħu jitqiegħdu fl-ordni.
formal.en: The drawer became disordered during the search, and the documents had to be put back in order.
formal.zh: 翻找过程中，抽屉里的东西被弄乱了，文件需要重新整理。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ix-xagħar tiegħi tgerfex bir-riħ! Sara: Għandi moxt fil-basket; trid tużah?
colloquial.en: Maja: My hair got messed up in the wind! Sara: I've got a comb in my bag; would you like to use it?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我的头发被风吹乱了！萨拉：我包里有把梳子；你要用吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我的头发被风吹乱了！
messages.en: My hair got messed up in the wind!

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我包里有把梳子；你要用吗？
messages.en: I've got a comb in my bag; would you like to use it?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整齐头发被风吹乱的前后画面连起来，用这个动词记住状态发生变化。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A state of disorder in which things are mixed up or are not properly arranged.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 物品混杂、摆放不整齐或缺乏秩序的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Stat ta' diżordni fejn l-affarijiet ikunu mħallta jew mhux irranġati kif suppost.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 凌乱；事物缺乏整齐安排或秩序的状态。

formal.mt: It-tgerfix fil-karti għamel it-tfittxija għad-dokument aktar diffiċli.
formal.en: The disorder among the papers made the search for the document more difficult.
formal.zh: 纸张杂乱无序，使查找那份文件变得更加困难。

colloquial.mt: Toni: X'inhu dan it-tgerfix fuq il-mejda? Lara: Qed nagħżel il-karti; dalwaqt inpoġġi kollox f'postu.
colloquial.en: Toni: What's all this mess on the table? Lara: I'm sorting the papers; I'll put everything in its place soon.
colloquial.zh: 托尼：桌上怎么这么乱？拉拉：我在分类整理纸张；很快就会把所有东西放好。

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.zh: 桌上怎么这么乱？
messages.en: What's all this mess on the table?

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed nagħżel il-karti; dalwaqt inpoġġi kollox f'postu.
messages.mt_standard: Qed nagħżel il-karti; dalwaqt inpoġġi kollox f'postu.
messages.zh: 我在分类整理纸张；很快就会把所有东西放好。
messages.en: I'm sorting the papers; I'll put everything in its place soon.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象桌上纸张混成一堆：这个名词给眼前的凌乱状态起名字，可与变乱的动词对照记忆。

gloss_zh: 成为抱怨或投诉的对象

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be the person or thing about which a complaint is made.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 成为别人提出抱怨、不满或投诉所针对的人或事物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikun il-persuna jew il-ħaġa li dwarha jsir ilment.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be the subject of complaint
sense_translations.zh_definition: 成为抱怨或投诉所针对的对象。

collocations.en: a service that was the subject of complaint
a delay that was the subject of complaint

formal.mt: Fir-rapport issemma s-servizz li tgerger dwaru, flimkien mal-miżuri proposti biex jitjieb.
formal.en: The report mentioned the service that was the subject of complaint, together with the measures proposed to improve it.
formal.zh: 报告提到了受到投诉的服务，以及为改善该服务而提出的措施。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Liema servizz tgerger dwaru? Mark: Dak tal-kunsinna; il-pakketti waslu tard.
colloquial.en: Maja: Which service was the subject of complaint? Mark: The delivery service; the parcels arrived late.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：哪项服务受到了投诉？马克：配送服务；包裹送晚了。

messages.speaker: Maja (客服主管)
messages.zh: 哪项服务受到了投诉？
messages.en: Which service was the subject of complaint?

messages.speaker: Mark (客服人员)
messages.zh: 配送服务；包裹送晚了。
messages.en: The delivery service; the parcels arrived late.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在本词条中，把镜头对准投诉单上被投诉的服务，记住它是抱怨所针对的对象。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To feel disgusted by something or offended by someone's words or behaviour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因某事感到厌恶，或因他人的言语、行为感到被冒犯。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iħoss stmerrija għal xi ħaġa jew iħossu offiż bil-kliem jew bl-imġiba ta' xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 感到厌恶、反感或恶心。
感到受到冒犯或侮辱。

collocations.zh: 因那些话而感到被冒犯

formal.mt: Il-mistieden tgerges bil-kliem offensiv li ntqal waqt il-laqgħa.
formal.en: The guest felt offended by the insulting words spoken during the meeting.
formal.zh: 来宾因会议上说出的侮辱性话语而感到被冒犯。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex Mark telaq minn ħdejn il-barmil? Toni: Tgerges bir-riħa; se noħroġ iż-żibel issa.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did Mark move away from the bin? Toni: He felt disgusted by the smell; I'll take the rubbish out now.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：马克为什么从垃圾桶旁走开了？托尼：那股气味让他觉得恶心；我现在就去倒垃圾。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Mark telaq minn ħdejn il-barmil?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Mark telaq minn ħdejn il-barmil?
messages.zh: 马克为什么从垃圾桶旁走开了？
messages.en: Why did Mark move away from the bin?

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tgerges bir-riħa; se noħroġ iż-żibel issa.
messages.mt_standard: Tgerges bir-riħa; se noħroġ iż-żibel issa.
messages.zh: 那股气味让他觉得恶心；我现在就去倒垃圾。
messages.en: He felt disgusted by the smell; I'll take the rubbish out now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅皱眉画面记忆：闻到臭味是厌恶，听到侮辱性话语则是感到被冒犯。

gloss_zh: 被转动起来；被带着旋转

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be made to turn round in a spinning movement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受到外力作用而转动起来，形成旋转运动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġi mdawwar b'moviment ta' tidwir fuq innifsu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被转动起来；受外力作用而旋转。

collocations.en: was spun round on the table

formal.mt: Waqt id-dimostrazzjoni, il-ġugarell tgergex fuq wiċċ ċatt u baqa' jdur għal ftit sekondi.
formal.en: During the demonstration, the toy was spun round on a flat surface and continued turning for a few seconds.
formal.zh: 演示时，玩具在平坦表面上被转动起来，并持续旋转了几秒钟。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'ġara mill-ġugarell meta ġbidt il-ħajta? Pawlu: Tgergex fuq il-mejda u mbagħad waqaf.
colloquial.en: Lara: What happened to the toy when you pulled the string? Pawlu: It was spun round on the table and then stopped.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你拉绳子时，玩具怎么样了？保罗：它在桌上被带着转了起来，然后停下了。

messages.speaker: Lara (姐姐)
messages.zh: 你拉绳子时，玩具怎么样了？
messages.en: What happened to the toy when you pulled the string?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (弟弟)
messages.mt_spoken: Tgergex fuq il-mejda u mbagħad waqaf.
messages.mt_standard: Tgergex fuq il-mejda u mbagħad waqaf.
messages.zh: 它在桌上被带着转了起来，然后停下了。
messages.en: It was spun round on the table and then stopped.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一拉绳子，玩具便被带着转起来；用这段动作记住被动旋转的含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action or movement of spinning, especially the spinning of a top.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 物体围绕自身转动的运动，尤指陀螺的旋转。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-moviment ta' xi ħaġa li ddur fuqha nnifisha, speċjalment żugraga.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 旋转，尤指陀螺围绕自身不断转动的运动。

formal.mt: L-istudenti kejlu kemm dam it-tgergix taż-żugraga fuq wiċċ lixx.
formal.en: The students measured how long the top's spinning lasted on a smooth surface.
formal.zh: 学生们测量了陀螺在光滑表面上持续旋转的时间。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kemm dam it-tgergix taż-żugraga tiegħek? Toni: Għaxar sekondi; ejja nerġgħu nippruvaw!
colloquial.en: Maja: How long did your top keep spinning? Toni: Ten seconds; let's try again!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你的陀螺转了多久？托尼：十秒；我们再试一次吧！

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 你的陀螺转了多久？
messages.en: How long did your top keep spinning?

messages.speaker: Toni (同学)
messages.zh: 十秒；我们再试一次吧！
messages.en: Ten seconds; let's try again!

cognitive_memory_aid: 看着陀螺原地转圈并开始计时：这个名词指可以观察、计时的旋转运动。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become covered with soot, or to become dirty and scruffy in appearance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 沾上一层煤烟，或因弄脏而显得邋遢、不整洁。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinkesa bin-nugrufun, jew isir maħmuġ u jidher traskurat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 沾满煤烟；表面蒙上一层烟灰。
变得邋遢、不整洁。

collocations.en: became dirty and scruffy while working

formal.mt: Wara li naddaf iċ-ċumnija, il-ħaddiem tgermed bin-nugrufun u kellu jinħasel.
formal.en: After cleaning the chimney, the worker became covered with soot and had to wash.
formal.zh: 清理烟囱后，工人沾满了煤烟，必须洗一洗。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Mark kollu iswed? Lara: Naddaf iċ-ċumnija u tgermed bin-nugrufun.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is Mark all black? Lara: He cleaned the chimney and got covered with soot.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克怎么浑身黑乎乎的？拉拉：他清理了烟囱，沾满了煤烟。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克怎么浑身黑乎乎的？
messages.en: Why is Mark all black?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 他清理了烟囱，沾满了煤烟。
messages.en: He cleaned the chimney and got covered with soot.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象清完烟囱后满脸发黑：先记“沾煤烟”，再联系“变邋遢”。

gloss_zh: 沾上煤烟的过程；变脏、变邋遢

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of becoming covered with soot or becoming dirty and scruffy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 沾上煤烟，或逐渐变脏、变得邋遢的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li fih xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa jinkesa bin-nugrufun jew isir maħmuġ u traskurat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 沾上煤烟、被烟灰覆盖的过程。
变脏或变得邋遢、不整洁的过程。

formal.mt: Waqt it-tindif taċ-ċumnija, l-ilbies protettiv jgħin biex jitnaqqas it-tgermid tal-ħwejjeġ bin-nugrufun.
formal.en: During chimney cleaning, protective clothing helps reduce the soiling of clothes with soot.
formal.zh: 清理烟囱时，防护服有助于减少衣物沾染煤烟。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex qed tilbes dik il-libsa l-qadima? Lara: Biex nevita t-tgermid tal-ħwejjeġ tajbin waqt li nnaddaf iċ-ċumnija.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why are you wearing that old outfit? Lara: To keep my good clothes from getting covered with soot while I clean the chimney.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你为什么穿那套旧衣服？拉拉：清理烟囱时，免得好衣服沾满煤烟。

messages.speaker: Mark (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed tilbes dik il-libsa l-qadima?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed tilbes dik il-libsa l-qadima?
messages.zh: 你为什么穿那套旧衣服？
messages.en: Why are you wearing that old outfit?

messages.speaker: Lara (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex nevita t-tgermid tal-ħwejjeġ tajbin waqt li nnaddaf iċ-ċumnija.
messages.mt_standard: Biex nevita t-tgermid tal-ħwejjeġ tajbin waqt li nnaddaf iċ-ċumnija.
messages.zh: 清理烟囱时，免得好衣服沾满煤烟。
messages.en: To keep my good clothes from getting covered with soot while I clean the chimney.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它记成“弄脏这件事”：镜头关注衣服逐渐沾灰的过程。

gloss_zh: 被啃咬；被逐渐侵蚀、削减

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be gnawed or nibbled, or to be slowly eaten away, worn away, or reduced.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被啃咬或小口啃食，也可指某物逐渐被侵蚀、磨损或削减。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jittiekel bil-gdim jew ftit ftit, jintlibes bil-mod, jew jonqos gradwalment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被反复啃咬。
被小口啃食；被一点点咬食。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be eaten or worn away slowly
sense_translations.zh_definition: 慢慢被吃掉、侵蚀或磨损。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be gradually reduced (used, e.g. of salaries when they are progressively decreased)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被逐步削减，例如工资被一次次调低。

formal.mt: Matul is-sena, is-salarju tal-impjegat tgerrem ftit ftit minħabba tnaqqis ripetut fil-paga.
formal.en: Over the year, the employee's salary was gradually reduced through repeated pay cuts.
formal.zh: 这一年里，该员工的工资因反复减薪而逐步降低。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'ġara mit-tarf ta' dan l-ixkaffa? Mark: Tgerrem mill-ġrieden; ara l-marki tas-snien.
colloquial.en: Maja: What happened to the edge of this shelf? Mark: It was gnawed by mice; look at the tooth marks.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个架子的边缘怎么了？马克：被老鼠啃了，你看那些牙印。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 这个架子的边缘怎么了？
messages.en: What happened to the edge of this shelf?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 被老鼠啃了，你看那些牙印。
messages.en: It was gnawed by mice; look at the tooth marks.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象木头被一口口啃少，再把同一画面用于工资被一点点削减。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become upset or emotionally disturbed by something that happens.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因发生的事情而心烦、难过或感到不快。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jibda jħossu mdejjaq jew imħawwad minħabba xi ħaġa li tiġri.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得心烦、难过或不快。

formal.mt: Pawlu tgerres meta sar jaf li l-laqgħa importanti kienet tħassret mingħajr avviż.
formal.en: Pawlu became upset when he learned that the important meeting had been cancelled without notice.
formal.zh: 保罗得知重要会议未作通知就被取消后，感到很不快。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex Pawlu ma jridx jitkellem? Maja: Tgerres wara l-argument u għandu bżonn ftit ħin.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why doesn't Pawlu want to talk? Maja: He got upset after the argument and needs a little time.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：保罗为什么不想说话？玛雅：他争论后心情不好，需要缓一缓。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗为什么不想说话？
messages.en: Why doesn't Pawlu want to talk?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tgerres wara l-argument u għandu bżonn ftit ħin.
messages.mt_standard: Tgerres wara l-argument u għandu bżonn ftit ħin.
messages.zh: 他争论后心情不好，需要缓一缓。
messages.en: He got upset after the argument and needs a little time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住争论后沉默不语的表情，把这个词与“心情变坏”联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be frightened away, or to be timid and hesitant because of fear.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受到惊吓而退开或逃走，也可指表现得胆怯、畏缩。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitbeżża' u jitbiegħed, jew juri biża' u joqgħod lura.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被吓跑；因受惊而退开。
胆怯；因害怕而畏缩。

collocations.en: was scared off by the noise

collocations.mt: tgerrex minn nies li ma jafx

formal.mt: L-għasfur tgerrex mill-istorbju tal-magna u telaq mis-siġra.
formal.en: The bird was scared off by the noise of the machine and left the tree.
formal.zh: 那只鸟被机器的噪声吓跑，离开了树。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Fejn mar il-qattus? Lara: Tgerrex meta waqgħet il-kaxxa; qiegħed taħt is-sodda.
colloquial.en: Mark: Where did the cat go? Lara: It got scared off when the box fell; it's under the bed.
colloquial.zh: 马克：猫跑哪儿去了？拉拉：箱子掉下来时把它吓跑了，它在床底下。

messages.speaker: Mark (家人)
messages.zh: 猫跑哪儿去了？
messages.en: Where did the cat go?

messages.speaker: Lara (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Tgerrex meta waqgħet il-kaxxa; qiegħed taħt is-sodda.
messages.mt_standard: Tgerrex meta waqgħet il-kaxxa; qiegħed taħt is-sodda.
messages.zh: 箱子掉下来时把它吓跑了，它在床底下。
messages.en: It got scared off when the box fell; it's under the bed.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象胆小的猫听见响声便躲起来，串起“胆怯”和“被吓跑”两义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action of repeatedly biting or chewing at something, often removing small pieces.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 反复用牙齿啃咬某物的动作，常使小碎片逐渐脱落。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni ta' gdim ripetut fuq xi ħaġa, li spiss ineħħi biċċiet żgħar minnha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 啃咬；反复咬磨某物的动作。

formal.mt: L-ispezzjoni sabet marki tat-tgerrim fuq il-kaxxi tal-injam fil-maħżen.
formal.en: The inspection found gnawing marks on the wooden boxes in the storeroom.
formal.zh: 检查发现，储藏室里的木箱上有啃咬痕迹。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhu dak il-ħoss wara l-armarju? Mark: Naħseb li hu t-tgerrim ta' ġurdien; ejja nħarsu.
colloquial.en: Maja: What's that sound behind the cupboard? Mark: I think it's a mouse gnawing; let's have a look.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：柜子后面是什么声音？马克：我想是老鼠在啃东西，我们看看吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 柜子后面是什么声音？
messages.en: What's that sound behind the cupboard?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Naħseb li hu t-tgerrim ta' ġurdien; ejja nħarsu.
messages.mt_standard: Naħseb li hu t-tgerrim ta' ġurdien; ejja nħarsu.
messages.zh: 我想是老鼠在啃东西，我们看看吧。
messages.en: I think it's a mouse gnawing; let's have a look.

cognitive_memory_aid: 脑中播放老鼠反复啃木箱的声音，用“啃咬这个动作”记住名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action of making someone or something run away, or of giving someone or something a sudden fright.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人或动物逃走的行为，或突然使其受到惊吓的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li ġġiegħel lil xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa jaħrab, jew li tbeżżgħu għal għarrieda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使逃走；把人或动物赶跑、惊走。

sense_translations.en_definition: giving sb. or sth. a start
sense_translations.zh_definition: 突然吓某人或某物一跳；使其受惊。

formal.mt: Il-gwida tal-park titlob lill-viżitaturi jevitaw it-tgerrix tal-għasafar waqt li jkunu qed josservawhom.
formal.en: The park guide asks visitors to avoid scaring birds away while observing them.
formal.zh: 公园指南要求游客在观察鸟类时避免将它们惊走。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex qed titkellem daqshekk bil-mod? Mark: Biex nevita t-tgerrix tal-għasafar; irrid narahom mill-qrib.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why are you speaking so softly? Mark: To avoid scaring the birds away; I want to see them up close.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你为什么说话这么轻？马克：免得把鸟吓跑，我想近距离看看它们。

messages.speaker: Lara (观鸟同伴)
messages.zh: 你为什么说话这么轻？
messages.en: Why are you speaking so softly?

messages.speaker: Mark (观鸟同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex nevita t-tgerrix tal-għasafar; irrid narahom mill-qrib.
messages.mt_standard: Biex nevita t-tgerrix tal-għasafar; irrid narahom mill-qrib.
messages.zh: 免得把鸟吓跑，我想近距离看看它们。
messages.en: To avoid scaring the birds away; I want to see them up close.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象拍手后鸟群惊起飞走，记住这是“使别人受惊或逃走”的行为。

gloss_zh: 喋喋不休；空谈；激愤叫嚷

teaching_sense.en_definition: Continuous or rambling talk that may be unclear, trivial, or angrily forceful.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 连续不断或散漫无章的说话，可指含混的絮叨、无意义的空谈，或激愤的叫嚷。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Taħdit bla waqfien li jista' jkun mhux ċar, bla siwi, jew mimli rabja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 含混、杂乱地说个不停；叽里咕噜的絮叨。
喋喋不休的空谈；说许多无意义或琐碎的话。
激愤而冗长的叫嚷、斥责或抱怨。

collocations.zh: 没完没了的絮叨或空谈

formal.mt: It-tgerwil bla waqfien tal-kelliem għamilha diffiċli għall-udjenza biex tifhem il-punt ewlieni.
formal.en: The speaker's incessant rambling made it difficult for the audience to understand the main point.
formal.zh: 发言者没完没了地絮叨，使听众难以理解要点。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex tlaqt mil-laqgħa? Mark: Ma flaħtx aktar għat-tgerwil tiegħu; baqa' jirrepeti l-istess ilmenti.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you leave the meeting? Mark: I couldn't stand his ranting anymore; he kept repeating the same complaints.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么离开会议？马克：我再也受不了他那番叫嚷了，他一直重复同样的抱怨。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 你为什么离开会议？
messages.en: Why did you leave the meeting?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma flaħtx aktar għat-tgerwil tiegħu; baqa' jirrepeti l-istess ilmenti.
messages.mt_standard: Ma flaħtx aktar għat-tgerwil tiegħu; baqa' jirrepeti l-istess ilmenti.
messages.zh: 我再也受不了他那番叫嚷了，他一直重复同样的抱怨。
messages.en: I couldn't stand his ranting anymore; he kept repeating the same complaints.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象有人一直说却抓不住重点，再按语气区分絮叨、空谈和激愤叫嚷。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Casual talk about unimportant matters, especially when it distracts from something useful.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 围绕无关紧要的事情随意交谈，尤指让人分心的闲聊。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Taħdit fuq affarijiet bla wisq importanza, speċjalment meta jtellifna minn xi ħaġa utli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 闲聊；没有多少实质内容的絮谈

formal.mt: Waqt il-laqgħa, it-tgerwix bejn il-parteċipanti fixkel id-diskussjoni.
formal.en: During the meeting, idle chatter among the participants disrupted the discussion.
formal.zh: 会议期间，与会者之间的闲聊干扰了讨论。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kemm kien hemm tgerwix illum! Mark: Veru, u xorta ma ddeċidejna xejn.
colloquial.en: Maja: There was so much idle chatter today! Mark: True, and we still didn't decide anything.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：今天大家闲聊得可真多！马克：确实，结果我们还是什么都没决定。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 今天大家闲聊得可真多！
messages.en: There was so much idle chatter today!

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Veru, u xorta ma ddeċidejna xejn.
messages.mt_standard: Veru, u xorta ma ddeċidejna xejn.
messages.zh: 确实，结果我们还是什么都没决定。
messages.en: True, and we still didn't decide anything.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tgerwix 记成会议里不断冒出的小气泡：话很多，重要内容却很少，用画面联想“闲聊”。

gloss_zh: 变得胆怯；开始回避社交

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become timid or begin withdrawing from contact with other people.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变得胆怯、畏缩，或开始减少与他人的接触、回避社交。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir mistħi jew beżgħan, jew jibda jevita l-kumpanija ta' nies oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得胆怯；变得畏缩
开始回避社交；开始不愿与人来往

collocations.zh: 在陌生人面前变得胆怯

collocations.en: became withdrawn and began avoiding going out
collocations.zh: 变得退缩，并开始回避外出交际

formal.mt: Wara li daħal fil-grupp il-ġdid, Mark tgexter u beda jevita l-attivitajiet soċjali.
formal.en: After joining the new group, Mark became timid and began avoiding social activities.
formal.zh: 加入新团体后，马克变得胆怯，并开始回避社交活动。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mark tgexter dan l-aħħar; ma għadux joħroġ magħna. Lara: Nistiednuh għal kafè, aħna t-tlieta biss.
colloquial.en: Maja: Mark has become withdrawn lately; he doesn't go out with us anymore. Lara: Let's invite him for coffee, just the three of us.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克最近变得退缩了，都不再跟我们出去了。拉拉：我们约他喝杯咖啡吧，就我们三个人。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mark tgexter dan l-aħħar; ma għadux joħroġ magħna.
messages.mt_standard: Mark tgexter dan l-aħħar; ma għadux joħroġ magħna.
messages.zh: 马克最近变得退缩了，都不再跟我们出去了。
messages.en: Mark has become withdrawn lately; he doesn't go out with us anymore.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nistiednuh għal kafè, aħna t-tlieta biss.
messages.mt_standard: Nistiednuh għal kafè, aħna t-tlieta biss.
messages.zh: 我们约他喝杯咖啡吧，就我们三个人。
messages.en: Let's invite him for coffee, just the three of us.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“先缩到角落，再躲开聚会”的连续画面记 tgexter，分别对应变胆怯和开始回避社交。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be covered or enclosed in wrapping material, or to be wrapped snugly in cloth as a baby.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被纸、布等材料包住；也指婴儿被布或襁褓贴身包裹。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitgħatta jew jingħalaq f'karta jew drapp; għal tarbija, jitgeżwer sewwa f'drapp jew kutra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被包住；被包裹
被襁褓或布包裹，尤指婴儿

collocations.en: was wrapped in a soft blanket

formal.mt: Ir-rigal tgeżwer f'karta ħamra u tqiegħed f'kaxxa qabel intbagħat.
formal.en: The gift was wrapped in red paper and placed in a box before it was sent.
formal.zh: 礼物寄出前，先用红纸包好，再放进盒子里。

colloquial.mt: Lara: It-tifel tgeżwer sew fil-kutra? Mark: Iva, u issa raqad.
colloquial.en: Lara: Was the little boy wrapped snugly in the blanket? Mark: Yes, and now he's asleep.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：小男孩用毯子包好了吗？马克：包好了，现在已经睡着了。

messages.speaker: Lara (母亲)
messages.zh: 小男孩用毯子包好了吗？
messages.en: Was the little boy wrapped snugly in the blanket?

messages.speaker: Mark (父亲)
messages.zh: 包好了，现在已经睡着了。
messages.en: Yes, and now he's asleep.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tgeżwer 配上两个画面：礼物被纸包住、婴儿被布包住；主语都是接受包裹的一方。

gloss_zh: 包装；包裹物；夸张故事的讲述

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of wrapping something, the wrapping around an object, or the telling of exaggerated stories.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 包装物品的行为、物品外面的包裹物，也可指讲述夸张离奇的故事。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tgeżwer xi ħaġa, il-kisi madwar oġġett, jew ir-rakkontar ta' stejjer esaġerati.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 礼物等物品的包装；包裹物品的行为
物品外面的包装层或包裹物
讲述夸张离奇、令人难以相信的故事；吹嘘式讲述

formal.mt: Is-servizz jinkludi t-tgeżwir tar-rigali; il-klijent jista' jagħżel il-karta u ż-żigarella.
formal.en: The service includes gift wrapping; the customer can choose the paper and ribbon.
formal.zh: 该服务包括礼物包装；顾客可以选择包装纸和丝带。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Neħħejt it-tgeżwir minn fuq ir-rigal? Lara: Għadni le; irrid niftħu bil-mod biex ma nqattax il-karta.
colloquial.en: Maja: Have you removed the wrapping from the gift? Lara: Not yet; I want to open it slowly so I don't tear the paper.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你把礼物外面的包装拆了吗？拉拉：还没有；我想慢慢拆，免得把纸撕破。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你把礼物外面的包装拆了吗？
messages.en: Have you removed the wrapping from the gift?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadni le; irrid niftħu bil-mod biex ma nqattax il-karta.
messages.mt_standard: Għadni le; irrid niftħu bil-mod biex ma nqattax il-karta.
messages.zh: 还没有；我想慢慢拆，免得把纸撕破。
messages.en: Not yet; I want to open it slowly so I don't tear the paper.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三张学习卡记 tgeżwir：正在包装的手、物品外面的纸、讲夸张故事的人；第三张单独记作另一义项。

gloss_zh: 被反驳；被指出说法不实

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be contradicted or to have one's statement challenged as untrue.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受到反驳，或自己的说法被指出不真实。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jisfa kontradett, jew dak li jkun qal jiġi miċħud bħala mhux veru.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be contradicted or given the lie
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被反驳；被否认其说法的真实性；被指出说了不实之言

formal.mt: Il-kelliem tgiddeb meta d-dokumenti wrew li ċ-ċifri li semma ma kinux korretti.
formal.en: The speaker was contradicted when the documents showed that the figures he had cited were incorrect.
formal.zh: 文件显示发言人引用的数字有误，他的说法因此受到反驳。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Pawlu qal li l-ħanut kien magħluq, imma tgiddeb minn Lara. Mark: Iva, għax hi kienet għadha kemm xtrat minn hemm.
colloquial.en: Maja: Pawlu said the shop was closed, but Lara contradicted him. Mark: Yes, because she had just bought something there.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗说商店关门了，但拉拉反驳了他。马克：对，因为她刚在那里买过东西。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu qal li l-ħanut kien magħluq, imma tgiddeb minn Lara.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu qal li l-ħanut kien magħluq, imma tgiddeb minn Lara.
messages.zh: 保罗说商店关门了，但拉拉反驳了他。
messages.en: Pawlu said the shop was closed, but Lara contradicted him.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għax hi kienet għadha kemm xtrat minn hemm.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għax hi kienet għadha kemm xtrat minn hemm.
messages.zh: 对，因为她刚在那里买过东西。
messages.en: Yes, because she had just bought something there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象说话者面前出现一份相反证据，把 tgiddeb 记为“他说的话被反驳”，注意主语是受反驳的一方。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be bitten or have something chewed away through gnawing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被牙齿咬到，或因反复啃咬而受到损坏。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jisfa migdum, jew jittiekel jew jitħassar bil-gdim ripetut.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被咬；受到咬伤
被啃；被反复啃咬

formal.mt: Waqt l-ispezzjoni nstab li l-kejbil tgiddem mill-ġrieden u kellu jinbidel.
formal.en: During the inspection, the cable was found to have been gnawed by mice and needed replacing.
formal.zh: 检查发现，电缆被老鼠啃咬过，需要更换。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex il-lapes kollu marki tas-snien? Mark: Tgiddem mill-ġeru meta ħallejtu fuq is-sufan.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why is the pencil covered in tooth marks? Mark: It got chewed by the puppy when I left it on the sofa.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：铅笔上怎么全是牙印？马克：我把它放在沙发上时，被小狗啃了。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 铅笔上怎么全是牙印？
messages.en: Why is the pencil covered in tooth marks?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tgiddem mill-ġeru meta ħallejtu fuq is-sufan.
messages.mt_standard: Tgiddem mill-ġeru meta ħallejtu fuq is-sufan.
messages.zh: 我把它放在沙发上时，被小狗啃了。
messages.en: It got chewed by the puppy when I left it on the sofa.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tgiddem 写在带牙印的铅笔旁：一次咬到或反复啃咬都可联想，重点是物品或人“被咬”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of contradicting a statement or declaring that someone's claim is untrue.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 反驳某种说法，或指出他人的主张不真实的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tikkontradixxi stqarrija jew tgħid li dak li qal xi ħadd mhuwiex veru.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 反驳；对某种说法的否认
指出某人的说法不实；指斥其说谎

formal.mt: L-istqarrija uffiċjali kien fiha tgiddib tal-allegazzjonijiet u spjegazzjoni tal-fatti.
formal.en: The official statement contained a rebuttal of the allegations and an explanation of the facts.
formal.zh: 官方声明包含对指控的反驳以及对事实的说明。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dak li qal Mark kien tgiddib ċar ta' kliem Pawlu. Lara: Iva, qal li l-istorja ma kienet vera xejn.
colloquial.en: Maja: What Mark said was a clear rebuttal of Pawlu's words. Lara: Yes, he said the story wasn't true at all.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克那番话明显是在反驳保罗。拉拉：对，他说那个故事根本不是真的。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak li qal Mark kien tgiddib ċar ta' kliem Pawlu.
messages.mt_standard: Dak li qal Mark kien tgiddib ċar ta' kliem Pawlu.
messages.zh: 马克那番话明显是在反驳保罗。
messages.en: What Mark said was a clear rebuttal of Pawlu's words.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qal li l-istorja ma kienet vera xejn.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qal li l-istorja ma kienet vera xejn.
messages.zh: 对，他说那个故事根本不是真的。
messages.en: Yes, he said the story wasn't true at all.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tgiddib 当作贴在“这说法不对”气泡上的名词标签；与 tgiddeb 的“被反驳”对照，记住这里指反驳行为。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Repeated or frequent gnawing, usually involving many small bites at something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某物频繁、反复地啃咬，通常表现为连续的小口咬啮。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Gdim frekwenti jew ripetut ta' xi ħaġa, ħafna drabi b'gidmiet żgħar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 频繁啃咬；反复啃噬

formal.mt: L-ispezzjoni żvelat ħsara fl-injam ikkawżata mit-tgiddim tal-ġrieden.
formal.en: The inspection revealed damage to the wood caused by the repeated gnawing of mice.
formal.zh: 检查发现，木材受到老鼠反复啃咬而损坏。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'ġara minn sieq is-siġġu? Mark: Dak mit-tgiddim tal-ġeru; dejjem imur jigdimha.
colloquial.en: Lara: What happened to the chair leg? Mark: That's from the puppy's repeated gnawing; he keeps going over to chew it.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：椅子腿怎么了？马克：那是小狗反复啃出来的，它总跑过去咬。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 椅子腿怎么了？
messages.en: What happened to the chair leg?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak mit-tgiddim tal-ġeru; dejjem imur jigdimha.
messages.mt_standard: Dak mit-tgiddim tal-ġeru; dejjem imur jigdimha.
messages.zh: 那是小狗反复啃出来的，它总跑过去咬。
messages.en: That's from the puppy's repeated gnawing; he keeps going over to chew it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象椅子腿上的牙印一层层增加，把 tgiddim 记成反复发生的啃咬活动，突出“频繁、持续”的意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be contradicted or shown to be untrue.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指某个说法受到反驳，或被事实、证据证明并不属实。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikun miċħud jew jintwera li mhux minnu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被反驳；被证明不实。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport tgiedeb meta ġew ippubblikati dokumenti li wrew li l-informazzjoni kienet żbaljata.
formal.en: The report was disproved when documents were published showing that the information was incorrect.
formal.zh: 文件公布后，报告被证明不实，因为这些文件显示其中的信息有误。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dak li qal Mark kien minnu? Lara: Le, tgiedeb meta rajna r-ritratti.
colloquial.en: Maja: Was what Mark said true? Lara: No, it was disproved when we saw the photos.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克说的是真的吗？拉拉：不是，我们看过照片后，他的说法就被证明不实了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak li qal Mark kien minnu?
messages.mt_standard: Dak li qal Mark kien minnu?
messages.zh: 马克说的是真的吗？
messages.en: Was what Mark said true?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 不是，我们看过照片后，他的说法就被证明不实了。
messages.en: No, it was disproved when we saw the photos.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一张照片推翻了一段说法，把 tgiedeb 和“说法被证据反驳”一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To bite one another, with each participant biting the other.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指双方彼此用牙齿咬对方，强调相互发生的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jigdem lil ieħor u jingidem minnu wkoll; jigdmu lil xulxin.

sense_translations.en_definition: to bite (used in a mutual sense)
