sense_translations.zh_definition: 互相咬；用于双方彼此撕咬的情形。

collocations.en: they bit one another during the fight

formal.mt: Iż-żewġ klieb tgiedmu waqt ġlieda, u s-sidien firduhom minnufih.
formal.en: The two dogs bit one another during a fight, and their owners separated them immediately.
formal.zh: 两只狗在打斗中互相撕咬，主人立即把它们分开了。

colloquial.mt: Mark: X'ġara bejn il-klieb? Nina: Tgiedmu, imma issa huma mifrudin.
colloquial.en: Mark: What happened between the dogs? Nina: They bit one another, but they are separated now.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这两只狗怎么了？妮娜：它们刚才互相咬，不过现在已经分开了。

messages.speaker: Mark (邻居)
messages.zh: 这两只狗怎么了？
messages.en: What happened between the dogs?

messages.speaker: Nina (狗主人)
messages.zh: 它们刚才互相咬，不过现在已经分开了。
messages.en: They bit one another, but they are separated now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画两只狗各朝对方伸出牙齿，双向箭头提醒 tgiedem 强调“互相咬”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To scratch one another with nails or claws.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指双方用指甲或爪子彼此抓挠，强调动作是相互的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jigref lil ieħor u jingiref minnu wkoll; jigirfu lil xulxin.

sense_translations.en_definition: to scratch (used in a mutual sense)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 互相抓挠；用于双方彼此抓对方的情形。

collocations.en: they scratched one another during the fight
collocations.zh: 它们在打斗中互相抓挠

formal.mt: Iż-żewġ qtates tgierefu waqt il-ġlieda u mbagħad tbiegħdu minn xulxin.
formal.en: The two cats scratched one another during the fight and then moved away from each other.
formal.zh: 两只猫在打斗中互相抓挠，随后各自退开了。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex hemm pil mal-art? Pawlu: Il-qtates tgierefu ftit ilu, imma issa kkalmaw.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why is there fur on the floor? Pawlu: The cats scratched one another a little while ago, but they have calmed down now.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：地上怎么有猫毛？保罗：猫刚才互相抓了一阵，不过现在已经平静下来了。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 地上怎么有猫毛？
messages.en: Why is there fur on the floor?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (养猫的室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-qtates tgierefu ftit ilu, imma issa kkalmaw.
messages.mt_standard: Il-qtates tgierefu ftit ilu, imma issa kkalmaw.
messages.zh: 猫刚才互相抓了一阵，不过现在已经平静下来了。
messages.en: The cats scratched one another a little while ago, but they have calmed down now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把两只猫互伸爪子的画面配给 tgieref；记住是双方抓挠，区别于用牙互咬。

gloss_zh: 被装载；承担责任；被交付责任

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be loaded with something, or to take on or be assigned responsibility for something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指被装上货物或负载，也可指主动承担某事的责任，或被交付该责任。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikun mgħobbi b'xi ħaġa, jew jieħu fuqu jew jingħata r-responsabbiltà għal xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被装载；被装上货物或其他负载。
主动承担某事的责任。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be given responsibility for sth.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被交付某事的责任；被指派负责某事。

collocations.en: took on responsibility for the project

formal.mt: Il-koordinatur tgħabba bir-responsabbiltà li jorganizza t-trasport u jiżgura li l-materjal jasal fil-ħin.
formal.en: The coordinator took on responsibility for organizing transport and ensuring that the material arrived on time.
formal.zh: 协调员承担了安排运输并确保材料按时送达的责任。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min se jorganizza l-laqgħa? Mark: Jien tgħabbejt b'dan ix-xogħol; diġà bgħatt l-istediniet.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who is going to organize the meeting? Mark: I have taken on that job; I have already sent the invitations.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：谁来组织会议？马克：这项工作我已经接下了，邀请也已经发出去了。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 谁来组织会议？
messages.en: Who is going to organize the meeting?

messages.speaker: Mark (项目协调员)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien tgħabbejt b'dan ix-xogħol; diġà bgħatt l-istediniet.
messages.mt_standard: Jien tgħabbejt b'dan ix-xogħol; diġà bgħatt l-istediniet.
messages.zh: 这项工作我已经接下了，邀请也已经发出去了。
messages.en: I have taken on that job; I have already sent the invitations.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“肩上有负担”的画面串联记忆：车上装货、人接责任；是否主动承担要看上下文。

gloss_zh: 被喷施含硫杀虫剂；被抵消；被平衡

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be sprayed with a sulphurous insecticide in agriculture, or to be offset or counterbalanced.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在农业语境中指被喷施含硫杀虫剂，常用于葡萄藤等植物；也可指被抵消或被另一作用平衡。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikun imbexxex b'insettiċida bil-kubrit f'kuntest agrikolu, jew jiġi kkumpensat jew ibbilanċjat minn xi ħaġa oħra.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be sprayed with sulphurous insecticide (used in an agricultural context, typically for vines etc)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被喷施含硫杀虫剂，用于农业语境，通常描述葡萄藤等植物。
被抵消；某种损失、代价或不利影响得到补偿。
被平衡；由另一重量、力量或因素形成制衡。

collocations.en: was sprayed with a sulphurous insecticide
the disadvantage was offset by another advantage
collocations.zh: 这一劣势被另一项优势抵消

collocations.en: the weight was counterbalanced by another weight
collocations.zh: 这一重量由另一个重物平衡

formal.mt: Skont ir-reġistru agrikolu, id-dwieli tgħabbru b'insettiċida bil-kubrit.
formal.en: According to the agricultural record, the vines were sprayed with a sulphurous insecticide.
formal.zh: 根据农业作业记录，这些葡萄藤被喷施了含硫杀虫剂。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-piż fuq din in-naħa għadu akbar? Pawlu: Le, tgħabbar b'piż ieħor fuq in-naħa l-oħra.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is the weight on this side still greater? Pawlu: No, it was counterbalanced by another weight on the other side.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这一边还是更重吗？保罗：不是，另一边加的重物已经把它平衡了。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-piż fuq din in-naħa għadu akbar?
messages.mt_standard: Il-piż fuq din in-naħa għadu akbar?
messages.zh: 这一边还是更重吗？
messages.en: Is the weight on this side still greater?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, tgħabbar b'piż ieħor fuq in-naħa l-oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Le, tgħabbar b'piż ieħor fuq in-naħa l-oħra.
messages.zh: 不是，另一边加的重物已经把它平衡了。
messages.en: No, it was counterbalanced by another weight on the other side.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 tgħabbar 配两张学习卡：葡萄藤接受含硫药剂，以及天平得到平衡；分场景记住各义。

gloss_zh: 变得昏暗；变得模糊不清

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become dusky or to become obscured and difficult to see clearly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指光线变得昏暗，或景物受到遮蔽而难以看清。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir mudlam jew ma jibqax jidher ċar minħabba xi ħaġa li tgħattih.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得昏暗；光线逐渐暗下来。
被遮蔽而变得模糊不清；难以看清。

collocations.en: the landscape was obscured by fog

formal.mt: Lejn filgħaxija s-sema tgħabbex, u d-dettalji tal-pajsaġġ saru aktar diffiċli biex jingħarfu.
formal.en: Towards evening, the sky grew dusky, and the details of the landscape became harder to distinguish.
formal.zh: 临近傍晚，天空变得昏暗，景物的细节也更难辨认了。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għadek tara r-raħal minn hawn? Mark: Bilkemm; il-pajsaġġ tgħabbex biċ-ċpar.
colloquial.en: Nina: Can you still see the village from here? Mark: Barely; the landscape has been obscured by fog.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：从这里还能看见村子吗？马克：几乎看不见了，景色都被雾遮住了。

messages.speaker: Nina (同行朋友)
messages.zh: 从这里还能看见村子吗？
messages.en: Can you still see the village from here?

messages.speaker: Mark (同行朋友)
messages.zh: 几乎看不见了，景色都被雾遮住了。
messages.en: Barely; the landscape has been obscured by fog.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象给风景罩上一层灰纱：傍晚使它变暗，雾气使它看不清，两幅画面帮助记住 tgħabbex。

gloss_zh: 被转交；被传播或传递；被熨烫

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be passed on or transmitted, or, of clothing or fabric, to be ironed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指物品、消息等被转交、传递或传播；用于衣物、布料时，也可表示被熨烫。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikun mgħoddi lil ħaddieħor jew jiġi mxerred jew trażmess; dwar ħwejjeġ jew drapp, ikun mogħdi bil-ħadida.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被转交；被传给另一个人。
被传播或传递。
被熨烫，指衣服或布料等接受熨烫。

collocations.en: the document was passed on to the manager
the message was transmitted by telephone

formal.mt: Il-messaġġ tgħadda lill-membri kollha tat-tim qabel il-bidu tal-laqgħa.
formal.en: The message was passed on to all team members before the meeting began.
formal.zh: 会议开始前，消息已传达给所有团队成员。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Il-qmis tiegħi lesta? Omm: Iva, tgħaddiet u qiegħda mdendla fil-gwardarobba.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is my shirt ready? Mother: Yes, it has been ironed and is hanging in the wardrobe.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我的衬衫准备好了吗？妈妈：好了，已经熨过，挂在衣柜里了。

messages.speaker: Lara (女儿)
messages.zh: 我的衬衫准备好了吗？
messages.en: Is my shirt ready?

messages.speaker: Omm (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, tgħaddiet u qiegħda mdendla fil-gwardarobba.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, tgħaddiet u qiegħda mdendla fil-gwardarobba.
messages.zh: 好了，已经熨过，挂在衣柜里了。
messages.en: Yes, it has been ironed and is hanging in the wardrobe.

cognitive_memory_aid: 做两张情景卡记 tgħadda：消息被递给别人，衬衫被熨平；先看主语再判断词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become angry in response to something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指因某件事而生气，进入愤怒的情绪状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jirrabja jew jibda jħoss rabja minħabba xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 生气；发怒。

collocations.en: got angry because of the delay
got angry at the words he heard

formal.mt: Ir-resident tgħaddab meta sar jaf li l-ilment tiegħu ma kienx ġie eżaminat.
formal.en: The resident became angry when he learned that his complaint had not been examined.
formal.zh: 这位居民得知自己的投诉尚未得到审查时，生气了。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex tgħaddab Pawlu? Nina: Għax ħadd ma qallu li l-laqgħa kienet tħassret.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Pawlu get angry? Nina: Because nobody told him that the meeting had been cancelled.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗为什么生气了？妮娜：因为没人告诉他会议已经取消了。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 保罗为什么生气了？
messages.en: Why did Pawlu get angry?

messages.speaker: Nina (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax ħadd ma qallu li l-laqgħa kienet tħassret.
messages.mt_standard: Għax ħadd ma qallu li l-laqgħa kienet tħassret.
messages.zh: 因为没人告诉他会议已经取消了。
messages.en: Because nobody told him that the meeting had been cancelled.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象人物听到坏消息后眉头一皱、开始生气，把这一情绪变化与 tgħaddab 配对记忆。

gloss_zh: 变得骨瘦；瘦得骨头突出

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become thin enough for the bones to be prominent.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变得消瘦，以至于骨头明显突出。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir irqiq tant li l-għadam jibda jidher sew.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得骨瘦，骨头显露出来。

formal.mt: Il-kelb tgħaddam wara l-marda, u l-kustilji tiegħu bdew jidhru sew.
formal.en: The dog became bony after the illness, and its ribs became clearly visible.
formal.zh: 这只狗病后变得骨瘦，肋骨开始明显显露出来。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-qattus tgħaddam ħafna, hux? Mark: Iva, issa l-kustilji tiegħu jidhru sew.
colloquial.en: Maja: The cat has become very bony, hasn't it? Mark: Yes, its ribs are clearly visible now.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这只猫瘦得骨头都突出来了，是吧？马克：是啊，现在连肋骨都看得很清楚。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这只猫瘦得骨头都突出来了，是吧？
messages.en: The cat has become very bony, hasn't it?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, issa l-kustilji tiegħu jidhru sew.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, issa l-kustilji tiegħu jidhru sew.
messages.zh: 是啊，现在连肋骨都看得很清楚。
messages.en: Yes, its ribs are clearly visible now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词和一只逐渐消瘦、肋骨显露的小动物联系起来，记住重点是“变得骨瘦”的变化过程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To develop puddles as water collects on the ground or another surface.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 水在地面或其他表面聚集，形成一处或多处水洼。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jifforma għadajjar żgħar hekk kif l-ilma jinġabar fuq l-art jew fuq wiċċ ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 形成水洼，出现一滩滩积水。

formal.mt: Il-passaġġ tgħaddar wara x-xita qawwija, u l-ilma baqa' hemm għal diversi sigħat.
formal.en: Puddles formed on the path after the heavy rain, and the water remained there for several hours.
formal.zh: 大雨过后，小路上形成了水洼，积水数小时未退。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-passaġġ reġa' tgħaddar? Mark: Iva, hemm għadajjar żgħar kullimkien.
colloquial.en: Maja: Has the path developed puddles again? Mark: Yes, there are little puddles everywhere.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：小路上又积起水洼了吗？马克：是啊，到处都是小水洼。

messages.speaker: Maja (邻居)
messages.zh: 小路上又积起水洼了吗？
messages.en: Has the path developed puddles again?

messages.speaker: Mark (邻居)
messages.zh: 是啊，到处都是小水洼。
messages.en: Yes, there are little puddles everywhere.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象雨后小路上的水聚成一滩滩水洼，用“地面开始积水”的画面记住这个变化动词。

gloss_zh: 被浸入；被淹没；自己潜入水中

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be immersed in liquid, become submerged, or put oneself under the surface of water.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被浸入液体、没入水下，或主动使自己潜入水中。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddaħħal f'likwidu, jispiċċa taħt wiċċ l-ilma, jew jinżel hu stess taħt l-ilma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被浸入液体中。
被淹没，处于水面或液面以下。
使自己浸入液体中；自己潜入水中。

formal.mt: Il-kampjun tgħaddas kompletament fl-ilma qabel ma beda l-esperiment.
formal.en: The sample was completely immersed in water before the experiment began.
formal.zh: 实验开始前，样本被完全浸入水中。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Pawlu tgħaddas fil-baħar? Mark: Iva, niżel taħt l-ilma għal ftit sekondi.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did Pawlu immerse himself in the sea? Mark: Yes, he went underwater for a few seconds.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗潜到海水里了吗？马克：是啊，他潜到水下待了几秒钟。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗潜到海水里了吗？
messages.en: Did Pawlu immerse himself in the sea?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, niżel taħt l-ilma għal ftit sekondi.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, niżel taħt l-ilma għal ftit sekondi.
messages.zh: 是啊，他潜到水下待了几秒钟。
messages.en: Yes, he went underwater for a few seconds.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“水面上下”来记忆：物品被放入水中是浸入，被水覆盖是淹没，人主动下水则是自己潜入。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To receive punishment or corrective discipline for one's behaviour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因自己的行为而受到惩罚，或接受旨在纠正行为的管教。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħata kastig jew dixxiplina biex tiġi kkoreġuta l-imġiba tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 受到惩罚。
受到管教或纪律处分。

collocations.en: was punished for breaking the rules
was disciplined because of his behaviour
collocations.zh: 因自己的行为而受到管教

formal.mt: L-istudent tgħaddeb talli kiser ir-regoli tal-iskola ripetutament.
formal.en: The student was disciplined for repeatedly breaking the school rules.
formal.zh: 这名学生因屡次违反校规而受到纪律处分。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex tgħaddeb Pawlu? Mark: Għax reġa' kiser ir-regoli tal-logħba.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why was Pawlu punished? Mark: Because he broke the rules of the game again.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗为什么受罚了？马克：因为他又违反了游戏规则。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 保罗为什么受罚了？
messages.en: Why was Pawlu punished?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 因为他又违反了游戏规则。
messages.en: Because he broke the rules of the game again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把人物放在“接受处罚”的位置来记：他违反规则，随后受到惩罚或管教，重点落在受罚者身上。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To have its number or quantity determined by counting or estimation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 其数目或数量通过逐一清点或大致估算而被确定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġi stabbilit in-numru jew l-ammont tiegħu billi jingħadd jew jiġi stmat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被计数，被逐一清点。
被估算，其数量得到大致判断。

formal.mt: Il-materjal tgħadded biċċa biċċa qabel ma tqassam lill-parteċipanti.
formal.en: The material was counted piece by piece before being distributed to the participants.
formal.zh: 这些材料在分发给参与者之前，经过了逐件清点。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-materjal kollu tgħadded? Mark: Iva, hemm għoxrin biċċa b'kollox.
colloquial.en: Maja: Has all the material been counted? Mark: Yes, there are twenty pieces in total.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：材料都清点过了吗？马克：是的，总共二十件。

messages.speaker: Maja (活动组织者)
messages.zh: 材料都清点过了吗？
messages.en: Has all the material been counted?

messages.speaker: Mark (活动助手)
messages.zh: 是的，总共二十件。
messages.en: Yes, there are twenty pieces in total.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象桌上的材料正在被登记数量：逐件核对对应“被计数”，只给大概数目对应“被估算”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be made smooth, especially when describing a face.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被弄得平滑或光滑，尤其用于描述面部。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir lixx, speċjalment meta jkun qed jiġi deskritt wiċċ.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be smoothed (used especially of faces)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被弄平滑、被抚平，尤其用于面部。

collocations.zh: 雕像的面部被修整光滑

collocations.en: was smoothed with a fine tool
collocations.zh: 用精细工具修整得光滑

formal.mt: Wiċċ l-istatwa tgħaddel b'għodda fina biex il-wiċċ tal-ġebla jsir lixx.
formal.en: The statue's face was smoothed with a fine tool to make the stone surface smooth.
formal.zh: 雕像的面部用精细工具进行了修整，使石头表面变得光滑。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Wiċċ l-istatwa tgħaddel? Mark: Iva, issa hu lixx ħafna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Has the statue's face been smoothed? Mark: Yes, it is very smooth now.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：雕像的脸修光滑了吗？马克：是的，现在很光滑了。

messages.speaker: Maja (雕塑学员)
messages.zh: 雕像的脸修光滑了吗？
messages.en: Has the statue's face been smoothed?

messages.speaker: Mark (雕塑老师)
messages.zh: 是的，现在很光滑了。
messages.en: Yes, it is very smooth now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象雕像面部原本有粗糙痕迹，经过细细修整后变得光滑，用这个前后变化记住“被抚平”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be squeezed or compressed by someone's hand.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受到某人手部的捏挤或压握。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġi magħfus b'id xi ħadd.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be squeezed with sb.'s hand
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被某人用手捏挤或握压。

formal.mt: Il-frott tgħaffas f'id it-tifel, u ftit meraq niżel fuq il-mejda.
formal.en: The fruit was squeezed in the boy's hand, and a little juice dripped onto the table.
formal.zh: 水果被男孩握在手里挤压，少量果汁滴到了桌上。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-ħobż tgħaffas f'idek? Mark: Iva, għafastu bla ma ridt.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did the bread get squeezed in your hand? Mark: Yes, I squeezed it accidentally.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：面包被你握扁了吗？马克：是啊，我不小心把它捏扁了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 面包被你握扁了吗？
messages.en: Did the bread get squeezed in your hand?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 是啊，我不小心把它捏扁了。
messages.en: Yes, I squeezed it accidentally.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记忆时把一只手放进画面：软面包在手掌里被捏扁，突出“被人用手挤压”这个具体动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be crushed or squeezed by pressure, possibly losing its original shape.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受到压力而被压碎或挤压，可能因此失去原来的形状。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġi mgħaffeġ jew magħfus bil-pressjoni, u jista' jitlef il-forma oriġinali tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被压碎、压坏或压扁。
被挤压。

collocations.zh: 被挤压在两个箱子之间

formal.mt: Il-kartun tgħaffeġ taħt il-piż tal-kaxxi waqt it-trasport.
formal.en: The cardboard was crushed under the weight of the boxes during transport.
formal.zh: 运输过程中，纸板在箱子的重压下被压坏了。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-pakkett tgħaffeġ fil-borża? Mark: Iva, il-kotba kienu fuqu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did the package get crushed in the bag? Mark: Yes, the books were on top of it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：包裹在袋子里被压坏了吗？马克：是啊，书都压在它上面。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 包裹在袋子里被压坏了吗？
messages.en: Did the package get crushed in the bag?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 是啊，书都压在它上面。
messages.en: Yes, the books were on top of it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象包裹被一摞书压得变形：关注物品承受压力后的状态，就能记住“被压坏、被挤压”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be pressed with a finger.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受到手指的按压。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġi magħfus b'subgħa.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be pressed with a finger
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被手指按压。

collocations.en: the brush was pressed with a finger

formal.mt: Il-pinzell tgħaflas b'subgħa waqt it-tindif.
formal.en: The brush was pressed with a finger during cleaning.
formal.zh: 清洁过程中，刷子被手指按压了。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-pinzell tgħaflas b'subgħa? Mark: Iva, waqt li kont qed innaddfu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Was this brush pressed with a finger? Mark: Yes, while I was cleaning it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这把刷子被手指按过吗？马克：对，我清洁它的时候按过。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这把刷子被手指按过吗？
messages.en: Was this brush pressed with a finger?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, waqt li kont qed innaddfu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, waqt li kont qed innaddfu.
messages.zh: 对，我清洁它的时候按过。
messages.en: Yes, while I was cleaning it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一根手指按在刷子上，把这个词与“被指头按压”的画面一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: For water to be splashed, usually on the floor or ground.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指水被溅起或泼溅，通常发生在地板或地面上。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħad għall-ilma meta jitferrex biċ-ċafċif, ġeneralment fuq l-art.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be splashed (said of water, usually on the floor or ground)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被溅起或泼溅，指水，通常是在地板或地面上的水。

collocations.en: was splashed across the floor or ground
collocations.zh: 被溅洒在地板或地面上

formal.mt: L-ilma tgħafleġ mal-art meta t-tfal għaddew jiġru mill-għadira.
formal.en: The water was splashed across the ground when the children ran through the puddle.
formal.zh: 孩子们跑过水坑时，水被溅洒到地面上。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex l-art kollha mxarrba? Pawlu: L-ilma tgħafleġ meta għaddejt mill-għadira.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why is the whole floor wet? Pawlu: The water splashed when I walked through the puddle.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：为什么地板全湿了？保罗：我走过那摊积水时，水溅开了。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 为什么地板全湿了？
messages.en: Why is the whole floor wet?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.zh: 我走过那摊积水时，水溅开了。
messages.en: The water splashed when I walked through the puddle.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把注意力放在地上的水：脚一经过，水就被溅开；用这个画面记动词。

gloss_zh: 用手指按压的动作，尤指按刷子

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of pressing something with a finger, usually a brush.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用手指按压某物的动作，通常指按压刷子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed jagħfas xi ħaġa b'subgħa, ġeneralment pinzell.

sense_translations.en_definition: act of pressing with a finger (usually pressing a brush)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用手指按压的动作，通常指按压刷子。

collocations.en: pressing the brush with a finger
collocations.zh: 用手指按压刷子的动作

formal.mt: It-tgħaflis tal-pinzell b'subgħa jifrex il-lanżit tiegħu.
formal.en: Pressing the brush with a finger spreads its bristles.
formal.zh: 用手指按压刷子，会使刷毛散开。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif nifrex il-lanżit tal-pinzell? Rita: Bi ftit tgħaflis b'subgħa, bil-mod.
colloquial.en: Maja: How do I spread the brush's bristles? Rita: With a little gentle pressing with a finger.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：怎么把刷毛按开？丽塔：用手指轻轻按一按。

messages.speaker: Maja (绘画学员)
messages.zh: 怎么把刷毛按开？
messages.en: How do I spread the brush's bristles?

messages.speaker: Rita (绘画老师)
messages.zh: 用手指轻轻按一按。
messages.en: With a little gentle pressing with a finger.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住“一根手指按刷毛”的动作；这个词是名词，指按压这件事本身。

gloss_zh: 用脚踩溅地上水的动作

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of splashing water on the floor or ground with one's feet.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用脚把地板或地面上的水踩得溅起来的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed iferrex l-ilma ta' mal-art b'saqajh.

sense_translations.en_definition: act of splashing water on the floor or ground with one's feet
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用脚踩溅地板或地面上的水的动作。

collocations.en: splashing about in puddles with one's feet
collocations.zh: 在水坑里用脚踩水嬉溅

formal.mt: It-tgħafliġ tal-ilma bis-saqajn ħalla l-art madwar l-għadira kollha mxarrba.
formal.en: Splashing the water with their feet left all the ground around the puddle wet.
formal.zh: 用脚踩溅积水的动作弄湿了水坑周围的整片地面。

colloquial.mt: Omm: Biżżejjed tgħafliġ fl-għadira; qed ixxarrab iż-żraben! Ben: Tajjeb, issa noħroġ minnha.
colloquial.en: Mum: Enough splashing in the puddle with your feet; you're getting your shoes wet! Ben: Okay, I'll step out of it now.
colloquial.zh: 妈妈：别再在水坑里踩水了，鞋子都要湿了！本：好，我现在就出来。

messages.speaker: Omm (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Biżżejjed tgħafliġ fl-għadira; qed ixxarrab iż-żraben!
messages.mt_standard: Biżżejjed tgħafliġ fl-għadira; qed ixxarrab iż-żraben!
messages.zh: 别再在水坑里踩水了，鞋子都要湿了！
messages.en: Enough splashing in the puddle with your feet; you're getting your shoes wet!

messages.speaker: Ben (儿子)
messages.zh: 好，我现在就出来。
messages.en: Okay, I'll step out of it now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象孩子双脚踩进水坑；这里把“踩得水花四溅”这件事当作名词来记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be exhausted, with very little energy left.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 感到极度疲劳，几乎没有剩余精力。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikun għajjien ħafna u kważi bla saħħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 筋疲力尽；处于极度疲惫的状态。

formal.mt: Wara sigħat ta' xogħol fiżiku, il-ħaddiem tgħajja u kellu bżonn jistrieħ.
formal.en: After hours of physical work, the worker was exhausted and needed to rest.
formal.zh: 经过数小时的体力劳动，这名工人筋疲力尽，需要休息。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex Ben waqaf jimxi? Mark: Tgħajja wara t-telgħa; ejja nistrieħu ftit miegħu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did Ben stop walking? Mark: He was exhausted after the climb; let's rest with him for a bit.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：本为什么停下来不走了？马克：他爬完坡累坏了，我们陪他休息一会儿吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (同行朋友)
messages.zh: 本为什么停下来不走了？
messages.en: Why did Ben stop walking?

messages.speaker: Mark (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tgħajja wara t-telgħa; ejja nistrieħu ftit miegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Tgħajja wara t-telgħa; ejja nistrieħu ftit miegħu.
messages.zh: 他爬完坡累坏了，我们陪他休息一会儿吧。
messages.en: He was exhausted after the climb; let's rest with him for a bit.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象爬完长坡后坐下来喘气，把这个词记成“精力耗尽，累得需要休息”。

gloss_zh: 侮辱；用难听的称呼骂人

teaching_sense.en_definition: To insult someone, call them offensive names, or engage in insulting speech.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用言语侮辱别人、以难听的称呼骂人，或进行辱骂。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tinsulta lil xi ħadd, issejjaħlu b'ismijiet offensivi, jew toqgħod tgħid kliem ta' tgħajjir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 侮辱；以言语冒犯别人。
用难听或侮辱性的称呼骂某人。

sense_translations.en_definition: to indulge in the act of insulting
sense_translations.zh_definition: 进行辱骂；一味以言语侮辱别人。

collocations.en: to call other people offensive names
collocations.zh: 用侮辱性的称呼骂别人

formal.mt: Ma għandekx tgħajjar lil ħaddieħor b'ismijiet offensivi waqt diskussjoni.
formal.en: You should not call other people offensive names during a discussion.
formal.zh: 讨论时，你不应该用侮辱性的称呼骂别人。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Tista' tgħid li ma taqbilx mingħajr ma tgħajjar lil ħadd. Ben: Għandek raġun; se nispjega għaliex ma naqbilx.
colloquial.en: Maja: You can say you disagree without insulting anyone. Ben: You're right; I'll explain why I disagree.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你可以表达不同意见，不必辱骂任何人。本：你说得对，我会解释自己为什么不同意。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' tgħid li ma taqbilx mingħajr ma tgħajjar lil ħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Tista' tgħid li ma taqbilx mingħajr ma tgħajjar lil ħadd.
messages.zh: 你可以表达不同意见，不必辱骂任何人。
messages.en: You can say you disagree without insulting anyone.

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek raġun; se nispjega għaliex ma naqbilx.
messages.mt_standard: Għandek raġun; se nispjega għaliex ma naqbilx.
messages.zh: 你说得对，我会解释自己为什么不同意。
messages.en: You're right; I'll explain why I disagree.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“侮辱别人、用难听称呼骂人、不断辱骂”连成同一幅言语冲突的画面。

gloss_zh: 被喊出；被大声说出；被宣告

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be shouted, spoken loudly, or proclaimed so that others can hear.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指名字、话语或消息被喊出来、大声说出，或向众人宣告。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħad għal isem, kliem jew messaġġ li jingħad b'leħen għoli jew jitħabbar quddiem in-nies.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被喊出；被叫喊出来。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be spoken in a loud voice
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被大声说出。
被公开宣告；被宣布。

collocations.en: the message was spoken in a loud voice

formal.mt: Fi tmiem iċ-ċerimonja, l-isem tar-rebbieħ tgħajjat minn fuq il-palk biex kulħadd jisimgħu.
formal.en: At the end of the ceremony, the winner's name was shouted out from the stage so that everyone could hear it.
formal.zh: 仪式结束时，获胜者的名字从台上被大声喊出，让所有人都能听见。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'isem tgħajjat? Mark: L-isem ta' Sara; hi rebħet il-premju.
colloquial.en: Maja: What name was shouted out? Mark: Sara's name; she won the prize.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：刚才喊的是谁的名字？马克：萨拉的名字，她获奖了。

messages.speaker: Maja (观众)
messages.zh: 刚才喊的是谁的名字？
messages.en: What name was shouted out?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: L-isem ta' Sara; hi rebħet il-premju.
messages.mt_standard: L-isem ta' Sara; hi rebħet il-premju.
messages.zh: 萨拉的名字，她获奖了。
messages.en: Sara's name; she won the prize.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象颁奖台上传来响亮的名字，把这个词与“名字被喊出”的场景联系起来，并连带记住大声说出和公开宣告。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be made fun of or treated as the subject of mockery.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指某人成为取笑或嘲弄的对象。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħad għal xi ħadd li nies oħra jgħadduh biż-żmien jew jidħku bih.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被人取笑；受到嘲弄。

collocations.en: was made fun of in front of everyone
was made fun of because of his mistake
collocations.zh: 因为自己的错误而被嘲弄

formal.mt: L-istudent tgħajjeb minħabba żball fil-qari, u l-għalliema spjegat lill-klassi għaliex dan l-aġir iweġġa'.
formal.en: The student was made fun of because of a reading mistake, and the teacher explained to the class why this behaviour is hurtful.
formal.zh: 这名学生因朗读时出错而被取笑，老师向全班解释了这种行为为什么会伤害别人。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex telaq Pawlu? Mark: Tgħajjeb quddiem kulħadd u ħassu ħażin.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Pawlu leave? Mark: He was made fun of in front of everyone and felt upset.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗为什么走了？马克：他当着所有人的面被取笑了，心里很难受。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗为什么走了？
messages.en: Why did Pawlu leave?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tgħajjeb quddiem kulħadd u ħassu ħażin.
messages.mt_standard: Tgħajjeb quddiem kulħadd u ħassu ħażin.
messages.zh: 他当着所有人的面被取笑了，心里很难受。
messages.en: He was made fun of in front of everyone and felt upset.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把画面定格在被大家取笑的那个人身上：这个动词表示“被取笑”，记忆重点放在承受嘲弄的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be cursed or to become unlucky, as described in a story or belief.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指受到诅咒，或变得不走运；可用于故事情节或转述某种信念。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħad għal xi ħadd li ssir saħta fuqu jew li jsir sfortunat, pereżempju f'rakkont jew skont twemmin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被诅咒；受到诅咒。
变得不走运；开始遭遇厄运。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-vjaġġatur tgħajjen wara li fetaħ il-kaxxa, u minn dak il-ħin beda jiltaqa' ma' ħafna sfortuni.
formal.en: In the story, the traveller was cursed after opening the box, and from then on he began to encounter many misfortunes.
formal.zh: 故事中，旅行者打开箱子后受到了诅咒，从那时起便接连遭遇不幸。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex il-karattru beda jitlef kull logħba? Pawlu: Skont l-istorja, tgħajjen meta mess iċ-ċurkett.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did the character start losing every game? Pawlu: According to the story, he became unlucky when he touched the ring.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这个角色为什么开始每场游戏都输？保罗：按故事里的说法，他碰到戒指后就变得不走运了。

messages.speaker: Sara (读者)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex il-karattru beda jitlef kull logħba?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex il-karattru beda jitlef kull logħba?
messages.zh: 这个角色为什么开始每场游戏都输？
messages.en: Why did the character start losing every game?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Skont l-istorja, tgħajjen meta mess iċ-ċurkett.
messages.mt_standard: Skont l-istorja, tgħajjen meta mess iċ-ċurkett.
messages.zh: 按故事里的说法，他碰到戒指后就变得不走运了。
messages.en: According to the story, he became unlucky when he touched the ring.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用故事中的戒指串联两个义项：角色先“被诅咒”，随后“变得不走运”；这是记忆场景，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become jealous or resentful, for example because someone else receives attention or a reward.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指开始感到嫉妒或怨忿，例如因别人获得关注或奖励而心生不满。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jibda jħoss għira jew riżentiment, pereżempju għax xi ħadd ieħor jingħata attenzjoni jew premju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得嫉妒，或开始心怀怨忿。

collocations.en: became jealous of someone else's success
collocations.zh: 因别人的成功而心生嫉妒

collocations.en: became resentful when his friend won
collocations.zh: 朋友获胜时产生了怨忿

formal.mt: Meta ħabibu ngħata l-premju, Karlu tgħajjet għax ħass li x-xogħol tiegħu ma kienx ġie apprezzat.
formal.en: When his friend received the prize, Karlu became resentful because he felt that his own work had not been appreciated.
formal.zh: 朋友获奖时，卡尔鲁心生怨忿，因为他觉得自己的工作没有得到赏识。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Karlu ma feraħx lil sieħbu? Sara: Tgħajjet meta ra li sieħbu rebaħ il-premju.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why didn't Karlu congratulate his friend? Sara: He became jealous when he saw that his friend had won the prize.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：卡尔鲁为什么没有祝贺朋友？萨拉：看到朋友获奖，他心里嫉妒起来了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Karlu ma feraħx lil sieħbu?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Karlu ma feraħx lil sieħbu?
messages.zh: 卡尔鲁为什么没有祝贺朋友？
messages.en: Why didn't Karlu congratulate his friend?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tgħajjet meta ra li sieħbu rebaħ il-premju.
messages.mt_standard: Tgħajjet meta ra li sieħbu rebaħ il-premju.
messages.zh: 看到朋友获奖，他心里嫉妒起来了。
messages.en: He became jealous when he saw that his friend had won the prize.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象别人领奖时自己心里泛酸，把这个词记成“开始嫉妒或怨忿”；再留意结尾是 et，区别于 tgħajjat。

gloss_zh: 被维持生命；靠他人供养

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be kept alive or sustained through support provided by another person.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指生命得到维持，或依靠他人提供的生活支持而生存。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħad għal xi ħadd li jinżamm ħaj jew li jgħix bl-għajnuna u l-appoġġ ta' ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被维持生命；得到支持而继续活着。
由某人供养；依靠某人的支持维持生活。

collocations.en: was kept alive with food and water
was sustained by his sister's help
collocations.zh: 靠姐姐或妹妹的帮助维持生活

formal.mt: Matul ix-xhur li fihom ma setax jaħdem, ir-raġel tgħajjex bl-għajnuna ta' oħtu, li ħallsitlu l-kera u xtratlu l-ikel.
formal.en: During the months when he could not work, the man was sustained by his sister's help: she paid his rent and bought him food.
formal.zh: 在无法工作的那几个月里，这名男子靠姐妹的帮助维持生活；她替他付房租，并为他购买食物。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif għadda Pawlu dawk ix-xhur bla xogħol? Mark: Tgħajjex bl-għajnuna ta' oħtu sakemm sab xogħol ieħor.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did Pawlu get through those months without work? Mark: He was supported by his sister until he found another job.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗没工作的那几个月是怎么熬过来的？马克：他靠姐妹的帮助维持生活，直到找到另一份工作。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif għadda Pawlu dawk ix-xhur bla xogħol?
messages.mt_standard: Kif għadda Pawlu dawk ix-xhur bla xogħol?
messages.zh: 保罗没工作的那几个月是怎么熬过来的？
messages.en: How did Pawlu get through those months without work?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tgħajjex bl-għajnuna ta' oħtu sakemm sab xogħol ieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Tgħajjex bl-għajnuna ta' oħtu sakemm sab xogħol ieħor.
messages.zh: 他靠姐妹的帮助维持生活，直到找到另一份工作。
messages.en: He was supported by his sister until he found another job.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把食物、水和亲人的援助画成三只托住人的手，帮助记住“生命被维持”和“生活由别人支持”这两个相连的意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of making fun of someone or treating them as an object of ridicule.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指拿某人开嘲弄性玩笑、把对方当作笑柄的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tgħaddi lil xi ħadd biż-żmien jew tidħaq bih.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 嘲弄某人的行为；对某人的取笑。

collocations.en: mockery in front of other people
collocations.zh: 当着别人的面进行的嘲弄

formal.mt: It-tgħajjib tal-iżbalji ta' student jista' jnaqqas il-fiduċja tiegħu u jżommu milli jipparteċipa fil-klassi.
formal.en: Mocking a student's mistakes can reduce their confidence and discourage them from participating in class.
formal.zh: 取笑学生的错误可能削弱其自信，使其不愿参与课堂活动。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex ma tridx terġa' tilgħab magħhom? Pawlu: Minħabba t-tgħajjib; kull darba li niżbalja, jidħku bija.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why don't you want to play with them again? Pawlu: Because of the mockery; every time I make a mistake, they laugh at me.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你为什么不想再和他们玩了？保罗：因为他们总是取笑我，我每次一出错，他们就笑话我。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ma tridx terġa' tilgħab magħhom?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ma tridx terġa' tilgħab magħhom?
messages.zh: 你为什么不想再和他们玩了？
messages.en: Why don't you want to play with them again?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Minħabba t-tgħajjib; kull darba li niżbalja, jidħku bija.
messages.mt_standard: Minħabba t-tgħajjib; kull darba li niżbalja, jidħku bija.
messages.zh: 因为他们总是取笑我，我每次一出错，他们就笑话我。
messages.en: Because of the mockery; every time I make a mistake, they laugh at me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给“拿别人当笑柄”这段行为贴上名词标签 tgħajjib；与 tgħajjeb 对照时，一个记行为，一个记人被取笑。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Insulting speech or behaviour, including calling someone offensive names, or an individual insult.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指辱骂、用难听的称呼骂人的行为，也可指一句侮辱性言语。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kliem jew imġiba li biha toffendi lil xi ħadd, inkluż issejjaħlu b'ismijiet offensivi, jew offiża waħda bil-kliem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 侮辱或辱骂他人的行为。
用侮辱性的称呼骂人；给人起难听的外号进行攻击。
侮辱；一句辱骂或侮辱性言语。

formal.mt: Ir-regoli tal-iskola jipprojbixxu t-tgħajjir u t-theddid, u jħeġġu lill-istudenti jsolvu n-nuqqas ta' qbil b'rispett.
formal.en: The school rules prohibit name-calling and threats and encourage students to resolve disagreements respectfully.
formal.zh: 校规禁止辱骂和威胁，并鼓励学生以尊重彼此的方式解决分歧。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ħriġt mill-grupp? Mark: Kien hemm wisq tgħajjir; ma stajniex nitkellmu bil-kalma.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you leave the group? Mark: There was too much name-calling; we couldn't have a calm conversation.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么退群了？马克：里面骂人的话太多了，我们根本没法心平气和地说话。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么退群了？
messages.en: Why did you leave the group?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien hemm wisq tgħajjir; ma stajniex nitkellmu bil-kalma.
messages.mt_standard: Kien hemm wisq tgħajjir; ma stajniex nitkellmu bil-kalma.
messages.zh: 里面骂人的话太多了，我们根本没法心平气和地说话。
messages.en: There was too much name-calling; we couldn't have a calm conversation.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象群聊里连续出现攻击人的难听称呼，把 tgħajjir 与“辱骂、骂人、侮辱话”绑定，重点记住言语攻击的场景。

gloss_zh: 食物；滋养身体的食物；口粮

teaching_sense.en_definition: Food or provisions that nourish people and support their daily sustenance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指供人食用、提供营养并维持日常生活的食物或口粮。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikel jew provvisti tal-ikel li jagħtu n-nutriment u jsostnu l-ħajja ta' kuljum.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 食物；供人吃的东西。
营养；滋养身体的食物。
食品；口粮；储备或供应的食物。

collocations.zh: 足够一家人食用的食物

formal.mt: Qabel il-vjaġġ, il-familja ħejjiet biżżejjed tgħajjit għal jumejn u qassmitu f'kontenituri magħluqa.
formal.en: Before the journey, the family prepared enough food for two days and divided it among sealed containers.
formal.zh: 出发前，这家人准备了足够吃两天的食物，并把食物分装在密闭容器里。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Ħadna biżżejjed tgħajjit għall-vjaġġ? Pawlu: Iva, għandna ħobż, ġobon u frott għal kulħadd.
colloquial.en: Sara: Have we brought enough food for the journey? Pawlu: Yes, we have bread, cheese and fruit for everyone.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我们带够路上吃的东西了吗？保罗：够了，面包、奶酪和水果都有，每个人都有份。

messages.speaker: Sara (旅伴)
messages.zh: 我们带够路上吃的东西了吗？
messages.en: Have we brought enough food for the journey?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (旅伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għandna ħobż, ġobon u frott għal kulħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għandna ħobż, ġobon u frott għal kulħadd.
messages.zh: 够了，面包、奶酪和水果都有，每个人都有份。
messages.en: Yes, we have bread, cheese and fruit for everyone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tgħajjit 写在旅行食物袋上，袋里放面包、奶酪和水果；用具体食物串起“食物、滋养、口粮”三个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A very small amount of food or drink taken to discover its flavour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为了解食物或饮料的味道而尝的一小口，是 togħma 的指小形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ammont żgħir ħafna ta' ikel jew xorb li wieħed iduq biex jagħraf it-togħma tiegħu.

sense_translations.en_definition: small taste of sth. (the diminutive form of 'togħma')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 某种东西的一小口尝味；togħma 的指小形式。

collocations.en: a small taste of the soup

formal.mt: Qabel ma żied il-melħ, il-kok ħa tgħajma tas-soppa.
formal.en: Before adding salt, the cook had a small taste of the soup.
formal.zh: 加盐之前，厨师先尝了一小口汤。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Trid tgħajma tal-kejk? Pawlu: Iva, biċċa żgħira biss, grazzi.
colloquial.en: Lara: Would you like a small taste of the cake? Pawlu: Yes, just a little piece, thanks.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：想尝一小口蛋糕吗？保罗：好，只要一小块，谢谢。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 想尝一小口蛋糕吗？
messages.en: Would you like a small taste of the cake?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 好，只要一小块，谢谢。
messages.en: Yes, just a little piece, thanks.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象厨师只用小勺尝一口汤，把这个词和“少量尝味”的画面绑定；重点是尝味，不是吃完整份。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To look at oneself, for example in a mirror.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把目光投向自己，例如在镜子里查看或端详自己的样子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iħares lejh innifsu, pereżempju f'mera.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 看自己；查看或端详自己的样子。

collocations.en: looked at himself in the mirror
looked at himself before going out
collocations.zh: 出门前端详了一下自己

formal.mt: Qabel l-intervista, il-kandidat tgħajnas fil-mera biex jara jekk l-ingravata kinitx dritta.
formal.en: Before the interview, the candidate looked at himself in the mirror to check whether his tie was straight.
formal.zh: 面试前，应聘者照了照镜子，查看领带是否端正。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex dam daqshekk quddiem il-mera? Ġanni: Tgħajnas biex jara jekk il-qmis kinitx tidher sew.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why did he spend so long in front of the mirror? Ġanni: He looked at himself to see whether his shirt looked right.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：他为什么在镜子前待了那么久？詹尼：他在看自己，检查衬衫穿着是否合适。

messages.speaker: Marija (室友)
messages.zh: 他为什么在镜子前待了那么久？
messages.en: Why did he spend so long in front of the mirror?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tgħajnas biex jara jekk il-qmis kinitx tidher sew.
messages.mt_standard: Tgħajnas biex jara jekk il-qmis kinitx tidher sew.
messages.zh: 他在看自己，检查衬衫穿着是否合适。
messages.en: He looked at himself to see whether his shirt looked right.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“出门前照镜子整理衣服”作记忆场景，牢牢记住目光的对象是自己；与看别人的名词 tgħajnis 分开记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of looking at another person.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把目光投向某个人、观看或打量对方这一行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed iħares lejn persuna oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 看着某人；观看或打量他人的行为。

formal.mt: It-tgħajnis kontinwu lejn il-kelliem waqt il-laqgħa ġiegħlu jħossu skomdu.
formal.en: The continuous looking at the speaker during the meeting made him feel uncomfortable.
formal.zh: 会议期间，人们不断打量发言者，使他感到不自在。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dak ir-raġel baqa' jħares lejja l-ħin kollu. Rita: Iva, innutajt it-tgħajnis tiegħu wkoll.
colloquial.en: Nina: That man kept looking at me the whole time. Rita: Yes, I noticed him looking at you too.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：那个男人一直在看我。丽塔：是的，我也注意到他在打量你。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak ir-raġel baqa' jħares lejja l-ħin kollu.
messages.mt_standard: Dak ir-raġel baqa' jħares lejja l-ħin kollu.
messages.zh: 那个男人一直在看我。
messages.en: That man kept looking at me the whole time.

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 是的，我也注意到他在打量你。
messages.en: Yes, I noticed him looking at you too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它记成可以被人注意到的“打量行为”：有人看着来宾，旁人注意到这种目光；本词是名词，表示看人的行为。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become thick and resistant to flowing, or to become sticky.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 液体等变得黏稠、不易流动，或物质变得容易黏附、黏手。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir aktar oħxon u ma jiċċirkolax faċilment, jew jibda jeħel mal-affarijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得黏稠；流动性降低。
变得有黏性；开始黏手或黏附其他东西。

formal.mt: Wara li ntilef ftit mill-ilma waqt it-tisħin, il-ġulepp tgħakkar u beda jiċċirkola aktar bil-mod.
formal.en: After some water was lost during heating, the syrup became viscous and began to flow more slowly.
formal.zh: 加热过程中失去部分水分后，糖浆变得黏稠，流动也更慢了。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex il-mejda qed teħel ma' jdejja? Sara: Il-wiċċ tgħakkar għax waqa' ftit meraq fuqu.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why is the table sticking to my hands? Sara: The surface became sticky because some juice spilled on it.
colloquial.zh: 马克：桌子怎么黏我的手？萨拉：有些果汁洒在上面，表面就变黏了。

messages.speaker: Mark (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex il-mejda qed teħel ma' jdejja?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex il-mejda qed teħel ma' jdejja?
messages.zh: 桌子怎么黏我的手？
messages.en: Why is the table sticking to my hands?

messages.speaker: Sara (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-wiċċ tgħakkar għax waqa' ftit meraq fuqu.
messages.mt_standard: Il-wiċċ tgħakkar għax waqa' ftit meraq fuqu.
messages.zh: 有些果汁洒在上面，表面就变黏了。
messages.en: The surface became sticky because some juice spilled on it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅画面区分两个义项：糖浆倒得慢是“变黏稠”，桌面黏住手是“变黏”；共同记住这是状态发生变化。

gloss_zh: 年老体衰；随年岁增长而衰弱

teaching_sense.en_definition: To grow old and become physically weak or infirm.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 随着年龄增长而变老，身体也逐渐衰弱、行动或活动能力下降。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jixjieħ u jsir dgħajjef f'ġismu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得年老体衰；进入身体衰弱的老年状态。

collocations.en: grew old and infirm with age
collocations.zh: 随着年岁增长而变得衰弱

collocations.en: grew old and infirm over the years
collocations.zh: 在多年间逐渐年老体衰

formal.mt: Matul is-snin, is-Sur Borg tgħakkek u beda jkollu bżonn aktar għajnuna fl-attivitajiet ta' kuljum.
formal.en: Over the years, Mr Borg grew old and infirm and began to need more help with everyday activities.
formal.zh: 多年过去，博尔格先生逐渐年老体衰，日常活动也开始需要更多帮助。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Iz-ziju għadu jmur jixtri waħdu? Luqa: Dan l-aħħar tgħakkek, allura mmur miegħu biex ngħinu.
colloquial.en: Anna: Does your uncle still go shopping on his own? Luqa: He has grown old and infirm lately, so I go with him to help.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你叔叔还独自去买东西吗？卢卡：他近来年老体衰，所以我陪他去，帮帮他。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 你叔叔还独自去买东西吗？
messages.en: Does your uncle still go shopping on his own?

messages.speaker: Luqa (侄子)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan l-aħħar tgħakkek, allura mmur miegħu biex ngħinu.
messages.mt_standard: Dan l-aħħar tgħakkek, allura mmur miegħu biex ngħinu.
messages.zh: 他近来年老体衰，所以我陪他去，帮帮他。
messages.en: He has grown old and infirm lately, so I go with him to help.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“多年后走路需要人搀扶”作为学习画面，同时记住年老和体衰两层意思；不要只记成普通的疲劳。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Physical weakness or infirmity, or the process of growing old and declining with age.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体虚弱、功能衰弱的状态，也可指随着年龄增长而逐渐衰老的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dgħufija fiżika, jew il-proċess li wieħed jixjieħ u jonqsu s-saħħa u l-ħila.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 身体衰弱；体弱或身体功能减退的状态。
衰老；随着年龄增长而发生的逐渐衰退。

collocations.zh: 身体衰弱或衰老的迹象

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi t-tgħakkik marbut mal-età u l-għajnuna meħtieġa għall-attivitajiet ta' kuljum.
formal.en: The report describes age-related decline and the assistance needed for everyday activities.
formal.zh: 报告描述了与年龄有关的衰退，以及日常活动所需的帮助。

colloquial.mt: Marija: In-nannu qed isib it-taraġ aktar diffiċli? Toni: Iva, it-tgħakkik qed jagħmillu t-tlugħ aktar iebes, u nitilgħu miegħu.
colloquial.en: Marija: Is Grandad finding the stairs more difficult? Toni: Yes, his infirmity is making the climb harder, and we go up with him.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：爷爷爬楼梯越来越吃力了吗？托尼：是的，身体衰弱让他上楼更费劲，我们会陪他一起上去。

messages.speaker: Marija (孙女)
messages.mt_spoken: In-nannu qed isib it-taraġ aktar diffiċli?
messages.mt_standard: In-nannu qed isib it-taraġ aktar diffiċli?
messages.zh: 爷爷爬楼梯越来越吃力了吗？
messages.en: Is Grandad finding the stairs more difficult?

messages.speaker: Toni (孙子)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, it-tgħakkik qed jagħmillu t-tlugħ aktar iebes, u nitilgħu miegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, it-tgħakkik qed jagħmillu t-tlugħ aktar iebes, u nitilgħu miegħu.
messages.zh: 是的，身体衰弱让他上楼更费劲，我们会陪他一起上去。
messages.en: Yes, his infirmity is making the climb harder, and we go up with him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它放在“衰弱的迹象”这个名词短语里记忆：既能说体弱的状态，也能说衰老的过程；与动词 tgħakkek 配对复习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To linger without moving on, to delay doing something, or to move or act very slowly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 逗留闲逛而不继续前进，拖着不做某事，或走路、做事非常缓慢。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Idum f'post bla ma jibqa' sejjer, idum biex jagħmel xi ħaġa, jew jimxi jew jaġixxi bil-mod ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 闲逛；在某处逗留、磨蹭而不离开。
拖延；迟迟不开始、完成或继续某事。
行动非常缓慢；走路或做事很慢。

formal.mt: Il-parteċipant tgħakrek biex jitlaq mill-lukanda u wasal wara l-bidu tal-laqgħa.
formal.en: The participant was slow to leave the hotel and arrived after the meeting had begun.
formal.zh: 这名与会者迟迟没有离开酒店，抵达时会议已经开始。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għaliex wasal tard Pawlu? Mark: Tgħakrek fit-triq u waqaf quddiem kull vetrina.
colloquial.en: Rita: Why did Pawlu arrive late? Mark: He dawdled along the street and stopped at every shop window.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：保罗为什么迟到了？马克：他在街上磨磨蹭蹭，每个橱窗前都要停一下。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗为什么迟到了？
messages.en: Why did Pawlu arrive late?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tgħakrek fit-triq u waqaf quddiem kull vetrina.
messages.mt_standard: Tgħakrek fit-triq u waqaf quddiem kull vetrina.
messages.zh: 他在街上磨磨蹭蹭，每个橱窗前都要停一下。
messages.en: He dawdled along the street and stopped at every shop window.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象赶时间的人却每到橱窗就停下：停留是闲逛，迟迟不走是拖延，步子慢是行动缓慢；三个义项连成同一场景。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of walking slowly, lingering without moving on, or delaying something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 缓慢行走、逗留闲逛或拖延某事的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed jimxi bil-mod, idum f'post bla ma jibqa' sejjer, jew idum biex jagħmel xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 慢行；缓慢行走的行为。
闲逛；逗留、磨蹭而不继续前进的行为。
拖延；使事情迟迟不能开始、完成或继续的行为。

formal.mt: It-tgħakrik bla bżonn fil-bidu tax-xogħol wassal biex il-proġett ma tlestiex fil-ħin.
formal.en: Unnecessary delaying at the start of the work meant that the project was not completed on time.
formal.zh: 工作开始时不必要的拖延，导致项目未能按时完成。

colloquial.mt: Luqa: Għadna 'l bogħod mid-dar? Sara: Le, imma b'dan it-tgħakrik fit-triq se ndumu aktar milli ħsibna.
colloquial.en: Luqa: Are we still far from home? Sara: No, but with all this dawdling along the street, we will take longer than we thought.
colloquial.zh: 卢卡：我们离家还远吗？萨拉：不远，但照这样在街上磨蹭，我们会比原先想的花更长时间。

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们离家还远吗？
messages.en: Are we still far from home?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, imma b'dan it-tgħakrik fit-triq se ndumu aktar milli ħsibna.
messages.mt_standard: Le, imma b'dan it-tgħakrik fit-triq se ndumu aktar milli ħsibna.
messages.zh: 不远，但照这样在街上磨蹭，我们会比原先想的花更长时间。
messages.en: No, but with all this dawdling along the street, we will take longer than we thought.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“这种磨蹭耽误了时间”作为记忆句：本词给慢行、闲逛和拖延这些行为命名；与表示动作的 tgħakrek 对照记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: For a price or cost to rise or be increased.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指价格或费用上涨，或被提高。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Meta prezz jew spiża jogħla jew jiżdied.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be raised (usually used for prices)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被提高；通常指价格上涨。

collocations.en: The price of bread went up.

formal.mt: Skont ir-rapport, il-prezz tal-ħobż tgħalla matul ix-xahar li għadda.
formal.en: According to the report, the price of bread rose during the past month.
formal.zh: 根据报告，面包的价格在过去一个月里上涨了。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-prezz tal-ħobż reġa' tgħalla? Mark: Iva, illum ħallast aktar mis-soltu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Has the price of bread gone up again? Mark: Yes, I paid more than usual today.
colloquial.zh: Maja：面包又涨价了吗？Mark：是啊，我今天付的钱比平时多。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 面包又涨价了吗？
messages.en: Has the price of bread gone up again?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 是啊，我今天付的钱比平时多。
messages.en: Yes, I paid more than usual today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词放进“面包价格往上走”的画面里记：主角是价格，变化是上涨。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To take one's own life by hanging.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指通过上吊结束自己的生命，即自缢。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Itemm ħajtu billi jdendel lilu nnifsu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 上吊自杀；自缢。

collocations.en: a man who took his own life by hanging
the news that he had taken his own life by hanging

formal.mt: Ir-rapport qal li r-raġel tgħallaq u semma l-appoġġ mogħti lill-familja tiegħu.
formal.en: The report stated that the man had taken his own life by hanging and mentioned the support provided to his family.
formal.zh: 报告指出，该男子自缢身亡，并提到了向其家人提供的支持。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Qrajt l-aħbar li dak ir-raġel tgħallaq? Mark: Iva, kienet aħbar ta' niket. Nispera li l-familja tiegħu qed issib l-appoġġ li għandha bżonn.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you read the news that that man took his own life by hanging? Mark: Yes, it was sad news. I hope his family is getting the support they need.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你看到那名男子自缢身亡的消息了吗？Mark：看到了，真让人难过。希望他的家人能得到所需的支持。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qrajt l-aħbar li dak ir-raġel tgħallaq?
messages.mt_standard: Qrajt l-aħbar li dak ir-raġel tgħallaq?
messages.zh: 你看到那名男子自缢身亡的消息了吗？
messages.en: Did you read the news that that man took his own life by hanging?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kienet aħbar ta' niket. Nispera li l-familja tiegħu qed issib l-appoġġ li għandha bżonn.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kienet aħbar ta' niket. Nispera li l-familja tiegħu qed issib l-appoġġ li għandha bżonn.
messages.zh: 看到了，真让人难过。希望他的家人能得到所需的支持。
messages.en: Yes, it was sad news. I hope his family is getting the support they need.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用中文关键词“自缢”建立直接对应，记住动作指向本人；适合在严肃叙述中识别。

gloss_zh: 强迫自己减重；变得消瘦

teaching_sense.en_definition: To force oneself to lose weight, or to become skinny.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指强迫自己减轻体重，也可指身体变得消瘦。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġiegħel lilu nnifsu jitlef il-piż, jew isir irqiq ħafna.

sense_translations.en_definition: to force oneself to lose weight
sense_translations.zh_definition: 强迫自己减轻体重。
变得很瘦；变得消瘦。

collocations.en: he deliberately forced himself to lose weight
he became skinny after the illness

formal.mt: Fir-rapport, it-tabib innota li l-pazjent tgħalleb wara l-marda.
formal.en: In the report, the doctor noted that the patient had become skinny after the illness.
formal.zh: 医生在报告中指出，患者在生病后变得消瘦。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Pawlu tgħalleb ħafna dan l-aħħar. Mark: Iva, qalli li kien qed iġiegħel lilu nnifsu jitlef il-piż.
colloquial.en: Maja: Pawlu has become very skinny lately. Mark: Yes, he told me he had been forcing himself to lose weight.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Pawlu最近瘦了很多。Mark：是啊，他告诉我，他一直在强迫自己减重。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: Pawlu最近瘦了很多。
messages.en: Pawlu has become very skinny lately.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qalli li kien qed iġiegħel lilu nnifsu jitlef il-piż.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qalli li kien qed iġiegħel lilu nnifsu jitlef il-piż.
messages.zh: 是啊，他告诉我，他一直在强迫自己减重。
messages.en: Yes, he told me he had been forcing himself to lose weight.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“体重往下、身形变瘦”串起两个义项，再看上下文区分刻意强迫减重和变得消瘦。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become sticky, so that something begins to cling to a surface or to the fingers.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变得有黏性，开始容易黏在表面或手指上。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir iwaħħal, b'mod li jibda jeħel mal-uċuħ jew mas-swaba'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变黏；变得具有黏性。

collocations.en: The surface of the table became sticky.

formal.mt: Wara li nxtered il-ġulepp, il-wiċċ tal-mejda tgħallek u kellu jitnaddaf.
formal.en: After the syrup spilled, the surface of the table became sticky and had to be cleaned.
formal.zh: 糖浆洒出后，桌面变得黏糊糊的，需要清理。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-wiċċ tal-mejda tgħallek; waqa' xi ġulepp fuqu? Mark: Iva, se nimsaħha issa.
colloquial.en: Maja: The table surface has become sticky; did some syrup spill on it? Mark: Yes, I'll wipe it now.
colloquial.zh: Maja：桌面变黏了，是不是有糖浆洒在上面？Mark：是的，我现在就擦。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-wiċċ tal-mejda tgħallek; waqa' xi ġulepp fuqu?
messages.mt_standard: Il-wiċċ tal-mejda tgħallek; waqa' xi ġulepp fuqu?
messages.zh: 桌面变黏了，是不是有糖浆洒在上面？
messages.en: The table surface has become sticky; did some syrup spill on it?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 是的，我现在就擦。
messages.en: Yes, I'll wipe it now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象糖浆洒在桌上，手指碰一下就发黏；用这段触觉画面记住“变黏”的变化。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To grow physically feeble or to lose energy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指身体逐渐衰弱，或精力、体力减少。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir dgħajjef jew jitlef l-enerġija u s-saħħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 逐渐变得衰弱；身体变虚弱。
失去精力；体力减退。

collocations.en: he grew feeble after a long illness
collocations.zh: 他久病后身体变得衰弱

collocations.en: he lost energy after a day's work
collocations.zh: 他工作一天后没了精力

formal.mt: Wara marda twila, il-pazjent tgħallel u kellu bżonn aktar għajnuna fl-attivitajiet ta' kuljum.
formal.en: After a long illness, the patient grew feeble and needed more help with daily activities.
formal.zh: 患者久病后身体衰弱，在日常活动中需要更多帮助。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mark tgħallel wara ġurnata xogħol. Pawlu: Iva, m'għadx fadallu saħħa biex joħroġ magħna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Mark has lost his energy after a day's work. Pawlu: Yes, he has no energy left to go out with us.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Mark工作一天后没什么精力了。Pawlu：是啊，他已经没力气跟我们出去了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: Mark工作一天后没什么精力了。
messages.en: Mark has lost his energy after a day's work.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, m'għadx fadallu saħħa biex joħroġ magħna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, m'għadx fadallu saħħa biex joħroġ magħna.
messages.zh: 是啊，他已经没力气跟我们出去了。
messages.en: Yes, he has no energy left to go out with us.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把身体想成电量下降的电池：长期可以是衰弱，当下也可以是精力耗尽，两个义项都围绕力量减少。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of making a mistake, for example when calculating or writing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指犯错误这一行为，例如计算或书写时出错。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed jagħmel żball, pereżempju waqt kalkolu jew fil-kitba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 犯错误的行为；出错。

collocations.en: making a mistake in a calculation

formal.mt: It-tgħallit fil-kalkolu wassal għal total żbaljat fir-rapport.
formal.en: The act of making a mistake in the calculation led to an incorrect total in the report.
formal.zh: 计算时出错，导致报告中的总数有误。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan it-total mhux sew. Mark: Għandek raġun; kien hemm tgħallit fil-kalkolu. Se nerġa' nagħmlu.
colloquial.en: Maja: This total isn't right. Mark: You're right; there was a mistake in the calculation. I'll do it again.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这个总数不对。Mark：你说得对，计算时出了错。我重新算一遍。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 这个总数不对。
messages.en: This total isn't right.

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek raġun; kien hemm tgħallit fil-kalkolu. Se nerġa' nagħmlu.
messages.mt_standard: Għandek raġun; kien hemm tgħallit fil-kalkolu. Se nerġa' nagħmlu.
messages.zh: 你说得对，计算时出了错。我重新算一遍。
messages.en: You're right; there was a mistake in the calculation. I'll do it again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“算错了这一下”整体装进名词盒子：这个词指犯错的行为，学习时连同“计算中、书写中”一起记。

gloss_zh: 被遮住，尤指眼睛；天空转阴

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become covered, especially over the eyes, or for the sky to become overcast.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指被遮住，尤其是眼睛被蒙住；也指天空被云遮蔽而转阴。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinkesa jew jitgħatta, speċjalment fuq l-għajnejn; dwar is-sema, jimtela bis-sħab.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be covered (used especially of one's eyes)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被遮住、被蒙住，尤其指眼睛。
天空被云遮蔽；转为阴天。

collocations.en: his eyes were covered with a cloth band
collocations.zh: 他的眼睛被布带蒙住了

collocations.en: the sky became overcast with clouds
collocations.zh: 天空被云层遮蔽，转阴了

formal.mt: Is-sema tgħammad bis-sħab qabel ma bdiet ix-xita.
formal.en: The sky became overcast with clouds before the rain began.
formal.zh: 下雨之前，天空被云层遮蔽，转为阴天。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex għajnejn Pawlu tgħammdu b'faxxa? Mark: Għax fil-logħba jrid jagħraf l-oġġetti billi jmisshom.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why were Pawlu's eyes covered with a cloth band? Mark: Because in the game he has to identify objects by touching them.
colloquial.zh: Maja：为什么用布带蒙住了Pawlu的眼睛？Mark：因为游戏要求他靠触摸辨认物品。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 为什么用布带蒙住了Pawlu的眼睛？
messages.en: Why were Pawlu's eyes covered with a cloth band?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax fil-logħba jrid jagħraf l-oġġetti billi jmisshom.
messages.mt_standard: Għax fil-logħba jrid jagħraf l-oġġetti billi jmisshom.
messages.zh: 因为游戏要求他靠触摸辨认物品。
messages.en: Because in the game he has to identify objects by touching them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 并排想象两幅画面：布带遮住眼睛，云层遮住天空；用“被遮住”的共同画面连接两个义项。

gloss_zh: 有人居住；配有家具；配备设备；受孕

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become inhabited, furnished, or equipped; also, to be impregnated.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指地方开始有人居住，或被布置家具、配备设备；另可指受孕。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jintuża għal post li jibda jgħix fih xi ħadd jew li jingħata għamara jew tagħmir; jista' jfisser ukoll li femmina tinqabad tqila.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有人居住；成为有人居住的地方。
被布置家具；配有家具。
被配备器材、设备或所需用品。
受孕；被使之怀孕。

collocations.zh: 这栋建筑重新有人居住了

collocations.en: the apartment was furnished with the necessary furniture
collocations.zh: 公寓配上了所需的家具

collocations.en: the laboratory was equipped with new apparatus

formal.mt: Qabel il-ftuħ, il-laboratorju tgħammar b'apparat ġdid għall-kejl.
formal.en: Before opening, the laboratory was equipped with new measuring apparatus.
formal.zh: 开放之前，实验室配备了新的测量仪器。

colloquial.mt: Maja: L-appartament il-ġdid diġà tgħammar? Mark: Iva, issa għandu l-għamara kollha li għandna bżonn. Nistgħu nidħlu noqogħdu fih.
colloquial.en: Maja: Has the new apartment been furnished yet? Mark: Yes, it now has all the furniture we need. We can move in.
colloquial.zh: Maja：新公寓已经配好家具了吗？Mark：是的，现在我们需要的家具都有了，可以搬进去住了。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 新公寓已经配好家具了吗？
messages.en: Has the new apartment been furnished yet?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, issa għandu l-għamara kollha li għandna bżonn. Nistgħu nidħlu noqogħdu fih.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, issa għandu l-għamara kollha li għandna bżonn. Nistgħu nidħlu noqogħdu fih.
messages.zh: 是的，现在我们需要的家具都有了，可以搬进去住了。
messages.en: Yes, it now has all the furniture we need. We can move in.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按主语和搭配分格记忆：建筑看是否有人住，公寓看家具，实验室看设备；遇到生殖语境则单独记作“受孕”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To receive baptism as a religious ceremony.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 接受洗礼这一宗教仪式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jirċievi s-sagrament tal-magħmudija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 受洗；接受洗礼。

collocations.en: was baptized when he was a baby

formal.mt: Skont ir-reġistru tal-parroċċa, it-tifel tgħammed fil-knisja tar-raħal.
formal.en: According to the parish register, the boy was baptized in the village church.
formal.zh: 根据堂区登记簿，这个男孩在村里的教堂接受了洗礼。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Fejn tgħammed ħuk? Pawlu: Fil-knisja tar-raħal, meta kien tarbija.
colloquial.en: Marija: Where was your brother baptized? Pawlu: In the village church, when he was a baby.
colloquial.zh: Marija：你兄弟在哪里受洗的？Pawlu：在村里的教堂，那时他还是婴儿。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 你兄弟在哪里受洗的？
messages.en: Where was your brother baptized?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 在村里的教堂，那时他还是婴儿。
messages.en: In the village church, when he was a baby.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词与教堂洗礼的画面一起记：句中的人接受洗礼，中文对应“受洗”。

gloss_zh: 变得模糊不清；变得阴云密布或浑浊

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become unclear or difficult to understand, or to become cloudy rather than clear.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变得不清楚、难以理解；也指天空转为多云或液体变得浑浊。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir mhux ċar jew diffiċli biex jinftiehem; jew isir imsaħħab jew imċajpar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得模糊不清或晦涩难懂。
变得多云、阴沉，或由清澈变为浑浊。

formal.mt: Wara li tneħħiet is-sentenza introduttorja, it-tifsir tal-paragrafu tgħammem.
formal.en: After the introductory sentence was removed, the meaning of the paragraph became obscure.
formal.zh: 删去引导句后，这一段的含义变得晦涩不清。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dalgħodu kien hemm ix-xemx. Mark: Iva, imma issa s-sema tgħammem. Nieħu umbrella miegħi.
colloquial.en: Lara: It was sunny this morning. Mark: Yes, but now the sky has become cloudy. I'll take an umbrella with me.
colloquial.zh: Lara：今天早上还是晴天。Mark：是啊，不过现在天阴了。我带把伞。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 今天早上还是晴天。
messages.en: It was sunny this morning.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma issa s-sema tgħammem. Nieħu umbrella miegħi.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma issa s-sema tgħammem. Nieħu umbrella miegħi.
messages.zh: 是啊，不过现在天阴了。我带把伞。
messages.en: Yes, but now the sky has become cloudy. I'll take an umbrella with me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“清楚变不清楚”串起两个义项：意思像蒙了雾，天空像盖了云；这是学习联想。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be made deeper, in physical depth or in the extent of something such as understanding.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 深度被增加；既可指沟渠等被挖深，也可指理解等得到加深。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir aktar fond, kemm f'sens fiżiku kif ukoll f'sens figurattiv, bħal meta jiżdied il-fehim.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被加深；深度或程度得到增加。

formal.mt: Il-kanal tgħammeq waqt ix-xogħlijiet ta' manutenzjoni biex l-ilma jkun jista' jgħaddi aktar faċilment.
formal.en: The channel was deepened during maintenance work so that water could flow more easily.
formal.zh: 维护施工期间，水道被加深，以便水流更加顺畅。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Il-kanal jidher aktar fond minn qabel. Toni: Iva, tgħammeq waqt ix-xogħol tal-ġimgħa li għaddiet.
colloquial.en: Nina: The channel looks deeper than before. Toni: Yes, it was deepened during last week's work.
colloquial.zh: Nina：这条水道看起来比以前深了。Toni：是的，上周施工时把它加深了。

messages.speaker: Nina (居民)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kanal jidher aktar fond minn qabel.
messages.mt_standard: Il-kanal jidher aktar fond minn qabel.
messages.zh: 这条水道看起来比以前深了。
messages.en: The channel looks deeper than before.

messages.speaker: Toni (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, tgħammeq waqt ix-xogħol tal-ġimgħa li għaddiet.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, tgħammeq waqt ix-xogħol tal-ġimgħa li għaddiet.
messages.zh: 是的，上周施工时把它加深了。
messages.en: Yes, it was deepened during last week's work.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象水道底部被挖得更低，水道就“被加深”；再把这个画面迁移到理解加深。

gloss_zh: 开始身体欠佳，开始健康不佳

teaching_sense.en_definition: To begin to experience poor health or to start becoming unwell.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 开始出现身体不适，健康状况开始变差。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jibda jħossu ma jiflaħx jew jibda jbati minn saħħa ħażina.

sense_translations.en_definition: to begin to suffer ill health
sense_translations.zh_definition: 开始身体欠佳；开始出现健康不良的状况。

collocations.en: began to suffer ill health recently
began to feel unwell after the journey

formal.mt: Skont ir-rakkont tiegħu, Pawlu tgħammes ftit wara li rritorna mill-vjaġġ.
formal.en: According to his account, Pawlu began to suffer ill health shortly after returning from the journey.
formal.zh: 据他本人叙述，Pawlu在旅行归来后不久开始身体欠佳。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Kif inhu ħuk? Samwel: Tgħammes dan l-aħħar, u llum baqa' d-dar biex jistrieħ.
colloquial.en: Rita: How is your brother? Samwel: He started feeling unwell recently, and today he stayed home to rest.
colloquial.zh: Rita：你兄弟最近怎么样？Samwel：他最近开始身体不舒服，今天留在家里休息。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 你兄弟最近怎么样？
messages.en: How is your brother?

messages.speaker: Samwel (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tgħammes dan l-aħħar, u llum baqa' d-dar biex jistrieħ.
messages.mt_standard: Tgħammes dan l-aħħar, u llum baqa' d-dar biex jistrieħ.
messages.zh: 他最近开始身体不舒服，今天留在家里休息。
messages.en: He started feeling unwell recently, and today he stayed home to rest.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把重点放在“开始”：原先身体尚好，后来开始不舒服；这个词记的是健康转差的起点。

gloss_zh: 被强光晃眼；因强光眯起眼睛

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be dazzled by bright light or to narrow one's eyes because the light is too strong.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受到强光刺激而眼花，或因为光线太强而眯起眼睛。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jintlaqat minn dawl qawwi li jfixkillu l-vista, jew idejjaq għajnejh minħabba d-dawl.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被强光晃得眼花，暂时看不清楚。

sense_translations.en_definition: to have one's eyes narrowed due to bright light
sense_translations.zh_definition: 由于光线强烈而眯起眼睛。

collocations.en: was dazzled by the car's lights

formal.mt: Meta ħareġ mill-bini mudlam, il-viżitatur tgħammex bid-dawl qawwi tax-xemx.
formal.en: When he left the dark building, the visitor was dazzled by the bright sunlight.
formal.zh: 走出昏暗的建筑时，参观者被强烈的阳光晃了眼。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex Mark għalaq għajnejh hekk? Ġanni: Tgħammex bix-xemx. Se nsibu post fid-dell.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did Mark close his eyes like that? Ġanni: The sun dazzled him. We'll find a spot in the shade.
colloquial.zh: Lara：Mark怎么那样闭起眼睛了？Ġanni：他被太阳晃了眼。我们找个阴凉的地方吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: Mark怎么那样闭起眼睛了？
messages.en: Why did Mark close his eyes like that?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tgħammex bix-xemx. Se nsibu post fid-dell.
messages.mt_standard: Tgħammex bix-xemx. Se nsibu post fid-dell.
messages.zh: 他被太阳晃了眼。我们找个阴凉的地方吧。
messages.en: The sun dazzled him. We'll find a spot in the shade.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象从暗处走到烈日下，眼前一亮便眯眼：用“强光刺激”连接两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To receive a wink from another person, for example as a playful or discreet signal.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 有人向自己眨眼示意，例如传递玩笑或不便明说的信号。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikun ir-riċevitur ta' għamża mingħand persuna oħra, pereżempju bħala sinjal ta' ċajta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被别人眨眼示意；成为别人递眼色的对象。

collocations.en: was winked at by a friend
was winked at during the conversation
collocations.zh: 交谈时有人向他递眼色

formal.mt: Matul il-laqgħa, Mark tgħammeż minn kollega biex jifhem li l-kumment kien ċajta.
formal.en: During the meeting, Mark was winked at by a colleague to let him know that the comment was a joke.
formal.zh: 会议期间，一位同事向Mark眨眼示意，让他明白那句话是在开玩笑。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kif induna Mark li kienet ċajta? Lara: Tgħammeż minn Pawlu, u mill-ewwel fehem.
colloquial.en: Nina: How did Mark realize it was a joke? Lara: Pawlu winked at him, and he understood straight away.
colloquial.zh: Nina：Mark怎么知道那是在开玩笑？Lara：Pawlu向他眨了眨眼，他马上就明白了。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif induna Mark li kienet ċajta?
messages.mt_standard: Kif induna Mark li kienet ċajta?
messages.zh: Mark怎么知道那是在开玩笑？
messages.en: How did Mark realize it was a joke?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tgħammeż minn Pawlu, u mill-ewwel fehem.
messages.mt_standard: Tgħammeż minn Pawlu, u mill-ewwel fehem.
messages.zh: Pawlu向他眨了眨眼，他马上就明白了。
messages.en: Pawlu winked at him, and he understood straight away.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象朋友隔着桌子向你递眼色：你是收到眨眼信号的人。与因强光眯眼的词分开记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be performed by singing, as a song, hymn, or other vocal piece.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以歌唱的方式被唱出或演唱，主语可以是歌曲、赞美诗等。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġi esegwit bil-kant, bħal innu jew biċċa mużika vokali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被唱出；被演唱。

collocations.en: the hymn was sung by the choir

formal.mt: L-innu tgħanna mill-kor tal-iskola fil-ftuħ taċ-ċerimonja.
formal.en: The hymn was sung by the school choir at the opening of the ceremony.
formal.zh: 仪式开始时，学校合唱团演唱了这首赞美诗。

colloquial.mt: Marta: L-innu tgħanna llum? Ben: Iva, tgħanna mill-kor qabel id-diskors.
colloquial.en: Marta: Was the hymn sung today? Ben: Yes, it was sung by the choir before the speech.
colloquial.zh: Marta：今天唱那首赞美诗了吗？Ben：唱了，合唱团在讲话前演唱的。

messages.speaker: Marta (学生)
messages.zh: 今天唱那首赞美诗了吗？
messages.en: Was the hymn sung today?

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.zh: 唱了，合唱团在讲话前演唱的。
messages.en: Yes, it was sung by the choir before the speech.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把镜头对准歌本上的一首歌：歌被大家唱出来。记住此处主语是被演唱的内容。

gloss_zh: 相互拥抱；紧紧依偎或抱住

teaching_sense.en_definition: To embrace another person mutually, or to hold oneself tightly against someone or something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与别人相互拥抱；也指使自己紧贴并抱住某个人或某个物体。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jgħannaq lil persuna oħra u jiġi mgħannaq minnha, jew iżomm ruħu magħfus ma' xi ħadd jew ma' xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 相互拥抱；彼此搂抱。

sense_translations.en_definition: to hold oneself tightly against sb. or sth.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 紧紧依偎着或抱住某人或某物，使身体贴靠其上。

collocations.en: held himself tightly against the pillow

formal.mt: Malli ltaqa' ma' ħuh wara snin ta' firda, Pawlu tgħannaq miegħu.
formal.en: As soon as he met his brother after years apart, Pawlu embraced him.
formal.zh: 与兄弟分别多年后重逢，Pawlu一见到他便上前与他拥抱。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Iċ-ċkejken beża' mir-ragħad? Marija: Iva, tgħannaq m'ommu u baqa' ħdejha sakemm għaddiet il-maltempata.
colloquial.en: Sara: Was the little boy frightened by the thunder? Marija: Yes, he clung tightly to his mother and stayed beside her until the storm passed.
colloquial.zh: Sara：小男孩被雷声吓到了吗？Marija：是的，他紧紧依偎着妈妈，一直待在她身边，直到暴风雨过去。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 小男孩被雷声吓到了吗？
messages.en: Was the little boy frightened by the thunder?

messages.speaker: Marija (孩子的姑姑)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, tgħannaq m'ommu u baqa' ħdejha sakemm għaddiet il-maltempata.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, tgħannaq m'ommu u baqa' ħdejha sakemm għaddiet il-maltempata.
messages.zh: 是的，他紧紧依偎着妈妈，一直待在她身边，直到暴风雨过去。
messages.en: Yes, he clung tightly to his mother and stayed beside her until the storm passed.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个画面记忆：重逢时彼此拥抱，害怕时紧贴妈妈；共同动作都是把身体抱近。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To produce fruit growing in bunches.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指植物结出聚集成串的果实。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħti frott li jikber f'għenieqed.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 结出成串的果实

collocations.en: The palm produced bunches of fruit.
collocations.zh: 这棵棕榈结出了成串的果实。

collocations.en: produced bunches of fruit for the first time
collocations.zh: 第一次结出成串的果实

formal.mt: Din is-sena, il-palm fil-ġnien tgħanqad u ta diversi għenieqed ta' frott.
formal.en: This year, the palm in the garden produced several bunches of fruit.
formal.zh: 今年，花园里的这棵棕榈结出了好几串果实。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Il-palm tgħanqad din is-sena? Pawlu: Iva, ara kemm għandu għenieqed ta' frott!
colloquial.en: Marta: Did the palm produce bunches of fruit this year? Pawlu: Yes, look how many bunches of fruit it has!
colloquial.zh: Marta：这棵棕榈今年结出成串的果实了吗？Pawlu：结了，你看它有多少串果实！

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.zh: 这棵棕榈今年结出成串的果实了吗？
messages.en: Did the palm produce bunches of fruit this year?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (园丁)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ara kemm għandu għenieqed ta' frott!
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ara kemm għandu għenieqed ta' frott!
messages.zh: 结了，你看它有多少串果实！
messages.en: Yes, look how many bunches of fruit it has!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象树上挂着一串串果实，把这个动词记成“植物结串果”的动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process or occurrence of a plant producing bunches of fruit.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 植物结出成串果实的过程或现象。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li fih pjanta tagħti l-frott f'għenieqed.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 植物结出成串果实的过程或现象

collocations.en: the production of bunches of fruit by grapevines
abundant production of bunches of fruit

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi t-tgħanqid tad-dwieli osservat matul dan l-istaġun.
formal.en: The report describes the grapevines' production of bunches of fruit observed during this season.
formal.zh: 报告描述了本季观察到的葡萄藤结串果现象。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif kien it-tgħanqid tad-dwieli din is-sena? Toni: Kien tajjeb ħafna; kull dielja kellha ħafna għenieqed.
colloquial.en: Lara: How was the grapevines' production of fruit bunches this year? Toni: It was very good; each vine had plenty of bunches.
colloquial.zh: Lara：今年葡萄藤结串果的情况怎么样？Toni：很好，每株葡萄藤都结了很多串。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif kien it-tgħanqid tad-dwieli din is-sena?
messages.mt_standard: Kif kien it-tgħanqid tad-dwieli din is-sena?
messages.zh: 今年葡萄藤结串果的情况怎么样？
messages.en: How was the grapevines' production of fruit bunches this year?

messages.speaker: Toni (种植者)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien tajjeb ħafna; kull dielja kellha ħafna għenieqed.
messages.mt_standard: Kien tajjeb ħafna; kull dielja kellha ħafna għenieqed.
messages.zh: 很好，每株葡萄藤都结了很多串。
messages.en: It was very good; each vine had plenty of bunches.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“一串串果实长出来”看成一个过程，再给这个过程贴上名词标签。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become covered or filled with squill plants.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指某片地方逐渐长满海葱这种植物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jimtela bil-pjanti tal-għansar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 指地方长满海葱

collocations.en: The valley became filled with squills.
The abandoned garden became filled with squills.
collocations.zh: 荒废的花园长满了海葱。

formal.mt: L-istħarriġ tal-veġetazzjoni juri li dan il-wied tgħansal matul is-snin.
formal.en: The vegetation survey shows that this valley became filled with squills over the years.
formal.zh: 植被调查显示，这片山谷多年来逐渐长满了海葱。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Rajt il-ġnien il-qadim? Tgħansal! Ġorġ: Iva, issa hemm l-għansar kullimkien.
colloquial.en: Nina: Have you seen the old garden? It has become filled with squills! Ġorġ: Yes, there are squills everywhere now.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你看过那个老花园了吗？都长满海葱了！Ġorġ：是啊，现在到处都是海葱。

messages.speaker: Nina (邻居)
messages.zh: 你看过那个老花园了吗？都长满海葱了！
messages.en: Have you seen the old garden? It has become filled with squills!

messages.speaker: Ġorġ (邻居)
messages.zh: 是啊，现在到处都是海葱。
messages.en: Yes, there are squills everywhere now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一片空地渐渐被海葱铺满，用“地方变得长满海葱”的画面记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become entangled in something, or to congeal into a thicker or solid mass.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 缠入某物而纠结在一起；也指液体变稠、凝结成块。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitħabbel f'xi ħaġa, jew jagħqad u jsir massa aktar magħquda jew solida.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 缠入某物，陷入纠缠
凝结，凝固成块

collocations.en: The thread became entangled in the branches.

formal.mt: Wara li tħalla fil-kontenitur, id-demm tgħaqqad u fforma massa waħda.
formal.en: After being left in the container, the blood congealed and formed a single mass.
formal.zh: 血液留在容器里后凝结成了一块。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex il-ħajt mhux jinġibed? Ben: Tgħaqqad fil-fergħat; irridu nħolluh bil-mod.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why won't the thread pull through? Ben: It got entangled in the branches; we need to untangle it gently.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这根线怎么拉不动？Ben：它缠进树枝里了，我们得慢慢解开。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 这根线怎么拉不动？
messages.en: Why won't the thread pull through?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.zh: 它缠进树枝里了，我们得慢慢解开。
messages.en: It got entangled in the branches; we need to untangle it gently.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅图分别记义：线缠进树枝里，液体凝成一块；看主语判断具体意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To develop ulcers or pressure sores, or for a wound to produce pus.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 发生溃疡或压疮；也指伤口化脓。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiżviluppa ulċeri jew ġrieħi mill-pressjoni, jew jibda joħroġ il-materja minn ferita.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 发生溃疡，出现溃烂
化脓，产生或流出脓液
出现压疮，长褥疮

collocations.en: developed pressure sores because of prolonged pressure
collocations.zh: 因长时间受压而出现压疮

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi kif il-ġilda tgħaqqret f'żoni li kienu taħt pressjoni fit-tul.
formal.en: The report describes how the skin developed pressure sores in areas subjected to prolonged pressure.
formal.zh: 报告描述了皮肤在长期受压的部位出现压疮的情况。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Kif inhi l-ferita llum? Luqa: Tgħaqqret u qed toħroġ il-materja; se nurihielha lit-tabiba.
colloquial.en: Marija: How is the wound today? Luqa: It has started producing pus; I'm going to show it to the doctor.
colloquial.zh: Marija：今天伤口怎么样？Luqa：化脓了，正在流脓；我打算让医生看看。

messages.speaker: Marija (家人)
messages.zh: 今天伤口怎么样？
messages.en: How is the wound today?

messages.speaker: Luqa (伤者)
messages.mt_spoken: Tgħaqqret u qed toħroġ il-materja; se nurihielha lit-tabiba.
messages.mt_standard: Tgħaqqret u qed toħroġ il-materja; se nurihielha lit-tabiba.
messages.zh: 化脓了，正在流脓；我打算让医生看看。
messages.en: It has started producing pus; I'm going to show it to the doctor.

cognitive_memory_aid: 分三张词义卡记忆：皮肤生溃疡、伤口流脓、受压处长压疮，并用上下文区分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become wiser or more mature in judgment and behaviour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在判断或行为上变得更明智、更成熟懂事。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir aktar għaqli jew matur fil-ġudizzju u fl-imġiba tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得明智，增长智慧
变得成熟，逐渐懂事

collocations.zh: 随着时间推移变得成熟

formal.mt: Matul is-snin, Mark tgħaqqel bl-esperjenza u sar aktar attent fid-deċiżjonijiet tiegħu.
formal.en: Over the years, Mark became wiser through experience and more careful in his decisions.
formal.zh: 多年来，Mark 从经历中增长了智慧，作决定也更加谨慎了。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Rajt kemm inbidel David? Rita: Iva, tgħaqqel ħafna; issa jaħseb qabel jaġixxi.
colloquial.en: Anna: Have you noticed how much David has changed? Rita: Yes, he has matured a lot; now he thinks before he acts.
colloquial.zh: Anna：你发现 David 变化有多大了吗？Rita：是啊，他成熟多了，现在做事前会先想一想。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 你发现 David 变化有多大了吗？
messages.en: Have you noticed how much David has changed?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, tgħaqqel ħafna; issa jaħseb qabel jaġixxi.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, tgħaqqel ħafna; issa jaħseb qabel jaġixxi.
messages.zh: 是啊，他成熟多了，现在做事前会先想一想。
messages.en: Yes, he has matured a lot; now he thinks before he acts.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人从冲动行事变成三思而行，把“长智慧”和“变懂事”一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To try to become acquainted with a person or familiar with something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 主动尝试认识某个人，或试着熟悉、了解某件事物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jipprova jsir jaf lil xi ħadd jew isir familjari ma' xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.en_definition: to try to get acquainted with sth. or sb.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 尝试认识某人，或试着熟悉某事物
