collocations.en: tried to get acquainted with the new neighbours
tried to become familiar with the new surroundings

formal.mt: Fl-ewwel ġimgħa tiegħu, l-istudent tgħaraf mal-ambjent il-ġdid permezz ta' żjarat u laqgħat.
formal.en: During his first week, the student tried to become familiar with the new surroundings through visits and meetings.
formal.zh: 第一周里，这名学生通过参观和会面，尝试熟悉新环境。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Mark diġà tkellem mal-ġirien il-ġodda? Sam: Iva, ilbieraħ tgħaraf magħhom waqt li kienu fil-bitħa.
colloquial.en: Elena: Has Mark spoken to the new neighbours yet? Sam: Yes, yesterday he tried to get acquainted with them while they were in the courtyard.
colloquial.zh: Elena：Mark 已经和新邻居说过话了吗？Sam：说过了，昨天他们在院子里时，他试着和他们认识了一下。

messages.speaker: Elena (朋友)
messages.zh: Mark 已经和新邻居说过话了吗？
messages.en: Has Mark spoken to the new neighbours yet?

messages.speaker: Sam (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ilbieraħ tgħaraf magħhom waqt li kienu fil-bitħa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ilbieraħ tgħaraf magħhom waqt li kienu fil-bitħa.
messages.zh: 说过了，昨天他们在院子里时，他试着和他们认识了一下。
messages.en: Yes, yesterday he tried to get acquainted with them while they were in the courtyard.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象初到陌生地方，主动打招呼并四处了解；重点记住“尝试去熟悉”的过程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To experience the tickling sensation caused by a light touch.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因轻触或搔挠而产生痒感，受到搔痒。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iħoss it-tingiż tad-daħk meta xi ħadd imissu jew iżiegħel bih ħafif.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 受到搔痒，被挠得发痒

collocations.en: was tickled when someone touched his tummy

formal.mt: Matul il-logħba, it-tifel tgħarax meta missieru messlu żaqqu ħafif, u beda jidħaq.
formal.en: During the game, the boy was tickled when his father lightly touched his tummy, and he began to laugh.
formal.zh: 游戏时，父亲轻轻碰了碰男孩的肚子，男孩觉得痒，便笑了起来。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Leo beda jidħaq? Nina: Tgħarax meta messitlu żaqqu oħtu!
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Leo start laughing? Nina: He was tickled when his sister touched his tummy!
colloquial.zh: Maja：Leo 怎么笑起来了？Nina：他姐姐碰了碰他的肚子，把他弄痒了！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: Leo 怎么笑起来了？
messages.en: Why did Leo start laughing?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 他姐姐碰了碰他的肚子，把他弄痒了！
messages.en: He was tickled when his sister touched his tummy!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象肚子被轻轻一碰就痒得发笑，把词义连到“受到搔痒”的身体感觉。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To undergo consideration or examination, or to be passed through a sieve.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受到考虑或仔细审查，也可指材料经过筛分。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġi kkunsidrat jew eżaminat bir-reqqa, jew jgħaddi minn għarbiel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被考虑；被纳入思考或评估。
被检查或仔细审查。
被筛过；经过筛分。

collocations.zh: 这个案件受到了仔细审查。

collocations.en: The flour was sifted before use.
collocations.zh: 面粉在使用前经过了筛分。

formal.mt: Il-proġett tgħarbel mill-kumitat qabel ma ttieħdet id-deċiżjoni.
formal.en: The project was examined by the committee before the decision was made.
formal.zh: 委员会在作出决定前审查了这个项目。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Id-dqiq tgħarbel diġà? Toni: Iva, issa nistgħu nibdew nagħmlu l-kejk.
colloquial.en: Maja: Has the flour been sifted already? Toni: Yes, now we can start making the cake.
colloquial.zh: Maja：面粉已经筛过了吗？Toni：筛过了，现在可以开始做蛋糕了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 面粉已经筛过了吗？
messages.en: Has the flour been sifted already?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, issa nistgħu nibdew nagħmlu l-kejk.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, issa nistgħu nibdew nagħmlu l-kejk.
messages.zh: 筛过了，现在可以开始做蛋糕了。
messages.en: Yes, now we can start making the cake.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把面粉过筛和方案受审查并排记：材料被筛过，事情被仔细考虑；这是帮助区分词义的学习联想。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of examining something carefully or separating material by sifting.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 仔细检查或审查某事物的过程，也指用筛子分离材料的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess ta' eżami bir-reqqa jew ta' separazzjoni ta' materjal permezz ta' għarbiel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 检查；对事物进行查看和评估的过程。
筛分；用筛子分离或筛选材料的过程。
仔细审查；细致而严格的检查。

collocations.zh: 对各项提案的仔细审查

formal.mt: It-tgħarbil tal-applikazzjonijiet għandu jsir skont kriterji ċari.
formal.en: The examination of applications should follow clear criteria.
formal.zh: 申请的审查应当依据明确的标准进行。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex qed tuża l-għarbiel? Pawlu: Għat-tgħarbil tad-dqiq qabel ma nagħmel il-kejk.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why are you using the sieve? Pawlu: To sift the flour before I make the cake.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你为什么用筛子？Pawlu：做蛋糕前要用它筛面粉。

messages.speaker: Sara (家人)
messages.zh: 你为什么用筛子？
messages.en: Why are you using the sieve?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Għat-tgħarbil tad-dqiq qabel ma nagħmel il-kejk.
messages.mt_standard: Għat-tgħarbil tad-dqiq qabel ma nagħmel il-kejk.
messages.zh: 做蛋糕前要用它筛面粉。
messages.en: To sift the flour before I make the cake.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“筛分这一过程”来记这个名词：厨房里筛面粉，工作中审查提案，都可以作为学习场景。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become covered or filled with water, especially when water enters a place that is normally dry.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 原本干燥的地方进水，被水覆盖或淹没。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jimtela jew jitgħatta bl-ilma, speċjalment meta l-ilma jidħol f'post li normalment ikun niexef.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被水淹没；因进水而形成淹水状态。

collocations.en: The valley became flooded after the rain.

formal.mt: Wara x-xita qawwija, il-maħżen tgħargħar u l-ħaddiema kellhom ineħħu l-ilma.
formal.en: After the heavy rain, the warehouse became flooded and the workers had to remove the water.
formal.zh: 大雨过后，仓库被淹，工人们不得不排水。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Il-garaxx tgħargħar bil-lejl. Lara: Daħal ħafna ilma?
colloquial.en: Mark: The garage flooded during the night. Lara: Did a lot of water get in?
colloquial.zh: Mark：车库夜里被淹了。Lara：进了很多水吗？

messages.speaker: Mark (邻居)
messages.zh: 车库夜里被淹了。
messages.en: The garage flooded during the night.

messages.speaker: Lara (邻居)
messages.zh: 进了很多水吗？
messages.en: Did a lot of water get in?

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住“车库进水、地面被淹”的画面，用地点被水覆盖来固定这个动词的意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action of stamping with the heel against the ground or floor.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用脚跟向地面踏击或跺地的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li wieħed jagħti daqqiet mal-art bl-għarqub.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用脚跟跺地或踏击地面的动作。

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, it-tgħarqib isir billi l-għarqub jolqot l-art b'ritmu regolari.
formal.en: In this exercise, heel stamping is performed by striking the floor with the heel at a regular rhythm.
formal.zh: 在这项练习中，脚跟按照均匀的节奏踏击地面。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kif nagħmel it-tgħarqib? Rita: Agħti daqqa ħafifa mal-art bl-għarqub.
colloquial.en: Nina: How do I do the heel stamping? Rita: Tap the floor lightly with your heel.
colloquial.zh: Nina：脚跟踏击要怎么做？Rita：用脚跟轻轻踏一下地面。

messages.speaker: Nina (学员)
messages.zh: 脚跟踏击要怎么做？
messages.en: How do I do the heel stamping?

messages.speaker: Rita (教练)
messages.zh: 用脚跟轻轻踏一下地面。
messages.en: Tap the floor lightly with your heel.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把注意力放在脚后跟接触地面的瞬间，配合节拍想象“脚跟踏、脚跟踏”，记住这是动作名词。

gloss_zh: 被阿拉伯化；变得阿拉伯化

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become Arabicized, taking on an Arabic form or Arabic linguistic or cultural features.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变成阿拉伯语形式，或在语言、文化方面呈现阿拉伯特征。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jieħu forma Għarbija jew karatteristiċi Għarab fil-lingwa jew fil-kultura.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被阿拉伯化；在形式、语言或文化特征上变得阿拉伯化。

collocations.zh: 这个名字被阿拉伯化了。
这个术语被阿拉伯化了。

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżempju, l-isem tgħarrab biex jaqbel mal-pronunzja Għarbija.
formal.en: In this example, the name was Arabicized to suit Arabic pronunciation.
formal.zh: 在这个例子中，名字经过阿拉伯化处理，以适应阿拉伯语的发音。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex l-isem jidher differenti hawn? Sami: Għax tgħarrab għal din il-verżjoni.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why does the name look different here? Sami: Because it was Arabicized for this version.
colloquial.zh: Maja：为什么这里的名字看起来不一样？Sami：因为这个版本把名字阿拉伯化了。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 为什么这里的名字看起来不一样？
messages.en: Why does the name look different here?

messages.speaker: Sami (同学)
messages.zh: 因为这个版本把名字阿拉伯化了。
messages.en: Because it was Arabicized for this version.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象同一个名字在两个版本里呈现不同形式，阿拉伯化后的形式帮助你记住这个动词的结果状态。

gloss_zh: 获知；得到通知；获取信息

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become informed about something, either by being told or by obtaining information.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过别人告知或主动获取信息而了解某事。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir jaf dwar xi ħaġa, billi jingħata tagħrif jew billi jikseb l-informazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被告知；得到通知而获悉某事。
获取信息；通过了解情况而获得相关知识。

collocations.zh: 获取了有关课程的信息

formal.mt: Ir-rappreżentant tgħarraf bid-dettalji tal-proġett qabel il-laqgħa.
formal.en: The representative became informed of the project details before the meeting.
formal.zh: 这位代表在会议前了解了项目的详细情况。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Mark tgħarraf dwar il-kors? Toni: Iva, mar l-uffiċċju u staqsa għall-informazzjoni.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did Mark get information about the course? Toni: Yes, he went to the office and asked for information.
colloquial.zh: Lara：Mark了解过这门课程了吗？Toni：了解过了，他去办公室咨询了。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: Mark了解过这门课程了吗？
messages.en: Did Mark get information about the course?

messages.speaker: Toni (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, mar l-uffiċċju u staqsa għall-informazzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, mar l-uffiċċju u staqsa għall-informazzjoni.
messages.zh: 了解过了，他去办公室咨询了。
messages.en: Yes, he went to the office and asked for information.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“消息到了，我知道了”记被告知，再用“去办公室咨询”记获取信息，两种情景都指向获得了解。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be gathered or accumulated into a pile or heap.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被聚集或堆放成一堆，形成堆积状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinġabar jew jitqiegħed f'munzell.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被堆起来；被堆积成堆。

collocations.en: The rubbish was piled up in a corner.
collocations.zh: 垃圾被堆在一个角落里。

formal.mt: Il-materjal tgħarram ħdejn id-daħla u kellu jitneħħa biex il-passaġġ jibqa' ħieles.
formal.en: The material was piled up near the entrance and had to be removed to keep the passage clear.
formal.zh: 材料被堆在入口附近，必须移走才能保持通道畅通。

colloquial.mt: Pawlu: Fejn tgħarram ir-ramel? Rita: Ħdejn il-ħajt, fuq in-naħa tax-xellug.
colloquial.en: Pawlu: Where was the sand piled up? Rita: Next to the wall, on the left.
colloquial.zh: Pawlu：沙子堆在哪里了？Rita：在左边，靠墙的地方。

messages.speaker: Pawlu (工友)
messages.zh: 沙子堆在哪里了？
messages.en: Where was the sand piled up?

messages.speaker: Rita (工友)
messages.zh: 在左边，靠墙的地方。
messages.en: Next to the wall, on the left.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象散开的沙子被集中成一个小山堆，抓住“从散到堆”的画面来记住被堆起来的意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To die through drowning, or to cause oneself to drown.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因溺水而死亡，也可指使自己溺水身亡。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Imut mgħarraq fl-ilma, jew iġiegħel lilu nnifsu jegħreq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被淹死；溺水身亡。
使自己溺水身亡；自溺。

formal.mt: Skont ir-rapport, is-sajjied tgħarraq meta d-dgħajsa għerqet waqt il-maltempata.
formal.en: According to the report, the fisherman drowned when the boat sank during the storm.
formal.zh: 据报告，这名渔民在暴风雨中因船只沉没而溺亡。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Smajt bis-sajjied li tgħarraq? Mark: Iva, kienet aħbar ta' niket.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did you hear about the fisherman who drowned? Mark: Yes, it was sad news.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你听说那位渔民溺亡的事了吗？Mark：听说了，真是令人难过的消息。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你听说那位渔民溺亡的事了吗？
messages.en: Did you hear about the fisherman who drowned?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 听说了，真是令人难过的消息。
messages.en: Yes, it was sad news.

cognitive_memory_aid: 将这个词放进“人溺水身亡”的句子里记忆；遇到自溺义时，再根据上下文判断是否包含主动行为。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To enter an engagement with someone, agreeing to marry them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与某人订婚，约定将来结婚。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li wieħed jintrabat ma' persuna oħra bil-ħsieb li jiżżewġu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 订婚；与某人确立婚约。

formal.mt: Pawlu tgħarras ma' Marija waqt ċelebrazzjoni żgħira mal-familji tagħhom.
formal.en: Pawlu got engaged to Marija during a small celebration with their families.
formal.zh: 保罗在双方家人参加的小型庆祝活动中与玛丽亚订婚了。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Smajt li Mark tgħarras? Anna: Iva, ma' Lara! Qaluli lbieraħ.
colloquial.en: Rita: Did you hear that Mark got engaged? Anna: Yes, to Lara! They told me yesterday.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：你听说马克订婚了吗？安娜：听说了，和劳拉！他们昨天告诉我的。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 你听说马克订婚了吗？
messages.en: Did you hear that Mark got engaged?

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 听说了，和劳拉！他们昨天告诉我的。
messages.en: Yes, to Lara! They told me yesterday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词连到交换订婚戒指的画面，再用 ma' 加人名记住与谁订婚。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To experience the sensation of being tickled when someone touches the skin lightly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因别人轻触皮肤而受到搔痒，产生痒感或发笑。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li wieħed iħoss sensazzjoni li tista' ġġiegħlu jidħaq meta xi ħadd imissu ħafif fuq il-ġilda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被挠痒痒；受到轻触而觉得痒。

collocations.en: was tickled when someone touched his feet
collocations.zh: 有人碰他的脚时被挠得发痒

collocations.en: was tickled and began to laugh

formal.mt: It-tifel tgħarrax meta missieru messlu saqajh ħafif, u beda jidħaq.
formal.en: The boy was tickled when his father lightly touched his feet, and he began to laugh.
formal.zh: 父亲轻轻碰男孩的脚，男孩被挠得发痒，笑了起来。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex qed jidħaq Ben? Mark: Tgħarrax meta messejtlu saqajh!
colloquial.en: Lara: Why is Ben laughing? Mark: He was tickled when I touched his feet!
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：本为什么在笑？马克：我碰了他的脚，把他挠痒了！

messages.speaker: Lara (姐姐)
messages.zh: 本为什么在笑？
messages.en: Why is Ben laughing?

messages.speaker: Mark (哥哥)
messages.zh: 我碰了他的脚，把他挠痒了！
messages.en: He was tickled when I touched his feet!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象脚底被轻碰后忍不住笑，把整个词与被挠痒痒的身体反应相连。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To distance oneself from other people or become less close to them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 主动与他人拉开距离，或在关系中逐渐变得疏远。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li wieħed jitbiegħed minn nies oħra jew isir inqas qrib tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使自己与他人疏远；自行拉开关系上的距离。
变得疏远；原有的亲近关系逐渐淡化。

formal.mt: Wara snin ta' nuqqas ta' kuntatt, Pawlu tgħarreb minn familtu u sabha diffiċli jerġa' jkellimhom.
formal.en: After years without contact, Pawlu became estranged from his family and found it difficult to speak to them again.
formal.zh: 多年没有联系后，保罗与家人变得疏远，觉得很难重新与他们交谈。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għadek tara lil Mark? Rita: Ftit. Tgħarreb minna dan l-aħħar, imma nixtieq nerġa' nkellmu.
colloquial.en: Anna: Do you still see Mark? Rita: Not much. He has distanced himself from us lately, but I'd like to talk to him again.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你还见马克吗？丽塔：不太见了。他最近疏远了我们，不过我想再和他聊聊。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 你还见马克吗？
messages.en: Do you still see Mark?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ftit. Tgħarreb minna dan l-aħħar, imma nixtieq nerġa' nkellmu.
messages.mt_standard: Ftit. Tgħarreb minna dan l-aħħar, imma nixtieq nerġa' nkellmu.
messages.zh: 不太见了。他最近疏远了我们，不过我想再和他聊聊。
messages.en: Not much. He has distanced himself from us lately, but I'd like to talk to him again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象两个人之间的距离慢慢拉大；同一画面可记主动疏远和关系变淡两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become wiser and develop better judgment or understanding.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变得更有智慧，判断事情或理解事理的能力有所增长。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li wieħed isir aktar għaqli u jitgħallem jiġġudika jew jifhem l-affarijiet aħjar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得明智；增长智慧与判断力。

collocations.zh: 随着时间推移变得更明智

formal.mt: Tul is-snin, Mark tgħarref bl-esperjenza u tgħallem jaħseb sew qabel jieħu deċiżjoni.
formal.en: Over the years, Mark became wiser through experience and learned to think carefully before making a decision.
formal.zh: 多年来，马克从经历中增长了智慧，学会在作决定前仔细思考。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Pawlu llum jisma' qabel jitkellem. Ben: Iva, tgħarref maż-żmien!
colloquial.en: Lara: These days Pawlu listens before speaking. Ben: Yes, he's become wiser over time!
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：保罗现在会先听别人说，再开口。本：是啊，他慢慢变得更明智了！

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗现在会先听别人说，再开口。
messages.en: These days Pawlu listens before speaking.

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.zh: 是啊，他慢慢变得更明智了！
messages.en: Yes, he's become wiser over time!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词配上先思考再决定的画面，记住它强调智慧和判断力的增长。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become covered with clouds, with the sky turning overcast.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 天空逐渐被云层遮蔽，天气转为阴天。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li s-sema jinkesa bis-sħab u jsir imsaħħab.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 转阴；天空变得阴云密布。

formal.mt: Wara nofsinhar is-sema tgħarrex, u s-sħab għatta x-xemx għal diversi sigħat.
formal.en: In the afternoon the sky became overcast, and clouds covered the sun for several hours.
formal.zh: 下午天空转阴，云层遮住太阳长达数小时。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Fejn marret ix-xemx? Pawlu: Is-sema tgħarrex f'daqqa. Nispera li ma tagħmilx xita.
colloquial.en: Anna: Where did the sun go? Pawlu: The sky suddenly became overcast. I hope it doesn't rain.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：太阳怎么不见了？保罗：天突然阴下来了。希望别下雨。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 太阳怎么不见了？
messages.en: Where did the sun go?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Is-sema tgħarrex f'daqqa. Nispera li ma tagħmilx xita.
messages.mt_standard: Is-sema tgħarrex f'daqqa. Nispera li ma tagħmilx xita.
messages.zh: 天突然阴下来了。希望别下雨。
messages.en: The sky suddenly became overcast. I hope it doesn't rain.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词与云层盖住太阳的画面绑定，搭配 is-sema 记天空转阴。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To begin walking with a limp, taking uneven steps.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 开始一瘸一拐地走路，步态变得不均衡。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li wieħed jibda jimxi b'pass irregolari, b'mod li sieq waħda ma tiċċaqlaqx bħall-oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 开始跛行；开始一瘸一拐地走路。

collocations.zh: 散步途中开始一瘸一拐

formal.mt: Waqt il-logħba, il-plejer tgħarreġ wara li waqa' u ħareġ mill-grawnd biex jistrieħ.
formal.en: During the match, the player started limping after a fall and left the pitch to rest.
formal.zh: 比赛中，这名球员摔倒后开始跛行，随后离开球场休息。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għaliex waqaf Ben? Mark: Tgħarreġ waqt il-mixja, allura qed jistrieħ ftit.
colloquial.en: Rita: Why did Ben stop? Mark: He started limping during the walk, so he's resting for a bit.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：本为什么停下来了？马克：他走着走着开始一瘸一拐，所以正在歇一会儿。

messages.speaker: Rita (同行朋友)
messages.zh: 本为什么停下来了？
messages.en: Why did Ben stop?

messages.speaker: Mark (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tgħarreġ waqt il-mixja, allura qed jistrieħ ftit.
messages.mt_standard: Tgħarreġ waqt il-mixja, allura qed jistrieħ ftit.
messages.zh: 他走着走着开始一瘸一拐，所以正在歇一会儿。
messages.en: He started limping during the walk, so he's resting for a bit.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象原本平稳的脚步突然变成一高一低，重点记住开始跛行这一变化。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To remove one's own clothes; to undress.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 脱下自己穿着的衣服。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li wieħed ineħħi l-ħwejjeġ li jkun liebes.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 脱衣服；脱下自己身上的衣服。

formal.mt: Wara li wasal id-dar, Pawlu daħal fil-kamra tal-banju, tgħarwen u ħa doċċa.
formal.en: After arriving home, Pawlu went into the bathroom, undressed and took a shower.
formal.zh: 到家后，保罗走进浴室，脱下衣服，冲了个澡。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Ben lest biex jinħasel? Mark: Iva, diġà tgħarwen. Għaddili x-xugaman, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Rita: Is Ben ready for his wash? Mark: Yes, he's already undressed. Pass me the towel, please.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：本准备好洗澡了吗？马克：好了，他已经脱了衣服。请把毛巾递给我。

messages.speaker: Rita (母亲)
messages.zh: 本准备好洗澡了吗？
messages.en: Is Ben ready for his wash?

messages.speaker: Mark (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, diġà tgħarwen. Għaddili x-xugaman, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, diġà tgħarwen. Għaddili x-xugaman, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.zh: 好了，他已经脱了衣服。请把毛巾递给我。
messages.en: Yes, he's already undressed. Pass me the towel, please.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按进入浴室、脱衣、淋浴的顺序联想，把这个词固定在脱衣这一步。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of gathering or moving together in a large, dense group, especially of insects.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 大量个体，尤其是昆虫，密集聚集或成群移动的活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ġbir jew il-moviment ta' għadd kbir ta' ħlejjaq flimkien, speċjalment insetti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 成群聚集、蜂拥或密集移动的活动，尤指昆虫。

collocations.zh: 蜜蜂的成群聚集或飞动

collocations.en: the swarming of insects around the light
collocations.zh: 昆虫在灯光周围的成群飞动

formal.mt: L-istudenti osservaw it-tgħarwil tal-insetti madwar il-lampa u kitbu deskrizzjoni tal-moviment tagħhom.
formal.en: The students observed the swarming of insects around the lamp and wrote a description of their movement.
formal.zh: 学生们观察了昆虫在灯周围成群飞动的情景，并写下对其运动的描述。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'qed tara ħdejn it-tieqa? Ben: It-tgħarwil tal-insetti madwar id-dawl. Ara kemm hemm!
colloquial.en: Lara: What are you watching by the window? Ben: The swarming of insects around the light. Look how many there are!
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：你在窗边看什么？本：看昆虫围着灯成群飞动。你看，有这么多！

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你在窗边看什么？
messages.en: What are you watching by the window?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tgħarwil tal-insetti madwar id-dawl. Ara kemm hemm!
messages.mt_standard: It-tgħarwil tal-insetti madwar id-dawl. Ara kemm hemm!
messages.zh: 看昆虫围着灯成群飞动。你看，有这么多！
messages.en: The swarming of insects around the light. Look how many there are!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象灯边密密麻麻飞动的虫群；这个名词指成群活动的过程，可搭配昆虫名称。

gloss_zh: 丰富化；剥露；裸露；剥去衣物；脱衣

teaching_sense.en_definition: Enrichment; in separate senses, the removal of a covering or clothing, the act of disrobing, or the resulting state of bareness.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可指使事物更加丰富或充实；另有剥去覆盖物或衣物、脱衣以及裸露状态等不同义项。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li jagħmel xi ħaġa aktar għanja; f'tifsiriet oħra, it-tneħħija ta' kisi jew ħwejjeġ, jew l-istat ta' għera.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 丰富化；使内容或性质更加充实。
剥露；去掉表面的覆盖物，使之露出。
裸露；没有遮盖或覆盖物的状态。

sense_translations.en_definition: act of stripping sb. of clothing
sense_translations.zh_definition: 剥去某人衣物的行为。
脱衣；脱下身上衣物的行为。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi t-tgħarwin tal-art wara li tneħħiet il-veġetazzjoni.
formal.en: The report describes the denudement of the land after the vegetation was removed.
formal.zh: 报告描述了植被被清除后土地裸露的情况。

colloquial.mt: Pawlu: Għandi bżonn inneħħi ħwejġi kollha għall-eżami? Rita: Le, it-tgħarwin sħiħ mhux meħtieġ; tista' żżomm il-qalziet.
colloquial.en: Pawlu: Do I need to take off all my clothes for the examination? Rita: No, complete disrobing is unnecessary; you can keep your trousers on.
colloquial.zh: Pawlu：检查时我要脱掉所有衣服吗？Rita：不用，不需要完全脱衣；你可以穿着裤子。

messages.speaker: Pawlu (病人)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi bżonn inneħħi ħwejġi kollha għall-eżami?
messages.mt_standard: Għandi bżonn inneħħi ħwejġi kollha għall-eżami?
messages.zh: 检查时我要脱掉所有衣服吗？
messages.en: Do I need to take off all my clothes for the examination?

messages.speaker: Rita (医生)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, it-tgħarwin sħiħ mhux meħtieġ; tista' żżomm il-qalziet.
messages.mt_standard: Le, it-tgħarwin sħiħ mhux meħtieġ; tista' żżomm il-qalziet.
messages.zh: 不用，不需要完全脱衣；你可以穿着裤子。
messages.en: No, complete disrobing is unnecessary; you can keep your trousers on.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个独立抽屉记忆：一个放“丰富充实”，另一个放“去掉遮盖”。后者再分成剥除动作、脱衣动作和裸露状态，避免混淆义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become a place where birds gather or live.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指某个地方逐渐有鸟聚集或栖居。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir post fejn jinġabru jew jgħixu l-għasafar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得有鸟群聚集或栖居。

collocations.en: a garden that became populated with birds
collocations.zh: 有鸟群栖居起来的花园

collocations.en: a valley that became populated with birds
collocations.zh: 有鸟群聚集起来的山谷

formal.mt: Wara li tħawlu aktar siġar, il-ġnien tgħasfar u sar post tajjeb għall-osservazzjoni tal-għasafar.
formal.en: After more trees were planted, the garden became populated with birds and became a good place for birdwatching.
formal.zh: 增种树木后，花园里有了鸟群栖居，也成了适合观鸟的地方。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Qed tisma' kemm hawn għasafar? Mark: Iva, il-ġnien tgħasfar minn meta ħallejna l-frott fuq is-siġar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can you hear how many birds there are here? Mark: Yes, the garden has become populated with birds since we left the fruit on the trees.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你听，这里有好多鸟啊。Mark：是啊，自从我们把果子留在树上，花园里就聚起了鸟群。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你听，这里有好多鸟啊。
messages.en: Can you hear how many birds there are here?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-ġnien tgħasfar minn meta ħallejna l-frott fuq is-siġar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-ġnien tgħasfar minn meta ħallejna l-frott fuq is-siġar.
messages.zh: 是啊，自从我们把果子留在树上，花园里就聚起了鸟群。
messages.en: Yes, the garden has become populated with birds since we left the fruit on the trees.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一座原本安静的花园逐渐住进许多鸟，用“地方变得有鸟群栖居”的连续画面记住这个动词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To produce new twigs as part of plant growth.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指植物在生长过程中抽出新的细枝或嫩枝。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Joħroġ friegħi żgħar ġodda waqt li jikber.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 抽出细枝；萌生新的嫩枝。

formal.mt: Wara ż-żbir, l-arbuxxell tgħasleġ u l-friegħi l-ġodda bdew jikbru.
formal.en: After pruning, the shrub sprouted twigs, and the new branches began to grow.
formal.zh: 修剪后，灌木抽出了嫩枝，新枝开始生长。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan l-arbuxxell għadu ħaj? Toni: Iva, ara dawn il-friegħi żgħar; tgħasleġ din il-ġimgħa.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is this shrub still alive? Toni: Yes, look at these little branches; it sprouted twigs this week.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这棵灌木还活着吗？Toni：活着，你看这些小枝条；它这周抽出了嫩枝。

messages.speaker: Sara (园艺学员)
messages.zh: 这棵灌木还活着吗？
messages.en: Is this shrub still alive?

messages.speaker: Toni (园丁)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ara dawn il-friegħi żgħar; tgħasleġ din il-ġimgħa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ara dawn il-friegħi żgħar; tgħasleġ din il-ġimgħa.
messages.zh: 活着，你看这些小枝条；它这周抽出了嫩枝。
messages.en: Yes, look at these little branches; it sprouted twigs this week.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把镜头对准枝条而不是花朵：老枝旁冒出几根细小嫩枝，就是这个词要记住的生长动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be mixed or combined with another substance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指一种物质被混合或与另一种物质拌合。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitħallat ma' sustanza oħra jew ma' sustanzi oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被混合；被搅拌或拌合在一起。

collocations.en: plaster that was mixed with water

formal.mt: Il-ġibs tgħassed mal-ilma qabel ma ntuża għat-tiswija tal-ħajt.
formal.en: The plaster was mixed with water before it was used to repair the wall.
formal.zh: 石膏先与水拌合，随后用于修补墙壁。

colloquial.mt: Luca: Il-ġibs lest biex nużawh? Ben: Iva, tgħassed sew mal-ilma u issa nistgħu nibdew.
colloquial.en: Luca: Is the plaster ready for us to use? Ben: Yes, it has been mixed thoroughly with water, and we can start now.
colloquial.zh: Luca：石膏拌好可以用了吗？Ben：好了，已经和水充分拌匀，现在可以开始了。

messages.speaker: Luca (学徒)
messages.zh: 石膏拌好可以用了吗？
messages.en: Is the plaster ready for us to use?

messages.speaker: Ben (工匠)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, tgħassed sew mal-ilma u issa nistgħu nibdew.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, tgħassed sew mal-ilma u issa nistgħu nibdew.
messages.zh: 好了，已经和水充分拌匀，现在可以开始了。
messages.en: Yes, it has been mixed thoroughly with water, and we can start now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象石膏粉和水在桶里被拌匀，记忆重点放在材料“被混合”的状态，而不是谁拿着搅拌工具。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To have honey added in order to make something sweeter.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指食物或饮料被加入蜂蜜，以增加甜味。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiżdiedlu l-għasel biex isir aktar ħelu.

sense_translations.en_definition: to have honey added for sweetening
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被加入蜂蜜以调甜。

collocations.en: tea that was sweetened with honey
yogurt that was sweetened with honey

formal.mt: It-te tgħassel qabel ma ġie servut lill-mistednin.
formal.en: The tea was sweetened with honey before it was served to the guests.
formal.zh: 茶先加蜂蜜调甜，然后端给客人。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex dan it-te għandu togħma ta' għasel? Mark: Għax tgħassel; żidtlu ftit għasel qabel ġibtulek.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why does this tea taste of honey? Mark: Because it was sweetened with honey; I added a little before bringing it to you.
colloquial.zh: Nina：这杯茶怎么有蜂蜜味？Mark：因为加了蜂蜜调甜；端给你之前，我加了一点。

messages.speaker: Nina (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex dan it-te għandu togħma ta' għasel?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex dan it-te għandu togħma ta' għasel?
messages.zh: 这杯茶怎么有蜂蜜味？
messages.en: Why does this tea taste of honey?

messages.speaker: Mark (服务员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax tgħassel; żidtlu ftit għasel qabel ġibtulek.
messages.mt_standard: Għax tgħassel; żidtlu ftit għasel qabel ġibtulek.
messages.zh: 因为加了蜂蜜调甜；端给你之前，我加了一点。
messages.en: Because it was sweetened with honey; I added a little before bringing it to you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一勺蜂蜜流进茶杯，茶因此变甜。把“蜂蜜加入其中”整幅画面记住，便能区别于笼统的加糖调甜。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be watched or kept under surveillance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指人或地点受到看守、观察或持续监视。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikun taħt għassa jew taħt sorveljanza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被看守；受到注意或观察。
被持续监视；处于监控之下。

collocations.en: was kept under surveillance by the police

formal.mt: Il-bini tgħasses mill-pulizija għal tlett ijiem bħala parti mill-investigazzjoni.
formal.en: The building was kept under surveillance by the police for three days as part of the investigation.
formal.zh: 作为调查的一部分，警方对这栋建筑进行了三天监视。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Il-maħżen baqa' mingħajr għassa lbieraħ filgħaxija? Joe: Le, tgħasses matul il-lejl kollu.
colloquial.en: Anna: Was the warehouse left unwatched yesterday evening? Joe: No, it was watched throughout the night.
colloquial.zh: Anna：仓库昨晚没人看守吗？Joe：有人，整晚都有人看守。

messages.speaker: Anna (仓库主管)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-maħżen baqa' mingħajr għassa lbieraħ filgħaxija?
messages.mt_standard: Il-maħżen baqa' mingħajr għassa lbieraħ filgħaxija?
messages.zh: 仓库昨晚没人看守吗？
messages.en: Was the warehouse left unwatched yesterday evening?

messages.speaker: Joe (保安)
messages.zh: 有人，整晚都有人看守。
messages.en: No, it was watched throughout the night.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一栋楼始终处在观察者视线里：为保护而看守，或为调查而监视，都从“受到注视”的角度记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of keeping watch over a person or thing in order to protect them or it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为保护某人或某物而进行看守、守护的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed iżomm għassa fuq persuna jew ħaġa biex jipproteġiha.

sense_translations.en_definition: the act of guarding sth. or sb.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 看守或守护某物、某人的行为。

formal.mt: It-tgħassis tal-maħżen ikompli matul il-lejl biex il-ħaddiema u l-oġġetti jkunu protetti.
formal.en: The guarding of the warehouse continues through the night so that the workers and goods are protected.
formal.zh: 仓库的看守工作整夜持续，以保护工人和货物。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Min se jieħu ħsieb it-tgħassis tal-maħżen illejla? Pawlu: Jien, u Mark jiġi jgħinni f'nofsillejl.
colloquial.en: Rita: Who will take care of guarding the warehouse tonight? Pawlu: I will, and Mark will come to help me at midnight.
colloquial.zh: Rita：今晚谁负责看守仓库？Pawlu：我负责，Mark会在午夜过来帮忙。

messages.speaker: Rita (仓库主管)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jieħu ħsieb it-tgħassis tal-maħżen illejla?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jieħu ħsieb it-tgħassis tal-maħżen illejla?
messages.zh: 今晚谁负责看守仓库？
messages.en: Who will take care of guarding the warehouse tonight?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (保安)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien, u Mark jiġi jgħinni f'nofsillejl.
messages.mt_standard: Jien, u Mark jiġi jgħinni f'nofsillejl.
messages.zh: 我负责，Mark会在午夜过来帮忙。
messages.en: I will, and Mark will come to help me at midnight.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“看守”想成值班表上的一项工作：这个名词指守护行为本身，可以安排、接手，也可以持续整夜。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To put a covering over oneself, or to have a covering placed over something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指给自己盖上遮盖物，或指某人、某物被遮盖物覆盖。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiksi lilu nnifsu b'xi ħaġa, jew ikun miksi b'għata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 给自己盖上东西；把自己遮盖起来。
被盖住；被覆盖或遮蔽。

formal.mt: It-tagħmir tgħatta b'għata biex ikun protett mit-trab waqt ix-xogħol.
formal.en: The equipment was covered with a cover to protect it from dust during the work.
formal.zh: 施工期间，设备被罩布盖住，以免沾上灰尘。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għadek tħoss il-bard? Mark: Le, tgħattejt bil-kutra u issa qiegħed sew.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are you still feeling cold? Mark: No, I covered myself with the blanket, and I feel fine now.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你还觉得冷吗？Mark：不冷了，我盖上了毯子，现在舒服了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你还觉得冷吗？
messages.en: Are you still feeling cold?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, tgħattejt bil-kutra u issa qiegħed sew.
messages.mt_standard: Le, tgħattejt bil-kutra u issa qiegħed sew.
messages.zh: 不冷了，我盖上了毯子，现在舒服了。
messages.en: No, I covered myself with the blanket, and I feel fine now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一条毯子串联两个义项：人把毯子拉到身上是“盖住自己”，设备上铺着罩布是“被覆盖”。

gloss_zh: 变得肢体残障；发生瘫痪

teaching_sense.en_definition: To develop a physical disability affecting movement, or to suffer paralysis.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体变得行动受限或出现肢体残障，也可指发生瘫痪。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir b'diżabilità fiżika li tillimita l-moviment, jew iġarrab paraliżi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得肢体残障，行动能力受到损害。
发生瘫痪，身体部分或全部失去活动能力。

collocations.en: became physically disabled after an accident
became physically disabled because of an illness
collocations.zh: 因疾病而出现肢体残障

formal.mt: Wara li tgħattab fl-inċident, Pawlu kellu bżonn għajnuna biex jiċċaqlaq.
formal.en: After becoming physically disabled in the accident, Pawlu needed help moving around.
formal.zh: 保罗在事故中出现肢体残障后，需要别人协助行动。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Kif inhu Pawlu wara l-inċident? Lara: Tgħattab u għandu bżonn l-għajnuna biex jiċċaqlaq.
colloquial.en: Marta: How is Pawlu after the accident? Lara: He has become physically disabled and needs help moving around.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：保罗出事故后怎么样了？拉拉：他出现了肢体残障，行动需要别人帮助。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗出事故后怎么样了？
messages.en: How is Pawlu after the accident?

messages.speaker: Lara (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Tgħattab u għandu bżonn l-għajnuna biex jiċċaqlaq.
messages.mt_standard: Tgħattab u għandu bżonn l-għajnuna biex jiċċaqlaq.
messages.zh: 他出现了肢体残障，行动需要别人帮助。
messages.en: He has become physically disabled and needs help moving around.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词和“行动能力受损”的画面联记；两个义项分别记作肢体残障与瘫痪，别把两者完全等同。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become dented or crushed under impact or pressure.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 物体受到撞击或压力后出现凹陷，或被压扁、压碎。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġrilu daqq għal ġewwa jew jitgħaffeġ minħabba daqqa jew pressjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 表面被撞出或压出凹陷。
被压扁、压坏或压碎。

formal.mt: Il-barmil tal-metall tgħattan meta waqgħet fuqu kaxxa tqila.
formal.en: The metal bucket was dented when a heavy box fell onto it.
formal.zh: 一个沉重的箱子掉到金属桶上，把桶砸凹了。

colloquial.mt: Mark: X'ġara lill-barmil? Nina: Waqgħet fuqu kaxxa u tgħattan.
colloquial.en: Mark: What happened to the bucket? Nina: A box fell onto it and dented it.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这个桶怎么了？妮娜：一个箱子掉到上面，把它砸凹了。

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.zh: 这个桶怎么了？
messages.en: What happened to the bucket?

messages.speaker: Nina (同事)
messages.zh: 一个箱子掉到上面，把它砸凹了。
messages.en: A box fell onto it and dented it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象金属桶受压的连续画面：轻一点出现凹陷，重一点整个压扁；两个画面对应两个义项。

gloss_zh: 恢复青春活力；变得年轻有精神

teaching_sense.en_definition: To regain youthful energy or become more youthful in appearance or spirit.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 重新获得青春般的活力，或在外貌、精神状态上显得更年轻。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jerġa' jikseb il-ħeġġa taż-żgħożija jew jidher iżgħar fl-età.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 恢复青春活力，重新显得年轻而有精神。

collocations.zh: 休息后恢复了青春活力

formal.mt: Wara ġimgħa ta' mistrieħ, Ġużeppi tgħattaq u reġa' beda jieħu sehem fl-attivitajiet tar-raħal.
formal.en: After a week of rest, Ġużeppi felt rejuvenated and began taking part in village activities again.
formal.zh: 休息一周后，朱塞佩恢复了活力，又开始参加村里的活动。

colloquial.mt: Sara: In-nannu jidher mimli enerġija llum! Ben: Iva, tgħattaq wara l-vaganza.
colloquial.en: Sara: Grandad looks full of energy today! Ben: Yes, he feels rejuvenated after the holiday.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：爷爷今天看起来精力充沛！本：是啊，度假回来后他又焕发活力了。

messages.speaker: Sara (孙女)
messages.zh: 爷爷今天看起来精力充沛！
messages.en: Grandad looks full of energy today!

messages.speaker: Ben (孙子)
messages.zh: 是啊，度假回来后他又焕发活力了。
messages.en: Yes, he feels rejuvenated after the holiday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象休息过后步伐轻快、笑容增加，像重新年轻了一回；用这个画面记住“恢复青春活力”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To catch one's foot or lose one's footing briefly while walking.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 走路时脚被绊住或短暂失去平衡，踉跄一下。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitlef il-bilanċ għal mument waqt il-mixi, bħal meta siequ taħbat ma' xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 走路时绊了一下或踉跄，未必摔倒。

formal.mt: Il-mixi waqaf għal mument meta wieħed mill-parteċipanti tgħattar ma' ġebla fit-triq.
formal.en: The walk stopped briefly when one of the participants stumbled over a stone in the road.
formal.zh: 一名参与者被路上的石头绊了一下，步行活动因此短暂停了下来。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex waqaf Mark? Toni: Tgħattar ma' ġebla, imma ma waqax.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did Mark stop? Toni: He stumbled over a stone, but he didn't fall.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：马克为什么停下来了？托尼：他被石头绊了一下，不过没摔倒。

messages.speaker: Lara (同行朋友)
messages.zh: 马克为什么停下来了？
messages.en: Why did Mark stop?

messages.speaker: Toni (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tgħattar ma' ġebla, imma ma waqax.
messages.mt_standard: Tgħattar ma' ġebla, imma ma waqax.
messages.zh: 他被石头绊了一下，不过没摔倒。
messages.en: He stumbled over a stone, but he didn't fall.

cognitive_memory_aid: 脑中播放“脚碰石头、身体晃一下”的小片段；重点是绊了一下，不必真的摔倒。

gloss_zh: 被装上门槛；加设了门槛

teaching_sense.en_definition: To have a threshold fitted at a doorway.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 门口被加装门槛，成为设有门槛的入口。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikollu għatba mqiegħda fil-qiegħ tal-bieb.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be provided with a threshold
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被加装门槛，设有门槛。

collocations.en: was fitted with a stone threshold
was fitted with a threshold during restoration
collocations.zh: 在修复过程中加装了门槛

formal.mt: Waqt ir-restawr tad-dar, il-bieb ta' barra tgħatteb b'għatba tal-ġebel.
formal.en: During the restoration of the house, the outer doorway was fitted with a stone threshold.
formal.zh: 房屋修复期间，外门口加装了一道石门槛。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inbidel fil-bieb ta' barra? Pawlu: Tgħatteb b'għatba tal-ġebel.
colloquial.en: Maja: What has changed at the outer doorway? Pawlu: It has been fitted with a stone threshold.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：外门口有什么变化？保罗：那里装上了石门槛。

messages.speaker: Maja (屋主)
messages.zh: 外门口有什么变化？
messages.en: What has changed at the outer doorway?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (工匠)
messages.zh: 那里装上了石门槛。
messages.en: It has been fitted with a stone threshold.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把注意力放在门口底部：原来空着的位置装上一条门槛；用“门口有了门槛”的变化记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To have one's surface scraped, for example to remove material from it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表面受到刮擦，例如通过刮擦去掉附着的材料。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikollu l-wiċċ mibrux, pereżempju biex jitneħħa materjal minn fuqu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被刮擦，表面经过刮削处理。

collocations.en: was scraped to remove the paint

formal.mt: Il-ħajt tgħattel biex titneħħa ż-żebgħa l-qadima qabel ma nżebagħ mill-ġdid.
formal.en: The wall was scraped to remove the old paint before it was repainted.
formal.zh: 墙面重新粉刷前，先经过刮擦以去除旧漆。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Il-ħajt lest għaż-żebgħa? Mark: Iva, tgħattel dalgħodu u issa nadif.
colloquial.en: Rita: Is the wall ready for painting? Mark: Yes, it was scraped this morning and is clean now.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：墙面可以刷漆了吗？马克：可以了，今天早上刮过，现在很干净。

messages.speaker: Rita (屋主)
messages.zh: 墙面可以刷漆了吗？
messages.en: Is the wall ready for painting?

messages.speaker: Mark (油漆工)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, tgħattel dalgħodu u issa nadif.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, tgħattel dalgħodu u issa nadif.
messages.zh: 可以了，今天早上刮过，现在很干净。
messages.en: Yes, it was scraped this morning and is clean now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象刮刀贴着墙面移动，旧漆一片片脱落；把这个词记成“表面被刮过”的动作结果。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be dug out by removing material to make a hollow or channel.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过挖去材料而被挖出或挖空，形成空腔、沟槽等。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitħaffer billi jitneħħa materjal biex tinħoloq ħofra jew kanal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被挖出或挖空，通过挖掘形成空间。

collocations.en: was dug out in the soil
was dug out on the inside

formal.mt: Kanal żgħir tgħawwar fil-ħamrija biex l-ilma jgħaddi lejn il-ġnien.
formal.en: A small channel was dug out in the soil so that water could flow towards the garden.
formal.zh: 土里挖出了一条小沟，让水流向花园。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dan it-tronk għadu mimli minn ġewwa? Toni: Le, tgħawwar biex isir qasrija.
colloquial.en: Nina: Is this log still solid inside? Toni: No, it was dug out to make a planter.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这段树干里面还是实心的吗？托尼：不是，里面挖空了，要做成花盆。

messages.speaker: Nina (园艺爱好者)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan it-tronk għadu mimli minn ġewwa?
messages.mt_standard: Dan it-tronk għadu mimli minn ġewwa?
messages.zh: 这段树干里面还是实心的吗？
messages.en: Is this log still solid inside?

messages.speaker: Toni (园丁)
messages.zh: 不是，里面挖空了，要做成花盆。
messages.en: No, it was dug out to make a planter.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象不断取走泥土或树干内部材料，最后留下沟槽或空腔；记住重点是“挖去后形成空间”。

gloss_zh: 使自己养成某种习惯，通常指坏习惯

teaching_sense.en_definition: To get oneself into the habit of doing something, usually something undesirable.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使自己逐渐习惯某种行为，通常指养成不良习惯。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jidra jagħmel xi ħaġa, ġeneralment xi ħaġa li ssir drawwa ħażina.

sense_translations.en_definition: to habituate oneself to sth. (usually a bad habit)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使自己习惯某事或某种行为，通常指养成坏习惯。

collocations.en: got into the habit of going to bed late
got into the habit of arriving late

formal.mt: Matul il-vaganzi, Daniel tgħawwed jorqod tard u sabha diffiċli jerġa' jqum kmieni għall-iskola.
formal.en: During the holidays, Daniel got into the habit of going to bed late and found it difficult to get up early for school again.
formal.zh: 假期里，丹尼尔养成了晚睡的习惯，开学后发现重新早起很困难。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Daniel dejjem jasal tard? Ben: Tgħawwed joħroġ mid-dar fl-aħħar minuta.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why does Daniel always arrive late? Ben: He has got into the habit of leaving home at the last minute.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：丹尼尔为什么总迟到？本：他养成了拖到最后一刻才出门的习惯。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 丹尼尔为什么总迟到？
messages.en: Why does Daniel always arrive late?

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.zh: 他养成了拖到最后一刻才出门的习惯。
messages.en: He has got into the habit of leaving home at the last minute.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“今天拖一下、明天又拖一下、最后成了习惯”的连续画面记忆；这个词通常带有坏习惯的意味。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become deceitful and begin misleading others through dishonest words or actions.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变得不诚实、狡诈，开始用言语或行为欺骗别人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir qarrieqi u jibda jqarraq b'ħaddieħor bi kliemu jew bl-għemil tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得狡诈；开始以欺骗的方式待人。

collocations.en: became deceitful to gain an advantage
collocations.zh: 为了占便宜而变得狡诈

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-karattru tgħawwel biex jieħu vantaġġ minn dawk li kienu jafdawh.
formal.en: In the story, the character became deceitful to take advantage of those who trusted him.
formal.zh: 故事中，这个人物为了利用信任自己的人而变得狡诈。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex m'għadekx tafda lil Pawlu? Mark: Għax tgħawwel u beda jqarraq bina.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why don't you trust Pawlu anymore? Mark: Because he became deceitful and started tricking us.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你为什么不再信任保罗了？马克：因为他变得不诚实，开始骗我们了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么不再信任保罗了？
messages.en: Why don't you trust Pawlu anymore?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax tgħawwel u beda jqarraq bina.
messages.mt_standard: Għax tgħawwel u beda jqarraq bina.
messages.zh: 因为他变得不诚实，开始骗我们了。
messages.en: Because he became deceitful and started tricking us.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象故事人物从坦诚说话变成处处设套，重点记住“变得狡诈”的变化过程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To swim; also, of a fish, to float in the water rather than swim along the seabed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 游泳；也指鱼浮游于水中，而非沿海底游动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jgħum; jingħad ukoll għal ħut li jibqa' f'wiċċ l-ilma jew f'nofs l-ilma u ma jgħumx mal-qiegħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 游泳；在水中游动。

sense_translations.en_definition: to float (used of fish which do not swim along the seabed)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 浮游于水中，指不沿海底游动的鱼。

formal.mt: Matul l-osservazzjoni, il-ħut baqa' jitgħawwem f'nofs l-ilma mingħajr ma niżel mal-qiegħ.
formal.en: During the observation, the fish remained floating in midwater without descending to the seabed.
formal.zh: 观察期间，鱼一直浮游在水体中层，没有下到海底。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-kelb daħal fl-ilma? Mark: Iva, u tgħawwem sa ħdejja.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did the dog go into the water? Mark: Yes, and he swam over to me.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：狗下水了吗？马克：下了，还游到了我身边。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 狗下水了吗？
messages.en: Did the dog go into the water?

messages.speaker: Mark (狗主人)
messages.zh: 下了，还游到了我身边。
messages.en: Yes, and he swam over to me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先想狗划水游向岸边，再想鱼悬游在水中；鱼的义项要记住“不贴海底”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To bend out of a straight shape, or to twist one's body into an unusual position.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由直变弯，或把自己的身体扭成不寻常的姿势。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jieħu għamla mgħawġa, jew idawwar ġismu f'pożizzjoni mhux tas-soltu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 弯曲；变弯。
扭曲自己的身体；把身体扭成不自然的姿势。

collocations.en: twisted his body to get through

formal.mt: Waqt it-test, il-virga tal-metall tgħawġet taħt il-piż.
formal.en: During the test, the metal rod bent under the weight.
formal.zh: 测试期间，金属杆在重压下弯曲了。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex tgħawweġ hekk Mark? Lara: Biex jgħaddi mill-fetħa żgħira.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Mark twist his body like that? Lara: To get through the small opening.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克为什么把身体扭成那样？拉拉：为了从那个小开口挤过去。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克为什么把身体扭成那样？
messages.en: Why did Mark twist his body like that?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 为了从那个小开口挤过去。
messages.en: To get through the small opening.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把直铁丝弯成弧线，再想象人扭身穿过窄缝，用两个动作记住两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A feeling of discomfort or upset, usually in the stomach.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种不舒服、难受的感觉，通常指胃部不适。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sens ta' skumdità jew taqlib, l-aktar fl-istonku.

sense_translations.en_definition: discomfort or upset (usually referring to stomach upset)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 不适、难受，通常指胃部不舒服或肠胃不适。

formal.mt: Wara l-ikla, il-parteċipant irrapporta sens ta' tgħaxwix fl-istonku.
formal.en: After the meal, the participant reported a feeling of stomach discomfort.
formal.zh: 用餐后，参与者报告说感到胃部不适。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandi tgħaxwix fl-istonku. Lara: Trid toqgħod bilqiegħda ftit?
colloquial.en: Maja: My stomach feels upset. Lara: Do you want to sit down for a bit?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我胃里不太舒服。拉拉：你想坐一会儿吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我胃里不太舒服。
messages.en: My stomach feels upset.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你想坐一会儿吗？
messages.en: Do you want to sit down for a bit?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象饭后捂着胃说“不太舒服”，把这个名词和胃部难受的感觉一起记。

gloss_zh: 恢复精神；在傍晚发生；笑得发软；昏厥

teaching_sense.en_definition: To feel refreshed; in other senses, to happen in the evening, become weak from hearty laughter, or swoon or faint.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 感到精神恢复、舒畅；其他义项包括在傍晚发生、因大笑而浑身发软，以及昏厥。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iħossu mġedded; f'tifsiriet oħra, jiġri filgħaxija, iħossu bla saħħa bid-daħk, jew jintilef minn sensih.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 恢复精神；感到舒畅、清爽。
在傍晚发生；发生于晚间。

sense_translations.en_definition: to feel weak as a result of hearty laughter
sense_translations.zh_definition: 因开怀大笑而感到身体发软、无力。
昏厥；晕倒；暂时失去知觉。

collocations.en: felt refreshed by the fresh air
collocations.zh: 因清新空气而感到精神恢复

collocations.en: became weak from laughing so hard

formal.mt: Wara s-sigħat twal fis-sala magħluqa, il-viżitatur ħareġ fil-ġnien u tgħaxxa bl-arja friska.
formal.en: After long hours in the enclosed hall, the visitor went out into the garden and felt refreshed by the fresh air.
formal.zh: 在封闭的大厅里待了很久后，来访者走进花园，清新的空气让他恢复了精神。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Pawlu għoġbitu ċ-ċajta? Mark: U kif! Tgħaxxa bid-daħk.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did Pawlu like the joke? Mark: Absolutely! He laughed so hard he went weak.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：保罗喜欢那个笑话吗？马克：可喜欢了！他笑得浑身发软。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗喜欢那个笑话吗？
messages.en: Did Pawlu like the joke?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 可喜欢了！他笑得浑身发软。
messages.en: Absolutely! He laughed so hard he went weak.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用四张独立画面记忆：吹风恢复精神、傍晚发生事情、笑得发软、突然晕倒；不要混成同一种感受。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To feel delighted by something or become deeply absorbed in its beauty or pleasure.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因某事物而欣喜，或深深沉浸在其美好与愉悦之中。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iħoss ferħ kbir b'xi ħaġa jew jintilef fil-ġmiel u l-pjaċir tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 感到欣喜；十分高兴。
陶醉；心醉神迷；深深沉浸于美好感受之中。

formal.mt: Matul il-kunċert, l-udjenza tgħaxxqet bil-mużika u semgħet fis-skiet.
formal.en: During the concert, the audience was enraptured by the music and listened in silence.
formal.zh: 音乐会期间，观众陶醉于音乐，静静地聆听。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Missierek ħa gost fil-ġnien? Lara: Iva, tgħaxxaq bil-fjuri u baqa' jħares lejhom.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did your father enjoy the garden? Lara: Yes, he was delighted by the flowers and kept looking at them.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你爸爸在花园里玩得开心吗？拉拉：开心，他特别喜欢那些花，一直看个不停。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你爸爸在花园里玩得开心吗？
messages.en: Did your father enjoy the garden?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, tgħaxxaq bil-fjuri u baqa' jħares lejhom.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, tgħaxxaq bil-fjuri u baqa' jħares lejhom.
messages.zh: 开心，他特别喜欢那些花，一直看个不停。
messages.en: Yes, he was delighted by the flowers and kept looking at them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象听音乐时从微笑欣喜到闭眼陶醉，用感受加深的画面区分两个义项。

gloss_zh: 按十计数；须缴纳什一税

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be counted in groups of ten, or to be required to pay a tithe, a payment of one tenth.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被按十个一组计数；或被要求缴纳十分之一作为什一税。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħadd fi gruppi ta' għaxra, jew ikollu jħallas parti minn kull għaxra bħala taxxa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被按十个一组计数；以十为单位计算。

sense_translations.en_definition: to have to pay a tithe
sense_translations.zh_definition: 须缴纳什一税，即缴出十分之一。

collocations.en: to be counted in tens during counting
collocations.zh: 计数时按十个一组计算

collocations.en: to be obliged to pay a tithe

formal.mt: Fl-eżempju tal-lezzjoni, il-bidwi kellu jitgħaxxar: minn kull għaxar xkejjer tal-qamħ, kellu jagħti waħda bħala taxxa.
formal.en: In the lesson's example, the farmer had to pay a tithe: for every ten sacks of wheat, he had to give one as tax.
formal.zh: 在课堂例子中，农民须缴纳什一税：每十袋小麦中，他必须交出一袋作为税款。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex il-bidwi fl-eżerċizzju ta xkora minn kull għaxra? Mark: Għax kellu jitgħaxxar, jiġifieri jagħti parti minn kull għaxra bħala taxxa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did the farmer in the exercise give one sack out of every ten? Mark: Because he had to pay a tithe, meaning one tenth as tax.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：练习里的农民为什么每十袋要交出一袋？马克：因为他须缴纳什一税，也就是交出十分之一作为税款。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex il-bidwi fl-eżerċizzju ta xkora minn kull għaxra?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex il-bidwi fl-eżerċizzju ta xkora minn kull għaxra?
messages.zh: 练习里的农民为什么每十袋要交出一袋？
messages.en: Why did the farmer in the exercise give one sack out of every ten?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax kellu jitgħaxxar, jiġifieri jagħti parti minn kull għaxra bħala taxxa.
messages.mt_standard: Għax kellu jitgħaxxar, jiġifieri jagħti parti minn kull għaxra bħala taxxa.
messages.zh: 因为他须缴纳什一税，也就是交出十分之一作为税款。
messages.en: Because he had to pay a tithe, meaning one tenth as tax.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画十个小袋：先每十袋分一组记“按十计数”，再圈出一袋记“缴纳十分之一”。

gloss_zh: 失去精力；活力减退；变得虚弱

teaching_sense.en_definition: To lose energy, strength, or vigour and become feeble.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 精力、体力或活力逐渐减退，变得虚弱无力。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitlef l-enerġija, is-saħħa jew il-ħeġġa u jsir dgħajjef.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 失去精力；变得没有精神。
失去活力；原有的劲头或旺盛状态减退。
变得虚弱；身体变得衰弱无力。

formal.mt: Wara l-marda, ir-raġel tgħaxxex u ma setax ikompli bix-xogħol ta' kuljum bħas-soltu.
formal.en: After the illness, the man became feeble and could not carry on with his daily work as usual.
formal.zh: 患病后，这名男子变得虚弱，无法像往常一样继续日常工作。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex Pawlu waqaf jimxi? Mark: Tgħaxxex bil-għeja u kellu bżonn jistrieħ.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did Pawlu stop walking? Mark: He became weak with fatigue and needed to rest.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：保罗为什么停下来不走了？马克：他累得没力气了，需要休息。

messages.speaker: Lara (同行朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗为什么停下来不走了？
messages.en: Why did Pawlu stop walking?

messages.speaker: Mark (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tgħaxxex bil-għeja u kellu bżonn jistrieħ.
messages.mt_standard: Tgħaxxex bil-għeja u kellu bżonn jistrieħ.
messages.zh: 他累得没力气了，需要休息。
messages.en: He became weak with fatigue and needed to rest.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象电量格逐渐减少：先没精神，再没劲头，最后身体虚弱，用同一画面记住三个侧重点。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be made to act or move more quickly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受到催促，被要求加快行动或做事的速度。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġi mġiegħel jagħmel xi ħaġa jew jimxi aktar malajr.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被催促赶快；被迫加快速度。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem tgħaġġel mill-kap biex ilesti r-rapport qabel il-laqgħa.
formal.en: The worker was hurried by the boss into finishing the report before the meeting.
formal.zh: 上司催促这名员工在会议之前完成报告。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex Mark telaq daqshekk malajr? Lara: Tgħaġġel minn ħuh, li kien qed jistennieh fil-karozza.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did Mark leave so quickly? Lara: His brother, who was waiting for him in the car, hurried him along.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：马克为什么走得那么急？拉拉：他哥哥在车里等他，催着他赶快走。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克为什么走得那么急？
messages.en: Why did Mark leave so quickly?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tgħaġġel minn ħuh, li kien qed jistennieh fil-karozza.
messages.mt_standard: Tgħaġġel minn ħuh, li kien qed jistennieh fil-karozza.
messages.zh: 他哥哥在车里等他，催着他赶快走。
messages.en: His brother, who was waiting for him in the car, hurried him along.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象有人在旁边不停催“快一点”，把本条的意思记成“被催着加快”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To grow old or become physically weak and infirm.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 逐渐年老，或身体变得衰弱、行动能力下降。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jixjieħ jew isir dgħajjef f'saħħtu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变老；逐渐年老。
变得体弱；身体逐渐衰弱。

formal.mt: Maż-żmien, ir-raġel tgħaġġeż u beda jeħtieġ aktar għajnuna fil-ħajja ta' kuljum.
formal.en: Over time, the man grew old and infirm and began to need more help in daily life.
formal.zh: 随着时间推移，这名男子年老体弱，开始在日常生活中需要更多帮助。

colloquial.mt: Nina: In-nannu għadu joħroġ waħdu? Pawlu: Tgħaġġeż ftit; issa mmur miegħu meta jkollu bżonn.
colloquial.en: Nina: Does Grandpa still go out on his own? Pawlu: He's become a little frail; now I go with him when he needs me.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：爷爷现在还独自出门吗？保罗：他身体有些衰弱了；现在他需要时，我会陪他去。

messages.speaker: Nina (孙女)
messages.zh: 爷爷现在还独自出门吗？
messages.en: Does Grandpa still go out on his own?

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“岁月过去，人渐渐变老，身体也可能变弱”的画面连接两个义项。

gloss_zh: 身体逐渐变胖、变丰腴的过程

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of the body becoming fatter or more corpulent.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体逐渐变得更胖、更丰腴的过程，强调变化而非某一时刻的体型。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih il-ġisem isir aktar smin.

sense_translations.en_definition: the process of becoming more corpulent
sense_translations.zh_definition: 身体变得更加肥胖或丰腴的过程。

collocations.zh: 身体变得更丰腴的过程

formal.mt: Id-deskrizzjoni ssemmi tġissim gradwali tal-karattru matul is-snin.
formal.en: The description mentions the character gradually becoming more corpulent over the years.
formal.zh: 这段描写提到了该人物多年来逐渐变得丰腴的过程。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex dan il-karattru jidher aktar smin f'kull stampa? Lara: L-istampi juru t-tġissim tiegħu matul is-snin.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why does this character look fatter in each picture? Lara: The pictures show him becoming more corpulent over the years.
colloquial.zh: Maja：为什么这个人物在每张图里都显得更胖了？Lara：这些图展示了他多年来逐渐变得丰腴的过程。

messages.speaker: Maja (读者)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex dan il-karattru jidher aktar smin f'kull stampa?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex dan il-karattru jidher aktar smin f'kull stampa?
messages.zh: 为什么这个人物在每张图里都显得更胖了？
messages.en: Why does this character look fatter in each picture?

messages.mt_spoken: L-istampi juru t-tġissim tiegħu matul is-snin.
messages.mt_standard: L-istampi juru t-tġissim tiegħu matul is-snin.
messages.zh: 这些图展示了他多年来逐渐变得丰腴的过程。
messages.en: The pictures show him becoming more corpulent over the years.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象同一个人的连续画像，身形一幅比一幅丰腴；这个词给整段“逐渐变胖的过程”命名，属于名词。
